Next, proceed to the water pump station at the end of Export Lane to collect three empty chemical drums. Deliver the empty drums to the chemical storage zone behind the main processing building, then return to the spare parts shed to await further assignments.

Drive to the fertilizer storage barn and pick up two sealed barrels of organic fertilizer. Transport the barrels to Crop Field West. Wait for the field operator to unload the barrels from the robot, then proceed to the storage area behind the equipment shed and stand by for further tasks.

Proceed to the orchard entrance and collect four empty harvest bins. Take the bins to Orchard Row 7. Wait while the farmhands fill each bin with apples. After all bins are loaded, deliver the full bins to the packing barn and wait until the bins are completely unloaded from the robot.

Travel to the vineyard maintenance tent and pick up two coils of repair wire and a toolbox. Deliver these items to the southern trellis row for the maintenance team. Wait at the southern trellis row until the toolbox is removed from the robot. Then, proceed to the composting site beside the equipment shed and retrieve one empty compost bin. Carry the empty bin to the cafeteria loading dock for cleaning. Wait for 12 minutes to allow cafeteria staff to unload the bin. Once finished, return to the equipment shed and await further tasks.

Proceed to the irrigation control station and collect two replacement water filters. Transport the filters to the south orchard entrance, deliver them to the maintenance team, and wait for 5 minutes before returning to the storage facility.

Proceed to the fertilizer storage shed and collect one pallet of nitrogen fertilizer bags. Navigate to field plot 7 and deliver the pallet next to the irrigation pump station. Wait for the field crew to remove the fertilizer bags from the pallet. Once the pallet is empty, transport it to the recycling area adjacent to the admin building. Wait there for 10 minutes for further instructions.

Drive to the maintenance garage and pick up two sealed toolboxes. Transport the toolboxes to Wind Turbine Station 3 on the northern field. Wait until a technician removes both toolboxes from the robot, then proceed to the supply depot for your next assignment.

Proceed to the workshop garage and collect two sealed containers of lubricating oil. Deliver the containers to the irrigation pump station by the east field. Upon arrival, wait until both containers are unloaded by the maintenance crew. After unloading is complete, return to the workshop garage and stand by for 5 minutes before the next task.

Drive to the equipment shed, pick up a set of pruning shears and three spools of nylon wire, then transport them to vineyard sector 7. Wait for the vineyard crew to retrieve the items, and once unloaded, proceed to the refueling station before returning to the equipment shed.

Travel to the maintenance garage and pick up a toolbox and two spare hydraulic hoses. Proceed to the north orchard service lane and deliver the items to the repair crew. Wait at the location until a technician confirms receipt of all parts, then return to the garage for your next assignment.

Travel to the seed storage hut behind the greenhouse and pick up three sacks of corn seed. Deliver the sacks to the south field staging area. Wait for 10 minutes while the field crew unloads the seed, then proceed to the equipment wash station and wait to be washed before returning to your docking bay.

Travel to the maintenance shed and pick up two spare tires. Deliver the tires to the equipment repair yard and wait until a technician removes them from the robot. After the tires have been unloaded, proceed to the fuel depot and wait for 10 minutes before awaiting your next assignment.

Drive to the greenhouse loading bay and pick up three trays of young tomato seedlings. Navigate to field section B, near the southern irrigation line, and deliver the trays. Wait for the field staff to finish transplanting seedlings and remove the empty trays. Once the trays are empty, collect them and return to the greenhouse loading bay. After arrival, wait for 5 minutes in standby mode for possible new tasks.

Proceed to the spare parts depot near the machine sheds and collect a sealed box of tractor filters. Drive to the repair bay behind Factory 2, deliver the box to the maintenance supervisor at the bay entrance, and wait until the supervisor confirms receipt of all filters. Once unloaded, continue to the greenhouse complex main gate. Pick up two containers of nutrient solution from the delivery cart and transport them to the hydroponic station inside the central greenhouse. Wait for 7 minutes while technicians fill the tanks, then return to the spare parts depot.

Travel to the main greenhouse and collect two containers of organic fertilizer. Transport the fertilizer to Plot C near the irrigation pond. Wait at Plot C until the greenhouse supervisor confirms the containers are unloaded. After receiving confirmation, proceed to the machinery garage for scheduled maintenance.

Navigate to the grain silo on the northwest field edge and collect two 50-kilogram sacks of fertilizer. Deliver the sacks to plot number 3 in the vegetable garden. Wait at the delivery site for 10 minutes to allow field workers to unload the fertilizer. Following completion, proceed to the tool barn and await further loading instructions.

Travel to the vineyard supply shed and collect a crate of replacement grape trellises. Deliver the crate to the southern vineyard plot. Wait until the maintenance team has removed the crate from the robot. Afterwards, proceed to the irrigation control center and remain there for 12 minutes to oversee scheduled system checks, then return to the vineyard supply shed.

Proceed to the vineyard loading area and pick up three crates of harvested grapes. Deliver the crates to the cold storage facility by Warehouse B. Wait at the cold storage facility until all the crates are unloaded, then travel to the equipment shelter to await further instructions from the operations manager.

Proceed to the orchard storage shed and pick up three baskets of harvested pears. Transport the baskets to the central packing station beside the distribution barn. Wait for up to 15 minutes while the packing crew unloads all baskets. Return to the orchard storage shed once the task is complete.

Drive to the greenhouse storage room and pick up four flats of young tomato seedlings. Transport the seedlings to the west garden plots near the compost bins. Wait for 10 minutes while the gardening team unloads all the seedlings. After unloading is complete, proceed to the equipment shed at the north end of the fields and wait for the maintenance supervisor to load a box of replacement sprinkler heads onto the robot. When the box is loaded, deliver it to the irrigation control kiosk by the southern hedgerow. Once the box has been removed, return to the greenhouse storage room.

Drive to the orchard storage barn and collect three empty harvest bins. Transport the bins to the southeast apple grove, wait for 15 minutes while harvesters fill the bins, then deliver the filled bins to the packing station near the north gate. Once unloaded, remain at the packing station until further instructions.

Proceed to the materials depot and pick up four rolls of irrigation tubing. Drive to the east orchard entrance and wait for 5 minutes for the installation crew to arrive. Once the crew signals, deliver the tubing beside the worker's staging tent. Wait until the crew removes all tubing from the robot. After unloading, travel to the north storage compound and collect a set of empty wooden crates. Return the empty crates to the materials depot and await further instructions.

Travel to the maintenance garage and collect two replacement hydraulic hoses. Proceed to the vineyard equipment zone and deliver the hoses to the machinery technician. Wait at the equipment zone for up to 12 minutes in case any used hoses need to be returned. If given used hoses, transport them back to the maintenance garage.

Head to the seed storage barn located next to the north field. Collect three bags of organic fertilizer from the storage barn. Transport these fertilizer bags to Plot 7 on the east side of the property. Wait at Plot 7 until all bags have been completely unloaded by the field crew. When the unloading is finished, proceed to the farm's irrigation control room and stand by for further instructions.

Navigate to the greenhouse loading bay and pick up three containers of organic fertilizer. Deliver these containers to plot section B2 in the vegetable garden. Wait until the containers have been unloaded by the gardening staff. Once unloaded, proceed to the nearby composting area and collect two bags of compost. Return the compost bags to the greenhouse loading bay and wait for the head horticulturist to inspect the delivery before leaving the area.

Proceed to the maintenance depot near the east gate and pick up one replacement hydraulic pump. Navigate to the north vineyard equipment shelter and deliver the hydraulic pump. Wait until a technician unloads the pump from the robot, then move to the main path and await further instructions for 5 minutes before returning to standby at the central garage.

Drive to the seed storage barn located behind the main farmhouse and collect six bags of wheat seeds. Navigate to field plot 12 on the eastern boundary and deliver the seed bags to the planting team. After delivering the seeds, wait for 10 minutes while the team inspects and sorts the bags. Once the waiting period is complete, proceed to the fuel depot adjacent to the storage barn and pick up a fuel canister. Transport the fuel canister to the tractor parking area near field plot 4, and wait until a farm operator removes the canister from you before returning to the seed storage barn.

Travel to the barn storage area beside the south paddock and pick up three sacks of poultry feed. Drive to the free-range chicken enclosure near the windbreak trees and deliver the poultry feed. Wait until all sacks have been unloaded by the animal care team. Once unloading is finished, proceed to the equipment wash bay and stand by for 10 minutes for potential cleaning operations.

Proceed to the parts storage annex and collect a replacement hydraulic hose and two bottles of lubricant. Convey these items to the tractor repair area located behind the north barn. On arrival, wait for the maintenance crew to retrieve the hydraulic hose from the robot. After the item is removed, travel to the orchard's midpoint tool cache and collect any empty spray canisters found there. Deliver the empty canisters to the chemical supply depot beside the weather station. Upon delivery, wait for 10 minutes to allow staff to inspect and record the returns. Afterward, return to the main garage and park near the charging station.

Travel to the chemical storage shed and pick up a sealed canister of pesticide. Transport the canister to the southwest vineyard and wait until a field technician retrieves it from the robot. After delivery, proceed to the irrigation control booth and stand by for 5 minutes to assist with monitoring system operations. Finally, return to the south gate maintenance area.

Proceed to the orchard equipment shed and collect two spare tractor wheels. Drive to field plot 7 and deliver the wheels near the north boundary. Wait for 10 minutes while the maintenance crew installs the wheels onto the tractor. Once the parts have been unloaded from the robot, continue to the administrative office foyer and wait until a staff member loads a box of paperwork onto the robot. Transport this box to the archives room in the main compound and wait for the box to be removed before returning to the charging station behind the packing facility.

Go to the packing shed at the southern orchard and collect a pallet of empty apple cartons. Transport the pallet to the apple picking area at the west grove. Wait for 12 minutes while workers load freshly picked apples into the cartons. Once loading is complete, carry the filled cartons to the produce weighing station beside the barn. After delivering the cartons, proceed to the maintenance garage and stand by for your next assignment.

Proceed to the irrigation control station located near the northern greenhouse, retrieve the sealed toolbox, and deliver it to the maintenance area behind the equipment storage barn. Upon arrival, wait until a technician removes the toolbox from the robot, then return to the charging post by the main entrance road.

Proceed to the storage silo near the eastern field and collect three bags of granular fertilizer. Deliver the fertilizer bags to the compost preparation area adjacent to the greenhouse. Wait for 10 minutes while the horticulture team unloads the bags and prepares their mixture. Once the bags are removed, drive to the equipment charging station, wait there for 8 minutes to allow for auxiliary device maintenance, and finally navigate back to the storage silo to await further instructions.

Travel to the main orchard supply depot and collect two crates of pollination drones and a single canister of maintenance oil. Bring these items to the north orchard control hub. Wait for the technical team to unload both crates and the oil. Once unloaded, proceed to the west fence access gate for a routine perimeter check, wait there for 6 minutes, then return to the main orchard supply depot.

Begin at the central equipment depot and pick up two empty water tanks. Travel to the cattle pasture in the southern section of the farm. Wait until the tanks are filled by the farm workers. Once filling is complete, deliver the now-full water tanks to the shade shelter near the orchard. After unloading the tanks, return to the central equipment depot and await your next assignment.

Begin at the orchard loading zone and pick up three crates filled with freshly harvested apples. Transport the crates to the packing shed on the west side of the property. Upon arrival, wait for the packing crew to unload the crates, which should be completed within 7 minutes. After unloading is complete, proceed to the maintenance shack near the irrigation pond to collect a set of replacement sprinkler heads. Deliver the sprinkler heads to the field supervisor waiting at vineyard plot 3 and stand by until they have taken all parts, then return to the orchard loading zone.

Start at the equipment garage beside the south field fence and collect a box containing drone batteries. Deliver the box to the control station overlooking wheat field 4, and wait until the field technician removes all batteries from the robot. Proceed to the fertilizer storage shed next to the gravel road beyond the cattle pen, pick up two large sacks of organic fertilizer, and deliver them to the garden plots behind the horticulture classroom. Wait for 5 minutes as the gardening crew unloads the sacks. Once unloading is complete, head back to the equipment garage.

Travel to the fertilizer storage shed near the north fence and pick up two sealed fertilizer bags. Deliver the bags to the greenhouse loading area. Wait for 10 minutes while workers distribute some of the fertilizer, then collect any remaining bags. Return the leftover bags to the fertilizer storage shed and remain there, ready for the next task.

Drive to the greenhouse loading zone behind the equipment shed and pick up three trays of young tomato seedlings. Deliver the trays to the seedling propagation tent near the northern irrigation tanks. Wait for the horticultural staff to transfer the seedlings from the robot. After the transfer is complete, move to the compost collection area behind the main barn and stand by for 10 minutes until the compost manager signals the next task.

Go to the main orchard entrance and pick up a bundle of replacement tree stakes. Transport the bundle to the apple grove maintenance area near the irrigation reservoir. Wait until all stakes have been unloaded by the farm staff. Next, proceed to the solar-powered tool charging station behind the barn, collect a crate of freshly charged pruning shears, and deliver them to the vineyard plot A adjacent to the hillside trail. After confirming the crate has been removed, travel to the vehicle bay for standby until further instructions.

Drive to the seed storage barn and pick up five sacks of winter rye seeds. Deliver these sacks to the planting crew at the south end of field parcel C, and wait for 20 minutes while the crew distributes the seeds along the planting rows. Once the robot has been unloaded, proceed directly to the maintenance garage and wait until a mechanic places two toolboxes on the robot. Take these toolboxes to the solar panel array utility station for use in routine maintenance, and remain there until the toolboxes have been removed by the technician before departing.

Start at the maintenance room and retrieve a spare hydraulic hose. Proceed to the east boundary irrigation pump station and wait until the repair crew arrives to install the hose. Once installation is confirmed, transport the removed faulty hose back to the maintenance room, and then remain on standby for 15 minutes for potential urgent deliveries.

Begin at the equipment depot next to the machinery shed and collect three sealed pesticide drums and one empty pallet. Transport the pesticide drums to the citrus grove spray station near the southern fence line. Wait until each drum has been unloaded by the spray crew. After all drums have been removed, proceed to the composting area behind the tool workshop and collect the collected sacks of organic waste awaiting transfer. Deliver the sacks to the bio-processing facility adjacent to the water treatment pond. Upon delivery, wait for 15 minutes for the facility staff to scan and log the incoming materials. Once acknowledged, return to the equipment depot and await further deployment orders.

Begin at the parts storage area and retrieve four sealed chemical canisters. Drive to the greenhouse supply depot and wait for the horticulture supervisor to inspect and sign off on the delivery, for up to 10 minutes. Once approved, unload the chemical canisters at the depot. Then, proceed to the solar charging station near the admin building for a 20-minute recharge before returning to the parts storage area.

Head to the maintenance garage and pick up the spare tire cart. Transport the cart to the machinery repair bay on the east field. Wait until the technician has removed the old tire and placed it onto the cart, then return both the old tire and the cart to the maintenance garage. Once back, remain in standby mode until further notice.

Proceed to the fuel depot located behind the silo and pick up three sealed fuel canisters. Deliver the canisters to the drone charging station at the north end of the vineyard. Wait at the charging station for the on-site operator to unload the canisters. After unloading, drive to the equipment cleaning bay next to the greenhouse and wait for 10 minutes before returning to the main control center.

Proceed to the irrigation equipment shed and collect three coiled hoses. Transport the hoses to the east end of the vineyard, where the irrigation team is stationed. Wait on site for up to 10 minutes as the team unloads all the hoses. After the hoses have been removed, travel to the orchard tool depot to retrieve a large empty crate. Deliver the crate to the central apple-loading dock and remain there until the crate is filled with harvested apples and securely placed back on the robot. Once loaded, return the crate to the orchard tool depot.

Proceed to the spare parts storeroom located behind the central maintenance hangar and collect two crates of replacement hydraulic valves. Transport the crates to the wind turbine service platform on the eastern hilltop. Wait until the maintenance crew unloads both crates from the robot. After unloading, drive to the livestock feed bin near the animal care center and pick up one sack of mineral supplements. Deliver the sack to the nutrition mixing bay inside the feed warehouse. Once the sack is delivered, remain on standby for 10 minutes in the warehouse loading zone before returning to the spare parts storeroom for further instructions.

Travel to the greenhouse supply shed next to the irrigation canal and retrieve four seedling trays. Deliver the trays to Plot B in the southern vegetable field. Wait until the planting crew confirms successful unloading. Next, proceed to the compost collection site behind the barn and pick up two compost bins filled with organic matter. Transport the bins to the orchard mulching area and remain on site for 7 minutes while the orchard workers unload the compost. Afterward, return to the greenhouse supply shed to wait for additional loading.

Travel to the spare parts storage unit located beside the service garage and pick up a box containing assorted mechanical parts. Transport the box to the tractor maintenance bay just south of the grain silos. Wait at the maintenance bay until the repair crew has finished unloading all the mechanical parts from the robot. After the unloading is complete, proceed to the battery charging station near the western entrance of the facility and remain there for 15 minutes before heading back to the spare parts storage unit.

Proceed to the west orchard tool shed and collect one toolbox along with a pair of pruning shears. Transport these items to Vineyard Row 7, next to the compost pile. Wait at the location until the maintenance crew retrieves the tools. Once the toolbox and shears have been unloaded, proceed to the farm garage, and enter standby mode without delay.

Move to the potato storage barn and pick up two sacks of harvested potatoes. Deliver the sacks to the loading platform adjacent to the produce market kiosk. Wait for 8 minutes to allow the market staff to unload the sacks. Once offloaded, drive to the maintenance hut for a scheduled cleaning, and stay there until the cleaning crew has finished and signals you to depart.

Drive to the greenhouse supply room and collect four empty planting trays. Take the trays to the nursery area adjacent to the north field. Wait for the horticulture team to load the trays with young tomato seedlings. After all trays are loaded, transport them to Plot C near the west irrigation ditch and wait 10 minutes for the farm crew to unload the seedlings. Once done, proceed to the equipment shelter and await further assignments.

Navigate to the orchard equipment shed and collect one crate of tree pruning tools. Bring the crate to the east vineyard section, and wait until the field staff unload the equipment. Once unloaded, proceed to the compost transfer zone behind the barn and pick up a sack of animal feed. Deliver the sack to the livestock enclosure and wait for 10 minutes to ensure successful handover before returning to the parking bay for standby.

Travel to the maintenance workshop near the northern orchard entrance and pick up a crate of replacement sprinkler heads. Deliver the crate to the irrigation control point at the center of the vineyard. Wait until the vineyard technician retrieves all sprinkler heads from the robot, then proceed to the compost yard behind the main storage barn. Collect a bundle of empty collection baskets and transport these to the apple harvest zone along field lane 3. Once the baskets are unloaded, return to the maintenance workshop for the next task.

Start at the storage warehouse and collect four sealed bags of fertilizer. Navigate to the tomato field's southern entrance and deliver all fertilizer bags to the supply tent located there. Wait until the field staff finish unloading the bags, which may take up to 8 minutes. After the bags have been removed, proceed to the fuel depot beside the old barn, pick up a single barrel of diesel, and transport it to the generator station near greenhouse 2. Remain at the generator station until the diesel barrel is unloaded, then return to the storage warehouse.

Proceed to the orchard storage hut and pick up three empty produce crates. Transport the crates to the fruit collection station near Field A. Once delivered, wait up to 10 minutes for the workers to load filled fruit crates onto the robot. After receiving the full crates, move them to the cold storage warehouse and unload them at the receiving bay. Finally, return to the orchard storage hut and await further instruction.

Drive to the orchard equipment shed next to the eastern row of apple trees and pick up two empty pesticide containers. Transport the containers to the chemical refilling station by the north perimeter fence. Wait for the station attendant to refill both containers and load them back onto the robot. Once the containers are secured, deliver them to the field supervisor post just beyond the irrigation canal. Wait at the supervisor post for 10 minutes before returning to the orchard equipment shed.

Travel to the seed storage room beside the maintenance garage and pick up two bags of sunflower seeds. Deliver the bags to Field Plot 7 near the south irrigation canal. Wait at Field Plot 7 until the planting team has unloaded both bags. After unloading, proceed to the equipment charging station near the tool depot and remain there on standby until further instructions.

Begin by traveling to the eastern storage shed and retrieve two jugs of organic pesticide. Transport these to the northern field entry point, where the crop-dusting crew will be waiting. Once at the field, wait until both jugs have been unloaded by the crew supervisor. After the transfer, head to the maintenance alleyway next to the machinery garage and collect a box of spare wheel bearings. Finally, deliver the wheel bearings to the harvest equipment lot at the south perimeter fence, and then await further tasks for 10 minutes at the lot.

Proceed to the fertilizer storage barn situated west of the main greenhouse and pick up three nutrient solution drums. Transport the drums to the orchard’s central mixing station. Wait until the station operator has unloaded all drums from your platform. Once the transfer is complete, return to the main operations shed and await further tasks.

Head to the maintenance garage and pick up two sealed battery packs. Deliver the battery packs to the wind turbine relay station at the edge of the northern pasture. Wait for a technician to remove the used battery packs and load the new ones onto the control platform. Once the technician signals that the exchange is complete, return to the maintenance garage for further tasks.

Begin at the storage barn and collect three sacks of fertilizer. Transport the sacks to the northeast corner of the apple orchard. Wait until a farm worker removes all sacks from the robot. Next, proceed to the irrigation control station and pick up a sealed container of water samples. Deliver the container to the field lab located beside the main greenhouse. Wait at the field lab for 7 minutes to allow the lab technician to collect the sample. After completion, return to the storage barn and stand by for the next assignment.

Proceed to the equipment depot beside the eastern irrigation canal and pick up the toolbox marked 'Field Repairs.' Travel to wind turbine station 2 on the southern ridge and deliver the toolbox to the maintenance crew stationed there. Wait at the station until the crew removes the toolbox and places a used hydraulic pump on the robot. Once the hydraulic pump is secured, transport it back to the repair workshop in the central service building and deliver it at the intake counter.

Proceed to the maintenance workshop adjacent to the south gate and pick up a single crate of spare machinery parts. Transport the crate to the tractor storage barn near the east paddock. Wait until the maintenance supervisor has completely unloaded all parts from the robot, then travel to the tool depot beside the irrigation control shed and await further instructions.

Start by traveling to the pallet storage zone adjacent to the southeast warehouse and collect four wooden pallets. Next, navigate to the staging area at the entrance to the apple orchard. Deliver the pallets and wait until the harvest team removes all pallets from the robot. Once the pallets are unloaded, proceed to the solar panel maintenance shed west of the main farm office. Retrieve any used cleaning cloths you find and return them to the central laundry facility behind the cafeteria. Do not wait after the drop-off—immediately proceed to the compost station near the south fence and stand by there for 8 minutes before returning to the maintenance garage for parking.

Head to the irrigation equipment hut near the eastern orchards and pick up the set of replacement sprinklers. Deliver the sprinklers to the grapevine maintenance area beside the stone wall. Wait for 20 minutes while the vineyard staff installs the equipment and removes the empty packaging onto the robot. Return the empty packaging to the recycling zone behind the machinery garage. Once the payload is unloaded, proceed to the shade structure adjacent to the citrus grove and wait for 5 minutes before continuing any further tasks.

Start at the tools workshop and pick up the set of replacement tractor blades. Navigate to the eastern field entrance and deliver the blades to the field technician waiting near the equipment shelter. Stand by for up to 15 minutes while the technician installs one of the blades, then wait for the technician to place two broken blades onto the robot. Afterward, transport the damaged blades to the recycling container area beside the compost facility and wait until the blades are unloaded before finishing the task.

Travel to the equipment charging bay located north of the workshop and pick up two solar battery units. Deliver the battery units to the eastern vineyard maintenance outpost. Wait while the maintenance crew unloads both batteries from your platform. When unloading is finished, proceed to the grape sorting area and wait for 7 minutes before returning to the equipment charging bay.

Go to the battery charging station next to the central barn and wait until a technician attaches two spare lithium-ion battery packs onto the robot. After loading, drive to the remote weather monitoring tower at the southern field edge and deliver the battery packs. Remain at the site for 10 minutes to allow the monitoring team to replace the old batteries and place a container of climate sensor samples onto the robot. Once loaded, return to the central barn and deliver the climate sensor samples to the data processing room inside the barn.

Proceed to the eastern storage barn and pick up five sacks of seed potatoes. Transport the sacks to the north field planting site. Upon arrival, wait for 20 minutes while workers unload the sacks. Once unloading is complete, return to the equipment yard and stand by for the next assignment.

Drive to the lumber storage area located at the eastern boundary of the facility and pick up three wooden pallets. Transport the pallets to the packaging tent near the main entrance. Wait there until all three pallets are offloaded by the packaging staff, then return to the solar charging station adjacent to the greenhouse to recharge.

Travel to the vineyard’s supply shed to retrieve two irrigation control modules. Transport and deliver the control modules to the water pump station beside the west orchard. Remain at the water pump station for 12 minutes to allow technicians to install the modules and complete calibration. Afterwards, proceed to the tool storage facility located next to the main barn to collect a set of four pruning shears. Deliver the shears to the apple grove’s north entrance and wait until all are unloaded before returning directly to the vineyard’s supply shed.

Proceed to the spare parts shed next to the main workshop and collect three replacement hydraulic hoses and a box of assorted fasteners. Transport these items to the repair zone beside the loading dock. Wait until the maintenance crew offloads all parts from the robot. Once the parts have been removed, proceed to the fuel depot at the east perimeter and wait for 10 minutes for a potential refueling task. Afterward, return to the central navigation hub for further instructions.

Begin by driving to the fertilizer storage depot located beside the northern greenhouse. Pick up a single pallet of organic fertilizer. Transport the pallet to the field access gate at Plot 7, on the western boundary of the farm. Wait at the access gate for 12 minutes to allow the field team to remove the entire pallet. Once the pallet is unloaded, proceed to the monitoring station at the top of the eastern hill and await new delivery instructions from the site supervisor.

Head to the greenhouse storage area and pick up two trays of young tomato seedlings. Transport the seedlings to the east orchard planting site. Wait at the planting site until the field crew collects both trays—this process should take no more than 5 minutes. Once the seedlings are handed over, proceed to the weather monitoring station by the north fence and collect the portable soil sensor kit. Deliver the soil sensor kit to the farm manager’s office for calibration. After delivery, wait outside the farm manager’s office for 8 minutes in case additional equipment transport is required.

Navigate to the equipment depot behind the main silo and retrieve two replacement drive belts. Deliver the drive belts to the vehicle maintenance bay near the loading dock. Wait for the repair crew to collect both drive belts from the robot. After the belts have been collected, proceed to the shaded rest area beside the south gate and wait there for 15 minutes before returning to the equipment depot for the next task.

Drive to the greenhouse loading area and pick up a crate of replacement seedlings. Carry the crate to Vegetable Plot C, located adjacent to the irrigation channel. Wait for the field technician to unload the crate from the robot. After the transfer, proceed to the main workshop and collect a small pack of calibration tools. Deliver the calibration tools to the solar array equipment site near the east fence, then return to the central charging station and stand by for 15 minutes.

Proceed to the irrigation pump house behind the west greenhouse and pick up a sealed container of fertilizer solution. Transport the container to the tool shed entrance near the central maintenance path. Wait for 10 minutes while the maintenance crew refills the portable sprayers using the fertilizer. After the container is emptied and removed from the robot, travel to the compost yard at the southwest corner of the farm to await your next assignment.

Travel to the greenhouse complex at the north side of the property and pick up two trays of young tomato plants. Transport the trays to the vegetable plot beside the orchard entrance. Wait until all plants have been unloaded by the planting crew. After delivery, return to the greenhouse complex and stand by for 5 minutes for any additional loading requests.

Proceed to the chemical storage building and retrieve three sealed canisters of fertilizer. Carry the canisters to the west field supply station near the irrigation pumps. Upon arrival, deliver all fertilizer canisters. Wait at the supply station for 10 minutes to be reloaded with any empty canisters, then return all collected empty canisters to the chemical storage building.

Start at the maintenance garage and proceed to the solar equipment yard. Pick up two solar panel cleaning kits. Transport the cleaning kits to the southern greenhouse and deliver them to the tech crew. Once delivered, wait for 7 minutes while the crew finishes setup, then proceed to the weather monitoring station near the pond. At the station, collect a sealed box of weather sensors and bring the box back to the maintenance garage, waiting until the box is unloaded before ending the task.

Proceed to the fertilizer storage barn on the south side of the farm and pick up three sealed containers of liquid fertilizer. Carefully transport the containers to the irrigation control station adjacent to the east greenhouse. Wait for the greenhouse technician to unload the fertilizer containers from your platform. Once the containers have been fully unloaded, drive to the composting area and wait for 5 minutes to allow any residual materials to be cleared by the maintenance crew. After the waiting period, return to the parking area near the weather monitoring tower and stand by for your next task.

Proceed to the packaging warehouse and collect three sealed boxes of harvested strawberries. Navigate to the farmers' market delivery zone at the main entrance of the property. Wait for a market representative to inspect and sign off on the delivery. Once sign-off is complete, offload the boxes and return to the packaging warehouse for further tasks.

Proceed to the western orchard storage shed and pick up three crates of ripe apples. Transport the crates to the market loading zone at the farm’s main entrance. Wait for fifteen minutes while the market staff inspect and label the apples. Once the inspection is complete, proceed to the weather monitoring station near the irrigation pond and wait for further instructions.

Navigate to the vineyard's tool depot and retrieve two irrigation repair kits. Deliver the repair kits to the western grape row maintenance area. Wait until the field crew has removed the kits from your payload compartment. After all items are unloaded, drive to the composting site near the greenhouse to collect three bags of organic mulch. Transport the bags to the orchard's central tree ring zone, and once delivered, remain in position for 5 minutes before returning to the main charging station.

Proceed to the north field edge and collect three crates of freshly harvested potatoes. Deliver these crates to the produce sorting tent near the packing line. Wait for 8 minutes while the staff inspect and unload the potatoes. Afterward, head to the fuel storage shed, pick up a sealed drum of biodiesel, and transport it to the generator station behind the greenhouse. Once the station manager acknowledges delivery and removes the drum, return to the operations hub at the central courtyard.

Proceed to the machinery workshop located behind the central factory building. Pick up a single crate of replacement engine parts and two spare hydraulic hoses. Deliver these items to the maintenance tent near the main solar array on the west side of the facility. Once at the maintenance tent, wait for 10 minutes while the technicians unload the items. Afterward, continue to the equipment cleaning bay adjacent to the staff parking lot to be sanitized before your next assignment.

Proceed to the tool storage shed near the equipment garage and pick up the large toolbox labeled 'Maintenance Kit A'. Transport the toolbox to the wind turbine maintenance zone at the northern boundary of the property. Once you arrive, wait for the maintenance technician to remove the toolbox from your platform. After unloading is complete, continue to the gravel lot at the solar panel field entrance and wait for 10 minutes while further instructions are prepared. Once the waiting period is over, return to the tool storage shed and stand by for your next task.

Proceed to the maintenance garage near the central workshop and pick up two crates of replacement gears. Drive to the assembly line entrance in the production warehouse. Wait until both crates are unloaded by the technical team. Once unloading is complete, continue to the battery charging station adjacent to the vehicle bay and remain there for 10 minutes before awaiting the next assignment.

Start at the equipment storeroom beside the greenhouse and pick up a box containing precision soil sensors. Transport the box to the northern vineyard plot, where the installation team is waiting. Wait until all sensors have been removed from the robot. Then, proceed to the fertilizer shed on the southwest field border and collect three bags of organic fertilizer. Deliver the fertilizer bags to composting site number 2 beside the old orchard and wait for 12 minutes while farm staff unload the bags. After unloading is finished, return to the equipment storeroom beside the greenhouse.

Drive to the livestock barn delivery entrance and pick up two sealed buckets of mineral supplements. Proceed to the south pasture feed station beside the water tank. Wait for 15 minutes while the farmhands distribute the supplements to the herd. Once the buckets have been emptied and removed, continue to the machinery workshop to pick up a replacement hydraulic hose. Deliver the hose to the field maintenance outpost at the edge of the east paddock. After the hose is unloaded, return to the livestock barn delivery entrance.

Head to the orchard supply pavilion next to the south field entrance and collect three crates of irrigation drip lines. Take the crates directly to the fruit orchard block 7 unloading station. Wait up to 12 minutes while the field crew unloads all drip lines from your platform. Once cleared for departure, proceed to the compost yard behind the barn, collect a 20-liter sealed pail of liquid compost additive, and deliver it to the greenhouse potting shed. Upon arrival, wait until the greenhouse attendant removes the pail, then return to the orchard supply pavilion and stand by for further instructions.

Begin at the barn workshop and collect a box of replacement drive belts. Transport the box to the north orchard windmill tower. Wait until the maintenance team has unloaded all contents from your payload platform. Then, proceed to the compost yard and pick up a bag of organic fertilizer. Deliver the fertilizer to the rear entrance of the vegetable garden greenhouse and wait for 5 minutes while the garden staff retrieves it. Finally, return to the barn workshop for system inspection.

Begin at the east field entrance and travel to the seed storage barn. Retrieve four sacks of corn seed. Deliver the sacks to the tractor loading area and wait until the seeds are removed by the planting crew. After unloading, continue to the irrigation control hut to collect a single water flow meter. Take the flow meter to the vineyard maintenance tent and wait for 10 minutes while technicians install the device. Once the wait is complete, return to the east field entrance.

Navigate to the packaging facility near the orchard and collect two pallets of empty produce boxes. Transport the pallets to Harvest Field 3 for the morning picking crew. Wait until the crew has fully unloaded the pallets, then proceed to the maintenance room behind the barn to pick up a replacement air filter. Deliver the air filter to the irrigation control station adjacent to the main well, wait for 5 minutes to allow for installation, and finally return to the garage for system diagnostics.

Proceed to the maintenance bay and pick up a set of four replacement hydraulic pumps. Deliver the pumps to the machinery shelter beside the south wheat field. Wait at the machinery shelter for the mechanics to unload the pumps—this should take approximately 10 minutes. Once the pumps are unloaded, drive to the northeast irrigation control shed and collect a sealed box of water filter cartridges. Transport the water filter cartridges to the equipment distribution hub. After delivery, return to the maintenance bay and await your next assignment.

Head to the southern storage yard behind the greenhouse and pick up three crates of harvested peppers. Transport the crates to the produce sorting station adjacent to the main packing facility. Wait for sorting staff to unload all crates from the robot. Once the payload has been removed, proceed to the greenhouse entrance to await further instructions for 15 minutes before powering down.

Proceed to the solar equipment storage near the west gate and collect two rechargeable battery packs labeled for the drone fleet. Transport the battery packs to the drone maintenance tent set up beside the field office. Wait up to 8 minutes for the maintenance crew to take both battery packs from your platform. Next, travel to the grain silos, pick up any empty battery crates marked for return, and deliver them back to the solar equipment storage area. Do not wait upon delivery; return immediately to the central charging station and prepare for your next assignment.

Begin at the packing dock adjacent to the main road and load three crates of harvested blueberries onto the robot. Drive across the gravel path to the refrigeration bay behind the distribution center. Wait by the refrigeration bay for up to 12 minutes while staff unload the crates. Once unloading is complete, continue to the irrigation supply compound near the northern edge of field 6. Pick up two empty water tanks, then travel to the pond refilling station behind the orchard and wait 10 minutes while the tanks are filled. After refilling, deliver the full tanks to the pump house at the corner of field 3 and wait until the tanks are removed before returning to the packing dock.

Drive to the orchard loading area near the south field and collect three bushel baskets of harvested pears. Transport the baskets to the cold storage entrance at the main distribution center. Wait until all baskets are unloaded by the staff, then proceed to the greenhouse control shed on the west perimeter. Pick up a sealed container of nutrient solution and deliver it to greenhouse number 4. Once the container is delivered, wait for 5 minutes in the greenhouse service bay before returning to the orchard loading area.

Drive to the orchard supply shed located at the south end of the fruit groves and retrieve four empty harvest baskets and two protective netting rolls. Transport these supplies to collection point C, near the eastern row of apple trees. Wait until the field workers have finished unloading the baskets and netting. Once unloaded, proceed to the irrigation pump station along the main gravel road, and collect a sealed container of water testing equipment. Return this container to the environmental monitoring lab beside the north entrance gate and remain there for 5 minutes to await further instructions from the lab supervisor.

Proceed to the greenhouse storage shed near Plot 7 and pick up a tray containing six sapling pots. Deliver the tray of saplings to the orchard entrance beside the weather monitoring station. Wait for the horticulture team to finish unloading all sapling pots from the robot. Once unloading is complete, drive to the water tower access road and stand by for 10 minutes before heading back to the greenhouse storage shed.

Start at the storage shed next to the equipment yard and collect four sealed containers of cleaning solution. Transport the containers to the livestock feeding area beside the eastern paddock. Wait for 10 minutes while staff unload the cleaning solution. Once unloading is confirmed, proceed to the tool depot located near the wind turbine field to pick up a box of replacement bolts. Deliver the box to the machinery warehouse at the north entrance of the property and stand by there for further instructions.

Start at the machinery depot next to the east gate and pick up a set of four engine repair kits. Head to the tractor maintenance shed beside the sunflower field. Deliver the repair kits to the technicians there, then wait until the empty crates from the previous delivery are placed on the robot. After the empty crates are loaded, transport them to the recycling bay near the central workshop and deposit them before returning to the machinery depot.

Navigate to the vineyard shipping dock and collect four baskets of freshly harvested grapes. Transport the baskets to the cold storage facility. Upon arrival, deliver the grape baskets to the storage staff. Wait outside the cold storage facility for 15 minutes in case additional baskets need to be picked up, then proceed to the vineyard maintenance office and await further delivery assignments.

Proceed to the orchard south gate loading zone and pick up two crates of irrigation pipes. Transport the crates to the central farm workshop. Once at the workshop, wait up to 10 minutes for the maintenance crew to inspect and unload the crates. After unloading, travel to the solar charging station at the east field perimeter and remain there until battery charge reaches full capacity before resuming tasks.

Drive to the livestock feed storage behind barn D and pick up a single feed pallet. Deliver the feed pallet to the animal enclosure near the east pasture. Wait while the caretakers fully unload the pallet from your deck. After unloading, travel to the tool storage cabin by the main entrance and wait for 10 minutes before returning to barn D.

Navigate to the machinery storage room adjacent to the greenhouse and collect a pallet containing five bags of fertilizer. Deliver the pallet to field plot 3 behind the orchard row, where the planting crew is working. After arrival, wait until the fertilizer bags are fully unloaded, allowing up to 10 minutes for the process. Once unloading is confirmed, proceed to the north tool depot to pick up three empty watering cans and return them to the greenhouse entry area, then await further instructions outside the greenhouse.

Begin at the equipment bay next to the central control building and pick up three sealed battery packs. Proceed to the irrigation pump station at the edge of the east field and deliver the battery packs. Wait for the technician to install all the batteries and remove them from the robot. After the technician is finished, drive to the greenhouse supply annex near the north gate. Collect any empty fertilizer drums present and transport them to the recycling yard behind the machinery barn. Wait for 5 minutes at the recycling yard to ensure proper unloading, then return to the equipment bay and stand by for further instructions.

Start at the supply depot and pick up three sealed containers of irrigation tubing. Transport the containers to the old vineyard storage shed and wait until the field crew has unloaded all containers from your cargo platform. After unloading is complete, proceed to the machinery yard adjacent to the packing house and collect a set of four replacement chainsaws. Deliver the chainsaws to the forest edge logging station and wait for 10 minutes while the forestry team inspects and retrieves the equipment before returning to the supply depot.

Drive to the machinery repair bay adjacent to the main barn and pick up the pallet of replacement hydraulic hoses. Move the pallet to the east field irrigation pump station. Wait up to 15 minutes for the maintenance crew to take all hoses from the robot. Once empty, proceed to the solar charging station near the field entrance and remain there for 8 minutes to recharge. Finally, return to the machinery repair bay and await further instructions.

Navigate to the equipment garage and pick up a pallet of replacement hydraulic hoses. Transport the pallet to the maintenance bay beside the grain silos. Wait for 12 minutes while technicians unload the hoses. Once unloaded, proceed to the livestock feed shed, collect two bags of mineral supplement, and deliver them to the pasture gate for the ranch supervisor. After the supervisor confirms receipt, travel back to the equipment garage and stand by for the next assignment.

Begin at the greenhouse entryway adjacent to the irrigation control hut and collect three trays of seedlings. Transport the trays to the central planting plots near the southern orchard. Wait for staff to remove the seedlings, then continue to the chemical storage shed beside the gravel runway to pick up a sealed drum of fertilizer. Deliver the drum to the compost bay at the edge of the western field. Wait until the drum is unloaded, then return to the greenhouse entryway and prepare for the next assignment.

Navigate to the orchard equipment shed and collect a replacement battery pack. Deliver the battery pack to the tractor parked by the eastern orchard rows. Wait by the tractor for 10 minutes while technicians swap out the old battery. Once the technicians have completed their work, return to the equipment shed to pick up a toolbox, then transport the toolbox to the north field workshop. Await unloading of the toolbox by maintenance staff before heading to the central parking area to recharge.

Travel to the maintenance workshop located beside the southern greenhouse and collect two boxes of replacement sprinkler nozzles. Deliver the boxes to the rooftop access platform atop the central barn. Wait there until a technician arrives and removes both boxes, then move on to the composting site at the eastern edge of the property. At the composting site, pick up a container of biological fertilizer and transport it to the grapevine terrace on the hillside. After delivering the fertilizer, wait for 12 minutes to allow vineyard staff to distribute the contents, then return to the maintenance workshop.

Head to the greenhouse supply room and collect two cartons of beneficial insect release pods. Deliver the insect pods to Block B of the orchard, and wait until the orchard manager confirms unloading is complete. Next, travel to the maintenance workshop and pick up a toolbox containing calibration tools. Bring the toolbox to the main irrigation control station, and wait for 7 minutes while the technical crew completes their system adjustments before returning to the greenhouse supply room.

Travel to the maintenance garage behind the seed storage building and pick up one crate containing replacement hydraulic hoses. Deliver the crate to the greenhouse control room located at the north end of the property. Wait for the maintenance technician to unload and verify the contents. Once verified, proceed to the equipment yard and await further requests for 15 minutes.

Start by traveling to the irrigation supply depot located next to the north orchard entrance. Pick up four sealed water filters labeled for ‘Field System B’. Transport the water filters to Pump House 3 at the edge of the blueberry patch. Wait for 12 minutes while the technical team installs the filters and confirms the old filters are secured on your platform. Once you have collected the removed filters, carry them to the maintenance workshop inside the operations building. Wait until the filters are fully unloaded, then proceed to the refueling area behind the machine garage and stand by for your next instructions.

Travel to the storage shed next to the south orchard and pick up three empty fertilizer tanks. Transport the tanks to the mixing area beside the grain silos. Wait until the tanks are refilled and secured on the robot by the farm operator. After reloading, deliver all three tanks to the western crop field supply station. Once a field technician has unloaded the tanks, return directly to the storage shed and await further instructions.

Proceed to the equipment storage shed next to the northern orchard and collect three water sampling kits. Deliver these kits to the irrigation control hut adjacent to the east pond. Wait at the control hut for 10 minutes while the hydrology team uses the kits. After the waiting period, retrieve a sealed bin of soil samples from the control hut and bring it to the field research tent near the south farm gate. Upon arrival, wait until the research supervisor removes the bin from the robot before returning to the equipment storage shed.

Navigate to the solar panel maintenance shed next to Greenhouse 4 and pick up three boxes of photovoltaic replacement parts. Proceed to the utility corridor at the main control building and deliver all three boxes. Wait until a technician confirms all boxes have been unloaded. Afterward, drive to the equipment wash station beside Vehicle Garage 2 and wait for 8 minutes to allow cleaning personnel to sanitize your cargo deck before returning to the solar panel maintenance shed.

Proceed to the fertilizer storage barn behind the south orchard and pick up three 25-kg bags of organic fertilizer. Drive to plot 6 in the western vegetable patch and deliver the bags to the farm crew at the designated drop-off point. Wait for the crew supervisor to confirm successful unloading, then remain on standby at plot 6 for 10 minutes in case additional supplies are needed, before returning to the fertilizer storage barn.

Drive to the orchard packaging station and collect two crates of freshly picked apples. Transport the apples to the farm stand at the southwest entrance and deliver the crates. Remain at the farm stand for 15 minutes in case additional crates need to be moved. If no further instructions are received, return to the orchard logistics hub and power down until your next task.

Starting at the maintenance garage, navigate to the solar panel array on the south ridge and collect a toolbox marked 'Electrical Repairs.' Transport the toolbox to the greenhouse entryway and wait until a technician removes it from the robot. After the transfer is complete, proceed to the fertilizer storage unit near the western field to pick up two sealed bags of organic fertilizer. Deliver these fertilizer bags to the north tomato plot. Wait for 5 minutes while farm staff unload the bags, then return to the maintenance garage.

Head to the fertilizer storage shed beside the greenhouse and pick up two sealed containers of liquid fertilizer. Transport the containers to the vegetable plot on the south side of the farm. Wait until a farm worker manually transfers both containers from the robot. After the handoff is complete, proceed to the weather monitoring station by the main entrance and stand by there for 12 minutes before returning to the fertilizer storage shed to await further tasks.

Proceed to the maintenance workshop behind Warehouse B and collect two sealed boxes of replacement air filters. Deliver the boxes to the tractor parking lot next to the equipment wash bay. Wait there until the maintenance team unloads the boxes, then move to the supply depot at the north gate. At the depot, pick up a handheld tool kit and transport it to the irrigation control center near Pond 3. Once the tool kit is delivered, stand by for 12 minutes before heading back to the maintenance workshop.

Begin at the storage barn and navigate to the orchard sorting area. Pick up three crates of freshly harvested apples. Transport the crates to the fruit packaging station located adjacent to the market entrance. Wait for the packaging team to unload all three crates. Once unloaded, proceed to the spare parts depot beside the windmill, and collect a container labeled 'Irrigation Valves.' Deliver the irrigation valves to the pump house next to the main irrigation canal. Stand by for 7 minutes while engineers inspect the items, then drive to the storage barn and park in the designated robot bay.

Start at the maintenance bay beside the fuel storage facility and collect one toolbox and two rolls of irrigation hose. Transport these items to the northern vineyard repair station. Wait until the vineyard maintenance team has unloaded the toolbox and hoses. Then proceed to the greenhouse entry gate and collect a crate of harvested lettuce. Deliver the lettuce to the produce loading dock next to the main distribution center. Hold at the loading dock for 20 minutes while the shipping coordinator verifies the contents and signs off on the delivery report. After receiving confirmation, return to the maintenance bay and await the next task.

Start at the maintenance garage and proceed to the solar panel field access gate. Pick up a tool trolley containing solar cleaning supplies. Deliver the trolley to the technician station at the far end of the solar panel field. Wait for technicians to unload all supplies from the trolley. After confirmation of unloading, continue to the fuel depot beside the tractor shelter and collect two full canisters of biofuel. Take the canisters to the machinery bay adjacent to the equipment warehouse. Stand by for 10 minutes while staff refuel the machinery, then return to the maintenance garage and wait in the service bay until further notice.

Begin at the workshop annex and retrieve a box of drone batteries. Drive to the vineyard outpost and deliver the batteries to the charging station near the irrigation shed. Wait for 7 minutes while a technician swaps in the fresh batteries. Once the exchange is complete, proceed to the pesticides storage room and collect three sealed canisters. Transport the canisters to the eastern orchard's equipment bay entrance. After delivering the canisters, return to the workshop annex for further directions.

Proceed to the livestock feed storage shed behind the windbreak trees and pick up two sacks of corn feed. Drive to the poultry enclosure on the south end of the property and deliver the feed sacks. Wait near the enclosure for 10 minutes while staff unloads the corn feed. Once the sacks have been removed, continue to the shaded maintenance alcove by the rainwater tanks, pick up any used toolboxes left there, and transport them back to the main tool room adjacent to the workshop. Stand by at the tool room until further instructions are provided.

Travel to the fertilizer storage barn next to the north field and pick up three sealed sacks of fertilizer. Deliver the sacks to Greenhouse 2 located behind the orchard. Wait at the greenhouse until the staff confirm the sacks are unloaded, then proceed to the composting area near the farm entrance. At the composting area, collect one empty plastic bin and return it to the fertilizer storage barn. After delivery, stand by for 8 minutes before shutting down for maintenance.

Drive to the irrigation supply shed located near the west pasture and collect four coiled hoses. Deliver the hoses to the maintenance gazebo beside the fruit grove. Wait at the gazebo for 15 minutes to allow technicians to retrieve the hoses, then continue to the main garage. At the garage, pick up a set of battery packs and transport them to the solar panel outpost at the edge of the southern field. Once delivered, wait until a technician removes the battery packs from the robot before returning to the irrigation supply shed.

Begin at the equipment shelter near the south field entrance and pick up three empty pesticide sprayers. Transport the sprayers to the refill station beside the water tower. Wait at the station for 8 minutes while the sprayers are refilled by the staff. Once the sprayers are full, deliver them to the vineyard staging area on the east slope. After staff unloads the sprayers, travel to the observation deck at the field overlook, wait there for 12 minutes for a sensor calibration check, and then return to the equipment shelter.

Travel to the irrigation pump station located at the northern edge of the property and collect two sealed containers of water treatment chemicals. Deliver both containers to the hydroponic lab entrance by the western greenhouse. Wait until lab staff have retrieved and acknowledged receipt of both containers. Then, proceed to the equipment storage yard near the south perimeter and pick up an empty hose reel. Take the hose reel to the field operations office on the central lane and wait for 5 minutes to allow staff to reload it before returning the loaded hose reel to the equipment storage yard.

Go to the north field supply shed and pick up four sacks of fertilizer. Drive to the greenhouse entrance and deliver the fertilizer sacks to the designated drop-off point. Wait for up to 12 minutes for the greenhouse personnel to confirm receipt and sign off on delivery. Once confirmation is received, proceed to the maintenance garage and remain there until a diagnostic technician completes a routine inspection of the robot (expect up to 8 minutes). After the inspection is complete, return to the north field supply shed and stand by for additional tasks.

Proceed to the eastern machinery garage and pick up a replacement drive belt and two cans of lubricant. Deliver the items to the maintenance platform at the north edge of the tractor lot. Wait until the mechanic confirms receipt of all equipment. Next, travel to the seed storage barn and collect five sacks of sunflower seeds. Bring the sacks to sowing plot B, unload the payload, and then stand by for 10 minutes in case more supplies are required before returning to your parking bay near the admin office.

Drive to the maintenance garage located behind the equipment barn and collect one replacement battery pack from the charging station. Proceed to the remote field outpost near Irrigation Channel 3 and deliver the battery pack to the technician on site. Wait until the technician has removed the battery from the robot. Once complete, travel to the north gate security checkpoint and wait for 8 minutes before returning to the maintenance garage for your next assignment.

Begin at the equipment bay adjacent to the east greenhouse. Load two crates of pollination drones onto the robot. Drive to the flower testing plots at the northern end of the property and deliver both crates. Wait at the testing plots for 10 minutes while researchers inspect the drones and provide feedback. After the wait, travel to the compost depot near the main entrance. Pick up one sealed compost drum and bring it back to the equipment bay. Do not wait at the depot; return directly after the pickup.

Proceed to the maintenance garage located adjacent to the east parking lot. Collect three replacement air filters and a boxed set of wrench tools from the garage's supply shelf. Deliver both items to the tractor service bay behind the central barn, and wait until the maintenance team has unloaded the tools and filters. Once unloading is complete, drive to the packaging warehouse loading dock. Pick up a sealed crate of labeled shipping materials and transport it to the export staging area near the southern boundary fence. Remain at the staging area for 10 minutes to assist with additional deliveries and await new instructions.

Start at the maintenance garage behind the western storage sheds. Pick up four replacement tire assemblies from the garage. Drive to the tractor fleet area near the south pasture and deliver all four tires. Remain at the fleet area until a mechanic removes all the tires from the robot. Next, proceed to the chemical storage bunker at the southern boundary. Collect two unopened pesticide canisters. Transport these canisters to the machinery wash station beside the gravel access road. After delivery, wait for 5 minutes to allow operators to secure the canisters. Once complete, return to the maintenance garage and await further tasks.

Head to the orchard equipment shed located near the western property entrance and pick up two empty pesticide containers. Navigate to Plot 7 in the lower apple orchard and deliver the empty containers to the field operator stationed there. Wait until the operator loads three full containers of harvested apples onto the robot. Once the apples are on board, travel to the cold storage facility adjacent to the main barn and deliver the containers at the intake bay. After delivery, proceed to the charging station near the vehicle garage and wait for 20 minutes to recharge before returning to the orchard equipment shed for further instructions.

Proceed to the fertilizer storage shed near the south entrance and collect three sealed bags of granular fertilizer. Transport the fertilizer bags to Crop Plot 7 on the eastern side of the property and wait while the field crew unloads the bags. After unloading is confirmed, travel to the tool depot adjacent to the main silo and pick up a crate of irrigation hose fittings. Deliver the crate to the central greenhouse assembly area and stand by for 10 minutes before returning to the fertilizer storage shed for further instructions.

Start at the maintenance bay inside the central warehouse and pick up a set of four spare hydraulic hoses. Proceed to the wind turbine outpost at the northern field perimeter and deliver the hoses to the maintenance crew stationed there. Wait at the outpost for 15 minutes while the crew installs the hoses and prepares a used gearbox for transport. Once the gearbox is loaded onto the robot, carry it to the mechanical workshop adjacent to the solar array. Unload the gearbox at the parts intake ramp, then head to the cafeteria courtyard and wait for 10 minutes to serve as a temporary delivery platform for staff packages before returning to the central warehouse for your next assignment.

Begin at the central supply depot adjacent to the greenhouse cluster. Collect a pallet containing six crates of freshly harvested tomatoes. Transport the pallet to the east loading platform outside the main packaging facility. Wait until warehouse staff unload all six crates from the robot. Once unloading is complete, proceed to the orchard access pathway, stopping at the irrigation control post. Pick up a sealed container with irrigation valves destined for the field maintenance shed beside the north apple orchard. Deliver the container to the shed, then remain on standby for 7 minutes to allow the maintenance team to inspect and confirm receipt. After the wait, return to the central supply depot and dock at the designated recharge station.

Travel to the greenhouse annex located beside the irrigation pond and wait for the horticulture team to load six trays of young tomato plants onto the robot. Once the loading is complete, proceed to the elevated planter beds near the western orchard. Deliver the trays of tomato plants to the gardening crew and wait for 8 minutes in case additional plants need to be delivered. Afterwards, navigate to the equipment locker at the south end of the main storage shed, collect a sealed box of gardening tools, and deliver the box to the composting area adjacent to the east loading ramp. Once the tools have been unloaded, return to the greenhouse annex to await further instructions.

Begin at the equipment garage near the main entrance and pick up a pallet containing five sealed crates of irrigation sensors. Navigate to the orchard’s northwest tool shed and deliver the crates for inventory processing by the field supervisors. Wait for 10 minutes at the tool shed while the supervisors inspect the inventory and load two empty crates onto the robot for return. Transport the empty crates back to the equipment garage, unload them at the returns bay, and proceed to the fuel depot behind the seed storage barn to await further loading instructions.

Start at the solar charging pad along the western perimeter fence. After fully charging, drive to the greenhouse supply room near the eastern pond and pick up two bags of organic fertilizer and one box of irrigation drip parts. Deliver these items to the south field’s drip irrigation control station located beside the willow grove. Wait for the field manager to confirm reception and remove the delivered payload. Once unloaded, proceed to the lumber shed adjacent to the maintenance barn and wait for up to 15 minutes for new fence repair materials to be loaded onto the robot.

Begin at the compost collection point near the western vegetable beds. Pick up three bins containing harvest waste. Transport the bins to the central compost processor building by the wind turbine array. Wait until the on-site staff finish unloading all the bins, then continue to the parts storage shed situated beside the old equipment hangar and collect a single crate of replacement sprinkler heads. Deliver this crate to the repair zone at the eastern orchard boundary, wait for the maintenance crew to retrieve the cargo, and then return to the compost collection point for further assignments.

Start at the logistics center adjacent to the main farm office. Pick up four sealed cartons of fertilizer mix. Proceed to the southeast corner of Field 12 by the solar panel array and deliver the cartons to the fertilizer distribution crew. Wait until the crew has offloaded all cartons. Next, travel to the equipment charging station behind the grain silo and pick up a portable battery unit. Bring the battery unit to the drone staging area near the duck pond. Wait for 10 minutes while the drone operators swap out the battery. Once the swap is complete, return to the logistics center and await further tasks.

Begin at the garage adjacent to the machinery workshop. Collect two spare tractor tires placed near the entrance. Drive to the west end of Field 7 by the boundary hedgerow and deliver the tires to the equipment repair team. Wait until the repair team indicates both tires have been unloaded from the robot. Next, proceed to the chemical storage yard located behind the maintenance barn. Pick up a secured drum of herbicide marked for the south crop plots. Deliver the drum to the spraying crew at the south end of Plot 3. Wait for 5 minutes while the crew checks the drum and prepares for distribution. Afterward, return to the garage and park in the assigned bay.

Start at the packaging facility entrance beside the cold storage unit. Pick up four crates of freshly harvested strawberries stacked on the loading platform. Drive to the farmer's market tent near the north gate and deliver the strawberry crates to the vendor team. Wait until all crates have been removed. Then, proceed to the repair shed next to the pond and collect a box of replacement sprinkler heads. Transport this box to the orchard maintenance area behind the east orchard rows. After handing over the sprinkler heads, wait for 8 minutes to assist with any return items. Conclude by heading back to the packaging facility and await further directions at the reception area.

Begin at the greenhouse supplies depot adjacent to the southern irrigation canal. Pick up three bags of organic fertilizer stacked near the entrance. Proceed to Plot 12 in the vegetable field, located just west of the windbreak row. Deliver the fertilizer bags to the farm crew waiting at Plot 12. Wait until the crew confirms all bags have been unloaded from the robot. Then, travel to the tool exchange kiosk situated between the orchard and the east tractor garage, and collect a container of hand tools. Return to the greenhouse supplies depot and drop off the hand tools container at the loading area. After delivering the tools, wait at the depot office door for 7 minutes before proceeding to the next assignment.

Proceed to Orchard Row 6 and pick up three crates of freshly harvested pears stacked at the collection point. Transport the crates directly to the refrigerated storage unit behind the packing facility. Wait until a worker unloads all the pear crates from the robot, then continue to the maintenance shed to await further orders.

Begin at the fertilizer storage barn and load three bags of phosphorus-rich fertilizer onto the robot. Proceed to Orchard Row 7, near the east irrigation canal, and wait for the field supervisor to confirm the orchard is ready for fertilization. After receiving confirmation, unload the fertilizer bags and remain at Orchard Row 7 for 20 minutes to provide backup transport for additional supplies if needed. Once the waiting period is over, travel to the recycling depot at the farm entrance and pick up any empty fertilizer sacks left for collection before returning to the fertilizer storage barn to complete the task.

Proceed to the solar-powered equipment depot behind the machinery workshop and pick up a large carton containing replacement drone batteries. Transport the carton to the crop monitoring station at the east end of the barley field. Wait in standby mode for 10 minutes while the technicians distribute the batteries to their drones. Once the carton is empty, collect it and deliver it to the recycling hub near the packing warehouse. After the carton is dropped off, head to the machinery workshop for system check-in and await further instructions.

Drive to the composting yard located behind the machinery barn and pick up two sacks of organic fertilizer. Deliver the sacks to the community vegetable garden at Plot C. Wait until the garden staff has unloaded both sacks. Once complete, proceed to the farm supply depot near Irrigation Pump Station 1 and pick up a pallet of seed trays. Bring the pallet back to the greenhouse assembly area, then wait for 12 minutes while horticulture staff inspect the delivery before returning to the composting yard.

Begin at the central warehouse and proceed to the south field greenhouse. At the greenhouse, pick up three trays of tomato seedlings and a bag of peat moss. Deliver these items to the planting zone adjacent to the southern irrigation canal. Wait until farm staff fully unloads all items from your platform. After unloading is complete, continue to the machinery storage shed near the west fence and collect any spent fuel filters requiring disposal. Bring the filters to the hazardous waste collection point next to the maintenance office. Upon delivery, wait for 12 minutes to allow environmental safety personnel to document the items before returning to the central warehouse and parking in the designated robot bay.

Drive to the fertilizer storage unit near the greenhouse and pick up three bags of organic fertilizer. Transport the bags to the northern crop field and deliver them to the agronomy crew. Wait until the team confirms that all bags have been unloaded, then proceed to the solar panel array at the west boundary to collect one empty battery pack. Return the empty battery to the charging station inside the garage before resuming standby at the equipment depot.

Head to the greenhouse equipment shed located north of the tomato plots and pick up two sealed containers of plant nutrients. Deliver both containers to the irrigation control point beneath the wind turbines on the western boundary. Wait there until the containers are fully unloaded. After unloading, travel to the admin office patio and wait for 15 minutes for a routine status check before returning to the main charging station by the orchard gate.

Navigate to the greenhouse annex and collect two pallets of tomato seedlings. Transport the pallets to Plot C near the eastern irrigation pumps. Wait for the horticulture team to finish transferring all seedlings from your platform. Once empty, proceed to the composting facility beside the south orchard and pick up one sealed drum of organic fertilizer. Deliver the drum to the central irrigation hub and remain on standby for 5 minutes while technicians prepare the material for application. After waiting, return to the greenhouse annex.

Start at the south field equipment hub and collect three bags of fertilizer from the storage area. Deliver the bags to the eastern greenhouse entrance. Wait for the greenhouse staff to unload all fertilizer bags before proceeding to the irrigation control building in the central compound. Once you arrive, wait for 5 minutes to receive confirmation of delivery before reporting back to the south field equipment hub for your next assignment.

Travel to the orchard supply shed and pick up three bags of organic fertilizer. Deliver the bags to the apple orchard near Field 6, and wait until a farm worker has collected all of them from the robot. Once unloaded, continue to the greenhouse entryway next to the administration building and pick up a crate of seedling trays. Transport the crate to the planting site at the east end of Field 8. After the crate is delivered, remain at the site for 8 minutes to allow the planting crew to finish unloading and storing the trays before returning to the orchard supply shed.
