Begin at the workshop adjacent to the machine storage barn, and retrieve a carton of replacement hydraulic hoses. Transport the carton to the pivot irrigation controller platform located at the edge of sunflower field 3. Wait until the field engineer has removed all hoses from the robot. Then travel to the compost bunker near the eastern gate, collect three buckets of finished compost, and deliver them to the orchard nursery beds beside the eastern windbreak. Pause at the nursery beds for 10 minutes as horticulture staff distribute the compost. Once finished, return to the workshop and prepare for further assignments.

Navigate to the orchard storage shed situated at the eastern edge of the apple orchard. Collect five empty harvest baskets and a fresh roll of picking bags from the shed. Proceed to the southern end of the orchard where the harvest team is working. Wait until all the baskets and picking bags are loaded onto the robot. Once loaded, deliver them to the pickers' rest area beside the field entrance gate. After delivery, return to the orchard storage shed and stand by until your next assignment.

Start at the vehicle garage beside the central workshop. Pick up four barrels of hydraulic fluid and deliver them to the main wind turbine maintenance site on the west ridge. Upon arriving at the maintenance site, wait until all barrels have been removed by the technicians. Once the payload is unloaded, drive to the storage shed adjacent to the irrigation reservoir and stand by for 20 minutes for your next assignment.

Start at the central produce packing area and pick up a pallet stacked with crates of harvested carrots. Transport the pallet to the cold storage unit located within the northern storage facility. Wait until a worker unloads all crates from the pallet. Afterwards, proceed to the maintenance supply shed near the east orchard entrance, collect a container of lubricating oil, and deliver it to the tractor refueling station by the western farm road. After delivering the oil, wait for 8 minutes while maintenance personnel perform oil replenishment. Once complete, return to the central produce packing area for your next assignment.

Navigate to the greenhouse entrance near the east paddock and collect three trays of newly harvested tomatoes. Transport the trays to the produce packing station inside the central barn. After delivery, move to the compost area at the northwest corner of the property and wait for 12 minutes to allow collection of any empty crates. Once empty crates are ready, return them to the greenhouse entrance and wait there for further loading instructions.

Drive to the fertilizer storage barn next to the north orchard entrance. Pick up six bags of organic fertilizer and transport them to the compost mixing station located behind the old barn. Once at the compost mixing station, wait for 10 minutes while workers unload the fertilizer bags. After the bags have been removed from your payload, proceed to the solar charging bay in the central courtyard and wait until your battery is fully recharged before returning to your starting location at the fertilizer storage barn.

Begin at the equipment garage and proceed to the rivergate pump station. Pick up two barrels of mineral oil. Deliver the barrels to the irrigation control shed beside the main canal. Wait until the technician team removes both barrels from your cargo area. After the barrels have been unloaded, navigate to the orchard machinery yard to collect a broken mower blade. Transport the blade to the metal repair workshop by the east fence. Wait for 10 minutes while the maintenance crew inspects and accepts the blade, then return to the equipment garage and await your next assignment.

Start at the main operations hub and navigate to the feed storage barn beside the creek. Pick up three bags of supplemental livestock grain. Deliver the grain bags to the animal enclosures near the southern fence and wait for the farm staff to unload all bags. Once unloading is finished, travel to the solar equipment array close to the eastern pasture and wait for 10 minutes while technicians perform routine checks and load a toolbox onto the robot. After the toolbox has been placed on board, proceed to the energy unit maintenance shed behind the old silo, deliver the toolbox, and then return to the main operations hub for your next assignment.

Start at the equipment storage garage near the west entrance. Collect a stack of four empty fertilizer bins from the garage loading bay. Transport the bins to the fertilizer refill station next to the south crop field. Wait until all bins are filled by the station attendant. After the bins are loaded and refilled, drive to the machinery staging area behind the tractor parking lot. Deliver the filled fertilizer bins to the staging area. Remain at the staging area for 10 minutes while awaiting further instructions from the field supervisor.

Head to the orchard storage shed and pick up three empty harvest crates. Deliver the crates to the northern apple grove and wait while workers fill them with apples. Once loaded, transport the full crates to the cold storage facility and wait for the crates to be unloaded before returning to the orchard storage shed.

Drive to the orchard entrance near the northern farm gate and collect four baskets of freshly harvested apples. Transport the baskets to the cooling room at the produce storage facility and wait until all apples have been unloaded by the storage staff. Once unloading is complete, return to the orchard to pick up any empty baskets left at the collection point, and deliver them back to the orchard shed before proceeding to standby near the administration office.

Begin at the machine shop and pick up a sealed box of replacement hydraulic hoses. Travel to the dairy barn entry ramp and deliver the box to the maintenance bay. Wait for the maintenance supervisor to unload the box from your cargo area. Next, proceed to the farm operations office and collect two clipboards with updated work orders. Drive to the eastern vegetable packing shed and drop off the clipboards on the designated collection table. Once the delivery is complete, wait in standby mode for 15 minutes in case additional pickups are requested.

Navigate to the vineyard shed and collect two crates of freshly harvested grapes. Transport the crates to the pressing station adjacent to the main winery building. Wait at the pressing station for 10 minutes or until a worker removes both crates, whichever comes first. After the crates are unloaded, proceed to the water tank area by the east gate to pick up a hose reel and deliver it to the irrigation control hut at the southern field edge. Once delivered, wait until the hose reel is removed by the maintenance crew before returning to the vineyard shed.

Start at the workshop garage and collect two boxes of replacement tractor parts. Drive along service road 2 to the storage shed near the east pasture. Wait by the shed until maintenance staff unload both boxes, allowing up to 8 minutes for the process. After unloading, proceed to the solar charging station south of the greenhouse for a scheduled recharge. Remain at the charging station for 15 minutes before returning to the workshop garage.

Start at the greenhouse workshop and pick up a sealed crate of replacement irrigation valves. Transport the crate to the pump station beside Lake Willow. Wait until the maintenance technician finishes inspecting the current valves and indicates readiness to receive the new ones. Transfer the crate of valves to the technician and then head over to the utility shed at the southern boundary of the apple orchard. Remain at the utility shed for 10 minutes in case additional parts or tools need to be transported back to the greenhouse workshop, then return to your starting point.

Begin by driving to the engine parts storage area beside the grain silos. Collect three replacement hydraulic pumps and two small containers of coolant. Proceed to the equipment repair bay behind the tractor barn. Wait until the mechanics unload all parts and coolant from the robot. Once everything has been unloaded, travel to the irrigation control kiosk at the southern vineyard. Remain at the kiosk for 12 minutes in case additional supplies are needed, then make your way to the rubbish disposal zone near the eastern parking lot for end-of-shift inspection.

Travel to the seed supply storage at the western edge of the greenhouse complex and pick up two sacks of organic fertilizer pellets. Deliver the sacks to the berry patch located between the windbreak row and the northern compost station. Wait until the field workers have unloaded both sacks from the robot. Following unloading, proceed to the control center gazebo overlooking the irrigation canal, and collect a waterproof case containing soil sample kits. Transport this case to the test plot entrance near the old windmill and remain there for 15 minutes in case additional samples need to be picked up. Lastly, return to the maintenance hangar adjacent to the gravel driveway to await new deployment orders.

Head to the spare parts storage room next to the fabrication hall and collect a box containing eight ultrasonic sensors. Deliver the box to the assembly line supervisor’s office in the manufacturing wing. Wait until the supervisor retrieves the sensors from the robot, then drive to the outdoor fueling station on the south perimeter. Remain at the fueling station for 10 minutes to allow staff refueling, then return to standby at the logistics control hub.

Head to the main orchard storage shed and pick up two boxes of replacement drone propellers. Transport the boxes to the drone maintenance tent adjacent to the east orchard. Wait until a technician confirms both boxes have been received, then travel to the composting area behind the barn to retrieve a single full compost bin. Deliver the bin to the vegetable garden tool station, and remain there for 5 minutes before returning to the central maintenance garage.

Begin at the fertilizer storage shed and pick up three sealed bags of granular fertilizer. Make your way to the southern greenhouse loading area and deliver the fertilizer bags to the greenhouse supervisor. Once the bags are received, wait for an empty fertilizer bin to be loaded onto the robot by the supervisor. Transport the empty bin to the equipment cleaning station near the west entrance and wait for 10 minutes while the maintenance crew cleans the bin. After cleaning is complete and the bin has been removed from the robot, proceed to the field staging zone and await further instructions.

Begin at the central distribution depot and navigate to the fruit packing house near the northern field. Pick up four crates of mixed berries. Proceed to the juice processing station adjacent to the eastern greenhouse and deliver the crates to the processing crew. Wait for 7 minutes in case any empty crates are returned for reuse. If any empty crates are provided, bring them back to the fruit packing house and place them in the designated return area.

Drive to the equipment storage bay and collect three empty fuel canisters. Proceed to the diesel fill station next to the tractor barn and wait until a technician fills all three canisters. Once filled, deliver the canisters to the generator station behind the remote crop monitoring tower. Wait at the generator station for 15 minutes or until a crew member offloads all canisters, then return to the equipment storage bay.

Start at the central greenhouse and pick up three trays of tomato seedlings. Transport the trays to the designated plot in the north field, and deliver them to the planting crew. Wait nearby for 10 minutes to collect any empty seedling trays needing return. If any trays are returned, bring them back to the central greenhouse and place them on the receiving shelf.

Travel to the solar panel maintenance shed near the southwest perimeter and pick up three boxes of replacement solar cells. Deliver the boxes to the elevated platform at the main power relay station beside the machine yard. Wait until a technician arrives and removes at least one box. Afterward, proceed to the seed storage bunker near the western field gate to collect a crate containing drought-resistant wheat seeds. Transport the seed crate to the seeding drone launch pad at Field 6. Once delivery is complete, wait for 10 minutes while the crew verifies inventory, then return to the solar panel maintenance shed.

Travel to the irrigation station near Lakeview Pond and retrieve three water filter canisters. Proceed to orchard section B and deliver the canisters to the maintenance crew. After unloading, wait for 10 minutes while the crew installs the filters. When the canisters have been removed, head to the compost facility to pick up a container of organic fertilizer and deliver it to the greenhouse annex for soil enrichment. Wait until a technician removes the fertilizer container before returning to the central command post.

Drive to the orchard storage barn and collect six empty fruit crates. Deliver the fruit crates to the south orchard collection point and wait until a harvesting crew loads them with apples. After the crates are filled, transport them to the cold storage facility next to the packing station. Upon arrival, wait for 10 minutes while the cold storage staff unloads the apple crates. Once unloading is finished, proceed to the tool shed by the farm office and wait there for your next assignment.

Drive to the maintenance shed situated at the eastern edge of the production field and pick up a pallet containing four replacement drive belts. Continue to the conveyor house adjacent to the seed storage silo and deliver the pallet of drive belts to the mechanical crew waiting inside. Wait nearby until the crew provides a damaged conveyor motor for transport. After receiving the motor, return to the maintenance shed and deliver the motor to the designated repair bench. Remain at the maintenance shed for 10 minutes before traveling to the south field staging area for your next assignment.

Begin at the main storage yard behind the barn and collect three crates of replacement seed trays. Transport these crates to the eastern edge of the nursery field, where the planting crew is working. Wait at the drop-off point while the field supervisor inspects the delivery, allowing up to 10 minutes for review and unloading. Once the supervisor confirms unloading is complete, proceed to the weather monitoring station beside the irrigation pond and wait there for further instructions.

Travel to the fertilizer storage shed and pick up three sacks of nitrogen fertilizer. Deliver the sacks to Field Section 3, and wait for 10 minutes while they are unloaded by the field crew. Once unloaded, proceed to the equipment bay and retrieve an empty water tank. Bring the empty tank to the refilling station, wait until it is fully refilled by the station attendant, then transport the refilled water tank to the vineyard loading platform.

Proceed to the fertilizer supply depot near the main irrigation pond and pick up two sealed bags of organic compost. Transport the bags to plot 15 in the east field flower beds. Wait for 10 minutes while the gardening crew distributes the compost. Next, travel to the storage barn adjacent to the windmill and retrieve a set of spare irrigation hoses. Deliver the hoses to the maintenance hut near the east field entrance. Wait until all hoses have been unloaded by staff, then return to the fertilizer supply depot for your next assignment.

Drive to the chemical storage facility beside the farm workshop and collect two sealed drums of liquid fertilizer. Proceed to the crop treatment staging area by the south orchard. Wait until farm personnel have unloaded both drums before moving to the water tower access road, where you should stand by for 7 minutes for potential refilling tasks. On completion, return to the chemical storage facility and await further instructions.

Start at the packaging storage area beside the fruit processing plant and collect three sealed boxes of packaged pears. Transport the boxes to the farm gate checkpoint for inspection. Once inspected and cleared by staff, proceed to the outbound logistics hub on the western perimeter. Wait until the boxes are fully loaded onto the outbound trailer by the handlers. After confirmation that the boxes are loaded, return to the packaging storage area and dock in the loading bay for potential re-assignment.

Proceed to the equipment locker near the southeast entrance of the packing facility and pick up three sealed crates of protective gloves. Transport these crates to the quality control tent located in the central orchard. Upon arrival, wait until a staff member unloads all crates from the robot. Once the crates have been unloaded, travel to the fertilizer mixing station on the north hillside and collect a 20-liter container of liquid fertilizer. Deliver this container to the compost area by the windbreak trees at the western boundary. After delivery, wait for 8 minutes to allow for unloading, and then proceed to the field supervisor’s mobile office adjacent to the gravel lot for further instructions.

Proceed to the main orchard entrance and collect three crates of freshly harvested apples from the loading crew. Transport the crates to the cold storage facility adjacent to the packing house. Wait until the storage supervisor confirms the crates have been unloaded from the robot. Once unloading is complete, travel to the tool supply shed near the south fence and stand by for your next task.

Begin at the maintenance garage beside the vehicle wash bay. Collect two replacement hydraulic hoses and a crate of assorted bolts. Drive to the sunflower field access road, where the irrigation pump house is located. Deliver the hoses and bolts to the mechanical repair team working by the pump house. Wait until the team confirms receipt of all items. Afterwards, proceed to the southwest tool depot, pick up three soil moisture sensors, and bring them to the monitoring plot near the western windbreak. Deposit the sensors in the marked drop-off area, then return to the maintenance garage and stand by for the next assignment.

Start at the packing house located beside the main orchard entrance. Collect up to six bins of freshly picked apples ready for transport. Move to the refrigerated storage container across from the orchard manager’s office. Deliver all apple bins to the storage personnel at the entrance of the container. Wait until the entire load has been removed. When finished, proceed to the maintenance garage behind the grain silos and pick up one replacement drive belt and a toolbox labeled 'Repair Kit'. Deliver the drive belt and repair kit to the tractor shed at the east end of the property. Once items are delivered, wait for 5 minutes in case additional equipment needs to be transported before returning to the packing house for your next assignment.

Begin at the main greenhouse entryway and pick up a batch of freshly harvested tomato crates. Proceed to the packaging station located between the irrigation pond and the orchard. Deliver the tomato crates to the workers, then wait for 10 minutes to allow them to unload the produce. Once the crates have been emptied and placed back onto your platform, transport the empty crates to the sanitization bay adjacent to the greenhouse. Wait until sanitation staff confirm that the crates have been unloaded before returning to the main greenhouse entryway.

Travel to the solar panel field located southeast of the main farmhouse and collect a crate of replacement photovoltaic cells. Deliver the crate to the electrical maintenance station near the east gate. Wait until the maintenance team unloads the crate. Then, continue to the fuel storage facility beside the equipment shed, pick up two full fuel canisters, and deliver them to the generator pad at the north boundary. After the canisters are unloaded, remain at the generator pad for 8 minutes to supervise refueling operations before returning to the solar panel field.

Travel to the orchard’s southern entrance and pick up three crates of harvested apples marked for quality inspection. Deliver the crates to the quality control tent beside the main administration office. Wait at the tent until a supervisor confirms all crates are accounted for, then proceed to the greenhouse supply depot behind the greenhouse cluster. Pick up a single sealed box of plant nutrients and bring it directly to the main greenhouse. Upon arrival, wait for 15 minutes to allow the greenhouse staff to unload the box before returning to the orchard’s southern entrance and prepare for the next assignment.

Begin by traveling to the north equipment yard and pick up two large fuel canisters from the designated storage zone. Deliver the fuel canisters to the field generator station next to the eastern irrigation pumps. Wait until a technician has completely emptied the canisters from your cargo. Once unloaded, proceed to the shade tent by the workers’ rest area and wait for 8 minutes before returning to the equipment yard for reassignment.

Start at the north side of the warehouse and pick up two sealed drums of fertilizer. Drive to the north entrance of orchard block D, and deliver the drums to the supply pallet located under the shade structure. Wait for 15 minutes for the field crew to offload the fertilizer. Once the drums have been removed, proceed to the tool drop-off zone near the irrigation control hut, and await further loading instructions from the field supervisor.

Start at the equipment storage barn next to the east cargo gate. Load a pallet containing six bags of fertilizer and one bag of grass seed onto the robot. Proceed to the central orchard and deliver the grass seed bag to the groundskeeper stationed next to the main irrigation channel. After handing over the seed, continue with the remaining fertilizer bags to the southern crop plot. Wait for the field team to unload the fertilizer. Once unloading is finished, travel to the composting station behind the greenhouse, pick up a bin of organic waste, and bring it back to the equipment storage barn. Stand by at the barn for further instructions.

Start at the main storage yard and drive to the fertilizer bunker near the community greenhouse. Pick up three 25-kilogram bags of organic fertilizer. Deliver these bags to the raised bed plots next to the research cabin. Wait for 7 minutes while the planting team distributes the fertilizer. Afterward, proceed to the equipment shelter behind the north machine shed to collect a portable generator. Transport the generator to the remote pond's pump house and wait until the on-site crew unloads the generator before heading back to the maintenance office.

Navigate to the seed storage facility behind the main administration building and pick up two sacks of sunflower seeds. Deliver the sacks to the planting vehicle at Field Plot 6, located west of the equipment refueling bay. Wait for the planting team leader to remove both sacks from your platform. After the sacks have been collected, proceed to the supply tent near the north orchard and wait for 10 minutes to assist with any urgent supply requests from the harvest team. When the waiting time has elapsed, return to the central charging station beside the maintenance hangar.

Drive to the maintenance workshop and collect two boxes of replacement irrigation nozzles. Deliver the boxes to the east orchard’s central irrigation control hub. Wait until the orchard technician retrieves all items from the robot. Once unloaded, proceed to the tool storage barn and pick up a set of pruning shears and extension poles (bundle). Deliver this bundle to row 7 of the south apple grove and wait for the pruning crew to fully unload the equipment before departing.

Proceed to the maintenance garage located behind the packing house and collect a single toolbox containing spare hydraulic parts. Deliver the toolbox to the north vineyard equipment pad. Wait for the vineyard mechanic to remove the toolbox from the robot. After the toolbox has been unloaded, travel to the shaded rest area near the solar charging station and wait for 15 minutes before navigating to the central control station for a status check.

Begin at the harvest collection point near Greenhouse 2. Retrieve a crate filled with freshly picked tomatoes. Navigate to the refrigeration unit in the main produce processing building. Wait until a staff member removes the crate from your payload platform. After the crate has been unloaded, proceed to the supply kiosk adjacent to the maintenance garage and stand by for 5 minutes in case additional collection requests are made.

Drive to the loading dock adjacent to the administrative office. Pick up three crates of packaged lettuce. Deliver the crates to the vegetable sorting facility near the north orchard entrance. Wait until all crates have been unloaded by the sorting staff. After unloading, proceed to the machinery shed behind the main barn. At the shed, stand by for 10 minutes to assist with any unexpected transport requests before returning to the loading dock.

Proceed to the irrigation equipment depot located next to the windbreak trees and pick up two blue water pump filters and a sealed toolkit. Transport these items to the west orchard maintenance zone and deliver them to the onsite technician. Wait at the west orchard for 20 minutes in case additional parts are requested. If handed any used filters or broken tools, retrieve them and return to the irrigation equipment depot, then deliver the returned items to the storage counter for inspection.

Start by navigating to the solar panel maintenance station near the east fence. Pick up five cleaning kits and a replacement power inverter. Drive to the windbreak area along the northern boundary, and wait for the maintenance crew to remove the inverter and unload the cleaning kits. When all items have been offloaded, proceed to the pesticide storage shed at the southwest corner and collect two sealed pesticide drums. Deliver the drums to the crop duster loading zone adjacent to the farm office. Stand by for 8 minutes while the crop duster team transfers the drums before returning to the operations garage for scheduled diagnostics.

Travel to the equipment shed behind the main greenhouse and collect a box containing replacement irrigation nozzles. Transport the box to the northern field repair station beside the row of cypress trees. Wait for 10 minutes while the maintenance crew installs the nozzles and unloads the box. Next, proceed to the fruit sorting pavilion and pick up three crates of freshly harvested pears. Deliver the crates to the cold storage room inside the main warehouse. Wait until all crates are removed by warehouse staff before returning to the equipment shed.

Start at the maintenance garage and travel to the seed storage room inside the operations building. Pick up two sacks of sunflower seeds. Transport the sacks to the planting drone launch pad on the west side of the north field. Wait for the drone crew to remove both sacks and load the drones. After the sacks are removed, proceed to the chemical shed near the machinery depot and collect a sealed box of pollinator attractant. Deliver the box to the research greenhouse entryway, wait 5 minutes for the research team’s confirmation, then head to the maintenance garage and remain there until further notice.

Begin by navigating to the solar charging station next to the main barn and pick up the portable generator unit. Transport the generator to the vineyard monitoring cabin located at the edge of the north hillside. Upon arrival, wait until the technician signals and unloads the generator from your platform. Then, travel to the tool storage shed at the western boundary of the property and stand by for 10 minutes for possible equipment transfer orders before resuming your default patrol route.

Start at the east gate of the orchard. Proceed to the fruit sorting station beside the main barn and collect four crates of freshly picked pears. Transport the crates to the cool storage unit next to the packing facility. Wait until all crates have been unloaded by the packing staff. Next, travel to the supply room at the north end of the maintenance complex to pick up a package containing replacement irrigation valves. Deliver this package to the irrigation control shed located near the drainage canal in Sector 12. Once the package has been received by the irrigation technician, return to the orchard east gate and await further instructions.

Start by proceeding to the irrigation equipment garage beside Maintenance Building C and collect a single pallet of hose connectors. Transport the pallet to the edge of Vineyard Block 4 and wait for the irrigation team to unload the connectors onto their trailer. After the connectors have been removed from the robot, travel to the packaging warehouse at the western end of the facility. Pick up four empty produce crates from the warehouse entrance and deliver them to the loading zone behind the cold storage rooms. Remain at the loading zone for 10 minutes while workers fill the crates with harvested peppers. Once the crates are packed and loaded back onto the robot, return the filled crates to the packaging warehouse and wait for the line manager to sign off on successful delivery before finishing the task.

Travel to the orchard storage shed and pick up three crates of freshly harvested apples. Transport the crates to the farmers' market loading zone on the west side of the property. After unloading, wait at the loading zone for 10 minutes to allow the market staff to inspect and sign off on the delivery. Once confirmation is received, return to the orchard storage shed and prepare for your next assignment.

Head to the solar equipment bay adjacent to greenhouse 3 and collect a crate of replacement solar panels. Deliver the crate to the solar array field at the northern perimeter. Wait until the installation team unloads the crate and loads a container containing damaged panel fragments onto your deck. When the container is secure, proceed to the recycling center located near the west gate and deliver the container to the receiving dock. Once delivery is confirmed, return to the solar equipment bay and stand by for 15 minutes before resuming other tasks.

Navigate to the packing house and pick up three crates of freshly harvested strawberries. Deliver the crates to the cooling station adjacent to the north orchard. Wait until the cooling technician confirms the crates are unloaded, which should take about 8 minutes. After confirmation, proceed to the west greenhouse and collect a box containing pollinator supplies. Take the pollinator supplies to the soil testing lab near the main office. Upon successful delivery, return to your charging station located near the equipment garage and stand by for further instructions.

Start at the maintenance garage and proceed to the chemical storage silo on the southern perimeter of the property. Retrieve two sealed containers of liquid fertilizer. Carefully transport the containers to the equipment staging area adjacent to Greenhouse 3. Wait up to 12 minutes for the greenhouse crew to unload both containers. Once the containers have been removed, continue to the tire repair shed and pick up a new set of spare tractor tires. Deliver the spare tires to the machinery depot, and remain on site until the equipment manager has inspected and officially signed off on the delivery before departing.

Begin at the maintenance shed and collect two full fuel canisters. Transport the canisters to the irrigation pump station at the edge of the east orchard. Once you arrive, wait until the on-site technician has unloaded both canisters. After unloading, return directly to the maintenance shed and await further instructions.

Go to the spare parts depot behind the main greenhouse and collect a sealed crate of irrigation piping. Deliver the crate to the maintenance tent on the south end of the crop fields. Wait at the maintenance tent for the technicians to unload the piping and verify the inventory. Once unloading is complete and confirmation is received from the technicians, return to the spare parts depot.

Proceed to the north orchard equipment storage area and retrieve the blue crate containing replacement pruning shears and safety gloves. Take the crate to the grove foreman’s station at the center of the apple orchard. Wait until the foreman unloads the crate, then head to the operations pavilion by the main gate. Remain at the pavilion for 10 minutes to await possible additional payloads or instructions.

Proceed to the equipment bay adjacent to the vehicle garage and pick up a set of four sealed lubricant canisters. Deliver the canisters to the tractor fueling station located between the western storage silo and the access road. Wait until all canisters have been unloaded by the maintenance team. Next, travel to the main orchard tool shed and collect a bundle of pruning shears for delivery. Bring the shears to the citrus grove supervisors' tent at the east side of the orchard. Upon arrival, wait for 7 minutes to allow the staff to inspect and retrieve the tools, then return to the equipment bay and stand by for further instructions.

Start at the main storage depot adjacent to the western entrance. Proceed to the vineyard packing area to pick up four crates of freshly harvested grapes. Transport the crates to the cold storage facility located behind the fruit processing plant. Wait at the cold storage facility for 12 minutes while the staff inspects and unloads the crates. Once all crates have been confirmed delivered, travel to the maintenance hut behind the machinery shed to collect a replacement hydraulic hose. Bring the hose to the field operations tent near plot 7 for the repair crew. Do not wait at the tent after drop-off; proceed directly to the main storage depot and stand by for further instructions.

Proceed from the central control station to the pump house located at the far end of the east pasture. Pick up three containers of engine coolant. Transport these coolant containers to the windmill servicing site near the northern pond. Wait until a technician retrieves the coolant and places a used oil filter onto the robot. Carry the used oil filter to the hazardous waste depot alongside the composting yard. Once the filter has been unloaded, move to the shaded rest area next to the apiary and standby for 10 minutes before awaiting further instructions.

Start at the maintenance garage and collect two boxes of replacement air filters. Deliver the air filters to the combine harvester parked at Field 4. Wait until maintenance staff remove the used filters and install the new ones, then retrieve the old filters. Transport the used filters to the hazardous materials disposal area near the recycling center. Once the filters have been unloaded, proceed to the vineyard equipment shed and wait for the vineyard manager to assign your next mission.

Begin at the supply depot next to the grain silos and collect a stack of five spare irrigation hoses. Transport the hoses to the drip line service station at the southern end of the east pasture. Wait for maintenance staff to remove all hoses from the robot. After unloading, proceed to the machinery garage behind the dairy barn and pick up a small crate containing replacement hydraulic filters. Deliver this crate to the field maintenance workshop near the pump house by the riverbank. Wait for 10 minutes while technicians collect the crate, then return to the supply depot next to the grain silos.

Proceed to the equipment garage and collect a pallet of fertiliser bags. Transport the pallet to the vegetable trial plot located at the northwest corner of the farm. Wait up to 10 minutes for the planting team to unload the fertiliser bags. Once unloading is complete, drive to the storage silo access point and wait until you are loaded with three empty grain containers. After loading, deliver the empty containers to the grain harvest area near the barley field and wait for further instructions from the field supervisor.

Travel to the main greenhouse loading bay and pick up four crates of harvested strawberries. Drive to the farmers’ market tent on the southern lot and deliver the crates to the designated unloading zone. Wait for the produce coordinator to empty all crates from the robot. After unloading, proceed to the maintenance workshop and wait for 7 minutes to allow the staff to inspect the chassis for damage before returning to the orchard gate for redeployment.

Proceed to the equipment storage barn adjacent to the east field and pick up three reels of irrigation hose. Deliver the hoses to the vineyard on Hilltop Lane. Wait at the vineyard until the vineyard technician completes the hose installation and removes all reels from the robot. Once all items are unloaded, continue to the solar charging station behind the packing facility and remain there for 10 minutes before heading to the central control outpost for task reassignment.

Start at the maintenance garage and pick up two toolboxes along with a set of replacement hydraulic hoses. Travel to the wind turbine field entrance and deliver the toolboxes to the service crew waiting on-site. Wait until both toolboxes have been fully unloaded. Next, proceed to the east boundary fence line and drop off the hydraulic hoses at the repair outpost. After the drop-off, remain stationary for 15 minutes to serve as a temporary equipment carrier for spare components, then return to the maintenance garage once the timer completes.

Proceed to the irrigation supply barn near the north field access road and collect two coiled hoses. Navigate to the central greenhouse and deliver the hoses to the maintenance bench inside. Wait there until the greenhouse staff have offloaded both hoses and signal that the area is clear. Once the delivery is complete, continue to the nearby charging station for a 15-minute recharge before awaiting your next assignment.

Proceed to the equipment storage area adjacent to the southwest greenhouse. Pick up one pallet stacked with empty harvest trays. Transport the pallet to the central wash station located near the packing facility. Wait until the cleaning crew removes all the trays from the pallet and signals that unloading is complete. Once your payload is emptied, drive to the refueling station behind the administrative office and remain on standby for 10 minutes before resuming your route.

Begin at the equipment garage and pick up two replacement irrigation valves. Travel to the west greenhouse and deliver the valves to the maintenance team. Wait for 8 minutes while the team installs the new valves and hands you two used, faulty valves. Collect the faulty valves and transport them to the workshop at the south end of the property. Wait until a technician retrieves the used valves from you before returning to the equipment garage.

Proceed to the solar charging station behind the south greenhouse and pick up a sealed box containing weather sensors. Deliver the box to the technician's table inside the main field laboratory. Wait for 12 minutes while the sensors are inspected and calibrated by the staff. Once the box is empty, drive to the harvest area at the east orchard edge and collect two wooden crates of apples. Move the crates to the refrigerated storage unit next to the processing barn and wait for the loading team to unload both crates before returning to your base at the logistics hub.

Start at the seed storage room adjacent to the main barn and collect one pallet containing assorted vegetable seeds. Proceed to the greenhouse complex at the northern edge of the property. Once there, wait up to 10 minutes while the staff unload the entire pallet. After all seeds have been transferred, move to the supply kiosk near the equipment wash station and pick up a single chemical canister marked for pest control. Deliver the canister to the pesticide storage locker located behind the southern crop fields. Upon successful delivery, return to the seed storage room.

Go to the north field equipment depot and collect a toolbox containing precision repair instruments. Deliver the toolbox to the irrigation control station by the east orchard. Wait until the maintenance technician removes the toolbox, then proceed directly to the compost loading zone behind the barn to await further instructions.

Drive to the machinery warehouse and collect a pallet of tractor engine oil containers. Transport the pallet to the servicing bay behind the western barn. Wait until the maintenance crew unloads all containers, which might take up to 10 minutes. Afterward, proceed to the compost heap at the south end of the orchard and pick up two empty compost bins. Deliver these bins to the compost processing shed next to the greenhouse, then return to the machinery warehouse and await further instructions.

Begin at the machinery garage and collect one fuel canister and three replacement air filters from the storage rack. Transport these items to the main tractor depot near the irrigation channel. Wait at the tractor depot until maintenance staff unload the replacement air filters from the robot. Once unloaded, drive to the poultry barn on the north field boundary and retrieve two cartons of chicken feed. Deliver the chicken feed to the feed storage kiosk behind the barn. After completing the delivery, proceed to the supply tent next to the greenhouse and wait there for 10 minutes for further instructions.

Begin at the equipment storage barn and pick up two fuel canisters. Transport the canisters to the eastern tractor shed and wait there until the tractor operator has offloaded both canisters—this should not take more than 8 minutes. Afterward, travel to the greenhouse supply room and collect three trays of tomato seedlings. Deliver the trays to the central greenhouse entrance and wait until a horticulturist confirms receipt before returning to the maintenance garage for standby.

Proceed to the cold storage unit adjacent to the livestock barn and pick up a single insulated crate containing animal vaccines. Transport the crate to the field veterinary station near the north pasture. Upon arrival, wait until the veterinary technician unloads the crate. After delivery is complete, travel to the grain silo yard on the east side of the property. Pick up three empty feed bins and return them to the equipment cleaning bay beside the machine workshop. Once the bins are delivered, wait for 8 minutes to allow maintenance staff to disinfect the bins before returning to your designated standby area behind the administration office.

Begin at the chemical storage hut next to the irrigation control center. Safely collect two sealed canisters of crop fertilizer. Proceed to Plot 14 at the southern boundary of the field complex. Deliver both fertilizer canisters to the agronomy team stationed at the southern entrance to the plot and wait until both canisters have been fully unloaded. After the drop-off, make your way to the central machine yard and pick up a crate of spare wheel assemblies. Transport the crate to the workshop annex adjacent to the administration building, then wait for 10 minutes while the technicians inspect the deliveries. Once the waiting period is over or you receive confirmation, return to the chemical storage hut to be available for further assignments.

Travel to the solar panel array at the south end of the property and pick up a box of replacement circuit breakers. Deliver the box to the maintenance hut located next to the wind turbine control room. Wait until the maintenance engineer removes the box from your payload area. Once the delivery is confirmed, proceed to the horticulture shed near the greenhouse complex and collect two fertilizer canisters. Transport these canisters to the irrigation control station in the central orchard. After unloading the canisters, wait for 10 minutes to be reloaded with two empty irrigation filters, then return the filters to the filtration workshop adjacent to the main water reservoir.

Travel to the chemical storage room next to the greenhouse and pick up two sealed canisters of fertilizer. Deliver the canisters to the southern vegetable plot. Wait for 10 minutes while the field team applies the fertilizer. Once the waiting period is over, proceed to the maintenance bay and stand by for further tasks.

Proceed to the storage barn behind the southern greenhouse and retrieve a pallet of packaged fertilizers. Transport the pallet to the field plot C entrance near the west windbreak. Wait at the delivery zone for the farm supervisor to inspect and sign off on the pallet. After confirmation of delivery, continue to the maintenance shed adjacent to the tractor bay and wait for 10 minutes in case tools need to be transported. If no requests are received, return to the southern greenhouse loading pad and stand by.

Begin at the central vehicle bay. Proceed to the diesel storage shed near the south fence and pick up two full fuel canisters. Transport the canisters to the generator platform behind the poultry enclosure. Wait until the maintenance crew has taken both canisters from the robot, then move to the north vegetable field to collect a crate of harvested carrots. Deliver the crate to the produce washing station adjacent to the east loading ramp, and finally, return to the central vehicle bay and stand by for 5 minutes before shutting down.

Drive to the northern machinery depot beside the equipment wash station and pick up two sealed boxes of replacement hydraulic hoses. Proceed to the maintenance area next to barn 2 and deliver both boxes by the service entrance. Wait until the maintenance supervisor has unloaded all hoses. After unloading, navigate to the orchard east parking lot and stand by there for 8 minutes before returning to the northern machinery depot.

Begin at the central packing facility and collect three pallets of freshly harvested strawberries. Transport the pallets to the refrigerated storage unit located at the north end of the property. Wait at the storage unit for up to 10 minutes while staff members unload all pallets. Once unloaded, proceed to the maintenance barn and stand by for further instructions.

Begin at the equipment staging area and drive to the vineyard harvest lot at the southern boundary. Pick up four baskets of freshly harvested grapes. Deliver the baskets to the cold storage chambers adjacent to the winery processing room. Wait for ten minutes while the staff unload the baskets. Then, proceed to the spare parts room in the central workshop and pick up a container of irrigation valve replacements. Bring this container to the pump house next to the east irrigation canal and stand by until the maintenance team retrieves the container from the robot.

Drive to the vegetable sorting station adjacent to the north field and pick up four crates of freshly picked carrots. Transport the crates to the cold storage shed behind the packing house. Wait at the cold storage shed for 7 minutes while the produce is inspected and unloaded. Once all crates have been removed, return to the vegetable sorting station and await the next task assignment.

Head to the maintenance garage adjacent to the south fence and collect two spare hydraulic pump assemblies. Move these assemblies to the equipment repair bay next to the tractor parking lot. Wait until the lead mechanic signals that all assemblies have been removed from your platform, then continue to the tool storage room in the north annex and stand by for 5 minutes before returning to the maintenance garage.

Begin at the orchard supply pavilion just north of the citrus grove. Retrieve three crates of harvested lemons along with one weatherproof fruit tarp. Transport these items to the quality inspection tent located at the east perimeter of the packing zone. Wait until an inspector signs off on the delivery. Then, head to the tool dispensary shed near the irrigation canal and collect one pruning saw set. Deliver the pruning saw set to maintenance bay two in the nearby equipment depot. After completing the delivery, return to the orchard supply pavilion and stand by for 15 minutes in case additional transport requests arise.

Start at the machinery garage adjacent to the paved lot. Retrieve one sealed container of engine lubricant and a set of hydraulic hoses. Deliver both items to the tractor maintenance area located on the west side of the central field. Wait there until the mechanics confirm that the container and hoses have been received—this should take no more than 7 minutes. Once acknowledged, proceed to the compost processing yard behind the equipment storage barn and pick up two compost sampling jars. Transport the sampling jars to the laboratory collection window at the southern end of the research annex. Do not wait after delivery; return directly to the machinery garage to complete the task.

Drive to the loading dock near the east greenhouses and pick up a pallet of fertilizer bags. Deliver the pallet to field plot 12 at the far end of the west orchard. Wait for 10 minutes while the farmhands unload the fertilizer bags. Once unloaded, proceed to the charging station behind the pump house and wait until your battery is fully charged before returning to the loading dock.

Start at the tool shed behind the orchard and pick up a sealed container of pesticide. Drive to the northern vineyard and deliver the container to the vineyard crew supervisor. Remain at the delivery spot for 10 minutes to receive an empty container, then collect the empty container. Take the empty container to the hazardous material drop-off zone next to the recycling depot. Wait until the container is safely removed from the robot, then proceed to the central operations hub and stand by for further instructions.

Head to the maintenance room adjacent to the vehicle shed and collect a container of replacement engine oil. Carefully transport the oil container to the equipment storage tent in the southern tractor yard. Wait for up to 15 minutes while the maintenance crew swaps out the old oil and returns the empty container to the robot. After retrieving the empty container, carry it back to the maintenance room and place it by the supply rack before awaiting your next assignment.

Drive to the machine parts shed located near the southern fenceline and collect three replacement drive belts and a box of lubricating oil cans. Deliver these supplies to the cotton processing mill’s maintenance entrance. Wait at the entrance for 10 minutes while the maintenance team inspects the delivered items. Once they acknowledge receipt, proceed to the farm’s central garbage collection point, pick up any empty oil cans left there, and transport them to the recycling bay by the main gate. After delivery, return to your charging station at the equipment parking area for standby.

Proceed to the fertilizer storage shed near the north orchard and collect two bags of nitrogen fertilizer. Transport the fertilizer bags to the composting area beside the animal pens, and wait until the bags are removed by the farmhands. Once the fertilizer has been fully unloaded, return to the tool station located next to the northwest gate.

Begin at the orchard operations hut and collect four freshly picked crates of apples. Navigate to the produce sorting facility adjacent to the west loading dock and deliver the apple crates. Wait while the produce team inspects and unloads the crates from the robot. After the crates have been removed, proceed to the utility shed near the irrigation canal and pick up a replacement water pump. Transport the water pump to the south field pump house and wait for up to 10 minutes for the field technician to install and verify receipt of the pump. Once confirmed, return to the orchard operations hut and await further tasks.

Navigate to the riverbank irrigation pump station and collect three replacement water filters from the supply rack. Transport the filters to the solar-powered well adjacent to the western cornfield. Wait until the site technician swaps the filters and places the used filters onto the robot. Then, carry the used filters back to the recycling depot beside the equipment garage. Once the filters are handed over, proceed to the orchard tool shed to pick up a bundle of pruning shears. Deliver the shears to the fruit-sorting pavilion in the central marketplace. After the delivery, remain on standby for 15 minutes in the pavilion entryway to assist with any additional transport requests.

Proceed to the maintenance hangar near the eastern boundary and pick up two replacement hydraulic pumps. Deliver the pumps to the tractor depot located beside the main barn. Wait at the depot until the mechanics have removed both pumps from the robot. Once the delivery is complete, return to the maintenance hangar and stand by for 5 minutes for further loading instructions.

Start at the north farm entrance and proceed to the machinery parking bay. Pick up a pallet containing two diesel cans. Drive the pallet to the generator station near the grain silos. Wait for 8 minutes while the refueling crew unloads the diesel cans. After the cans are unloaded, proceed to the packaging hut north of the vegetable plots, collect a box of empty produce crates, and deliver them to the main harvesting field entrance. Once the crates have been delivered, return directly to the machinery parking bay.

Travel to the vineyard’s north gate supply shed and pick up a sealed container of replacement grapevine sensors. Deliver the container to the drone charging dock adjacent to the operations center. Wait there for the vineyard technician to unload the container and sign off. Once the technician has retrieved the sensors, proceed to the greenhouse entrance and stand by for 15 minutes in case a return trip for additional supplies is requested.

Drive to the machinery workshop beside the western field and collect a pallet containing four replacement mower blades. Transport the pallet to the equipment maintenance yard located behind the storage silos. Wait until the maintenance crew unloads the blades. Once the drop-off is complete, head to the rainwater collection depot and stand by for 10 minutes before returning to the main garage.

Travel to the equipment depot near the irrigation canal and pick up four new drip-line reels positioned beside the tool lockers. Deliver the reels to the installation crew waiting by Pump Station 3 at the northern field edge. Wait until the crew confirms all reels have been unloaded from the robot. Once the task is complete, proceed to the workshop garage and stand by for 10 minutes for a scheduled battery check by the maintenance technician.

Begin at the equipment depot near the southern storage silos and collect three empty pesticide canisters. Transport these canisters to the central sprayer refill station beside the solar panel field. Wait until the refill technician has replaced the canisters with full ones. After receiving the filled canisters, proceed to the far east apple orchard. Deliver all three full canisters to the supply tent next to the orchard entrance, and wait until all canisters are unloaded by the orchard crew. Once unloading is finished, return to the equipment depot and remain there on standby for 10 minutes in case additional transport requests are received.

Travel to the west orchard and collect four empty harvest bins. Deliver the bins to the berry picking field near the southern creek. Wait for 15 minutes while workers load the bins with freshly picked berries. Once the bins are filled, transport them to the cold storage facility behind the main packhouse. After delivery, proceed to the field equipment shed and remain there on standby for further assignments.

Start from the orchard loading zone and retrieve three crates of harvested apples. Travel to the west-side cold storage facility and deliver all three crates on the designated receiving platform. Wait until all crates have been unloaded by the storage team. After the crates are removed, proceed to the north entrance of the parts depot and wait for 7 minutes to be loaded with any outgoing packages for delivery. Once loaded, await further directions from the depot supervisor.

Start at the packaging shed located next to the southern loading ramp. Load two boxes of sealed apple juice bottles onto your payload platform. Proceed to Dock Bay 3 at the central distribution warehouse. Wait until the distribution staff have unloaded both boxes. Next, travel to the equipment charging station beside the fuel depot and stand by for 10 minutes to allow your battery to recharge before resuming duties.

Begin at the storage pavilion near the north gate of the agricultural campus. Pick up a pallet containing assorted greenhouse panels designated for repair. Transport the pallet to the propagation greenhouse located beside the southwest reservoir. Upon arrival, wait for the greenhouse technicians to unload each panel from the pallet. Once the pallet is empty, collect a bin of used irrigation tubing from the same technicians. Deliver the bin of tubing to the recycling station adjacent to the compost yard. Do not wait after unloading at the recycling station; immediately travel to the security checkpoint at the campus main entrance and stand by for 10 minutes before your next instructions.

Travel to the orchard entrance gate and pick up a container of organic fertilizer (20 kg bag). Deliver the fertilizer to the central fig grove just past the irrigation ditch. Wait for 8 minutes as the grove supervisor dispenses the fertilizer. Afterwards, proceed to the solar panel maintenance shack near the windbreak trees, collect a box of panel cleaning supplies, and bring them to the renewable energy station by the east pasture. Once the supplies are unloaded, return directly to the orchard entrance gate.

Proceed to the main vehicle maintenance shed located near the west boundary fence. Pick up two spare tractor tires and a box of hydraulic tools. Travel to the machinery repair area beside silo 4 and deliver the box of hydraulic tools to the mechanic on duty. Wait for up to 8 minutes while the mechanic inspects and removes the box. Once the tools are unloaded, continue to the tractor parking zone by the north access road to deliver the two spare tires. Wait until both tires are taken off your platform by the field crew, then move to the field workshop annex and await further loading instructions.

Start at the equipment shed beside the peach orchard. Pick up two cartons of protective netting rolls. Proceed to the northern edge of the orchard and deliver the netting to the farm workers there. Wait until all cartons have been unloaded from the robot. After unloading, travel to the solar charging station near the cattle pasture. Remain at the charging station for 8 minutes to allow battery replenishment, then return to the equipment shed and await further tasks.

Proceed to the equipment storage bunker near the east orchard entrance and pick up two sets of replacement irrigation filters. Deliver the replacement filters to Pump House 2 alongside the main irrigation canal. Upon arrival, wait until the maintenance technician retrieves both filter sets from the robot. Once unloaded, continue to the fuel depot in the southwest corner for a scheduled refueling. Wait at the fuel depot for 15 minutes before returning to the equipment storage bunker and await further assignments.

Head to the equipment storage yard located behind the greenhouse. Pick up one replacement irrigation valve and two bags of seed fertilizer. Transport the items to the west field maintenance station. Upon arrival, wait for 5 minutes for the maintenance crew to finish their ongoing repairs. Once the crew signals readiness, deliver the valve and fertilizer. Then, proceed to the water tank area to stand by until further instructions are given.

Begin at the maintenance bay beside the fuel depot and pick up two sealed cartons of replacement air filters. Transport the cartons to the irrigation pump station on the eastern boundary of the property. After delivery, wait for up to 15 minutes while the on-site engineer installs the new filters and loads any used filters onto the robot. Once the used filters are loaded, proceed to the recycling center adjacent to the north vehicle entrance, unload all used filters, then return to the maintenance bay and await further instructions.

Start at the storage barn and pick up three empty harvest baskets. Drive to the southern vineyard, deliver the baskets to the grape picking crew, and wait for 10 minutes while the baskets are filled. Once filled, transport the loaded baskets to the processing facility's loading ramp. After delivery, return to the storage barn and prepare for the next collection run.

Begin at the central storage pavilion and retrieve three 20-liter containers of irrigation solution. Transport the containers to Orchard Section D, which borders the eastern windbreak. Upon arrival, wait for the horticulturist to offload two of the containers. Once the first two containers are removed, proceed to the compost processing yard located at the south end of the farm and deliver the remaining container to the compost supervisor. After the final container is unloaded, return to the main access gate and stand by for 10 minutes before resuming your next assignment.

Start at the supply yard next to the main gate and pick up two pallets of fertilizer bags. Navigate to the north field’s auxiliary storage shed and unload the pallets at the marked drop-off zone. Wait for 10 minutes to allow farm workers to inventory the delivery. After confirmation, proceed to the fabrication workshop on the west side of the property and collect a metal repair kit from the equipment counter. Deliver the repair kit to the center irrigation pump station. Once delivered, return to the supply yard and stand by for further instructions.

Begin by traveling to the seedling greenhouse beside the west orchard gate. Collect four trays of tomato seedlings. Deliver the trays to Field Plot B near the irrigation canal, and wait until the field workers have removed all the trays. After all trays are offloaded, proceed to the compost facility at the southern edge, pick up a single bin of mature compost, and bring it to the horticulture research station adjacent to the main entrance. Wait for 12 minutes while the research team unloads and inspects the compost, then return to the maintenance garage for charging.

Proceed to the maintenance workshop adjacent to the vehicle garage. Pick up two replacement hydraulic hoses and a crate of assorted wrenches. Deliver these supplies to the irrigation pump station next to the east vineyard. Wait for 5 minutes until the on-site technician confirms receipt of the items. After the handover, drive to the equipment sanitization area near the greenhouse and wait there until scheduled cleaning protocols are completed before returning to the maintenance workshop.

Proceed to the greenhouse loading area at the eastern edge of the property and pick up two crates of young tomato plants. Deliver the crates to Plot 6 inside the main crop field. Wait until the planting crew confirms that all tomato plants have been unloaded from the robot. Once your payload is empty, navigate back to the equipment garage, and dock at the charging station for your scheduled recharge interval.

Start at the equipment shelter beside the machine shed. Pick up a spool of heavy-duty extension cable along with a tool kit. Proceed to the solar panel array located at the western boundary of the pasture field. Wait until the electricians remove both items from your cargo deck. Head to the livestock barn and collect two sacks of animal feed. Deliver the sacks to the far paddock feed bin next to the irrigation canal. After confirming that all feed has been transferred by the ranch staff, return to the equipment shelter and await further instructions for 8 minutes.

Start at the orchard garage. Travel to the apple storage barn on the north edge of the property and pick up four stacked crates of freshly harvested apples. Proceed to the farm market delivery zone at the main entrance and deliver the crates to the sorting supervisor. Wait until the empty crates from the previous delivery are loaded onto the robot. Return the empty crates to the orchard garage, and wait for 7 minutes to allow for unloading and cleaning before proceeding to the equipment shelter to await your next assignment.

Proceed to the equipment storage shed next to the windmill and collect two sealed containers of engine oil. Deliver the containers to the tractor refueling point behind the north barn. Wait until a technician has removed both containers from the robot. Once unloaded, navigate to the field supervisor’s mobile office by the irrigation canal, and wait for 10 minutes for further instructions before returning to the robot garage near the western fence.

Start at the vineyard packing shed beside the northwest entrance and pick up three baskets filled with harvested grapes. Transport the baskets to the weighing station next to the main farm office. Wait until the station operator has inspected and logged all baskets, then proceed to the compost yard behind the apple orchard and pick up a single empty fertilizer drum. Deliver the drum to the orchard supervisor's hut located at the east side of the orchard. Allow up to 15 minutes for the supervisor to load the drum before returning the filled drum to the compost yard.

Drive to the fertilizer storage bunker at the east end of the orchard and pick up three bags of slow-release fertilizer. Deliver the bags to the experimental crop plot beside the greenhouse. Wait until field staff have unloaded all the bags from the robot. After unloading, proceed to the water tanker refill station behind the pump house, and remain there for 15 minutes before awaiting further dispatch.

Travel to the irrigation equipment shed located behind the orchard and collect four coiled water hoses scheduled for field distribution. Deliver the hoses to the south field outpost adjacent to the blueberry grove. Wait up to 10 minutes for the field workers to unload all four hoses from your platform. After unloading, proceed to the main tool depot, pick up a box containing spare sprinkler nozzles, and return to the irrigation equipment shed. Do not wait after delivering the box; proceed directly to the robot garage for routine inspection.

Start at the orchard tool shed and collect a single crate of pruning shears. Transport the crate to the vineyard maintenance zone on the western slope. Wait while vineyard workers unload the pruning shears and then load three buckets of harvested grapes onto the robot. Once the grapes are secured, drive to the cold storage warehouse at the northern end of the property, deliver all grape buckets, and return to the orchard tool shed to complete the task.

Start at the maintenance garage by the north entrance of the facility. Drive to the fertilizer storage hut, which is located beside the apple orchard. Pick up two large sacks of organic fertilizer. Deliver the sacks to the compost mixing station near the western greenhouse. Wait until all fertilizer has been fully unloaded by the staff, or for up to 12 minutes—whichever occurs first. After delivery, move to the battery charging station in the central parking area and wait there for further instructions.

Proceed to the greenhouse supply yard and pick up four large trays of seedling pots. Deliver the trays to the eastern nursery section and wait until the horticulture staff unloads all trays. After unloading, navigate to the irrigation control station located near the southern field margin, collect a sealed canister of water analysis samples, and transport it to the laboratory door beside the admin building. Wait for 10 minutes for the laboratory technician to confirm receipt, then return to the greenhouse supply yard and await further instructions.

Begin at the maintenance garage and collect the sealed container of hydraulic fluid. Transport the container to the sunflower field’s pump station located near the northeast corner. Wait until the technician has offloaded the container and signals completion. Proceed to the supply shed adjacent to the vehicle wash bay, and stand by for 5 minutes in case further tool deliveries are requested.

Begin at the equipment garage behind the main barn and retrieve two sealed canisters of hydraulic fluid. Transport the canisters to the elevated pump house next to the southern irrigation reservoir. Wait until maintenance staff empties both canisters for pump servicing. Once finished, travel to the field produce collection point at the west cornfield, pick up a crate containing sample ears of corn, and deliver it to the quality control lab inside the produce inspection building. After dropping off the crate, wait for 12 minutes in case the lab requests additional samples. Finally, return to the equipment garage to complete the operation.

Begin at the shipping container lot near the eastern fence. Navigate to the composting area beside the north orchard and pick up two bins of finished compost. Deliver the compost bins to the raised garden beds adjacent to the crew lunch pavilion. Stand by for 8 minutes while the gardening team distributes the compost into the beds. Once finished, proceed to the maintenance garage, retrieve a small box of replacement filters, and deliver it to the generator station next to the irrigation lake. Do not wait after delivery; return immediately to the shipping container lot and await the next assignment.

Travel to the west orchard entrance and collect three crates of freshly picked pears. Transport these crates to the processing facility’s receiving bay near the north side of the plant. Upon arrival, wait up to 15 minutes for the processing crew to unload the pears. Once the unloading is complete, proceed to the supply tent by the farm road and pick up a replacement set of harvesting tools, returning them to the west orchard entrance before your next assignment.

Proceed to the south orchard loading zone and collect a crate of freshly picked pears. Transport the crate to the cold storage building adjacent to the packaging facility. Wait until the storage supervisor removes the crate from the robot. After the crate has been unloaded, travel to the maintenance trailer near the eastern tool shed and pick up a box of replacement sensors. Deliver these sensors to the autonomous tractor depot on the southern gravel lot. Once delivery is complete, return to the south orchard loading zone and wait for 5 minutes before resuming operations.

Begin at the east storage depot adjacent to the orchard and pick up three crates of harvested apples. Transport the crates to the fruit quality inspection station located along the farm’s main lane. Remain at the inspection station until all crates have been unloaded and inspected by staff. Once completed, proceed to the machinery maintenance shed behind the equipment garage for your next task.

Start at the tool supply shed near the orchard entrance and pick up a box of pruning shears. Deliver the box to the middle of Orchard Block 7, where the pruning team is working. Wait until the shears are removed from the robot, then proceed immediately to the fertilizer storage bunker adjacent to Field 3. Collect three sacks of organic fertilizer and transport them to the composting site at the north boundary of the facility. Wait for 8 minutes while groundskeepers unload the sacks. After unloading is confirmed, travel to the vehicle wash station just outside Maintenance Building A and remain there until further instructions are received.

Head to the seed warehouse located beside the west orchard. Pick up four trays of seedling pots scheduled for planting. Drive to the greenhouse complex entrance on the south side of the farm. Wait until the horticulture team removes all trays, then proceed to the perimeter fence gate and wait for 10 minutes to assist with any additional material transfers.

Start at the equipment garage and collect the toolbox labeled 'Field Repairs'. Proceed to wind turbine number three at the northwest end of the property. Wait at the turbine until the maintenance crew loads a damaged gearbox onto the robot. Once loaded, transport the gearbox to the mechanical workshop adjacent to the solar panel field. Wait at the workshop for 12 minutes while the technicians inspect the gearbox. Afterward, pick up a crate of replacement bearings from the workshop and deliver it to storage shed B, located near the east boundary of the property. After completing the delivery, return to the equipment garage and await further instructions.

Begin at the equipment shed near the east field entrance. Pick up two rolls of irrigation hose tagged for the vineyard sector. Deliver the hoses to the irrigation coordinator at the south end of the vineyard. Wait until the coordinator has offloaded both rolls and hands you two empty chemical sprayer tanks. Transport the empty tanks to the chemical storage facility adjacent to the farmhouse garage. Wait for 10 minutes while the staff inspects and refills the tanks. Once refilled, collect the tanks and deliver them to the greenhouse storage area for future use.

Begin at the machinery depot near the north gate and pick up two sealed containers of hydraulic oil. Drive to the repair bay located inside the eastern maintenance hangar. Wait in the designated unloading zone until a mechanic signals that the hydraulic lifts are ready to be refilled. Unload the containers as directed by the mechanic. Next, proceed to the pesticide storage unit behind the south field barn and collect a small pallet of empty chemical canisters. Transport these canisters to the decontamination station adjacent to the farm's main entrance. Once the canisters are handed over, wait for 8 minutes at the decontamination station in case there are any urgent transport needs, then return to the machinery depot.

Begin at the maintenance garage by the east fence and proceed to the irrigation supply shed. Pick up four rolls of irrigation tubing. Transport the rolls to the central orchard equipment depot. Wait up to 10 minutes for orchard staff to unload all tubing rolls. After the unload is confirmed, head to the main administration office and collect a sealed envelope marked 'Delivery'. Deliver the envelope to the greenhouse complex at the southern boundary. Once delivered, return to the maintenance garage.

Start at the vineyard operations center and proceed to the equipment shed beside the western windbreak. Pick up a single crate of grape pruning tools. Deliver the crate to the north slope block where the pruning crew is stationed. Wait for 15 minutes while the crew selects and removes the required tools. After the crate is emptied, proceed to the field office at the south entrance and collect two rolls of survey marking tape. Transport the marking tape rolls to the boundary markers storage rack in the southeast corner of the main field. Upon delivery, return to the vineyard operations center and prepare for the next task.

Travel to the pesticide storage shed near the east barn and pick up three sealed canisters of organic pesticide. Deliver the canisters to the apple orchard entrance where the orchard manager will be waiting. Wait until the manager has finished unloading the canisters; this is expected to take approximately 7 minutes. Once unloaded, head to the solar charging station adjacent to the maintenance garage for a scheduled charging session and wait there until your battery reaches 90% capacity. After charging, return to the main control hub near the farm office and stand by for your next assignment.

Begin at the main storage garage near the west entrance. Collect two boxes of replacement irrigation nozzles. Drive to field A’s eastern boundary where the irrigation system junction is located. Wait for the field engineer to unload and replace the nozzles with three faulty nozzle units. After the payload swap, transport the faulty nozzles to the maintenance bay adjacent to the fabrication workshop. Once all nozzles are delivered, proceed to the lunch tent by the south gate and wait for 15 minutes before receiving further tasks.

Start at the vineyard garage and pick up two barrels of grape concentrate. Travel to the fermentation facility at the east end of the property and deliver the barrels to the designated unloading platform. Wait until the barrels have been removed by the processing staff. After the delivery, proceed to the maintenance depot near the north access road and collect three replacement solar panels. Bring the solar panels to the equipment staging area behind the greenhouse and wait for 15 minutes for the installation crew to unload the panels. Once unloading is complete, return to the vineyard garage and stand by for further instructions.

Start at the pesticide storage shed near the orchard entrance. Pick up four sealed canisters of organic pesticide. Drive to the citrus grove irrigation tower at the northern edge of the property. Wait for the orchard supervisor to offload and apply the pesticide to the automated sprayer—remain until all canisters are removed. Once the pesticide is offloaded, proceed to the gravel lot outside the equipment refueling station and wait by the marked loading zone for 20 minutes before returning to your designated standby area at the central maintenance plaza.

Travel to the spare parts storage located beside the old machinery shed. Collect a single heavy-duty battery pack and three replacement drive belts. Proceed to the solar array maintenance station near the southern boundary. Upon arrival, wait for the maintenance technician to remove the old battery and take all spare parts from your payload. Once unloaded, remain at the solar array maintenance station for 10 minutes in case additional supplies are needed before returning to the spare parts storage.

Proceed to the orchard equipment barn and collect two crates of mechanical picking arms. Navigate to the east orchard row and deliver both crates to the field supervisor. Wait at the east orchard row until the supervisor confirms all equipment has been unloaded, then travel to the central maintenance garage for further assignments.

Head to the supply outpost near the orchard entrance and collect three crates of replacement drip line fittings. Travel to the northern quadrant of the vineyard and wait for 12 minutes while maintenance staff prepare the irrigation junctions. Once signaled, deliver the crates to the staging area adjacent to the service truck. Wait until all crates have been unloaded by the field technicians, then proceed to the farm office porch to pick up a package of safety vests, and bring them to the crew lunch shelter by the pond. After verifying delivery, return to the supply outpost and await further loading.

Proceed to the livestock feed silo adjacent to the red barn. Collect five sacks of poultry feed, ensuring they are securely loaded. Transport the feed sacks to the south-side poultry enclosure near the windbreak. Wait until all sacks have been removed from the robot by staff. Once unloaded, drive to the maintenance hub at the main workshop and stand by for 10 minutes before initiating your next task.
