After unloading, move to the chemical storage area to pick up a sealed drum of cleaning solution. Transport the drum to the equipment wash pad and wait for 10 minutes while the cleaning is in progress before returning to the vineyard control office.

Navigate to the orchard supply hut and pick up a pallet of biodegradable seed trays. Transport the pallet to the seedling greenhouse and wait for the horticulture team to unload all trays. Once empty, proceed to the west boundary fence, collect any discarded irrigation hoses found along the fence, and return them to the equipment recycling compound.

Drive to the maintenance shed and pick up two replacement hoses. Deliver the hoses to the pump station near Irrigation Field 3. Wait to be unloaded by the technician, then return to the maintenance shed and remain there until further notice.

Head to the feed storage barn and pick up two bags of chicken feed. Deliver the bags to the poultry enclosure and wait until the feed is fully unloaded. After delivery, travel to the maintenance workshop to collect a set of spare wheel assemblies, then bring the spare wheels to the equipment repair bay. Wait for 5 minutes at the repair bay before returning to the main control station.

Start by traveling to the solar panel array located near the southern perimeter fence and pick up two empty water jugs. Take these water jugs to the central greenhouse and wait until staff have refilled and reloaded them onto your platform. Once the jugs are ready, proceed to the seedling propagation shed on the west side, deliver the water jugs, and wait there for 15 minutes while the irrigation crew uses the water. After the waiting period, return to the main operations hub and await your next assignment.

Begin by traveling to the fertilizer silo by the north field and collect three sacks of organic fertilizer. Deliver the sacks to the greenhouse entrance. Wait until all sacks have been unloaded by the greenhouse staff. Afterwards, proceed to the drone charging station behind the barn, pick up a battery pack, and transport it to the weather monitoring station near the orchard. Wait for 10 minutes while the battery is exchanged, then return to the robot staging area next to the field gate.

First, drive to the pallet loading zone next to the packing shed and pick up two crates of harvested lettuce. Transport the crates to the cold storage room at the end of the west corridor. After unloading the crates, proceed outside to the water pump station by the irrigation canal. Wait there for 7 minutes until the maintenance crew signals that the required replacement hose has been prepared. Collect the replacement hose and deliver it to the main repair garage near the equipment depot. Once the hose has been handed over, return to the charging station at the southern perimeter of the property.

Proceed to the solar charging station beside the maintenance shed and pick up three battery packs ready for dispatch. Carry the battery packs to the remote field sensor array, deliver them to the technician on site, and wait until the technician finishes installing them. Once installation is complete and the battery packs have been handed off, return to the logistics hub and await further instructions.

Proceed to the vineyard storage shed and collect three empty grape collection baskets. Deliver the baskets to the east vineyard row 8. Wait until farm workers have filled the baskets with harvested grapes, which should take about 10 minutes. Then, transport the filled baskets to the produce sorting tent located near the main farm road. After dropping off the grapes, drive to the equipment wash station for cleaning.

Navigate to the lumber storage yard and load two bundles of wooden stakes onto the robot. Deliver the stakes to the southern field plot B, where the staking crew is working. Wait until a crew member unloads both bundles. Next, continue to the fertilizer shed and pick up one sealed fertilizer canister. Transport the canister to the irrigation control station near pond 2. Once the delivery is complete, proceed to the shade canopy near the orchard and stand by for 7 minutes before returning to the main garage.

Head to the southern greenhouse and collect three crates of seedling trays. Deliver the crates to the propagation field and wait for the horticulture team to unload the trays. After unloading, proceed to the compost facility to pick up two bags of organic fertilizer and transport them to the irrigation hub near the central field. Wait at the irrigation hub for 10 minutes, then continue to the maintenance barn before resuming standby operations.

Proceed to the storage barn located north of the vineyard and pick up four crates of harvested grapes. Transport the crates to the pressing facility at the eastern end of the property. Upon arrival, wait for staff to unload all the crates. After the unloading is confirmed, drive to the maintenance shed, collect a box of replacement parts, and deliver these to the drone charging station adjacent to the orchard. Once the box has been delivered, return to the storage barn and stand by for 10 minutes for further instructions.

Begin by proceeding to the fertilizer storage bunker beside the eastern crop fields. Pick up three sealed sacks of organic fertilizer. Deliver these sacks to the composting area located behind the greenhouse complex. Wait at the composting area for 10 minutes while the sacks are unloaded and an empty collection bin is prepared for transport. Once the bin is loaded onto the robot, carry it to the waste processing station adjacent to the solar panel array. After the collection bin is removed, return to the fueling outpost near the machinery barn.

Proceed to the orchard storage barn and collect three crates of freshly picked apples. Transport the crates to the roadside market stand. After arrival, wait for the vendor to offload the apples, then go to the equipment garage and remain on standby until needed.

Begin at the north equipment depot and travel to the greenhouse annex to collect three trays of young tomato plants. Carefully transport the trays to plot C in the urban farm sector. Wait for the horticulture team to unload all trays from the robot. Afterward, proceed to the maintenance hub to retrieve a box containing replacement irrigation valves. Deliver the box to the control hut at the eastern reservoir and wait for the technician to remove the package. Once the item has been received, navigate to the compost station near the windbreak for a 10-minute standby before returning to the north equipment depot to await further instructions.

Navigate to the irrigation pump house beside the south field and pick up two filter cartridges and a spool of irrigation tubing. Proceed to the equipment laydown area near the northern greenhouse. Wait for 7 minutes to allow the technicians to swap out the old filters and re-load the tubing onto your platform. Once all maintenance items are reloaded, deliver the used cartridges to the recycling depot next to the main access road. After delivery, return to the irrigation pump house and await further instructions.

Start from the central garage and travel to the north equipment yard. Pick up a pallet containing five replacement hydraulic hoses. Transport the pallet to the vehicle repair bay behind the administration building and wait to be unloaded. After the hoses are removed, proceed to the orchard's irrigation supply shed, wait for 15 minutes to receive a container of irrigation additives, and deliver the container to the field technician's staging area near the southern windbreak. Once delivered, return to the central garage.

Start at the packing house and proceed to the orchard loading point to pick up four crates of freshly harvested apples. Deliver the apple crates to the cold storage facility next to the market entrance. Wait until all crates have been unloaded by the storage staff. Then, travel to the shed adjacent to the pesticide mixing station to collect a sealed drum of organic pesticide. Carefully transport the drum to the equipment yard at the southern boundary and wait for the technician to remove the drum. Finally, return to the packing house and remain on standby for 15 minutes before reporting completion of your tasks.

Head to the seed storage barn adjacent to the east greenhouse and collect two crates of winter wheat seeds. Deliver the crates to the planter equipment awaiting loading in the southwest planting field. Wait for the operator to finish transferring the seeds from your platform to the planter. Once the crates have been unloaded, proceed to the fuel depot near the northern access road, wait for 10 minutes while your batteries are checked and topped up by the technician, then return to the seed storage barn for your next assignment.

Travel to the orchard supply shed and pick up four empty fruit bins. Deliver the bins to the apple harvest zone in the eastern orchard. Wait until the pickers have filled all the bins with apples and placed them securely on your platform. Once loaded, drive the full bins to the cool storage facility on the north side of the main warehouse and wait for 12 minutes while the storage crew unloads them. After the bins are empty, return to the orchard supply shed to complete your task.

Proceed to the spare parts depot near Warehouse 2 and pick up a box containing irrigation valve replacements. Transport the box to Greenhouse 4 at the northeastern corner of the property. Wait until the greenhouse staff have unloaded the box. Next, drive to the composting area behind the barn, and collect two empty fertilizer containers. Deliver the containers to the maintenance garage by the central access road. Remain there for 10 minutes while awaiting the supervisor’s approval for the next assignment.

Proceed to the equipment maintenance shed located next to the southern orchard. Pick up a pallet containing irrigation supplies and three replacement hoses. Deliver the pallet to irrigation zone C along the western fence line. Wait until the farm crew has finished unloading all items from your cargo bay. Once unloaded, travel to the tool kiosk near the central packing station and stand by for 12 minutes while awaiting a diagnostic firmware update from the service technician. After the update is complete, return to the equipment maintenance shed for reassignment.

Travel to the windbreak grove located along the southern boundary of the farm and retrieve four bundles of trimmed branches. Deliver the branches to the mulching station beside the compost heaps behind Storage Shed 3. Wait until the mulching station operator has signaled that all bundles are unloaded, then proceed to the diesel fueling station adjacent to the vehicle depot and stand by there for 15 minutes in case refueling assistance is needed.

Proceed to the tool locker inside the maintenance building and pick up two sealed containers of lubricating oil. Deliver the containers to the tractor assembly line in Workshop Bay 2. Wait until the assembly team removes both containers and confirms delivery. Then, drive to the farm weather station near the north entrance and remain there for 10 minutes in case additional supplies are requested.

Travel to the fertilizer storage bunker adjacent to the eastern cornfields. Collect four bags of slow-release fertilizer and a container of pest control granules. Deliver these materials to Greenhouse 4 located behind the horticulture research annex. Wait at the greenhouse loading area for 8 minutes to allow greenhouse staff to unload the supplies. After unloading is confirmed, proceed to the battery charging station inside the operations garage and wait until your battery has been fully recharged before returning to your starting position at the field deployment lot.

Drive to the orchard east gate and collect three empty harvest bins. Transport the bins to the apple grove central aisle where harvesters are working. Wait until all three bins are filled, which may take approximately 12 minutes. Once loaded, move the filled bins to the cold storage loading bay. After offloading the bins, return to the orchard east gate to stand by for additional harvest logistics.

Proceed to the machinery repair yard behind Operations Building 2 and pick up two toolboxes marked for maintenance. Deliver the toolboxes to the main greenhouse located northeast of the irrigation tank. Wait until both toolboxes have been removed from your platform, then return to the machinery repair yard to await further loading instructions.

Go to the chemical storage bay and pick up one sealed container of fertilizer solution. Transport the container to the south field irrigation junction. Wait while the field staff transfer the full container from your platform, then proceed to the maintenance workshop and wait for 8 minutes for a routine inspection. Once the inspection is complete, return to the chemical storage bay.

Proceed to the south orchard storage shed and collect six baskets of freshly harvested pears. Transport the baskets to the central packing station and wait for the packing crew to unload all baskets from the robot. Once unloaded, travel to the fertilizer storage barn, pick up two sealed bags of organic fertilizer, and deliver them to the compost mixing area adjacent to the east field. Wait until both bags are removed, then head to the farm office and await further instructions.

Drive to the greenhouse storage area and pick up two containers of nutrient solution. Transport them to the hydroponic greenhouse. Wait until the greenhouse manager confirms the containers have been unloaded, then proceed to the compost drop-off site to collect a bag of organic waste. Deliver the bag to the compost processing facility. After delivery, stand by for 10 minutes before returning to the greenhouse storage area.

Proceed to the main orchard and pick up two full baskets of harvested apples from the southern loading area. Transport the baskets to the packaging facility next to the northern access road. Wait at the entrance of the packaging facility for 15 minutes while workers inspect and unload the baskets. After the unloading is complete, drive to the maintenance shed near the equipment lot and collect a spare water filtration cartridge. Deliver the cartridge to the irrigation control center at the heart of the east meadow. Once the cartridge has been collected by the staff, return to the parking bay by the admin office.

Drive to the machinery workshop and pick up two sealed containers of engine oil. Transport the containers to the maintenance yard and wait until the mechanics have unloaded both containers, which may take up to 15 minutes. After unloading, proceed to the orchard cabin to collect a crate of replacement tractor parts. Deliver the crate to the north apple grove storage shed, then return to the central garage for further directions.

Start at the central depot and pick up a pallet of irrigation nozzles. Transport the pallet to the northern greenhouse. Wait until a horticulturist completes transferring the nozzles onto the assembly table. Once unloaded, proceed to the fertilizer storage area, collect two sealed fertilizer tubs, and deliver them to the tractor bay. After drop-off, wait for 10 minutes before returning to the central depot.

Drive to the farm tools storage and pick up three spare tractor batteries. Deliver the batteries to the maintenance garage. After delivery, wait in the garage for 10 minutes for further instructions from the maintenance crew. Once the wait is over, proceed to the machinery wash bay, collect any empty oil containers present, and bring them to the hazardous waste collection area for proper disposal.

Proceed to the maintenance shed located near the main orchard entrance and pick up a single toolbox labeled 'Irrigation Repair'. Transport the toolbox to Irrigation Station 3 in the southern orchard. Wait for the repair crew to remove the toolbox from your platform, then stand by for 20 minutes in case additional parts are needed. If no further items are requested, return to the maintenance shed and await further instructions.

Proceed from the equipment hangar to the western greenhouse complex. Pick up two sacks of organic fertilizer and a tray of potted seedlings. Deliver both items to the vegetable plot adjacent to the east pond. Wait up to 10 minutes for the farm team to unload the payload. Once the items are removed, travel to the solar charging station near the perimeter fence and wait for 20 minutes to recharge before returning to the equipment hangar.

Start at the west gate of the livestock pasture and proceed to the hay storage barn. Pick up four bundles of hay and deliver them to the feeding area inside the horse paddock. Wait for the farmhands to remove all hay bundles from your platform, then continue to the tool supply room adjacent to the equipment garage. Collect a sealed container of engine oil and take it to the tractor refueling station beside the north gravel lot. After leaving the container at the refueling station, wait for 10 minutes to allow for further assignment instructions before returning to the west gate.

Start by traveling to the vineyard loading area and pick up three crates of harvested grapes. Proceed to the wine cellar entrance and deliver the crates. Once delivery is complete, head over to the equipment shelter and wait to be loaded with a spare irrigation hose by the technician. After the hose is loaded, transport it to the greenhouse repair station and wait for five minutes while the repair crew removes the hose. Finally, return to the central operations hub and stand by for further instructions.

Begin at the maintenance garage and drive to the north machinery depot to retrieve a crate of spare hydraulic fittings. Transport the crate to the greenhouse annex near the eastern windbreak. Wait until the technical crew has fully unloaded the hydraulic fittings. Next, proceed to the workshop warehouse to pick up three cans of biodegradable solvent. Deliver the cans to the drone launch pad outside the grain silo and wait 10 minutes for the drone operators to finish unloading. Afterward, return to the maintenance garage and prepare for the next task.

Travel to the fertilizer storage bunker beside the eastern field. Retrieve two sealed containers of liquid fertilizer. Deliver both containers to the nutrient mixing station at Greenhouse 2. Wait until greenhouse staff have unloaded the containers from your platform, then proceed to the water reservoir outpost for your next assignment.

Travel to the machinery refueling station at the eastern boundary and pick up a drum of biofuel. Deliver the drum to Field Tractor 7, currently parked at the north paddock staging area. Wait there until farm personnel have finished refueling the tractor and remove the empty drum from your platform. Then, proceed to the orchard tool shed and collect a bin of pruning shears. Transport the pruning shears to the vineyard entrance at the western slope and wait for 20 minutes while the vineyard crew retrieves and organizes the tools. Afterwards, drive to the shade structure near the east gardens and await further instructions.

Navigate to the greenhouse storage area and pick up three trays of seedling pots. Deliver the trays to the propagation tunnel at the southern field entrance and wait until all trays are removed from your platform. Next, proceed to the irrigation equipment locker and collect a coiled length of hose and a box of spray nozzles. Transport these items to the central water management station. Wait for 10 minutes while technicians install the equipment, then return to the robot charging bay located beside the farm's central communications tower.

Proceed to the machine parts storage near the main workshop and pick up a pallet containing six hydraulic hoses. Deliver the pallet to the maintenance hangar at the far west end of the site. Wait until all hoses are unloaded by the technicians, which could take up to 8 minutes. After unloading is complete, travel to the refueling station and stand by for further tasks.

Begin at the maintenance hub and travel to the windbreak grove near the eastern perimeter. Pick up two bundles of replacement fencing posts from the designated supply rack. Carry the fencing posts to the livestock enclosure gate. Wait until the ranch crew has collected all bundles, which is estimated to take 8 minutes. Afterward, proceed to the water pump station beside the irrigation reservoir and retrieve a small pallet containing irrigation valve kits. Deliver the pallet to the greenhouse annex, and once the kits are offloaded by the horticulture team, return to the maintenance hub and stand by for further instructions.

Travel to the fertilizer depot beside the west field and pick up two sealed containers of liquid fertilizer. Deliver the containers to the irrigation control point in the southern greenhouse complex. Wait at the control point until a technician unloads both containers. Afterwards, proceed to the refuse collection area behind the maintenance building to collect a bin of used filters. Transport the bin to the waste processing center located near the main entrance and wait for 5 minutes before returning to the fertilizer depot.

Proceed to the spare parts depot near the west gate, pick up a set of replacement hydraulic hoses, and deliver them to the maintenance bay in the machine workshop. Wait until the technician signals that the hoses have been removed from your cargo platform, then drive to the solar charging pad behind the equipment barn and remain there until your battery is fully recharged.

Head to the composting zone located behind the greenhouse and pick up three empty fertilizer bins stacked near the northern fence. Transport the bins to the fertilizer mixing room adjacent to the central barn. Wait for 5 minutes while the staff loads the bins with fresh fertilizer mix. Once loaded, deliver the filled bins to the eastern orchard entrance for the planting crew. Remain at the orchard entrance until all bins are unloaded, then proceed to the tool storage locker next to the north entrance gate and await further instructions.

Proceed to the main machinery shed next to the west pasture and collect two sets of replacement hydraulic hoses and a box of lubricating grease. Transport these supplies to Tractor Maintenance Bay 2 at the central workshop. Wait until the maintenance technician inspects and unloads the items, then continue to the orchard tool station to pick up a crate of pruning shears. Deliver the shears to the south orchard supervisor’s tent and wait for 10 minutes to allow field workers to retrieve the equipment before returning to the parking zone near the farm office.

Proceed to the receiving bay beside the machine workshop and collect four sealed boxes of replacement tractor parts. Deliver the boxes to the repair tent at the edge of the equipment test field. Wait for 10 minutes as the mechanics inspect the contents and remove the required parts. Once all boxes have been unloaded, drive to the pesticide storage container located on the north end of the property and pick up two labeled pesticide sprayer tanks. Transport the sprayer tanks to the grapevines section behind water tower 1, and remain at the drop-off point until a vineyard supervisor confirms delivery completion by removing both tanks. Afterward, relocate to the solar charging pad near the main admin building and wait until the battery is fully recharged before resuming other tasks.

Begin at the packing warehouse next to the northern field. Proceed to the solar panel array located along the east fence. Pick up three boxes containing replacement inverters. Deliver the boxes to the maintenance depot behind the equipment workshop. Wait for technicians to unload all boxes and confirm the delivery, which may take up to 12 minutes. After delivery is confirmed, drive to the fertilizer storage shed by the irrigation control center. Wait to be loaded with two sealed containers of fertilizer, then transport them to greenhouse number 2 at the southern edge of the property. Wait until the containers are retrieved by the greenhouse staff, then return to the packing warehouse.

Proceed to the vineyard packaging area and pick up three pallets of boxed grapes. Transport the pallets to the refrigerated storage building beside the main barn. Once the delivery is complete, wait at the storage building for 10 minutes to receive any urgent return items. If handed any return packages, bring them to the farm’s supply office located next to the main entrance, then return to the charging station adjacent to the equipment hangar.

Drive to the south field supply shed and pick up five bags of fertilizer labeled 'Organic Feed.' Transport the bags to the crop treatment zone at the western edge of Field 4. Wait for 10 minutes while the field crew empties the fertilizer bags, then proceed to the wash station near the farm's east entrance and wait until your platform is cleaned.

Start at the orchard entrance and drive to the packaging shed. Pick up three crates of freshly harvested pears. Transport the crates to the storage barn next to the northern access road. Wait up to 15 minutes for the storage crew to unload the pears. Once unloaded, proceed to the maintenance bay for a quick system diagnostics, then return to the orchard entrance.

Travel to the orchard’s west entrance and pick up three empty crate stacks. Deliver these to the central fruit collection point. Wait there until the crates are filled with harvested apples. Once loaded, proceed to the north gate cold storage facility and unload all crate stacks. After unloading, drive to the equipment charging station and remain there for 15 minutes before returning to the orchard’s west entrance.

Start at the equipment garage and proceed to the solar array field near the southern edge of the property. Load four coils of electrical cable from the storage crate. Transport the coils to the utility control shed adjacent to the grain elevator. Wait until the maintenance team retrieves all coils, which may take up to 5 minutes. Once unloading is complete, move to the compost storage pad next to the east orchard entrance. Pick up a compost testing kit and deliver it to the laboratory trailer by the central access road. After dropping off the kit, wait for 7 minutes for laboratory staff to confirm receipt, then return to the equipment garage.

Begin at the equipment garage and proceed to the fuel depot. Pick up two sealed fuel canisters. Deliver the canisters to the irrigation pump station near the south field. After delivering, wait for 10 minutes while maintenance staff refuel the pumps. When the refueling is complete, head to the western tool yard, pick up a pallet of spare hoses, and transport it to the machinery shed located beside field 3.

Start at the north entrance of the vineyard and proceed to the harvest collection point. Pick up three crates of freshly picked grapes. Transport the crates to the temperature-controlled storage room beside the main winery building. After unloading the crates, wait for 5 minutes to allow the storage manager to verify the inventory. Upon confirmation, continue to the packaging station in the west wing, collect a box of empty wine bottles, and deliver them to the bottling line at the south facility.

Begin at the east workshop and pick up three battery packs for autonomous tractors. Deliver the battery packs to the farm equipment yard near the solar array. Wait until a technician has removed all three battery packs. Next, proceed to the orchard’s tool shed and collect a crate of pruning shears. Transport the crate to the orchard’s southeast corner, and wait 7 minutes for the field crew to complete unloading before returning to the east workshop.

Begin by navigating to the utility shed near the east pasture and collect one spare hydraulic pump. Transport the hydraulic pump to the machinery service area located beside the northern storage silo. Wait there until the maintenance crew installs the pump on a harvester. Once installation is complete and the pump has been removed from the robot, proceed to the field supply depot and pick up four containers of lubricating oil. Deliver the oil containers to the heavy equipment workshop and stay there for 10 minutes before returning to the utility shed for standby.

Head over to the lumber storage yard and collect two bundles of wooden planks designated for fence repairs. Transport the bundles to the far eastern orchard perimeter, where the maintenance crew will be stationed. Wait until all planks have been unloaded by the crew, then proceed to the irrigation control kiosk near pond number three. Pick up the water quality testing kit from the kiosk and deliver it to the aquaponics greenhouse entrance. Wait for seven minutes while the greenhouse staff use and then remove the testing kit from the robot. Once the transfer is complete, drive to the shade structure beside the staff break area and await further loading or task assignments.

Travel to the greenhouse annex and collect two crates of harvested tomatoes. Deliver the crates to the fresh produce depot located near the southern gate. Once delivery is complete, proceed to the pesticide storage shed and pick up one sealed pesticide canister. Transport the canister to the quarantine field and wait until the field supervisor removes it, then return to the supply corridor next to the main warehouse.

Begin at the maintenance garage, then travel to the equipment shed on the eastern perimeter. Pick up two replacement hydraulic hoses and a box of assorted wrenches. Deliver these items to the tractor repair bay adjacent to Field Section 7. Wait up to 10 minutes while the mechanics unload the items and confirm receipt. Once unladen, proceed to the water refill station near the irrigation pond and stand by for further instructions.

Start at the equipment shelter beside the east vineyard and proceed to the cold storage locker behind the berry processing barn. Pick up a pallet of harvested blueberries. Drive the load to the delivery point at the roadside market stand. Wait until all blueberry crates have been unloaded by the market staff. Next, travel to the supply hut near the irrigation pond to collect a single drum of liquid fertilizer. Deliver this drum to the pump station at the north field boundary and wait for 5 minutes while the field crew empties the drum. Once unloaded, head back to the equipment shelter by the east vineyard to await further instructions.

Navigate to the solar panel storage area behind the administration office and pick up two crates of backup batteries. Deliver the crates to the power management station beside the north barn. Wait until a technician has fully unloaded both crates from your cargo deck. Once the delivery is complete, proceed to the mobile charging dock near the machinery garage and recharge for 15 minutes before standing by for your next assignment.

Begin at the main garage adjacent to the maintenance yard. Navigate to the solar panel depot at the southern edge of the property and pick up three replacement solar inverters. Transport these inverters to the rooftop access point at the research lab building. Wait until the technical crew unloads all the inverters. After all items have been removed, proceed to the farm storehouse on the western lane to collect a crate of packaging materials. Deliver the crate to the harvest packing station beside the orchard entrance and stand by for 10 minutes for further unloading and inspection before returning to the main garage.

Start at the loading dock on the south side of the compound. Travel to the greenhouse supplies room and pick up four trays of potted seedlings. Deliver the trays to the planting zone in the southeast orchard. After ensuring all trays are unloaded by the horticulture team, proceed to the compost depot and collect one sealed drum of compost tea. Transport the drum to the raised beds beside the northern pathway, and wait for 7 minutes while gardeners apply the solution. Once the waiting period is complete, return to the loading dock and await new directions.

Start from the central loading bay and proceed to the greenhouse annex beside the irrigation channel. Pick up two trays of tomato seedlings from the prep station. Move the trays to the planting area along the west fence of the north field. Wait up to 10 minutes while the planting crew unloads both trays. After delivery, travel to the pesticide storage shed near the main drive. Collect one sealed container of organic pesticide and deliver it to the northern orchard gate. Wait there until orchard staff unloads the container, which should take no more than 5 minutes, before returning to the central loading bay.

Proceed to the orchard’s north loading area and collect three empty harvest bins. Deliver the empty bins to the berry patch at the eastern edge of the farm. Wait for 12 minutes while workers fill the bins with harvested berries. Once full, transport the loaded bins to the cold storage facility adjacent to the main distribution center. After unloading, return to the equipment garage and stand by for further instructions.

Travel to the tool storage locker next to the main greenhouse and pick up the box of pruning shears. Head over to Orchard Section 5 and deliver the pruning shears to the team leader near the southwest gate. Wait for the team leader to remove the box from your cargo area. After the handoff, proceed to the water refill point behind the supply barn and wait there for 10 minutes before proceeding to the equipment parking zone for standby.

Start at the garage adjacent to the main access road. Drive to the spare parts storage area near the wind turbine cluster and pick up two crates containing replacement rotor blades. Deliver these crates to the rooftop access point of the central factory building; wait until maintenance staff collect both crates, which may take up to 10 minutes. Afterward, proceed to the chemical storage bunker by the western gate, wait to be loaded with a single sealed drum of cleaning solvent, and transport the drum to the vehicle wash station beside the north parking lot. Wait for the drum to be unloaded, then return to the garage and await further assignments.

Travel to the machinery workshop and pick up two sealed tool kits. Deliver the tool kits to the field maintenance shed near the irrigation canal. Wait for 10 minutes while technicians check the kits and add replacement parts. Afterward, pick up any discarded tools that need repair from the maintenance shed and carry them back to the machinery workshop. Once there, wait until a technician removes the discarded tools from the robot.

Begin at the supply depot near the greenhouse complex. Proceed to the irrigation equipment shed at the northeast field margin and pick up four coiled hoses. Deliver these hoses to the reservoir control station located by the central pond. Wait on site for the water management crew to remove all hoses, then travel to the workshop annex beside the machinery barn. Collect a small crate of electronic sensors and take them to the vineyard processing tent situated at the south orchard border. Wait until the sensors are fully unloaded before returning to the supply depot.

Begin at the maintenance garage located behind the storage silos. Drive to the fertilizer distribution hub next to the east paddock and pick up three 25kg bags of granular fertilizer. Transport these bags to the southern pasture gate, where the field crew will collect them for spreading. Wait up to 7 minutes while the bags are unloaded. Next, travel to the service corridor behind the milking parlor to retrieve one replacement milking nozzle from the equipment cart. Deliver the nozzle to the hygiene station adjacent to the herd entrance and wait until dairy staff remove it. After the delivery is complete, return directly to the maintenance garage.

Head to the seed storage barn located beside the north field entrance and pick up a pallet loaded with assorted vegetable seeds. Transport the pallet to the greenhouse loading bay and wait for the greenhouse crew to unload it, which may take up to 10 minutes. After unloading, navigate to the tool shed near the irrigation pump house and collect a box containing spare drip line connectors. Deliver the box to the eastern irrigation outpost and wait until it is removed from the robot. Once all deliveries are complete, proceed to the robot charging station west of the administration building to dock and recharge.

Travel to the windbreak orchard located south of the apple fields and pick up three crates of fallen branches. Deliver the crates to the composting facility behind the equipment garage. Wait for 5 minutes while the facility staff unload the crates. Afterward, proceed to the chemical storage cabin and collect a safety kit bag. Transport the safety kit to the mobile sprayer parked at Field 7's southern edge and wait until the crew removes the kit from the robot. Finally, return to the maintenance bay near the greenhouse and await further instructions.

Proceed to the equipment yard adjacent to the west entrance and collect the pallet of irrigation hoses. Transport the pallet to the citrus grove loading stand near the eastern treeline. Wait for the grove supervisor to inspect and accept the hoses. Once the supervisor confirms, head to the storage shelter across from the maintenance office and pick up two cans of lubricating oil. Deliver these to the tractor service area beside Field 9 and wait until the technician removes both cans from your cargo bay. After delivery, return to the solar charging station near the fieldworker rest stop and wait for 20 minutes to recharge.

Begin at the central garage and drive to the solar panel array on the east ridge to pick up a toolkit and three replacement solar cells. Deliver these items to the energy monitoring station near the windmill in the north field. Wait until the station manager has unloaded all equipment. Next, proceed to the feed storage barn on the southeast corner of the farm to collect a pallet of animal feed. Transport the pallet to the livestock shelter adjoining the caretaker’s quarters and remain stationary until all feed is removed. Finally, return to the central garage and stand by for 10 minutes before awaiting further instructions.

Proceed to the greenhouse supply shed and collect five bags of potting soil. Transport the potting soil to the north greenhouse and wait while the staff unloads the cargo. Once unloaded, continue to the irrigation pump station to retrieve any empty fertilizer tanks. Deliver the empty tanks to the recycling area near the equipment barn. After delivery, wait for 8 minutes before heading back to the dispatch terminal for your next task.

Proceed to the seed storage bunker behind the greenhouse and collect five sacks of sunflower seeds. Transport these sacks to the planting area adjacent to the southern irrigation canal. After delivery, move to the composting station and pick up a barrel of organic compost. Take the barrel to the vegetable nursery’s loading bay and wait there until a staff member signals that the barrel has been unloaded. When unloading is complete, return to the seed storage bunker and await further instructions for 10 minutes.

Proceed to the compost heap near the southern orchard grove and collect two bins filled with fresh compost. Transport these bins to the flower nursery delivery bay on the southeast corner of the property. Wait until both bins are offloaded by the nursery staff. Next, travel to the equipment maintenance garage adjacent to the grain silo, pick up a crate containing replacement hydraulic hoses, and deliver it to the maintenance trailer parked beside the central tractor barn. Remain at the trailer until a technician removes the crate. Finally, return to the main robot dispatch shelter near the parking lot to await further instructions.

Begin at the logistics center loading bay and pick up two weatherproof toolboxes. Transport the toolboxes to the vineyard shed located at the edge of the eastern slope. Upon arrival, wait for vineyard staff to unload both toolboxes from your platform. When unloading is complete, proceed to the pesticide storage building and retrieve four sealed canisters of pesticide. Deliver these canisters to the spraying depot at the south end of the orchard. Wait at the depot for 15 minutes to allow for inventory checks, then return to the logistics center for standby.

Drive to the north orchard supply zone and collect three empty fruit crates. Deliver the crates to the fruit picking area on the east side of the orchard. Wait until all crates have been filled by the workers and loaded back onto the robot. Once loaded, transport the filled fruit crates to the cold storage building at the farm base and wait there until a staff member has unloaded every crate from the robot before returning to the central dispatch station.

Proceed to the seed storage shed next to the north barn and pick up a pallet of oat seed bags. Deliver the pallet to the planting equipment area by Field 3 on the eastern side of the property. Wait for 10 minutes while the planting team unloads the seed bags from the robot. Once unloading is complete, drive to the loading dock adjacent to the main office and collect a sealed shipment box labeled 'Lab Samples.' Transport the box to the laboratory entrance near the south greenhouse. After drop-off, return to the robot parking zone beside the equipment wash station and remain on standby for further tasks.

Proceed to the irrigation equipment shed beside the west pasture and collect a coiled hose reel marked for maintenance. Deliver the hose reel to the maintenance workshop situated north of the storage silos. Wait for 7 minutes while the technicians perform repairs on the reel. Once the repairs are complete and the hose reel is reloaded onto the robot, transport it back to the irrigation equipment shed and wait for authorized personnel to unload it before returning to standby at the fleet charging station.

Drive to the orchard equipment shed near the northern gate. Collect three empty harvest baskets. Deliver the baskets to the apple grove clearing by the old irrigation pump. Wait for 10 minutes while farm workers load apples into the baskets, then return the loaded baskets to the produce sorting barn at the main compound.

Drive to the orchard collection point and pick up two bins of freshly picked apples. Deliver the bins to the cold storage warehouse. Next, proceed to the pesticide supply zone and wait to be loaded with a canister of organic pesticide by the supervisor. After the canister is secured, travel to field plot C and deliver the pesticide to the field crew. Remain at field plot C for ten minutes to assist with any further hauling needs before returning to the maintenance garage for charging.

Drive to the equipment garage and pick up one crate of replacement irrigation nozzles. Bring the crate to the south field maintenance station and wait for the technician to remove the nozzles. After the crate is empty, proceed to the greenhouse loading bay and collect three trays of young tomato plants. Deliver the trays to the planting team at Plot 5 near the southern hedgerow. Wait until all trays are offloaded before returning to the equipment garage for your next assignment.

Travel to the packaging tent located at the south edge of the apple orchard and pick up three crates of freshly harvested apples. Proceed to the cold storage facility adjacent to the main greenhouse and deliver the crates. After unloading, wait at the cold storage facility for 10 minutes in case additional produce requires pickup. If no further payloads are assigned, navigate back to the packaging tent for your next assignment.

Go to the irrigation equipment depot and collect a box of replacement hoses. Transport the box to the vineyard maintenance area beside the north orchard. Wait for 8 minutes while technicians retrieve the hoses, then proceed to the packing barn and pick up two sealed containers of harvested grapes. Deliver the grape containers to the cold storage facility at the central warehouse, and wait until they are unloaded before returning to the main charging station.

Proceed to Greenhouse 3 near the southern field and pick up two crates of starter seedlings. Transport the seedlings to the northern irrigation station and wait for 10 minutes while the horticulture team inspects the crates. Once cleared, drive to the supply tent by the compost yard to collect an empty water barrel. Deliver the empty barrel to Maintenance Bay 2 inside the equipment hangar. After delivery, wait until a technician loads a toolbox onto your platform, then return the toolbox to the main administration building for storage.

Navigate to the northern vineyard entrance and collect three baskets of freshly harvested grapes. Transport these baskets to the fermentation facility located beside the old windmill. Wait for ten minutes while the baskets are unloaded. Then, proceed to the weather monitoring station at the eastern perimeter fence to pick up a sealed box of sensor data logs. Deliver the box to the farm office reception area next to the main farmhouse. After delivery, travel to the greenhouse supply shed and wait five minutes to be loaded with a bag of potting soil. Once loaded, bring the bag to the rooftop greenhouse on the warehouse building for final drop-off.

Start at the exterior shipping bay and proceed to the seed storage facility. Pick up three sacks of corn seed and deliver them to the planting machinery shed at the southern field edge. After unloading the seeds, wait for 10 minutes until the machinery operators have finished distributing the sacks. Next, move to the equipment sanitizing station and pick up a sanitation kit. Deliver the kit to the greenhouse entrance. Wait for the kit to be removed by the greenhouse staff, then travel to the control center for task completion.

Drive to the storage silo behind the main barn and pick up three sealed barrels of corn. Deliver the barrels to the animal feed distribution center and wait until the barrels are unloaded by the crew. Once finished, proceed to the tools depot next to the western orchard to collect a shipment of pruning shears. Carry the pruning shears to the orchard maintenance station. Do not wait after unloading—immediately travel to the battery charging station for standby until further instructions are received.

Start at the tool storage cabin near the north entrance of the equipment yard. Proceed to the greenhouse on the southeastern corner of the property and retrieve six bags of soil nutrients. Deliver these bags to the vegetable planting zone directly west of the greenhouse. Wait for field workers to unload all soil bags. Once unloaded, continue to the orchard supply hut to pick up a container of irrigation nozzles. Transport the container to the pump control station at the far end of the north field. After delivering the nozzles, wait for 5 minutes for an on-site inspection before returning to the tool storage cabin.

Begin at the maintenance garage and proceed to the fertilizer storage area. Pick up two sacks of organic fertilizer. Navigate to greenhouse number four and wait until the greenhouse staff have finished unloading both sacks. After delivery, drive to the orchard’s weather station to pick up a box containing weather monitoring sensors. Transport the box to the main control center office located near the eastern gate. Once the office staff have retrieved the sensors, wait for 10 minutes for further instructions before returning to the maintenance garage.

Begin at the maintenance garage adjacent to the main entrance. Travel to the lumber storage area at the west perimeter fence and collect three wooden pallets. Deliver the pallets to the carpentry workshop beside the machinery depot. Wait while the workshop team unloads the pallets, then proceed to the pesticide storage shed next to the old greenhouse. Pick up two sealed containers of pesticide, transport them to the southern orchard gate, and wait there until a field supervisor confirms the containers have been received. Finally, return to the maintenance garage and stand by for the next assignment.

Start at the storage yard beside the grain silos and pick up three sacks of fertilizer. Drive to the greenhouse complex near the west fence and deliver the fertilizer sacks to the potting area entrance. Wait for up to 10 minutes while greenhouse staff unload the sacks from your platform. Once unloading is finished, proceed to the tractor bay at the western garage to collect an empty fuel drum. Take the empty drum to the refueling station next to the central workshop and wait until staff refill and remove the drum. Afterwards, head to the shade canopy near the staff lunch area and remain there on standby until further instructions are given.

Proceed from the central workshop to the western storage canopy and collect a crate of mechanical spare parts. Deliver the crate to the solar panel maintenance yard near the windbreak poplars. Wait until maintenance staff unload all items, then continue to the equipment refueling bay by the northern gate to pick up two full fuel canisters. Take the fuel canisters to the main irrigation pump house at the pond edge, and after a staff member removes the canisters, return to the central workshop and stand by for 10 minutes before your next assignment.

Start at the central storage depot and proceed to the solar array field at the western edge of the property. Pick up three empty battery modules from the charging station collection point. Transport the battery modules to the energy management office adjacent to the control tower. Wait until the modules are unloaded and verified by the facility supervisor, which may take up to 12 minutes. After the delivery is complete, travel to the orchard processing shed and collect a single crate of harvested apples. Bring the crate to the farm market stall near the southern parking area. After the crate is collected by the vendor, return to the central storage depot and await further jobs.

Start at the fleet garage. Travel to the central orchard loading area to pick up five crates of freshly harvested apples. Deliver these crates to the produce inspection station adjacent to the main warehouse. Wait there until all crates are unloaded, which may take up to 10 minutes. Once unloaded, proceed to the seed storage shed near the south gate. Collect a bag of organic seed, and bring it to the planting equipment shed beside the west field. After delivery, return to the fleet garage.

Drive to the equipment drop-off zone near the tractor barn and collect a pallet of spare tractor parts. Transport the pallet to the field workshop station for the mechanics. Wait at the field workshop until the maintenance team unloads the pallet, then proceed to the battery charging area behind the solar array. Wait at the charging station for 20 minutes to complete the recharge cycle before heading to the central dispatch area for further instructions.

Begin your route at the greenhouse supply storage. Collect two sacks of fertilizer labeled for Field 3B. Head over to Field 3B irrigation outpost, and deliver the fertilizer sacks to the site foreman. Wait until both sacks are fully unloaded by farm staff. After confirmation, proceed to the maintenance shed and pick up a replacement water pump component. Deliver the water pump component to the lakeside irrigation station. When the technician collects the part, wait for eight minutes in case additional assistance is needed, then proceed to the rest area behind the equipment barn and stand by for further instructions.

Start at the equipment depot adjacent to the north gate and navigate to the grape vineyard on the southwestern slope. Pick up two empty water tanks left beside the drip irrigation system. Transport both tanks to the field workshop next to the packing house. Wait until the technician swaps out filter cartridges inside the tanks and reloads them onto your platform. Once reloaded, deliver the tanks to the reservoir pump station on the far west edge of the property. Wait for 15 minutes while the tanks are refilled, and once completed, return to the equipment depot and await the next assignment.

Proceed to the vineyard supply shed adjacent to the southern entrance and collect a stack of four irrigation hoses. Deliver these hoses to the pump house by the eastern pond, and wait for up to 7 minutes for the irrigation team to collect them. Once unloaded, continue to the compost heap area on the farm’s north edge and pick up a single bin of compost. Bring the compost bin to the orchard cart shed near the central path and remain there until the bin is removed from your platform. After unloading, return to the vineyard supply shed and await additional deployment orders.

Start at the seed storage room next to the greenhouse entrance. Travel to the northwest orchard collection point and pick up four crates of freshly harvested apples. Deliver the crates to the fruit sorting area near the loading dock. Wait until all crates have been removed from your platform by sorting staff. Once cleared, proceed to the solar panel maintenance lot and wait for 8 minutes while a supervisor inspects your systems for energy efficiency. After inspection, return to the seed storage room and await your next assignment.

Start at the orchard entrance and proceed to the fruit collection point near the apple trees. Pick up four crates of freshly harvested apples. Transport these crates to the sorting facility next to the main warehouse. After delivery, wait until all crates are unloaded by staff. Once empty, continue to the water tank fill station near the main gate, wait for a hose and refill container to be placed on the robot, then deliver the container to the mobile irrigation cart parked by the vineyard trail. Remain at the vineyard trail for 5 minutes in case further items need to be loaded before returning to the orchard entrance.

Proceed to the north barn tool room and collect one toolbox containing hand tools. Deliver the toolbox to the machinery repair site in the eastern paddock, where the maintenance team is waiting. Wait for the team to remove the toolbox from the robot. Afterwards, continue to the fuel storage area located beside the main access road and retrieve two sealed fuel cans. Transport the fuel cans to the tractor parking lot adjacent to the western hayfield. Remain on site for 10 minutes to allow the farm staff to unload the fuel cans, then return to the north barn tool room.

Proceed to the equipment garage located by the southern greenhouse and collect two spare water pumps. Transport the pumps to the irrigation control hub near the central field. Wait until the on-site technician installs and tests the pumps, which could require a wait of up to 15 minutes. After confirmation from the technician, return to the equipment garage and wait for further deployment orders.

Start at the machinery garage near the west field and travel to the cold storage unit located beside the main barn. Pick up two crates filled with freshly harvested carrots. Carefully drive the crates to the temporary sorting tent in the southeast corner of the farm and wait for the sorting crew to remove all crates from your platform. Next, proceed to the tool shed adjacent to the farm manager’s office and collect a container holding assorted hand tools. Bring the container to the rooftop greenhouse access gate and wait for 5 minutes, allowing the maintenance team to retrieve the tools. Once the transfer is complete, make your way to the fuel station behind the crop research lab, wait there for 8 minutes to allow refueling if necessary, and then return to the machinery garage to await the next assignment.

Start at the farmyard equipment shelter and drive to the fertilizer storage shed next to the western field. Collect two sacks of organic fertilizer. Transport the sacks to the planting crew at the eastern plot staging zone and wait until the crew finishes unloading both sacks. Once the sacks are gone, proceed to the cow barn’s veterinary supply room and pick up a sealed container of livestock vitamins. Deliver the vitamin container to the pasture gate near the north fence and wait for 10 minutes for the animal care team to retrieve it. Afterward, return to the equipment shelter.

Start at the main barn and travel to Orchard Block A on the eastern side of the property. Pick up three crates of freshly harvested apples. Deliver the crates to the inspection platform outside the packing house. Wait at the platform until the quality control inspector has removed all three crates. Next, proceed to the north gate entrance and stand by for 20 minutes in case a delivery truck arrives requiring loading support.

Start at the central supply depot near the main entrance gate. Proceed to the orchard tool locker behind the north apple rows and retrieve four pruning shears and a box containing drip line couplers. Deliver these items to the orchard staging area adjacent to the farmpond, where the pruning crew is assembling. Wait until all tools are removed from the robot. Once unloaded, drive to the greenhouse access path by the compost yard, collect two empty water sample canisters, and transport them to the laboratory receiving bench in the environmental monitoring building. Remain at the laboratory until all canisters are unloaded, then return to the central supply depot and await further instructions.

Begin at the machinery storage shed adjacent to the central workstation. Proceed to the irrigation control tower and collect two spare pressure valves. Deliver the valves to the south field pump station, then wait until the on-site technician has unloaded both valves. Afterwards, travel to the northern tool kiosk to retrieve a set of wrench kits, and deliver them to the east repair depot for use in scheduled maintenance operations.

Begin at the central garage beside the orchard. Travel to the irrigation pump shed near the east orchard boundary and pick up two containers of specialized lubricant. Deliver these containers to the drip irrigation control station at the southern edge of the vineyard. Wait for 5 minutes while technicians service the equipment and collect the lubricant. Once the containers have been taken, proceed to the loading dock at the barn to pick up a pallet of harvested strawberries. Transport the pallet to the cold storage facility at the farm's northern perimeter and wait to be unloaded by warehouse staff before returning to the central garage.

Begin at the equipment shelter on the southwest side of the field. Proceed to the solar panel array and collect three replacement inverters arranged on a pallet. Transport the pallet to the utility maintenance tent located beside the irrigation control hut. Wait up to 10 minutes for the technicians to offload the inverters. After offloading, make your way to the harvest packaging area behind the vegetable greenhouse to pick up a bundle of empty cardboard cartons. Deliver the bundle to the produce collection point adjacent to the southern parking lot. Once delivered, return to the equipment shelter and prepare for the next task.

Begin at the central maintenance depot. Proceed to the spare parts storeroom and pick up two sealed boxes of replacement sensors. Deliver the boxes to the autonomous drone hangar on the east side of the facility. Wait until a technician collects both boxes of sensors. Then, head to the fertilizer storage silo near the south crop field and collect four 10-liter canisters of liquid fertilizer. Transport the canisters to the irrigation staging area adjacent to the sunflower plot. After dropping off the fertilizer, wait for 12 minutes while workers load your platform with three empty return containers, then return these containers to the central maintenance depot.

Begin at the machinery depot adjacent to the east field access road. Drive to the compost processing facility located next to the old windmill. Pick up three sacks of processed compost from the storage bin. Deliver the compost sacks to the vegetable terrace at the south end of the farm. Wait for the gardening team to unload all sacks, which should take approximately 7 minutes. Once empty, proceed to the solar charging station beside the irrigation control room and wait 20 minutes for recharging before returning to the machinery depot.

Travel to the fertilizer storage shed located at the eastern side of the farm complex and wait until a pallet of nitrogen fertilizer bags is loaded onto your platform by the farm staff. Once loaded, proceed to greenhouse number 3 and deliver the pallet to the entrance. Wait until the greenhouse manager acknowledges receipt of the fertilizer, then head to the tool depot next to the irrigation control room, pick up a crate of spare irrigation valves, and deliver them to the pump station at the north field. After the valves are unloaded, return to your base near the supply office and prepare for your next assignment.

Proceed to the equipment shed and pick up a portable water tank. Deliver the water tank to the south field crop area. Wait for 20 minutes while field workers refill sprayers from the tank. Afterward, once the tank is empty, return it to the equipment shed and stand by for 10 minutes in case additional refilling is needed.

Start at the equipment garage near the main farm entrance. Drive to the greenhouse complex at the west end of the property. Pick up two trays of tomato seedlings at the packing table. Deliver the trays to the irrigation rig staging area outside Field 4. Wait for the field crew to finish unloading, which usually takes about 6 minutes. After delivery, proceed to the maintenance workshop next to the grain silos and stand by for further instructions.

Start at the seed storage cabin adjacent to Greenhouse 3. Proceed to the fertilizer shed near the south fence and pick up one large bag of granulated fertilizer. Transport the fertilizer bag to the central irrigation hub next to Field Plot 7, and wait until the irrigation manager unloads the bag. After the drop-off, continue to the battery swap station behind the maintenance garage and remain there for 15 minutes to allow for battery replacement before returning to the seed storage cabin.

Drive to the maintenance workshop located west of the machinery barn and pick up two replacement hydraulic hoses and a toolbox. Transport these items to the far end of Orchard Row 7, where the irrigation repairs are underway. Wait until the technician unloads both the hoses and the toolbox from the robot. Then, proceed to the compost facility near the southern fence and pick up three empty storage bins. Deliver the bins to the berry harvest station at the northwest corner of the property and return to the maintenance workshop for your next assignment.

Drive to the packaging warehouse and pick up four crates of harvested tomatoes. Transport these crates to the cooling station located behind the barn. Wait for 10 minutes to allow the crates to be loaded onto the conveyor system by the station staff. Once the crates have been transferred, proceed to the maintenance garage and await further loading instructions.

Start at the workshop garage and proceed to the fertilizer storage area. Pick up two barrels of liquid fertilizer and transport them to Orchard Block C. Wait for 15 minutes while the orchard supervisor inspects and unloads the barrels. Afterward, drive to the maintenance yard to collect a spare wheel. Deliver the spare wheel to the north gate checkpoint and wait there until the maintenance crew removes it. Once the wheel is unloaded, return to the workshop garage for the next assignment.

Begin at the equipment garage near the south entrance. Drive to the central greenhouse and pick up four boxes of seedling trays. Deliver the boxes to the propagation area located in the eastern section of the farm. Wait for the greenhouse supervisor to inspect and unload the trays, remaining on site for up to 20 minutes. After the boxes are unloaded, proceed to the nearby compost station and collect one container of organic fertilizer. Transport the fertilizer container to the irrigation control hub at the northern field border. Once delivered, return to the equipment garage.

Go to the east greenhouse to collect a stack of empty seed trays. Deliver the seed trays to the potting shed, then proceed to the irrigation control shed. Pick up one case of spare sprinkler nozzles and transport it to Field Plot 7. Wait until the field technician collects the nozzle case, then return to the main depot.

Start at the greenhouse supply depot and collect four trays of seedling pots. Deliver the trays to the north plot planting area adjacent to the windbreak. Wait for 10 minutes while the planting crew removes the trays. Next, drive to the machine shed near the gravel road and pick up a box containing replacement belts for the harvesters. Transport the box to the repair bay behind the storage silo. Wait until all belts are unloaded by the mechanic, then proceed to the composting station at the southwest corner of the property and stand by for 5 minutes before returning to the greenhouse supply depot.

Start at the maintenance garage and proceed to the eastern solar array field. Pick up a crate containing replacement photovoltaic panels. Deliver the crate to the solar workshop located at the south end of the property. Wait until the maintenance crew removes all replacement panels from your platform. Afterwards, navigate to the composting area in the northeast corner and collect two empty fertilizer bins. Bring the bins to the central fertilizer mixing station and wait for fifteen minutes while they are refilled. Once filled, transport them to the orchard storage barn for final drop-off before returning to the maintenance garage.

Begin at the east storage shed and collect three empty water tanks. Proceed to the field irrigation control station, and wait while field staff load the tanks with water for ten minutes. After the tanks are filled, deliver them to vineyard block C and wait until all tanks have been unloaded by the vineyard workers. Once completed, return directly to the east storage shed and await further tasks.

Proceed to the greenhouse supply room and collect two sacks of fertilizer. Drive to the north orchard and deliver the fertilizer sacks to the equipment shed. Wait for 5 minutes while the orchard staff unload the sacks. Then, travel to the maintenance garage and pick up a set of pruning shears. Deliver the shears to the east boundary gate for crew use, and after the delivery, return to the greenhouse supply room to await further instructions.

Start at the supply depot next to the north gate. Proceed to the grain silo access road and pick up a sealed container of crop samples and a portable soil analysis kit. Deliver both items to the agronomy lab inside the research building located at the east end of the property. Wait until the lab technician confirms receipt and removes the items from the robot’s cargo compartment. Once unloaded, drive to the livestock feed station behind Barn 3 and collect a sack of mineral supplements. Transport the sack to the small animal enclosure behind the veterinary clinic. Wait for 5 minutes to allow caretakers to unload the supplement. After completing these tasks, return to the supply depot near the north gate.

Navigate to the maintenance shed and pick up two containers of fertilizer pellets. Deliver the fertilizer containers to Vegetable Field C at the southern boundary of the property. Remain at the field for 20 minutes while workers disperse the fertilizer, then collect four empty water tanks from Field C. Transport the empty water tanks to the storage yard behind the supply warehouse. Once the tanks have been unloaded, proceed to the solar charging station located near the orchard and wait for 10 minutes to recharge.

Move to the spare parts cabinet in the maintenance shed at the south end of the vineyard. Pick up three replacement drive belts and a box of lubricating grease. Transport these items to the tractor bay beside the harvest equipment barn. Wait until a technician removes all the spare parts from your platform, then proceed to the north field irrigation control center. Remain there for 12 minutes for potential redeployment before returning to your home base at the mobile robot garage.

Proceed from the equipment shed to the northern greenhouse. Pick up three sealed boxes of tomato seedlings. Deliver the boxes to plot C in the western growing field. Wait until the greenhouse supervisor confirms all boxes have been unloaded. Next, travel to the irrigation pump station beside the river, collect a set of pipe couplings, and bring them to the machinery depot behind the storage silos. Wait for 10 minutes for the technician to inspect your payload before returning to the equipment shed.

Begin at the loading dock behind the seed supply building. Pick up four bags of organic fertilizer and one sealed container of micronutrient solution. Drive to the community orchard’s composting zone. Deliver the fertilizer bags and leave the micronutrient container at the marked drop-off point. Wait for 10 minutes in the composting zone for further instructions. After the wait, travel to the equipment wash station adjacent to the north barn and stand by until a staff member places a set of cleaned field tools on your platform. Once loaded, return the tools to the main tool depot inside the central operations center.

Begin at the equipment maintenance bay. Navigate to the irrigation supply depot near the northeast corner of the property and pick up three spare irrigation valves. Deliver the valves to the irrigation control center located next to the westernmost crop field. Wait for the technician to unload all valves, remaining in place until unloading is complete. Afterwards, travel to the workshop adjacent to the packing shed to retrieve a toolbox containing maintenance supplies. Take the toolbox to the windmill station at the southeastern boundary. Wait for the crew to remove the toolbox before returning to the equipment maintenance bay for further instructions.

Start at the supply depot near the northern access road. Proceed to the irrigation control hut by the central pond and collect a box of replacement sprinkler heads. Deliver the box to the greenhouse entrance on the eastern side of the property. Wait until the maintenance crew has unloaded the box, which should take approximately 8 minutes. Once the box is unloaded, drive to the field equipment parking area near the southwest gate and pick up any empty fertilizer canisters present. Transport the empty canisters to the recycling center adjacent to the main office before reporting back to the supply depot.

Begin at the maintenance garage adjacent to the main operations building. Drive to the solar panel field along the southern fence to pick up a toolbox containing electrical diagnostics equipment. Deliver the toolbox to the rooftop access point outside the equipment shed where technicians are assembling replacement inverters. Wait until the technicians have unloaded the toolbox from your cargo bay. Next, proceed to the irrigation pump house beside the southwest pond and collect two empty water sample canisters. Return the canisters to the water chemistry lab located behind the administration office for sample analysis. After all canisters are unloaded, return to the maintenance garage.

Begin at the vehicle bay next to the western garage. Drive to the orchard logistics shed and pick up two crates of harvested apples. Transport the crates to the cold storage unit at the northeast corner of the property. Wait at the cold storage unit for the packing team to finish unloading the apples, which is expected to take about 6 minutes. After the crates are unloaded, proceed to the maintenance yard and retrieve any empty wooden pallets stacked near the tool shed. Deliver the empty pallets back to the orchard logistics shed before returning to the vehicle bay.

Begin at the equipment yard beside the tool workshop. Drive to the orchard entrance on the eastern boundary and pick up two empty harvest baskets. Deliver the baskets to the harvesting team waiting at Row 12 in the orchard. Wait until both baskets have been unloaded by the team. Once unloaded, proceed to the compost area near the north pond and collect a sealed bin of compost. Transport the compost bin to the nursery shade house adjacent to the propagation beds and leave it at the designated drop-off point. Finally, travel to the fueling station near the main gate and stand by for 10 minutes to refuel before shutting down.

Head to the fertilizer storage beside the loading bay and pick up two sacks of organic fertilizer. Deliver the sacks to the orchard’s central distribution point and wait until the orchard manager verifies the delivery. After confirmation, proceed to the machinery garage at the eastern edge of the property and collect a replacement tire. Take the replacement tire to the main tractor parked outside the barn and wait for 5 minutes while the maintenance crew installs it. Once the tire has been successfully installed and removed from your platform, return to the fertilizer storage for the next assignment.

Begin at the main loading dock adjacent to the packaging warehouse. Proceed to the south field entrance and collect three empty pesticide containers left by the gate. Return to the hazardous materials storage shed near the west fence line and unload the containers. Wait for 10 minutes while the safety inspector checks the containers. After inspection is complete, drive to the irrigation pump house at the edge of the north pond and pick up a replacement pump filter. Deliver the filter to the technical workshop inside the machinery barn. After the drop-off, return to the main loading dock and await further assignment.

Start at the orchard supply shed adjacent to the southern fence. Travel to the packaging building to pick up a pallet of empty fruit crates. Deliver the pallet to the main orchard gate where harvesting crews are stationed. Wait for the crews to fully unload the empty crates from your platform. Once the crates have been unloaded, proceed to the weather monitoring station near the wind turbines and collect a sealed toolbox marked for maintenance. Bring the toolbox to the energy equipment shed beside the water reservoir and wait 7 minutes for the service technicians to unload it. Afterward, return to the orchard supply shed and stand by for further instructions.

Proceed to the workshop adjacent to the irrigation control shed and collect a sealed box of spare pressure valves along with three lengths of reinforced hose. Transport these items to the south field’s pump station, located beyond the windbreak trees. Wait until a technician arrives and removes all equipment from your payload bay. Once the transfer is complete, travel to the storage area behind the main barn and pick up an empty crate marked for harvest. Deliver the empty crate to the southeast grapevine row, set it beside the field worker’s bench, and then return to the workshop for further instructions.

Start at the main orchard entrance and proceed to the pesticide storage shed on the western perimeter. Pick up three sealed pesticide canisters and a set of applicator nozzles. Travel to the operations staging area just outside the east orchard. Wait for 12 minutes while the field crew offloads the nozzles and inspects the canisters. Once cleared, deliver any remaining canisters to the chemical disposal unit behind the equipment garage. Finally, return to the main orchard entrance and await your next assignment.

Start at the gravel forecourt outside the machinery shed. Proceed to the orchard’s northern tool cage and pick up three pruning shears stored in a green crate. Deliver the green crate to the fruit processing tent at the eastern field margin. Once the crate is offloaded, move to the insect monitoring station in the center of the sunflower plot and collect two data loggers in their protective cases. Bring the loggers to the farm office porch for syncing, and wait there for 8 minutes to allow for data transfer. When finished, return to the gravel forecourt outside the machinery shed.

Start at the supply depot beside the main parking lot. Navigate to the apple orchard in the western field and pick up three crates of freshly harvested apples. Deliver the crates to the cooling storage room situated next to the packaging facility. Wait for 10 minutes to allow staff to unload the crates. Once all crates are removed, proceed to the maintenance workshop adjacent to the grain silos and collect one spare battery pack. Bring the battery pack to the solar charging station located near the south fence. After the delivery, return to the supply depot to stand by for the next assignment.

Start from the maintenance garage next to the tractor shed. Navigate to the shipping container storage area behind the old mill and pick up a single crate containing replacement irrigation valves. Deliver the crate to the pump house beside the northern field. Wait until a technician unloads the crate from your platform. After the technician has removed the crate, drive to the weather monitoring station near the bluff, pick up a battery pack left at the station, and return it to the maintenance garage. Upon arrival, wait for 5 minutes while the maintenance team swaps out the battery pack before continuing to your next assignment.

Begin at the storage depot adjacent to the windbreak grove and drive to the irrigation control center beside the northern reservoir. Pick up a box containing replacement water sensors. Convey the box to the vineyard’s central trellis hub, where the technicians are stationed. Wait for the technicians to unload all water sensors from your platform and confirm the handoff. Afterward, make your way to the compost facility near the machinery parking lot, collect one sack of organic fertilizer, and deliver it to the orchard’s eastern entrance. Wait there for 12 minutes to allow the orchard staff to unload the fertilizer before returning to the storage depot to stand by for your next directive.

Start from the tractor garage and proceed to the northern greenhouse. Collect two empty water tanks and three harvest crates. Deliver the empty water tanks to the reservoir supply station and wait there until both tanks are filled by the staff. After the water tanks are loaded with water, move to the south orchard harvest zone. Drop off the filled tanks at the designated hydration point and deliver the three harvest crates near the apple collection tent. Once all items are delivered, travel to the shade area behind the orchard and wait for 12 minutes for the next assignment.

Head to the grain silo access path beside the east paddock and collect three bags of soil amendment compound from the marked pallet. Deliver them to the composting area at the rear of the greenhouse complex. Wait for 10 minutes while staff check in with the delivery. When the timer elapses, return to the silo area and collect any empty sacks left on the docking platform, then bring the empty sacks to the recycling depot next to the equipment barn before awaiting further instructions.

Start at the equipment garage beside the northern driveway. Travel to Vineyard Row 3 and pick up two soil sample kits from the collection box.
