Next, drive to the research lab located behind the solar array and deliver the soil samples. While at the lab, wait for 5 minutes for the technicians to load a sealed beehive crate onto the robot. Once loaded, transport the beehive crate carefully to the pollinator sanctuary at the eastern wildflower meadow. After the delivery, return to the equipment garage and wait there for 15 minutes before resuming further tasks.

Begin at the central depot adjacent to the east field. Proceed to the fertilizer storage shed located beside the irrigation pond and pick up two sealed bags of organic compost. Transport the compost bags to the community vegetable garden gate near the southern entrance. Wait for the garden supervisor to unload the cargo. Once the bags are removed, travel to the fuel station next to the machinery lot and wait there for 7 minutes for routine inspection. Afterwards, continue to the equipment wash bay by the main driveway and remain on standby for further instructions.

Start at the main storage building near the central parking lot. Proceed to the orchard's southern entrance and collect a crate of freshly picked apples. Transport the crate to the cold storage chamber attached to the administration office on the western edge of the property. Wait for 5 minutes to allow the staff to inspect and confirm the delivery. Once inspection is complete, head to the fuel station behind the machinery shed and pick up a full diesel canister. Deliver the canister to the tractor bay beside Field 7. After the canister has been removed by an operator, return to the main storage building for further instructions.

Start at the maintenance hangar near the western access road. Proceed to the spare parts storage facility next to the tractor shed and collect four hydraulic filter cartridges. Navigate to the field repair site west of the sunflower plot and deliver the cartridges to the repair crew. Wait for 10 minutes while the crew replaces the filters and returns the empty cartridges to you. Pick up the used cartridges and transport them to the hazardous waste collection center behind the equipment barn. Wait until all empty cartridges are properly unloaded by the technician, then head to the refreshment stand near the workers’ break area and wait there for further instructions.

Begin at the logistics hub by the northern entrance. Drive to the vineyard section C and pick up four pesticide canisters. Transport the canisters to the chemical storage facility next to the soil testing lab. Wait until a safety officer confirms the receipt and signs off, which may take approximately 5 minutes. After confirmation, proceed to the equipment garage located beside the windmill, and collect two empty harvest baskets. Deliver the baskets to the berry patch on the eastern slope and wait for them to be unloaded by the harvest team before returning to the logistics hub.

Start at the supply depot near the main entrance gate. Drive to the field storage tent adjacent to Cornfield Plot 8 and collect three containers of irrigation pipes. Deliver the irrigation pipes to pump station 2 located along the southern fence line. Upon arrival, wait for 10 minutes while the field crew unloads the containers. After unloading is complete, proceed to the battery charging station next to the wind turbine array and pick up a fresh battery module. Return the battery module to the supply depot before finishing the task.

Begin at the maintenance garage near the west gate. Travel to the compost yard beside the equipment wash station and collect one large blue bin of compostable waste. Deliver the blue bin to the organic waste drop-off area behind the cafeteria. Wait there for 15 minutes for processing staff to empty the bin. After the bin is emptied and reloaded onto your platform, return the empty bin to the compost yard. Next, proceed to the main greenhouse entrance and pick up a carton of freshly harvested tomatoes, then deliver the carton to the market stall at the farm’s south entrance. Once the tomatoes are delivered, wait for acknowledgement from the market supervisor and then return to the maintenance garage near the west gate.

Begin at the equipment staging area adjacent to the seedling nursery. Proceed to the eastern repair bay and pick up a replacement gearbox and a set of calibration tools. Deliver the gearbox to the machinery service zone at the west field entrance. Wait there until the maintenance team completes the gearbox installation—anticipated waiting time is 18 minutes. Once installation is confirmed, pick up the two faulty hydraulic pumps from the same service zone and transport them to the parts recycling center near the compost lot. After unloading the faulty pumps, return to the equipment staging area and wait for further instructions.

Begin at the maintenance room adjacent to the greenhouse. Proceed to the east field supply depot and pick up two irrigation hose reels and a box of hose connectors. Drive to the northern boundary of the sunflower plot and wait until the maintenance team has unloaded the hose reels. Next, continue to the spare parts cabinet near the workshop entrance and retrieve one hydraulic pump. Deliver the hydraulic pump to the service bay behind the harvester shed. Wait for 8 minutes while technicians install the pump, then return to the maintenance room and remain on standby.

Start at the west orchard tool station and pick up the sealed crate containing eight pruning shears. Navigate to the apple grove loading zone and deliver the crate to the orchard crew leader. Wait until all pruning shears are unloaded. Proceed to the compost yard entrance, collect two empty chemical drums, and bring them to the pesticide storage shed behind the equipment depot. Stay at the pesticide storage shed for 12 minutes in case additional items need to be transported, then return to the west orchard tool station for your next assignment.

Begin at the maintenance shed next to the solar panel array and pick up three fuel canisters. Deliver the canisters to the emergency generator station behind the administration building. After drop-off, wait up to 10 minutes for a maintenance supervisor to inspect and log the delivery. Once cleared, proceed to the north gate storage area and collect the stack of twelve empty produce crates. Transport these crates to the packaging terminal at the east field for further use, and remain at the terminal until the crates have been fully unloaded before returning to the maintenance shed.

Start at the central warehouse beside the administration building. Travel to the solar panel array located past the main gate. Pick up a crate of replacement bolts and two power inverters from the maintenance supervisor. Proceed to the hilltop wind turbine site. Wait while technicians unload the equipment, which may take around 8 minutes. Once unloaded, navigate to the supply shed near the machine workshop and collect three bags of animal feed. Deliver the feed to the livestock enclosure by the irrigation channel and wait until farmhands have fully unloaded the bags before returning to the central warehouse.

Begin at the equipment depot adjacent to the irrigation control station. Move to the orchard collection point beside the northern fence and pick up six crates of harvested pears. Deliver the crates to the cold storage unit located near the main processing building. Wait for the packaging crew to unload all crates from your platform—this may take up to 15 minutes. Once unloading is complete, proceed to the tool supply area next to the workshop and wait there for further instructions.

Begin at the tool storage hut beside the east orchard entrance. Drive to the vineyard gate at the south end of the property and pick up two crates of harvested grapes. Transport the crates to the processing barn next to the cold storage facility. Wait until the crates are offloaded by the processing staff, which should take approximately 6 minutes. After delivery, proceed to the main parking lot behind the visitor center and stand by for 12 minutes to assist with any further loading tasks. Upon completion, return to the tool storage hut.

Begin at the maintenance garage near the northwest edge of the flower nursery. Proceed to the machinery refueling station beside the irrigation pond and pick up four sealed fuel canisters marked for the tractor fleet. Deliver the canisters to the tractor bay at the far end of the equipment yard. Wait until all canisters have been unloaded by the maintenance team, allowing up to 8 minutes for the process. Once the fuel is unloaded, collect any empty oil drums from the collection area outside the tractor bay. Transport the empty drums to the hazardous materials containment shed adjacent to the compost heap, then wait for 5 minutes before returning to the maintenance garage.

Start at the storage shed beside the fuel station. Travel to the produce field edge near the eastern tree line and collect three sacks of potatoes. Transport the sacks to the quality inspection tent behind the tractor garage. Wait at the inspection tent until the sacks are checked and tagged by staff, which may take up to 10 minutes. Once the potatoes are cleared, deliver them to the distribution loading bay next to the farm office. After dropping off the sacks, return to the storage shed beside the fuel station.

Start from the delivery courtyard beside the greenhouse complex. Travel to the fruits packing station located next to Apple Orchard Row 4 and pick up two crates of packaged apples marked for immediate dispatch. Deliver both crates to the farm market loading bay on the eastern perimeter. Wait up to 12 minutes for the market staff to unload the apples. After unloading, proceed to the warehouse sorting area behind Vegetable Plot 3 to collect a box of replacement irrigation fittings. Transport the box to the maintenance cabin at the north end of the tractor shed. After the handover, remain at the maintenance cabin for 3 minutes before returning to the delivery courtyard to complete the assignment.

Start at the solar charging pad next to the machinery depot. Proceed to the fertilizer storage unit behind Grain Silo 2 and collect three bags of high-nitrogen fertilizer. Deliver the fertilizer to the eastern edge irrigation hub by the cornfield. Wait there until the field manager has unloaded all bags, which should take approximately 9 minutes. After unloading, travel to the orchard tool shed near Cherry Grove Lane and pick up a rolled tarp and two empty pesticide sprayers. Return both items to the machinery depot and remain at the depot until the next assignment is received.

Begin at the maintenance workshop adjacent to the main greenhouse. Drive to the west field access gate beside Willow Creek and pick up a pallet stacked with five irrigation hoses. Transport the pallet to the temporary equipment staging area behind the compost heap near the north boundary. Wait at the staging area for 12 minutes to allow the irrigation crew to inspect and sort the hoses. Once the crew confirms all hoses are accounted for, return any unused hoses to the maintenance workshop. Remain at the workshop until further instructions are provided.

Begin at the main supply depot and proceed to the greenhouse storage room. Pick up three crates of seedling trays. Deliver the seedling trays to the propagation area next to the southern greenhouse. Wait for 10 minutes while the horticulture team unloads the crates. After the unloading is complete, proceed to the western tool shed to collect a pressure sprayer. Transport the pressure sprayer to the pesticide staging zone and wait until the equipment has been removed before returning to the main supply depot for further tasks.

Begin at the maintenance shed adjacent to the southern orchard. Drive to the farm equipment yard and pick up two empty fuel drums. Deliver the drums to the fueling station beside the main irrigation pond. Wait there until the station attendant loads three filled drums onto your cargo bay. Once loaded, proceed to Field 7 and deliver the filled fuel drums to the designated refueling area. Wait for 7 minutes while the field crew refuels their equipment and unloads the drums. After unloading, return to the maintenance shed near the southern orchard to complete your task.

Drive to the maintenance yard and pick up one pallet of replacement tractor tires. Transport the pallet to the machinery workshop behind the main barn. Wait at the drop-off zone until a mechanic confirms unloading is complete. Next, proceed to the fuel depot adjacent to the storage silos and collect two canisters of diesel fuel. Deliver the canisters to the irrigation pump station in the east field, then wait for 15 minutes while the pump is refueled before returning to the maintenance yard.

Travel to the machine parts depot located behind the equipment barn and retrieve two hydraulic cylinders. Deliver the cylinders to the maintenance hangar next to the grain silos. Wait at the hangar for up to 10 minutes while the cylinders are inspected and unloaded. After delivery, navigate to the central greenhouse and collect three empty fertilizer crates. Transport the empty crates to the packaging area entrance near the loading dock and wait until all crates are removed from your cargo bay. Once emptied, proceed to the shade shelter in the east field and stand by for further instructions.

Start at the central logistics depot and travel to the south orchard service road. Pick up a crate containing drone battery packs from the charging station there. Deliver the crate to the UAV launch pad near the eastern field boundary and wait while the drone crew unloads the battery packs, which should take approximately 5 minutes. Once unloading is complete, continue to the storage barn adjacent to the milling area and retrieve three containers of seed lubricant. Transport these containers to the planter tractor parked at Field 2N, and remain in position until the tractor operator has finished transferring the containers, then return to the central logistics depot and await further instructions.

Begin at the maintenance garage and proceed to the eastern equipment depot. Pick up a spare tractor tire and a toolbox from the storage rack. Deliver both items to the machine repair area next to the southern field. Wait up to 7 minutes while the repair crew unloads the tire and toolbox. Once unloading is complete, travel to the fuel station near the western farm entrance, and wait there for 5 minutes to assist with any needed refueling support before returning to the maintenance garage.

Proceed to the chemical supply shed near the orchard entrance and pick up two sealed pesticide containers. Deliver the containers to the application rig parked in the east sector of the apple grove. Wait until the containers are unloaded by the support staff, then navigate to the compost collection point south of the greenhouse. Retrieve an empty compost bin and bring it to the loading area behind the main barn. Wait there for 8 minutes while the staff fills the bin with organic waste, then return the filled compost bin to the compost collection point and end your current task route.

Head to the spare parts storage near the workshop and retrieve a single box of hydraulic hoses. Deliver the box to the tractor repair bay on the south side of the property. Wait at the repair bay until the mechanics have removed the old hoses and placed the used hoses onto your payload deck, which should take approximately 12 minutes. Once the used hoses have been loaded, transport them to the recycling container adjacent to the fuel depot. Return to the spare parts storage for your next assignment.

Begin at the logistics hub near the site entrance and proceed to the storage shed by the south field. Pick up four irrigation pipe bundles placed just inside the shed. Deliver the bundles to the newly cleared plot north of the blueberry grove. Wait for 10 minutes for the installation crew to remove one bundle and verify placement. After the crew confirms, take the remaining three pipe bundles to the equipment station located beside the maintenance depot. Wait until all pipe bundles have been unloaded, then return to the logistics hub and stand by for the next assignment.

Begin at the supply depot near the northern entrance of the farm. Proceed to greenhouse number 4 along the east perimeter and pick up four sacks of fertilizer stacked near the entrance. Transport the sacks to the vineyard trellis zone at the southern edge of the property. Wait for the field crew to unload all fertilizer sacks from your platform, which may take up to 7 minutes. Once unloaded, continue to the wash station beside the equipment barn to collect any empty produce crates. Deliver the empty crates to packing station 2 inside the distribution warehouse for further use. After drop-off, return to the supply depot to await your next assignment.

Travel to the seed storage shed behind the east barn and pick up four sacks of barley seeds. Deliver the sacks to the planting station beside Field 3 along the creek. Wait until the field crew finishes loading fertilizer containers onto your platform (approximately 6 minutes). Move the fertilizer containers to the chemical storage unit next to the central workshop. After the cargo is offloaded, proceed to the north gate checkpoint and stand by for further delivery instructions.

Start at the maintenance garage near the central grain silo. Drive to the orchard's northern entrance and pick up six empty water canisters stored near the old apple crates. Transport the canisters to the irrigation pump house by the riverside. Wait for the field supervisor to refill all canisters, which should take about 10 minutes. Once refilled, deliver the water canisters to the flower nursery adjacent to the herb garden, then proceed to the security checkpoint by the main gate and wait for further instructions.

Start at the supply hut next to the solar charging station. Proceed to the lower vineyard storage shed to pick up two crates of harvested grapes and a bin of pruning shears. Transport the crates and bin to the wine processing tent at the west end of the estate. Wait until all items are unloaded by the processing crew. After the unloading is complete, travel to the irrigation pump house and wait there for 5 minutes before returning to the supply hut for your next assignment.

Start from the orchard entrance near the old windmill and travel to the cold storage facility at the north end of the property. Pick up a crate of freshly harvested pears. Proceed to the farm-to-table market stall located beside the picnic area on the western lawn. Wait for market staff to remove the crate from your platform. Once unloaded, head to the battery charging station by the greenhouse and wait there for 15 minutes before your next assignment.

Start at the logistics yard and drive to the north orchard entrance. Pick up four empty harvest bins and deliver them to the apple-picking zone at the center of the orchard. Wait for up to 15 minutes while workers fill the bins with apples. Once the bins are loaded, return them to the produce loading dock behind the cold storage facility. Wait at the loading dock until all bins have been unloaded from the robot before proceeding to the battery charging station for recharging.

Travel to the cold storage unit adjacent to the west field and pick up a pallet containing freshly harvested strawberries. Move the pallet to the outdoor farmers’ market queue area located by the farm shop entrance. Wait until market staff unload the pallet from your platform. Once the strawberries are unloaded, proceed to the cleaning station behind the barn and wait for 15 minutes to be sanitized before receiving your next assignment.

Start at the main storage barn and proceed to the solar equipment yard in the western pasture. Pick up one solar panel crate and a box of mounting brackets. Transport both items to the wind turbine installation site north of the gravel road. Wait at the site until technicians confirm the safety check is complete and the items are unloaded. Then, make your way to the irrigation pump house, retrieve three water quality test kits, and deliver them to the aquaculture hatchery at the far south pond. After delivery, stand by for 10 minutes for possible additional tasks before returning to the main storage barn.

Start from the orchard gate and drive to the seasonal produce packing shed to collect four crates of freshly picked strawberries. Transport the crates to the north loading dock beside the delivery trucks and wait for warehouse staff to unload them completely. Once finished, proceed to the tool storage annex on the south side of the equipment barn to pick up a box containing hand pruners and gloves. Deliver these tools to the field crew station at the eastern orchard row endpoint. Wait for 7 minutes at the field crew station, then travel to the vehicle charging station behind the greenhouse complex and stand by until further instructions.

Start at the garage adjacent to the main admin building. Drive to the spare parts container at the rear of the solar farm, and collect two boxes of replacement inverter modules. Deliver the inverter boxes to the maintenance bay at wind turbine tower 3, positioned at the far west boundary. Remain at the drop-off location for up to 10 minutes while the maintenance crew unloads the boxes. Once empty, proceed to the central storage silo and pick up a sealed drum of hydraulic oil. Take the drum to the tractor refueling station on the southern service lane. Leave the drum in the service zone and return directly to the garage.

Begin at the equipment garage and proceed to the vineyard's northeast tool shed. Pick up three coiled irrigation hoses. Transport the hoses to the drip-line installation area along the east boundary of the vineyard. Wait for a technician to remove all hoses from the robot. After unloading, navigate to the composting site near the creek and collect a sack of mature compost. Deliver the compost sack to the vegetable plot next to the farm manager's office and wait for 10 minutes before returning to the equipment garage.

Begin at the equipment shed next to the irrigation control center. Proceed to the pumpkin field located beyond the east orchard and collect two empty fertilizer bins. Transport the bins to the refill station beside the vehicle barn and wait to be loaded with fresh fertilizer. Once both bins are refilled, deliver them to the greenhouse complex at the property’s northern boundary. After offloading the fertilizer bins, wait 5 minutes for confirmation from the greenhouse staff before returning to the equipment shed.

Start at the main loading dock next to the packing warehouse. Drive to the apple orchard on the western hillside and wait until two crates of freshly harvested apples are placed on your platform by the orchard crew. After securing the load, transport the crates to the cold storage unit behind the processing plant. Wait until facility staff have unloaded all crates. Next, move to the maintenance yard near the vehicle sheds and collect a container of engine oil and a box of spare belts. Deliver these maintenance supplies to the equipment workshop adjacent to field number 6. Once all items are offloaded, return to the main loading dock and stand by for 15 minutes before your next deployment.

Begin at the maintenance workshop adjacent to the east parking lot. Move to the materials staging area near the southern fence and pick up three pallets of construction bricks. Deliver the pallets to the site entrance of the new storage barn build on the west side of the farm. Wait for the construction crew to unload all bricks. Following the unload, proceed to the chemical storage shed next to the grain silo, retrieve two sealed drums of fertilizer, and bring them to the fertilizer mixing station at the northeast corner of the property. Once delivered, wait for 10 minutes to allow for offloading and processing before returning to the maintenance workshop.

Start from the machinery parking zone near the grain silo. Head to the orchard loading platform and collect four crates of harvested pears awaiting shipment. Transport these crates to the cold storage unit behind the packing house, and wait until all crates are unloaded by the storage staff. Afterwards, proceed to the chemical storage area north of the greenhouse to collect two sealed herbicide canisters. Deliver the canisters to the application team’s trailer stationed in the northeast field and wait for up to 5 minutes for unloading confirmation. Once deliveries are complete, return to the machinery parking zone.

Start at the supply depot located at the southern edge of the vineyard. Navigate to the cold storage building near the east fence and pick up six boxes of pre-packed grapes. Deliver the boxes to the distribution loading zone adjacent to the main farm entrance. Wait for up to 12 minutes for the logistics team to finish unloading. After unloading, proceed to the wash station located behind the greenhouse, wait for 7 minutes for exterior cleaning, and finally return to the supply depot.

Start by moving to the supply bay adjacent to the west greenhouse. Pick up a crate containing replacement irrigation valves and a bundle of drip line tubing. Transport these supplies to the field technician outpost located on the southern slope, and wait until all items are removed from your platform. Once unloaded, proceed to the central packing shed and collect four empty harvest bins. Deliver the empty bins to the berry plot near the eastern windbreak, and wait 15 minutes for harvesters to fill and reload the bins onto your platform. After the bins are loaded, take them directly to the produce staging area behind the warehouse and wait until all bins have been unloaded before returning to the supply bay to complete your task.

Begin at the toolshed next to the east orchard gate. Head to the irrigation control unit located mid-field, and collect a cartridge of sensor probes from the technician there. Take the sensor probes to the remote monitoring station at the north fence line. Wait for 7 minutes while the field supervisor installs the probes and returns the empty cartridge. Collect the empty cartridge, then proceed to the composting facility beside the machinery barn. Deposit the empty cartridge in the designated recycling bin and proceed to the crop loading area to await further instructions.

Begin at the loading dock adjacent to the southern greenhouse. Drive to the equipment cage beside the irrigation pond and collect a metal toolbox labeled 'Pump Repair Kit.' Transport the toolbox to the pump control hut located between the two main water tanks. Wait for the maintenance crew to remove the toolbox, which may take up to 5 minutes. Once the toolbox is unloaded, proceed to the container storage area behind the seedling nursery and stand by for the next assignment.

Begin by traveling to the maintenance room next to the vehicle garage and pick up a box of replacement spark plugs. Transport the box to the tractor shed at the north end of the property. Wait until the mechanics have unloaded the spark plugs from your platform. After the box has been removed, drive to the fuel depot behind the grain silos and wait there for 10 minutes in standby mode before returning to the maintenance room for your next task.

Start at the central garage and proceed to the pesticide storage unit near the orchard entrance. Pick up two sealed containers of organic pesticide. Deliver these containers to Block C in the southern orchard. Wait for the orchard team to unload the pesticide containers. Once the containers have been removed, travel to the tool depot adjacent to the east maintenance barn and collect a case of pruning shears. Bring the case of shears to the crew rest area by the old windmill and wait for 5 minutes while the equipment is distributed before returning to the central garage.

Head to the supply shed next to the vegetable garden and pick up three crates of fertilizer labeled 'Field Application.' Transport the crates to the west cornfield's drop-off point near the scarecrow. Wait for 10 minutes to allow field workers to unload the fertilizer. Once all crates have been unloaded, proceed to the weather monitoring station north of the grain bins to collect a sealed data box. Deliver the data box to the control office inside the main administration building, then await further instructions at the loading bay nearby.

Start at the machinery barn next to the eastern orchard. Drive over to the crop storage shed by the southern pasture and collect three sacks of fertilizer. Transport the sacks to the southwest vineyard trellis area and wait for 7 minutes for the vineyard crew to unload them. After the sacks are unloaded, proceed immediately to the farm's solar panel maintenance pad, pick up two replacement inverters, and deliver them to the tools depot near the farm office. Remain at the depot until the technician confirms receipt of the inverters.

Begin at the equipment storage shed and navigate to the eastern crop trial plot. Pick up the soil sample boxes left by the agronomists. Deliver the soil sample boxes to the mobile lab van parked near the irrigation control center. Wait next to the lab van until a scientist confirms they have received all samples, then proceed to the windbreak area at the field’s edge. Pick up any empty pesticide containers found at the windbreak area and transport them to the hazardous material collection point near the main barn. Return to the equipment storage shed once the containers have been delivered.

Drive to the machine workshop located at the south end of the property and pick up two replacement hydraulic hoses. Proceed to the central irrigation control station and deliver the hoses to the technician on duty. Wait for the technician to confirm receipt. Next, continue to the orchard’s eastern access path to collect a pallet of empty harvest crates. Transport these empty crates to the apple loading bay behind Storage Shed 3. Once the crates are unloaded, return to the charging station adjacent to the equipment garage and remain on standby for further instructions.

Start at the tool crib adjacent to the fabrication workshop. Proceed to the greenhouse complex located on the eastern plot and collect two boxes of irrigation sensors. Transport the boxes to the control system kiosk near the hydroponics bay. Wait until technicians unload the sensors from the robot. Subsequently, drive to the equipment yard, retrieve a coiled extension hose, and deliver it to the maintenance depot next to the north gate. After the hose has been removed by staff, wait for 7 minutes in case additional parts need to be transported before returning to the tool crib.

Navigate to the spare parts storage room adjacent to the solar panel field and pick up a sealed box containing replacement solar inverters. Deliver the box to the maintenance team stationed at the central inverter platform on the west edge of the field. Wait until the inverters are unloaded and the team signals completion. Then, proceed to the west-side rainwater collection tank and stand by for 12 minutes in case further maintenance supplies are needed. Finally, return to the spare parts storage room and await your next assignment.

Start at the warehouse loading dock near the north gate. Proceed to the cold storage facility on the west side of the property. Pick up three crates of freshly harvested strawberries and a sealed container of ice packs. Transport these items to the farm shop located next to the main market stand. Wait up to 12 minutes for the shop staff to unload and inspect the delivery. When your cargo bay is empty, proceed to the solar charging station in the central courtyard and wait there until the battery is fully recharged and further instructions are provided.

Travel to the materials storage barn and collect two sealed containers of fertilizer. Deliver the containers to the greenhouse loading area. Wait until a greenhouse staff member removes both containers from the robot. Once unloaded, proceed to the gravel road entrance and wait there for 15 minutes for the next scheduled delivery task.

Begin at the supply depot near the central windmill. Proceed to the livestock feed storage building behind the northern cattle barn. Pick up a pallet containing 12 bags of grain feed. Deliver the pallet to the automated feeding zone at the open-air paddocks. Wait up to 15 minutes for the animal care team to unload the grain bags. After unloading, travel to the equipment wash-down zone adjacent to the old silo and remain there for 10 minutes to undergo cleaning before returning to the supply depot.

Begin at the battery charging bay and pick up a single replacement battery pack. Deliver this battery pack to the solar tractor parked at the south field entrance. Wait until the old battery is removed and the new battery is installed by the field technician. After the installation is complete, collect the used battery pack from the technician and transport it to the hazardous materials drop-off point near the recycling station. Once you have delivered the used battery, wait for 6 minutes in the area to ensure proper receipt before returning to the battery charging bay for further instructions.

Start at the logistics office adjacent to the factory yard. Drive to the recycling collection zone behind the packaging plant and pick up three bins of sorted plastics. Transport the loaded bins to the environmental processing station near the eastern perimeter fence. Wait at the unloading bay while facility staff remove all plastic bins, which may take approximately 8 minutes. After unloading, proceed to the component storage shed beside the west workshop, pick up a box containing electrical fuses, and deliver it to the maintenance workshop beside the north entrance. Once the fuses are handed over, return to the logistics office and await the next assignment.

Leave the maintenance workshop beside the old tractor barn and drive to the solar panel field on the east hill. Pick up a crate of panel cleaning equipment and two spare inverter modules. Proceed to the power storage station at the edge of the southern fence line and deliver the inverter modules. Wait until the modules are unloaded before continuing. Take the crate of cleaning equipment to the utility crew stationed at the field office near the eastern windmill. Wait for up to 10 minutes or until the crate is removed from the robot. After all deliveries are complete, return to the maintenance workshop and await your next assignment.

Begin at the service garage beside the main entry gate. Proceed to the tool storage annex located behind Workshop Bay 2. Pick up one secure tool chest containing diagnostic equipment. Transport the tool chest to the central irrigation control room adjacent to Field Sector B. Wait up to 8 minutes while the technicians unload the tool chest and reload the robot with three empty water sample canisters. Deliver the empty canisters to the environmental testing lab near the south pasture fence. Upon arrival, wait until all canisters have been removed before returning to the service garage to conclude your route.

Start at the maintenance garage beside the central barn. Proceed to the windbreak grove on the northern perimeter to pick up three collected soil sampling kits. Transport the kits to the laboratory annex at the rear of the administration building. Wait for lab staff to unload all sampling kits, then return to the maintenance garage and park in the designated recharging zone.

Travel to the greenhouse annex located near the north field margin and pick up four trays of freshly sprouted seedlings. Deliver the trays to the planting zone marked as Plot 5A, adjacent to the irrigation canal. Wait until the planting crew has removed all trays from your cargo platform. After unloading, proceed to the supply depot behind the grain silos and pick up a sealed toolbox containing precision planting tools. Deliver the toolbox to the temporary field laboratory set up at the western treeline. Once the field technician has taken the toolbox from your platform, return to the greenhouse annex and await further instructions.

Begin at the farm equipment garage. Drive to the orchard entrance and collect three empty harvest baskets. Proceed to the apple grove clearing and wait for field workers to load the baskets with apples. Once loaded, deliver the filled baskets to the produce collection barn. Wait there for 10 minutes while the baskets are unloaded, then return to the farm equipment garage.

Begin at the west gate service area adjacent to the visitor parking lot. Travel to the greenhouse complex behind the pond and pick up a crate of assorted seedling trays and a box containing temperature sensors. Deliver both items to the experimental crop plots at the far north end of the property. Wait for 12 minutes while field technicians unload and install the equipment. After the items are in place, proceed to the compost processing zone near the old barn and retrieve two empty organic waste bins. Drop off the bins at the staff picnic shelter behind the admin building, then return to the west gate service area and await further instructions.

Move to the greenhouse supply depot beside the irrigation lagoon and pick up three bags of horticultural substrate and a pallet of seed trays. Navigate to Greenhouse 4 on the north side of the farm and deliver the horticultural substrate, then wait until the greenhouse manager unloads the bags. Once unloaded, proceed to the propagation shed adjacent to the compost yard and deliver the pallet of seed trays. Wait for 7 minutes to allow staff to retrieve the trays, then return to the garage next to the main entrance gate and stand by for further instructions.

Proceed from the greenhouse rear entrance to the tool storage barn at the northern property line. Pick up three soil moisture sensors and six potted tomato seedlings. Transport all items to the experimental plots section located south of the irrigation canal. Wait for 8 minutes while research staff retrieve the sensors. Once only the seedlings remain, continue to the outdoor nursery by the shaded pergola, and deliver the potted seedlings to the nursery supervisor. Upon successful delivery, head to the refueling station near the central farm office and wait for 5 minutes before further tasks.

Start by navigating to the greenhouse supply shed to pick up three trays of seedlings. Deliver the seedlings to Plot 7 on the southern field and wait for the planting crew to unload the trays. Once unloaded, travel to the irrigation pump station near the windbreak, collect one replacement filter cartridge, and deliver it to the maintenance zone at the west end of the vineyard. Wait for 5 minutes while the technician installs the filter cartridge, then return to the greenhouse supply shed.

Begin at the solar panel charging station near the storage silo. Drive to the fertilizer shed adjacent to the west pasture and pick up a pallet of fertilizer bags. Transport the pallet to Grain Field 2’s access point. Wait for 15 minutes while farm staff unload the fertilizer bags. After the pallet is emptied, proceed to the repair shop on the north lot to be fitted with a new oil canister. Deliver the oil canister to the tractor port in Zone C, then return to the charging station to await further instructions.

Start at the shipping bay adjacent to the main office and drive to the farm equipment shelter near the west paddock. Pick up a stack of five irrigation hoses. Deliver the irrigation hoses to Plot 7 by the southern fence line. Wait until the field crew signals that all hoses have been unloaded. Next, head to the chemical storage facility near the reservoir and collect one sealed drum of plant nutrient solution. Transport the drum to the vertical farming tent at the center property. Wait for 15 minutes while the tent staff fill their tanks, then proceed to the vehicle wash station near the entrance gate for final inspection before returning to the shipping bay.

Proceed to the chemical supply shed next to the main livestock barn and collect one sealed container of fertilizer. Deliver the container to the crop spraying unit stationed at the north pasture boundary. Wait until the unit operator has securely loaded the fertilizer onto their equipment. Next, travel to the maintenance yard behind the vehicle depot and pick up three spare wheel assemblies. Transport the assemblies to the sunflower field service entrance, where the field technician will be waiting. Remain at the entrance for 5 minutes to allow the technician to unload the wheel assemblies, then return to the central robot docking station beside the administrative office and await further deployment.

Begin at the delivery holding area adjacent to the farm market storefront. Proceed to the apple orchard access gate on the west perimeter and collect three crates filled with harvested apples. Transport the apple crates to the refrigeration unit located behind Packing Shed 2. Wait until a worker has unloaded all crates from the platform. Next, proceed to the pesticide storage container near the northern equipment yard, pick up a sealed canister marked for safe disposal, and deliver it to the hazardous materials pickup zone near the rear service road. After drop-off, drive to the shade rest area under the large maple tree at the center of the property and wait for 10 minutes before returning to the delivery holding area.

Start at the fruit storage warehouse next to the paved access road. Head to the vineyard section labeled 'Block C' and collect two bins filled with harvested grapes. Transport the bins to the juice processing area located behind the solar array. Wait until the processing crew indicates the bins have been emptied, then continue to the repair shed at the far end of the field to pick up a sealed toolbox. Deliver the toolbox to the irrigation control station adjacent to the blueberry patch and wait for 7 minutes while the maintenance staff retrieves their equipment. Finally, return to the fruit storage warehouse and stand by for future assignments.

Begin at the machinery garage near the eastern orchard entrance. Drive to the main irrigation pump station beside the reservoir and collect a sealed toolkit box along with a roll of replacement irrigation pipe. Transport these items to the maintenance outpost located next to the sunflower field. Wait while the maintenance crew unloads the equipment and verifies their contents, which could take up to 8 minutes. Once unloading is complete, return to the machinery garage and remain there until assigned your next task.

Begin at the maintenance garage and collect a toolkit containing calibrated wrenches for machinery repairs. Proceed to the west orchard and deliver the toolkit to the equipment staging area near the apple harvesters. Wait until a technician removes the toolkit from the robot, then navigate to the produce packing shed on the southern perimeter. Pick up three crates of freshly packed apples. Transport these crates to the farm market delivery bay, located adjacent to the main entrance. Wait up to 12 minutes for market staff to unload the crates, then return to the maintenance garage for your next assignment.

Begin at the garage next to the machine shop. Proceed to the fruit sorting station near the south orchard gate and collect three empty produce crates. Deliver the crates to the apple picking area at the west end of the orchard. Wait until all crates have been fully loaded by the picking crew. Once loaded, transport the filled produce crates to the refrigerated storage container adjacent to the packing house. Wait for 10 minutes while the crates are unloaded by the storage staff. After completing the delivery, return to the garage and await further tasks.

Start at the seed storage bunker adjacent to the west entrance. Collect four burlap sacks filled with organic fertilizer. Proceed to the southern vineyard, and deliver the sacks to the temporary trellis assembly area. Wait for 10 minutes while vineyard workers distribute the fertilizer. Once unloading is complete, drive to the pump station behind the berry field and retrieve a box of irrigation couplers. Deliver the box to the east side greenhouse utility room, then wait nearby until signaled by facility staff for any additional pickups.

Begin at the maintenance depot located near the administrative building. Travel to the solar panel field on the east hillside, and retrieve two toolkits and a coil of insulated wiring left at the equipment staging area. Proceed to the substation at the north end of the property and deliver the wiring and toolkits to the electrical upgrade team. Wait up to 15 minutes for the technicians to finish unloading. After unloading is complete, drive to the livestock barn access gate. Pick up a sealed container of medication, then carry it to the veterinary supply room adjacent to the animal pens. Once delivery is confirmed, remain at the veterinary supply room for 5 minutes in case further items need to be transported.

Start at the greenhouse equipment bay located next to the irrigation control center. Proceed to the seedling nursery at the east side of the farm and retrieve two trays of vegetable seedlings designated for field planting. Transport the trays to Plot 7, marked by the blue flag near the livestock fence. Wait at the field edge until all trays have been unloaded by the planting crew. Once the trays are removed, proceed to the barn workshop, pick up a box of spare hose connectors, and deliver this box to the water pump station beside the main livestock pond. Do not wait for unloading at the pump station—after drop off, return to the greenhouse equipment bay for your next assignment.

Proceed to the orchard equipment shelter and pick up two pruning toolkits and one water testing kit. Navigate to the northern apple orchard and deliver the toolkits and testing kit to the crew at row 12. Wait until a crew member confirms that all items have been removed from your platform. Once unloaded, move to the composting station and collect any full compost bags. Bring the compost bags to the flower garden alongside the main entrance, and wait for 5 minutes for the garden staff to begin unloading. Return to the orchard equipment shelter to complete the current task cycle.

Start at the supply depot and proceed to the greenhouse packing area. Pick up four trays of harvested cherry tomatoes. Deliver the trays to the shipping container located at the farm’s western gate. Once unloaded, travel to the fuel storage shed and wait to be loaded with three diesel jerry cans by the operations manager. After the jerry cans have been secured, drive to the machinery bay and deliver the fuel to the maintenance team. Wait for 15 minutes to allow for unloading and possible refueling activities, then return to the supply depot.

Begin at the maintenance room adjacent to the machinery workshop. Proceed to the northern greenhouse and collect three containers of plant nutrients from the storage shelf. Deliver the containers to the irrigation control station located beside the west field. Wait until field technicians unload the containers, which should take approximately 4 minutes. Afterward, travel to the livestock supply yard near the main barn. Pick up a replacement water filter and transport it to the animal husbandry building at the south end of the ranch. Once delivered, stand by for 8 minutes for staff to inspect the filter, then return to the maintenance room.

Make your way to the vineyard supply shed nestled near the northwest corner of the fields and pick up four rolls of bird netting. Deliver the netting rolls to the trellis section at the north vineyard. Wait until all four rolls have been unloaded from the robot. After unloading, proceed to the irrigation pump house at the south end of the property and collect a single portable water pump. Transport the water pump to the maintenance station next to the farm workshop and wait for a maximum of 8 minutes or until the pump is removed from your cargo bay. Once your cargo is clear, return to the equipment shelter near the main gate and await your next assignment.

Begin at the solar panel charging station beside the greenhouse annex. Drive to the irrigation supply depot east of the main orchard and pick up three water pump units. Deliver these pump units to the riverside crop field south of the old windmill. Wait until the field supervisor signals that the pumps have been unloaded. After delivery is confirmed, proceed to the vineyard tool kiosk and collect a soil sensor kit. Travel to the upper terrace vineyard and deliver the soil sensor kit to the vine maintenance crew. Remain at the terrace for 15 minutes to assist with any additional transport requests that may arise from the maintenance crew.

Begin at the base of the wind turbine maintenance yard. Proceed to the granary loading ramp and pick up three bundles of sensor cables. Transport the cables to the south greenhouse entrance and wait for a technician to collect all bundles from your platform—this may take up to 10 minutes. Once you've been fully unloaded, head to the solar array service station and stand by for further assignments.

Start at the main workshop and proceed to the machinery parking lot by the south paddock. Pick up two spare hydraulic hoses from the service cart located there. Deliver the hydraulic hoses to the tractor repair bay behind the grain elevator. Wait for 20 minutes as the repair team installs the hoses, then return to the main workshop, stopping by the compost heap at the east side of the property to collect any empty toolboxes for return before concluding at the workshop.

Begin at the greenhouse entrance and proceed to the pesticide storage shed behind the irrigation tanks. Pick up a crate of organic pest repellent canisters. Deliver the crate to the vineyard utility station beside the north trellis rows. Wait there for 10 minutes while vineyard staff distribute the canisters. Afterward, travel to the weather monitoring tower near the eastern field and pick up the daily data logbook. Bring the logbook to the main office reception desk in the administration building. Once the handoff is complete, return to the greenhouse entrance and remain on standby until further notice.

Begin at the maintenance garage near the east gate. Drive to the fertilizer storage area adjacent to the southern warehouse and pick up two bags of nitrogen fertilizer. Deliver the fertilizer to the compost mixing site beside the eastern field. Wait for 7 minutes while the agronomy team unloads and inspects the bags. Once the site supervisor confirms all items are accounted for, proceed to the water tower courtyard and await further instructions for 5 minutes before returning to the maintenance garage.

Begin at the composting depot and travel to the orchard supply shed. Pick up a pallet containing assorted pruning shears and fertilizer sacks. Deliver the pallet to the north edge of the apple orchard, near Row 7. Wait for the field crew to unload all items from your platform; this process may take up to 12 minutes. Once finished, proceed to the weather monitoring tower for an equipment status check before returning to the composting depot.

Begin in the garage maintenance bay. Proceed to the spare parts depot located next to the main warehouse and pick up two heavy-duty hydraulic jacks. Deliver these jacks to the equipment repair tent set up near Field 3. Wait at the repair tent for 10 minutes while service technicians inspect the delivery and load an empty oil drum onto the robot. Collect the empty oil drum, carry it to the hazardous waste storage unit at the south end of the property, and wait until the drum is removed from the robot before returning to the garage maintenance bay for your next directive.

Begin at the equipment garage situated behind the administration building. Travel to the irrigation supply depot near the southern field. Pick up two pallets of fertilizer bags and a set of irrigation valves. Deliver these to the greenhouse complex on the western perimeter of the property. Wait for the greenhouse staff to remove the pallets and confirm receipt of the valves. Once unloading is complete, proceed to the tool storage cabin next to the compost area. Stand by for 8 minutes in case additional equipment is needed for transfer.

Start at the maintenance workshop adjacent to the grain silo. Drive to the orchard's edge near the southern boundary and pick up five baskets filled with freshly harvested apples. Transport the baskets to the quality inspection station beside the produce warehouse. Once there, wait for inspectors to check and tag the baskets, which may take up to 12 minutes. After the inspection is done, deliver all the baskets to cold storage room B in the produce warehouse. Wait until all the baskets have been unloaded by warehouse staff before returning to the maintenance workshop and await further instructions.

Start at the produce loading dock next to the orchard entrance. Proceed to the west apple orchard and collect six crates of freshly picked apples. Transport the apple crates to the cooling storage chamber located behind the main packing building. Wait up to 12 minutes while the staff unloads the crates. After unloading, move to the maintenance shed beside the equipment wash area to pick up any discarded packaging materials. Deliver these packaging materials to the composting facility near the windbreak trees. After completing the delivery, stand by for 10 minutes before returning to the produce loading dock to await further instructions.

Start at the grain silo control station. Drive to the orchard supply hut located next to the eastern apple grove and collect two pesticide sprayers. Transport the sprayers to the trellis repair site in the central vineyard. Wait for 10 minutes while vineyard staff unload the sprayers. Then, proceed to the mechanical workshop beside the main greenhouse and pick up a crate of spare conveyor belts. Deliver the crate to the packaging facility entrance. Once delivery is complete, return to the grain silo control station and stand by for further instructions.

Start at the maintenance bay next to the east entrance of the warehouse. Drive to the pumpkin patch near the irrigation pond and pick up two empty water tanks. Deliver the empty tanks to the refill station beside the barn and wait there for 12 minutes while the tanks are refilled. Once refilled, transport the water tanks back to the pumpkin patch and wait until all tanks have been unloaded by farm staff. After unloading, continue to the greenhouse office located at the northeast corner of the property to pick up a package of planting tools and bring it to the field supervisor station at the edge of Field 7. Once delivered, return to the maintenance bay for your next task.

Start at the supply depot adjacent to the greenhouse complex. Collect four containers of organic fertilizer from the marked storage rack. Transport the fertilizer to the irrigation control station situated between the berry field and the equipment lane. Upon arrival, wait until the agronomy team finishes unloading all fertilizer containers—this process may take several minutes. Once unloading is confirmed, travel to the field equipment bay beside the southern orchard and wait there for further loading or unloading tasks.

Start at the solar equipment shed beside the northern barn. Proceed to the maintenance yard and pick up a pallet containing four water pumps. Deliver this pallet to the irrigation control station in the east field. Wait until the pumps have been removed and signed for by the maintenance technician. Once the delivery is complete, return to the solar equipment shed and stand by for 10 minutes before taking on new assignments.

Begin at the equipment garage beside the northeast field. Drive to the grain silo located across the access road. Pick up four empty grain containers left by the storage manager. Deliver these containers to the composting station at the edge of the orchard. Wait for 10 minutes while the containers are loaded with organic material by the staff. After the loading is complete, transport the filled containers to the packaging barn near the farm entrance. Remain at the packaging barn until a worker signals that all containers have been unloaded, then return to the equipment garage and await further instructions.

Begin at the orchard entrance and navigate to the northern apple grove. Collect two crates of harvested apples from beneath the collection tent. Transport the crates to the central weighing station for processing. Wait for the crates to be weighed and labeled, which may take up to 10 minutes. Once labeling is complete, proceed to the packaging barn and deliver the apple crates. Return to the orchard entrance after delivery.

Begin at the central garage adjacent to the southern gate. Drive to the greenhouse inventory room and pick up a pallet containing five trays of young tomato seedlings. Transport the seedlings to greenhouses 3 and 4, located on the eastern side of the agricultural complex. Deliver three trays to greenhouse 3, then proceed with the remaining trays to greenhouse 4 and deliver them there. Afterwards, wait outside greenhouse 4 for 8 minutes to assist with any unexpected return shipments. When the waiting period is over, return to the central garage and prepare for your next task.

Begin at the main greenhouse loading point. Drive to the orchard’s southern entrance and pick up three crates of freshly harvested pears. Deliver the pear crates to the cold storage room behind the central processing facility. Wait until the refrigeration crew confirms all crates have been unloaded – estimated wait: 7 minutes. Proceed to the fertilizer depot, pick up a sealed sack of organic compost, and take it to the flower trial plots near the eastern fence. After delivering the compost, return to the main greenhouse loading point and stand by for 10 minutes before ending the assignment.

Start from the chemical storage shed near the western fence. Move to the fertilizer loading area behind the grain silo and pick up two sealed containers of liquid fertilizer. Deliver these containers to the vineyard spraying station at the north field edge. Wait for the field manager to approve the delivery, which may take up to 12 minutes. Once approved, return to the chemical storage shed and await further instructions.

Begin at the storage shed next to the central administration building. Drive to the citrus orchard loading area and pick up two crates of fertilizer packets. Transport the crates to the south orchard equipment depot and wait until a supervisor confirms the payload has been unloaded, which should take about 6 minutes. After unloading, continue to the weather monitoring station on the east ridge, deliver a sealed rain gauge for installation, and wait for 10 minutes while technicians install the gauge. Once complete, return to the storage shed.

Start at the storage yard beside the fertilizer blending station. Navigate to the grain silo area near the west entrance and pick up four sealed sacks of seed corn. Deliver these sacks to the planter machine assembly point south of the main barn. Wait until a technician arrives and removes all seed sacks, which may take around 8 minutes. Once unloading is complete, proceed to the maintenance room adjacent to the chicken coops and wait there for further instructions.

Begin at the maintenance garage beside Greenhouse 2. Drive to the irrigation control station at the edge of the central cornfield and pick up two sealed containers of fertilizer solution. Deliver the containers to the drip-feed system hub near the northern orchard entrance. Wait until the irrigation supervisor confirms both containers have been properly connected to the system, which should take approximately 7 minutes. Then, proceed to the tool supply kiosk near the meadow barn and await further loading instructions from the farm technician.

Navigate to the fresh produce packing station beside the central greenhouse and collect three crates of harvested strawberries. Deliver the crates to the refrigerated storage container located next to the northern loading dock. Upon arrival, wait for the cold storage attendant to unload all three crates, which may take up to 8 minutes. After the crates have been successfully unloaded, proceed to the maintenance garage behind the administrative offices to pick up a container of cleaning supplies. Deliver the cleaning supplies to the equipment wash pad near the south field entrance, then wait for 5 minutes to receive confirmation from the cleaning crew that the supplies have been received. Upon completion, proceed to the vehicle parking area for standby instructions.

Begin at the central machinery shed next to the entrance gate. Proceed to Orchard Block D near the old windmill and pick up three crates of freshly harvested pears. Deliver the crates to the refrigerated storage tent adjacent to Packing Facility 3. Wait until a staff member signals that unloading is complete. Then, proceed to the riverfront dock behind the property and collect a replacement water pump from the supply boat. Transport the water pump to the irrigation control station near Field 7 at the eastern boundary. After delivery, wait for 8 minutes for a technician to verify the installation before returning to the central machinery shed.

Proceed to the greenhouse annex located behind the main office and pick up three trays of tomato seedlings. Shuttle the trays to Plot B in the eastern cultivation area and ensure the trays are unloaded at the designated planting row. Once the drop-off is complete, navigate to the fertilizer depot near the composting station and load two bags of organic fertilizer. Deliver these bags to the orchard entrance beside the eastern gate. Wait for up to 10 minutes or until both bags have been removed, whichever comes first. After your cargo area is empty, return to the solar charging bay adjacent to the parking lot and dock for recharging.

Start at the north gate checkpoint and proceed to the chemical storage facility beside the weather monitoring tower. Pick up two sealed containers of liquid fertilizer. Deliver the containers to the crop sprayer assembly area on the west field’s edge. Wait until all containers have been unloaded by authorized personnel. Then, travel to the farm’s fuel depot near the central barn and collect a spare fuel canister. Transport the canister to the vineyard service shelter and wait for 5 minutes while vineyard staff unload and inspect the fuel. Finally, return to the north gate checkpoint.

Begin at the spare parts depot located behind the admin building and proceed to the orchard’s east entrance. Collect four empty harvesting baskets left by the fruit pickers. Transport the empty baskets to the freshly harvested apple rows in Section C of the orchard and wait until all baskets are loaded with apples. Once loaded, carry the full baskets to the fruit washing station next to the packing shed. Wait for 10 minutes while the washing crew processes the apples and removes the baskets from your platform. Afterward, drive to the security checkpoint at the property’s north gate and await further instructions.

Start at the orchard equipment bay next to the main entrance and collect two empty fruit collection bins. Proceed to the south apple grove and wait until the harvesting team fills both bins. Once loaded, drive the bins to the north-side processing warehouse. Deliver the bins to the designated receiving area at the warehouse entrance. Wait for 12 minutes as the contents are inspected and unloaded by the quality control staff. After unloading, collect a maintenance toolbox from the warehouse supervisor and transport it to the irrigation control hut by the eastern reservoir. Wait until the toolbox is fully unloaded, then return to the orchard equipment bay to complete the task.

Drive to the equipment depot and pick up three empty fuel canisters. Transport the canisters to the west field generator station and deliver them near the fuel pump. Wait until a technician fills and re-places the canisters on the robot. Return the filled canisters to the equipment depot and wait at the designated unloading area until a depot assistant removes all filled canisters from the robot. Once the canisters are unloaded, proceed to the orchard service lane to await further instructions.

Begin at the workshop entrance and travel to the fertilizer storage shed located at the southeast corner of the property. Pick up one sealed drum of liquid fertilizer. Next, deliver this drum to the irrigation control area adjacent to the large central reservoir. Wait until a staff member has unloaded the drum from the robot. After the delivery is complete, proceed to the weather monitoring station on the north ridge and remain there for 12 minutes to allow for sensor calibration proximity checks. Once the waiting period is over, return to the workshop entrance.

Start at the main greenhouse control center. Proceed to the west orchard, located beyond the irrigation pond, and pick up five crates of freshly harvested pears from the collection point. Deliver all crates to the packing station inside the produce warehouse. Wait up to 10 minutes for warehouse staff to unload all crates. After unloading, return to the greenhouse supply shed and wait there until further tasks are assigned.

Start at the main operations hub near the south entrance. Drive to the orchard supply shed along the eastern lane and pick up three empty wooden crates. Transport the crates to harvesting team A located at the north orchard plot. Wait until the team leader confirms all crates have been unloaded. Next, continue to the irrigation control station adjacent to the northeast pond and collect a toolbox containing spare irrigation valves. Deliver the toolbox to the pump house at the far end of the cornfield. Wait for the maintenance supervisor to remove the toolbox before returning to the main operations hub.

Start at the equipment storage barn next to the irrigation pump house. Drive to the tool shed beside the northern fence and pick up a set of six harvesting baskets. Deliver the baskets to the field tent located along the central crop lane. Wait there until all baskets have been unloaded by the harvest team, then proceed to the fuel station adjacent to the tractor garage. Collect one portable fuel canister and transport it to the machinery repair pad at the southern edge of the property. Wait for 12 minutes or until the repair crew retrieves the canister. After completing the delivery, return to the equipment storage barn and stand by for your next task.

Drive to the fertilizer depot at the southeast corner of the farm and pick up a pallet of organic fertilizer sacks. Deliver the pallet to the distribution point beside the north greenhouse. Wait for the farm staff to unload all sacks before leaving. Afterwards, proceed to the vehicle maintenance shed near the east perimeter and remain for 10 minutes to allow technicians to perform routine checks. Once the checks are finished, return to the fertilizer depot to complete your cycle.

Begin at the equipment storage barn beside the western gravel lot. Proceed to the herb garden shed near the greenhouse and pick up a pallet of organic fertilizer bags. Deliver the pallet to the composting site by the northern fence line. Wait for 10 minutes while the soil crew offloads the fertilizer. Then, drive to the machinery workshop just south of the composting site and pick up a sealed box of replacement conveyor belts. Transport the box to the packaging pavilion near the main road and wait until packaging staff unload the box. After the delivery is completed, return to the equipment storage barn.

Start at the machinery garage and proceed to the vineyard storage tent. Pick up four containers of irrigation tubing. Transport the containers to the eastern slope grapevines staging area. Wait for 8 minutes while the vineyard crew retrieves the tubing. After the crew finishes unloading, travel to the sensor calibration station by the farm entrance, and remain there for a scheduled diagnostic appointment before returning to the machinery garage for standby.

Start at the vehicle maintenance shelter near the south lot. Proceed to the storage barn adjacent to the wheat fields. Pick up two replacement tires and a box of hydraulic tools. Navigate to the tractor parking zone at the north end of the fields. Wait for the mechanics to unload the tools and install the tires, standing by for up to 15 minutes or until all items are removed from your platform. Once complete, move to the fuel tank area beside the central driveway, deposit any unused tools in the marked supply bin, and then return to the vehicle maintenance shelter to complete your round.

Begin at the north gate of the wind turbine assembly yard. Drive to the heavy machinery storage zone and collect a single steel tool chest marked for repairs. Deliver the tool chest to the hydraulic maintenance pavilion near the central reservoir. After delivery, stand by for 7 minutes while the maintenance crew assesses the tool chest and returns two damaged hydraulic pistons. Secure the pistons, then transport them directly to the engineering diagnostics lab located in the main administrative building. Wait at the diagnostics lab until an engineer removes the pistons before concluding your route.

Start at the maintenance garage and proceed to the greenhouse loading zone. Retrieve a pallet containing fertilizer bags from the shaded holding area. Deliver the pallet to the irrigation control station beside the southern creek. Wait for the greenhouse team to unload the fertilizer, which should take approximately 8 minutes. After unloading is complete, move to the equipment shelter near the compost yard, pick up a box of replacement water filters, transport them to the irrigation control station, and wait until all filters have been transferred to the storage rack before returning to the maintenance garage.

Start at the maintenance garage near the southern entrance. Proceed to the equipment storage yard and pick up two oil drums designated for the tractor fleet. Deliver the oil drums to the refueling station on the west lot, and wait for 12 minutes while the maintenance crew unloads them. Once the drums are offloaded, continue to the materials bunker adjacent to the weather station and retrieve a sealed container of fertilizer tablets. Take the container to the vineyard block B. Wait for the vineyard manager to confirm delivery, then return to the maintenance garage.

Begin at the orchard equipment depot and travel to the north apple grove. Pick up three empty harvest bins placed beside the main path. Transport the empty bins to the collection tent near the tractor station. Wait for the harvesting crew to fill the bins with apples, which may take up to 12 minutes. After loading, deliver the three filled bins to the cold storage unit behind the produce packing building. Once the bins are offloaded, return to the orchard equipment depot for further assignments.

Start at the packing shed beside the orchard entrance. Proceed to the loading area near the eastern orchard and collect three crates of freshly picked apples. Transport the crates to the farmers’ market stall situated on the southern boundary of the property. Wait for the market organizer to verify the delivery and unload the apples, which should take around 10 minutes. Once the crates are unloaded, proceed to the composting facility next to the equipment storage yard, pick up any empty harvest totes available, and return the empty totes to the packing shed to complete your assignment.

Begin at the spare parts depot next to the north gate. Travel to the machinery parking zone located near the west irrigation channel and pick up one heavy-duty transmission gearbox. Deliver the gearbox to assembly bay 3 inside the central manufacturing hall. After the gearbox is unloaded, wait for 8 minutes to receive a batch of defective sensors for return. Once the sensors are loaded, transport them back to the spare parts depot and wait for staff to complete the check-in process before proceeding to the battery charging area for a recharge.

Begin at the loading dock beside the northwest greenhouse. Drive to the compost collection area at the eastern boundary and pick up three bags of organic waste. Deliver the bags to the processing station next to the fertilizer silos. Wait for the station operator to unload the bags, which may take up to 8 minutes. Once unloaded, proceed to the packaging warehouse near the market access road. Pick up two sealed boxes of freshly packed strawberries and transport them to the roadside produce stand across from the main parking lot. After the delivery, return to the loading dock and await your next assignment.

Begin at the supply depot adjacent to the vehicle maintenance yard and pick up four sealed fertilizer canisters. Transport the canisters to the mid-field greenhouse near plot 3. Wait for the greenhouse staff to unload the canisters, then proceed to the composting site behind the southern hedgerow. Collect two full compost bags and deliver them to the orchard’s west entrance gate. Wait for five minutes while the landscaping team retrieves the bags. Once unloaded, return to the supply depot and await further deployment.

Begin at the vehicle maintenance garage. Proceed to the equipment storage barn located north of the grain silos to collect three replacement tractor batteries. Deliver the batteries to the field maintenance station near the north soybean plot and wait for the crew to finish unloading, which should take approximately 8 minutes. When unloading is complete, travel to the irrigation pump house beside the west irrigation canal to pick up a box of water quality test kits. Transport the test kits to the greenhouse control station adjacent to the plant nursery, then remain there for 5 minutes in case additional instructions are provided by the greenhouse manager. Finally, return to the vehicle maintenance garage and await further tasks.

Start by traveling to the farm's pesticide storage shed located behind the compost processing area. Pick up a sealed drum of organic pesticide. Deliver the drum to the apple orchard's equipment shed on the east side of the property. Wait for 12 minutes while the orchard workers transfer the pesticide into their sprayers. Once the drum is empty, proceed to the field workshop adjacent to the water reservoir and pick up a box of replacement drone batteries. Bring the battery box to the vineyard operations tent near the southern fence line. Wait at the tent until a technician retrieves the batteries, then return to the solar-powered charging station next to the greenhouse.

Start at the maintenance garage beside the west parking lot. Travel to the equipment yard located behind the solar panel bank and pick up two replacement tractor tires. Deliver the tires to the farm workshop adjacent to Grain Silo 3. Upon arrival, wait until the workshop staff remove both tires from the robot. Once unloaded, proceed to the orchard shade canopy near Apple Row 12 and wait there for 15 minutes for the orchard manager to arrive. After the wait, return to the maintenance garage to complete the task.

Proceed to the greenhouse annex behind the main office and collect a crate containing temperature-sensitive seedlings. Transport the crate to the north-side shade tent located along Row 12 in the vegetable plot. Wait for the horticulture specialist to verify the contents and remove the crate. Afterwards, travel to the maintenance supply shed adjacent to the gravel service road and pick up a packet of replacement sprinkler heads. Deliver the packet to the irrigation hub at the edge of the east cornfield and wait for 10 minutes while the field crew unloads the sprinkler heads from your cargo bay. After the cargo has been offloaded, drive to the central control kiosk under the wind turbine and stand by for further assignment.

Start at the equipment depot behind the main greenhouse. Drive to the pump house by the irrigation canal and pick up three containers of liquid fertilizer. Take the fertilizer containers to the northern crop field staging area. Wait for field workers to connect hoses and fully unload the liquid fertilizer, which is estimated to take about 10 minutes. Once unloading is confirmed, return to the equipment depot and stand by for 5 minutes before your next assignment.

Go to the orchard loading area near the southern fence and collect three bins of freshly harvested apples. Deliver the apple bins to the cooling trailer parked at the farm's east entrance. Wait for the agricultural logistics manager to scan and confirm receipt of the bins. Once confirmation is received, drive to the solar panel maintenance outpost by the reservoir and pick up a replacement inverter unit. Transport the inverter unit to the utility shed next to the animal barn, and remain there for 15 minutes while the maintenance technicians install the new equipment. Afterward, return to the operations briefing tent located between the repair bay and the equipment wash station.

Begin at the equipment garage next to the packing house. Drive to the west orchard entrance and pick up three sealed crates of pears waiting at the collection point. Transport the crates to the refrigerated loading bay behind the export warehouse. Wait for 15 minutes while the shipping staff inspects and unloads the crates. Once unloaded, proceed to the maintenance workshop near the greenhouse for your next assignment.

Begin at the packing shed beside the citrus grove and collect two crates of harvested lemons and a bundle of packing materials. Transport these items to the roadside farm stand near the eastern entrance. Wait until the farmstand staff confirms all items are offloaded. Then, drive to the equipment shelter next to the north service lane, pick up a replacement sprinkler unit, and deliver it to the center field irrigation hub. After delivery, wait for 15 minutes at the hub for directions from the irrigation team before proceeding back to the packing shed.

Start at the maintenance shed next to the central irrigation control center. Head to the tool storage cabin behind the machinery workshop and pick up two portable welding kits. Deliver the welding kits to the repair bay at the wind turbine station on the western ridge. Wait until the technicians have fully unloaded the welding kits from the robot, then proceed to the water tank reserve area. Collect three unopened water filters and drive to the drip line junction at the southern tomato plots. Await for 5 minutes while the farm crew installs the filters, then return to the maintenance shed and stand by for further tasks.

Start at the vehicle garage adjacent to the old farm office. Drive to the greenhouse complex at the west end of the property and pick up four trays of young tomato plants. Deliver the trays to the experimental plot entrance located south of the irrigation pond. Wait for the planting team to unload all trays, then proceed to the equipment storage bunker near the north access road. Collect one fuel canister from the marked storage bay, and deliver it to the grain dryer installation at the northeast corner of the main field.
