Once the operator removes the fuel canister, remain at the installation for 7 minutes in case further assistance is needed. Afterwards, return to the vehicle garage and await new instructions.

Begin at the maintenance bay adjacent to the equipment depot. Proceed to the compost storage shed near the southwest field. Pick up three bags of bio-fertilizer and deliver them to the planting crew at plot C, located beside the irrigation canal. Wait for the crew to fully unload the bags and provide a receipt confirmation. Next, travel to the solar panel array service area to collect a set of four spare solar inverters. Transport the inverters to the roof access point of the main operations building and wait for 10 minutes while the technical team retrieves all components. Once all items are delivered, return to the maintenance bay and await further instructions.

Begin at the equipment depot adjacent to the eastern storage silos. Proceed to the fertilizer mixing station near the southeast corner of the orchard and collect three sealed bags of mineral fertilizer. Drive the bags to the citrus grove entrance where the field team is preparing to apply fertilizer. Wait until the team has unloaded all three bags from your platform. After the offload, continue to the solar panel array atop the west hillside. Pick up a toolbox containing electrical instruments and deliver the toolbox to the central control office next to the greenhouse complex. Upon arrival, wait for 10 minutes while the maintenance supervisor verifies the contents before returning to the equipment depot for your next task.

Begin at the maintenance depot near the south gate. Proceed to the spare parts warehouse adjacent to the wind turbine field and pick up two hydraulic hose assemblies. Transport the hoses to the irrigation control center situated by the northern canal. Wait there until a field engineer removes both assemblies from the robot. After unloading, drive to the refueling pad near the grain silos and stand by for 10 minutes for a routine safety check before returning to the maintenance depot.

Start from the maintenance workshop adjacent to the main entrance gate. Proceed to the spare parts shed located near the north windbreak. Collect three spare tractor tires and a box of hydraulic fluid containers. Transport these items to the machinery parking lot next to the central barn. Wait for 10 minutes at the designated unloading area while maintenance personnel offload the supplies. Once unloading is complete, drive to the shade canopy near the staff rest area and remain there until you receive further instructions.

Start at the packing facility on the east side of the property. Drive to the vineyard supply depot located beside the irrigation pond. Pick up three compost bags stacked near the entrance. Deliver the compost bags to the compost dispersal site between Vine Rows 8 and 9. Wait at the dispersal site for the vineyard workers to unload all compost bags. After the compost is unloaded, proceed to the weather monitoring station at the top of the western slope and remain there for 10 minutes as directed by the site supervisor. Once the time has elapsed, return to the packing facility and await further instructions.

Start at the maintenance garage beside the west entrance. Head to the seed storage facility near the north field and pick up two boxes of wheat seeds. Deliver the boxes to the planting crew at Field Section C, located by the oak tree line. Wait until the crew confirms the seeds have been unloaded—expected duration: 5 minutes. After that, proceed to the water tank refill station next to the barn and collect a small water barrel. Transport it to the equipment cleaning area behind the machine shed. Once delivered, wait for 8 minutes to be fully unloaded before returning to the maintenance garage and await further instructions.

Start at the storage shed adjacent to the west field entrance. Drive to the orchard harvest zone in the southern sector to pick up three baskets of ripe peaches. Transport these baskets to the cooling facility at the farm’s southeast corner. Wait for the facility staff to offload the peaches, remaining there for up to 12 minutes. Once unloaded, head to the maintenance workshop near the windmill and collect a set of replacement hydraulic hoses. Deliver the hoses to the equipment repair site along the east perimeter road. After completing the delivery, return to the storage shed.

Start at the supply depot adjacent to the main parking lot. Travel to the solar charging station near the east orchard and collect two replacement solar panels. Deliver the panels to the maintenance crew at the roof access point of the processing facility. Wait until the crew has taken both panels from your platform (anticipated time: 10 minutes). Once the panels are unloaded, proceed to the livestock barn storage room and pick up a bundle of fencing wire. Deliver the fencing wire to the repair technicians at the pasture entrance gate. After confirming with the technicians that the wire has been received, return to the supply depot adjacent to the main parking lot.

Start from the equipment charging station situated beside the solar panel array. Proceed to the irrigation supply shed and collect three reels of drip irrigation tubing. Transport the reels to Vineyard Section B, specifically to the western edge where installation crews are stationed. Wait until the crew has fully unloaded all the tubing reels. Next, continue to the plant nursery, pick up a pallet containing young saplings, and deliver the pallet to the reforestation zone along the northern boundary. Once the saplings have been removed from the robot, return promptly to the equipment charging station for further assignments.

Proceed to the orchard entrance by the southern lane and pick up a pallet containing five crates of apples. Drive to the barn loading dock located beside the old windmill and deliver the apple crates to the designated unloading zone. Wait until a staff member has unloaded all crates from your platform before leaving. Once empty, travel to the equipment storage area behind the irrigation shed and collect two coiled water hoses. Take the hoses to the vineyard service gate and wait while field crew remove the hoses for use in the vineyard. When your platform is empty, return to the orchard entrance and stand by under the shade tree for further instructions.

Proceed to the orchard packing zone and pick up a pallet containing assorted apple boxes. Transport the pallet to the cool storage facility near the east barn and wait until all apple boxes have been unloaded by the storage crew. After delivery, navigate to the machinery maintenance garage and wait to be loaded with two replacement drive belts. Once the belts are securely loaded, head to the crop processing shed beside the south field and deliver the drive belts to the technicians. After the payload has been removed, travel to the central plaza and remain there for 8 minutes for scheduled system diagnostics.

Head to the solar equipment depot and collect three battery packs and a set of solar panel cleaning tools. Deliver these items to the remote solar array near the irrigation pond and wait until a maintenance technician removes the cleaning tools from your platform. Once unloaded, proceed to the north field edge and pick up a sealed container of soil samples. Transport the soil samples to the laboratory reception area inside the main research building. Wait for 10 minutes while the laboratory staff processes the samples, then return to the solar equipment depot to await your next task.

Start at the maintenance garage near the west parking lot and proceed to the solar panel array behind the storage barn. Pick up a box of replacement inverter components and deliver them to the utility shed adjacent to the array. Wait for 5 minutes while the maintenance crew inspects the delivery. Head to the livestock feed depot in the northern sector and collect four bags of grain mix. Transport the grain to the pasture-side feeding station, then wait until the farm staff has finished unloading all bags. Lastly, navigate to the field survey outpost on the hilltop and stand by there until further instructions are provided.

Begin at the greenhouse equipment garage located behind the southern greenhouses. Proceed to the compost facility near the south field entrance and pick up two bins of organic compost. Deliver the compost bins to the rooftop garden access point beside the administration building. Wait for 7 minutes while the gardening team unloads the bins. After unloading, travel to the irrigation pump house on the north side of the reservoir and collect a package of replacement irrigation filters. Bring the filters to the maintenance crew at the valve control room in the northwest corner of the property. Once delivery is confirmed, remain at the valve control room for further assignment.

Begin at the central dispatch station located near the wind turbine array. Head to the orchard supply shed by the southern apple rows and pick up three crates of bee hives. Deliver the bee hives to the pollination support area adjacent to the wildflower beds east of the orchard. Wait for the horticulture crew to unload all three crates. Afterward, proceed to the machinery repair zone beside the diesel pump and collect the toolbox marked 'Combine Repair.' Bring the toolbox to the combine harvester parked at the western end of Field 2. Remain next to the harvester until the repair technician removes the toolbox, then immediately return to the central dispatch station and await further instructions.

Start at the machinery garage near the west field entrance. Proceed to the seed storage hut across from the ponds and collect four sacks of barley seed. Deliver the sacks to the planting crew stationed at the south edge of Field 5, next to the irrigation channels. Wait until all sacks have been unloaded, which should take around 6 minutes. When unloading is complete, travel to the tool locker outside the maintenance office and pick up a battery pack. Take the battery pack to the solar monitoring station beside the windbreak grove and wait for the technician to install it, approximately 4 minutes. After installation, return to the machinery garage and remain on standby for further tasks.

Proceed to the northern vineyard storage hall and pick up two crates of pruning shears. Deliver the crates to the trellis maintenance zone adjacent to the west grapevines. Wait until the vineyard crew unloads all pruning shears from the robot. Once unloaded, travel to the composting yard at the far east end of the property. Collect all empty compost bins present, and return them to the supply cabinet in the central greenhouse atrium.

Start at the vehicle charging station beside the greenhouse. Travel to the irrigation control hub near the sunflower field. Collect two sealed containers of water treatment chemicals. Deliver the containers to the pump shed at the east end of the rice paddies. Wait for the field manager to remove the chemical containers from the robot. Once unloaded, proceed to the supply tent next to the compost storage area. Pick up a single weatherproof sensor kit and bring it to the weather monitoring tower in the southwest corner of the property. After delivering the sensor kit, return to the vehicle charging station and await further instructions.

Start at the farmyard dispatch zone next to Workshop 3. Proceed to the orchard equipment shed and retrieve a crate labeled 'Harvest Tools Set B'. Deliver the crate to Crew Station Delta, located halfway down the eastern vineyard row. Wait until the crew lead confirms the crate has been unloaded, which should take about 6 minutes. Afterwards, return to the orchard equipment shed and pick up two replacement nozzles for the crop sprayers. Take the nozzles to the pesticide mixing bay near Greenhouse 1. Once delivered, wait for 5 minutes at the bay in case additional equipment needs to be transferred.

Begin at the maintenance garage adjacent to the central operations office. Drive to the grain storage silo located on the southern field edge and collect four sealed bags of wheat seed. Take the bags to the planter crew waiting at Field 7, Section C, and wait while all bags are unloaded. Afterward, proceed to the recycling station near the workshop entrance, pick up a container of used oil filters, and transport them to the hazardous materials enclosure at the far end of the logistics yard. Wait for 5 minutes to be unloaded, then finally continue to the greenhouse area and stand by for further instructions.

Begin at the equipment shed near the north field entrance. Travel to the seed storage facility behind the administrative office. Pick up four bags of drought-resistant corn seed. Drive to the planting zone labeled Field 2A, located to the west of the irrigation canal. Deliver the seed bags to the marked drop zone for the planting crew. Wait until all four seed bags are unloaded. Once the payload has been released, proceed to the livestock barn feed area and collect an empty water trough. Bring the empty trough to the pasture gate at the southern perimeter and wait for 15 minutes while the maintenance team cleans and inspects the item. After the waiting period, return to the equipment shed near the north field entrance.

Begin at the supply depot near the main gate. Travel to the seedling greenhouse at the northern corner of the property and collect five trays of young tomato plants. Deliver these trays to planting field number 4, which is situated west of the irrigation pond. Wait for the planting crew to unload the trays, which typically takes about 7 minutes. Once the unloading is confirmed, drive to the fertilizer storage barn beside the gravel road and pick up two bags of organic fertilizer. Bring the bags to the equipment calibration station near the farm offices, and stand by for further instructions from the supervisor.

Begin at the packing shed adjacent to the southeast orchard gate. Proceed to the pallet staging area near the truck depot and collect three crates of freshly harvested strawberries. Transport the strawberry crates to the refrigerated storage unit behind the processing plant. Wait for 10 minutes at the storage unit while the staff inspects and unloads the crates. After all crates have been removed, drive to the equipment locker next to the compost yard to pick up a sealed container of pruning shears. Deliver the container to the crop management kiosk in the central vineyard. Once the delivery is complete, return to the packing shed and await further instructions.

Begin at the storage shed behind the greenhouse complex. Drive to the orchard tool staging area located along the southern fence line. Pick up two crates of replacement pruning shears and a spool of irrigation tubing. Proceed to the eastern gate of the apple orchard, where the maintenance crew is assembling equipment. Deliver the crates and tubing to the crew, and wait for 8 minutes while the crew checks inventory and unloads the items. Once unloading is confirmed, head to the compost heap adjacent to the tractor barn to pick up a bin of organic waste. Transport the bin to the waste processing unit at the north end of the facility, then return to the storage shed and park near the side entrance for recharging.

Start from the maintenance garage adjacent to the east gate. Proceed to the solar panel staging area near the north boundary fence and pick up two canisters of cleaning solution. Transport the canisters to the remote solar panel array at the hilltop overlook. Wait for up to 10 minutes while the solar technicians unload the canisters. Once the unloading is complete, continue to the compost collection bay beside the equipment refueling station and pick up a sealed bin of organic waste. Deliver the organic waste bin to the compost processing site near the southwest tree line. After delivery, head back to the maintenance garage and await your next assignment.

Start at the tool depot beside the west maintenance barn. Travel to the irrigation supply shed located behind the north greenhouse and pick up a single water pump assembly. Deliver the water pump to the central aquaponics control room adjoining the main greenhouse. Wait for up to 8 minutes while the aquaponics technician installs and checks the pump. After confirmation from the technician that the installation is complete, proceed to the vehicle refueling area on the south side of the property, wait there for 3 minutes as directed, and then return to the tool depot to conclude your task.

Start at the garage adjacent to the vehicle maintenance yard. Move to the solar panel array located south of the processing plant. Pick up three boxed solar inverters waiting beside panel row C. Transport the inverters to the technical storage room in Workshop Building 1. Wait for 10 minutes or until the workshop technician has removed all the boxes from the platform. After unloading, travel to the orchard’s equipment staging area to receive further instructions.

Start at the maintenance garage on Maple Lane. Drive to the solar panel field monitoring outpost and pick up three toolboxes containing electrical inspection kits. Deliver the toolboxes to the rooftop access point of the main barn. Wait for 15 minutes while the technicians retrieve their kits. After the transfer is complete, proceed to the livestock gate near the grazing meadows and collect two sealed buckets of sheep feed. Bring the feed to the caretaker's station beside the animal shelter, then wait until all buckets have been unloaded by the caretaking staff. Once your payload is empty, return to the maintenance garage on Maple Lane and stand by in the designated parking bay for further tasks.

Start at the central maintenance hub beside the tractor shed. Drive to the seedling nursery located at the north end of the property and collect four trays of young tomato plants from the loading bench. Proceed to the vegetable plots in field section C and deliver the trays to the planting team. Wait until all trays have been unloaded by a team member. Next, proceed to the water tank refill station near the compost yard. Wait for 10 minutes to be refilled with water. After the refill, navigate to the tool storage pavilion adjacent to the harvest lane and await further instructions.

Start at the central charging station by the administration building. Proceed to the pesticide storage shed located in the southwest quadrant of the farm. Collect three sealed canisters of approved pesticide. Deliver the canisters to crop field number 9, adjacent to the southern windbreak. Wait until the field manager signals that all canisters have been unloaded, which may take up to 10 minutes. Once unloading is complete, travel to the east gate tool kiosk and pick up a box containing irrigation pipe fittings. Transport the box to the vineyard workshop on the hillside and remain there until the vineyard technician removes the fittings from your platform. After the delivery is complete, return directly to the central charging station.

Begin at the central depot near the farm entrance. Proceed to the irrigation pump house in the eastern field. Pick up a sealed container of fertilizer solution. Deliver the container to the greenhouse loading bay, west side. Wait until a horticultural assistant has unloaded the container, then continue to the northern vegetable patch to pick up empty harvest crates for reuse. Bring the empty crates back to the central depot and await further tasks.

Begin at the supply garage beside the solar power station. Drive to the eastern orchard edge storage area and pick up two bags of pruning shears and a crate of protective gloves. Deliver these supplies to the fruit sorting facility dock on the south side, and wait for workers to unload the items, which should take approximately 7 minutes. Once all items have been offloaded, proceed to the gravel turnaround lot near the old windmill and remain there for further instructions.

Start at the maintenance garage located west of the solar panel field. Drive to the fertilizer storage barn near the north pasture and pick up four sacks of organic fertilizer. Deliver the sacks to the compost blending station adjacent to the southern greenhouse. Wait until the farm crew has fully unloaded all fertilizer sacks from the robot. Once the sacks are unloaded, head to the windbreak tree line and retrieve one container of tree saplings. Transport the saplings to the orchard replanting zone at the far eastern boundary of the property. After delivery, return to the maintenance garage to conclude your shift.

Start at the tool depot next to the machine shop and navigate to the north orchard picking zone. Collect three empty harvest crates from the orchard storage shed. Deliver the empty crates to the grape arbor on the eastern slope. Wait for 10 minutes while the field crew loads harvested grapes into the crates. Once loading is finished, transport the filled crates to the refrigerated storage unit behind the produce packing facility. After all crates have been unloaded by the storage attendant, proceed to the maintenance hangar near the main driveway for battery charging.

Begin at the equipment garage adjacent to the irrigation control center. Drive to the fertilizer shed beside the south field. Pick up a pallet containing six fertilizer bags. Transport the pallet to the greenhouse entrance on the west side of the property. Wait until the greenhouse manager unloads all fertilizer bags from the robot. Once unloading is confirmed, proceed to the water tank refilling station located next to the old barn. Wait for 5 minutes while the technician checks your water dispensing system, then return to the equipment garage.

Start at the equipment charging station next to the machinery repair garage. Head to the cold storage warehouse located at the northern boundary of the property and pick up five insulated crates of harvested strawberries. Transport the strawberries to the farmers' market distribution tent just outside the main gate. Wait until market staff have completely unloaded all crates and sign off on the delivery slip, which may take up to 8 minutes. After confirmation, proceed to the field workshop behind the grain silos and collect one container filled with replacement irrigation valves. Deliver this container to the water pump station at the east end of the irrigation trench. Once the technician unloads the item, return to the equipment charging station and await your next assignment.

Begin at the packaging facility by the eastern gate. Proceed to the citrus grove and collect three harvest bins filled with oranges. Transport the bins to the cold storage room in the main warehouse. Wait for 10 minutes as the storage crew inspects and unloads the bins. After unloading is confirmed, navigate to the composting station near the north boundary to pick up an empty pallet. Bring the empty pallet to the machine shop at the central yard, then await further instructions from the equipment supervisor before heading back to the packaging facility.

Start from the warehouse loading bay. Travel to the outdoor maintenance yard near the wind turbine. Pick up the tool chest labeled 'Hydraulic Kits.' Deliver the tool chest to the machinery repair area inside the main operations building. Wait for the maintenance supervisor to remove the tool chest. Once it is unloaded, drive to the fuel depot by the service road and wait there for 15 minutes for a scheduled safety inspection.

Begin at Maintenance Hub 2 beside the main barn. Drive to the solar panel service area at the southwestern corner of the property and collect a box containing cleaning brushes and microfiber cloths. Deliver the box to the solar panel inspection station, located adjacent to the storage silo. Wait at the inspection station for 10 minutes while technicians use the supplies. Once notified by the technician, proceed to the compost yard behind Greenhouse 4 and pick up three bags of dried mulch. Deliver the bags to the orchard entrance checkpoint and wait until all bags have been offloaded before returning to Maintenance Hub 2.

Start at the spare parts depot located behind the machine workshop. Drive to the eastern orchard’s equipment bay and pick up three boxes of replacement drone rotors waiting on the service bench. Deliver the rotor boxes to the drone launch pad on the southern slope of the orchard. Wait for the drone technician to unload all packages from the robot. Once unloaded, proceed to the staff picnic shelter near the artificial pond and pick up any leftover recycling bags collected after lunch. Transport the recycling bags to the recycling center at the northwestern fence line. After dropping off the bags, immediately return to the spare parts depot and await further task assignments.

Start at the logistics hub adjacent to the main entrance. Proceed to the packaging area beside the orchard and pick up three crates of freshly packed pears. Travel to the refrigerated storage unit near the crop processing facility and deliver the crates. Once delivered, wait until warehouse staff finish inspecting and documenting the delivery, which may take up to 12 minutes. After the inspection is complete, go to the maintenance shed south of the greenhouses, pick up a box containing replacement tools, and carry it to the barnyard workshop for the repair crew. Once the box is unloaded, proceed to return to the logistics hub and stand by for further instructions.

Begin at the equipment bay near the machinery garage. Proceed to the loading dock behind the supply warehouse and pick up two sacks of livestock feed and one plastic container of grain supplement. Deliver the feed and supplement to the animal holding pens located to the north of the main stable. Wait until the caretaker has unloaded all items from your cargo area, which may take up to 5 minutes. Once unloading is confirmed, travel to the composting site adjacent to the orchard’s east entrance. Pick up any empty fertilizer bins found on the sorting platform and transport them to the cleaning station beside the farm workshop. When all bins have been offloaded by the cleaning crew, return to the equipment bay near the machinery garage and stand by for further assignment.

Begin at the central logistics hub near the southwest loading ramp. Proceed to the vineyard's storage shed next to the irrigation pond and collect two sealed crates of grape fertilizer. Deliver the fertilizer crates to the vineyard maintenance outpost under the old oak tree. Wait until a supervisor confirms receipt and signs off on the delivery. Next, head to the greenhouse annex located beyond the main gravel path and retrieve a single box of spare seedling trays. Bring the seedling trays to the propagation room inside the main greenhouse and wait for 10 minutes while staff unload the box. Once finished, return to the central logistics hub and stand by for the next assignment.

Begin at the equipment storage yard adjacent to the west orchard. Travel to the irrigation control center near the south pond and collect two containers of water treatment tablets. Deliver the containers to the pump station at the northern wheat field. Wait until all tablets are removed by the field engineer. Next, proceed to the central packing house and collect a single crate filled with harvested carrots. Transport the crate to the cold storage facility at the far eastern edge of the farm. Stand by for 12 minutes while cooling staff inspect and transfer the carrots. After these procedures are complete, return to the equipment storage yard and await additional instructions.

Start at the vineyard control post adjacent to the southern entrance. Travel to the solar panel maintenance yard located behind the technical shed and pick up a crate containing replacement inverters. Deliver the crate to the mobile power unit near the irrigation lagoon, and wait until the technician retrieves all inverters. After the payload is unloaded, drive to the packing house next to the fruit sorting line. Collect three empty harvest baskets and take them to the berry field’s western edge. Once the baskets have been placed at the collection point, return directly to the vineyard control post and await the next directive.

Start at the main supply depot located beside the maintenance garage. Drive to the livestock feed shelter on the southern pasture and pick up four sealed bags of feed supplement. Deliver the feed bags to the outdoor feeding station adjacent to the dairy barn. Wait until the barn supervisor signals that the bags have been fully offloaded. Then, proceed to the solar charging station near the windbreak grove and remain docked for 8 minutes to allow battery recharging before your next assignment.

Begin at the equipment garage adjacent to the supply warehouse. Drive to the eastern apple orchard near the riverbank and pick up three crates of harvested apples from under the shade canopy. Deliver the apple crates to the cold storage facility on the north side of the property. Wait for the storage technician to complete the unloading process. After delivery, proceed to the compost processing site beside the field station and collect a bag of organic compost. Transport the compost bag to the rooftop vegetable garden above the administration building and wait for 5 minutes while the gardening team collects the bag from the robot. Once your load is empty, return to the equipment garage to complete the task.

Start at the equipment garage behind the east parking lot. Drive to the timber storage area near the north entrance and pick up a pallet of treated lumber and three buckets of exterior wood stain. Transport the load to the construction staging grounds beside the livestock shelter. Wait until the construction crew verifies the delivery and removes the pallet and buckets. Once emptied, proceed to the farm supply depot situated by the gravel road entrance, pick up two 50-pound bags of chicken feed, and deliver them to the poultry barn located at the far western boundary. After confirming the bags are unloaded, return to the equipment garage and park in the designated electric charging bay.

Start at the logistics hub adjacent to the administration office. Drive to the pesticide storage shed near the southern greenhouse and collect four sealed containers of organic pest control solution. Deliver the containers to the crop trial plots behind the test laboratory. Wait for 10 minutes while the research team unloads the pesticide containers and records the delivery. Once unloading is complete, proceed to the tool calibration workshop next to the fuel station and pick up a toolbox labeled 'Sensor Maintenance Kit.' Transport the kit to the wind turbine control cabin located on the western ridge of the property. Stand by for 7 minutes to support the maintenance crew with further supply requests before returning to the logistics hub and await the next assignment.

Begin at the west warehouse near the perimeter security gate. Travel to the irrigation pump house at the edge of the northern cornfield and collect two replacement pump filters. Transport the filters to the well station at the eastern fenceline. Wait until the maintenance operator collects and installs the filters. Then, proceed to the packaging pavilion adjacent to the fruit loading area and pick up a single crate of packaged strawberries. Deliver the crate to the cold storage chamber inside the main produce distribution center, and stand by until a worker completes the inventory scan of the delivery before returning to the west warehouse to await your next task.

Begin at the logistics garage next to the main access road. Drive to the orchard storage shed situated by the northern treeline to collect two crates of replacement tree stakes. Transport the crates to Orchard Block D, stopping at the southern boundary near the young sapling rows. Wait for the field crew to unload both crates from the robot. After the crates have been offloaded, proceed to the central machine shop to pick up a sealed carton of spare hydraulic fittings. Deliver the carton to the repair bay at the machinery barn and wait for the technician to unload the package. Conclude the task by returning to the logistics garage.

Begin at the maintenance garage and travel to the spare parts storage area behind the machinery shed. Pick up one crate containing replacement belts and three boxes of assorted bolts. Transport these items to the tractor repair bay located adjacent to the fueling zone. Wait until the mechanics have unloaded all the parts from your platform. After the delivery is complete and your platform is cleared, proceed to the southern entrance of the equipment yard and wait there for 10 minutes for further instructions from the field supervisor.

Proceed to the orchard equipment garage and pick up one crate of replacement pruning tools. Drive to the northern apple orchard and deliver the crate to the designated tool drop-off point. Wait for the orchard crew to remove all pruning tools from the robot. After unloading, continue east to the chemical storage cabin and collect two sealed containers of pest repellent. Transport the containers to the south vineyard entrance, where a technician will meet you. Wait for 10 minutes for the technician to unload and inspect the containers before returning to the orchard equipment garage for the next assignment.

Begin at the maintenance shed beside the windbreak trees. Proceed to the packing station near the orchard’s edge and collect two crates of harvested pears. Deliver the crates to the cold storage facility located behind the farm market store. Wait for up to 10 minutes while the staff inspects and approves the crates for storage. After the crates are accepted and unloaded, return to the maintenance shed and prepare for the next assignment.

Start at the southwest tool depot adjacent to the irrigation pond. Proceed to the solar panel array situated along the west perimeter fence. Pick up three boxes of cleaning supplies prepared by the maintenance staff. Drive these supplies to the control shed next to the wind turbine field. Wait until a technician unloads all the boxes. Afterwards, head to the seed storage barn at the northern boundary of the property and pick up a pallet loaded with seed bags. Deliver this pallet to the planting crew at Plot 5 near the orchard entrance. Once the pallet is fully unloaded by the crew, return to the southwest tool depot and stand by for the next task.

Start at the maintenance garage near the east gate. Drive to the storage container beside Irrigation Pump Station 4, and pick up two coiled hoses and a plastic toolbox. Deliver these items to the crop testing plots adjacent to the northern wind turbines. Wait until you receive confirmation from the field technician that all items have been unloaded—estimated wait time: 6 minutes. Afterward, proceed to the farm office porch, where you will pick up a stack of empty produce crates. Transport the crates to the berry washing area outside the packing barn, then return to the maintenance garage and wait for 5 minutes before completing the task.

Begin at the maintenance garage located next to the main barn and navigate to the spare parts depot behind the greenhouse. Pick up two heavy-duty tractor batteries. Deliver the batteries to the workshop tent beside the north orchard. Wait until the mechanics have unloaded the batteries, which should take approximately 7 minutes. Afterwards, proceed to the fenced livestock enclosure and collect a single feed supply crate. Transport the crate to the animal care station south of the pond before returning to the maintenance garage to stand by for further instructions.

Start at the parking area outside the machinery barn. Navigate to the irrigation control shed on the northern field edge to collect two boxes of replacement water filters. Transport these boxes to the main reservoir pump station beside the willow grove. Wait until the maintenance personnel confirm the boxes have been offloaded, then proceed to the fertilizer storage bay behind the equipment depot. Pick up a sealed drum of organic fertilizer. Deliver the drum to the composting facility loading zone, located east of the main planting rows. Wait for five minutes while supervisors inspect the delivery, then return to the parking area outside the machinery barn for further instructions.

Begin at the equipment garage adjacent to the main office. Travel to the southwest irrigation pump station and pick up two sealed water analysis sample containers. Proceed to the laboratory receiving dock at the northeast corner of the research building. Deliver the sample containers to the laboratory technician. Wait for the technician to confirm receipt and sign off, which may take up to 7 minutes. After confirmation, return directly to the equipment garage and stand by for your next assignment.

Drive to the orchard’s north gate and collect three bins of freshly harvested pears. Deliver these bins to the packing barn and wait while workers unload them. Once empty, proceed to the pesticide storage shed on the east farm road, pick up a sealed container of agricultural chemicals, and transport it to the greenhouse entrance. Wait for the on-site technician to remove the container, then drive to the vehicle refueling station near the equipment barn and stand by for 8 minutes before returning to the orchard’s north gate.

Start at the maintenance garage next to the orchard entrance. Drive to the tool storage shed by the south greenhouse and collect three mechanical toolboxes. Transport the toolboxes to the machinery repair bay inside the east wing of the main processing building. Wait up to 8 minutes for the repair crew to offload all toolboxes. Once offloaded, proceed to the irrigation pump station at the far west corner of the property. Wait there until a technician loads a single sealed case containing replacement pump valves onto the robot. Deliver the case to the central control room on the upper level of the admin building, and wait until an operator removes it. Finally, return to the maintenance garage and stand by for new instructions.

Begin at the supply depot near the east gate. Drive to the orchard tool shed and pick up two crates of pruning shears and a bundle of protective netting. Deliver these items to the northern apple orchard near Row 12. Wait for workers to unload all items, then continue to the nearby composting area, retrieve one sealed bag of collected organic waste, and bring it to the bio-recycling station by the equipment workshop. After delivery, wait for 15 minutes in case further transport of materials is requested.

Begin at the machinery garage near the eastern field. Drive to the fertilizer storage shed located beside the irrigation reservoir. Pick up three sealed bags of organic fertilizer. Proceed to the west cornfield entrance. Wait for field technicians to unload all fertilizer bags from your platform—this may take up to 7 minutes. After unloading is confirmed, travel to the maintenance workshop and await further instructions.

Start at the eastern tool depot beside the machine hangar. Proceed to the solar panel maintenance lot located south of the central roadway and pick up a toolbox labeled 'Electrical Repairs'. Deliver the toolbox to the remote pump station at the edge of the southern field. Wait for 8 minutes while the technician completes the scheduled maintenance. Once the toolbox is returned to your payload bay, transport it back to the eastern tool depot and await further loading instructions.

Begin at the machinery garage adjacent to the main entrance. Travel to the seed storage bunker located south of the equipment yard. Retrieve four sacks of sunflower seeds from the storage racks. Transport the sacks to the eastern plot seeding zone near the old windmill. Wait until the farm operator has unloaded all four sacks, which should not exceed 12 minutes. Then, proceed to the maintenance workshop next to the barn to collect an empty oil drum. Deliver the empty drum to the utility shed behind the solar panel array. Upon successful handoff, return to the machinery garage.

Navigate from the equipment garage near the eucalyptus grove to the hydroponic greenhouse at the northwest corner of the property. Collect two sealed nutrient solution containers and one small crate of replacement drip nozzles. Drive to the irrigation control center next to the berry patch and deliver the nutrient solution containers. Wait until the staff has unloaded both containers from your bay. Then, proceed directly to the orchard tool shed and drop off the crate of replacement drip nozzles. Once the delivery is complete, return to the equipment garage and await further instructions.

Start at the logistics hub next to the south parking lot and proceed to the chemical storage building on the west side of the farm. Pick up two sealed containers of fertilizer from the loading platform. Transport the containers to the irrigation control station near Field 7. After delivering the containers, wait until they are removed by the field technician. Once the payload is confirmed unloaded, travel to the greenhouse annex, collect a carton of seed trays, and deliver these to the nursery staging area adjacent to the north entrance. When the seed trays are offloaded, stand by for 5 minutes before returning to the logistics hub for further tasks.

Proceed to the livestock feed storage silo located east of the main barn and collect one pallet of bagged feed. Deliver the pallet to the cattle shelter adjacent to the north pasture. On arrival, wait until the feed supervisor inspects and unloads the pallet, which may take up to 12 minutes. Once unloading is complete, drive to the compost collection point near the equipment yard and pick up two bins of compost material. Transport the compost bins to the organic field treatment area on the western edge of the property, drop them off, then return to the central charging station near the operations office for your next assignment.

Head to the chemical storage barn near the northern windbreak and collect three sealed canisters of fertilizer. Deliver these canisters to the drip irrigation filling point by the south vineyard entrance. Wait until all three canisters are removed by the field crew. Afterward, proceed to the packing house porch just west of the root vegetable sorting shed and pick up a box of safety gloves. Transport the box to the greenhouse entry corridor. Wait for 15 minutes at the corridor for greenhouse staff to collect the gloves. Once completed, drive to the shade shelter next to the east field entrance gate and remain there on standby.

Start at the main equipment shed adjacent to the east orchards. Drive to the pesticide storage unit beside the central barn. Pick up four sealed chemical canisters and a crate of protective gloves. Transport these items to the field operations tent located at the edge of the northern wheat field. After delivering the supplies, wait at the tent for the field supervisor to inspect and confirm the delivery. Once confirmation is received, continue to the fuel station behind the barn and wait there for 5 minutes for possible refueling orders.

Begin at the logistics hub on the northeast corner of the distribution center. Navigate to the greenhouse complex by the central irrigation canal and pick up four trays of seedling tomato plants. Deliver the trays to the horticulture research lab located behind the administration offices. Wait for 7 minutes while researchers verify and unload the seedlings. Once the trays are removed, proceed to the mechanical shed next to the fuel storage tanks and collect a box containing replacement hydraulic hoses. Deliver the box to the tractor maintenance bay adjacent to the main vehicle garage. After the delivery, return to the logistics hub and wait for further deployment.

Begin at the north warehouse and pick up four sealed cartons containing packaging materials. Drive to the open-air loading dock adjacent to the farmers' market pavilion and deliver the cartons to the market coordinator. Wait up to 8 minutes for staff to offload the packaging materials from your platform. Once the offloading is complete, proceed to the machine maintenance lot at the southeast corner of the property. There, collect two used hydraulic pumps that require repairs. Transport the pumps to the service workshop located next to the large solar array, and wait until the maintenance team removes them from your payload bay. Finally, travel to the central parking courtyard and await further assignment in standby mode.

Start at the logistics hub situated near the northern parking lot. Drive to the fertilizer storage shed behind the equipment depot and pick up four sealed bags of granulated fertilizer. Deliver the fertilizer bags to the crop processing pavilion at the west edge of Field B, where the planting crew is preparing for distribution. Wait for all fertilizer bags to be unloaded by the crew. Once the payload has been delivered, proceed to the fuel refilling station at the eastern service lane and wait for 10 minutes for routine safety inspections. After the inspection is complete, return to the logistics hub to complete the task.

Start by traveling to the fertilizer storage bunker located behind the greenhouse. Collect three sealed containers of liquid fertilizer, ensuring they are securely loaded onto the robot. Then, proceed to the irrigation control outpost at the north edge of the carrot field and deliver the fertilizer containers to the field technician present. Wait until all three containers have been removed. Next, head to the solar equipment charging station and remain docked for 12 minutes to recharge batteries. Upon completion, navigate to the spare parts shelter adjacent to the machinery lot and await loading with a box of hydraulic hoses before returning to the initial launch pad.

Start at the maintenance depot adjacent to the west field entrance. Proceed to the vine trellis section by the eastern boundary and pick up three crates of harvested grapes. Deliver the loaded crates to the wine processing bay at the rear of the storage warehouse. After delivery, wait while the crates are removed—this may take up to 10 minutes. Once unloaded, head to the tool sanitation station located next to the composting area and collect any empty cleaning solution canisters. Transport the empty canisters to the hazard waste collection point behind the machinery shed before returning to the maintenance depot for your next assignment.

Start at the warehouse south entrance. Travel to the windbreak grove and pick up two containers of organic fertilizer. Proceed to the north field boundary and deliver the fertilizer containers to the crop treatment crew. Wait on site for 10 minutes while the containers are emptied. Once both containers have been unloaded, drive to the supply depot near the water tower and collect a single crate of irrigation filters. Transport the crate to the pump station beside the east reservoir. After delivering the crate, return to the warehouse south entrance and stand by for the next assignment.

Begin at the machinery bay adjacent to the fabrication workshop. Navigate to the pallet storage area in the western yard and pick up two crates of hydraulic fittings. Deliver the crates to the assembly line staging zone halfway down the main production corridor. Wait for assembly staff to remove both crates from your loading tray. Once unloaded, proceed to the composting site near the windbreak grove and retrieve one sealed barrel of processed compost. Bring the barrel to the greenhouse annex entrance, just south of the main greenhouse, and wait 10 minutes for the horticulture crew to unload it. After this, return to the machinery bay by the fabrication workshop.

Start at the south gate storage area near the main access trail. Travel to the compost yard by the orchard’s southern edge and pick up four sacks of organic mulch. Deliver the sacks to the vegetable patch next to the irrigation pond. Wait until the farmhands have removed all the mulch from the robot. Next, proceed to the machine barn at the western fence line and collect a boxed replacement belt for the conveyor system. Take the boxed belt to the packaging center beside the gravel loading dock and wait 6 minutes for the technicians to complete their inspection. Once the delivery is complete, return to the south gate storage area and await further instructions.

Start at the hay storage barn beside the livestock enclosure. Drive to the equipment supply shed at the east edge of the farm and pick up two new water pumps. Deliver the water pumps to the irrigation control room next to Field Plot 2. Wait for 5 minutes while the pumps are inspected and unloaded by the technician. After delivery, proceed to the wash station across from Greenhouse 1 and wait there until the robot is hosed down and cleared for further operations. Then return to the hay storage barn and await your next assignment.

Start at the maintenance garage located behind the solar panel array. Travel to the vineyard packing station near the southern field and pick up four crates of harvested grapes. Deliver the grape crates to the fermentation warehouse adjacent to the irrigation reservoir. Wait until the warehouse manager unloads all crates. Once unloaded, proceed to the storage shed by the eastern windbreak and collect a spare water pump. Deliver the water pump to the irrigation control hut at the center of the property, then await further instructions.

Start at the supply depot near the central water tower. Drive to the greenhouse on the southeast corner of the property and pick up a single box of seed trays. Deliver the box to the planting crew at the field gate by the irrigation channel. Wait while the planting crew unloads the seed trays, which should take no more than 8 minutes. Afterward, proceed to the machinery shed adjacent to the compost heap, retrieve three spare hydraulic hoses, and bring them to the maintenance platform at the south field edge, leaving them near the tool cabinet before returning to the supply depot.

Begin at the maintenance garage next to the equipment shelter. Proceed to the packing shed located south of the nursery beds. Pick up two pallets of boxed strawberries from the loading platform. Transport both pallets to the refrigerated storage vault adjacent to the main produce market. Wait for 7 minutes while the pallets are unloaded and the return paperwork is prepared. Once unloaded, collect a small crate of replacement packaging materials from the vault and deliver it to the packing shed. After the crate has been removed, return to the maintenance garage and stand by for your next assignment.

Begin at the parts storage shed beside the eastern equipment depot. Navigate to the tractor fueling station near the southern field gate and pick up two sealed containers of diesel fuel. Deliver the containers to the repair bay inside the machinery workshop at the western facility edge. Wait until technicians have completely unloaded the fuel containers from your platform. Then, proceed to the tool calibration area located behind the fertilizer silo and wait for 12 minutes to allow a technician to recalibrate your lifting arms. Finally, return to the parts storage shed and stand by for your next deployment.

Begin at the equipment shed near the north gate. Drive to the fertilizer storage silo beside the irrigation reservoir and pick up two sealed barrels of liquid fertilizer. Transport these barrels to the tomato plot entrance at Field 5W. Wait until the field crew has unloaded both barrels, which should take about 7 minutes. After unloading is complete, proceed to the spare parts depot by the west service road, collect a package containing replacement hose fittings, and deliver it to the drip irrigation control station south of the tractor parking lot. Upon delivery, wait for 3 minutes for confirmation of receipt before returning to the equipment shed.

Begin at the north equipment depot. Drive to the greenhouse loading area next to the irrigation pond. Collect 4 crates of tomato seedlings and one sealed bag of fertilizer. Proceed to Field Plot C, located west of the orchard. Wait for up to 20 minutes while farm staff unload the seedlings and fertilizer. Once all items are removed, travel to the compost center and drop off any empty crates. End your route at the charging station in the central courtyard.

Begin at the equipment garage next to the east vineyard. Proceed to the north orchard and collect one large battery pack from the charging station. Transport the battery pack to the irrigation control hut by the river. Wait until the technician swaps out the old battery for the new one, which should take about 12 minutes. Once the swap is complete and the spent battery has been loaded onto you, return the spent battery to the equipment garage. Wait there until the maintenance supervisor inspects and removes the spent battery.

Start at the equipment parking lot next to the main entrance. Proceed to the irrigation supply depot and pick up a pallet of drip-line fittings. Transport and deliver the pallet to the north vineyard’s tool staging area. Wait at the staging area for the vineyard supervisor to unload the pallet, remaining on standby for up to 8 minutes. After the pallet is unloaded, drive to the central administration building and pick up a sealed box containing important soil analysis kits. Bring the box to the remote soil testing station near the southwest boundary. Once the box has been delivered, return to the equipment parking lot.

Begin at the main storage warehouse near the northern entrance. Proceed to the western machinery workshop to pick up one large toolbox and three sealed lubricant canisters. Deliver these items to the tractor parking area situated behind the produce receiving dock. Wait for the mechanics to unload all items from your platform. Once unloading is complete, continue to the irrigation pond access gate and collect any empty chemical containers left by the maintenance staff. Return the empty containers to the hazardous materials storage shed on the southeast corner of the property. After delivery, remain at the shed for 10 minutes awaiting possible additional collection tasks.

Begin at the equipment depot adjacent to the west paddock. Travel to the solar panel field at the northern edge of the property and collect one crate of replacement solar cells. Proceed to the central operations tent and deliver the crate to the electrical maintenance crew. Wait nearby until the crew confirms they have unloaded all solar cells, then collect any faulty or broken solar panels they have set aside for disposal. Transport the faulty panels to the recycling shed located next to the main farm entrance. After completion, drive to the fuel station by the tractor path and recharge batteries for 10 minutes before returning to the equipment depot.

Begin at the machine depot situated south of the storage silos. Proceed to the irrigation equipment locker beside the north field access gate and collect two coiled hoses and a box of water pressure gauges. Travel to the pump monitoring station next to the central reservoir. Wait until the maintenance supervisor finishes inspecting and removes the box of gauges. Deliver the remaining hoses to the greenhouse utility shed on the eastern boundary. Once the hoses are delivered, return to the machine depot and remain on standby for further directives.

Start at the seed storage unit next to the greenhouse. Proceed to the central irrigation control station and pick up a sealed water quality testing kit and three empty sample flasks. Travel to the southern rice paddy margin and wait for the agronomist to collect and load soil samples into the flasks. Once the samples are loaded, carry all flasks and the sealed testing kit to the laboratory entrance located beside the main office. Deliver the items to the lab staff and wait for 10 minutes in case additional materials need to be transported. After waiting, return to the seed storage unit and stand by for further tasks.

Begin at the maintenance garage located near the central workshop. Travel to the field equipment depot on the north side of the agricultural plots and collect two full containers of fertilizer pellets. Deliver the containers to the crop duster loading station situated by the western service road. Wait until the station operator has fully unloaded both containers, which may take up to 15 minutes. After the containers are emptied, proceed to the vineyard storage barn, pick up any spare irrigation valves awaiting transport, and carry them back to the maintenance garage to complete the task.

Start at the operations garage adjacent to the main entry road. Drive to the orchard tool shed located at the western treeline to pick up three empty crate stacks and a set of pruning shears. Deliver the crates to the fruit packing station near the southern loading bay. Wait for 10 minutes while harvesters load the crates with apples. Once loaded, transport the filled crates to the cold storage facility behind the processing plant. Return the pruning shears to the orchard tool shed, then proceed back to the operations garage and await further instructions.

Start at the greenhouse supply depot and collect four trays of seedling pots. Deliver the trays to the north edge of the experimental field. Wait until the planting team has finished unloading all trays, which should take about 8 minutes. Then proceed to the packing shed, retrieve two baskets of harvested tomatoes, and transport them to the farm market stall at the front gate. Wait until the stall attendant has offloaded the baskets before returning to the greenhouse supply depot.

Travel to the greenhouse storage shed and pick up three containers of liquid fertilizer. Deliver the fertilizer containers to the irrigation control hub next to the west vineyard. Wait for 10 minutes while the irrigation manager distributes the fertilizer. Once the containers are emptied, collect any empty canisters and transport them to the cleaning station in the utility garage. After dropping off the empty canisters, proceed to the supply depot and stand by for 8 minutes awaiting further loading instructions.

Start at the north gate equipment bay. Drive to the citrus orchard on the eastern slope and collect three crates of harvested lemons stacked under the shelter. Transport the crates to the cold storage facility adjacent to the packing house. Wait until a staff member removes all the crates, with a maximum waiting time of 8 minutes. Once unloaded, travel to the tool depot beside the irrigation control room and pick up a toolbox labeled 'Field Repair Kit.' Deliver the toolbox to the tractor parking area near the gravel turnaround, and wait there until the toolbox has been collected. Afterwards, proceed to the rest area under the oak trees and stand by for 5 minutes before returning to the north gate equipment bay.

Drive to the southwest gate composting yard and pick up four empty wooden pallets stacked near the loading ramp. Transport the pallets to the warehouse annex beside the packaging facility. Wait until all four pallets have been unloaded by the receiving crew. Once unloading is confirmed, proceed to the well house by the central irrigation pond and wait there for 10 minutes before returning to the charging bay at the south parking lot.

Begin at the harvest crate depot and drive to the central orchard entrance. Collect seven empty harvest bins from the designated pickup zone. Deliver the bins to the apple grove loading area on the west side of the orchard. Wait until all bins have been removed from your platform by the harvest team. Once unloaded, proceed to the equipment service shed and remain there for 6 minutes to allow the maintenance crew to perform a quick check. Afterward, return to the harvest crate depot to await further tasks.

Start at the maintenance depot adjacent to the solar panel field. Proceed to the fertilizer storage facility on the west side of the property to collect three sacks of organic fertilizer. Deliver the sacks to Greenhouse 2, located behind the irrigation reservoir. Upon arrival, wait for the greenhouse attendant to unload all sacks. Once unloaded, travel to Seed Sorting Area C to retrieve a pallet of labeled seed trays. Transport the seed trays to the garden supply drop-off point near the caretaker's cottage. After confirming delivery, head to the maintenance depot to complete the cycle.

Start at the main equipment garage located beside the field entrance. Drive to the greenhouse supply depot and collect three irrigation hose reels. Deliver the hose reels to the east greenhouse maintenance entrance. Wait for 8 minutes while the greenhouse crew unloads the reels. After unloading, proceed to the southwest compost area and pick up any empty chemical canisters stacked by the access gate. Transport the empty canisters to the hazardous materials storage shed next to the water tower. Once the canisters are dropped off, return to the equipment garage and stand by until further notice.

Start at the main farm office adjacent to the visitor parking lot. Travel to the irrigation supplies shed at the south field edge and pick up four coiled hoses. Deliver the hoses to the north orchard irrigation station. Wait for the orchard team to connect and install the hoses, which should take approximately 7 minutes. Once the hoses have been installed, proceed to the solar-panel maintenance yard at the eastern boundary and collect a toolbox. Bring the toolbox to the wind turbine inspection site halfway up the eastern hill, and wait there until a technician unloads it. After successful delivery, return to the main farm office.

Head to the pallet staging area beside the west barn and pick up two pallets of animal feed. Deliver the feed pallets to the livestock enclosure near the south pasture gate and wait until the caretakers have emptied both pallets from your platform. Once empty, proceed to the machinery depot located next to the solar charging station to collect a box of spare mower blades. Transport the box to the field repair zone, situated at the northwest corner of the hay meadow, and wait 5 minutes for the maintenance crew to retrieve the mower blades. After this, return to the equipment parking lot adjacent to the main storage warehouse and await docking instructions.

Begin at the maintenance garage near the operations office. Drive to the north orchard equipment shed and collect one crate of replacement pruning shears. Head to the apricot grove on the eastern slope and deliver the crate to the supply tent. Wait for 5 minutes while the field crew retrieves the shears. Once your platform is empty, proceed to the irrigation canal bridge and pick up a set of water quality test kits from the designated pick-up table. Transport the test kits to the science lab trailer by the west pond, and wait there until a laboratory technician confirms receipt of the kits. After confirmation, navigate back to the maintenance garage to complete your route.

Start at the tool storage shed near Orchard Lane. Proceed to the irrigation equipment dock and pick up three sealed pesticide canisters. Deliver the canisters to the crop maintenance station beside Greenhouse 2. Wait at the station for the crew to offload all canisters and load a set of empty water collection bins onto the robot. After the bins are secured, transport them to the rainfall measurement outpost beyond the north vineyard. Upon arrival, wait for 7 minutes while meteorology staff calibrate the bins and remove them from the robot. Once complete, return directly to the tool storage shed.

Start at the west gate of the materials yard. Proceed to the compost heap behind the greenhouse and pick up a brown sack containing collected plant trimmings. Transport the sack to the animal feed storage hut adjacent to the dairy barn. Wait for 5 minutes while the staff member unloads the sack for sorting. Next, drive to the irrigation pump house at the edge of the southern field and pick up a box of replacement water filters. Deliver the box to the maintenance room inside the machine hall. Once the filters are handed over, return to the materials yard via the west gate.

Begin at the pallet staging area adjacent to the main storage barn. Proceed to the solar panel maintenance zone just past the eastern hedge and pick up two sealed boxes containing electrical connectors. Transport the boxes to the remote monitoring outpost at the edge of the south pasture. Wait up to 10 minutes at the outpost for the field engineer to unload both boxes. After the engineer confirms unloading, proceed to the supply tent near the livestock shelter, collect a small container of lubricant, and deliver it back to the pallet staging area. Do not wait at the final destination after delivery; resume standard routing.

Start from the logistics hub adjacent to the main farm office. Drive to the harvest staging area on the south end of Orchard Lane and pick up three crates of freshly picked apples. Deliver the crates to the cold storage chamber next to Greenhouse 2 and wait for the cold storage attendant to scan and unload all crates, which should take approximately 10 minutes. Once unloaded, proceed to the tool exchange kiosk near the composting zone to collect a box of pruning shears. Take the box to the vineyard overlook station on the hillside, and wait for the viticulture supervisor to remove the box before returning to the logistics hub.

Begin at the maintenance garage next to the east workshop. Travel to the solar array field control shed located beyond the southern gate. Pick up three replacement inverters and a coil of high-voltage cable. Deliver these items to the operations platform on the western end of the solar panels. Wait until the maintenance technicians have unloaded all equipment from the robot. Once emptied, move to the spare parts tent near the vehicle charging station. Collect a crate containing assorted fasteners and deliver it to the storage alcove under the turbine maintenance tower. Remain at the alcove for 5 minutes after unloading, then return to the maintenance garage for further tasks.

Navigate to the machinery shed situated by the southwest field and pick up an empty pesticide sprayer tank along with a set of protective gloves. Deliver both items to the field workshop next to grain silo number three. Wait until the workshop attendant has unloaded the gloves and tank from your platform. Next, proceed to the refrigerated storage unit behind the packing house and collect two crates of freshly harvested strawberries. Transport these crates to the farmers’ market delivery dock and wait for 15 minutes to allow market staff to unload the produce. Once unloading is complete, return to the machinery shed to complete your task.

Start at the logistics garage and travel to the solar panel field on the southern slope. Load four boxes of replacement inverters from the maintenance supply tent. Deliver the boxes to the main control kiosk near the center of the solar array. Wait for 12 minutes while the engineering crew swaps out the inverters and returns the empty packaging onto your platform. Once the empty boxes are loaded, proceed to the equipment recycling center beside the vehicle entrance. Unload all empty boxes and then return to the logistics garage to await additional assignments.

Start from the main garage located next to the maintenance office. Proceed to the solar field on the western slope and collect three cases of photovoltaic cleaning supplies stacked near the onsite storage locker. Deliver these cases to the central irrigation control hub near the windbreak grove. Wait for up to 12 minutes as technical staff offload the cleaning supplies. After delivery, continue to the composting area north of the orchard, pick up all bagged compostable waste, and transport it to the recycling center at the southwest boundary. Once the waste bags have been emptied by facility personnel, return to the main garage and await further instructions.

Begin at the storage hangar next to the administrative office. Head over to the pesticide depot situated between the southern fields and the equipment barn. Pick up one sealed canister of bio-safe pesticide. Proceed to Vineyard Parcel 12 and deliver the canister to the vineyard supervisor. Wait for 20 minutes while the supervisor applies the pesticide and returns the empty canister to the robot. Once the empty canister is on board, drive to the hazardous materials containment area at the eastern boundary and drop off the used canister. Then, make your way to the energy charging station near the water reservoir to recharge before your next task.

Begin at the produce loading dock adjacent to the onion field. Proceed to the cold storage container near the east orchard and pick up two crates of harvested apples. Transport the crates to the juice processing barn located beside the windbreak row. Wait until the processing crew has unloaded the crates, allowing up to 10 minutes for unloading. Once the delivery is complete, drive to the tool depot behind the old greenhouse and pick up a box of replacement pruning shears. Deliver the shears to the vineyard maintenance crew working at Row 12. Wait to be unloaded, then return to the produce loading dock.

Proceed to the warehouse loading dock near the northern fence and pick up three crates of spare irrigation nozzles. Deliver the crates to the drip system maintenance area in the southwest corner of the crop fields. Wait until the field technician confirms the delivery has been received. Once confirmation is received, make your way to the solar panel lot behind the equipment shed and collect a box of cleaning brushes. Deliver the cleaning brushes to the maintenance crew working on the greenhouse rooftop access platform and wait for 10 minutes while they unload the supplies. After all items are removed from your platform, return to the warehouse loading dock and await further instructions.

Begin at the central dispatch hub located next to the site office. Proceed to the materials storage yard behind the manufacturing facility and collect three sealed containers of industrial lubricants. Deliver these containers to the conveyor belt maintenance zone on the northwest side of the facility. Wait up to 8 minutes for the maintenance team to unload all containers. After unloading is complete, continue to the battery charging station adjacent to the admin building and remain there until further directions are provided.

Begin at the battery recharge station near the north greenhouse. Proceed to the fertilizer storage silo adjacent to the east barn and retrieve four 25-kg sacks of mineral fertilizer. Transport the fertilizer to the citrus grove distribution point. Wait for 10 minutes while the orchard team offloads the sacks. After unloading is complete, continue to the pump house at the southwest field boundary, collect a single spare irrigation valve, and deliver it promptly to the central service depot for inspection. Once the valve has been received by a technician, return to the battery recharge station and await further instruction.

Begin at the supply depot located near the main gate. Drive to the orchard's east edge, where the temporary harvest station is set up. Pick up four crates of freshly picked pears. Transport the pears to the cooling container at the packing shed entrance. Wait for the packing team to unload all crates, which should take approximately 7 minutes. Once empty, proceed to the chemical storage bunker behind the old silo and collect two sealed bottles of equipment cleaner. Deliver these bottles to the machinery maintenance zone adjacent to the south tractor garage. Wait until a supervisor removes both bottles, then return to the supply depot for your next assignment.

Begin at the main entrance of the maintenance facility adjacent to the central courtyard. Drive to the windbreak orchard edge and pick up three rolls of shade netting stacked by the irrigation pump house. Transport the netting to the greenhouse complex at the west end of the property and deliver it to the supply bay. Wait there for 10 minutes while greenhouse staff inspect and unload the netting. Afterwards, proceed to the manure composting site near the old tractor barn and retrieve a sealed container of composting accelerant. Deliver the container to the compost mixing zone at the southern fields, and await confirmation from the crew chief before departing. Once the container is confirmed as received, return to the maintenance facility to complete your assignment.

Start from the main garage adjacent to the packing house. Move to the chemical storage bunker and retrieve two sealed containers of plant nutrient solution. Deliver both containers to the aquaponics greenhouse on the western lot. Wait outside the greenhouse for 6 minutes until a staff member unloads the containers. Once unloaded, proceed to the tractor maintenance yard to pick up any used oil filters collected by the mechanics. Take these used filters to the hazardous waste collection point at the far end of the property. Deposit the filters in the correct disposal bin, then return to the main garage and stand by for further instructions.

Begin at the maintenance workshop adjacent to the solar panels. Proceed to the equipment storage yard and pick up three replacement hydraulic hoses. Transport the hoses to the combine repair zone located next to the western wheat field. Wait until the repair crew removes the hoses from the robot. After unloading, travel to the orchard gate and collect a crate of spare drone batteries. Deliver the crate to the drone charging station near the northern orchard boundary. Once the crate is unloaded by the drone team, return to the maintenance workshop.

Begin at the vehicle charging station located near the northwest gate. Proceed to the apple orchard picking area and collect four empty produce bins stacked beside the storage shed. Transport the bins to the fruit harvest zone at the orchard’s eastern edge, where the picking crew is working. Wait at this location for 20 minutes to allow the crew to fill the bins with harvested apples. Once all bins are loaded, deliver them to the cold storage facility adjacent to the packhouse. Wait until all bins are unloaded by the storage team, then head to the tool depot next to the machinery garage and stand by for further instructions.

Start at the northwest supply depot. Travel to the vineyard maintenance shed and pick up a sealed case of grape fertilizer. Deliver the case to the southeast irrigation junction. Wait for 5 minutes while the field supervisor inspects the delivery. After inspection, proceed to the riverside toolpoint to pick up a pair of replacement water filters and return them to the northwest supply depot for storage.

Start at the equipment depot adjacent to the eastern orchard gate. Travel to the solar array maintenance cabin on the southern perimeter and pick up a crate containing solar panel cleaning supplies. Deliver the crate to the temporary technician station set up at the edge of the wildflower meadow. Wait for technicians to unload all cleaning supplies from your platform, then proceed to the storage tent near the composting lot. Collect three empty pesticide containers from the tent and transport them to the hazardous waste collection point beside the machinery wash bay. Wait for 5 minutes until personnel confirm successful handover of the containers, then return to the equipment depot and await further instructions.

Begin at the supply warehouse located behind the main barn. Drive to the fuel storage shed adjacent to the tractor lot. Pick up two sealed fuel canisters from the designated collection point. Deliver these canisters to the equipment maintenance zone next to the workshop. Wait for the maintenance crew to remove both fuel canisters, which may take up to 5 minutes. After completing the delivery, proceed to the break area near the orchard’s north gate and stand by for 10 minutes before returning to the supply warehouse for your next task.

Begin at the parking area beside the old barn. Navigate to the orchard's west gate and collect three empty harvesting crates. Transport these crates to Row 12, Section B in the apple orchard. Wait until workers have filled all three crates with apples. Afterward, move the filled crates to the cold storage facility's receiving entrance. Once the crates are unloaded by staff, proceed to the compost station near the south fence and wait there for 8 minutes before returning to the parking area.

Start at the solar panel maintenance hut. Travel to the fertilizer storage bunker and pick up two sealed fertilizer barrels. Move to Paddock 3 at the livestock feed trough area and deliver the fertilizer barrels. Wait for the field manager to inspect and sign off on the delivery, which may take up to 7 minutes. Next, drive to the irrigation pump house near Pond 4. Pick up a water quality testing kit and deliver it to the aquaponics greenhouse. Wait at the greenhouse until the kit has been retrieved by the technician, then return to the solar panel maintenance hut to complete your round.

Start at the vehicle parking zone west of the solar panel field. Proceed to the grain storage silo bordering Corn Section 2 and collect a pallet containing three bags of feed grain. Transport the pallet directly to the animal husbandry center situated south of the irrigation pond. Wait up to 8 minutes while the farm staff unloads the grain bags. Once empty, travel to the compost facility beside Orchard Lane and pick up an empty compost bin. Take this bin to the fruit processing hall at the end of Berry Row 7. Upon arrival, wait for the processing team to fill the bin, which may take up to 7 minutes, and then deliver the filled bin to the organic fertilizer shed adjacent to the west field gate. Return to the vehicle parking zone to complete your circuit.

Drive to the lumber storage yard adjacent to the east fence and pick up five untreated timber beams and a box of galvanized nails. Deliver the materials to the construction zone by the south boundary, next to the equipment parking lot. Wait until the construction crew unloads all supplies. After unloading, proceed to the covered lunch area behind the greenhouse and wait for 12 minutes for the midday break to finish before returning to your starting position at the barn entrance.

Begin at the solar charging station near the eastern perimeter of the facility. Navigate to the barn storage area and pick up two sacks of animal feed and a container of mineral supplements. Deliver these supplies to the feed dispenser unit inside the livestock enclosure by the western fence. After all items are unloaded, wait for 5 minutes while farm staff inspect your platform for leftover materials. Once cleared, proceed to the workshop entryway and stand by until the end of your assigned shift.

Begin at the equipment bay located next to the central greenhouse and proceed to the cold storage facility near the north orchard entrance. Pick up three crates of freshly harvested strawberries. Deliver the crates to the produce sorting area behind the farm market stall. Wait for 15 minutes while staff verify the produce inventory and unload the crates. After unloading, travel to the rainwater collection tanks adjacent to the vineyard. Collect two empty filtration canisters and transport them to the maintenance dock beside the irrigation canal.
