Wait until the site supervisor confirms receipt of the canisters, then return to the equipment bay to complete the assignment.

Start at the packing station adjacent to the apple orchard. Navigate to the north equipment yard and retrieve two empty harvest bins. Carry these bins to the berry picking zone at the western field edge. Wait for the harvesting crew to fill both bins with berries before departing. Once loaded, transport the filled bins to the quality control tent located behind the main storage barn. After delivery, remain at the tent for 5 minutes to assist with additional loading if needed, then proceed to the maintenance hub near the farm entrance and park there until further instructions.

Begin at the maintenance shed located behind the barn. Move to the grapevine trellis section in the southern vineyard and pick up three empty bulk grape bins. Transport the bins to the main winery loading dock near the fermentation tanks and wait for the crew to unload all the bins from the robot. Once the unloading is complete, proceed to the packaging depot next to the cold storage building. Collect two sealed cartons of bottle labels and deliver them to the labeling line inside the bottling facility. After delivering the cartons, travel to the solar charging pad close to the equipment parking lot and stand by for 20 minutes to recharge batteries before resuming further operations.

Start at the storage barn located near the east entrance of the farm. Proceed to the solar tool shed adjacent to the south orchard and pick up three boxes of pruning shears and two rolls of protective netting. Deliver these supplies to the vineyard, meeting the workers near Row 12. Wait until the workers have unloaded all items from the robot, then travel to the packaging facility across from the main farmhouse. Stand by for 15 minutes at the packaging facility before returning to the storage barn.

Begin at the central greenhouse supply room. Proceed to the irrigation equipment yard behind the west utility building and pick up three lengths of flexible irrigation hose. Deliver the hoses to the drip line repair station at the south end of Field 5. Wait until the maintenance team finishes installing connectors onto the hoses (approximately 8 minutes). Afterward, transport any used packaging from the repair station back to the recycling container located adjacent to the greenhouse supply room. Once the packaging is delivered, move to the weather station observation post near the farm pond and stand by for 7 minutes before returning to the central greenhouse supply room.

Begin at the loading dock behind the main warehouse. Proceed to the fertilizer storage silo by the north field entrance. Pick up a pallet containing six bags of organic fertilizer. Transport the pallet to Greenhouse 2, located east of the main barn. Wait until all six bags have been manually unloaded by the greenhouse staff. Once empty, return to the loading dock and stand by for 15 minutes in case additional tasks are assigned.

Start at the repair garage next to the old barn. Navigate to the solar panel field maintenance station near the western ridge and pick up a toolkit containing voltage meters and replacement wiring. Proceed to the wind turbine control tower located at the crest of the north hill and wait until the maintenance team has offloaded the toolkit and signaled completion. Once finished, travel to the main control office near the administrative building and collect three boxes of logbooks. Deliver these boxes to the archive storage room in the underground annex, and wait for 12 minutes while archival staff organize the logbooks before proceeding to the repair garage to stand by for new assignments.

Drive to the orchard equipment garage located beside Orchard Block D and collect two crates filled with replacement pruning shears. Deliver both crates to the north apple grove maintenance tent. Wait for the grove crew leader to unload the crates. Once unloaded, proceed to the livestock feed storage facility near the east paddock and pick up a 50-kg bale of hay. Transport the bale to the feeding area at Pasture Gate 4 and wait for 15 minutes while the ranch staff distributes the hay. After completing both drop-offs, proceed to the exit staging area beside the gravel track and remain there awaiting your next assignment.

Start at the main garage located beside the farm office. Drive to the orchard's north edge and collect four empty fruit collection bins. Transport these bins to the apple harvest zone in the center of the orchard. Wait for orchard workers to unload all empty bins from the robot before proceeding. Afterwards, move to the packaging building's west entrance and pick up a single crate of packed apples. Deliver this crate to the farm market stall situated at the east entrance of the property. Once the crate is unloaded by the staff, return to the main garage and await further assignments.

Begin at the north field access gate and proceed to the seed storage shed beside the irrigation canal. Pick up three bags of corn seed and a box of seed markers. Deliver these items to Plot 7, located in the northeast quadrant of the fields. Wait for the planting crew to unload all items, then remain on standby for 10 minutes in case additional transports are needed. Once dismissed by the crew lead, drive to the equipment wash station near the maintenance yard and prepare for cleaning operations.

Start at the fertilizer storage shed and collect two bags of organic fertilizer pellets. Transport the bags to the raised planter beds at the east orchard entrance and wait for the gardening crew to unload them. Once empty, drive to the main operations office to pick up a single sealed envelope containing updated field maps. Deliver the envelope to the field supervisor stationed at the windbreak shelter near Plot 2. After the transfer is completed, return to the fertilizer storage shed and prepare for the next task.

Begin at the inventory checkpoint by the eastern fence and travel to the fertilizer storage locker located beside the greenhouse complex. Pick up two 25-kilogram bags of organic fertilizer. Transport the fertilizer bags to the south field’s machinery lot and wait up to 10 minutes for the farm workers to retrieve them. Once offloaded, proceed to the barn at the northeast corner of the property to collect a container of chicken feed. Deliver the chicken feed to the animal enclosure beside the main lane. Wait at the enclosure until the feed container is removed, then return to the inventory checkpoint and signal for further instructions.

Begin at the orchard equipment bunker near the eastern perimeter. Drive to the packaging tent adjacent to the apple grove and pick up four crates of freshly harvested apples. Transport these crates to the cold storage facility located in the northeast corner of the farm. Wait until the storage manager confirms all crates have been transferred, which may take up to 12 minutes. Once the transfer is complete, proceed to the solar panel field maintenance shed, collect a single replacement inverter unit, and deliver it to the solar power distribution hub by the southern fence. After delivery, wait at the distribution hub for 6 minutes in case further instructions are provided before returning to the orchard equipment bunker.

Begin at the southeast entrance of the harvested grain depot. Navigate to the solar panel field bordering the north fence and pick up a toolkit along with a sealed box of replacement fuses from the maintenance supervisor. Transport these items to the top of Battery Hill, where the solar array control cabinets are located. Wait for the electrical team to remove the toolkit and box of fuses from your platform. Once offloaded, drive to the composting zone west of the irrigation pond and wait there for 10 minutes before resuming service.

Start from the maintenance zone next to the east orchard. Drive to the fertilizer storage shed adjacent to the northern tractor enclosure and pick up two sacks of organic fertilizer and a box of irrigation nozzles. Deliver these items to the compost mixing area by the west field access road. Wait until all items are unloaded from your platform. Afterwards, proceed to the equipment wash station situated at the far end of the barnlane and collect three empty chemical sprayer tanks. Take the empty tanks to the chemical refilling depot just north of the old seed barn, and wait 10 minutes while the tanks are cleaned and refilled. Once the full tanks are reloaded onto your platform, deliver them to the field deployment crew stationed at the south end of Corn Plot 3. Wait until the crew has removed all tanks before returning to the maintenance zone to complete your task.

Start at the vehicle garage near the southwest corner of the facility. Proceed to the solar panel array on the southern field and pick up one sealed container of replacement microinverters. Deliver the container to the electrical control shed beside the wind turbine installation. Wait for the engineering crew to unload the microinverters from the robot. After unloading, drive to the parts storage area behind warehouse B, pick up a box of circuit fuses, and bring it to the mobile maintenance van stationed at the east access road. Once the box has been removed, return directly to the vehicle garage.

Start at the maintenance garage near the southern gate. Travel to the solar equipment storage located behind the farm office and pick up a pallet loaded with solar panel cleaning kits. Transport the pallet to the solar array field at the hilltop. Wait there for the field crew to unload all cleaning kits from the robot—anticipated wait time: 12 minutes. Then, proceed to the irrigation control shed next to the eastern pond, collect one box of pressure gauges, and deliver the box to the pump house adjacent to the northern wetlands. Once delivery is complete, navigate back to the maintenance garage and await further instructions for 5 minutes before concluding the task.

Begin at the orchard equipment shed near the east fence. Travel to the citrus grove beside Creek Lane and collect three crates of harvested lemons. Transport the crates to the cold storage facility adjacent to Warehouse 4. After delivering the lemons, remain at the cold storage facility for 10 minutes to receive potential additional cartons for transport. If none are provided within that timeframe, return to the orchard equipment shed and prepare for the next assignment.

Begin at the main workshop near the equipment garage. Drive to the storage tent east of Vineyard Block 4 and pick up a box containing five sets of irrigation valves. Deliver the box to the pump house at the center of the wetland restoration area. Wait for up to 10 minutes as the field manager inspects and removes each set of valves from the box. Once unloaded, proceed to the seedling greenhouse adjoining the nursery shed and collect two trays of tomato seedlings. Carefully transport the trays to Plot 12A on the hillside planting terraces. Wait while planting staff remove the trays, then return to the main workshop to complete your round.

Start at the main entrance of the machinery barn. Navigate to the orchard’s southeast gate to collect two crates of freshly harvested pears. Deliver the crates to the quality control tent situated between the cold storage warehouse and the farm office. Stand by for up to 7 minutes while inspectors assess the produce. After approval, retrieve any rejected pears (if present) and return them to the composting area behind the equipment shelter. Once the rejected produce is dropped off, proceed to the machinery barn and await further assignments.

Begin at the equipment garage next to the farm’s west entrance. Navigate to the solar panel array on the hilltop and pick up a box containing replacement inverters. Transport the box to the energy management station at the north barn. Wait for the technician to remove the inverters from the robot, which may take up to 12 minutes. Once the technician confirms that unloading is complete, proceed to the livestock feed store on the southern lane and collect four sacks of mineral supplements. Deliver these sacks to the feeding area at the central pasture, and after ensuring all sacks have been unloaded, return to the equipment garage near the west entrance.

Begin at the farm maintenance shed located beside the irrigation control house. Collect three replacement water filters from the marked storage bin. Navigate to the west field pump station along the riverbank and deposit the water filters at the supply table for the maintenance crew. Wait up to 6 minutes for the crew to retrieve and check all filters. After unloading is confirmed, proceed south to the fertilizer depot next to the wheat silo. Pick up a pallet containing eight bags of organic fertilizer and deliver it to the greenhouse loading area near the main entrance. Allow the greenhouse staff to unload all bags and confirm delivery before returning to the farm maintenance shed.

Start at the central produce staging area next to the farm retail shed. Drive to the orchard's southwest entrance to collect two crates of freshly picked pears. After picking up the crates, proceed to the cold storage facility near the western boundary of the farm and deliver the pears. Wait at the cold storage facility for up to 10 minutes for a staff member to verify the delivery and sign off the transfer. Once confirmation is received, travel to the compost collection point behind the compost bins and pick up an empty organic waste container. Return the empty container to the orchard's southwest entrance and stand by until field workers are ready to reload it.

Start at the equipment shelter near the south entrance and travel to the crop chemical storage shed adjacent to the west field. Collect three sealed drums of fertilizer solution. Move these drums to the robotic sprayer station in the central meadow. Wait for the operators to finish unloading, which may take up to 10 minutes. Once the drums are offloaded, proceed to the carpenter’s workshop behind the barn and pick up a pallet of wooden stakes. Deliver the pallet to the new orchard plot on the east side of the property, and return to the equipment shelter for recharge.

Begin at the maintenance workshop adjacent to the millhouse. Drive to the open-air storage yard west of the tractor depot and pick up a container of spare hydraulic hoses and a tool case. Deliver both items to the tractor repair bay near the southern machinery shed. Wait for the repair technician to unload the container and tool case, then proceed to the solar panel array on the hillside north of the irrigation pond. Pick up any discarded packaging material from recent maintenance at the solar array and transport it to the recycling station located behind the grain silos. Once the material is delivered, return to the maintenance workshop for standby.

Start at the central workshop near the machinery shed. Travel to the vineyard’s southern gate and pick up two sealed containers of grape samples. Deliver these containers to the laboratory in the research annex located on the farm’s north side. Wait in the laboratory for 7 minutes while researchers extract samples from the containers. After confirmation, carry the now-empty containers to the recycling depot near the main parking lot and wait until a staff member unloads both containers. Once the containers have been removed, return to the central workshop and await new tasks.

Begin at the vehicle charging bay near the machine workshop. Travel to the seed storage bunker beside the eastern tractor shed and pick up two sacks of corn seed and a container of growth accelerator. Deliver these supplies to the freshly tilled field plot B northeast of the irrigation ditch. Wait for the planting crew to unload all materials from your cargo area, which is expected to take about 15 minutes. After unloading, proceed to the loading dock outside the chemical storage building and await the arrival of the safety officer for further instructions.

Begin at the main maintenance shed near the eastern property gate. Drive to the orchard tool depot beside the southern row of apple trees and pick up three bundles of pruning shears. Deliver the bundles to the field supervisor’s station located at the center of the orchard. Wait until the supervisor collects all bundles from your deck. Next, proceed to the composting yard adjacent to the windbreak line in the southwest corner and pick up a sealed bag of safety gloves from the supply crate. Transport the safety gloves to the pest management trailer parked near the western vineyard. Remain there for 10 minutes, standing by to assist with additional transport requests.

Start at the maintenance workshop located west of the central storage building. Proceed to the irrigation control station beside the north pond and pick up a crate containing replacement sprinkler heads. Deliver the crate to the field technician at the irrigation plot labeled Section D, located in the northwest corner of the field. Wait 10 minutes while the technician swaps out faulty equipment and then collects three used sprinkler heads to be returned. Obtain the three used sprinkler heads and transport them to the recycling bay situated next to the equipment warehouse. After the transfer is complete, return to the maintenance workshop and await further instructions.

Begin at the equipment storage shed near the central access road. Drive to the tractor maintenance bay and wait for the mechanic to place a replacement hydraulic pump on the robot. Once the pump is loaded, head to the vineyard tool station located beside Block C. Deliver the hydraulic pump to the tool station and wait until the maintenance crew has retrieved it. Then, proceed to the shade structure near the western windbreak and pick up any empty pesticide canisters. Transport the empty canisters back to the equipment storage shed for recycling.

Start at the central loading bay near the greenhouse cluster. Navigate to the east-side seed storage facility and pick up four sacks of ryegrass seed. Deliver the sacks to the planting team at the lower meadow staging area near the east irrigation ditch. Wait until the crew has completely unloaded the sacks. Then proceed to the fruit sorting zone adjacent to the north orchard, collect two bins of sorted apples, and deliver them to the cold storage annex by the farm office. Stand by for 5 minutes while staff confirm the transfer. After confirmation, return to the central loading bay.

Begin at the outdoor repair bay beside the fuel depot. Proceed to the fertilizer storage bunker near the eastern fence. Pick up two sealed sacks of organic fertilizer. Transport the sacks to greenhouse tunnel B, located west of the irrigation pond. Wait up to 12 minutes for the greenhouse staff to unload the sacks from the robot. Once unloaded, drive to the northeast corner of the solar panel field and collect a replacement inverter from the designated supply rack. Finally, deliver the replacement inverter to the solar maintenance shed and await confirmation from the maintenance supervisor before returning to the outdoor repair bay.

Start at the loading dock beside the grain silo. Drive to the livestock barn to collect four bags of feed from the storage alcove. Proceed to the feeding station in Pasture 2 and deliver the bags of feed. Wait for 8 minutes while farm staff distribute the feed to animals. Once the task is complete, return to the loading dock for your next assignment without waiting for further instructions.

Start at the maintenance garage next to the west gate. Drive to the windbreak nursery near the eastern perimeter and pick up four bags of soil conditioner. Deliver the bags to the blueberry plot at the southeastern corner of the farm. Wait up to 10 minutes while the field crew unloads the soil conditioner from your platform. After unloading is confirmed, return to the maintenance garage and stand by for the next assignment.

Begin at the supply depot across from the maintenance workshop. Navigate to the solar-powered charging station behind the weather monitoring tower and pick up two replacement solar batteries. Transport these batteries to the rooftop access point of the administrative building and wait until a technician has removed both batteries from your cargo tray. After batteries are delivered, proceed to the orchard gate kiosk at the southeast corner of the orchard and collect a small box of temperature sensors. Deliver the sensors to the monitoring station positioned along the southern perimeter fence. Wait for 8 minutes or until the station supervisor confirms receipt, then return to the supply depot and await further instructions.

Begin at the equipment garage near the main access road. Drive to the orchard tool shed and pick up three pruning toolkits. Transport the toolkits to Harvest Row, where the fruit-picking crew is stationed, and wait for 10 minutes while the crew unloads the toolkits. Next, proceed to the chemical storage unit beside the vineyard and collect a safety-sealed barrel of organic pesticide. Deliver this barrel to the grape processing yard. After delivery, remain onsite until a supervisor confirms the barrel's receipt, then head to the compost heap behind the storage barn to pick up two empty compost bins and bring them back to the equipment garage.

Start at the orchard maintenance hub near the north gate. Drive to the irrigation control station by the western orchard rows and pick up two replacement water filters. Carry the filters to the pump house at the central pond and wait for the system technician to unload both filters. After the technician confirms unloading, proceed to the fertilizer storage shed behind the old greenhouse. Load a medium-sized bag of organic fertilizer and deliver it to the blueberry patch alongside the eastern fence. Wait for 8 minutes in the blueberry patch area, then return to the orchard maintenance hub.

Start at the main garage and proceed to the equipment storage shed. Retrieve four replacement hydraulic hoses. Deliver the hoses to the vineyard machinery depot. Wait until a technician removes the used hoses and places the old ones onto the robot, which should take approximately 7 minutes. Once the old hoses are loaded, return them to the recycling center adjacent to the maintenance office. After dropping off the old hoses, return to the main garage.

Start at the tool maintenance shed adjacent to the loading dock. Travel to the spare parts warehouse located behind Greenhouse 3 and pick up two replacement hydraulic pumps. Deliver the pumps to the machinery repair bay on the north end of the wheat field. Wait there until the field technician removes the damaged pumps and installs the new ones, which should take approximately 30 minutes. Once the technician has loaded the two faulty pumps onto the robot, transport them to the recycling depot at the west perimeter. After depositing the old pumps, return to the tool maintenance shed and stand by for further instructions.

Begin at the orchard service lane next to the irrigation control station. Head over to the northeast apple picking area and collect four bins of freshly picked apples. Deliver these bins to the produce weigh-in station adjacent to the packing house. Wait for 6 minutes while the quality control team inspects and logs each bin. When finished, proceed to the compost depot behind the livestock shelter, pick up an empty fertilizer spreader, and return it to the orchard storage shed located by the eastern fence. After dropping off the spreader, continue to the equipment charging dock behind the field operations office and remain there for 12 minutes for battery recharging before standing by for your next assignment.

Start at the maintenance garage and drive to the vineyard workshop. Pick up three spare water pumps and a box of drip line connectors. Deliver these items to the southern irrigation hub. Wait for the irrigation technician to unload all items, which may take up to 8 minutes. Once the task is complete, travel to the solar panel array for a routine inspection check, then return to the maintenance garage.

Start at the maintenance garage, then drive to the spare parts depot near the eastern boundary. Pick up three hydraulic cylinders and two sealed boxes of replacement filters. Continue to the grain silo access pad by the farm’s north storage fields and deliver all collected items to the on-site technician. Wait for 10 minutes while the technician inspects the parts. Afterwards, proceed to the composting area beside the vegetable plots to pick up two empty chemical containers. Transport the empty containers back to the maintenance garage and wait until a staff member removes them from the robot.

Begin at the field-side charging station near the north orchard. Navigate to the irrigation supply depot and collect two rolls of repair tubing. Transport these tubing rolls to the tomato greenhouse packing area. Wait for 10 minutes while staff inspect and temporarily store the tubing. Continue to the workshop beside the main access road to retrieve a spilled set of harvesting shears from outside the entry door. Deliver the set of shears to the tool cabinet inside the machinery shed and wait until a technician confirms the items have been placed inside. Once all deliveries are complete, return to the field-side charging station.

Begin at the storage pavilion located west of the packing shed. Drive to the northern greenhouse annex and pick up a large crate of seedling trays. Transport the crate to the eastern propagation tunnel. Wait until the horticultural staff unloads the seedling trays from your platform. Once the crate is completely empty, proceed to the main farm entrance and wait for 8 minutes to receive a sealed box of field sensors destined for deployment. After the box is secured, deliver it to the technology station by the solar panel array in the southeast corner. Stand by for the technicians to remove the box, then return to the storage pavilion to finish your route.

Begin at the farm’s main garage near the north gate. Drive to the packaging warehouse at the edge of the eastern orchard and pick up four sealed crates of harvested peaches. Transport the crates to the cooling chamber adjacent to the fruit processing facility. Wait for 10 minutes while the cooling chamber staff unload the crates. Once unloaded, proceed to the irrigation control station at the southern fields. Collect two replacement water valves from the storage locker. Deliver these valves to the greenhouse repair area next to the pond, and wait there until a technician collects both valves. Finally, return to the main garage near the north gate for standby.

Start at the central workshop near the equipment lot. Proceed to the parts storage shed behind the greenhouse and collect two replacement drive belts. Drive carefully to the packaging facility entrance next to the shipment yard and wait until a technician removes the drive belts for machinery repair, which may take up to 7 minutes. After drop-off is confirmed, travel to the vehicle wash station by the north fence for cleaning before parking at the central workshop and awaiting the next task.

Start at the garage near the equipment shed. Navigate to the vineyard access road and pick up four bags of pruning shears from the tool drop-off point. Deliver the bags to the irrigation control cabin next to the east field. Wait for 6 minutes while the agricultural team retrieves the shears. Once the bags are removed from the cargo area, proceed to the compost heap by the south orchard and collect two empty fertilizer bins. Return the empty bins to the garage near the equipment shed and await further instruction.

Start at the machinery depot next to the fuel station. Proceed to the orchard's northwest corner and pick up five crates of freshly picked apples. Transport the crates to the cold storage facility adjacent to the packing line. Once there, wait for the facility supervisor to confirm the unloading is complete. After unloading, travel to the fertilizer bunker by the south lane to retrieve two bags of organic fertilizer. Deliver the bags to the greenhouse entry point, then wait for 8 minutes to allow the horticulture team to transfer the materials inside. Finally, return to the machinery depot for task completion confirmation.

From the central warehouse adjacent to the loading bay, proceed to the chemical storage shed next to the south entrance and pick up a sealed container of fertilizer. Deliver this container to the hydroponic greenhouse located along the eastern service road. Wait until the greenhouse supervisor confirms receipt and removes the container from the robot. Once the transfer is complete, travel to the tool depot between the vehicle wash station and the grain elevator. Stand by for 5 minutes to assist with any urgent tool transport requests before returning to the central warehouse.

Begin at the maintenance garage beside the machinery depot. Drive to the north vineyard supply shed and pick up a pallet containing eight boxes of grapevine cuttings. Transport the pallet to the propagation tent located at the eastern field margin. Wait until horticulturists have removed all boxes from your platform, which may take up to 12 minutes. When unloaded, proceed to the fertilizer distribution kiosk near the central irrigation hub and collect two containers of liquid fertilizer. Deliver these containers to the rice paddy control station situated at the southern end of Field 12. After delivery, return directly to the maintenance garage and await your next assignment.

Begin at the operations control hut beside the orchard entrance. Proceed to the solar panel array at the eastern field boundary and pick up three replacement battery packs. Deliver these battery packs to the maintenance workshop next to the tractor garage. Wait for 8 minutes while technicians replace the spent batteries. Once the technicians confirm the batteries are unloaded, navigate to the irrigation supply depot behind the orchard and collect a crate of sprinkler heads. Transport the crate to the vineyard edge near the western fence. After delivery, return to the operations control hut and await additional tasks.

Start at the equipment garage next to the orchard entrance. Travel to the pesticide storage shed located at the southern edge of the property and collect a single sealed container of biopesticide. Proceed to Vegetable Plot 3, adjacent to the east irrigation pond, and deliver the container to the field supervisor. Wait for 12 minutes while the biopesticide is transferred to sprayers. Afterward, continue to the tool charging station beside the administrative office and wait until a battery pack is placed onto your platform. Finally, transport the battery pack to the drone hangar near the solar array and remain there until the pack is removed.

Start at the fleet charging station in the main service yard. Drive to the greenhouse annex located south of the composting area and pick up two sacks of organic fertilizer. Transport the sacks to the row crop test plots adjacent to the experimental seedling nursery. Wait for 10 minutes while the agronomy team distributes the fertilizer onto the beds. Once loading is complete, proceed to the equipment rental garage near the east gate and collect a toolbox with labeled ‘Drip Line Tools’. Deliver the toolbox to the vineyard pump house west of Hilltop Lane. Remain at the pump house until a technician retrieves the toolbox before returning to the fleet charging station.

Begin at the central dispatch area and drive to the vineyard’s irrigation pump station. Pick up two sealed canisters of fertilizer solution from the supply rack. Transport the canisters to the west grapevine block where the field crew is preparing for application. Wait for the crew to unload both fertilizer canisters, which may take up to 10 minutes. After the canisters have been removed, continue to the field equipment zone and collect a pallet of unused drip lines. Deliver the pallet to the greenhouse entrance for further distribution, then return to the central dispatch area.

Begin your task at the equipment staging area located east of the workshop complex. Proceed to the lumber yard and pick up three timber beams stacked near the loading ramp. Transport the beams to the assembly station inside the fabrication hangar on the northern perimeter. Wait while a team member unloads the beams, which should take approximately 7 minutes. After unloading is complete, travel to the pesticide storage shed adjacent to the orchard fence and collect a sealed drum of organic pesticide. Deliver the drum to the drone launch pad behind the orchard’s research station. Once delivery is confirmed, return to the equipment staging area and stand by for further instructions.

Begin at the storage garage and drive to the equipment inspection bay beside the solar panels. Pick up two sealed containers of engine oil. Transport these containers to the tractor maintenance lot located behind the eastern barn. Wait until the maintenance crew has collected both containers. Then, proceed to the orchard entrance to retrieve a small crate of spare irrigation nozzles. Deliver the crate to the utility shed at the northern edge of the orchard and stand by for 8 minutes while the irrigation team inspects and unloads the items. Once all deliveries are complete, return to the storage garage for further assignment.

Begin at the warehouse entry near the south end of the orchard. Drive to the compost processing area located behind the machinery shed and collect two bins filled with organic mulch. Transport both bins to the vegetable plot at the eastern edge of the farm and wait for 12 minutes while the field crew distributes the mulch. Once the bins are empty, proceed to the equipment calibration station next to the northern greenhouse, pick up a toolbox containing small calibration weights, and deliver it to the main laboratory in the administration block. Wait for the lab technician to unload the toolbox, then navigate to the parking area behind the farm office and stand by for further instructions.

Begin at the fertilizer storage shed next to the east greenhouse. Proceed to the southern orchard and collect six empty harvest bins from beneath the apple trees. Transport the bins to the sorting station near the orchard entrance and wait until all bins are loaded with apples by orchard workers. Once loaded, deliver the filled harvest bins to the cold storage facility adjacent to the packaging plant. After the bins have been fully unloaded by storage personnel, drive to the water pump house by the creek and wait for 20 minutes to allow for routine battery cooling. When the wait is complete, return to the fertilizer storage shed and stand by for your next assignment.

Begin at the vehicle maintenance garage and drive to the fuel depot behind the main barn. Pick up two sealed canisters of diesel. Deliver the canisters to the northern greenhouse utility room. Wait until the facilities manager confirms all canisters have been offloaded. Next, proceed to the tool storage locker adjacent to the machine repair workshop, pick up a set of hydraulic jacks, and transport them to the windbreak construction site on the southern boundary. Once the jacks have been collected by the crew, wait for 10 minutes before heading to the central data post for your next assignment.

Start at the supply depot adjacent to the west warehouse. Proceed to the fertilizer storage area near the north field entrance. Pick up three sacks of organic fertilizer. Drive to the compost turning site beside the large windrow piles and deliver the sacks. Allow 8 minutes for the team to unload the fertilizer. Next, travel to the equipment calibration shed behind the machine barn, wait to be loaded with a calibration toolkit, then deliver the toolkit to the drone launch pad near the eastern hedgerow. Remain at the launch pad until the toolkit has been collected, then return to the supply depot and end the task.

Begin at the greenhouse supply room located adjacent to the northeast access gate. Drive to the composting site beside the old barn and pick up a pallet of empty planting trays. Transport the pallet to the propagation tunnel on the western edge of the experimental fields. Wait until the horticulture staff unloads the planting trays—a process that should take approximately 7 minutes. Once the payload has been offloaded, proceed to the central apiary close to the wildflower meadow and pick up two sealed boxes containing honey sample jars. Deliver the honey sample boxes to the laboratory entrance in the main research building. After confirming delivery, return to the greenhouse supply room.

Start at the equipment garage near the east boundary of the property. Drive to the greenhouse cluster beside the irrigation control shed and pick up three crates of hydroponic nutrient solution. Deliver the crates to the hydroponic processing unit adjacent to the west pond. Wait for 12 minutes while staff unload the nutrient solution. Once unloading is complete, proceed to the covered loading bay next to the machinery lot and collect a spool of replacement irrigation tubing. Transport the tubing to Irrigation Junction 4 along the main access road and wait until maintenance personnel have removed the spool from your cargo tray. Return to the equipment garage and stand by for the next task.

Start from the central dispatch dock beside the grain silos. Drive to the irrigation pump house located along the west perimeter fence and pick up three sealed canisters of water treatment chemicals. Transport the canisters to the vineyard entrance at the northern slope and transfer them to the storage crate designated for liquid supplies. Wait for 6 minutes while the vineyard staff verify the delivery and remove the canisters. Once the handoff is complete, proceed to the maintenance shed near the tractor garage and await further loading instructions.

Begin at the machine maintenance garage and travel to the seed storage depot located next to the north field. Pickup two sacks of organic corn seed from the loading bay. Deliver the sacks to the field planting crew in the eastern planting section of the farm. Wait for the crew to unload the sacks, which may take up to 7 minutes. Once the seeds are successfully delivered, proceed to the solar panel array maintenance site and wait for the solar technician to load a replacement inverter onto the robot. After receiving the inverter, transport it to the central power hub and wait until the technician removes the inverter. Finally, return to the machine maintenance garage and remain on standby near the entrance.

Begin at the greenhouse loading bay and pick up three trays of young tomato seedlings. Drive to the irrigation pump station located at the north edge of the vegetable plot and wait for the planting crew to arrive. Once they have unloaded all the trays, travel to the equipment maintenance bunker behind the machinery depot. Wait for 10 minutes to stand by for possible retrieval of spare irrigation hose reels. Once the waiting period has passed and no additional items are requested, return to the greenhouse loading bay to stand by for further instructions.

Starting at the central storage shed next to the workshop, travel to the irrigation control station on the western hill. Pick up one large repair tool kit and a coiled spool of hose left for maintenance. Drive to Greenhouse 2 located between the pond and the apple grove. Deliver both the tool kit and hose to the greenhouse supervisor. Wait for 5 minutes as the supervisor inspects and unloads the items. Once unloaded, proceed to the tool washing area by the south parking lot. Pick up a crate containing cleaned hand tools. Transport this crate back to the central storage shed and await further instructions.

Begin at the north gate of the packaging facility and travel to the seed storage bunker adjacent to the irrigation control room. Load the bin labeled "Sunflower Seeds Batch 4" onto your cargo platform. Transport this bin to the planting platform on the west side of Field 7. Upon arrival, wait until farm workers have unloaded all contents or for a maximum of 8 minutes, whichever occurs first. Once unloaded, navigate to the maintenance workshop behind the tractor shed and wait there for further servicing instructions.

Start at the orchard packing shed beside the farm lane. Drive to the citrus grove near the west boundary and pick up four crates of harvested oranges. Transport the crates to the juice processing unit next to the cold storage building. Wait until all crates have been unloaded by the processing staff. Afterwards, proceed to the farm workshop to collect one roll of replacement conveyor belt material. Deliver the roll to the grain silo loading area and stand by for 7 minutes before heading back to the orchard packing shed for further assignments.

Start at the maintenance garage situated near the eastern parking lot. Drive to the vineyard storage shed and pick up four empty water canisters. Transport the canisters to the irrigation pump station at the southern edge of the property. Wait for 10 minutes while the workers refill the canisters. After refilling, deliver the full canisters to the solar field operations cabin east of the sunflower patch. Wait until all canisters are unloaded by the staff before returning to the maintenance garage and stand by for further deployment.

Start at the equipment shelter next to Orchard Lane. Drive to the field-side chemical storage between the north orchard and the olive grove, and pick up three sealed pesticide canisters. Deliver the canisters to Crop Plot 7 at the eastern vineyard boundary. Wait until the field supervisor has signed off on the delivery, then proceed to the farm gate entrance on the south perimeter. Pick up two incoming crates of soil sampling kits and transport them to the laboratory facility beside the old windmill. Wait for 15 minutes at the laboratory for unloading and possible additional instructions before returning to the equipment shelter by Orchard Lane.

Start at the maintenance garage near the eastern orchard. Drive to the storage barn and pick up two boxes of seed packets. Carry the boxes to the planting drone staging area along the southern field. Wait there while the field crew removes one box and loads an empty packaging crate onto your cargo bay. Bring the empty crate to the composting station behind the greenhouse, unload it, and then return directly to the maintenance garage.

Begin at the warehouse loading bay next to the north entrance. Drive to the storage silo row and pick up a single pallet of packaged fertilizer bags from under the silo conveyor. Deliver the pallet to the crop trial plots located between Field 3 and Field 4. Wait for the agronomy team to unload all the fertilizer bags—do not leave until they have confirmed the delivery is complete. Once empty, proceed to the nearby tool storage shed behind the windbreak trees and pick up a bin of harvested apples waiting by the door. Take the bin of apples to the cold storage chamber at the eastern end of the processing facility. After dropping off the bin, return to the warehouse loading bay to end your route.

Proceed to the solar charging station at the east perimeter fence. Pick up three charged battery packs and a weatherproof diagnostic kit. Transport these items to the irrigation control hut near the north cornfield. Deliver the battery packs to the designated charging rack and wait until a technician retrieves the diagnostic kit from your platform. After the technician has taken the kit, return to the solar charging station and wait for 5 minutes before powering down for maintenance.

Start at the central courtyard adjacent to the main control hub. Travel to the orchard loading dock on the south end of the property and pick up four crates of freshly harvested pears. Deliver these crates to the cold storage room behind the produce packing facility. Wait at the designated waiting area for up to 10 minutes while the storage crew removes the crates. After all crates have been offloaded, proceed to the machine tool shed on the western service road to collect a set of specialized pruning shears. Transport the pruning shears to the vineyard equipment station near the eastern hillside, and hand them over to the equipment staff. Do not wait after the handover—immediately proceed to the central courtyard to complete the assignment.

Start at the maintenance bay adjacent to the solar panel field. Collect a crate containing six replacement drone batteries. Drive to the field operations tent near the northeast pasture and deliver the battery crate to the supply table just inside the entrance. Wait for fifteen minutes while the drone technician inspects and removes the batteries from your platform. Once unloaded, proceed to the farm machinery garage beside the grain silos and pick up a container filled with lubricating oil. Transport the oil container to the central tractor refueling station and deliver it to the designated drop-off mat. Without waiting, head to the fence repair station near the north gate and wait until two fence posts are placed on your platform for transport. Once loaded, deliver the fence posts to the paddock at the north field and wait for ten minutes while the posts are offloaded by the repair crew. After the platform is clear, return to the maintenance bay for your next assignment.

Start by traveling to the livestock feed storage area near the southern barn and pick up four bales of hay. Transport the bales to the animal enclosure by the pond and wait until the farmhands have removed all bales from the robot. Next, proceed to the equipment calibration station beside the windmill, and wait there for 8 minutes to allow for system updates. Once the updates are complete, move on to the chemical supply shed situated at the east end of the property, collect a sealed container of rust inhibitor, and deliver it to the tractor maintenance bay adjacent to the west gate. After the container is unloaded, return to the livestock feed storage area and park near the entrance.

Begin at the garage next to the machinery repair shed. Drive to the grain storage silo beside the main field entrance and pick up two sacks of wheat seed. Proceed to the tractor assembly area on the west service road. Wait for the crew to offload both sacks of seed. Continue to the orchard’s northern tool depot to pick up a bundled set of pruning shears. Take the shears to the maintenance tent at the orchard’s east edge. After the bundle has been retrieved by the horticulture supervisor, go back to the garage adjacent to the machinery repair shed and stand by for further orders.

Start at the machinery garage adjacent to the fuel depot. Proceed to the eastern orchard gate and collect a boxed set of pruning shears and a bundle of replacement irrigation hoses left on the storage bench. Navigate to the berry plot along the southern fence line and deliver both items to the field crew waiting there. Wait until the crew has removed all equipment from the robot, which may take about 5 minutes. After unloading is complete, head to the packing shed beside the main road entrance and wait for a crate containing harvested strawberries to be loaded. Once loaded, deliver the crate to the cold storage facility beside the shipping terminal. Do not return to the garage; await further instructions at the cold storage facility entrance.

Start at the supply depot behind the workshop building. Proceed to the livestock feed barn on the western pasture and pick up two sacks of animal feed. Transport the feed sacks to the automated feeder station near the pond. Wait for the barn staff to unload the feed, remaining on standby for up to 12 minutes. After unloading is complete, head to the maintenance tool shed beside the old windmill and collect a crate of spare tractor parts. Deliver the crate to the machinery repair bay within the equipment hangar. Once delivery is finished, return to the supply depot.

Begin at the main equipment garage adjacent to the access road. Proceed to the spare parts depot in the northern tool yard and collect two hydraulic pumps marked for field repair. Transport the pumps to the soybean field repair site near the irrigation canal and deliver them to the maintenance crew. Wait until the crew has checked and accepted the pumps, then return to the equipment garage and wait for the next dispatch order.

Begin at the east entrance of the vineyard and proceed to the composting station located near the windbreak trees. Pick up two sealed bins of organic fertilizer. Deliver these bins to the vegetable patch adjacent to the central irrigation pond. Wait until the field supervisor signals that the bins have been emptied. Once emptied, travel to the tractor storage garage near the main access lane and pick up a replacement hydraulic hose. Transport the hydraulic hose to the far end of the olive grove, where the repair crew is stationed, and wait for up to 20 minutes while the crew installs the hose and loads any used parts onto your platform. When the used parts are secured, return them to the recycling bay beside the machinery workshop, and then return to the east entrance of the vineyard.

Start at the solar panel maintenance depot near the north entrance. Drive to the field supply storage shed beside the irrigation pond and pick up two sealed canisters of liquid fertilizer. Deliver the canisters to the crop spraying station along the east boundary of the lower cornfield. Wait until the station crew inspects and removes both canisters. Once unloaded, proceed to the machinery parking area adjacent to the composting yard and retrieve an empty pallet. Transport the empty pallet back to the field supply storage shed, then return to the solar panel maintenance depot for your next assignment.

Begin at the machine workshop adjacent to the western maintenance shed. Move to the orchard loading zone at the southern edge of the farm and collect two crates of picked apples. Deliver these crates to the cold storage warehouse located near the north entrance. After delivery, wait for the quality inspector to confirm receipt and remove the crates, a process expected to take about 7 minutes. Once confirmation is received, proceed to the composting site behind the old barn, pick up any empty crates stacked there, and return them to the machine workshop before concluding the task.

Start at the tool storage room adjacent to the greenhouse. Travel to the pesticide supply shed near the northeast fence and pick up three sealed canisters of organic pesticide. Deliver the canisters to the vineyard maintenance area at the edge of the southern slope. Wait for 3 minutes for the vineyard staff to unload the pesticide. After unloading is confirmed, proceed to the west orchard entrance just past the tractor lot and collect any empty crates left by the fruit pickers. Transport these empty crates back to the packing barn next to the central driveway. Once the crates have been offloaded, return to the tool storage room adjacent to the greenhouse and await the next task.

Start at the maintenance pavilion next to the tractor refueling station. Proceed to the spare parts depot and collect a single heavy-duty hydraulic piston. Navigate to the vineyard’s onsite irrigation control cabin and deliver the piston to the technician waiting there. Once the item has been unloaded, wait for 7 minutes in case additional repair components are requested. If no further items are provided during that period, proceed to the field boundary fence checkpoint and await further instructions.

Start from the maintenance shed beside the south entrance. Drive to the fertilizer storage barn in the west field and pick up three sealed bags of organic fertilizer. Deliver these bags to the greenhouse complex, and wait outside Bay 2 until staff remove all bags—this may take up to 6 minutes. Once unloaded, proceed to the orchard tool station near Row D and collect a metal toolkit. Bring the toolkit to the mobile scouting unit parked at the northern grove. After handing off the toolkit, wait for 5 minutes to see if additional requests arrive before returning to the maintenance shed.

Begin at the equipment storage hangar located adjacent to the north pasture. Travel to the greenhouse supply rack and pick up two boxes of tomato starter trays. Deliver the boxes to the propagation laboratory at the southwest corner of the property. Wait until lab staff have inspected and accepted the delivery, estimated to take 8 minutes. Next, proceed to the composting station behind the orchard and collect a sealed bag of organic fertilizer. Take the fertilizer to the vegetable plot access gate, and remain in place until a field technician unloads the bag. Once the payload is fully unloaded, return to the equipment storage hangar and prepare for the next assignment.

Begin at the equipment garage located behind the administrative office. Navigate to the orchard loading platform, which is adjacent to the southern apple grove. Pick up six crates of newly harvested apples from the platform. Deliver the crates to the cold storage warehouse on the western perimeter of the property. Upon arrival, wait for 12 minutes while the warehouse team finishes unloading all crates. Once unloaded, proceed to the tool maintenance shed beside the irrigation canal and retrieve two replacement pruning shears, then deliver them back to the orchard loading platform before returning to the equipment garage to complete your task.

Start at the fertiliser storage shelter beside the east orchard entrance. Proceed to the pesticide containment area positioned along the southern service road and pick up two sealed canisters of liquid pesticide. Transport the canisters to the vineyard supply drop-off, located next to the windbreak hedgerow at the western field boundary. Wait until a field technician unloads both canisters. As soon as unloading is confirmed, continue to the equipment wash station adjacent to the main barn for decontamination procedures before returning to the fertiliser storage shelter and awaiting new dispatch orders.

Begin at the maintenance bay behind the greenhouse. Proceed to the seed storage building and collect three sacks of sunflower seeds. Navigate to the west vegetable plots and deliver the sacks to the shed at plot number 7. Wait for the gardening supervisor to unload all seed sacks from your platform, then continue to the machinery workshop adjacent to the barn. Pick up any available empty oil drums from the workshop and transport them back to the maintenance bay. Conclude the task by waiting for 4 minutes for a technician to inspect the returned oil drums.

Begin at the central workshop near the main gate. Retrieve one crate of assorted replacement parts labeled for the automatic harvesting units. Travel to Orchard Sector E and deliver the crate to the equipment area next to the main path. Wait until the maintenance supervisor unloads the crate. Once complete, proceed to the seed supply tent in the west field and pick up a pallet of seed trays. Head to the nursery greenhouse beside the irrigation pond and deliver the seed trays. After delivery, remain at the greenhouse for 10 minutes to assist with any additional tasks before returning to the central workshop.

Start at the receiving dock beside the production facility. Proceed to the vineyard harvesting area near the east terrace to collect four baskets of freshly picked grapes. Deliver the grape baskets to the fermentation room next to the tasting hall. Wait at the fermentation room until all baskets have been unloaded by the staff. After unloading, make your way to the tool storage shed on the north side of the equipment depot. Pick up a box of unused irrigation nozzles, then deliver this box to the irrigation control hub near the central pond. Once the delivery is complete, head to the solar charging station on the south end of the main parking lot and wait there for 12 minutes before concluding the assignment.

Start at the storage garage next to the old grain silo. Proceed to the livestock barn feed room and pick up two sacks of mineral supplements. Deliver the supplements to the pasture feeding station near the creek on the north perimeter. Wait until the ranch hand unloads all items from your platform. Then head to the field supply station by the east cornfield and collect five irrigation valve kits. Transport the valve kits to the irrigation control shed west of the potato field and wait for 15 minutes while field engineers set up the new equipment. After the waiting period, return to the storage garage near the old grain silo.

Proceed to Orchard Sector C near the north tree line and collect a crate of ripe apples from beneath the shade tent. Deliver the apple crate to the quality inspection table inside Sorting Shed 1. Wait until the inspection team signals that the crate has been removed. Then, travel to the maintenance trailer adjacent to the farm workshop and await further loading instructions.

Start at the farmstead supply depot. Drive to the irrigation pump station beside the west pasture and pick up three water filtration cartridges. Deliver the filtration cartridges to the greenhouse tool room. Wait at the tool room’s entry dock until all cartridges are unloaded, which may take up to 8 minutes. Following unloading, head to the vineyard workshop and collect a pallet of grape harvesting nets. Transport the nets to the hillside vineyard block and wait 10 minutes to allow field workers to unload the pallet. Once complete, proceed to the workshop canteen and remain there for further assignments.

Start at the north gate of the produce farm. Drive to the greenhouse complex near the water reservoir and pick up three trays of seedling tomato plants. Carefully transport the trays to the raised beds section along the west fence. Wait for the planting crew to finish unloading all trays before proceeding. Next, head to the maintenance shed next to the dirt road and collect a case of irrigation drippers. Deliver the case to the berry field on the southern slope. Wait for 10 minutes while the irrigation team installs drippers and places any discarded packaging onto your platform. After all waste materials are loaded, carry them to the waste collection station by the main road, then proceed to the north gate to complete the task.

Begin at the north vehicle garage. Drive to the spare parts depot near the eastern fence and collect a replacement hydraulic pump and two filter cartridges. Transport these components to the tractor repair yard adjacent to the machine storage hangar. Wait until the mechanics have unloaded all the parts, which should take approximately 8 minutes. Then, proceed to the solar panel array inspection point south of the workshop and pick up an empty battery crate. Deliver the empty crate to the electrical charging station by the main administration building. Once the crate is offloaded, return to the north vehicle garage to await your next assignment.

Start at the loading bay beside the seed warehouse. Pick up two sealed containers of soybean seeds and drive to the planting rig assembly area at the north field entrance. Drop off both containers at the assembly supervisor’s marked spot. Next, proceed to the maintenance junction near the windbreak grove, where a crate of used tractor filters awaits. Collect the crate and deliver it to the hazardous materials shed located at the far end of the machinery yard. Wait outside the shed for 8 minutes while safety personnel complete the transfer paperwork, then return to the seed warehouse main entrance and await further instructions.

Begin at the tool depot adjacent to the main greenhouse. Proceed to the fertilizer distribution shed next to the southern fence and collect three bags of organic fertilizer. Transport the fertilizer to orchard plot C near the old windbreak. Wait for the orchard supervisor to unload all fertilizer bags, which should take approximately 8 minutes. Once unloading is complete, return to the tool depot and await the next assignment.

Start at the solar charging station behind the equipment warehouse. Proceed to the vineyard’s central supply shed and pick up a box containing irrigation valves. Deliver the box to the greenhouse at the southeast corner of the farm and wait for the greenhouse technician to remove the valves from your payload area. Once the box is unloaded, proceed to the fertilizer mixing zone near the south fence and collect two containers of liquid fertilizer. Transport these containers to the shipping dock adjacent to the crop field and wait for 12 minutes or until a shipping supervisor has finished inspecting the containers before returning to the solar charging station for battery replenishment.

Begin at the logistics center by the north greenhouse. Travel to the vineyard supply shed and collect two sacks of grape fertilizer. Deliver the sacks to the irrigation pump station at the west edge of the vineyard. Wait until vineyard staff unload all sacks from your platform, then proceed to the machinery garage next to the central wind turbine. Wait there for 10 minutes while your battery is checked, and then return to the logistics center.

Start at the maintenance garage at the west side of the equipment yard. Proceed to the solar panel field near the northern boundary and collect three replacement solar inverters from the technician waiting by the service trailer. Deliver the inverters to the main solar power hub adjacent to the central control building. Wait until the technicians have installed all three inverters, which should take about 10 minutes. After installation, pick up any faulty components removed from the hub and bring them to the recycling shed next to the maintenance garage. Wait for the faulty components to be unloaded, then remain at the recycling shed for 5 minutes in case additional recyclable materials need transporting. Return to the maintenance garage when all tasks are complete.

Start at the maintenance garage near the facility’s northern boundary. Travel to the solar farm control center positioned at the edge of the eastern field. Collect a toolkit containing electrical testers and four replacement solar panel fuses. Head to station 3 of the solar array, which is marked by the orange flag near the windbreak trees. Deliver the toolkit and fuses to the technician waiting on-site, then wait for 10 minutes to assist with any additional component deliveries the technician may request. Afterward, proceed to the farm office lobby beside the visitor parking lot to pick up three outgoing packages labeled for the parts distributor. Take these packages to the shipping container at the western loading dock, and wait until the packages are removed before returning to the maintenance garage.

Begin at the workshop annex located near the central parking lot. Travel to the citrus orchard and collect one crate of freshly harvested lemons at the southeast collection point. Transport the crate to the packing station inside the main storage barn. Wait for 6 minutes while the packing crew processes the delivery. After the crate has been unloaded, proceed to the equipment wash bay on the west side of the facility and await further instructions.

Begin at the equipment shed located on the east side of the greenhouse complex. Proceed to the irrigation valve station next to the northern hedgerow and pick up three water filter cartridges scheduled for maintenance. Deliver these cartridges to the pump room adjacent to the central reservoir. Wait at the pump room for up to 8 minutes while the maintenance crew inspects and exchanges the cartridges. After the crew is done, head over to the grains loading dock beside the silo cluster, pick up a pallet of fertilizer bags, and transport it to the field supply depot south of Crop Field 3. Once delivery is complete, return to the equipment shed and wait until new deployment instructions are received.

Start at the packing shed beside the vineyard entrance. Drive to the cold storage locker near the eastern orchard and pick up three crates of freshly harvested grapes. Transport the crates to the farmers' market loading area next to the greenhouse complex. Wait there for 10 minutes while staff unload the grapes. Once the delivery is complete, return to the packing shed and stand by for further assignments.

Begin at the central greenhouse entrance. Drive to the compost storage area near the south fence and pick up a pallet of biodegradable planting pots. Deliver the pallet to the seedling propagation room inside the main horticulture building. Wait for up to 8 minutes for the horticulture team to unload the pots. After unloading, proceed to the chemical storage locker adjacent to the research station and retrieve two sealed bottles of plant nutrient solution. Transport the bottles to the precision irrigation control house at the edge of Field 7, and remain there for 10 minutes under supervision before returning to the central greenhouse entrance.

Start at the equipment depot located next to the administration building. Travel to the vineyard's eastern edge to pick up two reels of irrigation tubing and a replacement water filter. Deliver these items to the maintenance crew stationed at the greenhouse complex on the southern hillside. Wait until all items have been unloaded, which could take up to 8 minutes. Afterwards, proceed to the packaging shed behind the citrus grove to collect any empty fruit bins. Bring the empty bins back to the equipment depot for cleaning.

Begin at the central loading dock beside the storage warehouse. Travel to the fertilizer depot near the western access road and pick up two sealed barrels of organic fertilizer. Transport the barrels to the northwest vineyard supply area and wait for the vineyard foreman to unload both barrels. Once the fertilizer is offloaded, proceed to the solar equipment yard behind the maintenance office and collect a crate containing replacement solar panels. Deliver the crate to the rooftop access at the research greenhouse. Wait up to 10 minutes while research staff unload the crate. After unloading is complete, return to the central loading dock and await further instructions.

Begin at the central loading platform adjacent to Barn A. Drive to the greenhouse near the northern perimeter and pick up three trays of harvested tomatoes. Deliver the trays to the produce sorting station inside Warehouse 2 for processing. Wait at the sorting station for 12 minutes while the staff inspect and unload the tomatoes. Next, travel to the irrigation pump house located by the eastern pond and collect two sealed bottles of pump lubricant. Transport the bottles to the maintenance kiosk on the main access lane. After the lubricant is unloaded, proceed to the equipment wash bay south of Barn A and wait there for your next assignment.

Start at the maintenance hub in the southeast corner of the industrial yard. Proceed to the outdoor pallet storage area near the west perimeter fence and pick up three wooden pallets containing assorted machine parts. Deliver these pallets to the assembly zone inside the large red barn. Wait for up to 6 minutes while the assembly team unloads and inspects the parts. After offloading, drive to the fuel depot near the old water tower. There, stand by for 12 minutes to be refueled by the service crew before returning to the maintenance hub for further assignments.

Drive to the parts depot adjacent to the machine workshop and collect three replacement hydraulic hoses. Deliver the hydraulic hoses to the south greenhouse maintenance bay. Upon arrival, wait until the maintenance crew has retrieved all hoses, which may take up to 7 minutes. Afterward, proceed to the recycling collection area by the east fence and pick up one container of sorted plastic waste. Deliver the container to the waste processing facility next to the main gate, then wait for 5 minutes to receive confirmation of successful drop-off before returning to the staging area outside the farm manager's office.

Begin at the seed storage alcove located beside the central farm lane. Proceed to the fertilizer depot situated at the eastern edge of the property and collect four sacks of organic fertilizer. Transport these sacks to the greenhouse potting area in the northern field. Wait until horticulture staff finish unloading all the fertilizer sacks. Afterward, head to the battery charging station next to the main barn and pick up a box of spare solar panels. Deliver the box to the remote weather monitoring station at the southwestern corner of the farmland. After leaving the solar panels, wait for 7 minutes to allow technicians to install the components, then return to the seed storage alcove to complete the assignment.

Start at the charging station near the main barn and proceed to the tool storage hut next to the eastern machinery lot. Collect a container filled with replacement drill bits. Deliver the container to the field workshop adjacent to the sunflower field. Wait until the maintenance crew has finished unloading the drill bits and gives you the go-ahead to depart. Next, navigate to the pesticide storage building on the southern farm boundary and pick up five sealed canisters of organic pesticide. Transport the canisters to the equipment sanitizing area west of the cow pasture. Wait for 10 minutes while the supervisor logs the delivery and inspects the payload. Finally, return to the charging station to complete your route.

Start at the northern orchard staging area. Navigate to the irrigation equipment bay between Field 2 and Field 3. Pick up two sealed containers of drip-line connectors and three reels of irrigation tubing. Transport these items to the vineyard's main access gate near the weather monitoring kiosk. Wait at the gate until the vineyard crew unloads all delivered materials. Once unloaded, drive to the shaded rest enclosure beside the greenhouse complex and remain there for 10 minutes to be on standby for further delivery requests.

Start at the equipment shed next to the south entrance. Drive to the fertilizer storage area beside Field 3 and pick up three bags of organic fertilizer and a small pail of soil samples. Transport these items to the experimental crop beds on the east ridge. Wait there until the agronomist confirms receipt and unloads all materials; expected wait time is approximately 8 minutes. Afterward, proceed to the supply staging zone near the maintenance barn and wait to be loaded with a spare tire and a set of wrenches. Once loaded, carry these to the utility vehicle parking lot by the northwest fence, deliver the items, and await confirmation from the service technician before ending the task.

Begin at the farm’s central charging station located next to the south parking lot. Proceed to the dairy barn entrance along Cow Lane and pick up two containers of replacement bedding material. Deliver the containers to the calf shelter in the northern pasture, near the windbreak of poplar trees. Wait at the shelter for 7 minutes as the staff offload the bedding material and prepare any used containers for return. Once the used containers are loaded onto the robot, transport them back to the sanitation storage area beside the composting yard. After drop-off, navigate to the equipment garage on Maple Drive and await additional instructions.

Begin at the machinery garage adjacent to the main field. Proceed to the seed storage facility located near the northwest irrigation pumps and collect six burlap sacks of soybean seeds. Drive the seeds to the planting equipment bay behind the western tractor depot. Wait until all six sacks have been manually unloaded and placed on the planting rigs. After unloading, move to the field-side fueling station to await a refill of diesel canisters—remain in place until a technician has completed replenishing your fuel supply. Afterwards, return directly to the machinery garage and stand by for the next scheduled task.

Start at the greenhouse supply depot near the irrigation reservoir. Pick up two boxes of tomato seedlings and a roll of plastic ground cover. Deliver these items to the northwest planting plots adjacent to the windbreak hedges. Upon arrival, wait until all items have been removed by the planting crew, which is expected to take around 6 minutes. Once unloading is finished, head to the battery swap station by the old water tower, collect a fresh power cell, and deliver it to the robotic tractor parked at the southern equipment bay. Remain there until the power cell is installed and the empty cell is loaded onto the robot, then return the empty cell to the battery swap station before reporting back to the greenhouse supply depot.

Start at the equipment shelter next to the northern greenhouse. Drive to the central feed storage barn and pick up three bags of livestock feed from the loading ramp. Proceed to the chicken coop by the western orchard and deliver the feed bags. Wait until a farmhand removes all three bags from your platform, then continue to the maintenance garage near the river crossing and wait there for 15 minutes for further instructions.

Start at the central equipment hub located near the eastern parking lot. Travel to the irrigation supplies depot beside the north field entrance and collect four rolls of drip hose. Deliver these rolls to the vegetable plot near the south farm boundary. Wait until the field crew has unloaded all hose rolls. Afterwards, move to the battery charging station near the solar array and wait 15 minutes to recharge. Once charged, proceed to the shipping dock at the western warehouse, pick up one crate of packing materials, and transport it to the farm store loading bay, located next to the main road. Wait for the store staff to unload the crate, then return to the central equipment hub to complete your assignment.

Start at the maintenance workshop adjacent to the greenhouse. Drive to the solar-powered irrigation station and pick up two coiled hose reels. Proceed to Field Plot 7, located north of the main access path, and deliver the hoses to the irrigation crew. Wait for 8 minutes while the crew installs the hoses. Once finished, continue to the north gate loading area and collect a crate of replacement irrigation valves. Transport these valves to the central greenhouse and remain there until the on-site technician removes the payload. Finally, return to the maintenance workshop and stand by for further instructions.

Start at the supply depot next to the north parking lot. Move to the citrus orchard entrance and collect five empty harvesting bins. Deliver the bins to the designated picking zone on the east side of the orchard. Wait while farmhands load two full bins of oranges onto the robot, which should take approximately 12 minutes. Transport the loaded bins to the cold storage warehouse located behind the processing facility. Immediately return to the supply depot after the warehouse team unloads the bins.

Begin at the maintenance bay near the south workshop. Drive to the equipment storage yard and pick up two sealed boxes of spare tractor parts. Proceed to the tractor refueling station at the northern end of the farm. Wait for 15 minutes while technicians unload the spare parts. Next, head to the greenhouse complex and collect a tray of gardening tools from the supply closet. Deliver the tray to the experimental crop plot on the west side of the estate, and wait until the tools are removed by the horticulture team. Once finished, return to the maintenance bay and stand by for further instructions.

Start at the supply staging area behind the north orchard. Proceed to the machinery repair bay located next to the fuel depot. Pick up a tool crate labeled 'emergency repair kit.' Transport the tool crate to the solar panel array service point at the east end of the property. Wait at the designated service area until the technician unloads all tools from the robot. Once unloading is confirmed, drive to the compost heap near the southern fence, and wait for 10 minutes while the compost manager loads two biodegradable waste bins onto the robot. After the bins are loaded, deliver them to the recycling center adjacent to the farm office, and return to the supply staging area once delivery is complete.

Start at the orchard maintenance hut near the northern apple grove. Navigate to the irrigation supply yard adjacent to the central pond and collect three replacement sprinkler heads. Proceed to the northwest orchard quadrant and deliver the sprinkler heads to the field technician station. Wait until the field technicians have removed all sprinkler heads from your platform and given clearance. Following delivery, head to the equipment wash pad near the staff canteen for a 6-minute exterior rinse. After washing, return to the orchard maintenance hut and await further task instructions.

Begin at the harvesting depot adjacent to the east orchard. Drive to the cold storage facility near the packing station and collect four crates of freshly picked pears. Transport the pears to the farmers' market loading zone beside the main gate. Wait for up to 15 minutes until all crates are unloaded by the market staff. After delivery, proceed to the field equipment shelter on the south side for end-of-shift cleaning, then return to the harvesting depot to complete the task.

Begin at the equipment storage facility near the solar panel array. Travel to the greenhouse entrance at the south side of the property and wait for two crates of fertilizer to be placed onto your platform by the greenhouse staff. Once loaded, drive to the rooftop water reservoir’s ground-level loading area and deliver the fertilizer crates to the awaiting supervisor. Wait until the supervisor unloads both crates from your platform. After delivery is confirmed, proceed to the composting yard adjacent to the north field to pick up any empty nutrient containers, then return these containers to the equipment storage facility for cleaning before ending the task.

Begin at the storage bay adjacent to the solar panel array. Navigate to the orchard’s north entry gate and pick up two crates of harvested pears waiting by the collection stand. Deliver both crates to the fruit sorting facility loading dock, located behind the refrigerated storage unit. Wait at the loading dock for 10 minutes while the sorting team inspects the fruit and returns the empty crates. Once the emptied crates have been placed back on your platform, return them to the orchard’s north entry gate. Afterwards, travel to the machinery maintenance shed and stand by for the next assignment.

Begin at the machine workshop next to the north tractor garage. Travel to the equipment yard to pick up two replacement hydraulic hoses. Deliver the hoses to the vineyard maintenance area, where the repair crew is stationed. Wait until the crew has finished unloading the hoses. Afterwards, proceed to the fuel storage station to collect a full canister of diesel. Transport the diesel canister to Harvest Field 3's refueling site. Once the canister is delivered, stand by for 10 minutes in case additional tools or supplies are requested, then return to the machine workshop to await further instructions.

Begin at the workshop bay adjacent to the old barn. Travel to the solar inverter station on the west ridge and retrieve two boxes of replacement fuses.
