Deliver the fuse boxes to the electrical control room inside the main greenhouse. Wait while the technician confirms receipt of all boxes, which may take about 5 minutes. Once the task is complete, proceed to the machinery yard near the equipment sheds and wait to be refueled before returning to the workshop bay.

Start at the maintenance garage beside the central workshop. Travel to the solar panel array on top of hill crest and collect two toolboxes left by the electrical maintenance crew. Proceed to the pump station office at the base of the east slope and unload both toolboxes. Remain stationary for 5 minutes while you await the technician’s inspection sign-off. Once completed, continue to the orchard’s southern gate and pick up four crates of freshly harvested peaches stacked on a wooden pallet. Deliver the crates to the farmers’ market stand in the northwest corner of the farm. After delivering the crates, return to the maintenance garage and await your next task.

Start at the equipment shelter near the irrigation reservoir. Drive to the tractor supply yard adjacent to the western stables and pick up two crates of replacement tractor parts. Deliver the crates to the machine repair bay inside the mechanical workshop. Wait for technicians to finish unloading all tractor parts, then proceed to the livestock feed shed to collect a bag of grain supplements. Take the grain supplements to the eastern pasture gate and wait 5 minutes for the ranch staff to handle distribution. Once the waiting period is over, return to the equipment shelter and park in front of the tool storage area.

From the south gate entry point, travel to the row crop storage pad near the east fence. Pick up three sacks of fertilizer placed on the loading platform. Deliver the sacks to the rooftop garden access hallway inside the research lab building. Wait until a lab technician removes all sacks, then continue to the old apiary shed next to the field station and stand by there for 15 minutes for further directions.

Begin at the tool storage locker adjacent to the northern orchard gate. Proceed to the compost site at the eastern edge of the farm and pick up two bins of freshly processed compost material. Transport both bins to the vineyard section closest to the irrigation canal. Wait for the vineyard crew to remove the bins and signal completion. Once unloaded, head to the weather monitoring station beside the central gravel road and collect a metal box containing spare sensors. Deliver the box to the maintenance shed behind the farm garage and await further instructions.

Begin at the maintenance garage adjacent to the workshop annex. Travel to the north field tool drop-off zone and pick up two crates of pruning shears. Deliver the crates to the orchard equipment bay located beside the apple grove. Wait until the field supervisor confirms the crates have been unloaded from the robot. Afterwards, proceed to the pesticide storage bunker near the gravel service road, collect a sealed container of organic pesticide, and transport it to the greenhouse loading ramp next to the glasshouse. Wait at the greenhouse until the greenhouse manager removes the pesticide container. Finally, return to the maintenance garage and stand by for further assignments.

Begin at the loading dock beside the north entrance. Proceed to the solar panel array situated beyond the irrigation pond and pick up any loose debris nets left by the maintenance crew. Transport all collected nets to the utility shed next to the weather monitoring station. Wait at the shed for 4 minutes to allow staff to inspect and unload the nets. Afterwards, travel to the livestock feed storage barn on the southwestern corner of the property to collect two empty feed bins. Deliver the empty bins to the grain silo service area along the farm road. Wait until a worker removes both bins from the robot, then proceed to the vehicle washing station near the entrance gate and stand by for further tasks.

Start at the produce packing barn near the west orchard entrance. Travel to the cold storage facility behind the greenhouse and pick up a pallet containing freshly harvested strawberries. Deliver the pallet to the farm market loading bay by the main road. Wait for 12 minutes while the market staff inspects and unloads the strawberries. Next, proceed to the maintenance supply room adjacent to the storage silos. Pick up a single box of small metal fasteners marked 'Shed Repairs.' Transport this box to the tool shed beside the east irrigation canal. Wait until a technician arrives and removes the box from your platform before returning to the produce packing barn to complete your assigned route.

Begin at the central depot near the farm’s main entrance. Proceed to the irrigation pump house by the western field and pick up three coils of replacement hosing. Deliver the hosing to the vineyard maintenance cart parked at Sector D. Wait for 8 minutes while workers secure the coils onto the cart. Next, travel to the packaging warehouse located behind the fruit sorting station. Collect a pallet of empty crates from the warehouse loading area. Transport the pallet to the freshly harvested blueberry patch in Field 7, then wait until all crates have been removed from your platform before returning to the central depot.

Start at the maintenance depot adjacent to the east storage warehouse. Drive to the solar panel array located on the hillside above the grain silos. Pick up the three replacement solar inverters positioned in the designated parts bay. Transport these inverters to the roof access ramp at the central operations building. Wait for 5 minutes while the maintenance team unloads the inverters and checks them against their repair manifest. Afterwards, proceed to the composting yard near the equipment wash station to collect a container of organic waste. Deliver the container to the soil enrichment plot behind the greenhouse dome and wait until the container has been fully emptied. Once finished, return to the maintenance depot adjacent to the east storage warehouse.

Begin at the maintenance hub near the south entrance. Proceed to the seed storage bunker adjacent to the greenhouse complex and collect two bags of fertilizer marked 'Spring Mix.' Deliver the bags to plot 7 at the east field boundary next to the weather station. Wait until a field hand removes both bags, with a maximum wait time of 10 minutes. After unloading, navigate to the parts warehouse beside the machine assembly lot, pick up a replacement wheel assembly, and bring it to the orchard service trail near row 12. Wait there for the service crew to retrieve the wheel assembly, then return to the maintenance hub for standby.

Begin at the equipment shelter next to the irrigation pond. Drive to the scrapyard adjacent to the northern fence and collect one pallet of damaged gears. Take the pallet to the recycling corner by the west gate, and wait up to 5 minutes while the recycling team offloads the gears. Next, proceed to the workshop near the solar panel test yard and retrieve a crate of calibration tools. Deliver the crate to the satellite monitoring station behind the main barn. Once delivered, wait until a technician verifies receipt, then return to the equipment shelter to end the task.

Drive to the fertilizer storage bunker at the south field entrance and pick up three sealed bags of quick-release fertilizer. Transport the bags to the irrigation control station beside Greenhouse 4. Leave the fertilizer in the marked drop-off zone and wait for 15 minutes to allow staff to retrieve the bags. Once the waiting period is over, proceed to the equipment wash area behind the service garage and await your next assignment.

Begin at the truck loading bay on the south side of the logistics warehouse. Travel to the produce sorting station located at the southern edge of the apple orchard. Pick up four crates of sorted apples labeled for shipment. Deliver these crates to the cold storage facility next to the greenhouse complex. Wait for the storage crew to unload the apple crates and confirm receipt. Then proceed to the irrigation equipment shed southeast of the storage facility and collect a box of replacement sprinkler nozzles. Bring the box to the center of the east barley field where the irrigation crew is stationed, and wait as long as needed for the crew to remove the nozzles from your payload. Once unloaded, return directly to the truck loading bay.

Begin at the workshop located beside the central farm road. Navigate to the solar panel array at the field’s eastern perimeter and pick up two malfunctioning photovoltaic modules. Deliver these modules to the tech lab adjacent to the administrative office for diagnostics. Wait for 5 minutes while the technician inspects and confirms receipt of the modules. Next, proceed to the barn storage area near the silo and collect a bundle of replacement irrigation hoses. Transport the hoses to the lettuce patch along the northern ridge. Wait until the field crew has unloaded all hoses from your platform, then return to the workshop and remain there on standby until further instructions are received.

Start at the central loading bay adjacent to the farm entrance. Make your way to the cold storage annex behind the dairy facility and pick up four sealed crates of harvested strawberries. Deliver the crates to the market vendor tent set up near the west gate. Wait until all crates have been unloaded by the vendor assistants. After delivery, proceed to the irrigation control station beside the southern rice paddies and collect one replacement pump component. Bring the component to the head mechanic waiting at the repair workshop and wait to be unloaded before returning to the central loading bay for the next task.

Start at the maintenance garage near the west field access road. Navigate to the pesticide storage shed behind the irrigation pumps and pick up two sealed canisters of organic pesticide. Deliver the canisters to the crop spraying zone at the north cornfield boundary. Wait at the drop-off point until the field supervisor signs off on the delivery and collects both canisters. Once confirmation is received, proceed to the employee tool station near the solar equipment platform and retrieve a portable toolbox. Bring the toolbox to the machinery repair pad between the tractor bay and equipment wash area. Wait for 8 minutes while the repair crew uses the tools, then return to the maintenance garage and stand by for the next task.

Begin at the equipment garage adjacent to the southern vineyard access road. Proceed to the solar array maintenance yard located northwest of the property and collect a crate containing solar panel cleaning supplies. Drive the crate to the southeast storage cabin by the apple grove and wait there until a technician removes all cleaning supplies from the payload area. Once unloaded, continue to the cattle corral feed station, where three empty mineral supplement bins need to be picked up. Transport the empty bins to the recycling depot behind the main farm office, deliver them, and wait for 12 minutes for staff to process the bins. After processing is complete, return to the equipment garage to conclude your assignment.

Begin at the vehicle maintenance garage and drive to the lumber storage area near the north boundary fence. Load two pallets of treated timber boards onto the robot. Proceed with the timber to the greenhouse assembly site on the west hillside. Remain at the site until the construction team removes the pallets. Then, continue to the seed storage shed behind the grain silos, and pick up a heavy-duty sack of corn seeds. Deliver the sack to the automated planter staging area beside the central field. After the delivery is confirmed by staff, wait for 5 minutes in case any further materials need to be transported before heading back to the vehicle maintenance garage.

Start at the maintenance garage beside the vehicle parking lot. Drive to the eastern orchard entrance and pick up three crates of freshly picked peaches. Deliver the crates to the refrigerated storage unit at the packaging facility near the north boundary. Wait for the packaging team to unload all three crates. Next, travel to the tool shed on the west side of the farm and collect a set of replacement pruning shears. Transport the shears to the vineyard trellis zone, and wait for 10 minutes while the vineyard crew completes their tool check-in. Once finished, return to the maintenance garage to complete the task.

Start at the field supply depot adjacent to the north tractor lane. Drive to the irrigation control station near the eastern wheat plots. Pick up the container of irrigation sensors waiting at the designated pick-up zone. Transport the container to the greenhouse complex on the eastern side of the farm. Upon arrival, wait for the greenhouse crew to unload the irrigation sensors, which should take approximately 10 minutes. Following unloading, collect a bundle of empty planter trays from the greenhouse loading dock. Deliver the empty trays to the composting facility beside the south orchard. Wait at the composting facility until all trays are removed, then return to the field supply depot to complete your task.

Begin at the storage barn adjacent to the east orchard. Drive to the compost pile at the southern perimeter and collect three empty compost bins and a sack of mulching straw. Head to the apple grove at Hilltop Section C and deliver the bins and straw to the workers. Pause for 12 minutes while the crew fills the bins with orchard trimmings and places them onto your platform. Once loaded, transport the full compost bins to the waste management station next to the tractor garage. After depositing the bins, proceed to the repair shelter located beside the west irrigation canal and stand by until the maintenance supervisor unloads any remaining items from your platform.

Start at the north gate parking area and proceed directly to the greenhouse loading dock beside Lily Pond Lane. Pick up a pallet containing four crates of assorted seedlings. Deliver the pallet to the main field planting zone near the western windbreak. Wait at the drop-off spot until the planting supervisor removes all crates, which is expected to take about 12 minutes. Afterward, continue to the water pump station by the southern hedgerow, collect two coiled irrigation hoses, and return these to the greenhouse tool storage area. Once all items have been delivered, remain at the greenhouse loading dock until further tasks are assigned.

Start at the logistics hub next to the main entrance gate. Navigate to the fertilizer storage facility beside the barn and pick up four sacks of organic fertilizer. Drive to Orchard Lane and deliver the fertilizer to the section marked 'Row A'. Wait for the field crew to unload all four sacks, then proceed to the machinery shed at the eastern perimeter. Collect a crate containing mechanical lubricants and a toolbox. Take these items to the wind turbine maintenance pad on Hilltop Ridge. Wait for 20 minutes while the maintenance crew services the turbines and removes the toolbox. After the items have been taken, return to the logistics hub and prepare for your next assignment.

Start at the maintenance garage situated behind the grain silo complex. Drive to the wind turbine control kiosk near the northern field perimeter and collect a toolbox containing three specialized diagnostic devices. Transport the toolbox to the solar panel array worksite next to the irrigation canal. Wait until the engineers finish installing all devices, then retrieve any unused equipment and deliver the toolbox back to the maintenance garage. Upon return, stand by for 5 minutes in the loading bay for any emergency service requests.

Begin at the parts storage yard beside the main entrance gate. Collect a pallet containing eight replacement conveyor belts and three cartons of fasteners. Transport these items to the packing house maintenance workshop, located at the rear of the cold storage facility. After arrival, wait for the maintenance supervisor to inspect and unload all delivered components; this process may take up to 12 minutes. Once the supervisor confirms unloading is complete, proceed to the shade canopy near the solar panel array and await further assignment for 5 minutes.

Begin at the equipment garage adjacent to the maintenance depot. Drive to the fertilizer depot located at the end of the south access road. Pick up three bags of slow-release granular fertilizer. Transport the fertilizer to the community orchard, stopping at the central tool shelter near the apple rows. Wait there for 8 minutes while the orchard team unloads all bags. Once unloading is complete, continue to the compost yard next to the old silo and pick up an empty collection bin. Return the empty bin to the equipment garage and remain there awaiting further instructions.

Start at the maintenance shed beside the orchard entrance. Proceed to the chemical supply depot to pick up three sealed containers of pesticides. Deliver the containers to the northern apple grove staging area. Wait until the orchard team has fully removed the pesticide containers from your cargo bed. After unloading, continue to the workshop adjacent to the east tractor bay to collect a toolkit. Transport the toolkit to the solar field operations cabin, and wait there for 5 minutes until a technician verifies the delivery. Once verification is complete, return directly to the maintenance shed.

Start at the central logistics hub and drive to the north field storage area. Pick up three sacks of fertilizer from the storage bins. Proceed to greenhouse 3 near the irrigation pond and deliver the sacks at the fertilizer drop-off point. Wait for up to 10 minutes until the greenhouse staff confirms the unloaded materials. Then, travel to the east loading dock and wait until two empty soil trays are placed onto the robot—this could take several minutes. Once loaded, bring the soil trays back to the central logistics hub and await further directions at the receiving bay.

Start at the equipment bay in the southwest corner of the main storage yard. Drive to the pesticide storage shed near the eastern side of the orchard. Pick up two sealed pesticide canisters located on the marked pallet beside the entrance. Proceed to the drone charging station behind the windbreak grove, and deliver the canisters to the technician on duty. Wait up to 10 minutes for the technician to unload both canisters. After delivery, return to the equipment bay in the storage yard and remain there until new tasks are assigned.

Start at the loading dock adjacent to the grain mill. Proceed to the solar-powered produce chiller behind Greenhouse 1 and pick up three baskets of cooled strawberries. Transport the baskets to the farm market stall near the entrance gate. Wait for 10 minutes while the market staff unload the baskets and confirm inventory receipt. Once cleared, return to the compost processing area behind the south field equipment shed and await the arrival of the next load.

Begin at the maintenance garage next to the northern vineyard entrance. Drive to the fertilizer storage unit located behind the greenhouse cluster and pick up three sacks of organic fertilizer. Deliver the fertilizer sacks to the orchard edge composting area, just south of the windbreak hedgerow, and wait until farm staff finish unloading all sacks from your platform. Then proceed to the workshop annex near the eastern perimeter fence to collect a sealed crate of irrigation drippers. Transport this crate to the tomato field’s supply station at row 12, and remain there for seven minutes to allow the field crew to unload the drippers. After completing this task, drive to the central operations pad beside the field HQ and remain on standby for further instructions.

Begin at the north gate security post. Drive to the seed warehouse located along the western service road. Pick up three wooden crates containing corn seed from just inside the warehouse entrance. Transport the crates to the planting equipment staging area in the central field. Wait until a field operator confirms all crates have been received and unloaded, which should take around 6 minutes. Once confirmation is given, proceed to the solar panel maintenance zone adjacent to the supply workshop, and stand by for further instructions.

Begin at the main irrigation reservoir checkpoint. Navigate to the harvest storage barn adjacent to the southern loading ramp and collect three crates of freshly picked strawberries. Deliver the strawberry crates to the cold storage unit beside the west orchard fence. Wait until the storage supervisor has scanned all crates and confirms successful delivery. Next, proceed to the maintenance workshop near the farm’s north entrance and pick up a sealed crate of engine parts. Transport the crate to the machinery shed in the sunflower field and remain there for 15 minutes to allow the mechanic team to unload the shipment. Afterwards, return to the main irrigation reservoir checkpoint and await further tasks.

Start at the chemical storage shed near the greenhouse complex. Drive to the east orchard and collect four empty pesticide sprayer tanks. Bring the empty tanks to the decontamination station next to the main admin building and wait while the crew rinses the tanks (approximately 12 minutes). Once the tanks are cleaned, proceed to the supply depot at the north end of the farm, pick up three full sacks of fertilizer pellets, and deliver them to the distribution platform inside the vineyard annex. Return to the chemical storage shed to complete the assignment.

Begin your route at the maintenance workshop near the central water tower. Pick up two containers of lubricating oil designated for the tractor fleet. Drive to the equipment yard adjoining the east perimeter fence and deliver the oil containers. Wait for the maintenance team to retrieve all containers from your platform. Next, travel to the field gate adjacent to the old barn and collect a bundled stack of empty crates intended for apple collection. Proceed with the crates to the southern orchard edge and wait until the field workers have finished unloading. Once all crates are removed, return directly to the maintenance workshop to complete your assignment.

Begin at the solar array control building at the northern edge of the property. Drive to the battery storage enclosure near the wind turbine and collect a medium-sized crate labeled 'Replacement Fuses'. Transport the crate to the electrical maintenance bay located near the central operations tower. Wait for 10 minutes while the maintenance engineer verifies the contents and unloads the crate. Once the crate has been removed, proceed to the staff canteen on the second floor of the main administrative building. Pick up two empty water coolers and deliver them to the water refill station adjacent to the south parking lot. After delivering the water coolers, return to the solar array control building and await further directions.

Begin at the supply depot beside the north gate. Travel to the vineyard sorting station located next to the irrigation reservoir and collect six empty harvest bins. Transport the bins to the east field grape picking area and wait until the field workers have fully loaded the bins with fresh grapes. Once all bins are loaded, deliver them to the cold storage building behind the main winery. Wait up to 15 minutes for the unloading process to be completed. After unloading, drive to the maintenance bay adjacent to the biodiesel pump and pick up a sealed package of replacement air filters. Finally, deliver these filters to the garage in the southwest corner of the property and stand by until a garage attendant confirms receipt.

Begin at the west field charging station. Drive to the northeastern greenhouse and pick up three sealed bags of organic soil enhancer. Deliver these bags to the rooftop gardening terrace above the equipment storage barn. Wait for 10 minutes while the gardening team unloads the bags. Once unloaded, proceed to the main feed silo near the cattle enclosures and collect a spare feed auger. Transport the feed auger to the mechanical workshop adjacent to the southern access road and wait until a technician removes it from your payload bay.

Start at the maintenance shed next to the vehicle refueling station. Navigate to the irrigation control center along the southern canal to pick up four coiled hoses and a box of sensor modules. Deliver these items to the eastern orchard pump house and wait until the field technician has unloaded all equipment. Next, travel to the grain storage silo beside the operations office and collect two sacks of rye seed. Bring the sacks to the planter staging area near the tractor shed and wait for 5 minutes as planting teams retrieve the seeds. After all tasks are complete, return to the maintenance shed and await further assignment.

Start from the charging station adjacent to the main storage barn. Drive to the machinery shed near the east paddock and pick up two crates of replacement engine parts. Transport the crates to the maintenance workshop beside the central access road. Wait for the workshop team to arrive and unload the engine parts, which could take up to 12 minutes. As soon as all crates are fully unloaded, proceed to the orchard tool depot north of the irrigation lake and await further instructions.

Start at the main entrance of the vineyard. Drive to the irrigation supply station beside the east windbreak and pick up three sealed containers of fertilizer solution. Transport the containers to plot section C3, located near the southern vineyard boundary. Wait while the field crew connects hoses and unloads the containers, which should take approximately 10 minutes. After delivery, return to the irrigation supply station and pick up any empty containers left from earlier deliveries, then transport these back to the maintenance garage located behind the vineyard office and wait there for further loading instructions.

Start from the south entrance of the grain processing facility. Proceed to the palletized seed storage shed and collect four bags of high-yield barley seeds. Deliver the seed bags to the remote planting outpost located at the base of Hilltop Plot C. Wait for 10 minutes as planting personnel unload the seed bags. After all bags are removed, continue to the irrigation intake control house near the canal bridge. Pick up an empty water testing kit and bring it to the water sampling station on the eastern levee. Stay at the sampling station until the laboratory technician removes the kit from the robot’s platform. Once the kit has been removed, return to the south entrance of the grain processing facility and await further tasks.

Begin your operation at the storage garage beside the solar panel array. Head over to the irrigation supply station next to the west pond and pick up three sealed water canisters. Deliver the canisters to the eastern crop trial plot entrance. Wait for the agricultural technician to offload all canisters. After unloading, proceed to the compost collection point behind the farm office and collect one large bin of organic compost. Transport the bin to the vineyard staging area along the hillside and wait for 15 minutes while the crew applies the compost to the vines. Once your platform is empty, return to the storage garage for end-of-task verification.

Start at the workshop entrance adjacent to the equipment garage. Drive to the central repair bay and pick up the blue toolbox containing diagnostic sensors. Transport the toolbox to the irrigation control shed beside the western field and wait until the maintenance supervisor removes the toolbox, which may require up to 6 minutes. After unloading, proceed to the machinery refueling station on the south perimeter, collect a single container of engine oil, and deliver it to the tractor hangar across from the windbreak line. Once the container has been handed over, head back to the workshop entrance and stand by for further instructions.

Begin at the machinery shelter adjacent to the grain silo. Drive to the fertilizer storage shed on the south edge of the main crop field and collect two bags of granular fertilizer. Deliver the bags to the eastern orchard’s main entry, where farm staff will collect them. Wait up to 5 minutes for the staff to unload both bags. Next, proceed to the maintenance workshop behind the dairy barn and collect a toolbox containing equipment repair parts. Transport the toolbox to the greenhouse maintenance area, which is located near the north pond. Leave the toolbox at the designated drop-off point, then return to the machinery shelter to finish your route.

Begin at the equipment garage next to the main service road. Proceed to the fertilizer storage shed located behind the western fields. Wait at the loading platform for the field supervisor to place two sealed drums of fertilizer onto the robot. Once loaded, transport the fertilizer drums to the crop trial plots along the southern perimeter of the property. Upon arrival, wait until the maintenance crew unloads both drums—this should require approximately 12 minutes. After unloading, drive to the machine maintenance workshop near the water tower to pick up a toolbox. Return the toolbox to the equipment garage to complete your route.

Start at the maintenance bay next to the solar panel array. Travel to the orchard packing area and pick up four bins of freshly harvested apples. Deliver the bins to the cold storage warehouse at the north end of the property. Wait at the warehouse until all bins are unloaded by the staff, which may take up to 12 minutes. After unloading is confirmed, proceed to the lumber storage lot near the workshop, collect a box of replacement chainsaw blades, and transport it to the forestry equipment station beside the western tree line. Once delivery is complete, return to the maintenance bay for further instructions.

Begin at the solar charging station near the main entrance gate. Travel to the orchard's north storage shed and pick up a pallet containing twelve harvest baskets. Deliver the baskets to the sorting table area beside the eastern grove. Wait for the harvest crew to unload all twelve baskets, which may take up to 10 minutes. Once the baskets are unloaded, proceed to the composting site on the southern boundary of the orchard and collect two empty compost bins. Return these bins to the storage shed where you originally picked up the harvest baskets.

Begin your mission at the maintenance shed adjacent to the tractor lot. Travel to the seed storage facility located at the southern edge of the cornfield and pick up four crates of hybrid maize seeds. Deliver these crates to the field operations tent near the main irrigation pivot. Wait for ten minutes while the field crew unloads the seeds. Next, proceed to the chemical storage enclosure across from the livestock barn and wait until a technician places two sealed pesticide containers onto your platform. Drive these containers to the high tunnel greenhouse entryway. Remain in position until both containers are removed, then return to the maintenance shed to complete your task report.

Begin at the vehicle charging station adjacent to the south parking area. Proceed to the greenhouse loading dock and pick up three trays of young tomato plants destined for replanting. Transport the trays to Field Plot C on the eastern slope and wait up to 8 minutes for field staff to unload all trays. After the trays are removed, continue to the pesticide storage shed next to the windmill and collect a sealed drum of organic pesticide. Deliver the drum to the crop dusting staging zone between the sunflower fields and wait until a technician unloads the drum. Once empty, return directly to the vehicle charging station and prepare for the next task.

Begin at the south field maintenance garage and travel to the irrigation pump house beside the central reservoir. Pick up a waterproof case containing four sensor modules from the pump house entryway. Deliver the case to the precision agriculture monitoring station next to the grain silo. Wait for 10 minutes while the station technician installs and inspects the sensor modules. After the technician confirms completion, proceed to the north side cattle gate and collect one replacement hydraulic hose lying next to the gate. Bring the hose to the utility vehicle bay at the east equipment yard. Once the hose has been unloaded, return to the south field maintenance garage to stand by for further assignments.

Start at the greenhouse loading bay on the south side of the property. Drive to the auxiliary irrigation control shed by following the gravel access path. Pick up the box of replacement drip line connectors from inside the control shed. Transport the box to the vineyard’s east perimeter station near row 14. Wait until the ground crew retrieves all items from the robot, which may take approximately 8 minutes. Once unloaded, head to the compost transfer point beside the maintenance garage and wait there until the next assignment is communicated.

Begin at the farm central depot. Travel to the post-harvest storage barn to pick up three boxes of harvested corn. Proceed to the grain drying facility next to Silo 2 and deliver the corn boxes. Wait at the drying facility for up to 10 minutes while the boxes are unloaded by the staff. Then, continue to the solar-powered charging station behind the compost yard. Wait at the charging station for 7 minutes to allow for battery recharge before returning to the farm central depot to complete your route.

Start at the receiving pad next to the north parking lot. Drive to the orchard barn and pick up two crates of harvested pears. Transport the crates to the cold storage unit behind the main sorting facility and wait for the storage technician to unload both crates. After the crates are removed, proceed to the workshop garage near the service road and collect one sealed toolbox. Deliver the toolbox to the irrigation pump station by the east pond. Wait for 6 minutes or until a maintenance worker takes the toolbox from your cargo area. Once the toolbox is delivered, return to the receiving pad and stand by for your next assignment.

Start at the gravel courtyard in front of the maintenance garage. Travel to the vineyard at the southern boundary and pick up three crates of harvested grapes from station B. Deliver the crates to the cold storage facility next to the packing house. Wait for 10 minutes while the storage supervisor inspects and logs the delivery. Once cleared, move to the water filtration shed by the pond, pick up a sealed canister of water treatment chemicals, and deliver it to the greenhouse utility entrance. Remain at the greenhouse until the staff has removed the canister from your platform, then return to the maintenance garage and await further orders.

Begin at the equipment garage beside the northern entrance gate. Drive to the solar panel clearing near the research outpost and pick up a crate of replacement photovoltaic modules along with two toolcases. Proceed with these items to the rooftop access of the administrative building. Wait until engineering staff unload all payloads, which may take up to 12 minutes. After unloading, head to the livestock barn to collect three empty feed containers. Transport the empty containers to the sterilization facility adjacent to the animal health clinic. Once all deliveries are made, return to the equipment garage to await your next instructions.

Proceed to the fertilizer silo located behind the southern warehouse and pick up a pallet containing fertilizer bags. Transport the pallet to the irrigation control area in the central field. Wait until the field team has unloaded all the bags from your platform. Then, move to the loading dock by the machinery shed to collect two replacement hydraulic hoses. Deliver the hoses to the northern tractor maintenance bay, wait for 5 minutes while the mechanic removes them from your loading area, and finally return to the fertilizer silo to await further instructions.

Start at the maintenance garage and proceed to the equipment shed near the eastern field. Pick up two replacement water pumps. Deliver both pumps to the irrigation control center at the southern orchard. Wait at the control center for 12 minutes while the on-site engineers inspect and offload the equipment. Afterward, continue to the weather monitoring station adjacent to the main entrance gate, and wait there for further instructions before departing the area.

Start at the main storage barn adjacent to the north field entrance. Proceed to the vineyard harvest area past the windbreak and collect two crates of freshly picked grapes. Transport the grape crates to the cooling tunnel near the winery entrance. Wait for harvest staff to unload both crates, which should take approximately 10 minutes. After unloading, move to the supply depot near the equipment wash pad and pick up a sealed container of lubricating oil. Deliver the oil to the machinery maintenance zone next to the field workshop. Once the container is received by the maintenance crew, return to the main storage barn and remain on standby for your next assignment.

Begin at the central tool storage hut near the farm workshop. Proceed to the solar equipment yard beside the southwestern pond. Pick up three replacement solar panels and a crate of mounting brackets. Deliver these items to the maintenance scaffolding located behind the mill. Wait until the technicians have removed all solar panels from your cargo area, then return to the tool storage hut and stand by for 5 minutes before taking on new assignments.

Start at the loading bay adjacent to the main greenhouse entrance. Move to the fertilizer storage silo beside the eastern paddock and pick up two sacks of organic fertilizer. Deliver the sacks to the tomato field staging area near Plot 3. Wait until both sacks are unloaded from your platform. Once your cargo area is empty, proceed to the equipment supply bunkers near the old tractor shed and retrieve a toolbox containing irrigation repair tools. Take the toolbox to the crop monitoring drone station close to the south fence line and wait for 10 minutes or until the toolbox is removed from your bay, whichever happens first. After completing deliveries, head back to the loading bay and await further instructions.

Start at the maintenance hub located beside the west field irrigation controls. Drive to the spare parts depot at the edge of the machinery yard and collect four hydraulic cylinder assemblies. Carry the assemblies to the vineyard equipment workshop and wait for technicians to unload each item, which should take approximately 8 minutes. After unloading is complete, proceed to the remote beehive enclosure in the southern apiary to pick up two full honey storage canisters. Deliver the canisters to the cooling room at the farm product warehouse and wait for all items to be removed before returning to the maintenance hub for standby.

Start at the solar charging station adjacent to the greenhouse complex. Travel to the irrigation control hut situated north of the vegetable fields and pick up four sealed containers of calibration solution. Deliver the containers to the sensor mounting platform midway along the eastern vineyard edge. Wait for the vineyard technician to retrieve all four containers and acknowledge receipt. Next, navigate to the storage compound next to the south farm gate to collect two boxes of spare irrigation emitters. Bring these boxes to the maintenance staging area inside the greenhouse complex and remain there until a crew member removes both boxes. Finally, return to the solar charging station and stand by for the next assignment.

Head to the supply depot situated next to the west storage barn and pick up four sealed cartons of irrigation drip lines. Deliver the cartons to the newly tilled plot at the edge of the north field. Wait for the installation crew to unload the cartons from your platform. Afterwards, proceed to the equipment garage near the main entrance and collect a toolbox designated for field repairs. Transport the toolbox to the central repair station at the greenhouse complex. Remain at the repair station for 12 minutes while technicians use the tools and then, once the toolbox is retrieved, return to the supply depot for your next assignment.

Start at the refueling station next to the vehicle garage. Proceed to the fertilizer depot situated behind the southern greenhouse and pick up three sealed barrels of liquid fertilizer. Transport these barrels to the irrigation control center, which is located along the eastern canal. Upon arrival, wait for the agronomy team to connect the refill hoses and fully empty the barrels—this may take about 10 minutes. Once unloading is complete, return the empty barrels to the fertilizer depot. Finally, head to the observation platform near the field monitoring tower and stand by there for further instructions.

Begin at the logistics hub near Seed Storage Facility A. Drive to the packing barn entrance and collect a pallet with six boxes of fresh lettuce. Transport the pallet to the market loading zone beside the South Gate. Wait until the produce supervisor signs off on the delivery, which typically takes 4 minutes. After sign-off, proceed to the equipment garage and pick up a single box labeled 'Irrigation Fittings'. Deliver this box to Field Plot 5A irrigation station, then return directly to the logistics hub near Seed Storage Facility A.

Start at the equipment shelter beside the south greenhouse. Proceed to the irrigation supply station on the west field perimeter and pick up three sealed water canisters. Deliver the canisters to the berry patch maintenance area near the central windbreak. Wait until farm personnel remove all the canisters, which should take approximately 5 minutes. Once unloaded, drive to the pesticide storage enclosure at the northeast corner of the property and pick up a locked containment box. Deliver the containment box to the safety inspection office next to the main parking lot. After drop-off, return to the equipment shelter beside the south greenhouse and await further instructions.

Begin at the machinery depot next to the administration office. Travel to the compost pile at the northern edge of the property and pick up three bio-waste bags. Deliver the bags to the soil enrichment center behind the orchard packing shed. Wait up to 8 minutes for the agronomist to unload the bags. Afterward, proceed to the tool locker adjacent to the drone landing pad and retrieve a toolbox requested by the maintenance crew. Take the toolbox to the equipment shelter at the east field boundary, wait until the crew removes it, then return to the machinery depot to conclude your task.

Begin at the seed warehouse next to the greenhouse complex. Head to the equipment yard located north of the storage silos and pick up two replacement hydraulic pumps. Deliver the pumps to the field repair zone on the southern edge of Field 8. Wait for the maintenance technician to install the pumps and confirm receipt, which may require up to 8 minutes. Once confirmed, proceed to the nearby compost collection area and retrieve a single bin of organic waste. Transport this bin to the composting facility adjacent to the eastern perimeter fence, then return to the seed warehouse and stand by for further instructions.

Begin at the loading dock adjacent to the fabrication workshop. Pick up a pallet containing eight sealed boxes of electronic components. Navigate to the assembly line storage cage near the eastern perimeter and deliver the pallet to the intake platform. Once the boxes are unloaded by the assembly crew, proceed to the pesticide storage shed behind the main greenhouse and wait until two chemical canisters are positioned on your platform. After confirming the load is secure, deliver the canisters to the crop spraying zone access gate on the southern field edge. Wait for 12 minutes while the field team removes the canisters for refilling operations. After your platform is clear, return to the fabrication workshop via the west path and stand by at the designated parking area for further instructions.

Start at the logistics hub near the greenhouse complex and proceed to the west vineyard entrance. Pick up four sealed boxes of grape samples scheduled for quality testing. Deliver the boxes to the laboratory loading dock situated behind the administration building. Wait for the laboratory technician to collect all the samples, which may take up to 10 minutes. Once the boxes are collected, proceed to the solar panel array behind the machinery depot for your next assignment.

Start at the orchard equipment bay adjacent to the south orchard. Drive to the pesticide chemical storage shed near the east perimeter fence. Pick up one sealed crate of approved pesticide canisters. Transport the crate to the vineyard supply drop-off zone at the northwest corner of the property. Wait for vineyard staff to fully unload the pesticide canisters, which may take up to 10 minutes. Once unloading is complete, proceed to the weather monitoring station by the farm entrance gate and wait there for the next assignment.

Begin at the equipment yard adjacent to the fuel station. Drive to Storage Shed 3 near the southern tree line and pick up three containers of fertilizer pellets. Transport the containers to Field Row A5 beside the canal. Wait for 12 minutes while the field team unloads all fertilizer containers from your cargo area. Once the containers are unloaded, proceed to the maintenance hangar and await further instructions.

Begin at the logistics shed beside the eastern solar panel array. Head to the fertilizer supply bunkers next to the orchard’s north fence and collect three 25-kilogram sacks of organic fertilizer. Transport the sacks to the citrus grove irrigation control center and wait for the grove manager to unload each sack—a process expected to take about 6 minutes. Once unloaded, proceed to the equipment cleaning bay located behind the greenhouse complex and wait for 10 minutes while your exterior is washed and inspected. When the cleaning is complete, return to the logistics shed to await further deployment instructions.

Begin at the main greenhouse control center and proceed to the irrigation equipment yard behind the barn. Pick up two crates of new drip tubing. Transport both crates to the berry patch maintenance area along the north creek. Wait at the maintenance area until all new drip tubing is unloaded by the field technicians, which should take about 8 minutes. After unloading, travel to the compost bin near the solar array and collect any empty spools left there. Return the empty spools to the irrigation equipment yard for storage. Finally, park at the equipment recharging station behind the greenhouse.

Begin at the main gate checkpoint near the perimeter road. Proceed to the solar panel array maintenance zone at the south field edge and collect a crate of photovoltaic cleaning supplies. Navigate to the renewable energy control room behind the grain silos and wait for up to 12 minutes until staff unload the crate. Once the crate is removed, continue to the northern loading dock by the vehicle garage and pick up three sealed barrels of lubricating oil. Deliver the barrels to the machinery workshop near the orchard entrance. After ensuring delivery is complete, return to the main gate checkpoint and stand by for your next assignment.

Start at the central storage depot adjacent to the old windmill. Proceed to the vineyard’s southern tool rack and pick up two boxes of harvest gloves. Deliver the gloves to the grape-picking crew stationed at checkpoint Alpha near row sixteen. Wait for the crew supervisor to confirm delivery, then drive to the composting yard behind the barn and collect a sealed bin of organic waste. Transport the bin to the biogas processing facility next to the south field entrance and wait for facility staff to unload the bin. Once your platform is empty, return to the central storage depot for debriefing.

Begin at the equipment shelter near the eastern orchard fence. Travel to the solar panel array by the utility road and pick up one box of replacement inverters. Deliver the box to the control cabin at the edge of the solar field, and wait for 5 minutes while the technicians unload the equipment. Once completed, continue to the livestock feed depot near barn 3. Collect two bags of mineral feed supplements and transport them to the animal care bay in the main stable area. Wait until both bags have been removed from your payload tray, then proceed to the equipment shelter and standby for the next assignment.

Begin at the main storage barn next to the old windmill. Proceed to the blueberry field entrance gate. Pick up two crates of protective netting stacked by the gate. Transport the crates to the pest control station adjacent to the western grove. Wait up to 10 minutes for the station crew to remove all netting. Once the unloading is complete, continue to the field equipment garage situated between the eastern orchard and the access trail. Wait there until a set of five empty fuel canisters are placed onto the robot. After loading, deliver the canisters to the refueling station near the northern pond. After you arrive and the canisters are removed, return to the main storage barn.

Start at the material receiving gate adjacent to the western access road. Proceed to the maintenance shed near Silo 3 and collect three replacement hydraulic hoses. Carry the hoses to the orchard repair site on the north slope and wait for the maintenance crew to take the hoses, allowing up to 7 minutes. Once unloaded, continue to the fuel depot by the central gravel lot, collect one portable fuel tank, and deliver it to the tractor staging area at Field Edge Lane. Wait there until the fuel tank has been removed, then return to the material receiving gate and await further directions.

Start at the storage bay near the main entrance gate. Move to the solar panel array beside the western fence and collect one crate of replacement solar cells. Transport the crate to the maintenance outpost next to the water purification site. Wait until the maintenance technician removes the crate from your platform. Then proceed to the chemical storage tent at the far southern corner of the property to pick up two sealed pesticide canisters. Deliver these canisters to the spray rig parked behind the fruit grading facility and wait for 10 minutes while the rig is refilled. Once the pesticide canisters are unloaded, make your way back to the storage bay to complete your task.

Start at the central dispatch station. Proceed to the orchard's tool kiosk just south of the apple grove. Pick up three pruning tool cases. Deliver the tool cases to the trellis row marked Section D5. Wait for up to 15 minutes while the orchard team retrieves the tools and replaces them with two bins of freshly pruned branches for composting. Once the bins are loaded onto the robot, head to the compost collection point adjacent to the south fence. Deposit the bins of branches, then return to the central dispatch station to log the completed deliveries.

Begin at the equipment depot adjacent to the machine barn. Drive to the orchard's north entrance and pick up four empty fruit collection baskets. Proceed to the cider press area in the central courtyard and deliver the empty baskets. Wait for 7 minutes while the pressing crew loads three full baskets of apples onto your platform. Transport the loaded apple baskets to the cold storage warehouse near the east loading dock and wait until all baskets are unloaded. After unloading is complete, return to the equipment depot to finish your round.

Start at the equipment storage yard adjacent to the western greenhouse. Proceed to the central fertilizer depot and pick up four bags of nitrogen fertilizer. Deliver the fertilizer bags to the vineyard supply area beside the southern trellis rows. Wait at the vineyard supply area for vineyard staff to unload the bags from your platform. Afterward, travel to the maintenance workshop behind the orchard machinery shed and pick up a replacement set of hydraulic hoses. Take the hydraulic hoses to the tractor repair bay inside the north barn and wait for exactly 20 minutes while technicians swap out the old hoses. Once the waiting period has elapsed, return to the equipment storage yard next to the western greenhouse.

Begin at the equipment garage near the south entrance of the compound. Drive to the manufacturing shed adjacent to the grain silo and collect a sealed toolbox containing specialized repair tools. Transport the toolbox to the wind turbine platform located at the top of the north hill. Wait for 12 minutes while maintenance personnel use the tools to perform scheduled repairs, making sure to remain nearby in case additional equipment is needed. Once the toolbox has been unloaded and the personnel signal completion, proceed to the compost area beside the main orchard and pick up two empty compost bins. Deliver the empty bins to the vegetable packing station next to the south greenhouse. After delivery, return to the equipment garage and await the next assignment.

Start at the storage shed beside the irrigation control hut. Navigate to the greenhouse corridor located at the west side of the property and collect a single crate containing tomato seedlings. Deliver the crate to Field Plot 3, near the solar panel array, and wait for 10 minutes while the planting crew removes the seedlings. Once unloaded, proceed to the farm kitchen entrance adjacent to the herb garden and retrieve two empty transport trays. Bring the trays back to the greenhouse corridor before returning to the storage shed to complete the task.

Begin at the maintenance depot on the north access road. Proceed to the west orchard storage tent and pick up two crates of replacement drip nozzles. Transport the crates to the pump station annex adjacent to the main irrigation pond. Wait until the facility technician removes the crates, which should take around 10 minutes. Then continue to the vineyard equipment lot to the southeast and collect a pallet of empty harvest baskets. Deliver the harvest baskets to the grape sorting station located behind the field crew rest area. After completing the delivery, stand by at the grape sorting station for further assignments.

Begin at the equipment garage near the west orchard entrance. Drive to the citrus grove adjacent to the old irrigation ditch and pick up two crates of harvested lemons and a container of pruning shears. Next, proceed to the agricultural research lab east of Warehouse 4 and deliver the lemons to the receiving bay. Wait at the loading area for 8 minutes as the staff unload the crates and return the empty container. Once unloading is complete, travel to the vehicle refueling station beside Field D. Remain at the refueling station for 5 minutes, then return to the equipment garage and wait there until new instructions arrive.

Start at the main garage near the property entrance. Drive to the orchard loading zone at the eastern edge of the apple grove and pick up three crates of freshly harvested apples. Transport the apple crates to the cold storage facility adjacent to the central processing plant. Wait at the cold storage entrance until all crates are unloaded by facility staff. Once unloaded, proceed to the irrigation equipment shed next to the southern water reservoir, and pick up two spools of irrigation tubing. Deliver the tubing to the field operations center located beside the north wheat plot, then return to the main garage to complete the task.

Start at the workshop annex situated beside the farm's wind turbine installation. Drive to the pesticide storage shed behind the machinery wash-down area and pick up three sealed canisters of organic pest control solution. Deliver the canisters to the vineyard service station located at the southern end of Main Vine Row. Wait for vineyard staff to remove all canisters from the payload deck, which may take up to 6 minutes. After unloading, proceed directly to the seedling nursery near the eastern greenhouse to collect a batch of empty seed trays. Bring the empty seed trays to the nursery prep tent adjacent to the central garden beds and wait until the nursery supervisor confirms the trays are stacked in the designated area. Conclude your route by heading to the vehicle maintenance ramp beside the farm office and remain there for further instructions.

Begin at the equipment storage shed located beside the eastern orchard entrance. Drive to the seed distribution hub near the north farm road and collect four sacks of heritage wheat seeds. Deliver the sacks to the open field plot B, situated south of the old windmill. Wait at plot B for up to 15 minutes while the planting crew dispenses the contents. Once the sacks are empty and returned, transport them to the compost facility adjacent to the livestock barn. After drop-off, move to the farm manager’s office porch and await further instructions.

Begin at the equipment garage adjacent to the east entrance. Drive to the solar panel yard west of Field 9 and collect two crates of photovoltaic cleaning supplies. Proceed to Storage Shed C near the irrigation controller station and unload the cleaning supply crates. Wait at the shed for 5 minutes to allow for inventory verification. After confirmation, continue to the compost loading area at the southern farm boundary, and stand by there for new pickup assignments.

Begin at the fueling station beside the southwest equipment barn. Proceed to the livestock feed depot located across the central pasture and pick up two large feed bins. Drive to Stall Row 3 inside the main dairy barn and deliver both bins to the assigned storage area. Wait while the farm staff empties one bin, then collect the empty bin and transport it to the compost processing area near the orchard entrance. After dropping off the empty bin, proceed to the farmhouse tool shed and pick up a sack of replacement fence posts. Deliver the sack to the north creek bridge maintenance site. Stand by for 10 minutes while the repair crew unloads the fence posts and provides further directions.

Begin at the equipment depot next to the solar panel array. Drive to the irrigation supply room located at the greenhouse entrance. Collect a pallet containing four coiled irrigation hoses. Deliver the pallet of hoses to Field Plot C, near the eastern boundary of the property. Wait at Field Plot C for up to 12 minutes while the field technicians unload the hoses. Once unloading is confirmed, proceed to the wash bay beside the machinery garage to be cleaned before your next task.

Start at the central greenhouse loading bay. Drive to the fertilizer storage shed on the east boundary and pick up three sealed containers of organic fertilizer. Deliver the containers to the vegetable plot distribution point near the south entrance. Wait at the distribution point for 5 minutes to allow the field manager to verify the delivery. Once verified, proceed to the solar equipment shelter in the northwest corner and retrieve the battery maintenance toolbox. Finally, return the toolbox to the central greenhouse loading bay and stand by for further instructions.

Start at the central workshop beside the main driveway. Proceed to the fertilizer storage shed near the west pasture and pick up three bags of organic fertilizer. Drive to the community vegetable garden behind the administration building and deliver the fertilizer to the garden team. Wait for up to 8 minutes while the bags are unloaded. After the delivery, return to the central workshop for your next assignment.

Start at the main seed storage facility next to the northern tractor bay. Pick up eight bags of hybrid corn seed. Drive to the experimental plot greenhouse beside the northern irrigation channel. Wait for the greenhouse supervisor to offload the seed bags. Once offloaded, proceed to the field operations tent near the southwest pasture and collect three empty pesticide drums. Deliver the empty drums to the hazardous materials containment area at the rear of the equipment yard. Wait there for seven minutes for the safety officer to log the delivery before heading back to the main seed storage facility.

Start at the main control center next to the administration office. Proceed to the lumber yard located behind the western barn and pick up three wooden pallets stacked near the entrance. Transport the pallets to the temporary staging area beside the north tractor bay. Wait until the loading crew finishes unloading all pallets. Once the pallets have been removed, continue to the irrigation monitoring station at the edge of the sunflower field. Pick up a sealed water quality sampler left inside the station. Deliver the sampler to the laboratory entrance adjacent to the farm's central greenhouse. After delivering the sampler, wait for 8 minutes in case laboratory staff require any additional items to be retrieved. When the waiting period concludes, return to the main control center and stand by for further instructions.

Begin at the equipment shelter beside the orchard road. Navigate to the citrus orchard's north corner and pick up three empty fruit bins. Transport the empty bins to the grove central collection area where harvesters are working. Wait until all three bins have been completely filled by the harvest crew, which may take up to 15 minutes. When notified that loading is finished, drive to the processing shed adjacent to the vegetable packing line and deliver the filled fruit bins. Do not wait for unloading; once you have delivered the bins, proceed directly to the equipment shelter beside the orchard road and await further tasks.

Start at the maintenance garage near the main gate of the solar farm. Drive to the southern control station and pick up a container of replacement solar panel fuses. Transport the container to the windbreak maintenance hut located at the western edge of the property. Wait for a technician to unload the fuses, which should take no more than 10 minutes. After the fuses have been removed, proceed to the storage yard behind the main office and collect two spare battery packs. Deliver the battery packs to the electrical distribution tower at the northeast corner of the field, then return to the maintenance garage to complete the task.

Start at the vehicle maintenance garage behind the southern machinery depot. Proceed to the spare parts container located beside the west greenhouse complex and retrieve a box containing six irrigation filters. Deliver the box to the main pump station at the edge of irrigation canal #3. Wait for the on-site technician to unload the filters and provide a signed receipt, which may take up to 12 minutes. After receiving the receipt and confirming the box is empty, travel to the small field supply kiosk near the caretaker’s cottage. Collect a 20-liter can of diesel fuel earmarked for the generator and transport it carefully to the generator shelter south of the orchard dam. Once delivery is complete, return directly to the vehicle maintenance garage and await the next assignment.

Begin at the shipping container hub along the eastern access road. Proceed to the orchard's eastern block and collect three crates of harvested pears placed near the central cart path. Deliver the crates to the refrigerated storage room adjacent to the farm office. Wait at the storage room for up to 10 minutes for the quality control manager to inspect and sign for the crates. After receiving confirmation, continue to the main tool depot located near the west machinery garage. Pick up a box of spare hydraulic hoses and deliver it to the maintenance bay at the southern equipment shed. Remain at the maintenance bay until the repair technician unloads the box, then move to the solar charging station near the central crossroads and wait there for further instructions.

Start at the maintenance garage next to the south parking lot. Travel to the pesticide storage cabin on the eastern edge of the vineyard and collect one container of grape-friendly pesticide along with a sprayer unit. Transport both items to Spraying Zone B in the lower vineyard. Wait there until a technician removes the equipment from the platform, then proceed to the water pump station near the irrigation canal, pick up two empty water sample jars, and deliver them to the laboratory entry station beside the greenhouse. Once delivery is complete, wait in standby mode for 10 minutes to assist with additional laboratory transport if needed.

Start at the seed storage shed located on the northern farm road. Navigate to the greenhouse complex at Plot 9A and pick up four trays of seedlings and a weatherproof tool kit. Proceed to the south hillside vineyard and deliver both the seedlings and the tool kit to the vineyard foreman. Wait for 10 minutes as workers unload the trays and remove the tool kit from your platform. Once your platform is clear, return to the seed storage shed and stand by for further loading instructions.

Start at the main entrance gate near the north road. Proceed to the vineyard loading bay adjacent to Silo #4. Pick up three baskets of freshly harvested grapes. Drive to the wine cellar storage building located behind the farmhouse. Deliver the grape baskets to the cellar staff for processing. Wait until all baskets have been unloaded. Afterwards, return to the central maintenance depot and remain there until further dispatch.

Begin at the central logistics hub near the north gate. Drive to the southwest orchard packing area and pick up four crates of freshly harvested apples. Deliver these crates to Cold Storage Room 2 inside the processing warehouse. Wait until all crates have been unloaded by a warehouse assistant. Next, proceed to the equipment depot adjacent to the main farm road, collect a box of replacement air filters, and deliver this box to the maintenance room on the upper level of the greenhouse complex. Return to the central logistics hub when all tasks are complete.

Begin your route at the equipment garage adjacent to the northeast tool shed. Navigate to the machinery repair bay near the eastern gravel lot and collect one sealed toolbox along with a replacement hydraulic pump. Continue to the cornfield control station at the southern edge of the property. Deliver both the toolbox and the hydraulic pump to the technician on duty. Wait for 10 minutes while the technician inspects the delivered items and prepares any broken components to be returned. Once the technician has loaded two damaged gears onto your platform, transport these parts back to the equipment garage and leave them at the designated repair intake area.

Begin at the operations center beside the east paddock entrance. Drive to the fertilizer storage unit adjacent to the irrigation lagoon and collect two pallets of organic fertilizer bags. Take the pallets to the remote orchard clearing past the southern windbreak. Wait while orchard workers unload all fertilizer bags—do not leave until all pallets are empty. After unloading is confirmed, continue to the maintenance workshop located next to the packing house, pick up a set of spare combine harvester blades, and promptly deliver the blades to the mechanics’ bay at the machinery depot. Once on site, wait 7 minutes for the maintenance staff to collect the blades. After your platform is empty, return to the operations center and hold for your next dispatch.

Begin at the north equipment shed beside the irrigation canal. Drive to the greenhouse annex at the rear of the property and collect a stack of fertilizer bags—there should be at least six bags ready for transport. Deliver the fertilizer bags to the compost mixing station adjacent to the west orchard. Wait for up to 12 minutes as the station staff unload the bags. Once the unloading is finished, proceed to the shaded tool depot near the farm entrance and wait there for further instructions or until the end of your current task.

Start at the maintenance garage adjacent to Field B. Proceed to the fertilizer storage container located near the irrigation pump on the south side of Field C and pick up three sealed fertilizer drums. Deliver these drums to the application equipment station next to the southeastern crop rows. Wait for the field crew to unload the drums, which may take up to 8 minutes. After unloading, drive to the workshop near the farm office and collect a toolbox. Transport the toolbox to the tractor parking area by the north machinery shelter and wait for the mechanic to remove it from your tray before returning to the maintenance garage.

Begin at the fertilizer storage shed near the east orchard boundary. Proceed to the packaging tent situated between the apple grove and the cherry trees. Pick up five empty produce crates stacked beneath the tent awning. Transport the crates to the sorting station at the southwest corner of the orchard. Wait for the harvest crew to fill and reload the crates onto the robot. Once all crates are loaded, deliver them to the cold storage facility behind the produce market. After dropping off the full crates, wait for 12 minutes in case additional crates arrive for cold storage. When the waiting period ends, head back to the fertilizer storage shed and await further deployment orders.

Start at the tool depot adjacent to the solar panel array on the north edge of the property. Make your way to the irrigation pump house located beside Willow Creek. Pick up two repair toolkits and one waterproof supply box from the pump house. Transport these items to Field Plot 4’s control tower, found at the center of the newly planted corn section. Wait until the field technician offloads all items, which could take approximately 8 minutes. After unloading, proceed to the compost drop site near the barn and collect two filled compost bins. Deliver the compost bins to the orchard’s mulching area, positioned next to the citrus grove on the western perimeter. Once delivery is complete, return to the tool depot and await additional tasks.

Start at the west-side equipment garage. Proceed to the northern irrigation supply station and pick up four coiled hoses. Deliver the hoses to the newly-planted orchard on the east ridge and wait up to 10 minutes for the orchard crew to unload them. Once the delivery is complete, drive to the compost storage area near the southern livestock barns, collect one compost bin, and transport it to the community garden assembly area adjacent to the guest parking lot. After dropping off the compost bin, return to the equipment garage and await your next assignment.

Start from the equipment garage next to the northern tree line. Proceed to the tool supply room at the end of the central corridor and pick up a crate containing irrigation repair kits. Transport the crate to the broken irrigation pump located near the western cornfield edge. Wait for up to 10 minutes while the repair crew removes all repair kits from your platform. When unloaded, drive to the seed storage loft beside the old barn, collect a bag of winter rye seeds, then deliver it to the soil test plot along the southern ridge. Once the seed bag is transferred to the research staff at the plot, return to the equipment garage and standby until further instructions.

Start at the east field service bay next to the solar panel array. Navigate to the central packing house and collect three crates of harvested tomatoes. Transport the crates to the farmer’s market loading zone by the roadside gate. Wait at the loading zone while the vendor staff unload all three crates; do not leave until all crates are removed from your platform. Once the crates have been fully offloaded, proceed to the windmill maintenance yard and pick up a sealed box of mechanical spare parts. Deliver the box to the main irrigation control room inside the south utility shed, then return to the east field service bay to complete the loop.

Begin at the south gate workshop. Proceed to the pesticide containment shed adjacent to the east orchard and pick up three sealed pesticide canisters. Deliver these canisters to the drone launch platform on the north hillside. Wait until the onsite technician removes all canisters from your delivery tray. Afterwards, travel to the farm supply silo behind the livestock barn, collect two bags of high-protein animal feed, and deliver them to the feeding station inside the goat pen. Once your payload has been unloaded by the farmhand, return to the south gate workshop and await your next assignment.

Begin at the central garage next to the main parking lot. Head to the grain storage silos located behind the windbreak pines. Pick up three sealed sacks of fertilizer and one spare grain auger belt. Deliver these items to the fertilizer staging area behind the equipment repair shop on the eastern boundary of the property. Wait up to 10 minutes for the shop manager to inspect and unload the items. After unloading, move to the livestock feed barn at the far northern end to collect any empty feed drums present. Return the empty drums to the central garage for cleaning and await further instructions.

Begin at the orchard supply station next to the northwest apple grove. Proceed to the chemical storage facility near the western rainwater collection tanks and pick up two sealed containers of fertilizer. Navigate to the vineyard irrigation hub situated south of the greenhouse. Deliver the fertilizer containers to the vineyard staff at the hub. Wait for 15 minutes while the staff uses the fertilizer and prepares empty drums for return. After the wait, collect three empty fertilizer drums from the staff. Return the empty drums to the chemical storage facility’s return area and complete your operation at the orchard supply station.

Begin at the materials staging lot beside the northwest gate. Drive to the cold storage shed located behind the main greenhouse and pick up two crates of harvested lettuce. Transport the crates to the farm market stand at the front entrance. Wait up to 6 minutes for the stand attendant to unload the crates. Once empty, drive to the tool locker room at the east end of the barn, collect a sack of soil amendments, and deliver it to the demonstration plot on the south slope. Once the sack has been removed, return to the materials staging lot and remain there until further instruction.

Start at the operations control room near the central office building. Make your way to Workshop Bay 2 beside the vehicle garage and collect four replacement hydraulic hoses. Deliver these hoses to Irrigation Pump Station C located beyond the windbreak at the northeast corner of the property. Wait for up to 10 minutes while the technicians retrieve and install the hoses. Once all hoses have been removed from your cargo area, proceed to the chemical storage area near the east boundary and wait there until further instructions are provided.

Start at the maintenance garage adjacent to the equipment yard. Travel to the windmill control center located on the northern ridge and pick up a crate containing diagnostic tools. Proceed to the hydroponic research tent behind the central greenhouse. Deliver the crate of diagnostic tools to the research team inside the tent. Stand by for 10 minutes while the team utilizes the tools for emergency repairs. Once the crate has been reloaded with replacement water filters by the team, return the crate to the maintenance garage and await further tasks.

Begin at the operations hub adjacent to the western entrance gate. Navigate to the citrus grove equipment shed and collect a pallet of irrigation hoses. Deliver the pallet to the main pump station located beside the north irrigation reservoir. Wait for the on-site technician to inspect and unload the hoses, which may take up to 15 minutes. After the pallet has been fully unloaded, proceed to the orchard’s northern watchtower and retrieve an empty fuel canister. Transport the empty canister to the refueling station behind the tool warehouse and wait until the station attendant replaces it with a filled fuel canister. Once loaded with the filled canister, return to the citrus grove equipment shed to complete the assignment.

Start at the maintenance depot near the south entrance. Proceed to the vineyard’s northeast corner and pick up two crates of damaged trellis brackets and four bags of vine clippings. Transport these items to the recycling collection bay situated beside the composting facility. Wait up to 20 minutes for the recycling team to sort and process the load. Once unloaded, head to the cold storage building beside the main processing hall to collect a shipment of packaged grape samples. Deliver the grape samples to the quality control lab located on the mezzanine level of the processing hall for immediate inspection. Once the samples are delivered, stand by at the lab for further instructions.

Begin at the equipment storage shed near the east orchard gate. Drive over to the solar panel array service area adjacent to Field 7 and pick up two containers of maintenance tools and three spare inverter units. Proceed to the remote relay station at the far north end of the property and deliver the maintenance tools and inverter units to the technical crew. Wait for up to 15 minutes while the crew checks and offloads the equipment. After all items are removed from your cargo area, return to the equipment storage shed and await your next assignment.

Start from the chemical storage bunker beside the north fertilizer silo. Travel to the fruit packing tent at the southern end of Orchard Block C and pick up three sealed crates of harvested peaches. Deliver the crates to the refrigeration unit entry bay found in the main produce warehouse. Wait by the loading zone until all crates are removed by a warehouse staff member, which could take up to 8 minutes. Once unloaded, proceed to the composting facility behind the supply barn, and pick up a container of biodegradable waste. Transport the container to the green waste drop-off area next to the field equipment lot. After completing the drop-off, return to the chemical storage bunker and stand by for your next task.

Initiate your route from the west-side vehicle garage and proceed to the irrigation equipment shed near the south field boundary. Pick up a waterproof container holding six replacement sprinkler nozzles. Drive to Station 4 within the western irrigation grid and deliver the container to the technician waiting there. Wait until the technician removes all six nozzles from your platform, then proceed to the seed storage barn adjacent to the central access road. Collect one sealed sack of corn seed and transport it to Plot C-7 at the far north planting zone. Once at the destination, deposit the seed sack next to the blue flagged marker and return to the west-side vehicle garage to complete your shift.

Start at the equipment depot beside the irrigation reservoir. Travel to the greenhouse loading zone and pick up three crates of hydroponic seedlings. Transport these seedlings to the planting beds at the east farm plot. Wait up to 8 minutes for the planting crew to distribute the seedlings. Once unloading is complete, proceed to the barn workshop and collect a toolbox labeled 'Field Repairs.' Deliver the toolbox to the maintenance tent set up near the tractor bay and wait there until the repair technician retrieves the toolbox.
