Afterward, head to the administration building lobby and await further instructions.

Start from the machinery shelter located behind the main office. Proceed to the fertilizer storage depot adjacent to the south orchard. Collect two large containers of organic fertilizer. Deliver the containers to Vineyard Section 3 on the western slope. Wait until the vineyard supervisor has finished unloading both containers. Following confirmation, navigate to the tool calibration area near the water tower and stand by for further instructions.

Begin at the machinery shed beside the southern fence line. Proceed to the fertilizer storage yard located just east of the seed barn. Pick up three sealed sacks of organic fertilizer from the ramp area. Deliver the sacks to the compost blending platform adjacent to the irrigation control station. Wait until the platform supervisor signals that all sacks have been unloaded, which may take up to 8 minutes. Once the transfer is complete, navigate to the main barn and collect a single empty feed container from the livestock aisle. Deliver the feed container to the quarantine pen outside the veterinary clinic, then return directly to the machinery shed for further instructions.

Begin at the maintenance workshop located behind the main greenhouse. Pick up a single crate of replacement irrigation valves. Transport this crate to the pump control station at the far end of the north field. Wait for the field technician to retrieve the crate from your platform. After the crate has been unloaded, proceed to the west orchard entrance and collect three empty fertilizer spreaders. Deliver the spreaders to the storage enclosure beside the packing house. Once all spreaders are unloaded, return to the maintenance workshop for your next task.

Start at the maintenance garage next to the main greenhouse. Travel to the supply depot located behind the irrigation reservoir and pick up two replacement water pumps. Deliver the water pumps to the pump station at the northern edge of the blueberry field. Wait until the maintenance crew removes the faulty pumps and installs the new ones, then collect the two old pumps for return. Bring the faulty pumps back to the workshop adjacent to the machinery bay. Once the delivery is complete, proceed to the compost yard near the southwest corner and await new assignment updates.

Begin at the central maintenance garage adjacent to the striped wind turbine tower. Drive to the shipping container yard near the eastern fence and pick up three wooden crates containing replacement tractor parts. Transport the crates to the farm's machinery workshop next to the grain silo. Wait for a technician to unload the crates, which should take about 12 minutes. After unloading, proceed to the pesticide storage shed by the southern irrigation canal and retrieve a small metal drum labeled 'Herbicide B.' Deliver the drum to the crop spraying station beside Field 5, and wait until a supervisor confirms successful handover before returning to the central maintenance garage for further instructions.

Start at the storage pavilion next to Greenhouse B. Drive to the packaging zone behind the berry field and pick up two crates of freshly harvested strawberries. Deliver the crates to the cold storage room inside the main distribution center. Wait up to 10 minutes while the crates are unloaded by staff. After delivery, proceed to the maintenance supply closet under the west awning to collect a box of spare irrigation nozzles. Transport the box to the pump station at the southern edge of the cactus nursery. Wait until the box of nozzles has been removed by the technician before returning to the storage pavilion.

Begin at the logistics station at the entrance of the flower nursery. Travel to the pesticide storage unit next to Vineyard Block C and collect four sealed canisters of eco-safe pesticide. Deliver the canisters to the aerial drone launch pad near the west orchard. Wait there until the drone operators confirm receipt of all canisters, for up to 10 minutes. Next, proceed to the compost mixing pit off Garden Lane and pick up a bag of fertilizer samples. Take the bag to the soil testing facility beside the main barn, hand off the samples, and remain at the facility for 5 minutes in case further items require transport, before returning to the logistics station to end the assignment.

Begin at the central supply depot. Travel to the compost yard and collect two sealed bio-waste drums. Transport the drums to the east boundary refuse collection station and wait up to 12 minutes for the environmental crew to remove both drums. Once offloaded, drive to the pesticide storage bunker near the southern fence and wait for the storage supervisor to load four containment canisters onto the robot. Deliver the canisters to the secure access bay of the crop research laboratory, and remain there until all items are unloaded. Lastly, return to the central supply depot and prepare for the next assignment.

Begin at the maintenance garage located beside the main office. Drive to the southeast gravel lot and pick up two reels of irrigation tubing stacked near the loading ramp. Transport the reels to the field equipment depot at the edge of Vineyard Block C. Wait for the field crew supervisor to offload the reels before leaving. Next, proceed to the livestock supply shed adjacent to the west barn and collect a box of veterinary supplies labeled for urgent delivery. Deliver the supplies to the animal care station at the north pasture entrance. Wait for 10 minutes while the veterinarian inspects and removes the box. When finished, return to the maintenance garage and remain on standby until further instructions.

Start at the equipment parking area beside the irrigation control center. Drive to the orchard loading zone on East Lane and pick up two baskets of freshly picked apples and a box of tree pruning tools. Deliver the apples to the market staging area next to Barn 2, and wait while market staff unload the baskets. Once the apples are removed, travel to the farm caretaker’s cottage near the western pond, and drop off the box of tree pruning tools at the designated bench. Immediately return to the equipment parking area and await additional assignments.

Start at the maintenance barn near the solar panel array. Drive to the chemical storage hut located by the north irrigation ditch. Collect one container of pest control solution and three empty sprayer tanks. Deliver all items to the portable greenhouse at the northwest corner of the property. Wait for 12 minutes while the greenhouse crew loads their equipment with the solution and returns the empty tanks. When the loading is done, proceed to the staff rest shelter next to the supply parking lot, wait until a maintenance worker places a toolbox on the robot, and then return to the maintenance barn to complete the task.

Start at the field operations shed next to the weather monitoring station. Proceed to the greenhouse complex and pick up four trays of young tomato seedlings from the greenhouse manager. Transport the trays to Plot B, located by the southern edge of the apple orchard. Wait until the planting crew has taken all the trays, which can take approximately 12 minutes. Once unloading is complete, travel to the water pump facility near the eastern service road to collect a replacement water filter. Deliver the water filter to the irrigation control room in the main barn, and wait until the maintenance team has removed the filter before returning to the field operations shed.

Proceed to the cold storage unit at the central warehouse and collect three crates of harvested strawberries. Deliver the crates to the farm market stand located at the entrance to the visitor parking area. Wait until the market staff has unloaded all crates from your platform. Once unloading is complete, travel to the irrigation pump station on the southwest edge of the vegetable fields and pick up a sealed container of water testing supplies. Transport the container to the water management building on the eastern side of the property and hand it over to the on-site technician. After delivery, remain by the building entrance for 15 minutes to assist with any additional equipment transport requested by the staff before returning to the central warehouse to conclude your assignment.

Start at the garage located next to the equipment barn. Proceed to the chemical storage shed beside the north pond and collect one sealed container of fertilizer and a box of plant nutrient vials. Deliver these items to the distribution outpost situated near the central irrigation pump. Wait until the agricultural staff have unloaded both the fertilizer container and the nutrient vials from your cargo tray. Once unloaded, travel to the south greenhouse annex. Pick up three empty seed trays. Transport the empty seed trays to the potting room adjacent to the seedling nursery. Remain there for 12 minutes or until the trays have been refilled and placed back on your tray, then return to the garage and enter standby mode.

Begin at the gravel lot near the main gate. Drive to the orchard packaging pavilion located by the eastern row of apple trees and pick up three crates of freshly picked apples. Transport the crates to the cold storage facility behind the produce warehouse. Wait until all three apple crates are unloaded by the storage crew. Then proceed to the chemical storage shed adjacent to the south drainage pond, collect two sealed pesticide containers, and deliver them to the equipment wash station beside the western tractor port. Wait for up to 10 minutes or until the containers are removed by the grounds team. After completing this task, return to the gravel lot at the main gate and stand by for further instructions.

Start from the fuel storage lot adjacent to the maintenance shed. Navigate to the machinery parking area next to the grain silo and pick up one spare combine harvester tire and a toolbox labeled 'Field Repair Kit.' Transport both items to the east boundary windbreak, where repair technicians are awaiting parts. Wait while the crew offloads both the tire and the toolbox from the robot. After unloading, proceed to the temporary harvest staging tent near the southern sunflower field, retrieve three sacks of harvested sunflower heads, and deliver them to the seed processing trailer beside the main access road. Wait at the trailer until all sacks have been unloaded, then drive back to the fuel storage lot and stand by for new tasks.

Start at the supply warehouse adjacent to the wind turbine field. Proceed to the north equipment yard and pick up a sealed drum of lubricant. Deliver the drum to the loading dock behind the fruit packing house and wait 10 minutes while workers unload the payload. Once the drum is removed, head to the greenhouses on the south side of the property and collect two empty fertilizer bins. Transport these bins to the compost facility near the edge of the pine grove. After you deliver the bins, remain at the compost facility for 7 minutes before returning to the supply warehouse.

Start by the west entrance of the seed storage barn. Navigate to the equipment depot near the north tractor shed and pick up two cases of replacement hydraulic hoses. Deliver the hoses to the main field operations hut on the east side of the property. Wait until the site manager removes both cases from your platform—this may take up to 5 minutes. After delivery, return to the seed storage barn and stand by for your next task.

Start at the tool depot adjacent to the maintenance garage. Travel to the tractor shed located on the south side of Field 8 and collect one pallet of replacement hydraulic hoses and three fuel filters. Deliver these items to the machinery repair zone next to the irrigation pond. Wait until the site manager has finished unloading all cargo, which may take up to 15 minutes. After unloading is complete, proceed to the seed storage barn near the eastern fence and pick up two bags of sunflower seeds. Bring the sunflower seeds to Greenhouse Three near the orchard entrance and deposit them at the main door; do not wait for unloading. Finally, return to the tool depot to stand by for your next task.

Start at the equipment garage near the east entrance. Move to the timber storage yard and pick up two sealed containers of wood treatment solution. Deliver the containers to the sawmill maintenance shed. Wait for the maintenance team to remove both containers from your platform, which may take around 7 minutes. Once offloaded, proceed to the solar panel array at the southern edge of the property for a remote diagnostics check before heading back to the equipment garage.

Start at the fertilizer storage shed behind the equipment hangar. Proceed to the orchard's northern entrance to pick up two crates of freshly harvested apples. Deliver the apple crates to the cold storage unit inside the main barn, located near the farm's central driveway. Wait for the barn staff to unload both crates, remaining stationary until unloading is finished. Afterwards, travel to the solar panel field along the eastern ridge and collect a single replacement inverter placed beside the maintenance station. Transport the inverter to the greenhouse utility room positioned at the southern end of the greenhouse complex. Wait until the technician has removed the inverter, then proceed back to the fertilizer storage shed and await further directions.

Start at the central loading zone near the main farm office. Proceed to the fertilizer storage barn and collect four bags of granular fertilizer. Transport these bags to Vegetable Plot 3 at the northeastern corner of the property. Wait for 10 minutes as the bags are unloaded and fertilizer is distributed. Afterward, drive to the workshop garage to retrieve a box of replacement spark plugs, then deliver the spark plugs to the machinery shed adjacent to the grain silo. Once delivery is complete, return to the central loading zone.

Begin at the fertilizer depot near the equipment parking area. Drive to the greenhouse loading zone to pick up three sealed containers of plant nutrients. Transport the containers to Hydroponics Greenhouse 2 located at the eastern end of the facility. Upon arrival, wait for the greenhouse supervisor to unload the containers and confirm the drop-off. After the payload has been offloaded, proceed to the spare parts kiosk by the machine shed to retrieve a replacement water filter. Deliver the water filter to the maintenance room adjacent to the main irrigation hub, then remain there for 5 minutes before returning to the fertilizer depot.

Start from the storage garage beside the eastern greenhouse. Proceed to the livestock feed silo near the north barn and collect two sacks of premium grain feed and a carton of mineral supplements. Deliver these items to the animal pen feeding station located adjacent to the southern pasture. Wait there until all items have been removed from your loading tray by the barn staff. Once the delivery is complete, travel to the weather monitoring station next to the old windmill and remain on standby for 7 minutes to allow the technical crew to load environmental data recorders into your storage compartment. When loading is finished, return to the storage garage and await new instructions.

Start at the maintenance shed next to the solar farm entrance. Travel to the orchard packing zone beside the southern flower rows and collect two large crates of apples. Deliver the crates to the cold storage unit near the eastern loading dock. Wait up to fifteen minutes for staff to finish unloading the crates. Afterward, continue to the irrigation control hut along the western perimeter path and pick up a small toolbox labeled 'Irrigation Repair Kit.' Transport the toolbox to the central water pump station located behind the equipment barn. Once the toolbox has been handed over to the technician, move to the waste collection point at the northern boundary and await the placement of compostable material bags for the next assignment.

Start at the maintenance garage beside the south orchard entrance. Proceed to the tool storage shed at the far end of the citrus grove. Pick up one large toolbox and two reels of irrigation hose from the marked shelf near the door. Deliver these items to the pump installation site next to the west irrigation canal. Wait for the installation crew to unload the equipment, which may take approximately 10 minutes. After unloading, head to the battery charging station adjacent to the central control room and wait there until your battery is fully recharged or you receive a new task.

Begin at the main storage hangar near the northwest gate. Proceed to the vineyard section behind the irrigation control shed and pick up four containers of harvested grapes. Carefully transport the grape containers to the fermentation facility at the far end of the production courtyard. Upon arrival, wait until cellar staff have removed all containers, but do not wait longer than 10 minutes. Once emptied, head to the equipment wash station adjacent to the fuel depot, and wait to be loaded with empty fertilizer drums. After the drums are placed on the robot, deliver them to the recycling compound next to the north field entrance. After completing the delivery, immediately return to the main storage hangar and prepare for the next assignment.

Start at the maintenance garage at the north end of the facility. Drive to the solar panel array by the southern fence. Retrieve three boxes of replacement photovoltaic cells from the designated storage rack. Transport the boxes to the utility shed located next to the orchard entrance. Wait for the technician to unload all boxes, which should take approximately 7 minutes. Once the unloading is completed, proceed to the waste sorting station in the recycling yard for your next task assignment.

Start at the maintenance garage by the south gate. Drive to the vineyard edge and collect three empty grape bins. Transport the empty bins to the hand-harvest area next to the eastern trellis. Wait there until all bins are fully loaded with harvested grapes (maximum wait: 30 minutes). Once loaded, deliver the full grape bins to the cold storage annex beside the processing barn. After unloading, proceed to the washdown station to receive a cleaning. Finally, return to the maintenance garage to complete the task.

Begin at the vineyard equipment depot located by the western orchard. Travel to the seed storage silo south of the main barn and collect two sacks of grapevine fertilizer. Deliver the sacks to the trellis field near the eastern boundary. Wait at the field for the staff to unload the fertilizer—this should take approximately 8 minutes. Once unloading is finished, head to the recycling station beside the workers’ rest area, pick up a bundle of empty crates, and return them to the vineyard equipment depot. Finally, wait outside the depot for 7 minutes in case additional crates need to be transported.

Begin at the packaging depot adjacent to the north orchard entrance. Proceed to the southeastern apple grove at the far end of the orchard. Collect two bins of freshly harvested apples labeled 'Premium Red.' Transport the apple bins to the quality control tent by the irrigation canal. Wait until the quality inspectors have removed both bins from the cargo bay. Once the robot is unloaded, head to the compost storage area behind the barn and wait for 10 minutes to be assigned further collection tasks.

Start at the maintenance shed near the north field entrance. Proceed to the orchard’s produce loading zone behind the cold storage building and pick up three full bins of harvested apples. Deliver the apple bins to the market prep area along the east fence. Wait for 5 minutes while staff inspect and unload the bins. Once unloading is complete, travel to the solar equipment yard by the west windbreak, pick up a replacement battery pack, and deliver it to the charging station outside the irrigation control cabin. Return to the maintenance shed and await further instructions.

Begin at the equipment depot near the north service entrance. Proceed to the greenhouse staging area to pick up two trays of tomato seedlings. Transport the trays carefully to the designated section of the rooftop garden atop Building C. Wait until the horticulture team has finished unloading both trays. Next, head to the mechanical workshop inside the main facility to collect a pallet containing irrigation valves. Deliver the pallet to Field 3A along Meadow Road. Wait for 10 minutes for the installation crew to offload the valves. Once completed, return to the equipment depot and stand by for your next instructions.

Begin at the maintenance garage adjacent to the main orchard entrance. Drive to the pesticide storage container located next to the windbreak rows. Pick up two sealed drums of organic pesticide. Travel to the south grove and deliver the pesticide drums next to the storage shed labeled 'Field Supplies.' Wait until the orchard manager unlocks the shed and removes both drums from your platform, which may take up to 8 minutes. Once the transfer is complete, proceed to the equipment cleaning station on the ridge above the orchard and stand by for your next directive.

Begin at the equipment depot adjacent to the north orchard entrance. Navigate to the machine parts storage room located inside the central processing facility. Pick up a set of spare tractor tires and two sealed boxes of replacement engine filters. Transport the payload to the tractor maintenance area directly behind the main barn. Wait up to 8 minutes for the mechanics to unload and check the delivered parts. Once your cargo bay is empty, drive to the weather monitoring station near the east perimeter fence and remain there until you receive new task instructions.

Begin at the solar recharging station near the north fence line. Proceed to the greenhouse annex situated along the western service road and collect a pallet containing six trays of young tomato plants. Deliver the pallet to the planting field entry gate, which is adjacent to the main irrigation channel. Wait at the entry gate for up to 8 minutes while the planting crew transfers the trays. After the trays have been collected, move to the orchard chemical storage unit to pick up two sealed fertilizer canisters. Transport the canisters to the central apple grove toolshed and remain there until the canisters are removed from your platform. Once all payloads are delivered and the platform is empty, return to the solar recharging station for further assignment.

Begin at the orchard shed near the south fence and drive to the compost collection area behind the packing barn. Pick up two bins of mulched leaf waste. Deliver the bins to the field plot study site on the western edge of the property. Wait until the bins are fully unloaded by the research assistants conducting the soil amendment trial. Once empty, head to the solar array maintenance point adjacent to the tractor parking lot, and remain there for fifteen minutes while awaiting a safety inspection.

Start at the equipment garage adjacent to the main workshop. Drive to the machinery supply depot located on the east side of the property. Pick up four heavy-duty hydraulic hoses and a box of pressure gauges. Deliver these supplies to the repair station behind the large irrigation pumps near the north water tower. Wait for the maintenance crew to unload all items from your platform. After unloading, proceed to the solar panel array monitoring station and remain there for 7 minutes before returning to the equipment garage.

Start at the west storage shed near the solar array. Proceed to the container yard adjacent to the delivery gate and pick up two large crates of irrigation hoses. Deliver both crates to the irrigation control hub next to the southern crop fields. After all items have been removed from the robot, continue to the seed storage annex to collect a single box of heirloom tomato seeds. Transport this box to the demonstration plot near the visitors’ center. Once you have delivered the seeds, wait for 5 minutes to allow staff to confirm receipt. After the wait, return directly to the west storage shed.

Start at the field equipment garage north of Grain Silo 4. Drive to the main packing shed on Orchard Lane and collect three empty fruit crates. Proceed to Apple Orchard Section C and wait up to 10 minutes for harvesting workers to load the crates with apples. Once loading is complete, deliver the filled crates to the quality inspection canopy beside the processing facility. Wait until the inspection crew removes all crates, then return to the field equipment garage.

Begin at the storage barn adjacent to the solar charging station. Navigate to the north orchard collection point to pick up three baskets of harvested pears. Deliver the baskets to the cold storage facility located behind the eastern market hall. Wait until the storage supervisor inspects and signs off on the delivery, which is expected to take about 10 minutes. Once approval is received, proceed to the supply depot near the windbreak, pick up a sealed container of pruning tools, and transport the container to the orchard crew rest area before returning to the storage barn to end the task.

Start your route from the charging station near the vineyard processing building. Travel to the tool storage hut beside the eastern orchard and collect a single replacement irrigation pump. Next, proceed to the berry patch maintenance gate, where you are to deliver the pump to the on-site supervisor. Wait until the supervisor confirms the pump is removed, then move to the harvest staging area at the south end of the apple grove. Pick up two bins of freshly harvested apples and transport them to the refrigerated storage bay located along the west perimeter fence. Do not wait after delivery; return immediately to the charging station for your next assignment.

Begin at the vineyard charging station. Navigate to the tool shed located beside the irrigation control tower and pick up two crates containing pruning equipment. Deliver both crates to the grapevine sector C, just past the orchard’s northern boundary. Wait for 10 minutes while the field crew unloads the equipment. After unloading, proceed to the pesticide storage bunker near the east entrance and collect a sealed container of bio-safe pesticides. Transport this container to the southern greenhouse annex. Wait until the greenhouse supervisor removes the container, then return to the vineyard charging station and remain on standby.

Start at the packaging warehouse located next to the west gate. Travel to the vineyard loading bay near Field 12 and pick up four crates of harvested grapes. Deliver these crates to the cold storage facility adjacent to the processing plant. Wait in the unloading zone until a worker has verified and removed all four crates. Once the cargo area is empty, proceed to the greenhouse supply cache north of the east access road, collect a sack of fertilizer pellets, and transport it back to the packaging warehouse, where you should wait for further instructions.

Start at the greenhouse loading bay beside the irrigation control center. Travel to the fertilizer storage shed on the southern field perimeter and pick up three sealed bags of organic fertilizer. Deliver the fertilizer bags to the composting zone adjacent to the biodigester tanks. Wait for 15 minutes while the bags are unloaded and inspected by the environmental staff. Once the unloading is complete, proceed to the weather station behind the equipment shelter and collect a box of sensor calibration tools. Bring the calibration tools to the rooftop access point of the main administration building for the maintenance team. After ensuring the tools are delivered, return to the greenhouse loading bay beside the irrigation control center.

Begin at the equipment shed near the vineyard entrance. Proceed to the fertilizer storage bunker next to the irrigation control building and collect two sealed bags of organic fertilizer. Deliver the fertilizer bags to the greenhouse complex situated at the southeast corner of the property. Wait up to 15 minutes for the horticulture staff to unload the bags. Once the delivery is complete, head to the drone landing pad near the central monitoring tower and pick up a weather sensor package. Transport the weather sensor package to the experimental crop plot beside the windbreak rows and wait until the field technician retrieves the payload from the robot. After all items have been unloaded, return to the equipment shed for standby.

Start at the workshop beside the eastern equipment shed and pick up three rechargeable battery packs. Navigate to the irrigation control station near the north pond. Wait until the maintenance supervisor swaps the old batteries for the new ones. Once the exchange is complete, collect the spent batteries and transport them to the hazardous materials storage building behind the main office. Upon arrival, wait for the safety inspector to unload the spent batteries before returning to the workshop to await your next task.

Begin at the equipment garage situated next to the main access road. Travel to the vineyard tool shed at the edge of the west hillside and collect three buckets of pruning tools. Deliver the buckets to the grapevine trellis section labeled Block C near the weather monitoring station. Wait for the vineyard crew to unload all the pruning tools from your platform. Once the buckets are removed, head to the compost collection area adjacent to the irrigation reservoir, and wait there for 12 minutes to allow the organic waste team to deposit two bags of vine clippings onto your deck. After loading, transport the bags to the waste processing site behind the machinery maintenance barn, unload the vine clippings, and then return to the equipment garage for further instructions.

Begin at the maintenance garage next to the fuel storage area. Drive to the livestock feed zone adjacent to the southern pasture and pick up three sacks of mineral supplement. Transport the sacks to the barn entrance by the main access road. Wait for the farmhand to remove all sacks from your platform—this may take up to 12 minutes. After the offloading is complete, continue to the machine shed near the western irrigation pond and await further instructions.

Begin at the maintenance room beside the central warehouse and pick up two toolkits for field repairs. Transport the toolkits to the irrigation pump station along the eastern fence line. Wait for 12 minutes while the pump technician retrieves and inspects the toolkits. Next, drive to the southern fruit storage facility and collect a wooden pallet stacked with five boxes of packed strawberries. Deliver this pallet to the loading dock at the main distribution center. Once the boxes have been unloaded by the logistics team, proceed to the farm office porch and stand by for 6 minutes before returning to the maintenance room.

Start at the solar panel charging station located behind the administration building. Proceed to the packaging warehouse and collect five crates of freshly packed tomatoes. Deliver all crates to the distribution loading bay on the west side of the facility. Wait for 10 minutes while the logistics team inspects and processes the crates. Afterward, continue to the equipment repair workshop near the irrigation canal, and pick up a replacement hydraulic pump. Transport the pump to the combine harvester parked at field lane four. Once the pump is unloaded, return directly to the solar panel charging station.

Start at the equipment shelter located near the southern pasture. Drive to the fertilizer storage facility beside the west access road and pick up three containers of liquid fertilizer. Deliver the containers to the crop treatment team at the east cornfield equipment laydown area. Wait for up to 10 minutes while the team transfers the fertilizer from the robot. Once unloaded, proceed to the orchard storage shed and retrieve a box of pruning tools. Return to the equipment shelter, and wait there for 15 minutes before shutting down for maintenance.

Begin at the equipment storage yard next to the barn. Drive to the north field’s irrigation control station and collect six empty fertilizer drums. Transport the empty drums to the recycling bay near the main entrance gate and unload them. Wait at the recycling bay for 10 minutes to be loaded with two pallets of replacement irrigation hoses by the logistics team. Once loaded, proceed to the vineyard entrance and deliver the pallets to the vineyard supervisor. After the handover is complete, return to the equipment storage yard and await further instructions.

Start at the loading dock next to the main packing facility. Drive to the central vineyard intersection and retrieve four sealed containers of harvested grapes from the shaded collection point. Deliver these containers to the fermentation room entrance on the west side of the production building. Wait for 12 minutes until the winemaking crew finishes weighing the grapes and signals completion. Afterwards, collect any empty collection bins from the fermentation room entrance, transport them to the sanitation station behind the pump house, and then remain at the sanitation station until further instructions are provided.

Head to the solar equipment storage shed near the southern vineyard entrance and pick up three rechargeable battery packs. Deliver the battery packs to the irrigation control station in the central fields. Wait until the technician collects all battery packs from the robot. After delivery, proceed to the greenhouse loading bay along the western edge and retrieve a pallet of seedling trays. Transport the pallet to the hydroponic plot C distribution point. Remain for 5 minutes to allow the horticulture crew to unload the seedling trays, then return to the solar equipment storage shed for further instructions.

Begin at the supply depot adjacent to the farm office. Navigate to Greenhouse 3, located at the eastern edge of the property, and collect a tray containing 12 tomato seedlings from the greenhouse attendant. Deliver the tray to the planting team working at Field Plot 7, which is situated south of the windbreak grove. Wait until the seedlings are unloaded by the team, which should take approximately 6 minutes. Once unloaded, proceed to the machinery shed north of the orchard and pick up two sealed containers of engine oil from the storage rack. Take these containers to the machinery refueling bay beside the grain dryer and wait up to 5 minutes while the maintenance crew unloads the oil containers. Once the task is complete, return to the supply depot and stand by for the next assignment.

Start at the maintenance garage adjacent to the workshop. Drive to the southeast greenhouse and pick up two sealed boxes of fertilizer. Transport the boxes to Field Plot B, located next to the irrigation canal. Wait at Field Plot B until all boxes are unloaded and distributed by the field staff. When unloading is complete, proceed to the main water pump station near the east boundary fence and pick up a replacement pump filter. Deliver this pump filter to the utility closet inside the barn. After delivery, return to the maintenance garage and park at the designated charging area to await further instructions.

Start at the logistics garage next to the central farm road. Drive to the seedling greenhouse located west of the main silo and pick up two trays of young tomato plants. Carefully transport these trays to Field Plot 4 at the southern boundary. Wait until the planting crew has unloaded both trays, which may take up to 10 minutes. After unloading, proceed to the fertilizer storage hut near the field entrance, collect one sealed bag of organic fertilizer, and deliver it to the water pump station at the corner of the adjacent wheat field. Once delivery is complete, return immediately to the logistics garage for your next assignment.

Begin at the operations center beside the eastern orchard entrance. Proceed to the fertilizer storage shed located near the cornfield and collect two sacks of organic fertilizer. Deliver these sacks to the southern vineyard supply station. Once delivered, continue to the weather monitoring tower—waiting there for up to 8 minutes while a technician loads a sealed equipment crate onto the robot. After loading, transport the crate to the remote sensor array at the back of the north pasture, deliver the crate, and then return to the operations center for your next task.

Start at the orchard loading zone and proceed to the pesticide storage shed to pick up four sealed cartons of organic pest control solution. Deliver the cartons to the north apple grove and wait until the orchard workers have removed all cartons from the robot. Next, drive to the irrigation pump station near pond three, pick up two replacement water filters, and transport them to the vineyard supply bay by the western fence. Wait to be unloaded by the supply manager, then return to the orchard loading zone to complete your route.

Begin your task at the north entrance of the packing warehouse. Drive to the citrus orchard loading area and wait to be loaded with six crates of oranges. Once loaded, transport the crates to Cold Storage Room 2 located at the rear of the main warehouse facility. Wait for 10 minutes while workers inspect and inventory the crates before unloading. After unloading, proceed to the tool depot near the tractor garage and pick up three spare irrigation nozzles. Deliver these nozzles to the pump station by the western canal. Once the delivery is complete, return to the packing warehouse north entrance and await your next instructions.

Start at the central logistics hub adjacent to the warehouse offices. Proceed to the orchard's loading bay on the north side and pick up four crates of freshly harvested pears. Transport the crates to the main distribution dock behind the retail storage unit. Wait until all crates are removed by the distribution team, which is expected to take approximately 10 minutes. Next, travel to the tool cage beside the tractor garage and collect a container holding replacement hose nozzles. Deliver the container to the field equipment station near the western crop plots. Once the hose nozzles have been offloaded by staff, return to the central logistics hub and await your next assignment.

Start at the packing warehouse near the orchard entrance. Proceed to the fertilizer storage barn located at the northern edge of the property and pick up two sealed bags of organic fertilizer. Deliver the bags to the blueberry field plot B6, which is east of the irrigation pond. Wait there until a crew member confirms the bags have been offloaded, which may take up to 7 minutes. After confirmation, head to the machinery refueling station adjacent to the main gravel path, and stand by for 5 minutes for a scheduled diagnostics check before returning to the packing warehouse.

Start at the main loading zone beside the paved access road. Drive to the eastern livestock barn and pick up three 20-liter containers of veterinary supplies. Deliver these containers to the animal health station situated near the western paddocks. Wait for 10 minutes while the supplies are inspected and received by the station manager. After confirmation of receipt, proceed to the water treatment shed located by the southern creek and collect one replacement water filter unit. Transport the filter unit to the pump control building near the center of the property. Once drop-off is completed, return to the main loading zone and await further instructions.

Start at the main garage adjacent to the paved access road on the west side of the facility. Navigate to the solar panel field at the far east boundary and pick up three replacement inverter units from the technician’s drop-off zone. Deliver the inverter units to the maintenance control room inside the energy operations building. Upon arrival, wait up to 12 minutes for the facility engineers to unload the inverter units from your platform. Once unloading is complete, proceed to the storage yard behind the workshops to collect two coiled irrigation hoses. Transport these hoses to the seedling nursery on the north slope and deliver them to the designated storage rack. After completing the delivery, remain at the nursery until further tasks are assigned.

Start at the central storage depot beside the paved equipment lot. Navigate to the north vineyard loading area and pick up four crates of harvested grapes. Deliver these crates to the fermentation room in the processing facility on the east hillside. Wait for up to 10 minutes while the facility crew unloads the crates. Once the grapes are unloaded, proceed to the irrigation control station south of the reservoir and collect a sealed container of fertilizer solution. Transport the container directly to the pump house at the western creek crossing and wait for the technician to remove the container. After the technician is finished, return to the central storage depot.

Start at the maintenance garage next to the vehicle wash station. Drive to the fertilizer storage shed behind the greenhouse and pick up two sealed bags of compost. Deliver the compost bags to the planting zone at the south end of the nursery. Wait for 10 minutes while the landscaping crew spreads the compost. Once the crew confirms you are empty, proceed to the irrigation control room to collect a replacement water filter cartridge. Take the filter cartridge to the pump house by the pond. Wait until the filter is removed from your platform, then return to the maintenance garage.

Start at the main machinery dock next to the grain mill. Drive to the packaging tent beside the eastern corn field and pick up four sacks of corn kernels. Deliver these sacks to the feed mixing station at the north barn. Wait for 8 minutes while the mixing station operator unloads the sacks. Once all sacks are removed, proceed to the fertilizer storage bunker across from the composting area to collect one drum of liquid fertilizer. Safely transport the drum to the greenhouse entrance on the south side of the property. After dropping off the fertilizer drum, return to the main machinery dock and wait for further instructions.

Start at the east entrance of the machinery workshop. Proceed to the equipment yard located behind the windbreak row. Pick up three containers of hydraulic fluid stacked near the service tent. Drive the containers to the tractor bay at the southern edge of the main barn. Wait up to 7 minutes for the maintenance crew to unload all containers. After unloading, travel to the fertilizer bunker near the silage silos, and wait until a worker places two sacks of plant nutrients on your platform before returning to the east entrance of the machinery workshop.

Begin at the equipment depot behind the main barn. Travel to the irrigation control station located at the southern canal. Pick up two replacement water pumps labeled for field 12. Proceed to the vegetable packaging tent situated near the north field and deliver the water pumps to the maintenance crew. Wait at the packaging tent for 8 minutes while the crew inspects the equipment and unloads the pumps. Once unloaded, head to the fuel storage bunker next to the gravel road and collect a portable fuel canister. Deliver the fuel canister to the generator station near the western entrance. After ensuring the canister has been offloaded, return to the equipment depot.

Start at the tool maintenance shed behind the packing barn. Make your way to the north orchard gate and pick up four empty harvest crates left beside the fence. Transport the crates to the berry harvester assembly point near the southern hedgerow and wait for 10 minutes while field workers fill the crates with blueberries. Once all crates are loaded, carry them to the refrigerated storage unit by the farm's east driveway. Wait until the storage operator removes each crate from your platform. After completing the delivery, proceed to the fuel depot beside the machinery shed for a system diagnostic check. Wait there until a technician verifies your operational readiness before returning to the tool maintenance shed.

Start at the supply depot near the greenhouse entrance. Head to the maintenance yard and retrieve two sealed boxes of irrigation filters. Take the boxes to the solar panel field’s service area and wait for maintenance staff to remove and replace any used filters; this may take up to 20 minutes. Once all used filters have been loaded into the boxes, return with the filled boxes to the supply depot and deliver them for inspection. Then, proceed to the storage zone adjacent to the supply depot and stand by for further instructions.

Begin at the south storage garage located adjacent to the main access road. Proceed to the orchard supply shed and pick up a pair of 20-liter pesticide canisters. Transport the canisters to the mobile spraying unit stationed at Orchard Row 12, indicated by the red marker post. Wait for the spraying crew to unload both canisters; this may take up to 10 minutes. Once unloading is confirmed, drive to the north field tool tent and pick up a bundle of replacement rake handles. Deliver the rake handles to the composting area at the rear of Plot 3 and wait for a staff member to remove the bundle before returning to the south storage garage for your next instructions.

Begin at the vehicle garage adjacent to the east entrance. Travel to the tool supply kiosk located by the northern repair shed and pick up a set of four replacement drive belts. Deliver the drive belts to the maintenance pit inside the central tractor bay. Wait at the pit for the mechanics to retrieve all drive belts, which may take up to 10 minutes. Once the belts have been unloaded, proceed to the solar panel cleaning station on the south edge of Field 4 and pick up a container of spent cleaning solution. Transport the container to the hazardous materials collection point in the rear yard of the operations building. After offloading the container, return to the vehicle garage and await further instructions.

Begin at the packing shed next to the main farm road. Proceed to the refrigerated storage unit behind the berry greenhouse and pick up two pallets of freshly picked strawberries. Deliver both pallets to the distribution truck parked at loading bay 2 at the north end of the produce market. Wait until the driver confirms that all strawberries are loaded off your platform. Once complete, return to the packing shed and await new delivery requests.

Begin at the equipment bay next to the eastern orchard and proceed to the compost heap by the south fence line. Pick up three full sacks of composted material. Transport these sacks to the vineyard maintenance hut on the north slope and wait for 7 minutes while the ground crew unloads the material. Next, navigate over to the irrigation control shed near the blueberry patch and wait to be loaded with an empty water tank. Once the tank is secured, deliver it to the central reservoir refill station just past the gravel service road. Wait there until the tank is refilled and removed by the reservoir staff, then return to the equipment bay and stand by for your next assignment.

Begin at the central supply depot adjacent to the north gate. Navigate to the irrigation control station near Field 7 and collect a package labeled 'Pressure Sensors Batch 4'. Deliver this package to the reservoir pump house on the southern perimeter of the property. Wait there until a technician retrieves the package; this process usually takes about 7 minutes. Next, proceed to the seed storage silo by the eastern tractor bay and pick up a pallet containing seed drill attachments. Transport the pallet to the planting crew at Plot 3 West, situated beside the windbreak hedges. Once the attachments have been unloaded, immediately return to the central supply depot to complete the cycle.

Start at the southeast equipment depot next to the water tower. Drive to the compost storage area behind the south pasture and retrieve three bags of compost mix. Deliver the bags to the planter assembly site at the northern greenhouse entrance. Wait for 10 minutes while the field crew distributes the compost into the planters. Afterward, proceed to the battery charging station near the service entrance and wait until you receive a full charge or further instructions from the maintenance supervisor.

Start at the greenhouse control room and collect two sealed boxes of tomato seedlings from the storage shelf. Transport these boxes to Plot 7 in the west growing field. Wait until the planting crew has finished unloading the boxes from your platform. Once unloading is complete, proceed to the irrigation pump station near the central pond and pick up a filtered water canister. Deliver the water canister to the drone charging bay where maintenance technicians are cleaning drone equipment. After the canister has been accepted, remain in the drone bay for 12 minutes in case additional supplies are required before returning to the greenhouse control room.

Begin at the supply depot beside the orchard gate. Proceed to the central greenhouse and pick up two crates of seedling trays. Deliver both crates to the propagation bench inside the northern greenhouse extension. Wait for the horticulture team to unload the seedling trays, which should take approximately 7 minutes. After unloading, continue to the component storage behind the tool shed and collect a roll of irrigation tubing. Bring this irrigation tubing to the drip line section at the east end of the vineyard. Once delivered, return to the supply depot for further instructions.

Start from the logistics hub adjacent to the solar panel array. Proceed to the workshop courtyard situated behind the main administrative building. Pick up two sealed toolboxes designated for field repairs. Travel to the mechanical outpost at the far end of the southern pasture and deliver both toolboxes to the technician's station. Wait until the outpost technician has finished unloading the toolboxes, then return to the logistics hub. Once back, stand by for 12 minutes in case additional supply requests arise.

Begin at the maintenance garage adjacent to the machine shop. Navigate to the western vineyard loading dock and pick up three crates of harvested grapes stacked near the conveyor belt. Transport the crates to the quality inspection tent located beside the irrigation pond. Wait there until the crates are inspected and unloaded by the inspection crew. After unloading, proceed to the fuel depot next to the tractor shed, and wait for 7 minutes for refueling. Once refuelled, return to the maintenance garage and await further assignments.

Begin at the orchard storage shed located east of the fruit sorting facility. Travel to the south apple grove and pick up two bins filled with harvested apples. Head to the cold storage room at the eastern end of the packing plant and deliver the apple bins for processing. Wait for 6 minutes while the processing supervisor checks the contents. When cleared, proceed to the equipment maintenance bay located next to the vehicle wash station. Wait there until a technician loads a crate of spare hydraulic hoses onto the robot. After receiving the crate, transport it to the irrigation pump house on the north field boundary and deliver it there before awaiting your next task.

Start at the vineyard entrance near the main road. Proceed to the southern grape sorting shed and pick up one crate of sampling equipment. Deliver the crate to the quality control laboratory beside the reservoir. Wait for 5 minutes while the lab staff unload the equipment. Once empty, continue to the fertilizer storage shed located by the windmill, collect two bags of organic fertilizer, and transport them to the irrigation control station at the field's northwest corner. Wait until the fertilizer bags are removed before returning to the vineyard entrance.

Start at the equipment bay next to the maintenance barn. Proceed to the solar panel array on the southern perimeter and pick up three containers of cleaning solution left by the service crew. Deliver these containers to the machinery workshop near the machinery wash station. Wait for the maintenance technician to unload and sign off the cleaning solution, which should take about 5 minutes. Once unloaded, head to the pesticide storage building near the main driveway and retrieve two sealed boxes of protective gloves. Bring the gloves to the pest control staging area at the western field entrance, then remain at the staging area and await further loading tasks.

Begin at the central maintenance hub next to the fuel depot. Drive to the spare parts trailer located near the old barn. Pick up two heavy-duty batteries and a sealed toolbag. Proceed to Wind Turbine 3 at the north edge of the property. Wait for the turbine technician to arrive and unload the batteries and toolbag; this should take approximately 8 minutes. Once unloading is complete, continue to the composting facility behind the livestock pens and pick up a crate of organic waste. Deliver the crate to the biogas plant entrance on the southeastern slope, then return to the central maintenance hub and await further instructions.

Begin at the supply depot adjacent to the main farm road. Travel to the eastern vegetable plots and pick up five sacks of harvested carrots stacked near the field entrance. Deliver the sacks to the produce sorting station beside the central barn. Wait for 10 minutes while staff sorts and checks the quality of the carrots, then proceed to the composting area behind the poultry yard to collect two empty crates. Return the empty crates to the supply depot and await further instructions.

Start at the equipment charging station near the wind turbine field. Move to the seed storage shed located along the eastern gravel path and pick up four sacks of wheat seeds. Deliver these seed sacks to the greenhouse entrance on the south side of the property. Wait until horticulture staff have finished unloading all sacks. Upon confirmation, travel to the field tool cabinet next to the irrigation pump house and pick up a tray of replacement nozzles. Drop the tray off at the tractor maintenance bay located beside the main vehicle shed and wait 5 minutes for potential return tasks.

Start at the fuel depot adjacent to the north parking lot. Proceed to the grain silo access road near Field Plot 3 and pick up four full grain sample containers. Deliver these containers to the quality testing lab inside the production building, using the west-side service entrance. Wait for 6 minutes while technicians unload and verify the samples. Once the containers have been transferred, travel to the climate monitoring post behind the windbreak row and await the next assignment.

Begin at the farmyard fuel station located near the north equipment lot. Proceed to the machinery wash bay on the southeast side and pick up four empty oil drums. Transport the oil drums to the recycling center beside the compost heap. Wait until the recycling crew has removed all drums from your platform. After unloading, drive to the orchard gate, collect a single crate of replacement irrigation hoses, and deliver it to the fruit packing tent next to Market Row. Remain at the packing tent for 8 minutes to stand by for any urgent transfer requests from the packing supervisors.

Start at the maintenance workshop adjacent to the equipment storage yard. Proceed to the solar panel array at the southern boundary. Pick up three damaged solar modules that have been stacked on a pallet. Transport the pallet of damaged modules to the electronics recycling container next to the site office. Await the arrival of the facilities technician, who will unload the pallet; remain stationary until all modules are offloaded. After unloading, drive to the irrigation control shed behind the greenhouse complex and stand by for 15 minutes in case urgent supply pickups are required.

Begin at the seed storage facility behind the greenhouse. Collect five sacks of organic fertilizer stored near the eastern wall. Transport the sacks to the planting plot at the south orchard edge. Upon arrival, wait while the planting crew unloads all fertilizer sacks, which the crew estimates will take around 7 minutes. Once unloaded, proceed to the main greenhouse entrance and pick up an empty water tank. Deliver the empty tank to the water refill station next to the windmill pump at the west property line. Wait until the station operator replaces the tank with a full one, which should take about 12 minutes. Finally, carry the filled water tank back to the greenhouse entrance, and wait for the greenhouse attendant to confirm receipt before returning to the seed storage facility.

Start at the equipment garage near the north entrance. Pick up a sealed crate of calibration sensors. Drive to the automated greenhouse and deliver the crate to the climate monitoring station. Wait until the greenhouse technician signs off the delivery and removes the crate. Proceed to the water reservoir station at the western edge of the property, collect three empty water sampling containers, and take them to the laboratory annex next to the administration building. After the lab staff unloads the containers, wait for 10 minutes for any urgent return tasks before heading back to the equipment garage.

Begin at the maintenance workshop adjacent to the vehicle depot. Travel to the fertilizer storage shed near the northern irrigation pond. Pick up two sealed canisters of fertilizer. Drive to the sunflower field along the western boundary of the farm. Wait for fifteen minutes while the field supervisor inspects and unloads the canisters. After they are removed, proceed to the recycling collection point beside the compost yard and collect any used pallets. Deliver the used pallets to the warehouse receiving bay and end the task upon arrival.

Begin at the packaging facility next to the east orchard. Pick up three crates of freshly harvested apples. Drive to the cold storage unit behind the central warehouse and deliver the apple crates to the marked unloading zone. Remain there until the storage team has removed all crates from your platform. Next, proceed to the irrigation control station near the south pond, and pick up a sealed container of water testing kits. Transport the container to the vineyard equipment shed along the western property boundary. Wait for five minutes for the vineyard staff to receive and unload the testing kits. Afterward, return to the packaging facility for your next task.

Start at the tractor garage next to the eastern field. Drive to the supply depot behind the equipment workshop and collect three crates of irrigation tubing. Deliver the crates to the newly planted apple grove at Sector C. Wait at the grove for the farm tech to unload all three crates, which may take up to 10 minutes. After all crates have been removed, travel to the compost yard near the south fence and pick up any empty pallets. Drop off the empty pallets at the repair shop loading bay before returning to the tractor garage.

Begin at the logistics garage adjacent to the southern orchard entrance. Proceed to the central compost station near the solar array and collect two empty bio-waste bins. Transport both bins to the livestock shelter on the west pasture and wait until farm personnel have filled them with animal bedding waste, with a maximum waiting time of 10 minutes. Once loaded, carry the filled bins to the industrial composting pit at the far end of the north field and unload them. After unloading, return the empty bins to the central compost station, then proceed to the charging station beside the shipping yard and dock for battery recharge to conclude your task.

Start at the west equipment depot adjacent to the field office. Proceed to the bulk seed storage silo near the southern boundary of the property and pick up four bags of high-yield wheat seed. Navigate to Crop Field A2 and deliver the seed bags to the planting crew stationed at the marked distribution zone. Remain onsite while the crew unloads the bags—this may take approximately 5 minutes. Once unloading is complete, travel to the workshop annex beside the tractor garage and collect a sealed crate of spare hydraulic hoses. Deliver the crate to the machinery shelter near the vineyard. Wait until the maintenance supervisor acknowledges receipt, then return to the west equipment depot and stand by for additional task assignments.

Begin at the vehicle bay next to the central equipment garage. Drive to the fertilizer storage shed located on the north side of the cornfield and pick up two sealed bags of granular fertilizer. Deliver the bags to the irrigation pump house midway along the east fence line. Place the bags next to the main intake valve. Then, wait for 8 minutes to allow the field crew to retrieve and check the materials. Afterward, return to the vehicle bay and await further instructions.

Start from the greenhouse supply shed near the northern gate. Drive to the vineyard’s northern entrance and pick up two sacks of fertilizer. Deliver the fertilizer to the irrigation control station beside the reservoir. Wait for a vineyard supervisor to confirm the sacks have been unloaded, then proceed to the maintenance garage, and remain there for 10 minutes before returning to the greenhouse supply shed.

Begin at the fleet charging station beside the main garage. Drive to the orchard's southeast tool shed and pick up a box containing pruning shears and a bundle of replacement gloves. Proceed to the eastern apple grove, where the orchard crew is working. Deliver the tools and gloves directly to the crew leader. Wait for 5 minutes to ensure no further items are required. Afterward, travel to the compost processing area near the barn, collect two emptied pesticide containers that are ready for return, and transport them back to the hazardous materials locker at the garage. Once the containers are safely stored, proceed to the garden staging area and await additional instructions.

Begin at the gravel parking area adjoining the machinery garage. Proceed to the greenhouse complex and pick up two trays of young strawberry plants as well as a fertilizer canister. Drive to the rooftop garden elevator access at the vertical farming tower west of the main road. Wait for up to 15 minutes while the horticulture crew unloads all items from your bay. Once unloaded, navigate to the orchard supply shed and collect a coil of irrigation tubing. Deliver the tubing to the northern apple grove near the old stone wall, set it beside the water access point, and then return to the machinery garage for the next assignment.

Begin at the greenhouse supply annex adjacent to the northern gravel lane. Proceed to the seedling propagation tent next to the compost yard and pick up two trays of tomato seedlings. Deliver the trays to the east field's planting row entrance, where the planting crew is stationed. Wait for the crew to unload the seedling trays and confirm delivery. Next, travel to the irrigation control kiosk at the center pivot point, retrieve a box of replacement nozzles, and transport the box to the pump house by the drainage ditch. After dropping off the box, wait for 10 minutes in case any additional irrigation components need transporting. Finally, return to the greenhouse supply annex.

Begin at the maintenance garage located behind the grain silos. Travel to the fertilizer depot by the north access road and pick up three sealed sacks of fertilizer. Deliver the sacks to the irrigation control shed situated at the center of the east alfalfa field. Wait there for 10 minutes while field technicians unload the fertilizer sacks. Once the unloading is complete, move to the machinery washdown station next to the main greenhouse, pick up the empty chemical canister awaiting disposal, and transport it to the hazardous materials drop-off zone at the southern perimeter. After safely unloading the canister, return directly to the maintenance garage and await further instructions.

Start at the packaging warehouse near the north orchard entrance. Travel to the citrus grove and pick up four crates of freshly harvested oranges. Deliver these crates to the cold storage facility behind the main sorting building. After delivery, wait for 7 minutes to allow the quality control team to inspect the crates. Once inspection is complete, proceed to the maintenance hangar, collect two boxes of replacement sprinkler heads, and deliver them to the field technician station at the east irrigation control tower. Return to the packaging warehouse and await further instructions.

Go to the equipment garage located near the main entrance and pick up two canisters of hydraulic oil. Deliver these canisters to the tractor maintenance bay next to the fuel station. After dropping off the canisters, proceed to the orchard tool shed and collect a toolbox marked 'Pruning Tools.' Bring the toolbox to the east orchard gate and wait there until a groundskeeper removes the toolbox. Once the toolbox has been offloaded, return to the equipment garage and wait for 12 minutes before accepting further tasks.

Travel to the compost pile by the west garden beds and retrieve four bins of matured compost. Deliver the bins to the vineyard processing shed located at the southwest corner of the estate. Wait until vineyard workers have removed all compost bins from your platform. Once fully unloaded, proceed to the chemical storage locker adjacent to the fruit sorting building, pick up two sealed pesticide containers, and deliver them to the storage alcove behind the maintenance garage. Do not wait after unloading the pesticide containers; immediately continue to the rest area beside the central access road and remain on standby for 5 minutes before awaiting further instructions.

Begin at the equipment bay behind the north garage and proceed to the compost processing yard. Collect four empty compost bins. Transport the bins to the southeast vegetable plot, where the field crew is stationed near the irrigation pumps. Wait until the crew has finished loading the bins with plant waste. Deliver the filled bins to the waste transfer point beside the maintenance workshop. Once the bins are unloaded, return to the equipment bay.

Start at the maintenance garage beside the administrative office. Navigate to the fertilizer storage area behind the greenhouse complex and pick up two sealed barrels of organic fertilizer. Deliver the barrels to the western crop demonstration plot located beyond the windbreak hedgerow. Wait 7 minutes for the field crew to inspect and unload the barrels. After unloading is complete, drive to the shaded equipment bay at the edge of the machinery lot, pick up any spare irrigation hoses present, and return them to the maintenance garage to complete your route.

Start at the maintenance garage next to the central workyard. Proceed to the solar panel array near the eastern fence and pick up one replacement inverter module. Deliver the inverter to the engineering repair station at the workshop annex. Wait until the maintenance engineer removes the inverter from your platform. Then, travel to the compost yard on the southern edge of the property, collect three empty fermentation bins, and transport them to the orchard equipment station opposite the apple grove. Wait for 7 minutes while the orchard crew unloads the bins. Afterward, return to the maintenance garage and standby for your next assignment.

Begin at the maintenance shed next to the north gate and collect the orange tool case labeled 'Emergency Repair Kit'. Make your way to the wind turbine access road and deliver the tool case to the maintenance team at Turbine 3. Wait until the kit is completely offloaded, then continue to the solar panel array on the east hill and retrieve four used battery packs. Bring the battery packs to the recycling container behind the electronics workshop. Once the batteries are delivered, remain at the workshop for 10 minutes in case additional pickups are required before returning to the maintenance shed for further tasks.

Start at the supply depot adjacent to the orchard entrance. Navigate to the pesticide locker behind the south tractor barn and collect a single locked container of organic pesticide. Proceed to the southernmost row of the apple orchard and deliver the container at the designated drop-off point near the irrigation control box. Wait there until the orchard supervisor confirms the transfer has been completed. Once confirmation is received, travel to the solar charging station between the greenhouse cluster and the compost yard, and remain docked for 15 minutes of charging time.

Start at the central depot next to the main office building. Proceed to Orchard Section C and pick up two bins of harvested pears. Drive the bins to the cooling storage area behind Packing Shed 2. Wait for the warehouse staff to transfer the pears into cold storage. Once the bins are empty, return them to Orchard Section C and notify the harvesting crew before heading back to the central depot.

Start at the storage garage behind the machine shop. Proceed to the vineyard tool shed near the eastern trellis rows and collect a set of pruning shears and two repair kits. Deliver these items to the viticulture team stationed at the south overlook staging area. Wait while the team inspects and collects the tools, which may take up to 8 minutes. Once the tools are unloaded, continue to the packaging pavilion by the main gate, pick up four sealed boxes of bottled grape juice, and transport them to the delivery dispatch office beside the administration building. After completing the delivery, return to the storage garage and remain in standby mode.

Begin at the equipment storage shed located adjacent to the cattle barn. Drive to the east gate greenhouse and pick up two sealed boxes of starter seedlings. Take the boxes to the propagation chamber inside the research facility on the north ridge. Wait for 10 minutes while the research staff unload and catalog the seedlings. After unloading is complete, proceed to the vehicle service station near the eastern access road, collect an empty parts crate, and transport it back to the equipment storage shed. Once the crate has been placed in the designated drop-off zone, await further instructions for 3 minutes.

Start at the vineyard equipment shed and proceed to the compost processing area near the northern apple orchard. Pick up two bags of soil nutrients stacked beside the compost bins. Deliver both bags to the greenhouse potting station beside the visitor parking lot. Wait for 8 minutes while the greenhouse crew unloads the bags and confirms receipt. Afterwards, drive to the field supervisor’s tent between the cornfield and sunflower plot to collect an empty crate marked 'Return to Storage.' Take the crate back to the vineyard equipment shed and await further instructions.

Start at the field-side maintenance garage. Collect two containers of biofertilizer stored by the entrance. Drive to the grape vineyard's southern edge where the fertilization team is working. Deliver both containers and wait until the team has fully emptied the contents, which should take roughly 8 minutes. Once the containers are empty, return them to the maintenance garage and stay by the entrance in case additional supplies are needed.

Begin at the central maintenance hub beside the paved access trail. Drive to the fertilizer storage shed adjacent to the west orchard and collect two sealed drums of organic fertilizer. Navigate to the irrigation control area between the apple and pear groves, and deliver the fertilizer drums. Wait while the orchard manager inspects and unloads the cargo, then proceed to the tool distribution kiosk outside the fabrication workshop. Pick up a container of replacement drip nozzles. Take the nozzles to the berry crop patch on the south slope, and remain stationary for 7 minutes to allow technicians to retrieve the container. Once the task is complete, return to the central maintenance hub by the access trail.

Start at the workshop behind the solar array. Drive to the fertilizer storage unit south of the carrot field and pick up three bags of organic fertilizer. Transport the bags to the composting area near the main irrigation canal. Wait for 5 minutes to allow the grounds crew to unload the fertilizer. After unloading, proceed to the storage barn next to the cattle paddock and collect a spool of heavy-duty fencing wire. Deliver the spool to the pasture gate at the northeast corner of the property. Wait until the fencing crew has removed the spool before returning to the workshop.

Start at the solar panel storage shed behind the administration building. Drive to the north orchard entrance and pick up three crates of fresh apples. Transport the apple crates to the produce loading dock at the distribution warehouse. Wait for 5 minutes while warehouse staff inspect and unload the crates. After unloading, pick up one empty crate marked for cleaning from the loading dock and return it to the solar panel storage shed. Wait there until a cleaner retrieves the empty crate from the robot.

Start at the equipment charging station next to the eastern tractor depot. Travel to the southwestern vineyard loading platform and pick up four crates of harvested grapes. Deliver the loaded crates to the fermentation room inside the main winery building. Wait at the delivery entrance for approximately 10 minutes while the winery staff unload the grapes. Afterwards, proceed to the pest control supply room behind the administration office, collect a sealed container of eco-friendly pesticide, and drive it to the southern raspberry patch adjacent to the pond. Wait until a field technician retrieves the pesticide before returning to the equipment charging station to await further instructions.

Go to the tool storage shed next to the southwest greenhouse and pick up a sealed container of plant nutrients and three replacement irrigation nozzles. Deliver these items to the irrigation control hub behind the hydroponic shelterbelt. Wait for the facility manager to remove the plant nutrient container and install the nozzles—estimated wait time is 8 minutes. Once all equipment has been unloaded, proceed to the seed vault at the eastern fence corner to pick up a set of shelving brackets. Transport the brackets to the vertical seedling racks area inside Greenhouse 2, then return to the tool storage shed and stand by for further instructions for 4 minutes before ending the task.

Begin at the maintenance workshop adjacent to the southern machinery shed. Proceed to the windbreak grove storage unit and collect five solar panel cleaning kits and a crate of replacement fuses. Transport all items to the solar array control station situated at the east field boundary and wait for 15 minutes while the site technicians inspect and retrieve the delivered materials. Once the items have been unloaded, return to the machinery shed and wait until an operator loads two empty oil canisters onto your platform. After the canisters are secured, travel to the hazardous waste collection zone next to the compost facility and deliver the empty canisters for recycling. When delivery is complete, move to the equipment charging point on the north side of the main barn and remain there until your next instructions are received.

Begin at the equipment shelter beside the admin office. Navigate to the orchard's north boundary and retrieve three crates of freshly harvested apples. Transport the apple crates to the processing facility loading bay. Wait until all crates have been unloaded by facility staff. After confirming your platform is empty, proceed to the solar panel array near the tool depot. Remain at the solar panel array for 5 minutes to allow for system diagnostics before returning to the equipment shelter.

Start at the main garage beside the old windmill. Head to the solar panel lot at the far west corner of the property and pick up a single box of replacement solar cell units. Deliver the box to the maintenance platform at the top entrance of the control tower. Wait 10 minutes for the maintenance crew to install the replacement units and potentially return unused components. Once you receive any returned items, transport them to the storage room next to the parts workshop, offload the items, and then proceed to the central courtyard to await further instructions.

Start at the maintenance hub next to the south parking lot. Proceed to the orchard’s east gate and pick up three bins of freshly harvested apples. Deliver the bins to the produce cooling shed at the rear of the distribution warehouse. Wait until a staff member has removed all three bins from your payload area. Afterward, travel to the fuel storage annex behind the main utility building and collect a sealed container of engine oil. Transport the engine oil to the tractor refueling station by the field entrance. Once the container has been offloaded, return to the maintenance hub and await further instructions.

Start at the maintenance garage next to the seed warehouse. Travel to the field tool supply lot on the east perimeter and pick up a container holding assorted replacement sprinkler nozzles. Deliver the container to the central irrigation hub at the south field corner and wait until the maintenance crew has removed all nozzles from your platform. After unloading, drive to the composting area near the windbreak grove and collect two empty fertilizer bins. Take the bins to the chemical storage shed at the back of the main greenhouse and wait for 10 minutes to allow staff to fill the bins. Once loaded, return the filled fertilizer bins to the composting area and remain there until a technician verifies delivery before heading back to the maintenance garage.

Begin at the equipment charging station beside the eastern orchard gate. Proceed to the grain silo loading bay and pick up three empty produce crates. Deliver the crates to Plot 7 at the blueberry harvesting zone, and wait until field workers have filled and loaded the crates with harvested blueberries. Once all crates are secured (expect a wait of up to 10 minutes), transport the loaded crates to the cold storage facility behind the main greenhouse. Wait at the loading ramp until all crates are removed from your platform, then return to the equipment charging station to conclude your assignment.

Start at the logistics garage next to the south entrance gate. Proceed to the fertilizer storage facility situated within the field operations complex. Pick up four stacked bags of organic fertilizer from the designated loading area. Transport these bags to Plot 12 at the eastern end of the vineyard. Wait for farmhands to unload the fertilizer, which may take about 6 minutes. Following this, drive to the solar panel maintenance area beside the utility outbuilding. Collect a toolkit case and a replacement inverter unit. Deliver these items to the electrical substation near the windbreak grove and wait until all items have been unloaded before returning to the logistics garage.

Begin at the equipment garage next to the packing house. Navigate to the western composting area and collect a sealed drum of organic fertilizer. Deliver the drum to the raised planter beds at the south end of the demonstration garden. Wait for 12 minutes while the planting crew distributes the fertilizer.
