Afterward, proceed to the storage tent near the rainwater collection tanks and pick up a pallet containing three boxes of seed packets. Transport the seed packets to the farmers’ market staging area by the roadside entrance. Once the boxes are unloaded, return to the equipment garage and await further assignments.

Begin at the maintenance workshop beside the eastern storage silos. Proceed to the seed warehouse located behind the irrigation tanks and collect a pallet of hybrid corn seed bags. Deliver the pallet to the northern field supply zone near the crop rotation plots. Wait for 10 minutes while farm technicians verify the inventory and unload the seed bags. After all items are accounted for, navigate to the equipment charging station on the western service road, and remain there until your charging cycle is completed before awaiting further instructions.

Begin at the maintenance depot near the west orchard entrance. Proceed to the storage shed beside the windmill and pick up two replacement tractor tires and a toolkit. Transport both items to the vehicle repair station located beside the eastern row of solar panels. Wait up to 20 minutes while mechanics offload the cargo and inspect the tools. Once given the go-ahead by the repair crew, drive to the compost yard adjacent to the pumpkin patch. Collect three empty compost bins and deliver them to the crop residue collection point behind the grain silo. After the bins have been unloaded, return to the maintenance depot and await further instructions.

Begin at the storage quay beside the northern farm pond. Proceed to the pallet yard located west of the grain silos. Collect one crate of irrigation fittings and two coils of drip hose from the marked pallets. Transport these supplies to the orchard tool station near the east side of the apple grove. Wait up to 10 minutes for the orchard crew to unload all items. When the unloading is confirmed complete, continue to the compost shelter at the end of the gravel lane and pick up a single bin of organic waste. Deliver the compost bin to the vegetable beds behind the greenhouse, then return to the storage quay to complete your route.

Begin at the maintenance garage near the entrance to the storage silos. Drive to the spare parts shed behind the machinery repair barn. Pick up four hydraulic hoses and a box of assorted bolts from the supplies rack. Deliver these items to the field maintenance station located along the northern cattle path. Wait until you are unloaded by the repair crew, which should take no more than 8 minutes. Once the payload is removed, proceed to the refueling station next to the windbreak hedgerow and wait 12 minutes for refueling before returning to the maintenance garage.

Start at the administration building’s side entrance. Drive to the solar equipment yard and pick up three coiled extension cables. Deliver the cables to the irrigation control station next to the west canal and wait until a technician removes all the cables from your payload bay. Then, proceed to the shipping container area by the north gate, collect a single crate of packaged seedlings, and deliver it to the planting team at plot 7 of the experimental field. Once the crate is offloaded, stand by in the shade pavilion near the main access road for 10 minutes before proceeding to your docking station located beside the operations office.

Begin at the south gate parking area. Drive to the greenhouse supply lot near the western edge of the property and collect three cartons of fertilizer supplements. Proceed to the berry patch at Station 4 next to the windbreak trees. Deliver the fertilizer cartons to the supply table near the patch entrance. Wait until all cartons have been unloaded, then travel to the pond-side tool shed to pick up a hose reel. Bring the hose reel to the vineyard's main irrigation valve, and wait up to 10 minutes for the vineyard manager to connect the equipment. After the task is confirmed complete, return to the south gate parking area.

Begin at the maintenance garage near the north entrance of the facility. Drive to the forklift supplies area adjacent to Warehouse C. Pick up a pallet containing four new hydraulic hoses. Deliver the pallet to the tractor repair zone at the eastern edge of the main field. Wait at the repair zone until the mechanic removes the pallet from the platform. Once unloaded, proceed to the greenhouse recycling station and wait there for 10 minutes before returning to the maintenance garage to conclude your task sequence.

Start at the orchard equipment garage near the western grove. Navigate to the packaging area at the south end of the orchard and pick up three boxes of freshly picked apples. Deliver these boxes to the cooling chamber inside the farm's produce warehouse. Wait until a staff member has unloaded all boxes and confirmed the storage. Once the unloading is complete, drive to the greenhouse annex to the north and collect a single fertilizer bag left in the supply corner. Bring the fertilizer bag back to the orchard equipment garage and stand by for 5 minutes before receiving your next task.

Begin at the garage located behind the administration office. Drive to Orchard Block C and collect two crates of harvested peaches from the collection point near the old oak tree. Proceed to the fruit packing facility on Harvest Lane and deliver the crates at the designated receiving dock. Wait until both crates have been unloaded by the packing staff. Then, continue to the maintenance workshop opposite the pump house and pick up a replacement drive belt. Take the drive belt to the windmill station at the top of Ridge Hill and hand it over to the technician on duty. Once the technician has collected the part from the robot, return directly to the garage to complete the route.

Begin at the equipment storage area adjacent to the eastern gate. Move to the orchard's central distribution point and pick up four crates of harvested apples. Deliver the apple crates to the cold storage facility next to the packing house. Wait for the quality control inspector to finish checking the crates, which may take up to 10 minutes. Once the apples have been approved and removed, proceed to the chemical supply hut near the southern hedgerow, collect two sealed containers of fertilizer, and transport them to the crop trial plots at the far end of Field 7. Upon delivery, stand by for instructions from the agronomy team.

Begin at the maintenance corridor beside the main greenhouse. Drive to the seed storage facility next to the east field and retrieve three sacks of corn seeds. Deliver the sacks to the planting machinery assembly area near the north entrance of Field B. Wait until a farm technician has unloaded all the sacks from your platform. Once unloading is complete, proceed to the water filtration hut at the edge of the irrigation canal and collect a crate of water filters. Transport the crate to the utility shed behind the sheep enclosure and return to the maintenance corridor after delivery.

Begin at the vehicle garage adjacent to the solar farm. Proceed to the supply depot near the west orchard and pick up a box of replacement drone batteries. Transport the box to the control station at the center of the farm. Wait for up to 5 minutes while a technician retrieves the batteries from your platform. After unloading, navigate to the compost processing area next to the southern fence and collect two empty compost bins. Deliver the empty bins to the greenhouse complex north of the pond and wait until both bins are removed from your cargo bay. Once the task is complete, move to the equipment wash station beside the windmill and remain on standby for further assignments.

Begin at the equipment charging bay behind the main office. Proceed to the solar farm supply depot and pick up three sealed boxes of photovoltaic sensors. Deliver the sensor boxes to the solar array control hut on the south ridge. Wait for the technician to remove all boxes from your cargo area. Next, travel to the vehicle maintenance yard and wait for five minutes to allow engineers to load a replacement tire and a toolkit onto your platform. Once loaded, transport these items to the wind turbine base near the pond at the northern border. After someone removes the tools and tire from your platform, return to the equipment charging bay and stand by for further instructions.

Start at the storage garage located behind the administrative office building. Travel to the fertilizer staging area near the west cornfield entrance and pick up three sealed bags of organic fertilizer. Navigate to the vineyard supply dock adjacent to the southern vineyard rows and deliver the fertilizer bags. Wait until the vineyard supervisor confirms receipt and removes all bags from the platform. Afterwards, proceed to the spare parts shed on the northern maintenance road, collect a crate containing replacement sprinkler nozzles, and deliver the crate to the irrigation control hut next to the main access driveway. Upon completion of all deliveries, return to the storage garage and await further assignments.

Start at the orchard supply shed near the west field entrance. Collect three sacks of organic fertilizer and a bundle of wooden planting stakes. Drive to the berry patch beside the irrigation canal and deliver the items to the field supervisor. Wait up to 5 minutes while workers unload the supplies from your platform. After delivery is complete, proceed to the equipment cleaning station at the south end of the property. There, pick up two empty water barrels and return them to the recycling depot located behind the composting area. Finally, travel to the shade structure beside the field workers’ rest area and wait there in standby mode until you receive further instructions.

Start at the equipment hub near the main entrance. Drive to the orchard loading dock and pick up three crates of harvested apples. Deliver the crates to the cold storage facility on the north side of the processing plant. After unloading, proceed to the pesticide storage room adjacent to the greenhouses and pick up two sealed canisters of eco-friendly pesticide. Transport the canisters to the southern greenhouse bay, and wait for 10 minutes while the field crew unloads the contents. Once the canisters are removed, return to the equipment hub.

Begin at the maintenance garage near the southwestern gate. Navigate to the spare parts storage area beside the solar panel array and collect a crate of hydraulic pistons. Deliver the crate to the machine repair zone at the northern end of the harvest field. Wait until the mechanics finish unloading the crate. Next, proceed to the orchard entrance and pick up a pair of empty produce bins. Transport the empty bins to the east-side apple grove, and wait for 20 minutes as orchard workers load them with freshly picked apples. Once the bins are full, move them to the cold storage chamber adjacent to the packing house. After delivery, return to the maintenance garage near the southwestern gate.

Start at the fuel depot located beside the machinery garage. Collect two portable generators from the depot loading platform. Transport the generators to the temporary event area at the east meadow, just past the visitors’ kiosk. Wait until the logistics coordinator verifies and unloads both generators. Once unloaded, proceed to the main greenhouse entrance and pick up a crate of harvested zucchinis. Deliver the crate to the fresh produce dispatch bay next to the north parking lot. After completing delivery, return directly to the machinery garage for battery recharge.

Begin at the equipment shelter near the west cattle barn. Drive to the fertilizer storage shed adjacent to the main grain silo. Pick up two sealed fertilizer containers and transport them to the row crop field access point at the southern boundary. Wait up to 10 minutes for the containers to be unloaded by field staff. After all containers are unloaded, proceed to the irrigation control hub near the center pond for inspection, then return to the equipment shelter to complete the assignment.

Begin at the farm equipment bay located beside the irrigation control center. Drive to the compost station and pick up three full bags of organic fertilizer. Transport these bags to the greenhouse at the eastern edge of the farm complex. Wait in the designated unloading area for up to 10 minutes while greenhouse staff remove all three fertilizer bags. Once offloading is complete, proceed to the packaging facility loading dock to collect a pallet of empty produce crates. Deliver the pallet to the field staging area next to the south tomato plots. After dropping off the crates, return to the farm equipment bay for further instructions.

Start at the parts storage depot adjacent to the eastern access road. Drive to the windbreak orchard and retrieve a crate of pruning shears and safety vests prepared by the agricultural team. Bring the crate to the field worker assembly area near the main operations tent. Wait until all items have been removed from your platform. Next, travel to the water treatment outbuilding on the southeastern perimeter and collect three sealed canisters of water treatment solution. Deliver these canisters to the plant nursery's shaded pavilion entryway. Remain at the pavilion for 6 minutes while the nursery staff unloads the canisters. Once complete, proceed to the operations command station and await further task assignment.

Begin at the logistics depot near the entrance gate. Travel to the field-side tool storage container next to the west barley field and pick up the bag of specialized wrenches. Deliver the wrenches to the mechanical service tent by the fleet refueling bay. Wait until the mechanic has taken all wrenches and confirms the area is clear. Next, proceed to the main harvesting path near the weather monitoring station and collect two sealed bins of soil samples. Transport the soil sample bins to the laboratory cabin beside the greenhouses. Wait for laboratory staff to unload both bins before returning to the logistics depot and await further tasks.

Start at the maintenance garage near the eastern orchard entrance. Drive to the spare parts depot beside the machine workshop and pick up two replacement hydraulic hoses. Transport the hoses to the tractor service bay on the south end of the field operations center. Wait for a technician to arrive and unload both hoses. Once the area is cleared, proceed to the chemical storage shed north of the irrigation control station, retrieve a sealed container of pesticide, and deliver it to the crop treatment team staging area at the west edge of Orchard Block 3. After dropping off the container, return to the maintenance garage.

Start at the logistics bay beside the north machinery shop. Drive to the seed storage tent located behind the irrigation pond. Pick up six sacks of hybrid corn seed. Proceed to the northwest field plot near the windbreak trees. Wait while farm staff remove the sacks from the robot, which may take approximately 10 minutes. Once the seeds are unloaded, navigate to the field workshop at the west boundary. Retrieve a set of soil moisture sensors from the designated workbench. Deliver the sensors to the crop research station adjacent to the field, and after staff confirm successful delivery, return to the logistics bay.

Start at the equipment garage next to the composting facility. Head to the pallet storage area near the north greenhouse entrance and pick up three sealed pallets of soil amendments. Transport the pallets to the fertilizer mixing zone just past the east tractor shed. Wait for up to 12 minutes while the agricultural staff unloads the materials and confirms receipt. Once the unloading is finished, proceed to the orchard access gate adjacent to the irrigation canal to retrieve one empty water tank. Deliver the empty tank to the pump house beside the central reservoir. After delivery, return to the equipment garage and remain on standby for further instructions.

Begin at the tool storage cabin beside the north access road. Proceed to the central fertilizer depot and pick up a canister of liquid fertilizer. Transport the canister to the autonomous tractor refueling bay near the east meadow. Wait at the bay until the support team has emptied the canister. Once the payload is removed, drive to the orchard’s north gate and collect six empty produce crates. Take these crates to the fruit loading ramp at the south end of the orchard, then wait for 10 minutes to allow the harvest team to fill the crates before returning to the tool storage cabin.

Start from the central storage bunker near the west entrance. Drive to Orchard Block 4 and collect a crate of freshly picked pears and two empty harvesting baskets. Proceed to the fruit packing shed on the southern boundary of the property and unload the pears for processing. Wait at the shed for 10 minutes to allow workers to refill the baskets with packaging materials. Once loaded, transport the filled baskets to the cold storage unit beside the main office, deliver them inside, and then return to the central storage bunker.

Start at the maintenance garage next to the irrigation reservoir. Proceed to the greenhouse annex and collect two bins of harvested tomatoes. Drive to the packing shed located between the orchard and the old windmill and wait until the crew fully unloads the bins. After unloading, continue to the fertilizer storage yard at the west boundary and pick up a single 25-liter container of liquid fertilizer. Deliver the container to the westernmost irrigation pump house and wait for 8 minutes to allow technicians to transfer the fertilizer into the system. Once the transfer is complete, return to the maintenance garage and prepare for the next task.

Start at the maintenance bay next to the greenhouse complex. Proceed to the irrigation pump station by the north pond and pick up two sealed chemical canisters. Deliver the canisters to field block C at the southern edge of the property. Wait until the field supervisor unloads both canisters from the robot. After the transfer is complete, go to the equipment storage barn located near the west entrance and collect three replacement hoses. Deliver the hoses to the repair crew stationed at the tractor refueling point, then return to the maintenance bay and await further instructions.

Begin at the equipment depot adjacent to the main grain silo. Navigate to the machinery storage yard located behind the old farmhouse and pick up a pallet containing three hydraulic hoses and a box of replacement fuses. Deliver the box of fuses to the electrical maintenance bay near the north entrance of the facility and wait until the maintenance technician removes the box from your platform. Next, proceed to the irrigation station by the west canal and drop off the pallet with hydraulic hoses. Remain at the irrigation station for 7 minutes to assist with any additional unloading needs. After the waiting period or once the load is removed, return to the equipment depot to complete your route.

Start at the fertilizer shed next to Field Gate 3. Travel to the orchard packing area located south of the apple grove. Pick up two crates of freshly harvested apples stacked by the west loading platform. Transport these crates to the cold storage facility behind the distribution warehouse. Wait up to 6 minutes for the cold storage staff to unload the crates, then remain in position until a single empty transport bin is loaded onto your platform. Once you have the empty bin, return it to the orchard packing area and place it at the designated drop-off point beside the conveyor belt. When the drop-off is complete, proceed to the fertilizer shed to end your shift.

Begin at the seed storage room near the eastern greenhouse. Drive to the supply pickup zone at the southern orchard entrance and collect one large pallet of irrigation hoses. Transport the pallet directly to the northern crop field, where workers will be waiting. Wait until all irrigation hoses have been offloaded from the robot—confirm with a signal from the field supervisor. Once unloaded, move to the central tractor garage, collect a replacement hydraulic pump, and deliver it to the workshop adjacent to the machine assembly yard. Do not wait after delivery; return promptly to the seed storage room to complete the task.

Proceed to the tool storage room at the maintenance garage and pick up two sets of pruning shears and a box containing replacement blades. Transport these items directly to the field supervisor’s trailer located at the edge of the southern crop rows. Wait at the trailer until the supervisor has removed all items from your platform. Then, drive to the greenhouse loading zone, and collect a pallet of seedling trays. Deliver the seedling trays to the garden plot staging area near the west fence. Once the trays have been offloaded by the garden staff, return to the maintenance garage for further assignments.

Begin at the maintenance workshop adjacent to the main barn. Proceed to the solar panel array near the eastern fence line. Retrieve two boxes of replacement panel components from the supply rack. Transport the boxes to the utility storage shed beside the north gate. Wait at the shed until the site technician has unloaded both boxes and signs off on the delivery. Then continue to the loading dock at the southern storage facility and remain there until given new instructions.

Begin at the orchard’s east access gate near the farm office. Proceed to the supply shed adjacent to the north greenhouse and pick up a sealed crate containing 25 young apple saplings. Transport the crate to the planting area on Terrace Field 3, next to the northern irrigation canal. Wait for the planting crew to unload all saplings, approximately 10 minutes. After the crate is empty, drive to the composting site beside the old barn and collect a bag of organic fertilizer. Deliver the fertilizer bag to the flower nursery just east of the main greenhouse. Wait until the nursery staff signals that delivery is complete, then return to the orchard’s east access gate and await further instructions.

Begin at the central garage near the east entrance. Proceed to the machinery workshop and collect two boxes of replacement spark plugs. Carefully deliver these boxes to the tractor refueling station on the west farm road. Wait for the mechanics to unload both boxes, then continue to the irrigation control hub in the south field to pick up any maintenance reports left on the designated platform. Return the collected reports to the central garage and place them in the maintenance inbox to complete your task.

Start at the maintenance garage beside the machinery lot. Travel to the pump control hut near the eastern irrigation canal. Pick up a toolbox and three sealed bottles of lubricating oil. Drive to the solar panel field's service area at the northern boundary. Deliver the lubricating oil at the supply rack and wait until the maintenance technician removes the toolbox from your platform. After unloading, proceed to the grain silo observation deck and wait for 7 minutes for status verification. Once the waiting period is over, return to the maintenance garage.

Start at the logistics hub adjacent to the grain silos. Proceed to the equipment depot located behind the maintenance barn and collect a single crate of spare irrigation valves. Deliver the crate to the pump control station near the eastern crop circle. Wait at the control station for 10 minutes or until the system supervisor retrieves the crate, whichever comes first. When your platform is empty, continue to the southwestern storage tent and pick up two empty water tanks. Bring the empty tanks to the river loading point at the old dock. Remain at the dock until workers have filled and removed both tanks, then return to the logistics hub to stand by for your next assignment.

Begin at the equipment garage adjacent to the north parking lot. Travel to the compost processing station on the eastern hillside and pick up three sacks of organic fertilizer. Transport the sacks to the vineyard block located below the irrigation reservoir and wait until the vineyard supervisor unloads all the fertilizer from your platform. After the delivery, proceed to the shipping container near the orchard entrance to collect a set of pruning shears and a box of plant tags. Deliver these supplies to the orchard crew working near the central apple rows, then wait for 5 minutes in case any additional hand tools need to be added. Once the final items are loaded or if there are no additions after the 5-minute wait, return to the equipment garage to finish the task.

Begin at the supply depot adjacent to the main greenhouse. Drive to the composting facility near the southeast corner of the property and pick up three sacks of organic fertilizer. Deliver the fertilizer sacks to the flower bed staging area just behind the botanical research cabin. Wait up to 7 minutes for the horticulture team to unload all sacks and confirm receipt. Next, proceed to the livestock barn located by the southern pasture and pick up a medium-size feed container. Transport the feed container to the veterinary outpost at the foot of the western hillside. Wait until the outpost staff have removed the container, then return to the supply depot and await further tasks.

Begin at the maintenance depot adjacent to the central storage yard. Proceed to the western livestock shelter and pick up two sealed containers of animal feed supplements. Deliver the containers to the veterinary station beside the pasture gates. Wait until both containers have been unloaded by the veterinary team. Next, drive to the supply tent at the southwest corner of the equipment lot and collect three sets of hydraulic hose replacements. Transport these hoses to the field tractor bay located near the southern crop fields. Wait for 5 minutes to allow the maintenance crew to retrieve the hoses before returning to the maintenance depot to complete the task.

Start at the maintenance workshop next to the wind turbine array. Travel to the livestock shelter beyond the eastern orchard to collect two sealed veterinary supply crates. Deliver these crates to the mobile clinic van parked near the southern pasture gate. Wait until the clinic staff has fully unloaded the supplies and confirm completion with the team leader. Then proceed to the central tool depot at the heart of the machinery yard and retrieve a spare hydraulic pump. Take the hydraulic pump to the north machinery shed for use in scheduled repairs. Once you've completed the delivery, remain at the north machinery shed for 10 minutes in case further transport requests are made.

Begin at the central grain silo access point. Travel to the blueberry patch at the north field edge and pick up three empty water canisters from the irrigation station. Deliver the canisters to the riverfront pump house located near the old windmill. Wait for 10 minutes while the canisters are filled by the farmhands. Afterward, return the full water canisters to the berry patch watering station and place them beside the storage crate. Once the delivery is complete, continue to the central grain silo and await further instructions.

Start from the central storage bunker adjacent to the seed processing building. Proceed to the east-side machinery bay and pick up one replacement hydraulic pump. Transport the hydraulic pump to the solar irrigation station located along the west perimeter road. Wait until a maintenance technician removes the pump from your cargo deck. Once unloaded, proceed to the livestock feed depot and collect four bags of pellet feed. Deliver these bags to the automated feeder area in the north stable. After delivery, return to the central storage bunker and await further instructions.

Start at the equipment storage shed near the irrigation pond. Drive to the farm market tent adjacent to the eastern parking lot and pick up three baskets of freshly harvested strawberries. Bring the baskets to the produce packing room inside the barn. Wait there until the produce team has unloaded all the baskets, which is estimated to take about 8 minutes. After unloading, travel to the greenhouse loading bay and collect any empty plastic trays stacked by the entrance. Deliver the empty trays to the equipment storage shed before ending the route.

Begin at the maintenance garage located next to the west parking lot. Drive to the equipment depot behind the fertilizer silos and pick up a pallet of replacement tractor tires. Transport the pallet to the vehicle repair zone beside the machinery barn. Wait for the mechanics to unload all the tires. Once unloading is confirmed, proceed to the nursery greenhouse on the south end and collect six bags of potting soil. Deliver the soil bags to the landscaping crew at the central garden plot near the main walkway. After the crew has received the soil, return to the maintenance garage.

Start at the maintenance garage next to the orchard. Proceed to the pesticide storage shed located behind the eastern greenhouse. Retrieve three sealed pesticide containers marked for the apple grove. Deliver these containers to the orchard edge near the northeast fence, where the spraying team is stationed. Wait at the delivery point for 12 minutes as the team unloads the containers and places two empty drums onto your loading platform. After securing the empty drums, travel to the recycling station near the compost facility and offload the drums before returning to the maintenance garage.

Start at the maintenance depot beside the south parking lot. Travel to the loading zone outside the wooden pallet warehouse. Pick up two crates of ceramic tiles. Deliver the crates to the greenhouse repair site at the eastern perimeter. Wait for 15 minutes while the repair team unloads the tiles. After unloading is complete, proceed to the fertilizer storage building near the center of the property. Collect one 50-liter drum of liquid fertilizer. Transport the drum to the orchard supply shed adjacent to the apple grove and wait until the orchard manager removes the drum from your platform before heading back to the maintenance depot.

Begin by traveling to the livestock barn located north of the tractor bay. Pick up two sacks of mineral feed from the storage alcove inside the barn. Transport the feed sacks to the open pen near the windbreak trees on the western property boundary. Wait for the barn staff to unload the sacks—this should take about 6 minutes. After unloading, proceed to the maintenance garage next to the paved central courtyard. Collect a crate containing assorted hydraulic fittings from the tool bench area. Deliver the crate to the packing facility loading ramp at the north entrance. Stand by at the loading ramp for 10 minutes to allow the mechanics to inspect and empty the crate, then return to the central equipment park near the silo complex.

Start at the maintenance room adjacent to the central workshop. Navigate to the apple orchard picking lane near the eastern fence and collect three full crates of freshly harvested apples. Transport the crates to the cold storage facility by the southern greenhouses. Wait at the receiving bay for 8 minutes while the staff inspects the crates and electronically logs the inventory. Once the crates are confirmed and removed, proceed to the fertilizer storage shed behind the machinery garage to pick up a sealed bag of granular fertilizer. Deliver the fertilizer bag to the open field plot numbered F12, and wait until a field technician retrieves it from the robot. After delivery is complete, return to the maintenance room to complete the cycle.

Start at the greenhouse maintenance garage adjacent to the east perimeter fence. Drive to the tools storage cabin nestled between the compost processing unit and the pond, and pick up a crate containing pruning shears. Transport the crate to the hillside orchard entrance near the old olive grove. Wait at the entrance for 5 minutes for the orchard team to unload the crate. After unloading, proceed to the rainwater collection cistern beside the solar panel array, wait there until two empty water containers are loaded onto the robot (wait for the staff to place them), and finally deliver these containers to the greenhouse maintenance garage.

Begin by traveling to the seed storage barn located north of the greenhouse complex. Pick up a box of tomato seeds and an irrigation tool kit. Proceed to the south greenhouse and deliver both items to the planting crew at the entryway. Wait for up to 10 minutes until the planting crew unloads the supplies. When finished, head over to the maintenance workshop next to the tractor parking area. Collect four drained battery packs from the charging rack and take them to the battery recycling center at the northeast corner of the facility. Once the battery packs have been delivered, proceed to the security checkpoint at the main entrance and stand by there until directed to a new task.

Begin at the main gate security checkpoint. Head to the east orchard loading zone to pick up three bins of freshly harvested apples. Transport these apple bins to the cold storage facility beside the administrative building. After delivery, wait for 5 minutes while the storage manager verifies the inventory and places empty collection crates on the robot. Collect the empty crates and deliver them to the field station at the far western edge of the property. Wait until the crates are offloaded at the field station before proceeding to the central charging hub for your next assignment.

Start from the workshop annex beside the central tool depot. Drive to the southern greenhouse loading dock and collect two sealed crates of horticultural sensors. Carefully transport the crates to the seedling preparation area in Greenhouse 4. Wait for a technician to unload both crates, then proceed to the southwest compost yard and pick up an empty fertilizer drum from the storage pallet. Deliver this drum to the chemical refill station adjacent to the main water tower, and stand by for 8 minutes while the drum is refilled. Once loading is confirmed complete, return to the workshop annex to end your route.

Travel to the central loading dock adjacent to the packaging warehouse and wait for a pallet of sealed apple crates to be loaded onto your platform. Once the crates are securely in place, proceed to the cold storage facility at the southern edge of the farm. Deliver the pallet of apple crates at the receiving bay of the cold storage and await confirmation from the facility manager. Following confirmation, drive to the farm equipment workshop to collect an empty toolbox. Transport the empty toolbox to the mobile field repair trailer stationed by the pumpkin patch, and wait there until the field technician has removed the toolbox before returning to the central loading dock to complete your task.

Start at the orchard supply shed near the apple grove entrance. Drive to the fertilizer bunker beside the maintenance garage and collect two bags of slow-release fertilizer pellets. Proceed to the north orchard section along Cherry Lane and deliver the bags to the designated drop-off point by the old tractor. Wait for the orchard manager to confirm receipt, which may take up to 10 minutes. Once confirmed, continue to the weather monitoring station near the west treeline and await further instructions.

Start at the equipment garage near the east boundary. Drive to the loading bay adjacent to the field warehouse and pick up two reels of irrigation hose and a crate labeled 'Spare Nozzles.' Transport these items to Station 3 at the southern end of the cornfield. Wait at Station 3 until the field technicians have unloaded the hoses and the crate. Next, proceed to the workshop storeroom behind the equipment garage and collect three empty oil drums. Take the drums to the waste disposal shed near the facility’s west entrance. Once the drums are unloaded by the waste crew, continue to the staff break area beside the windmill, and wait there for 12 minutes before returning to the equipment garage.

Start at the operations headquarters office located by the main entrance. Move to the storage container behind the compost yard to collect two sealed bins of soil samples. Take the bins to the agricultural testing lab inside the eastern research wing. Wait for 10 minutes while lab staff collect the bins and confirm receipt. Afterward, proceed to the seed storage vault next to the machinery hall and pick up a box containing hybrid seed packets. Deliver the box to the demonstration plot shed beside Field Plot D and wait until instructed that the shed manager has unloaded the box. Once complete, return to the operations headquarters office and stand by for new assignments.

Begin at the logistics hub near the main farm entrance. Proceed to the compost processing site at the edge of the south pasture and collect two bins of processed compost. Transport the compost bins to the vegetable field storage shed on the northeast corner of the property. Wait for 5 minutes while the field supervisor inspects and unloads the bins. After unloading, continue to the spare parts cabinet in Workshop 3 located behind the wind turbine row, and pick up a box of irrigation nozzles. Deliver the box to the equipment loading station adjacent to the central greenhouse. Following confirmation of delivery, return to the logistics hub to complete your assigned route.

Start at the equipment garage near the field maintenance office. Navigate to the irrigation control station located at the northern end of Field C and collect one replacement water pump unit. Proceed to the main greenhouse entrance, where the greenhouse technician will unload the pump. Wait until the technician confirms successful offloading, which may take up to 5 minutes. Afterward, drive to the fertilizer storage shed adjacent to the gravel drive and pick up a pallet containing three bags of organic fertilizer. Deliver these bags to Plot 12 by the southwest orchard boundary. Once all items have been offloaded, return to the equipment garage and await further instructions.

Commence operations at the composting station near the southern field boundary. Navigate to the fertilizer storage barn adjacent to the grain silo and collect two sealed bags of organic fertilizer and a plastic measuring scoop. Deliver these items to the community vegetable plot on the northeast side of the farmstead. Upon arrival, wait for the plot manager to unload the fertilizer and receive instructions, which might require waiting for up to 10 minutes. After all items are unloaded, drive to the equipment cleaning bay behind the administrative offices. Remain there until your next assignment is communicated.

Begin at the maintenance garage adjacent to the old windmill. Drive to the main greenhouse located beside the irrigation reservoir and pick up a pallet of seedling trays stacked near the western entrance. Deliver the seedling trays to the propagation tunnel at the eastern field edge. Wait for a maximum of 12 minutes while the propagation team unloads the pallet. After all trays are removed from the robot, proceed to the machinery fuel depot near the southern gate and stand by for refueling operations until a technician signals that the robot can leave. Finally, return to the maintenance garage and await further instructions.

Begin at the orchard packing station adjacent to the eastern windbreak. Proceed to the fertilizer storage shed beside the south machinery garage and retrieve three sacks of organic fertilizer. Transport the fertilizer to the vegetable plot north of the greenhouse complex. Upon arrival, wait for a field technician to remove all three sacks—this may take up to 7 minutes. Once offloaded, proceed to the supply dock at the greenhouse entrance and await further loading instructions.

Begin at the farm workshop next to the machinery shed. Drive to the packaging tent on the south orchard lane and pick up two sealed boxes of harvested apples. Deliver the boxes to the refrigerated storage unit behind the cold chain building. Wait at the storage unit for 15 minutes or until a staff member unloads both boxes. After unloading, proceed to the fuel station and stand by for further instructions.

Begin at the central materials shed beside the orchard entrance. Proceed to the vineyard tool depot and collect five empty grape harvest bins. Deliver these bins to the picking team stationed at Row 12 of the east vineyard. Wait on site until the crew fully loads at least three of the bins with harvested grapes and places them back onto your platform. Transport the loaded grape bins to the cold storage facility adjacent to the packaging barn. Wait for a storage operator to remove the grape bins, then return to the central materials shed for your next assignment.

Start at the maintenance garage near the southern boundary. Drive to the vineyard storage barn and pick up four crates of freshly harvested grapes. Deliver the crates to the quality control station next to the main gate. Wait for 10 minutes while the quality control team inspects and approves the delivery. Once approved, head to the workshop courtyard and collect a box of replacement tractor batteries. Transport the box to the machinery yard behind the east field canopy and wait until the farm mechanics unload the batteries. After unloading, proceed to the water treatment facility and await further instructions.

Begin at the vehicle garage adjacent to the east loading gate. Proceed to the compost storage bunker next to the windbreak hedges and pick up three bags of organic fertilizer. Transport the bags to the orchard extension plot near the southern irrigation ditch. Wait until orchard workers unload all fertilizer bags, then move to the apiary shelter at the corner of the wildflower meadow. Pick up an empty honey crate from the shelter and deliver it to the storage shed behind the farm office. Wait for 5 minutes while the crate is inspected, then return to the vehicle garage.

Begin at the equipment garage next to the west entrance. Drive to the lumber storage yard behind the machine shop and collect three sealed boxes of replacement chainsaw blades. Proceed to the pine plantation area at the north ridge and deliver the boxes to the forestry team leader. Wait onsite for 5 minutes while the team inspects and unloads the boxes. After confirmation that unloading is complete, head to the solar power station located at the southwest meadow. There, pick up a single roll of replacement cable and transport it to the workshop adjacent to the maintenance office. Once delivery is made, return to the equipment garage and await further instructions.

Begin stationed at the maintenance garage next to the vehicle wash bay. Drive to the northern irrigation control hut and pick up a spare irrigation pump assembly waiting on the loading ramp. Transport the pump assembly to the greenhouse annex located on the western edge of the property and wait for up to 8 minutes while the greenhouse technician swaps the old assembly for the new one. Once the technician has confirmed the swap is complete, proceed to the main fuel depot near the equipment hangar and retrieve a single drum of biofuel. Deliver the biofuel drum to the harvest combine parked at the southern grain bunker. Remain at the combine until the operator has removed the biofuel drum from the robot. After completing all deliveries, return to the maintenance garage and remain ready for the next task.

Begin at the maintenance bay located behind the north warehouse. Proceed to the central orchard and collect four bins filled with freshly harvested apples. Transport the apple bins to the produce packing facility near the west truck entrance. Wait until all bins have been unloaded by the packing crew, which may take up to 12 minutes. Afterward, go to the chemical supply cabin adjacent to the compost yard and pick up a sealed container of organic fertilizer. Deliver the fertilizer container to the root vegetable patch next to the irrigation canal. Once the on-site agronomist confirms receipt, return immediately to the maintenance bay and stand by for further tasks.

Start at the equipment staging area near the southern workshop and proceed to the orchard’s collection shed beside the east grove. Pick up four crates of freshly picked apples. Transport the crates to the produce sorting facility adjacent to the main driveway. Upon arrival, wait until warehouse staff unload all the apple crates, which may take up to 8 minutes. After delivery is complete, drive to the tool supply kiosk on the western maintenance path, collect the set of pruning shears marked for servicing, and deliver them to the tool repair bay opposite the farm office. Once the pruning shears have been received by the repair specialist, return to the equipment staging area and stand by for your next task.

Start at the vehicle charging bay by the southern security gate. Travel to the packing house adjacent to the east orchard and pick up four large pallets of boxed blueberries. Deliver the pallets to Loading Bay 3 at the distribution warehouse. Wait until the supervisor completes a checklist and the pallets are unloaded—this may take up to 8 minutes. After unloading, proceed to the maintenance supply closet in the machine garage and pick up a container of spare air filters. Bring the filters to Engine Repair Station 1 near the field entrance and remain there until a mechanic collects the container or for a maximum of 15 minutes, whichever comes first. When the task is complete, return to the charging bay and stand by for new assignments.

Start at the equipment garage near the west entrance gate. Travel to the main tool depot located beside the tractor parking area and pick up two repair toolboxes. Deliver the toolboxes to the broken-down irrigation unit at the northern end of the wheat field. Wait until field technicians have removed both toolboxes from your cargo bay. Once the toolboxes are unloaded, proceed to the compost heap behind the storage barn and collect any two compost sacks that are ready for transport. Bring the compost sacks to the greenhouse complex at the southern property border and wait up to 15 minutes for the gardening staff to finish unloading them. After unloading, return to the equipment garage and await further instructions.

Start from the main tool shed beside the eastern parking lot. Drive to the fertilizer warehouse located past the old windbreak and pick up two sealed bags of potassium nitrate. Transport the bags to the south orchard's storage zone near the row-marking stakes. Wait until a farmworker removes both bags from your cargo tray. Once unloaded, head to the packing barn adjacent to the north gate, collect a crate of freshly packaged apples, and deliver it to the farm market kiosk by the roadside entrance. After the crate has been delivered, proceed to the charging station near the central water tower and wait for 10 minutes before seeking new instructions.

Start from the tool depot near the east parking lot and drive to the greenhouse loading area. Pick up three large containers marked 'Hydroponic Nutrient Solution.' Deliver these containers to the irrigation control shed located beside the berry fields. Wait for 10 minutes while the farm technicians refill the irrigation tanks and place the empty solution containers back on your platform. Once all empty containers are secured, transport them to the hazardous materials return cage behind the main warehouse. Deposit the empty containers and then proceed to the charging station near the weather monitoring tower to recharge before your next deployment.

Start at the robotics garage behind the main office building. Proceed to the solar array field located east of the property and collect four replacement solar panels stored near panel row 12. Once you have collected all panels, transport them to the maintenance depot adjacent to the control tower. Wait for up to 20 minutes while the technical team unloads the solar panels. After unloading is confirmed, drive to the irrigation supply shed near creek crossing A and pick up a sealed container of pesticide. Deliver the container to the temporary storage tent situated at the north end of the vegetable research plot. Once delivery is complete, return to the robotics garage and wait for 10 minutes before receiving further instructions.

Begin at the storage compound near the greenhouse. Proceed to the spare parts trailer parked beside the northern truck lot and pick up a sealed box of replacement hydraulic hoses. Transport the sealed box to the harvester repair station in the northeast corner of the field. Wait up to 15 minutes while the mechanics remove the box and inspect the contents. Once the delivery is complete, return to the greenhouse storage compound, and stand by near the entrance for the next assignment.

Begin at the rear entrance of the maintenance yard. Drive to the orchard next to the irrigation reservoir and collect three baskets of harvested pears. Carefully deliver these baskets to the sorting facility located on the east side of the packing station. Wait for the sorting team to unload all baskets, which may take up to 7 minutes. Once unloading is confirmed, proceed to the equipment shed across from the main road, pick up one set of replacement irrigation nozzles, and transport them to the southwest corner of the vineyard. Wait for a technician to retrieve the nozzles from the robot, then return to the maintenance yard to await further tasks.

Begin at the equipment charging station near the storage hangar. Travel to the seedling nursery, which is located beside the eastern windbreak. Pick up two trays of young tomato plants from the shaded bench area. Deliver the trays to the cultivation area labeled "Row 7" in the southern vegetable field. Wait for up to 15 minutes while the field staff unloads and plants all the seedlings. Once unloaded, proceed to the composting depot near the northern fence and wait there for the arrival of empty planting trays to be loaded onto the robot for return.

Begin at the vehicle charging station next to the irrigation shed. Travel to the vineyard slope and collect three containers of freshly harvested grapes. Move the containers to the wine processing unit adjacent to the old silo. Wait up to 12 minutes for personnel to unload all grape containers. After delivery is confirmed, proceed to the workshop near the eastern access road and retrieve a box of spare irrigation valves. Carry the valves to the pump control room at the reservoir. Once you have delivered the valves, wait for 5 minutes for maintenance staff to display an all-clear signal before returning to the vehicle charging station.

Begin at the packaging warehouse west of the processing plant. Travel to the north field fertilizer depot and pick up three containers of organic fertilizer and a pallet of mulch bags. Deliver these materials to the compost mixing site adjacent to the greenhouse complex. Wait for 10 minutes while the materials are offloaded and mixed by the facility crew. Proceed to the nearby machine workshop and collect two toolboxes and a replacement fan belt, then deliver these items to the equipment service yard by the main entrance. After the equipment is unloaded, wait for confirmation from the maintenance supervisor before returning to the packaging warehouse to stand by for further instructions.

Begin at the supply depot located next to the main service road. Proceed to the vineyard block B and pick up two crates of harvested grapes. Transport the crates to the cold storage room in the processing facility. Wait inside the cold storage room for 10 minutes while the staff transfers the grapes into storage racks. After the crates are emptied and reloaded onto your platform, return the empty crates to vineyard block B. Then continue to the irrigation control station and collect a box of spare irrigation valves. Deliver these to the farm workshop beside the tractor garage. Once the box is handed over, wait for confirmation from the maintenance supervisor before returning to the supply depot.

Start at the maintenance garage near the east entrance of the manufacturing facility. Travel to the outdoor spare parts depot by the assembly line and pick up a crate containing eight replacement conveyor belts. Deliver the crate to Workshop 4 in the fabrication hall. Wait until the workshop supervisor confirms the removal of all conveyor belts from your platform. Afterwards, proceed to the central courtyard and stand by for 10 minutes to assist with any additional material transports before returning to the maintenance garage.

Begin at the central equipment depot adjacent to the irrigation reservoir. Travel to the west orchard packing shed to collect two crates of freshly picked apples and a single sealed tray of sample pears. Deliver both crates and the tray to the quality inspection office located inside the main warehouse. Wait up to 10 minutes while inspectors verify and unload the produce. Once the unloading is complete, proceed to the exterior dispatch ramp near the southeast loading zone to pick up any empty collection bins. Bring the empty bins back to the west orchard packing shed and wait for staff confirmation before returning to the equipment depot.

Start at the fertilizer storage shed behind the irrigation control tower. Proceed to the blueberry orchard at the southern slope and collect four crates filled with harvested blueberries. Deliver the blueberry crates to the covered loading bay next to the distribution warehouse. Wait at the loading bay for 12 minutes as the logistics team inspects and tags the crates. Once inspection is complete and the crates are documented, transport any empty berry crates found at the loading bay back to the fertilizer storage shed. After offloading the empty crates, remain near the shed until new pickup instructions are provided.

Begin at the maintenance garage next to the solar panel array. Drive to the orchard supply depot situated at the eastern edge of the property. Pick up two crates of pruning tools and one box of replacement dripline fittings. Travel to the apple orchard central path and deliver all the items to the equipment staging area. Wait until all items are unloaded by the orchard crew, which may take approximately 5 minutes. Afterwards, proceed to the compost processing shed beside the irrigation reservoir and remain there until the next assignment is received.

Start at the farm maintenance garage. Drive to the west orchard gate and pick up three sacks of harvested peaches placed next to the loading bench. Transport the sacks to the cold storage facility adjacent to the main barn. Wait for the storage technician to unload all sacks from the robot. Once empty, proceed to the water reservoir platform near the east pasture and collect a toolbox labeled 'Irrigation Repairs.' Deliver the toolbox to the technician’s station by the central pivot sprinkler system. Wait for 5 minutes at the station, then return to the farm maintenance garage.

Start from the orchard tool locker situated beside the apple grove. Proceed to the central water pump station near the southern creek and collect two empty water filter cartridges. Transport the cartridges to the filtration maintenance bay at the northwestern edge of the property. Wait up to 7 minutes for the maintenance staff to replace the cartridges with cleaned ones. Once the cleaned cartridges are loaded, return them to the central water pump station. Remain at the pump station for 5 minutes in case further items need transporting, then drive to the orchard tool locker to complete the task.

Begin at the machinery parking lot next to the west entrance gate. Drive to the seed supply warehouse adjacent to the northern greenhouses and pick up three bags of winter wheat seed. Transport the seed bags to Field Plot 7 on the eastern side of the property. Wait for 8 minutes as the planting crew unloads all the seed bags from your platform. After all bags are removed, proceed to the solar battery charging station behind the equipment shed and remain there for charging until the battery indicator reaches full capacity before shutting down.

Begin at the storage annex adjacent to the north vineyard. Drive to the citrus grove and collect five empty harvest bins stacked by the entrance gate. Deliver the empty bins to the central fruit collection station near the old windmill. Once the collection supervisor has removed all bins (wait as needed), proceed to the north field perimeter and pick up any misplaced scarecrow parts along the fence. Return these items to the maintenance shed next to the storage annex before ending the task.

Start at the main dispatch center in front of the logistics building. Head to the central storage silo and pick up two sealed barrels of motor oil and a crate of replacement spark plugs. Take these items to the tractor service bay located behind the old dairy barn. Wait up to 15 minutes for the mechanics to finish unloading and transfer any empty oil barrels onto your platform. Once loaded with the empty barrels, proceed to the hazardous materials disposal point behind the solar panel array. Offload the empty barrels at the marked drop-off area and wait for 5 minutes to receive clearance before returning to the main dispatch center.

Start at the gravel turnaround near the pesticide storage facility. Drive to the vegetable greenhouse loading entrance and pick up three sacks of fertilizer. Transport the fertilizer to Plot C’s tool shed, positioned at the southern edge of the crop field. Wait at the tool shed for the farm manager to sign off on delivery — this may take up to 5 minutes. Once acknowledged, head to the equipment calibration workshop next to the irrigation reservoir to await further loading instructions.

Begin at the main supply depot near the west entrance. Navigate to the chemical storage shed in the southern field and pick up three sealed containers of plant nutrient solution. Transport the containers to the greenhouse loading bay and wait while the greenhouse manager checks and unloads each container. Once unloading is complete, proceed to the packaging area south of the sorting barn to collect two empty wooden pallets. Deliver the pallets to the fruit harvest zone in Orchard Section A. After delivery, return to the main supply depot and stand by for new instructions.

Start at the materials staging area next to the solar panel array. Proceed to the southwest pasture gate and pick up two sacks of livestock mineral supplements placed by the fence. Deliver the sacks to the feed storage bunker at Cattle Barn 2. Wait by the feed storage bunker while the farmhand unloads the supplements from your platform. Once the platform is empty, travel to the maintenance workshop behind the grain silos and collect the orange hydraulic pump unit. Take the hydraulic pump to the irrigation control hut in the alfalfa field. Wait at the irrigation control hut for 8 minutes to allow the technician to install the pump; when the technician signals completion, return to the materials staging area to stand by for your next task.

Start at the logistics hub beside the greenhouse complex. Move to the supplies staging area near the west orchard and pick up six empty harvest baskets. Deliver the baskets to the cherry harvesting team at orchard block D, located by the hillside windbreak. Wait for the team to remove all baskets from your platform. Next, proceed to the pump station by the southern reservoir and collect two sealed containers of irrigation fluid. Transport these containers to the equipment garage behind the field technician’s office. Wait for 8 minutes while the maintenance staff unload and store the containers. Finally, go to the shaded parking zone next to the vehicle recharging station and remain there until further assignment.

Start at the maintenance shed behind the solar panel array. Travel to the northwest greenhouse and pick up a pallet containing five sacks of potting soil. Deliver the pallet to the nursery area adjacent to the west irrigation pond. Wait for 12 minutes while the nursery staff unloads the potting soil. Once unloaded, proceed to the farm equipment yard and collect a weatherproof toolbox labeled 'Field Repairs.' Take the toolbox to the windbreak grove on the southern boundary and wait until the field technician removes the toolbox from your platform. After confirming unloading, return to the maintenance shed and stand by for further instructions.

Start at the north equipment shed adjacent to Field 7. Drive to the irrigation control hub near the southern pond and collect a sealed box containing replacement sprinkler heads. Deliver the box to Greenhouse 2 on Maple Lane and wait for the greenhouse technician to unload the sprinkler heads. Once unloaded, proceed to the chemical storage bunker to the west and pick up three empty pesticide containers. Carry the containers to the decontamination station behind the construction supply yard and wait for 10 minutes until the cleaning process is completed. Finally, return the cleaned containers to the chemical storage bunker before heading back to the north equipment shed.

Begin at the orchard’s equipment depot located beside the north field gate. Drive to the produce collection area behind Packing Shed 2, and pick up five crates of freshly harvested apples. Deliver the crates to the cold storage chamber situated inside Warehouse B. Wait inside the chamber until a supervisor completes unloading the apple crates. Once unloaded, proceed to the vehicle wash bay next to the eastern access road, and remain there for 10 minutes for a routine cleaning before returning to the orchard’s equipment depot.

Begin at the seed storage shed beside the west citrus grove. Proceed to the fertilizer bunker adjacent to the tractor shelter and pick up three sealed drums of liquid fertilizer. Deliver the drums to the irrigation control station at the far edge of the south field. Wait until field staff confirm delivery and unload the fertilizer, which should take approximately 6 minutes. Once the drums are unloaded, head to the tool distribution booth next to the workers' break area. Collect a box of pruning tools and transport it to the orchard maintenance zone located on the eastern hilltop. Leave the box at the designated drop-off point without waiting, then return to the seed storage shed and standby for your next task.

Start at the supply bay located next to the irrigation pump house. Proceed to the seed storage container near the west barn and pick up five sacks of corn seed. Transport the seed sacks to the planter vehicle stationed at the southern field entry gate and wait for the field crew to unload all sacks, remaining on standby for up to 10 minutes if needed. Once unloading is complete, navigate to the parts kiosk adjacent to the solar panel array to retrieve two replacement hydraulic hoses. Deliver the hoses to the machinery repair tent at the southwest plot and wait until all items are offloaded by the technicians before returning to the supply bay to finish your assignment.

Begin at the supply depot near the north entrance. Travel to the equipment shed adjacent to the blueberry patch and pick up four sealed containers of irrigation fittings. Deliver the containers to the field maintenance station by the south orchard gate. Wait until a member of the field crew has unloaded all containers from the robot. Once the payload area is empty, proceed to the compost area beside the old orchard, and pick up two empty fertilizer bins. Return the empty bins to the supply depot near the north entrance and wait in the designated holding area for your next assignment.

Commence operations at the maintenance bay next to the main entrance. Travel to the orchard’s northern gate and pick up a crate of harvested pears and a sealed box of pest control sensors. Deliver both the crate and box to the quality assurance lab at the southern end of the property. Wait until the lab analyst signals that all items have been unloaded. Then, drive to the water pump station near the western boundary to collect a spare pump filter. Carry the filter to the irrigation control center behind the farmhouse and remain until an engineer retrieves the filter. Finally, return to the maintenance bay and wait for 8 minutes before powering down.

Start at the greenhouse service entrance. Proceed to the compost station to pick up three bags of organic compost. Deliver the compost bags to Orchard Block 12 along the east boundary. After unloading, wait for the orchard supervisor to inspect and confirm delivery, which may take up to 6 minutes. Upon confirmation, continue to the supply shed behind the greenhouse to collect a wooden crate marked 'Seedlings'. Transport the crate to Greenhouse 2 seedling bay, and once the delivery is complete, return to the greenhouse service entrance.

Leave the storage garage located south of the administrative office and travel to the machine repair area. Pick up three replacement drive belts. Deliver the belts to the combine harvester parking lot situated at the east edge of the property. Wait for the maintenance crew to retrieve all drive belts, which may take up to 8 minutes. Then, proceed to the irrigation control center and collect two lightweight water sampling kits. Carry the kits to the river dock for the environmental survey team. After making the delivery, remain at the river dock and await further instructions from the survey supervisor.

Proceed to the seed storage facility located south of Greenhouse 7 and collect four sacks of sunflower seeds. Transport the sacks to the northern tractor shed beside the central access road. Wait at the shed until the farm crew unloads all the sacks. Once unloading is complete, continue to the compost processing area on the east end of the property to pick up a bin of biodegradable waste. Deliver the waste bin to the waste management station adjacent to the parking lot and wait for 10 minutes for the recycling team to empty the bin. Afterward, return to the central dispatch hub and remain at the designated standby zone for further instructions.

Start at the maintenance bay beside the solar panel field. Proceed to the orchard storage tent and pick up three baskets of ripe pears. Deliver the baskets to the distribution platform at the north gate loading zone. Wait until all baskets have been collected by the distribution staff, then head to the pesticide cabinet next to the greenhouse workshop. Collect one sealed canister of liquid pesticide and deliver it to the crop science lab located at the research building’s west entrance. Wait for 7 minutes while the lab team unloads the canister, then return to the maintenance bay.

Start from the logistics hub next to the southeast supply road. Proceed to the grain silo yard and pick up four sealed nutrition supplement barrels. Deliver the barrels to the poultry greenhouse at the western edge of the property. Wait at the greenhouse until the farm staff have finished unloading the barrels, which could take up to 10 minutes. Once unloading is complete, travel to the maintenance annex behind the central processing plant to collect a box of lubricating oil canisters. Transport the oil canisters to the harvest equipment line at the far southern boundary for machinery servicing. After completing all deliveries, proceed to the shade port near the water reservoir and stand by for further instructions.

Start at the maintenance depot next to the south vehicle lot. Proceed to the packaging warehouse at the western end of the property and pick up three pallets of boxed strawberries. Transport the pallets to the cooling chamber beside the east greenhouse and deliver the strawberries. Wait for 10 minutes while the cooling staff inspects and stores the boxes. Once completed, travel to the fertilizer storage bunker near the grain silo and collect a container of liquid fertilizer. Deliver it to the irrigation control station behind the lavender field, then park at the charging pad behind the maintenance depot for battery replenishment.

Start at the storage yard adjacent to the equipment repair workshop. Proceed to the seed depot near the southern field entrance and pick up four crates of soybean seeds. Transport the crates to the portable greenhouse at the east end of the property. Wait until all crates have been unloaded by greenhouse staff. Next, drive to the weather monitoring station by the north pasture and collect a small sealed box containing replacement sensor components. Deliver this box to the data center loading bay behind the administrative building. After delivery, wait for 10 minutes in the loading bay area for potential additional tasks before returning to the storage yard.

Start at the grain storage barn located adjacent to the western boundary of the farm. Head to the central packing shed and pick up four crates of harvested strawberries. Deliver the crates to the refrigerated truck parked next to the southern gate. Wait until the driver confirms receipt of all crates. Proceed to the pesticide storage outbuilding near the east orchard and collect two sealed canisters of organic pesticide. Transport the canisters to the row crop field station northeast of the pond. After dropping off the canisters, wait for 10 minutes to allow field staff to complete their preparations, then return to the grain storage barn.

Start at the maintenance garage located behind the main office. Drive to the southwest solar panel array. Pick up three boxes of replacement inverter parts stacked beside the maintenance cart. Transport the boxes to the elevated observation platform overlooking the western pasture. Wait for the maintenance technician to unload the inverter parts. Next, proceed to the livestock feed depot near the barn and collect a bag of supplemental feed. Deliver the bag to the feeding station at Pen 3. Once the feed is delivered, return to the maintenance garage and await further directions.

Start from the maintenance garage behind the north orchard. Navigate to the spare parts shack located on the west side of the solar panel array and pick up a box of replacement hydraulic hoses. Deliver the box to the packaging line outside the produce sorting hangar. Wait for 10 minutes or until the line supervisor retrieves the box, whichever comes first. After the box is removed, proceed to the shaded rest area near the farm entrance and stand by for up to 5 minutes before returning to the maintenance garage to await the next assignment.

Begin at the maintenance bay adjacent to the vehicle garage. Drive to the equipment field located south of the grain silos and pick up four containers of hydraulic fluid. Carry the fluid containers to the machinery service station at the west end of the tractor depot. Wait for the service technician to remove all containers from the robot. Then, proceed to the greenhouse propagation area and collect two empty seed trays. Deliver the empty trays to the seed storage room inside the central agricultural building. Once inside, wait for 10 minutes to allow storage staff to inspect the trays before returning to the maintenance bay to await further instructions.

Begin at the equipment bay adjacent to the seed warehouse. Drive to the packing shed located at the north entrance of the vineyard and pick up a pallet containing freshly harvested grape crates. Transport the pallet to the cold storage building next to the western loading dock. Wait at the storage building for up to 10 minutes to allow staff to unload all grape crates from your platform. Once the pallet is empty, return it to the packing shed. After returning the pallet, proceed to the equipment bay and await further instructions.

Start at the workshop garage on the north edge of the compound. Drive to the main greenhouse’s west entrance and pick up four crates of freshly harvested cucumbers. Deliver these crates to the vegetable cooling room inside the central packing facility. Wait until the storage team unloads all crates, which should require about 10 minutes. Once the crates are completely offloaded, make your way to the fuel depot near the maintenance hangar. Collect a sealed fuel canister and bring it to the generator station beside the irrigation canal. Remain at the generator station for 5 minutes to ensure safe transfer, then proceed back to the workshop garage and await further instructions.

Begin at the farm equipment garage and proceed to the packaging barn to collect three empty harvest bins. Deliver the empty bins to the south strawberry field for picking. Wait until the bins have been fully loaded with harvested strawberries, which should take approximately 20 minutes. Once loaded, transport the bins to the refrigerated storage building at the east end of the facility. Wait for the storage team to unload all bins from your platform. Then, return directly to the farm equipment garage and stand by for your next assignment.

Start at the fertilizer supply tent near the eastern orchard. Travel to the main vineyard loading bay and pick up four wooden crates of harvested grapes. Deliver the crates to the chilled storage chamber inside the processing facility adjacent to the vineyard. Once the staff has unloaded the grapes, continue to the farm implement shed by the north pasture gate and pick up a single container of tractor coolant. Bring the container to the central fuel depot located between the seed silos and the pump house. Wait for 7 minutes while the coolant is transferred, then return to the fertilizer supply tent at the eastern orchard.

Start at the logistics hub near the eastern machinery barn. Drive to the greenhouse complex beside Hydroponic Plot 4 and pick up a crate containing assorted seedling trays. Transport the crate to the propagation lab situated at the far end of Pollinator Lane. Upon delivery, wait for 6 minutes while the lab technician inspects and unloads the seedling trays. After unloading, proceed to the rainwater collection cistern behind the solar panel field and collect an empty water canister. Return the empty canister to the logistics hub before awaiting your next assignment.

Start at the tool charging station near the northwest vehicle bay. Drive to the irrigation control room located at the western end of the vineyard and pick up two replacement water pumps. Deliver both pumps to the riverbank pump house found along the southern edge of the property. Wait beside the pump house for 12 minutes while technicians install the new pumps. After the waiting period, return to the tool charging station and await further deployment.

Start at the maintenance garage by the southern entrance. Drive to the orchard supply tent and pick up two crates of replacement irrigation emitters. Transport the crates to Orchard Section 4 at the eastern edge of the property. Wait for the orchard crew to remove the crates from your platform. After unloading, proceed to the compost collection area behind the livestock barn to pick up a sealed bin of organic waste. Deliver the organic waste bin to the compost processing center next to the woodland trail. Once delivered, return to the maintenance garage and stand by for further instructions.

Begin at the solar panel maintenance tent beside the western irrigation pond. Proceed to the produce sorting station adjacent to Plot 5 and collect three bins of freshly picked tomatoes. Transport these bins to the farmers' market loading dock on the north perimeter of the property. Once there, wait until market staff have removed all bins from the robot. After unloading, drive to the compost heap area next to the barn and pick up a small container of compostable waste. Deliver the waste container to the waste management bay behind the workshop, and then remain stationary for 10 minutes in case additional hauling requests are dispatched.

Start at the equipment garage near the main silo. Proceed to the vineyard block B picking zone and collect two harvest bins filled with grapes. Transport the bins to the grape pressing station situated next to the farm’s south-side processing building. After unloading the bins, wait at the pressing station for 8 minutes to allow the crew to finish washing empty fermentation barrels. Once the barrels are ready, pick up four empty barrels and deliver them to the barrel aging room located adjacent to the laboratory. After this delivery, travel to the maintenance shed beside the north perimeter fence and stand by for your routine diagnostic check.

Start at the maintenance garage. Drive to the fertilizer shed located beside the west orchard. Pick up two large bags of organic fertilizer. Deliver the fertilizer bags to the community vegetable garden near the farm’s main gate. Wait until the garden supervisor confirms the bags have been unloaded. Then, proceed to the roadside produce stand, collect any empty produce crates left from sales, and return the empty crates to the packhouse adjacent to the main barn.

Start at the fertilizer storage barn adjacent to the northern irrigation ditch. Proceed to the orchard’s southern gate where a wooden pallet containing crates of harvested apples awaits pickup. Load all crates onto your platform and transport them to the cold storage facility located behind the main administration building. Wait for the orchard staff to fully unload the apple crates (this should take approximately 10 minutes). Once unloaded, continue to the waste processing yard near the east fence and collect any empty water barrels designated for recycling. Return the empty barrels to the fertilizer storage barn and conclude your task there.

Begin at the manufacturing plant’s maintenance room located beside the eastern access gate. Proceed to the spare parts depot adjacent to the forklift charging area. Collect one large battery pack and a box containing five hydraulic hoses. Deliver both items to the repair bay near the central production line, and wait until the battery pack is offloaded and the box of hoses is removed (this may take several minutes). Once both items are confirmed unloaded, proceed to the open-air storage yard in the southwest corner of the complex to pick up two empty cable spools. Bring these spools back to the maintenance room and await further instructions.

Start at the maintenance garage at the eastern perimeter of the complex. Drive to the irrigation pump station behind the sugar beet field and collect a single replacement water filter. Deliver this filter to the utility shed beside the composting area, and wait until the shed supervisor installs the new filter, which usually takes about 6 minutes. Once installation is confirmed, proceed to the lumber storage yard at the end of Cedar Lane and pick up four wooden pallets. Take the pallets to the temporary storage tent adjacent to the machinery repair workshop. After unloading, return to the maintenance garage.

Start at the main entrance gate near the facility’s north boundary. Proceed to the vineyard harvesting zone on the western slope to collect four stacked grape bins. Transport the grape bins to the fermentation pavilion situated behind the packaging warehouse. Wait for the pavilion operator to unload all bins, which may take up to 12 minutes. Once the unloading is confirmed, drive to the mobile workshop stationed at the southeast equipment yard to retrieve a toolkit. Deliver the toolkit to the irrigation pump station on the central service road, and wait for the maintenance technician to remove it before returning to the facility’s north entrance gate for standby.
