Begin at the eastern orchard parking lot and travel to the tool shed located adjacent to the old barn. Pick up a box of hand pruners and a bundled tarp from inside the shed. Proceed to the northern apple grove access gate, and deliver both items to the waiting orchard crew. Wait until all items are removed from your payload compartment, then continue on to the farm shop near the main entrance. At the farm shop, pick up a single oil drum designated for recycling, and bring it to the onsite recycling collection point next to the solar panel array. Once you have delivered the oil drum, return to the eastern orchard parking lot and await further instructions.

Start at the east orchard loading bay. Proceed to the cold storage unit adjacent to the south barn and collect three crates of freshly picked peaches. Transport these crates to the farmer’s market staging area near the main farm gate. Wait for market staff to remove all crates, which may take up to 6 minutes. After unloading, travel to the shade structure beside the equipment wash station and stand by for 15 minutes before returning to the east orchard loading bay.

Begin at the maintenance garage located beside the grain silos. Proceed to the nursery greenhouse across from the eastern orchard and pick up three crates of seedling trays labeled 'Tomato Starts.' Transport the crates to the planting zone adjacent to the north boundary fence. Wait there for the planting crew to remove all crates from your platform. Once unloaded, drive south to the compost yard and await further instructions without delay.

Begin at the maintenance garage near the west gate entrance. Proceed to the packaging warehouse behind the equipment barn and collect a shipping crate labeled 'Fresh Vegetables'. Transport the crate to the north-side delivery point adjacent to the roadside farm stand. Allow 8 minutes for the crate to be unloaded. Afterward, continue to the water tank refill station beside the greenhouse cluster and pick up two full water containers. Deliver these containers to the blueberry patch entrance next to Hillside Path, wait until both containers are unloaded, then return to the maintenance garage and remain on standby for your next assignment.

Begin at the supply shed adjacent to the north loading zone. Drive to the equipment yard and pick up one crate of replacement hydraulic hoses and a pair of toolboxes. Proceed to Field Plot 4 where the repair crew is stationed. Deliver all items to the crew supervisor and wait until the crew confirms the items have been received and unloaded, which may take up to 12 minutes. Once confirmation is received, continue to the compost facility near the western fence line to pick up an empty fertilizer spreader. Finally, return the empty spreader to the supply shed before ending the task.

Start at the field workshop near the eastern boundary of the barley plantation. Proceed to the seed storage depot beside the north silo and pick up four sacks of fertilizer pellets. Deliver the fertilizer to the distribution hub at the center of the east planting section. Wait for 8 minutes while the planting team offloads the sacks. After unloading, navigate to the south water tank site next to the orchard, and pick up two empty water canisters. Transport the empty canisters to the greenhouse maintenance area near the main farm gate, and wait there for further loading instructions.

Begin at the greenhouse loading bay behind the horticulture lab. Travel to the fertilizer storage pavilion near the north parking lot and pick up four sacks of organic fertilizer. Transport the sacks to the raised-bed planting area at the western edge of the gardens. Wait for up to 15 minutes while the gardening crew unloads the fertilizer. Once unloaded, proceed to the nearby compost processing unit and wait there for 10 minutes before awaiting further assignment.

Start at the north vehicle staging area beside the main entrance. Travel to the irrigation pump house near the southwest cornfield and pick up one toolbox, a replacement water filter assembly, and four rolls of waterproof tape. Deliver these items to the remote irrigation control outpost next to the south fence line. Wait until the maintenance engineer collects all equipment from your platform. Once unloaded, proceed to the compost material storage shed adjacent to the greenhouse complex. Collect two sealed bins of organic fertilizer and bring them to the community vegetable garden at the eastern orchard boundary. Wait for five minutes while the garden staff distribute the bins. After confirmation that your platform is empty, return to the north vehicle staging area and wait for further tasks.

Commence operations at the spare parts depot adjacent to the northern machinery shed. Proceed to the loading dock behind the fertilizer warehouse and pick up three boxes of replacement tractor filters. Deliver these boxes to the maintenance workshop near the field access road on the eastern boundary. Wait for the mechanics to unload all filters from your cargo platform. After the filters are removed, continue to the solar panel array at the southern perimeter and collect a compact toolbox left by the utility crew. Return the toolbox to the operations office just west of the main gate. Once the toolbox is handed over, remain in the office courtyard for 10 minutes in case additional equipment transport assignments arise.

Start at the storage yard next to the equipment garage. Drive to the fertilizer depot situated at the far end of the west access road and pick up three sealed containers of organic fertilizer. Transport the containers to the vineyard entrance along the northern hillside. Upon arrival, wait until vineyard personnel transfer all containers onto their utility vehicles. Once unloaded, proceed to the weather monitoring station by the main water retention pond, and remain there for 8 minutes to allow for scheduled sensor synchronization before awaiting further tasks.

Begin at the storage shed adjacent to the wind turbine maintenance yard. Travel to the livestock feed barn located on the southeastern edge of the property and pick up five bags of cattle feed. Transport the feed bags to the pasture gate closest to the south creek. Wait for the ranch staff to unload all five bags from the robot. After the feed has been unloaded, drive to the equipment wash station beside the solar panel field and wait for 10 minutes to allow cleaning staff to perform routine maintenance on the robot before returning to the storage shed and concluding the route.

Start at the battery maintenance bay next to the machinery wash station. Travel to the western vegetable field loading zone and pick up two crates of harvested carrots. Deliver these crates to the cooling chamber located behind the produce packaging hall. Wait until the facility staff removes both crates for processing. Afterwards, proceed to the main tool storage closet adjacent to the worker rest area to collect one box of replacement irrigation nozzles. Transport the nozzle box to the irrigation supply outpost that sits along the southern field boundary. Upon delivery, wait for 5 minutes to verify inventory and confirm handover, then return to the battery maintenance bay and await your next set of instructions.

Start at the equipment storage garage beside the main access road. Proceed to the apple orchard's southeast corner where the harvest crew is stationed. Collect four sacks of picked apples. Deliver the apple sacks to the refrigerated storage unit next to the packing shed. Wait for 8 minutes while staff unload the apples and inspect the robot. Once the sacks have been removed, proceed to the fuel station behind the granary to await further instructions.

Begin at the logistics hub near the western service road. Drive to the battery storage area adjacent to the solar panel field and pick up four replacement battery packs. Deliver the battery packs to the utility shed at wind turbine site B on the southern ridge. Wait until the maintenance technician retrieves all of the battery packs from your platform. Next, proceed to the central greenhouse loading area, where the horticulturist will place a crate of seedling trays and two bags of potting soil on your platform. After being loaded, travel to the research test plots beside the pond and deliver the items to the research crew. Remain at the research test plots for 8 minutes to support any additional equipment transfer requests, then return to the logistics hub to complete your route.

Begin at the maintenance garage beside the east vehicle shed. Drive to the livestock feed storage room on the southern boundary and pick up two sealed barrels of vitamin supplements. Carry the barrels to the animal health outpost near the dairy barns at the western meadow. Wait until veterinary staff have unloaded both barrels, approximately 8 minutes. Afterward, proceed to the irrigation parts pavilion by the northern fence and pick up a box of pressure regulators. Deliver the regulators to the pump control station at the edge of the central pond. Wait until the box has been removed by the technician, then return to the maintenance garage to complete your route.

Start at the packing house on the west end of the property. Drive to the greenhouse storage annex near the central irrigation pond and pick up five trays of young tomato seedlings. Deliver the seedlings to the planting zone at Field 7’s southern border and wait for a worker to unload all trays. After unloading, proceed to the maintenance workshop adjacent to the farm office, pick up a box of assorted wrenches, and deliver them to the machinery shed next to the tractor parking area. Wait for five minutes, then return to the packing house and stand by for further instructions.

Start at the central operations hub next to the administration office. Proceed to the orchard tool depot near the north gate and pick up a crate containing pruning shears and hand saws. Transport the crate to orchard row 7, section C, where the maintenance crew is stationed. Wait up to 20 minutes or until the crew removes all tools from the crate. Once the crate is empty, navigate to the packaging tent on the western meadow and collect three empty fruit baskets. Deliver the baskets to the farm entrance collection point and wait for the packing supervisor to confirm receipt before returning to the central operations hub.

Begin at the equipment depot located behind the apple orchard entrance. Travel to the packaging area adjacent to the eastern field shed and collect a pallet of empty harvest crates. Deliver the pallet to the field staging area near the southern orchard rows. Wait for up to 12 minutes while workers transfer crates onto the pallet. Once the pallet is empty, drive to the workshop beside the north-side irrigation tank. Pick up a replacement water pump. Transport the pump to the maintenance platform near the central well and remain until a technician removes the pump from the robot. After unloading, return to the equipment depot.

Begin at the logistics hub next to Maintenance Shed B. Navigate to the north orchard collection point and retrieve four crates of harvested pears. Transport these crates to the refrigerated storage dock located behind the packing warehouse. Wait for the storage crew to unload the crates, which may take up to 10 minutes. After the crates have been removed, drive to the central machine shop, and collect a toolbox from the tool exchange counter. Deliver the toolbox to the wind turbine service station along Service Road East, and wait until a technician removes the toolbox from the platform before returning to the logistics hub to complete your round.

Begin at the forestry garage adjacent to the east boundary. Travel to the timber storage yard near the old windmill and retrieve two bundles of surveying stakes. Deliver the bundles to the soil sampling site in the hilly sector south of the machinery barn. Wait until workers have unloaded all surveying stakes. Next, proceed to the fuel depot beside the gravel access road and collect a container of engine oil. Bring the container to the machinery repair bay at the southwest corner of the property. Wait for 8 minutes while the maintenance crew refills equipment and loads any empty oil canisters onto your platform. Transport the empty canisters to the recycling point behind the administration greenhouse, then return to the forestry garage to complete your assignment.

Travel to the maintenance workshop near the west irrigation channel and collect a toolbox containing electrical spare parts. Deliver the toolbox to the solar panel array installation site beside Field 3. Remain at the site until an engineer unloads the toolbox. After the toolbox is unloaded, proceed to the chemical storage facility. Pick up two sealed containers of approved fertilizer. Transport them to the greenhouse distribution center by the main gravel lane, wait for 5 minutes to be unloaded by the horticultural staff, then proceed to the equipment cleaning bay and wait there for further tasks.

Start at the logistics hub adjacent to the main greenhouse. Proceed to the orchard tool shed located at the base of the north hill and pick up a pallet of pruning shears and a sealed container of tree fertilizer. Deliver both items to the orchard supervisor's station at the west end of the peach grove. Wait until the supervisor unloads the pallet and container. Next, travel to the crate collection zone near the irrigation canal and pick up any empty wooden fruit crates. Transport the crates to the packaging facility beside the farm office. Once delivered, return to the logistics hub and remain on standby until assigned a new task.

Begin at the charging station adjacent to the maintenance garage. Travel to Field 2’s irrigation valve station and collect two replacement control modules packaged in a sealed container. Deliver the container to the south greenhouse mechanical room and wait until the on-site technician removes the modules. Once unloaded, proceed to the tool storage shed near the compost yard, pick up a bin of spare hoses, and transport it to the equipment wash area. After placing the bin beside the wash station, return to the charging station without delay.

Begin at the equipment bay located behind the western storage silo. Proceed to the packaging shed beside the berry patch and collect two boxes of assorted irrigation fittings. Transport these boxes to the field operations tent in the central pasture. Wait at the operations tent for the field crew to unload the fittings, then continue on to the seed vault adjacent to the machinery workshop. Pick up one sealed bag of winter rye seeds from the seed vault and deliver it to the crop demonstration plot near the eastern boundary fence. Once delivery is complete, return to the equipment bay without stopping.

Start at the logistics hub near the front gate of the farm complex. Drive to the northern greenhouse—adjacent to the hydroponics system—and pick up four trays of assorted seedlings. Carefully transport the trays to the planting site at plot 4B, which is located on the east side of the central field. Wait at the plot for 20 minutes while planting crews unload and distribute the seedlings. Once all trays are off your deck, proceed to the fertilizer bin area next to the equipment shelter, retrieve two buckets of organic fertilizer, and deliver them to the tool preparation shed near the northern orchard access road. After delivering the fertilizer, return to the logistics hub and stand by for further tasks.

Begin at the weather monitoring station adjacent to the west field entrance. Proceed to the equipment garage near the main access road and retrieve two sealed containers of hydraulic fluid. Transport the containers to the maintenance bay located at the far side of the machinery lot. Wait for the maintenance supervisor to verify and sign off on the delivery. After confirmation, move to the composting area beside the south orchard and collect all empty fertilizer sacks designated for recycling. Deliver the empty sacks to the recycling pickup point near the administrative office and wait until all sacks are unloaded from your platform before returning to the weather monitoring station for your next assignment.

Start from the vehicle charging station located next to the main office. Head towards the field tool depot behind the north greenhouse. Pick up three containers of planting stakes from the tool depot. Proceed to the vineyard’s eastern entrance and deliver the containers of planting stakes. Wait until all containers have been unloaded. Once empty, travel to the composting area adjacent to the apiary, and wait for 8 minutes before returning to the vehicle charging station.

Begin at the machinery garage next to the central maintenance yard. Drive to the seedling nursery located at the north end of the property. Pick up two racks of young tomato plants from the nursery loading platform. Transport the racks to the south field staging area beside the blue irrigation tanks. Wait for the field crew to unload the racks, which is expected to take about 8 minutes. Once unloaded, proceed to the equipment storage barn by the main access road and collect a container of replacement sprinkler heads. Deliver the container to the irrigation monitoring station near the southwest orchard. Wait until the station technician retrieves all sprinkler heads from your platform, then return to the machinery garage to complete your round.

Begin at the equipment charging station behind the main administration office. Proceed to the herb greenhouse near the eastern water reservoir and collect four sacks of potting soil stacked by the entrance. Transport the sacks to the compost mixing zone adjacent to the citrus grove. Wait there until the facility manager completes the intake check and removes all potting soil sacks. Once unloaded, head to the tool repair shed opposite the compost zone to pick up an empty tool crate. Deliver the empty crate to the mechanical workshop next to the west parking lot. After placing the crate, wait for 8 minutes to allow technicians to refill it with serviced tools, then return to the equipment charging station and prepare for further tasks.

Begin at the maintenance garage adjacent to the east machinery lot. Travel to the orchard warehouse near the southern field and pick up two crates of replacement irrigation valves. Transport these crates to the pump control terminal by the riverbank. Wait at the terminal for the maintenance team to unload the valves. After the unload is complete, receive a single box of used filters from the team and carry it to the waste processing station behind the composting area. Upon delivery of the box, wait 10 minutes for the station operator to inspect and sign off on receipt. Once signed off, proceed to the north gate security booth and await further instructions.

Navigate to the seed storage facility beside the greenhouse and collect a crate labeled 'Corn Seeds Batch A.' Transport the crate to the automated planter station in Field 2, just north of the irrigation reservoir. Upon arrival, wait while the planting crew unloads the crate, which may take up to 5 minutes. After the crate has been fully unloaded, proceed to the charging station behind the barn and recharge for 10 minutes before resuming further tasks.

Start at the seed storage facility, located just behind the main office. Proceed to Greenhouse 3 at the west edge of the property and pick up three bags of potting soil. Travel to the nursery growing area adjacent to the windbreak line and deliver the potting soil to the designated drop-off point. Wait until the greenhouse staff unload all the bags, then continue to the tool cleaning station beside the irrigation pump house and remain there for 7 minutes before returning to the seed storage facility.

Begin at the maintenance workshop next to the vehicle garage. Proceed to the north orchard entrance and pick up three empty fertilizer bins. Transport the bins to the supply depot adjacent to the east field. Wait until the depot staff has refilled all bins, then deliver the loaded fertilizer bins to the vineyard on the southern slope. Once all bins have been unloaded, wait for 5 minutes in case additional assistance is needed, then return to the maintenance workshop.

Start at the north gate near the visitor parking lot. Drive to the pesticide containment bunker located beside Field 4. Pick up one secure case of pesticide testing vials from the bunker. Deliver the case to Laboratory B inside the farm research center. Wait outside the laboratory loading bay until the lab technician removes the case, which may take up to 8 minutes. Once unloaded, proceed to the utility barn adjacent to the cattle pens to await further loading instructions.

Start at the harvest equipment bay behind the greenhouse. Drive to the irrigation pump station at the western edge of the sunflower field. Pick up a spool of replacement irrigation hose and a case of pipe fittings. Transport these supplies to the vineyard repair outpost near the northern fence. Wait until the maintenance crew unloads the hose and fittings, which typically takes 4 minutes. Once unloaded, travel to the central feed storage silo, collect three bags of animal feed, and deliver them to the livestock holding area adjacent to Barn C. Wait until a farmhand confirms all bags have been received before returning to the equipment bay.

Begin at the charging station in the northwest corner of the logistics yard. Travel to the seed storage bunker next to the greenhouse complex. Pick up two bags of hybrid corn seed. Deliver the bags to the drone launching pad located in the open field behind the grain silos. Wait for the agronomy team to unload the seeds, which may take up to 15 minutes. After unloading, proceed to the maintenance hut across from the fuel depot and collect a toolbox containing calibration equipment. Take the toolbox to the windbreak tree line observation post at the south boundary, and then return to the charging station for standby.

Begin at the equipment depot located beside the vineyard entrance. Drive to the irrigation pump station west of the main irrigation canal and pick up a replacement water filter, as well as a toolbox containing assorted wrenches. Deliver both the water filter and the toolbox to the maintenance hut at the north end of Orchard Lane. Wait until a technician confirms the receipt and removal of both items. Following this, travel to the seedling greenhouse behind the harvest barn and collect five trays of young tomato plants. Transport these trays to the experimental crop plot near the eastern boundary fence. Wait for 8 minutes while the planting team unloads the trays, then return to the equipment depot to complete your cycle.

Start at the main garage near the west entrance. Travel to the machinery repair bay beside the old windmill and pick up a replacement hydraulic pump from the service shelf. Deliver the hydraulic pump to the grain processing shed on the south end of the property. Wait at the grain processing shed until the maintenance crew retrieves and installs the pump, which may take approximately 12 minutes. Once installation is confirmed, proceed to the shed's exterior and collect any spent oil canisters marked for disposal. Transport the spent oil canisters to the designated hazardous materials storage facility located behind the storage silos. After drop-off, return to the main garage and stand by for further assignments.

Begin at the solar power maintenance bay next to the main barn. Proceed to the water pump station on the southern edge of the irrigation canal. Pick up a sealed container holding water quality testing kits. Deliver the container to the river monitoring outpost beside the east bridge. Wait at the outpost until a technician collects the container and provides a signed receipt. Once the exchange is complete, travel to the composting facility behind the equipment garage and stand by for 10 minutes in case new pickup requests arise.

Start at the logistics garage near the west access road. Drive to the pallet storage area south of the main packing facility and pick up a crate of spare greenhouse sensors and four cartons of packing foam. Transport these items to the smart farming technology station on the north overlook. Wait up to 12 minutes for a technician to unload both the crate and cartilage. Return to the logistics garage for further assignment.

Start at the maintenance garage adjacent to the northern vehicle shed. Travel to the solar array control center near the southern fence line and pick up a replacement inverter unit. Deliver the inverter unit to the wind turbine base at the eastern pasture boundary. Wait for 10 minutes while technicians install the new inverter and remove the damaged one. Once the damaged inverter has been loaded onto your payload bay, return it to the electrical workshop beside the equipment warehouse. After offloading the damaged inverter, proceed to the vehicle washing station near the main access road and await further instructions.

Begin at the main machine garage near the west gate. Drive to the fertilizer storage shed behind the northern greenhouses and pick up one large sack labeled 'Spring Blend Fertilizer'. Transport the sack to the vegetable cultivation plots, stopping beside row marker 5. Wait for 8 minutes to allow the field crew to unload the fertilizer. Once unloaded, proceed to the drone charging station near the irrigation pond. Collect two replacement drone batteries and deliver them to the flight operations kiosk at the edge of the cotton fields. Await removal of the batteries from your platform, then travel to the main machine garage and stand by for the next task.

Begin at the farm administration building's rear entrance. Proceed to the small greenhouse beside the irrigation shed and pick up two trays of tomato seedlings. Transport the trays to the rooftop hydroponic garden on the distribution center. Wait up to 7 minutes for the garden crew to unload both trays. Once unloaded, head to the northern equipment yard and collect a spool of extension cord. Deliver the extension cord to the maintenance tent at the far edge of the orchard, waiting until the tent supervisor removes it from the robot. Conclude the task by returning to the farm administration building and standing by for the next assignment.

Start your route at the fresh produce packing house near the southeast orchard gate. Drive to the irrigation control station adjacent to the main pond and pick up three coiled hoses and a sealed box of drip-line connectors. Deliver all items to the citrus grove maintenance shed located along the southern border of the orchard. Wait until all hoses and the box of connectors are fully unloaded by the maintenance team. After the items are unloaded, travel to the waste processing unit positioned behind the composting area and collect a small container of organic waste samples. Bring the container to the pest management lab at the north end of the administrative building. Leave the container with the lab technician and await confirmation that delivery is complete before completing your task.

Begin at the maintenance garage next to the eastern storage building. Drive to the fuel depot behind the equipment shed and pick up one secured fuel canister. Deliver the canister to the irrigation pump station at the southern edge of the cornfield. Wait 5 minutes for the pump technician to remove the canister from your platform. Then, proceed to the fertilizer loading bay located between the seed warehouse and the grain silo, and collect three bags of granular fertilizer. Transport these bags to the vineyard access gate on the hillside. Upon arrival, stand by until all three bags have been unloaded by the vineyard crew. After the task is complete, return to the maintenance garage near the eastern storage building.

Begin at the northern entrance of the vegetable processing facility. Travel to the packaging dock beside the cooling chamber and collect three sealed cartons of fresh lettuce. Deliver the cartons to the outdoor farmer’s market area near the south parking lot, and wait for the market supervisor to verify and accept the delivery. After confirmation, return to the processing facility’s equipment cleaning bay and wait for 12 minutes for a routine system wash before powering down.

Begin at the outdoor charging station near the vineyard gate. Travel to the storage shed behind the windbreak trees and pick up three crates of organic fertilizer. Deliver the crates to Field Plot 7, situated on the east slope near the apiary. Upon arrival, wait for the field crew to unload all fertilizer crates. Once the robot is empty, proceed to the packing tent beside the berry wash station and wait for 10 minutes for possible additional delivery instructions. After waiting, return to the charging station near the vineyard gate to end the operation.

Navigate to the orchard’s equipment shelter near the north fence line and collect four crates of pruning shears. Deliver the crates to the eastern orchard block, placing them beside the cherry trees. Wait for 12 minutes while the field workers unload the shears and conduct a tool inspection. After unloading, gather any broken or unusable shears if provided and transport them back to the tool repair workshop behind the administration building. Once the return is complete, head to the refueling station adjacent to the main farm lane and wait there for 5 minutes before shutting down.

Begin at the fertilizer storage shed near the eastern barns. Travel to the mechanical supply depot adjacent to the machinery yard and pick up three containers of lubricating oil. Deliver the containers to the windmill maintenance platform located at the top of the southern hill. Wait for 15 minutes while the maintenance crew offloads the oil. Next, proceed to the vegetable greenhouse beside the west irrigation pond and collect two empty pesticide sprayers. Transport the empty sprayers to the washing station behind the processing plant. Once the sprayers have been received by the sanitation team, return to the fertilizer storage shed near the eastern barns and await further instructions.

Start at the main garage next to the vehicle refueling station. Drive to the machinery shed adjacent to the east cornfield. Pick up one replacement hydraulic pump and two containers of coolant. Deliver these items to the field repair outpost beside the west wheat field. Wait for the maintenance crew to unload the components, which should take about 12 minutes. Once unloading is complete, proceed to the composting yard near the wind turbine cluster, pick up any empty fertilizer totes present (up to four), and bring them back to the main garage to complete the operation.

Start at the farm equipment garage adjacent to the west cornfield. Proceed to the fertilizer storage silo behind the machine shed and collect three sacks of granular fertilizer. Transport the sacks to the soil amendment distribution area at the north end of Field 3. Upon arrival, wait for the field supervisor to confirm receipt of the fertilizer, which may take up to 7 minutes. Once confirmation is provided, continue to the maintenance yard to pick up an empty fuel canister. Deliver the empty canister to the fuel depot next to the service entrance, and return to the farm equipment garage when the delivery is complete.

Begin at the north gate service lot, adjacent to the wind turbine array. Navigate to the irrigation pump house near the southeast edge of the cornfield and pick up three replacement water filters from the storage cabinet on the east wall. Deliver the filters to the maintenance workshop beside the composting area. After the filters have been received by the technician, wait for 10 minutes while the old filters are prepared for disposal. Collect the used filters and transport them to the hazardous materials containment unit near the western gravel road. Finally, drive to the admin portico at the entrance of the central administrative building and await further assignment.

Begin at the equipment storage bay near the north farm gate. Head over to the compost shed on the eastern slope and collect three bags of organic mulch. Move these bags to the flowerbeds along the visitor’s path in the central garden area. Wait until all mulch bags have been unloaded by the landscaping crew (this may take up to 10 minutes). When unloading is confirmed, continue to the tool locker next to the vineyard maintenance shed and pick up a crate containing assorted pruning tools. Deliver the crate to the main orchard entry point beside the citrus groves. After the crate has been retrieved by the orchard supervisor, return to the equipment storage bay and stand by for new tasks.

Begin at the orchard equipment barn located on the east side of the property. Proceed to the packing shed adjacent to the apple orchard and pick up two crates of freshly harvested apples. Deliver the apple crates to the farm co-op's cold storage facility situated in the southwest corner of the compound. After delivery, wait inside the cold storage entrance for up to 10 minutes while the produce team inspects and logs the incoming crates. Once inspection is complete, continue to the irrigation supply depot, collect a box of drip hose connectors, and bring the box to the vineyard tool station near row 12A. Once the delivery is complete, return to the orchard equipment barn and await further instructions.

Start at the tool depot beside the assembly line facility. Navigate to the equipment yard adjacent to the east entrance gate and pick up three containers of mechanical parts. Deliver these containers to the repair bay within the vehicle maintenance center. Upon arrival, wait for 10 minutes while technicians unload the parts and prepare outgoing scrap metal bins. Once the containers are removed, collect two bins of scrap metal from the repair bay and transport them to the recycling station located behind the warehouse. After offloading the bins at the recycling station, return to the tool depot and await further instructions.

Begin at the vehicle garage beside the west gate of the facility. Proceed to the irrigation control center located next to Field 7 and retrieve two spare irrigation valves. Next, deliver the valves to the maintenance bay behind the equipment storage hangar. Wait for 8 minutes while the technicians inspect and exchange the old valves. After the technicians finish, drive to the orchard workshop adjacent to the apple grove and collect a box of replacement pruning shears. Return the box to the vehicle garage to complete your assignment.

Start at the inventory yard across from the north orchard gate. Travel to the repair shed next to the irrigation control building and collect a box of replacement sprinkler valves and a coiled hose. Make your way to the central wheat field by the old silo and deliver both items. Wait for up to 15 minutes while the field crew retrieves the cargo. After deliveries are complete, proceed to the composting area behind the tractor sheds and pick up a single bin of organic waste. Transport the bin to the waste sorting station near the eastern access road, wait until the bin is fully unloaded, then return to the inventory yard.

Begin at the maintenance room inside the southwest administration building. Travel to the orchard’s storage shed near the irrigation pond and pick up four containers of pruning shears. Deliver the containers to the apple grove work crew stationed at sector Delta, next to the eastern orchard entrance. Wait up to 5 minutes for the crew lead to distribute the shears and confirm receipt. Once confirmed, proceed to the equipment calibration station adjacent to the dirt path leading to the south pasture. Pick up any used batteries awaiting recycling and transport them to the hazardous materials locker by the main gate for secure unloading. After your platform is empty, return to the maintenance room and await reassignment.

Start at the equipment garage near the west service road. Drive to the southern orchard loading area and pick up six crates of harvested apples. Deliver the crates to the cold storage chamber attached to the produce warehouse, and wait there until all crates are unloaded by warehouse staff. Afterwards, proceed to the supply shed beside the irrigation control center to collect three sacks of fertilizer. Transport the fertilizer to Plot 12 on the eastern ridge and wait for 10 minutes as the farm crew distributes the sacks. Once completed, travel to the front gate security kiosk to pick up an incoming parcel, then deliver the parcel to the administrative building lobby at the center of the property. Conclude by returning to the equipment garage for your next assignment.

Start at the maintenance garage next to the wind turbine cluster. Drive to the welding workshop adjacent to the storage silos and collect three sealed canisters of welding gas. Deliver the canisters to the vehicle repair bay inside building 2. Wait for the mechanics to unload all the canisters; this should take approximately 8 minutes. After the delivery is complete, proceed to the inventory check station beside the equipment shelter and wait there until you are loaded with inspection tools. Once the tools are on board, return them to the maintenance garage and stand by for further instructions.

Start at the equipment bay annex behind the main administration building. Navigate to the northern tool shed near the irrigation canal and collect two sets of pruning shears and one roll of fencing wire. Transport these items to the vineyard hillside worksite at sector D3, where the crew leader will unload them. Wait for 7 minutes while the crew inspects the deliveries. After all items have been removed, continue to the composting station beside the east orchard to pick up a bin of organic waste. Deliver the waste bin to the recycling platform located inside the maintenance courtyard. After dropping off the bin, return to the equipment bay annex and stand by for further instructions.

Start at the machinery storage bay next to the seed sorting facility. Drive to the vineyard loading zone on the east side of the terraced hills and pick up three crates of freshly harvested grapes. Transport the grapes to the temperature-controlled produce locker inside the main distribution warehouse. Wait until the crates are fully unloaded by the warehouse staff. Next, proceed to the chemical storage bunker near the northern boundary to collect a sealed drum of irrigation fertilizer. Deliver the drum to the crop trial greenhouse situated behind the horticulture research office. After confirming the drum has been unloaded, make your way back to the machinery storage bay.

Begin at the field operations post near the main gate. Drive to the greenhouse cluster in the northeast corner and collect two trays of tomato seedlings from loading bay A. Transport the trays to the planting zone adjacent to irrigation canal 3. Wait for the crew leader to inspect and confirm the seedling delivery, which may require up to 10 minutes. Once confirmed, drive to the shade structure beside the seed storage barn and pick up a single crate of fertilizer packets. Deliver the crate to the row crop trial plots by the west embankment before returning to the operations post for further instructions.

Begin at the equipment depot near the western orchard gate. Proceed to the solar tool charging station beside the weed management plot and collect two fully-charged battery units from the station attendant. Transport the battery units to the vineyard trellis monitoring post on hillside parcel B. Wait for the maintenance crew to remove both battery units from the robot. After the payload is unloaded, travel to the field-side rest pavilion adjacent to the apple storage sheds and wait there for 12 minutes before heading back to the equipment depot to complete your route.

Begin at the machine workshop located adjacent to the west gate. Navigate to the spare parts depot near the maintenance yard and collect three small containers of lubricating oil. Deliver the oil containers to the tractor refueling station beside the hay barns. Wait up to 12 minutes for the mechanics to unload the containers, then continue to the field sensor node at the southeast corn plot. Pick up a weatherproof carrying case containing calibration equipment left at the node. Transport the case to the drone operations center behind the research greenhouse. After dropping off the case, return to the machine workshop and stand by for your next assignment.

Begin at the maintenance shed adjacent to the eastern solar field. Proceed to the central water pump station and collect one large toolbox and three coiled water hoses. Navigate to the blueberry patch on the southern slope and deliver all collected items to the irrigation crew. Wait until all tools and hoses have been removed from the robot, then travel to the northern composting facility to pick up two bins of organic fertilizer. Deliver these bins to the southern greenhouse loading bay. Once the bins have been unloaded, remain on standby for 8 minutes in case additional supplies are requested. When the standby period ends, return to the maintenance shed.

Start at the equipment staging area next to the orchard tool shed. Navigate to the west orchard entrance and pick up two bins of harvested apples stacked on the pallet. Transport the bins to the sorting station at the farm’s central courtyard. Wait for the sorting team to unload only one bin. Then deliver the remaining bin to the exterior loading ramp adjoining the refrigerated storage barn. Remain at the loading ramp for 8 minutes for a quick equipment inspection before proceeding to the solar charging station at the northeast perimeter of the property for battery replenishment.

Begin at the operations hub on the south side of the machinery garage. Drive to the orchard near the western boundary and pick up five crates of freshly picked apples. Deliver the crates to the cold storage room inside the main distribution warehouse. Wait at the cold storage room for 8 minutes while the staff inspect and move the apples into storage. After unloading, proceed to the chemical supply shed adjacent to the southern field, and collect one sealed drum of fertilizer. Transport the drum to the crop monitoring post located along the central irrigation lane. Once the drum is delivered, return to the operations hub and wait there for the next set of instructions.

Start at the north gate of the main compound. Proceed to the spare parts depot near the machine repair barn and pick up two hydraulic hose reels. Transport the hose reels to the crop sprayer maintenance area on the west side of the property. Wait up to 8 minutes for the maintenance crew to unload the reels. Once unloaded, travel to the solar pump station on the southern end of the vineyard and remain there for 5 minutes to enable inspection staff to use on-board diagnostic equipment. After the waiting period, navigate back to the north gate to complete the task.

Start at the materials staging area near the central packing house. Proceed to the solar power station on the south ridge to collect two replacement battery modules. Deliver the battery modules to the utility cabinet at the weather monitoring tower on Hilltop Lane. Wait for 10 minutes while the modules are installed by a technician. Once installation is complete and the empty packaging is placed on your cargo platform, transport the empty packaging to the recycling bay beside the vehicle garage. After depositing the empty packaging, await further instructions at the materials staging area.

Begin at the main barn adjacent to the central pathway. Proceed to the produce packing area situated behind the cold storage building and pick up three crates of harvested tomatoes. Transport the crates to the delivery staging zone near the farm’s main roadway entrance. Wait until the delivery truck driver confirms all crates have been unloaded from the robot. After offloading, head to the irrigation supply shed located by Field 12, collect a tool kit box, and deliver it to the maintenance bay inside the machinery garage. After the tool kit has been removed, wait for 10 minutes before moving to the main barn holding point to await further instructions.

Begin at the south perimeter garage. Proceed to the seed storage facility located beside the western wheat fields. Pick up three sacks of corn seeds and a small crate of planting markers. Deliver these items to the planting crew at Field Plot 7 near the central irrigation canal. Wait until the planting crew has unloaded all materials and confirms the receipt of the delivery. Once the platform is empty, travel to the battery charging station adjacent to the administrative office and wait there for 20 minutes for a scheduled recharge or further instructions.

Start from the main service station beside the southern parking lot. Drive to the fertilizer compound room behind the greenhouse annex and retrieve two containers of liquid fertilizer. Deliver both containers to the tomato plantation sector near the eastern windbreak. Wait for up to 8 minutes while greenhouse technicians unload the fertilizer containers from your platform. Once fully unloaded, proceed to the maintenance depot next to the central equipment yard and collect a replacement air filter unit. Transport the air filter unit to the wind turbine platform on the northern hilltop. Upon delivery, wait until the maintenance crew removes the air filter from your cargo. After successful unloading, return directly to the main service station and remain on standby.

Start at the central tool depot near the workshop annex. Navigate to the compost yard behind Orchard Block A and pick up a sealed bin of compostable waste placed by the east gate. Deliver the bin to the waste processing center south of the solar field. Wait for sanitation staff to unload the bin—this process may take approximately 8 minutes. After unloading, proceed to the equipment washing station beside the storage silos, and wait there until ordered to pick up cleaned harvest crates.

Begin at the equipment shed near the northern entrance. Proceed to the orchard packing station situated beside the west field and pick up a crate of freshly harvested apples. Deliver the crate to the farm supply dock located behind the reception barn. Wait until the dock staff have removed the crate from your payload. Once the payload compartment is empty, drive to the greenhouse loading bays and await further orders for 10 minutes before returning to the equipment shed.

Begin at the maintenance hub next to the machine repair workshop. Travel to the supply tent located on the west edge of the solar field and pick up four replacement solar panel modules. Deliver the modules to the solar installation area at the far north end of the property. Wait until technicians unload all four solar panel modules—a process that should take up to 7 minutes. After unloading is complete, drive to the compost yard near the western boundary and collect one container of processed compost. Bring the container to the vegetable garden beside the main farmhouse and deposit it there. Once the delivery is done, return to the maintenance hub and stand by for your next assignment.

Begin at the chemical storage shed situated near the wind turbine cluster on the southeast hill. Navigate to the vineyard equipment lot just beyond the trellis section. Pick up three empty grape collection crates and a roll of protective netting. Deliver these items to the Grapevine Block 7 staging area, located adjacent to the vineyard pond. Wait until the harvest supervisor secures the netting and removes the crates, which may take around 10 minutes. After unloading, move to the produce packaging tent at the central farm hub. Pick up one sealed box of freshly packed berries. Transport the box to the retail farm stand at the roadside market entrance, then return to the chemical storage shed and await further directives.

Start at the maintenance garage next to the central workshop. Navigate to the pesticide storage shed located at the eastern fence line and pick up two sealed chemical canisters. Deliver the canisters to the crop sprayer loading station at the edge of the sunflower field. Wait until the field crew has removed both canisters from your payload. Then, travel to the supply depot adjacent to the lunch pavilion and collect a box of replacement gloves and a set of safety goggles. Bring these safety supplies to the vineyard repair station at the southern trellis rows. Once delivered, return to the maintenance garage and await further instructions.

Begin at the maintenance garage located beside the solar panel array. Proceed to the seed storage loft next to the weather monitoring station. Pick up three bags of corn seed from the storage racks. Deliver these bags to the planting machine stationed in the east field near the old windmill. Wait while the farm crew loads the planting machine with the seeds, remaining in position for up to 7 minutes. Once the task is complete, travel to the refueling station by the north equipment yard. Wait to be refueled, then return to the maintenance garage by the solar panel array to complete your route.

Begin at the supply dock behind the equipment warehouse. Proceed to the fertilizer storage tent on the north end of the field. Collect two sealed containers of granulated fertilizer. Transport the containers to Greenhouse 3 loading area. Wait until the greenhouse supervisor confirms all containers are unloaded from the robot. Then drive to the fuel shed near the machinery parking lot and pick up a filled diesel canister. Deliver the diesel canister to the generator enclosure at the windmill clearing. Once delivery is complete, return to the supply dock.

Begin at the field equipment bay beside the east orchard entrance. Proceed to the beehive management zone situated along the southern boundary and pick up a medium-sized sealed container labeled 'Bee Nutrient Supplement.' Deliver the container to the pollination research hut located at the northern end of the wildflower meadow. Wait until the research team has unloaded the container and given an approval signal (no longer than ten minutes). Next, travel to the livestock barn just beyond the central gravel road, collect a crate of feed supplements from the loading area, and carry it to the shade shelter in the west pasture. Once the crate is collected by the farmhand, return to the field equipment bay to complete your route.

Begin at the equipment shelter adjacent to the composting area. Navigate to the vineyard canopy at the southern slope and retrieve three collection baskets filled with freshly picked grapes. Transport the baskets to the processing tent beside the main winery. Wait for the production team to remove all baskets from your cargo tray. Once emptied, move to the solar panel maintenance yard on the eastern field and pick up one replacement inverter unit. Deliver the inverter to the utility control shed near the central wind turbine. Remain at the control shed for 5 minutes to allow technicians to install the new component. Afterward, return to the equipment shelter and await further instructions.

Start at the central dispatch hub near the administration office. Drive to the fertilizer depot on the eastern boundary of the property and pick up four bags of granular fertilizer. Transport the fertilizer to the vegetable planting fields next to the irrigation canal. Wait until the field crew unloads all the bags. Then, proceed to the seed storage bunker at the rear of the greenhouses. Collect a crate of tomato seeds and bring it to the greenhouse number 3 loading area. Wait for 10 minutes or until a greenhouse technician acknowledges delivery. Afterward, return directly to the central dispatch hub and await your next task.

Begin at the logistics hub beside the farm’s east entrance. Proceed to the fertilizer storage shed adjacent to the compost yard and pick up three bags of organic fertilizer. Transport the fertilizer to the entrance of the apple orchard pavilion. Wait for the orchard manager to confirm the transfer and sign off, which may take up to 5 minutes. After confirmation, continue to the machinery wash station at the south end of the property. Pause there for 7 minutes to allow for a quick rinse and inspection. Once the inspection is complete, return to the logistics hub to stand by for your next assignment.

Begin at the eastern equipment garage. Travel to the south orchard’s harvest platform and pick up three crates filled with newly picked peaches. Deliver the crates to the cold storage bunker behind the produce packaging facility. Wait for ten minutes to allow staff to sort and label the crates. Once the sorting is complete, proceed to the irrigation control hut on the northern embankment and collect a sealed drum of liquid fertilizer. Transport the drum to the main greenhouse complex and wait until greenhouse technicians have unloaded it before returning to the eastern equipment garage to stand by for the next assignment.

Start at the equipment garage beside the northern paddock. Travel to the supply warehouse at the west end of the facility and collect one large crate of seed potatoes. Deliver the crate to planting field B, located beyond the line of poplars. Wait up to 10 minutes for the field crew to confirm the receipt of the crate and complete the initial inventory check. After confirmation, proceed to the composting area near the livestock barns, retrieve two empty compost bins, and transport them back to the equipment garage. Once the bins have been dropped off, stand by for 7 minutes for cleaning staff to sanitize the bins before concluding the task.

Start at the north field service station. Proceed to the orchard entrance and pick up three crates of freshly harvested peaches. Transport the crates to the cold storage facility near the eastern periphery. Wait for 8 minutes while the loading staff stores the crates. After the crates are unloaded, travel to the mechanical workshop next to the equipment barn and collect a spare drive belt. Deliver the drive belt to the irrigation control shed beside the northern pond. Once the delivery is acknowledged by the site engineer, return to the north field service station.

Begin at the logistics hub located beside the grain silos. Travel to the seed storage barn near the orchard boundary and collect six bags of winter wheat seeds stacked at the loading ramp. Take the seed bags to Plot 7, which is situated along the northern fence line. Wait until the planting crew has finished unloading all six bags. Once your cargo is unloaded, move to the pesticide mixing station near the eastern equipment garage to pick up a sealed drum of organic pesticide. Deliver the drum to the drone launch pad area by the southern tool depot, and wait until the attendant unloads it before returning to the logistics hub for assignment.

Start at the maintenance bay beside the north entrance. Travel to the parts storage facility adjacent to the water tower. Retrieve two sealed boxes of replacement tractor components. Transport these boxes to the tractor shed near the western boundary of the property. Wait at the tractor shed for up to 10 minutes for the maintenance crew to unload the boxes. After delivery is complete, return to the maintenance bay and await further instructions.

Begin at the storage tent beside the orchard tool shed. Collect two bins of washed apples. Drive to the packing station at the southern end of the main warehouse. Wait until the packing assistant has unloaded both bins; this may take up to 7 minutes. Then proceed to the composting area near the east fence and pick up an empty compost container. Deliver the empty container to the greenhouse annex for reuse. After returning the container, proceed to the orchard tool shed and stand by for further payload delivery tasks.

Start from the equipment charging station next to the southern perimeter fence. Travel to the seed storage shed close to the windbreak grove and pick up two sacks of corn seed. Deliver these sacks to the automated seeding machine midway along the eastern cultivation plots. Wait for 15 minutes while the crew refills the machine and confirms completion. Afterward, head to the field supply depot behind the fertilizer silo to collect a bag of replacement seeding nozzles. Bring the nozzles back to the equipment charging station and await further instructions for 5 minutes.

Start at the north-side loading dock beside the machine shop. Proceed to the field equipment supply shed and collect a pallet of replacement irrigation hoses. Transfer the pallet to the south vineyard’s repair station near the workers’ break tent. Wait for 7 minutes while maintenance staff unload the hoses. After the unload is finished, drive to the composting yard at the east perimeter and collect a pile of empty harvest crates. Deliver the empty crates to the washing station behind the packing house. Once the crates have been offloaded, navigate to the north-side loading dock and wait there for further instructions.

Start at the maintenance garage near the western entrance. Navigate to the irrigation control hub located beside the reed pond and pick up a waterproof container filled with sensor probes. Transport the container to the north orchard field station. Wait up to 20 minutes for the orchard technician to install the probes and return any faulty units to the container. Once the technician is finished, deliver any faulty sensor probes to the equipment diagnostics lab adjacent to the central administration building. After delivery, wait for 10 minutes in the diagnostics lab for additional maintenance requests.

Begin at the central farm garage and drive to the eastern greenhouse loading bay. Pick up a pallet containing assorted seedlings. Transport the pallet to the orchard entrance and deliver it next to the staging canopy. Wait while the field crew removes all seedlings from the pallet; do not leave until your platform is fully empty. Once offloaded, proceed to the packing shed's rear entrance and collect a crate of compostable packaging material. Return the crate to the central farm garage and place it in the recyclable materials area before shutting down to await further instructions.

Start at the equipment garage adjacent to the main farmhouse. Drive to the solar panel field along the eastern fence line and pick up three boxed replacement inverters awaiting maintenance. Deliver the inverters to the electrical maintenance shed beside the grain storage silos. Wait for up to 7 minutes while the maintenance crew verifies the delivery. Once confirmation is received, head to the feed storage barn near the north paddock and pick up a sack of mineral supplements. Transport the mineral supplements to the livestock feeding area behind the irrigation pumps, then return to the equipment garage after completing the task.

Start at the equipment charging station near the central barn. Proceed to the irrigation supply shed and pick up two coiled hoses and a box of pipe fittings. Deliver these items to the northern pasture irrigation control point. Wait for 15 minutes while the maintenance crew completes their installation. After this, proceed to the east field’s windbreak, pick up a weather monitoring sensor unit, and transport it to the research plot collection area in the southwest corner of the property. Wait until the sensor unit is unloaded, then return to the equipment charging station for your next assignment.

Start at the equipment charging station beside the main administrative building. Proceed to the packing shed located on the west side of the citrus grove and pick up two crates of lemons and one crate of oranges. Deliver these crates to the outbound shipping dock next to the access road. Wait at the shipping dock for 6 minutes to allow the logistics team to unload the crates. After the crates are removed, continue to the irrigation control hut south of the vegetable plots to pick up a replacement irrigation filter cartridge. Transport the filter cartridge to the repair bay at the base of the windmill structure, and await further instructions after arrival.

Start at the machinery garage adjacent to the greenhouse complex. Proceed to the loading dock behind Barn 3 and pick up a pallet of sealed seed bags. Transport the pallet to the crop staging area beside Field 12. Wait for the planting crew to unload all seed bags; do not depart until the cargo area is empty. Once unloaded, navigate to the recycling shed near the west boundary and collect any available empty crates. Deliver the empty crates to the storage alcove within the root vegetable warehouse, then return to the machinery garage and stand by for 8 minutes while awaiting potential follow-up tasks.

Begin at the equipment bay adjacent to the eastern orchard gate. Drive to the seed storage shed located along the southern fence and pick up two sacks of organic fertilizer. Deliver the sacks to the community planting area at the west end of the property. Wait until garden volunteers have removed both sacks from your platform. After unloading, travel to the composting station behind the main greenhouse, pick up a bundle of empty planting trays, and transport them back to the equipment bay. Upon completion, wait 10 minutes in the equipment bay before proceeding to your next task.

Begin your route at the central loading bay near the harvest aggregation point. Proceed to the orchard maintenance yard located east of the apple groves and collect two bins of pruned branches. Transport the bins to the composting site at the western perimeter of the property. Wait until both bins have been emptied by site personnel—this may take up to 10 minutes. After the bins are cleared, traverse to the chemical storage container behind the greenhouse complex and retrieve a canister of foliar nutrient solution. Deliver the canister to the field supply station at Vegetable Plot B, and remain in position until the agricultural technician confirms successful handoff. Afterwards, return to the central loading bay and prepare for your next deployment.

Start at the vehicle garage near the main service road. Proceed to the spare parts storage shed adjacent to the maintenance office and collect one large crate of tractor tires. Deliver the crate to the field repair station located at the north edge of the east wheat field. Wait for 10 minutes while the repair team unloads the tires and fits them onto equipment. After unloading, drive to the chemical storage room behind the packaging center and pick up two boxes of safety goggles. Transport the boxes to the first-aid supply station under the central windmill. Wait until the supply supervisor confirms all boxes have been unloaded, then return to the vehicle garage to complete your task.

Begin at the storage bay adjoining the equipment repair shop. Navigate to the central composting station and collect four empty fertilizer bins stacked near the processing unit. Proceed to the pasture gate along the northern perimeter and deliver the bins to the groundskeeper stationed there. Wait until all bins are removed, which may take up to 10 minutes. After unloading, continue to the vineyard loading dock near the hillside and wait until three crates of freshly picked grapes are loaded onto your platform by the harvest crew. Once all crates are securely on board, transport them to the fermentation facility located behind the main barn. Remain at the fermentation facility for further loading instructions.

Begin at the packaging warehouse near the loading docks. Drive to the north field irrigation station and pick up four sealed water sample containers. Bring the containers to the laboratory entrance at the research center on the west campus. Wait for a laboratory technician to collect the containers, which should take approximately 8 minutes. After the handover, proceed to the machinery refueling depot adjacent to the fuel tanks. Retrieve one full diesel canister and deliver it to the tractor parking area behind the harvesting barn. Wait until the tractor operator removes the canister from your platform. Once all deliveries are complete, return to the packaging warehouse and await further instructions.

Start at the water pump station on the western field boundary. Drive to the orchard center and pick up two crates of freshly harvested cherries stacked near the central tree. Transport the crates to the cooling room inside the post-harvest processing facility located at the south end of the orchard. Wait until the crates are unloaded by the facility staff. After delivery is confirmed, continue to the northeast greenhouse. There, collect any empty nutrient solution drums left outside the entrance. Proceed to the waste management zone next to the compost heap and deposit the empty drums. Once the delivery is complete, return to the water pump station to stand by for further instructions.

Begin at the main greenhouse loading zone beside the irrigation pond. Move to the compost facility west of the equipment storage lot and pick up three biodegradable waste bins. Deliver the waste bins to the waste processing depot adjacent to the solar power array on the southern boundary. Wait for 8 minutes while the processing crew empties the bins. After unloading, proceed to the storage container lot near the fuel refill station and collect four empty crates marked for Field 5. Transport the crates to the farm supply drop-off point just outside Field 5's northwest entrance. Once delivery is confirmed, return to the main greenhouse loading zone and await further instructions.

Begin at the main greenhouse entrance on the south side of the property. Navigate to the irrigation pump house adjacent to the central pond. Pick up four coiled hoses and a box containing drip irrigation nozzles. Proceed to the newly planted vineyard plot located by the eastern slope. Deliver the hoses and nozzle box to the field crew at the plot. Wait for 12 minutes while the crew unloads the equipment and confirms receipt. Next, travel to the battery charging station behind the solar array, wait 5 minutes for a battery swap, then transport the used batteries back to the maintenance kiosk at the greenhouse. Once the batteries have been delivered, remain at the kiosk until a technician removes them. End the task afterward.

Begin at the storage garage along the northern fence of the property. Drive to the vineyard entrance beside the old oak tree and pick up two bins of freshly harvested grapes. Deliver the bins to the wine processing building located next to Workshop 2. Wait nearby until the harvest crew has unloaded both bins from the robot. Afterward, proceed to the equipment shed behind Field 3 and collect a replacement hose reel. Transport the hose reel to the greenhouse annex at the southern end of the farm. Wait for 12 minutes to allow the gardeners to install the hose before returning to the storage garage.

Start at the supply garage near the staff parking area. Drive to the greenhouse loading bay and pick up a cart containing six trays of young tomato seedlings. Deliver the seedlings to the raised beds section inside the east greenhouse. Wait at the beds until the horticulturist has unloaded all trays; this should take approximately 8 minutes. Once unloaded, proceed to the southeast tool shed and collect a box of hand tools. Bring the tools to the irrigation valve station in the center field and wait there for instructions from the field maintenance supervisor.

Start at the vehicle garage near the western farm entrance. Drive to the equipment staging yard next to the packing house and pick up two replacement tractor tires and a container of hydraulic fluid. Proceed to the north field storage barn and deliver the tires and hydraulic fluid to the repair team stationed there. Wait until all items have been removed from the robot. Next, continue to the orchard tool station and collect a crate of pruning shears and three bundles of twine. Transport these supplies to the main apple orchard entry point and wait for 7 minutes for the orchard staff to collect them. Once the items have been retrieved, return to the vehicle garage and await further instructions.

Start from the maintenance garage adjacent to the solar recharge station. Drive to the fertilizer mixing shed near Crop Block C and pick up two sacks labeled 'Organic Fertilizer No. 12'. Transport the sacks to the irrigation pivot at the center of the sunflower field. Wait there for up to 12 minutes while the field team unloads the sacks. After unloading, continue to the spare parts storage tent next to the west equipment lane and collect a box of replacement sprinkler heads. Deliver this box to the row-crop machinery depot located by the north gravel lane. After delivery, return directly to the maintenance garage to complete your tasks.

Start at the primary seed storage facility located near the north barn. Drive to the polycarbonate tool shelter behind the cattle enclosure and pick up a bag of soil testing kits and two containers of crop sensor batteries. Deliver these items to the environmental monitoring station at the east field edge. Wait for the station technicians to retrieve both the bag and containers from your platform. After your platform is empty, travel to the visitor parking lot entrance and stand by for 15 minutes for the arrival of the next delivery assignment.

Begin at the operations garage adjacent to the south fence. Navigate to the irrigation valve station beside the central reservoir and retrieve the sealed box containing replacement drip nozzles. Proceed to the east orchard and deliver the box to the repair crew located by Row 7. Wait at the site for up to 15 minutes while the crew unloads the nozzles and confirms the delivery. Once the delivery is complete, continue to the field supply outpost on the west lane and collect any empty fertilizer bags awaiting disposal. Transport the empty bags to the materials recycling bay behind the equipment barn before returning to the operations garage to await your next instructions.

Begin at the equipment garage next to the machine maintenance shed. Proceed to the orchard's west gate and pick up three baskets of harvested apples waiting beside the sorting table. Deliver the baskets to the cold storage unit located adjacent to the produce packing house. Wait for the storage supervisor to sign off on the delivery, then move to the chemical supply shed south of the main barn. Retrieve a single sealed drum of organic pesticide. Transport the drum to the application equipment station in field block 7. Wait for 15 minutes while the field technician completes the transfer. Once the drum has been unloaded, return to the equipment garage and prepare for your next operation.

Start at the tool storage unit beside Workshop C. Drive to the north greenhouse and pick up a crate of organic fertilizer along with four seedling trays. Deliver the seedling trays to the propagation area at the west end of the nursery, and wait while staff unload the trays, which usually takes around 6 minutes. Once the seedling trays are removed, continue to the equipment calibration pad behind Garage 1 and drop off the crate of fertilizer. After delivery, return to the tool storage unit and stand by for 10 minutes before accepting the next assignment.

Begin at the loading dock next to the greenhouse complex. Proceed to the fertilizer storage shed at the southeastern corner of the property and pick up three sacks of organic fertilizer. Transport these sacks to the irrigation control hub near the rice paddy fields. Wait for farm staff to unload the fertilizer, which may take up to 8 minutes. Once unloading is done, navigate to the solar panel maintenance depot beside the southern utility road and collect a box of replacement fuses. Deliver the box to the rooftop access ladder on the barn, then wait until a technician retrieves the box before returning to the loading dock and standing by for further instructions.

Begin at the maintenance bay located behind the packaging facility. Drive to the greenhouse complex near the eastern field and pick up two trays of tomato seedlings. Deliver the trays to Section B of the south orchard. Wait for 10 minutes while workers distribute the seedlings. After the wait, proceed to the irrigation control shed adjacent to the orchard and stand by for further instructions.

Begin at the spare parts depot adjacent to the solar panel array. Proceed to the equipment maintenance tent beside the main greenhouse and pick up three replacement irrigation valves and a spool of water hose. Transport these items to the west sprinkler manifold, located between the compost station and the wildflower meadow. Wait for 10 minutes while the irrigation team offloads the valves and hose. Once unloading is complete, return to the spare parts depot and await the next parts request.

Start at the drone charging pad located behind the central control building. Travel to the vineyard supply shed at the southeast edge of the property and pick up three crates of trellising wire. Deliver the crates to the vineyard’s block 7A entrance and wait for the vineyard crew to unload all wires. Once the crates are completely removed, proceed to the solar panel array near the irrigation reservoir, wait for 10 minutes to allow technicians time to load a box of replacement inverters onto your platform, then transport the box to the electrical maintenance workshop by the northern perimeter gate. Wait for the workshop supervisor to acknowledge receipt, then return to the drone charging pad to stand by for further tasks.

Begin at the main charging station next to the maintenance garage. Proceed to the pallet stack area across from the packaging shed and collect four empty wooden pallets. Transport the pallets to the berry greenhouse located south of the orchard entrance. Wait there for the greenhouse crew to fully load the pallets with packed berry trays. After the pallets are loaded, deliver them to the market loading bay on the eastern edge of the property. Remain at the market loading bay until a supervisor has verified each pallet and given clearance to depart, then return to the main charging station.

Start at the main storage hangar adjacent to the gravel parking lot. Drive to the greenhouse complex on the south edge of the property. Pick up two containers of sensitive plant seedlings waiting on the loading platform. Proceed carefully to the horticulture research tent, positioned beside the windbreak row. Wait up to 10 minutes while the researchers unload the seedling containers from your platform. After unloading is completed, drive to the field equipment bay near the access road, and stand by for additional tasks.

Travel to the greenhouse storage and gather six sacks of fertilizer. Deliver three sacks to the North Field irrigation hub, two sacks to the Orchard entrance, and one sack to the South Pasture gate. Wait at the South Pasture gate for 7 minutes for confirmation. After delivery is confirmed, proceed to the equipment garage and stand by for further tasks.
Begin at the maintenance depot and pick up two toolboxes and a spool of insulated wire.
Travel to Windmill Station 3 and deliver one toolbox to the on-site technician. Wait until the technician removes the toolbox from the robot.
Proceed to the solar panel array and deliver the spool of insulated wire to the maintenance crew. Wait for 10 minutes while they inspect the delivery.
After the wait, head to the livestock barn, deliver the remaining toolbox to the barn supervisor, then return to the maintenance depot and await further instructions.

Drive to the solar panel field control shed to pick up four spools of insulated wire. Transport two spools to the wind turbine tower near the north boundary. Wait until the maintenance team unloads the wire. Then, deliver the remaining two spools to the power station by the irrigation canal, and return to the central operations garage.

Travel to the greenhouse supply shed and pick up eight seed dispersal kits. Deliver two kits each to the North field, South field, East field, and West field. After all deliveries are complete, return to the supply shed and wait for 10 minutes to be reloaded with fertilizer packs.

Proceed to the solar array maintenance shed and pick up three boxes of replacement solar panels. Deliver one box each to the South Hill solar field, the East Ridge solar field, and the West Valley solar field. At each site, wait until the on-site technician confirms the box has been unloaded before moving to the next location. Once all deliveries are complete, return any remaining empty crates from the last site to the maintenance shed.

Proceed to the orchard supply tent and pick up five fresh water tanks. Deliver three tanks to the north field irrigation station and wait 20 minutes for the farm crew to install them. Then take the remaining two tanks to the south field pump house. Once the tanks are unloaded, return to the orchard supply tent for further instructions.

Drive to the irrigation supply depot and pick up two large water pumps and six reels of irrigation hose. Deliver one water pump and three reels of hose to the North Orchard pump station. Wait until a supervisor inspects the equipment and gives clearance to unload. After unloading there, proceed to the South Field reservoir and deliver the remaining pump and hoses. Wait for 10 minutes at the reservoir in case additional assistance is needed. Finally, return to the irrigation supply depot and report task completion.

Drive to the maintenance garage and pick up two replacement hydraulic hoses. Proceed to the Orchard Irrigation Control Station and deliver one hose. Wait until the station attendant confirms receipt by removing the hose. Continue to the Vineyard Pump House and deliver the second hose. After delivery, return to the maintenance garage for further assignment.

Start at the storage barn and pick up a pallet containing six bags of fertilizer. Drive to Greenhouse 4 and deliver two bags. After unloading, wait for the greenhouse technician to inspect and sign off before proceeding. Next, go to the field composting area and drop off the remaining four bags. Wait for 10 minutes to ensure safe placement before returning to the storage barn.

Proceed to the equipment storage barn and load three large water tanks onto the robot. Transport two tanks directly to the upper meadow grazing area and wait while they are unloaded by the field hands. Deliver the final tank to the east orchard pump station. Once delivery is complete, stand by at the pump station for 15 minutes in case further assistance is required, then return to the maintenance depot.

Start at the greenhouse storage area and collect four trays of vegetable seedlings and a box of soil sensors. Travel to the eastern test plot and deliver the seedlings to the planting crew. Wait until the planting crew unloads all trays. Afterward, proceed to the center monitoring station to drop off the soil sensor box. Finally, return to the greenhouse storage area and await further assignments.

Drive to the vineyard storage shed and collect five crates of harvested grapes. Transport three crates to the winery pressing room and wait until they are unloaded by staff. Deliver the remaining two crates to the fermentation cellar.
