After drop-off, proceed to the solar panel field and check if maintenance supplies are ready for pickup; if not, wait for 10 minutes before returning to the operations hub.

Travel to the equipment garage and pick up two replacement water pumps. Deliver the pumps to the irrigation control station at the eastern field. Wait until a technician removes the old equipment and loads the faulty pumps onto your payload area. Return the faulty pumps to the repair workshop near the main entrance, then proceed to the charging station for a 20-minute recharge.

Begin at Workshop 2 and pick up the maintenance tool kit and a replacement hydraulic pump. Drive to the wind turbine service pad and deliver both items to the designated technician. Wait until the technician removes the hydraulic pump from the robot, then stand by for 15 minutes while the tool kit is in use. Once the technician places the tool kit back onto the robot, return it to Workshop 2 and place it in the equipment locker.

Start at the tractor garage and collect three empty fuel canisters. Navigate to the west field fuel depot and refill all canisters. Then, drive to the southern harvesting area and deliver the filled fuel canisters to the harvester crew. Wait until all canisters are unloaded by the crew. Once unloaded, proceed to the main operations office to pick up a weatherproof data tablet for field logging, and deliver the tablet to the foreman at the northern observation tower. Finally, return to the tractor garage and await the next task.

Start at the maintenance bay and pick up a box containing replacement sensor modules and a tool kit. Travel to the vineyard drone charging station in the eastern vineyard and deliver the tool kit to the technician present. Wait until the technician loads two depleted drone batteries onto the robot. Next, proceed to the solar array maintenance platform and drop off the replacement sensor modules. Remain at the platform for 15 minutes in standby mode, in case further transport of malfunctioning components is needed. Afterward, return to the maintenance bay and transfer the depleted drone batteries to the designated recycling bin.

Begin at the seed storage shed and collect three sacks of corn seeds. Travel across the north gravel path to the tractor fueling depot. Deliver one sack of corn seeds to the attendant at the fueling depot. Continue to the hillside greenhouse, located on the west slope, and deliver the remaining two sacks of corn seeds to the storage area inside. Wait at the greenhouse for 10 minutes in case additional seed transfer is requested. Once the waiting period has elapsed, navigate back to the seed storage shed and park at the designated unloading bay.

Proceed to the north field storage shed and collect six irrigation hoses and four bags of fertilizer. Transport all items to the greenhouse loading area and wait there until all items are unloaded by the staff. Once unloaded, travel to the orchard gate and pick up any empty crates left beside the entrance. Take the empty crates to the composting station, drop them off, and then head back to the charging station near the garage to recharge.

Begin at the processing warehouse and pick up three crates of freshly harvested strawberries. Travel to the farm manager’s office in the north building and deliver one crate to the receptionist. Next, continue to the refrigeration unit behind the packing shed and leave the remaining two crates inside. Wait at the refrigeration unit for 10 minutes to confirm that the crates are properly stored and signed in, then proceed to the parking area near the equipment shed and stand by for further assignment.

Head to the machinery workshop and collect three sealed containers of lubricating oil. Transport these containers to the tractor fleet parking zone and deliver one container to each of the three designated maintenance pits. After all containers are delivered, wait for 10 minutes to allow the mechanics to complete oil refills. Once the waiting period is over, move to the solar array field and pick up any discarded packaging materials scattered near the southern maintenance hut. Deliver all collected packaging materials to the recycling center adjacent to the east gate before returning to your docking station behind the maintenance room.

Start at the Farm Storage Shed and pick up three bags of fertilizer and a box of irrigation valves. Drive to the Greenhouse Complex and deliver the box of irrigation valves. Wait for 5 minutes to be unloaded. Proceed to Field Plot 7 and deliver the three bags of fertilizer. Wait until the field supervisor removes all fertilizer bags, then return to the Storage Shed for your next task.

Proceed to the irrigation shed and pick up two rolls of drip tape along with a set of replacement sprinkler heads. Drive to the east vineyard block and deliver the supplies to the irrigation maintenance crew. Wait for up to 10 minutes while the crew inspects and removes the items from the robot. Once unloaded, continue to the equipment calibration shelter to collect a box containing sensor calibration tools. Transport the box to greenhouse 2 and hand it over to the technical staff awaiting within. Afterwards, head to the shade structure near the central orchard and remain on standby for further instructions.

Start at the machinery garage and pick up two sealed cases of irrigation nozzles. Drive to the eastern pasture fence line and deliver one case to the tool crate beside Gate 2. Wait there for 15 minutes to allow the maintenance crew to retrieve the nozzles. When the wait is over, proceed to the southern pumping station with the remaining case of nozzles and place it on the supply platform. Once the delivery is complete, return to the machinery garage and park near Bay 3 for further assignments.

Travel to the machine shop and pick up four sealed toolboxes. Take two toolboxes to the solar panel maintenance area and wait until the site supervisor confirms they are unloaded. Then deliver the remaining two toolboxes to the wind turbine control shelter. After all toolboxes have been delivered, wait at the shelter for 10 minutes in case additional equipment needs to be loaded. Finally, return to the machine shop.

Start at the maintenance garage and collect four solar panel cleaning kits. Proceed to the west orchard and deliver two cleaning kits to the field crew supervisor near the irrigation control station. Then, travel to the south greenhouse to drop off the remaining two kits at the climate monitoring room. After completing the deliveries, wait at the climate monitoring room for 15 minutes to assist with any additional supply requests. Once finished, return to the maintenance garage for your next assignment.

Begin at the greenhouse loading bay and pick up three trays of young tomato seedlings. Transport the first tray to the central planting plot and deliver it to the marker labeled "Plot A1." Then proceed to the east field entrance and drop off the second tray near Shed 4 for the planting team. Wait beside Shed 4 for 10 minutes to confirm receipt by the team leader. After the waiting period, take the final tray to the irrigation control room and place it on the seedling shelf. Finally, return to the greenhouse loading bay and await new instructions.

Begin at the greenhouse entrance and collect six irrigation filters from the supply rack. Deliver three filters to the central field irrigation control station, then proceed to the east crop plot and deliver the remaining three filters. After all filters have been delivered, move to the compost processing area and wait for 15 minutes to be loaded with any recyclable materials. Once loaded, transport the recyclables to the recycling bay and wait until they are fully unloaded before returning to the greenhouse entrance.

Begin at the supply depot and pick up three sealed fertilizer canisters. Travel to Crop Field B and deliver two canisters to the storage shed near the north entrance. Wait until the field supervisor confirms receipt of the fertilizer. Next, proceed to the machinery shed at the eastern perimeter fence and deliver the remaining canister to the equipment operator. After completing both deliveries, wait at the machinery shed for 10 minutes in case additional tools or materials are needed for ongoing repairs. Once the waiting period is over, return to the supply depot to await your next task.

Begin at the greenhouse loading bay and retrieve four pallets of seedling trays. Deliver two pallets to the planting crew stationed near Irrigation Sector A. Wait until the crew leader signals that all trays have been offloaded. Next, carry the remaining two pallets to the compost yard beside the utility barn for temporary storage. After unloading, proceed to the maintenance area and wait for 12 minutes for the maintenance team to perform a routine sensor calibration before returning to the greenhouse loading bay.

Start at the harvest staging area and collect four crates of harvested tomatoes. Transport all four crates to the produce sorting station beside Packing Shed B. Wait at the sorting station until the quality control staff removes two crates from the robot. After removal, take the remaining two crates to the local farmers’ market loading zone and deliver them to the delivery supervisor on site. Following the delivery, proceed to the maintenance supply closet adjacent to Greenhouse 3 and wait for 12 minutes for the arrival of the equipment technician. Stand by for further instructions once the waiting period is complete.

Start at the north equipment shed and pick up two crates of replacement irrigation valves. Transport both crates to the repair crew stationed beside Field 7. Wait until the technician removes one crate for immediate use. Take the remaining crate to the storage tent at Standpipe Junction and place it inside. Proceed to the main control tent and wait for 8 minutes while receiving new task updates, then navigate back to the equipment shed.

Begin at the equipment shed next to the north vineyard and pick up three sealed buckets of irrigation solution. Transport the buckets to the main greenhouse entrance and wait until the horticulture team offloads all buckets from the robot. Once unloaded, drive to the orchard’s south end and fetch a replacement wheelbarrow, then return it to the maintenance workshop behind Storage Unit 5.

Start at the vehicle service garage and collect two replacement tires. Drive to the western pasture gate and deliver one tire to the repair station adjacent to the silo. Wait at the repair station until the maintenance supervisor confirms the delivery by scanning the receipt badge. Once confirmation is received, proceed with the second tire to the barns at the north end of the property, and place it inside the designated tire storage rack. After placing the tire, return to the service garage and stand by for further tasks.

Start by traveling to the grain storage shed and collect five empty fertilizer dispensers. Proceed to Field Plot 3 and drop off three dispensers at the southeast corner tool station. Deliver the remaining two dispensers to the north pathway equipment depot. Wait at the depot for 20 minutes to receive two full harvesting crates from the field crew, then return both crates to the packing house loading bay. After offloading the crates, wait at the loading bay until the supervisor confirms that all items have been processed.

Go to the irrigation control center and pick up a crate containing assorted irrigation valves. Drive to the east vineyard and deliver half of the valves to the field technician stationed at the red utility tent. Wait for 10 minutes while the technician installs some of the valves. Afterwards, proceed with the remaining valves to the equipment bay near the windmill and leave the crate on the supply shelf labeled 'Field Parts.' Once the crate is placed, wait until the equipment manager inspects the delivery and provides verbal confirmation before returning to the irrigation control center.

Proceed to the north orchard tool depot and collect a crate of pruning shears and three bundles of sapling stakes. Deliver the pruning shears to the southern orchard entrance and wait for the field crew to unload them. Next, take the sapling stakes to the reforestation plot by the western fence. Stand by for 10 minutes while the planting team retrieves the stakes, then return to the tool depot for your next assignment.

Begin at the supply garage and load three spools of electrical cable and a pallet of solar panel mounts onto the robot. Drive to the west solar installation site and deliver the pallet of mounts to the assembly crew. Wait until all mounts are unloaded. With the cable still on board, continue to the maintenance workshop near the central barn and transfer the spools to the technicians waiting there. Once the delivery is complete, proceed to the parking bay near the orchard and remain there for 12 minutes before returning to the supply garage.

Go to the central greenhouse supply room and pick up four trays of tomato seedlings and two sacks of organic fertilizer. Deliver the tomato seedlings to the south field seedling bed and wait until the greenhouse staff unload them from the robot. Afterwards, take the sacks of fertilizer to the compost mixing station near the west irrigation canal. Wait for 5 minutes while the farm crew collects the fertilizer, then return to the central greenhouse supply room for further orders.

Start at the north gate of the manufacturing yard and drive to the pallet storage area behind the assembly line. Pick up four empty wooden pallets and two sealed boxes of machine parts. Deliver the pallets to the packaging tent adjacent to the main shipping zone and wait until the staff have unloaded all pallets from the robot. Then, transport the two boxes of machine parts to the Mechanical Workshop. Wait for five minutes to allow the technicians to receive and check the parts. After confirmation, proceed to the central control office and await further instructions from the operations manager.

Start at the chemical storage facility and load two large containers of fertilizer and one crate of pest control units onto the robot. Transport the pest control units to the south vineyard's equipment shed and wait until they are removed by the vineyard staff. Then, proceed with the fertilizer containers to the irrigation control station at the north orchard and deliver them to the agricultural supervisor. Wait for 8 minutes for approval of the delivery. Once approval is received, head to the equipment washdown area near the machinery depot and remain there until a technician removes any remaining equipment from the robot. Upon completion, return to the chemical storage facility.

Begin by traveling to the irrigation control station and picking up four sealed water sampling canisters. Deliver one canister each to the North Field pond, the Central Orchard reservoir, and the Greenhouse water inlet. At each drop-off location, wait for the local quality inspector to verify receipt of the canister before proceeding. After the last delivery, return to the irrigation control station with any leftover canisters and report completion to the station supervisor.

Start at the machinery garage and pick up two boxes of replacement hydraulic hoses from the equipment shelf. Travel to the west vineyard maintenance shed and deliver one box of hoses. Wait for a technician to inspect and retrieve the box before proceeding. Next, head to the southern tractor depot, deliver the second box of hoses, and wait for 10 minutes to be loaded with any used hoses returned for recycling. Once loaded, transport the used hoses to the hazardous materials collection point outside the maintenance yard, waiting until all items have been transferred to the collection bin before returning to the machinery garage.

Begin at the north barn loading dock and collect four sacks of animal feed. Drive the robot to Pasture Gate 3 and deliver two sacks to the livestock feed station beside the east fence. Then, proceed with the remaining sacks to the poultry enclosure near the western irrigation canal. Wait for farm staff to unload both sacks. After the payload is removed, continue to the pump house just south of the enclosure and retrieve any used water filters that are ready for collection. Transport all collected filters to the maintenance recycling facility behind the repair garage, and after delivery, wait for 12 minutes in case further items are added for recycling. Conclude by returning to the north barn loading dock.

Proceed to the machinery storage garage and collect three spare hydraulic pumps. Deliver one pump each to the east orchard repair station, the northern fence maintenance site, and the west equipment depot. Once all pumps have been delivered, drive to the central vehicle washing bay and wait until your platform has been fully cleaned and dried before returning to the machinery storage garage.

Begin at the packaging facility and pick up three crates of freshly harvested tomatoes. Drive to the farm market stall and deliver one crate. Wait until the market attendant unloads the crate and provides confirmation. Next, proceed to the produce storage cellar, deliver the remaining two crates, and wait for 5 minutes while the storage staff inspect and organize the delivery. After confirmation, return to the packaging facility.

Start at the maintenance garage and pick up a toolbox containing diagnostic instruments. Proceed to the north field equipment hub and deliver the toolbox to the tractor maintenance crew. Wait until the crew unloads the toolbox and visually confirms receipt. Then, drive to the solar panel array near the reservoir, pick up two empty battery crates, and transport them to the battery charging station behind the operations shed. Leave the empty crates in the designated recharge area and return to the maintenance garage.

Start at the equipment charging bay beside the west greenhouse. Pick up one large sealed box of irrigation sensors from the charging bay. Navigate to the southern orchard storage shed and collect three empty fertilizer containers waiting by the door. Next, deliver the sealed box of sensors to the central orchard weather station and wait for the technicians to unload the box. Proceed to the composting area near the east fence and drop off the empty fertilizer containers. Stand by for 10 minutes to allow on-site staff to inspect and log the containers, then return to the equipment charging bay for recharging.

Begin at the Materials Supply Depot and load two crates of replacement solar panels onto the robot. Travel to the north field charging station and deliver one crate of solar panels. Wait for 10 minutes while technicians install the panels and remove the crate. Next, proceed to the west boundary observation post and deliver the remaining crate of solar panels. Once the post supervisor confirms receipt and the crate is offloaded, drive to the Maintenance Control Office and await further instructions.

Start at the field workshop behind the eastern barn. Collect two toolkits and one box of replacement drone batteries. Travel to the north pasture gate and deliver the toolkits to the maintenance crew waiting onsite. Wait until both toolkits are removed from your payload area. Continue to the drone landing area near the irrigation pond and drop off the box of batteries for the drone operators. After delivery, proceed to the seedling nursery on the south side of the main greenhouse and wait for 15 minutes in case additional materials need to be loaded for afternoon deliveries.

Begin at the central supply depot next to the equipment storage barn. Load three sacks of fertilizer and one irrigation filter cart onto your payload area. Make your way to the west orchard entrance where the farm staff is waiting. Deliver two sacks of fertilizer to the staff and wait until both sacks are removed. Proceed to the greenhouse loading bay and drop off the irrigation filter cart for the technician team. Then, transport the remaining sack of fertilizer to the compost station near the old mill. After depositing the last sack in the storage bin, remain at the compost station for 10 minutes before returning to the central supply depot.

Start at the workshop annex behind the main factory building. Load one sealed container of precision bearings and two boxes of replacement hydraulic hoses onto your cargo bay. Drive to the southern assembly line entrance and deliver the container of precision bearings. Wait until assembly staff unload the container and confirm receipt. Next, bring the two boxes of hydraulic hoses to the east-side maintenance pit. Wait for 5 minutes as technicians inspect the contents and remove both boxes. After all deliveries are complete, proceed to the shaded parking area near the cafeteria and wait there for further deployment orders.

Start at the equipment storage shed and pick up three bags of fertilizer. Drive to the South Orchard compost area and deliver one bag, waiting for the groundskeeper to unload it. Then continue to the Vineyard edge and deliver the second bag to the vineyard supervisor. Transport the final bag to the Crop Research Plot, wait for 10 minutes while the bag is unloaded and inspected, then return to the equipment storage shed for the next task.

Start at the central workshop and collect three containers of lubricating oil. Deliver one container to the eastern tractor depot and wait 15 minutes for the maintenance crew to refill the tractors. Next, bring the second container to the main greenhouse storage room and wait until the greenhouse manager takes it off the robot. Finally, deliver the last container to the compost processing shed. After making all deliveries, return to the central workshop and await further tasks.

Start at the Central Packing House and pick up a pallet containing mixed cartons of oranges and lemons. Navigate to the Orchard North Gate and wait for the produce inspector to check the paperwork; this may take up to 8 minutes. Once cleared, proceed to the Farmers' Market Delivery Zone, and deliver all cartons to Stall 3. After the payload is unloaded, head to the Equipment Garage and stand by for 5 minutes to allow the loading crew to place two empty transport crates onto the robot for return. Return the empty crates to the Central Packing House.

Begin at the workshop garage and collect three canisters of biodegradable lubricant. Proceed to the wind turbine service pad and deliver one canister to the maintenance engineer. Wait until you receive a visual confirmation of acceptance. Next, drive to the greenhouse corridor, and deposit the remaining two canisters in the marked supply bay. After unloading, wait for 12 minutes before returning to the garage.

Start at the machinery storage depot and pick up two containers of engine lubricants. Transport both containers to the tractor maintenance zone, and wait until the maintenance staff have removed the lubricants. Proceed immediately to the northwest equipment yard to collect a pallet of replacement seed drills. Deliver the entire pallet to the planting operations office, then wait for 10 minutes to allow staff to inspect and unload the pallet. Once unloading is confirmed, return directly to the machinery storage depot.

Travel to the machinery maintenance bay and pick up one container of hydraulic fluid and a toolkit labeled 'M-3'. Proceed to the loading dock at the north storage warehouse and collect three empty produce crates. Deliver the hydraulic fluid and toolkit to the maintenance supervisor at the combine harvester near the west field, and stay for up to 8 minutes while the maintenance team unloads the items. Next, bring the empty crates to packing station 3 inside the sorting facility and wait for packers to fill them with harvested cucumbers. Once loaded, transport the filled crates to the farm market entrance and wait until the market manager has inspected and removed them from your platform before returning to the machinery maintenance bay for end-of-task check-in.

Begin at the maintenance garage and collect the toolbox and three replacement air filters. Transport the toolbox to the grain silo's control room and wait until a technician retrieves it. Next, proceed to the greenhouse annex and deliver the air filters to the climate control station. Wait for 5 minutes while greenhouse staff inspect the filters. After the inspection, pick up any faulty air filters that have been set aside for disposal and carry them to the waste collection facility near the compost yard. Return to the maintenance garage once the task is complete.

Begin at the packaging shed beside the western storage silos. Pick up three sealed crates of harvested strawberries. Drive to the farmers’ market loading zone at the north entrance and wait until a market coordinator approaches and unloads all three crates. Once the crates have been removed, proceed to the composting lot at the southwest corner and collect one empty compost bin. Return the empty compost bin to the green waste collection area at the rear of the central barn. After drop-off, wait for 10 minutes in case additional compost bins need retrieval.

Start at the vineyard garage and collect a pallet containing six water purification filters. Proceed to Irrigation Hub West and unload four filters. Wait for the irrigation technician to inspect and install the filters, which may take up to 15 minutes. Once installation is confirmed, deliver the remaining two filters to Pump Station 3, located beside the southern reservoir. Wait until the on-site engineer receives the filters, then return to the vineyard garage and stand by for further instructions.

Start at the storage shed near the vineyard and pick up three empty fertilizer containers. Drive to the central greenhouse and wait for 8 minutes for staff to load six trays of seedlings onto the robot. Once loaded, deliver two fertilizer containers and all six trays of seedlings to the demonstration plot at the eastern field. After staff unload the trays, proceed to the compost site with the remaining fertilizer container and deliver it there. Finalize the route by returning to the storage shed near the vineyard.

Begin at the north orchard entrance. Pick up three crates of freshly harvested apples and a bag of pruning shears from the orchard supply shed. Travel to the main sorting facility near the barn and deliver the crates of apples. Wait until all crates are removed by sorting staff and a quality inspection is performed. Next, take the bag of pruning shears to the west-side tool depot. Wait for 10 minutes while tool managers check the inventory and unload the bag. Once tasks are finished, return to the service station behind the equipment garage for system checkup and recharging.

Begin at the equipment storage shed near the cornfield. Pick up four containers of organic pesticide. Drive to Greenhouse 2 on the eastern edge of the property and deliver two containers, waiting while the greenhouse manager unloads them. Next, proceed to Orchard Block D and drop off the remaining two containers by the central tool station. Wait for 10 minutes to ensure the delivery is recorded, then continue to the maintenance shack at the farm's north entrance and stand by for further loading tasks.

Travel to the crop harvesting zone on the south field and pick up four crates of freshly harvested strawberries. Navigate to the refrigerated loading platform beside the farmhouse and deliver all four crates to the temperature-controlled storage unit. After delivery, wait for 15 minutes to allow the quality control team to inspect the crates. Once inspection is complete, proceed to the tool supply shed near the irrigation pond, collect a toolbox marked 'urgent repairs', and deliver it to the grape vine maintenance area behind the barn. After the toolbox has been collected by a technician, return to the crop harvesting zone for further assignments.

Begin at the greenhouse storage area and pick up two boxes of tomato seedlings labeled 'Spring Early'. Travel to planting zone B in the east field and deliver the boxes to the planting supervisor. Stay for up to 5 minutes to allow the planting crew to empty both boxes. Afterwards, proceed to the irrigation shed, collect one set of hose connectors, and deliver them to maintenance technician Valero by the main water pump near the windmill. Remain on standby for 10 minutes while the technician completes system checks before heading back to the greenhouse storage area for the next assignment.

Drive to the equipment depot located at the north entrance of the facility and collect three spare hydraulic hoses. Transport these hoses to the packing machine area inside the main warehouse. Wait until the maintenance crew has unloaded all three hoses. Next, proceed to the fertilizer storage yard adjacent to the greenhouse and pick up two 50-liter bags of organic fertilizer. Deliver these bags to the compost preparation zone near the eastern orchard. After dropping off the fertilizer, stand by for 10 minutes in case additional material needs to be transported. Once the wait is over, return to the equipment depot and await further instructions.

Travel to the spare parts storage depot near the wind turbine array and collect three replacement gearboxes. Deliver the first gearbox to Maintenance Station Alpha, located at the far end of the gravel service road. After unloading the first gearbox, proceed to the Pump House by the irrigation reservoir to offload the second gearbox. For the final delivery, head to the Emergency Backup Generator facility next to the access gate and hand over the last gearbox to the on-site engineer. Once all deliveries are complete, return to the spare parts storage depot and wait for 10 minutes for further assignment.

Start at the packing shed and pick up four crates of freshly harvested tomatoes. Deliver two crates to the farmers' market loading area and wait until the delivery supervisor confirms receipt. Transport the remaining two crates to the cold storage facility in the western lot. After the crates are offloaded, proceed to the tool depot. Wait at the tool depot for 10 minutes to be equipped with a new set of pruning shears. Return to the packing shed and stand by for the next assignment.

Begin at the harvesting crate drop-off zone beside the apple orchard. Pick up four crates of freshly picked apples and a spare irrigation valve. Proceed to the farm’s north entrance where the produce truck is parked and deliver all four apple crates to the awaiting driver. Wait for 10 minutes while farm workers load a pallet of empty crates onto the robot. Next, drive to the irrigation control station near the southern vegetable beds and deliver the spare irrigation valve to the maintenance supervisor. Finally, return to the apple orchard drop-off zone and deposit the pallet of empty crates for reuse by the harvesting crew.

Start at the maintenance shed beside the fuel storage tanks. Collect four empty chemical barrels and secure them to your payload area. Travel to the pesticide mixing station located beyond the northern boundary fence. Upon arrival, wait until station workers refill all barrels with diluted pesticide solution. Once loaded, deliver two filled barrels to the orchard distribution point and offload them. Proceed to the hillside vineyard station with the remaining two barrels and wait for 8 minutes while staff inspect and unload both. Finally, return to the maintenance shed and park near the charging outlet.

Start at the greenhouse loading bay and pick up a pallet of seedling trays. Drive to the irrigation control station and wait for 10 minutes while technicians load sensor equipment onto the robot. Once the equipment is loaded, proceed to Field Plot C, deliver the seedling trays, and wait until a crew member confirms unloading. After the delivery, return to the greenhouse loading bay for the next assignment.

Go to the equipment storage area near the eastern tool shed and pick up two bags of fertilizer. Transport the bags to the irrigation control station beside the southern greenhouse. Wait until the on-site technician unloads both bags. Once unloaded, proceed to the supply depot at the northern boundary and pick up a replacement irrigation valve. Deliver the valve to the maintenance hatch at Pond #2, and wait for 5 minutes for the valve to be retrieved by maintenance personnel before returning to your starting location.

Begin at the Maintenance Workshop and pick up a sealed container of hydraulic fluid. Drive to the Windmill Field Control Station and deliver the container. Wait for the site supervisor to check and remove the container—this process may take around 7 minutes. Then, travel to the Tool Exchange Depot, where the crew will load three used wrenches onto the robot. Wait until all wrenches have been loaded, then return them to the Maintenance Workshop for inventory.

Head to the maintenance workshop in the southwest yard and collect two replacement hydraulic pumps and a box of assorted bolts. Deliver the box of bolts to the assembly line entrance in the main factory. Wait for a supervisor to confirm receipt of the bolts. Next, transport both hydraulic pumps to the forestry equipment bay by the eastern forest entrance. Wait for the repair crew to unload the pumps, then return directly to the southwest yard maintenance workshop to await further instructions.

Go to the equipment yard beside the machine workshop and retrieve three spare tractor tires. Deliver the tires to the maintenance bay near the southern barn and wait until a technician removes them from the robot. Once unloaded, proceed to the irrigation pump station and collect a sealed canister of engine oil. Bring the canister to the fuel storage area at the east end of the property and wait for 7 minutes to allow the fuel manager to inspect the delivery. After inspection, return to the equipment yard for the next pickup.

Start at the equipment garage. Travel to the solar panel array at the east field’s edge and pick up four maintenance toolkits and two boxes of replacement solar cells. Head to the maintenance hub near the central wind turbines, delivering two toolkits and one box of solar cells. Wait until the maintenance crew finishes unloading, then continue to the hilltop power relay station to deliver the remaining toolkits and solar cells. After delivery, stand by for 15 minutes for any urgent repair requests, then proceed back to the equipment garage and await further instructions.

Begin at the central warehouse and pick up three crates of fertilizer. Drive to the eastern orchard and deliver one crate to the storage shed beside the apple grove. Continue to the berry field equipment station and drop off the second crate. Next, proceed to the farm supply office and hand over the final crate of fertilizer. Wait at the supply office for 5 minutes in case additional items need to be transported. After the waiting period, proceed to the vehicle charging station and stand by for further tasks.

Start at the main workshop beside the livestock barn and collect three replacement motor units. Navigate to the irrigation pump station near the southeast pond and drop off one motor unit for repairs. Continue to the solar panel array south of the hayfields and unload the other two motor units at the technician's workstation. Wait there for 15 minutes while the panel maintenance crew inspects the repairs, then proceed to the orchard supply cabin and await further pickup instructions from the onsite coordinator.

Start at the greenhouse loading platform and pick up two seedling trays, one bag of potting soil, and a set of pruning shears. Drive to the vineyard’s central tool depot and deliver the pruning shears to the gardening crew. Proceed to the western hillside planting plots, unload the seedling trays and potting soil, and wait for 7 minutes while the planting team inspects the supplies. Once cleared, return to the greenhouse loading platform and await further instructions.

Begin at the storage barn near the north field and load three sacks of livestock feed onto your platform. Head to the open grazing paddock and deliver two sacks to the feed troughs beside the main shelter. Wait by the paddock gate for 10 minutes while the farmhands distribute the feed. After the wait, take the remaining sack to the poultry coop located at the west end of the farm and place it next to the supply bins. Once delivery is complete, proceed to the equipment wash bay behind the machinery garage and await cleaning procedures.

Start at the workshop adjacent to the central barn and pick up a crate of replacement tractor parts. Drive along the eastern perimeter road to the equipment storage yard. Deliver the crate of tractor parts to the supply manager stationed there. Next, proceed to the farm's irrigation control center along the main southern lane and collect a box of irrigation valves. Bring these valves directly to the vegetable field's tool drop-off point located near plot 5B. After delivering the box of valves, wait for 6 minutes in case farm staff require assistance with additional deliveries. Upon completion, return to the workshop and park in the tool maintenance area.

Proceed to the equipment storage shed near the north entrance and collect a bag of soil sensors and a thermal camera unit. Travel to the blueberry patch adjacent to the windbreak trees and deliver the soil sensors to the field technician stationed there. Wait for 10 minutes for the technician to install and calibrate the sensors. Then, continue to the eastern greenhouse next to the compost area and supply the thermal camera unit to the monitoring team. After unloading, return to the equipment storage shed and stand by for the next assignment.

Begin at the fruit packing shed and load five crates of freshly harvested peaches onto the robot. Proceed to the refrigerated storage warehouse located beside the main access road. Unload all five crates of peaches for the warehouse staff. Then, continue to the equipment charging alcove behind the greenhouse complex and wait there for 20 minutes to allow for any required battery maintenance. Following the wait, return to the fruit packing shed for your next assignment.

Start at the nursery loading bay and pick up five trays of young tomato plants. Transport the trays to Plot 7A in the east cultivation field. Wait for the planting crew to remove all trays from the robot. Once unloaded, proceed to the supply depot behind the irrigation pumps and collect two bags of organic fertilizer. Deliver the fertilizer bags to the composting area next to the farm's storage barn and wait for 10 minutes to be unloaded. Return to the nursery loading bay when the task is complete.

Begin at the orchard gate and collect two bins of harvested apples. Deliver the first bin to the produce sorting station inside Warehouse 2 and place it on the designated platform. Proceed to the farm manager's office, located near the north parking lot, and drop off the second bin at the rear entrance for quality inspection. Wait for 15 minutes near the office to obtain confirmation from the manager. Once confirmed, navigate to the composting area behind Greenhouse 3 and pick up an empty crate. Transport the empty crate back to the orchard gate and leave it at the collection spot for the harvest crew before standing by for further tasks.

Start at the maintenance garage and load four sealed coolant canisters onto your cargo tray. Proceed to the solar panel array at the southern ridge and deliver two canisters to the storage shed adjacent to the control cabin. Remain at the array for 8 minutes while technicians refill the coolant in the panel circuits. After the waiting period, transport the remaining two canisters to the wind turbine station by the river and place them in the marked supply cage. Finally, return to the maintenance garage and await further assignment.

Start at the Storage Barn and collect six empty harvest baskets. Proceed to the North Orchard Entrance and deliver three of the baskets to the field crew waiting there. Wait up to 10 minutes until the crew confirms receipt of the baskets. Then, drive to the Apple Grove on the east side and provide the remaining three baskets to the picking team. Once all baskets have been delivered and acknowledged, return to the Storage Barn for your next assignment.

Begin at the North Field Depot and collect four crates of freshly harvested carrots. Transport the crates to the Produce Grading Station near the main barn. Place the crates onto the designated unloading platform and wait for 7 minutes while quality control checks are performed. Once the inspection is completed and the crates are cleared by staff, proceed to the Workshop Annex and retrieve two replacement hydraulic hoses. Deliver these hoses to the Tractor Maintenance Bay, then return to the North Field Depot to await further instructions.

Begin at the maintenance shed and pick up three replacement hydraulic hoses and a case of lubricant. Drive to the west orchard machinery station and deliver the replacement hoses to the repair crew. Wait until the crew has unloaded all hoses. Next, proceed to the field equipment locker by the north fence and collect a toolbox. Bring the toolbox to the automated irrigation control center located near the main reservoir. Wait for 7 minutes while the technicians complete their inspection, then return the empty toolbox to the field equipment locker. Finish by heading back to the maintenance shed and await further orders.

Start at the central warehouse and load two sealed chemical drums onto the robot. Drive to the irrigation control station next to the east orchard. Deliver one chemical drum to the station and wait for 15 minutes while the technician connects the drum to the nutrient mixer. Afterward, proceed to the greenhouse entrance at the southern end of the property and deliver the remaining chemical drum. Remain at the greenhouse until the crew finishes unloading, then return to the central warehouse for further instructions.

Depart from the logistics tent in the southwestern corner of the field and travel to the harvest zone near Orchard Block C. Load three crates of freshly picked pears onto the robot. Take the crates to the produce quality inspection station next to the main barn. Wait for the inspector to examine and unload all three crates. Once unloading is completed, proceed to the maintenance cart parked by the central machinery shed. Pick up one container of lubricating oil and deliver it to the windmill control room at Hilltop Station. Upon delivery, wait for 10 minutes for the maintenance crew to use the oil before heading back to the logistics tent.

Begin at the central machinery garage and collect a set of diagnostic tools and three rechargeable battery packs. Navigate to the irrigation control hub and deliver one battery pack to the maintenance technician. Continue to the eastern field’s monitoring station to deliver the diagnostic tools and the remaining two battery packs. Once all items have been delivered, remain on standby at the monitoring station for 12 minutes to assist with any urgent equipment needs before returning to the central machinery garage.

Start at the Orchard Equipment Shed and pick up three containers of biodynamic fertilizer. Proceed to the Vineyard East Entrance and deliver one container to the soil amendment zone, waiting for the vineyard manager to confirm proper placement. Continue with the remaining two containers to the South Orchard Block, distributing one to the compost preparation station and the other to the tree nursery near the irrigation tanks. After all deliveries are completed, drive to the Solar Charging Pad adjacent to the farm office and wait for 20 minutes or until your battery is fully charged before resuming standard patrol duties.

Begin at the fruit packing shed and pick up three crates of ripe peaches from the cooling rack. Travel to the north orchard sorting area and deliver two crates to the inspection table, waiting until a worker has finished unloading both crates. Proceed to the farm market stand at the main entrance and deliver the remaining crate of peaches. Wait for 5 minutes for the display shelves to be restocked before returning to the fruit packing shed to receive the next assignment.

Start at the equipment storage barn and collect two containers of engine oil and four spark plug kits. Deliver the engine oil to the tractor fueling station beside the south field and wait until the station attendant has finished unloading both containers. Then, drive to the machinery shed near the irrigation canal to drop off the spark plug kits at the central repair bench. Wait for 10 minutes while mechanics check inventory and confirm receipt. After confirmation, pick up any empty oil drums left at the machinery shed and bring them to the recycling depot by the eastern boundary. Upon completion, return to the equipment storage barn.

Begin at the Maintenance Workshop and collect a single heavy-duty tool crate. Navigate to the North Grapevine Trellis and deliver the tool crate to the ground crew leader. Wait until all essential tools are removed from the crate, then travel to the Storage Barn East Entrance. Pick up four irrigation hose spools and transport them to the Central Field Pumping Station. After all hose spools are unloaded by the pumping technician, proceed to the Weather Shelter for a scheduled 10-minute standby before heading back to the Maintenance Workshop to complete the route.

Begin at the central depot and load three containers of organic pesticides. Drive to Orchard Zone B and deliver one container to the equipment tent near the apple trees. Next, proceed to the berry patch and drop off the second container inside the small storage hut. Wait at the berry patch for 6 minutes to allow the field supervisor to inspect the area. Afterward, transport the final pesticide container to the greenhouse and place it on the designated shelf near the entrance. Once the deliveries are complete, return to the central depot and wait until additional supplies are placed onto your cargo tray.

Begin at the western orchard loading dock and collect three crates of ripe pears marked 'Premium Harvest'. Deliver these crates to the fruit processing facility's receiving bay and wait for the quality inspector to approve the delivery. Once approval is granted, proceed to the tool supply hut just north of the compost yard. Retrieve a portable pruning kit and bring it to horticulturist Lena at row 12 of the southern orchard block. Remain with Lena for up to 7 minutes to assist her in transferring the kit to her field cart. Afterwards, return directly to the loading dock at the western orchard for your next assignment.

Proceed to the South Orchard Loading Zone and pick up three boxes of freshly harvested apples. Transport the apple boxes to the Juice Press Facility and wait for the press operator to unload all cargo. Once unloaded, move to the Riverbank Fuel Depot. There, pick up one sealed diesel canister and deliver it to the Tractor Garage. Wait for a mechanic to remove the canister from the platform, then continue to the Shade Pavilion for a 20-minute charging break before returning to the South Orchard Loading Zone.

Begin at the supply depot beside the irrigation control center. Travel to Greenhouse 4 on the eastern side of the farm. Pick up two bins of heirloom tomato seedlings. Deliver both bins to the northern planting area near the old windbreak trees. Wait at the planting area for twenty minutes while field workers unload the bins and distribute the seedlings. After confirming the bins are empty and loaded back onto the robot, proceed to the chemical storage shed and drop off the empty bins. Once delivered, await notification for your next assignment.

Start by traveling to the Equipment Cleaning Bay situated beside the greenhouse complex. Collect two empty fertilizer carts from the bay. Deliver the first cart to the East Field Fertilization Point and wait for 5 minutes while the crew fills it with fresh fertilizer granules. After the cart is loaded, proceed to the North Pasture Feed Storage and drop off the second empty cart near the entrance. Once both deliveries are complete, drive to the Central Control Tent, pick up a package of soil sensors, and bring them to the Irrigation Valve Cluster at the field's southeast corner. Wait until an agronomist retrieves the sensor package from the platform, then return to the Equipment Cleaning Bay for further instructions.

Start at the central maintenance garage on the west side of the facility. Collect one large toolbox and three spare hydraulic hoses. Drive to the field equipment repair site near the edge of the south barley plot. Wait at the repair site for 15 minutes for technicians to unload the tools and hoses. Once unloaded, retrieve any damaged parts placed onto the robot (up to four items). Return to the maintenance garage and deposit all retrieved damaged parts at the designated repair bench. Await further loading instructions after the drop-off.

Begin at the Main Workshop adjacent to the machinery garage and pick up two replacement hydraulic pumps and a toolbox containing specialty wrenches. Drive to the South Field Irrigation Station, located past the row of solar panels, and deliver the toolbox to the maintenance supervisor waiting onsite. Wait until the supervisor unloads the toolbox and gives approval to proceed. Next, travel to the Tractor Depot near the southwest boundary fence and supply the two hydraulic pumps to the mechanic crew. Once the pumps have been transferred, remain at the depot for 15 minutes in case additional parts are requested, then return to the Main Workshop and power down until further instructions are received.

Start at the maintenance garage and collect two sealed containers of engine oil from the supply rack. Drive to the tractor fleet area near the north barn and deliver one container to the mechanic beside the red tractor for immediate use. Continue to the irrigation control station along the western fence line and drop off the remaining container at the designated bench. Before leaving, wait at the control station for 10 minutes to stand by in case additional parts deliveries are requested. Once the waiting period concludes, proceed to the operations office located at the central courtyard and await further instructions.

Begin at the warehouse receiving area beside the main access road. Pick up three crates of packaged lettuce and two sealed boxes of irrigation sensors. Drive to the southeastern produce cooling shed and deliver all three crates of lettuce at the intake platform. After unloading the lettuce, proceed with the boxes of irrigation sensors to the equipment staging zone behind the greenhouse complex. Wait for 10 minutes for the site manager to inspect and accept the sensor boxes. Once inspection is complete, return to the warehouse receiving area and stand by for the next assignment.

Begin at Storage Shed B and collect a bundle of irrigation hoses and three water flow sensors from the shelving unit. Drive to the east orchard edge, stopping at the new sapling row. Deliver the irrigation hoses to the team lead on site, then wait until all three flow sensors are removed from the robot by the technicians. Stand by for 20 minutes to assist with additional supply runs if requested. Once released by the team lead, proceed back to Storage Shed B and dock at the charging station.

Start at the fueling station near the west gate. Pick up a pair of diesel canisters and one emergency generator. Drive to the field operations outpost located at the northern edge of the sunflower plot. Unload the emergency generator at the designated equipment pad, then deliver both diesel canisters to the refueling area behind the outpost. Wait for 7 minutes while the site crew checks and signs off on the deliveries. After the wait, proceed to the main office courtyard and await new instructions.

Start at the maintenance garage and pick up two containers of biodegradable lubricant and a toolkit from the workbench. Travel to the north wind turbine array and deliver one container of lubricant to the onsite technician near turbine #3. Wait for 15 minutes while the technician services the turbine. Next, proceed with the remaining container and toolkit to the central equipment depot. Wait at the unloading bay until the depot supervisor retrieves both the container and toolkit, then receive visual confirmation before returning to the maintenance garage.

Start at the Seed Storage Barn next to the east gate and collect four bags of certified wheat seeds along with a box of seed markers. Navigate to the Remote Planting Plot on the far northern edge of the property, passing through the irrigation channel crossing. At the plot, deliver the seed markers to the agronomy assistant and wait until they have unloaded the box. Next, dispense the four bags of seeds into the storage container marked ‘Plot 12’. Remain at the planting plot for 5 minutes to allow for seed inspection, then travel to the Solar Charging Station near the nursery greenhouse and initiate recharging procedures.

Start at the Maintenance Garage adjacent to the main workshop. Pick up two replacement battery units and a crate containing assorted hand tools. Proceed to the Field Machinery Shed located beside the western soy fields. Deliver the battery units to the machinery technician stationed by the combine harvester, and wait until both batteries have been unloaded. Next, transport the crate of hand tools to the Repair Tent at the southern boundary of the fields and place it inside next to the spare parts shelf. Remain at the Repair Tent for 8 minutes to assist with equipment restocking. When finished, return to the Maintenance Garage and stand by for further instructions.

Begin at the orchard packing shed and collect four empty wooden apple crates from the western stack. Transport two crates to the South Orchard Harvest Site and wait for 10 minutes while harvesters load them with freshly picked apples. Once loaded, deliver these crates to the Cold Storage Facility's receiving dock. Then, return to the packing shed, retrieve the remaining two crates, and bring them to the Juice Processing Unit adjacent to the water tower. Wait at the processing unit until all crates have been unloaded, then proceed to the outdoor charging station near the equipment barn and dock for recharging.

Start at the materials storage yard and pick up two sacks of fertilizer and a set of soil testing kits. Proceed to the Greenhouse entrance and deliver the soil testing kits to the horticulture supervisor. Continue to the North Pasture’s feed station and drop off both sacks of fertilizer. Pause at the feed station for 8 minutes to await further instructions or emergency transport requests. When the waiting period is over, return to the materials storage yard and check in for your next task.

Begin at the machine workshop and pick up a replacement hydraulic pump and three cans of lubricating oil. Drive to the field maintenance shed, located beside Irrigation Channel B, and deliver the hydraulic pump to the maintenance technician waiting at the entrance. Proceed to the grain silo complex, enter through the main gate, and drop off the three cans of lubricating oil at Storage Bay 1. Wait at Storage Bay 1 for 12 minutes in case there are any urgent requests for spare parts delivery. After waiting, return to the machine workshop and park at the designated robot recharge station, standing by for your next assignment.

Start at the harvest barn next to the eastern orchard. Collect two crates of freshly picked apples and a box of orchard maintenance tools. Drive to the packaging pavilion at the southern edge of the farm estate. Deliver the crates of apples to Sorting Table 3 inside the pavilion. Wait at the pavilion for the packaging crew to place prepared boxes of packaged apples—this may take up to 10 minutes. Once loaded with the packaged apple boxes, transport them to the farm market stall by the roadside entrance. Unload the boxes of packaged apples at the market stall, then proceed to the parking shelter behind the workshop and wait there for further instructions.

Begin at the Seed Storage Facility located north of the equipment depot. Pick up a pallet containing five bags of wheat seed and a sealed container marked 'Crop Treatment Solution.' Travel to the South Field Entrance adjacent to the irrigation channel. At the entrance, deliver the pallet of wheat seed to the planting supervisor and wait until all bags have been unloaded. Carry the container of crop treatment solution to the Field Application Station located at the northeast corner of the rice paddies. Wait for the field crew to unload the container, which may take up to 6 minutes. After all deliveries are complete, proceed to the shaded rest area beside the greenhouse complex and remain there for 12 minutes before awaiting further assignment.

Start at the parts storage bay adjacent to the main garage. Pick up two crates of metal fencing posts and one spool of electrical wire. Drive to the south pasture entrance, stopping at Gate 3. Deliver the crates of fencing posts to the repair team stationed at the gate and wait until the team has finished unloading both crates. Next, take the spool of electrical wire to the solar panel array control hut located at the east edge of the property. Wait for 8 minutes while the maintenance staff install the wire, then return to the parts storage bay to await your next task.

Proceed to the vineyard equipment shed and collect four empty grape harvesting bins. Deliver two bins each to the north and south ends of Vine Row 12. Wait for 15 minutes as the vineyard crew fills the bins with harvested grapes. Once the bins are full, pick them up and transport all four full bins to the cold storage facility near the western access road. After unloading, travel to the main tool storage area next to the field engineer’s cabin, and pick up one spare irrigation valve. Bring the valve to the pump control station near the central reservoir, deliver it to the maintenance platform, and return to the vineyard equipment shed after the task is complete.

Begin at the Central Workshop and pick up two cases of replacement drone batteries and a spool of electrical wiring. Proceed to the Drone Launch Pad on the southern field and deliver one case of batteries. Remain for 8 minutes while aerial technicians perform the battery swap and confirm delivery. Afterwards, head to the Solar Maintenance Hub and deliver the second case of batteries along with the spool of electrical wiring. Wait until the maintenance team has unloaded both items, then make your way to the Refueling Bay next to the grain silos and stand by there for further instructions.

Begin at the Maintenance Workshop and retrieve a toolbox along with two spare hydraulic hoses. Travel to the Windmill Field's southeast access point. Wait for 7 minutes as the repair crew removes the faulty hoses and replaces them using the delivered spares. After the repair crew is finished, pick up the old (used) hoses and return them to the Maintenance Workshop for disposal. Once unloaded, proceed to the South Storage Bunker and stand by until further instructions are received.

Start at the central supply depot near the western storage barn. Retrieve two rolls of protective netting. Deliver the netting to the berry patch entrance, and wait for the field supervisor to inspect and approve the delivery. After approval, proceed to the packaging station beside the loading ramp and collect any empty produce crates. Return the empty crates to the recycling corner adjacent to the equipment garage.

Start in the maintenance yard adjacent to the fueling station. Collect a box of replacement bearings and two coiled hoses from the maintenance staff. Proceed to the eastern pivot field where the irrigation unit is stationed. Deliver the coiled hoses to the irrigation technician and wait until both hoses are unloaded. Next, transport the box of replacement bearings to the machine workshop adjacent to the grain silo. After delivering the bearings to the workshop supervisor, navigate to the storage area behind the greenhouse complex. Remain there for 8 minutes to provide standby support while additional equipment is loaded onto your payload platform.

Begin at the main storage hangar and collect four replacement sprinkler heads and a maintenance toolkit. Travel to the eastern irrigation control station and deliver the toolkit to the maintenance supervisor. Next, proceed to the north orchard equipment bay to pick up two spare drive belts. Bring the drive belts and the replacement sprinkler heads to the central orchard maintenance shed. Wait for 10 minutes while the engineering team installs the components. Once the team has finished unloading and signals that installation is complete, return to the main storage hangar and await further assignment.

Start at the maintenance room inside the main fabrication building and pick up a box of replacement air filters. Navigate to the greenhouse complex and deliver the air filters to the east-wing control station. Wait for technicians to unload the box and signal that the filters have been received. Following the delivery, proceed to the fuel storage shed on the southern perimeter to await your next assignment.

Begin at the orchard’s south entrance and navigate to the apple collection zone near the irrigation canal. Load three baskets of freshly picked apples and one sack of pruning shears onto the robot. Proceed to the fruit grading pavilion on the east side of the market lot. Deliver all apple baskets to the grading staff and wait until all baskets have been emptied from the robot. Then, take the pruning shears to the maintenance shed behind the barn. Wait for 10 minutes while the farm crew inspects and services the tools. Once the process is complete, return to the orchard’s south entrance and stand by for next assignment.

Begin at the orchard supply depot and load two crates of irrigation valves and a roll of drip tubing. Drive to irrigation station 3 at the northern edge of the orchard. Wait until a crew member unloads both crates and verifies receipt of the tubing. Once the handover is complete, continue to the composting area and pick up a bag of organic fertilizer. Deliver the fertilizer bag to the tool shed adjacent to the orchard workshop. Upon delivery, wait for five minutes before returning to the orchard supply depot for further instructions.

Drive to the solar charging station next to the maintenance garage and pick up three spare lithium battery packs. Deliver one battery pack each to the autonomous tractor at the north field entrance, the irrigation pump beside the east greenhouse, and the pest-control drone dock at the orchard’s south edge. Wait for 10 minutes at the orchard dock while the drone is recharging with the newly delivered battery. Once recharging is finished, travel to the composting center near the old silo, collect a sealed bag of bio-waste samples, and bring them to the environmental monitoring lab on the west campus. After transfer of the samples is confirmed, return to the solar charging station for the next assignment.

Start at the shipping container next to the equipment barn. Travel to the orchard's northwest corner and collect four empty fruit crates. Bring the crates to the central apple sorting station. Wait there until harvesting staff finish filling all the crates with apples, which may take up to thirty minutes. Once full, deliver all loaded apple crates to the cold storage facility at the south end of the farm. After delivering, retrieve one spare conveyor belt part from the cold storage office and return it to the equipment barn.

Head to the Storage Shed near the northern wheat fields and collect four sacks of fertilizer. Deliver two sacks to the Greenhouse Main Entrance and wait until the greenhouse staff retrieve the cargo. Transport the remaining two sacks to the Hillside Vineyard and wait for 8 minutes to allow the vineyard crew to unload. After delivery, proceed to the Central Equipment Hub and stand by for 12 minutes for a system diagnostic, then return to the Storage Shed to complete the loop.

Drive to the equipment shed adjacent to the eastern orchard and pick up three containers of pesticide solution. Proceed to the citrus grove, and deliver one container to the field technician stationed at the southern entrance. After the technician has removed the container, wait for 7 minutes for a refill check. Next, transport the remaining two containers to the vineyard's edge storage area, drop off the containers, and wait until an automated dispenser arm has unloaded them. Once all deliveries are complete, return to the equipment shed for inspection.

Proceed to the fertilizer storage shed located behind the northern greenhouse and collect three sacks of organic fertilizer. Take one sack to the orchard gate at the eastern boundary and wait until the orchard manager has unloaded it. Bring the remaining two sacks to the compost preparation area next to the irrigation pond. Wait at the compost area for 12 minutes in case additional organic material or tools need to be transported to the greenhouse. After all deliveries are confirmed, return to the fertilizer storage shed and await further instructions.

Start at the greenhouse loading ramp and pick up five trays of young tomato seedlings. Transport the seedlings to the south vegetable plot entrance and wait until the field crew has unloaded all trays. Once unloaded, continue to the composting area near the windbreak to collect two empty nutrient bins. Deliver the empty bins to the fertigation shed beside the irrigation pond. Wait at the fertigation shed for 7 minutes to be reloaded with full bins, then proceed to the central walkway and stand by for your next task.

Begin at the orchard access gate. Drive to the collection barn to pick up four crates of freshly harvested peaches. Transport two crates to the produce cooling facility near the south entrance and wait until a facility worker unloads both crates. Take the remaining two crates to the farm stand at field corner B. After completing the deliveries, proceed to the vehicle shed next to the windbreak and wait there for 12 minutes in case further transport requests arise.

Start at the Battery Charging Station and verify that your batteries are fully charged. Proceed to the Vineyard Shed and pick up five empty harvest baskets and one toolbox. Deliver three baskets to the Lower Slope Vine Row 14, and wait until the workers have collected a load of grapes and place it onto the robot. Once loaded, carry the full basket to the Wine Production Barn. Unload the grapes and toolbox there, then return to the Vineyard Shed to deliver the remaining two empty baskets. Wait there for 12 minutes in case additional tools or baskets are needed before returning to the Battery Charging Station.

Start at the northwest equipment yard and pick up two sacks of fertilizer and one empty water canister. Drive to the vineyard greenhouse and deliver one sack of fertilizer. Then proceed to the pond pump station to fill the empty water canister. Return to the main orchard entrance to deliver the filled water canister and the remaining sack of fertilizer to the orchard supervisor. After deliveries are complete, wait at the orchard entrance for 8 minutes to assist with possible additional requests.

Start at the maintenance garage adjacent to the machine workshop. Collect one heavy-duty battery pack and a set of replacement hydraulic hoses. Transport the battery pack to the solar charging station located near the east orchard and wait while the technical crew installs the battery. After the crew has removed the battery from the robot, proceed to the northern tractor barn with the hydraulic hoses. Wait for 7 minutes while the maintenance supervisor unloads the hoses, then return to the maintenance garage and await further instructions.

Begin at the equipment storage shed located beside the southern vehicle parking lot. Pick up three waterproof seed containers and a single bag of soil conditioner. Travel to the experimental crop plots near the old apple orchard. Deliver the seed containers to the agronomy team at plot B3. Wait until all three seed containers are unloaded. Afterward, continue to the composting area at the far end of the orchard and drop off the bag of soil conditioner for the groundskeeping staff. Return to the equipment storage shed and wait for 10 minutes for inspection before your next assignment.

Begin at the maintenance garage and collect four replacement drive belts from storage. Drive to the windmill repair site at the north boundary of the property. Deliver two drive belts to the windmill technician; wait until the technician has taken both belts and confirms the delivery. Transport the remaining two belts to the farm machinery lot near the central access road. Upon arrival, wait for 10 minutes while the field mechanics inspect your cargo and remove the belts. After the drop-off, proceed to the solar panel array behind the greenhouse and wait there for further instructions.

Begin at the field supply depot and collect four stacked crates of irrigation pipe fittings. Navigate to the blueberry patch maintenance station and deliver two crates, waiting 5 minutes for the farm team to unload them. Continue to the greenhouse complex on the west side and drop off one crate, then proceed to the main barn entrance to deliver the final crate to the livestock supervisor. Once all deliveries are complete, drive back to the field supply depot and await further assignments.

Start at the main workshop and retrieve a toolkit along with four replacement hydraulic cylinders from the storage cabinet. Navigate to the windbreak maintenance area by the west boundary of the farm. Deliver the toolkit to the maintenance supervisor on site and allow them to unload it before continuing. Wait for 15 minutes to assist with replacing any faulty hydraulic cylinders on the wind turbines; deliver up to four cylinders as requested by the repair crew. When all items have been transferred and you are released by the supervisor, proceed to the field office parking area and remain there until further instructions are provided.

Start at the maintenance garage and pick up a pallet of replacement batteries. Transport the pallet to the irrigation control center near the southern fields. Upon arrival, wait until the old batteries are removed from the irrigation units and the new ones are installed; this process should take approximately 30 minutes. Once installation is complete, collect the old batteries and deliver them to the hazardous materials depot at the northern perimeter of the property. After offloading the old batteries, proceed to the central workshop for your next assignment.

Start at the equipment depot and pick up two replacement hydraulic pumps and a box of mixed fasteners. Travel to the irrigation pump station beside the eastern canal and deliver one hydraulic pump to the onsite engineer, waiting until the pump is unloaded. Then, head to the main machinery barn and drop off the remaining pump and the box of fasteners at the service bay. Wait for 10 minutes to allow staff to inspect the deliveries before proceeding to the refueling zone near the vehicle fleet to await further instructions.

Start at the equipment storage garage near the eastern gate. Pick up two spare tractor tires and one box of hydraulic hoses from the loading area. Head to the main crop field access road, where the field maintenance crew is stationed. Deliver the box of hydraulic hoses and wait until the crew has unloaded the box and acknowledged receipt. Next, proceed with the two spare tractor tires to the southern machinery workshop. Wait there for 10 minutes while technicians replace worn-out tires and transfer the spares from your payload area. After the technician confirms completion, return to the equipment storage garage and park in the designated vehicle bay.

Begin at the equipment storage garage next to the north entrance. Collect five sealed pesticide containers. Proceed to the blueberry field adjacent to the creek and deliver two containers at the field’s distribution station. Continue to the southern greenhouse and drop off the remaining three containers at the main entry bay. Wait for 10 minutes to allow the agricultural crew to inspect the delivery. After inspection is complete, return to the equipment storage garage for your next assignment.

Begin at the equipment garage by the northern paddock. Drive to the irrigation supply depot and pick up two rolls of irrigation hose and a box of replacement sprinkler heads. Head to the southern pasture maintenance area and deliver one roll of hose and the sprinkler head box. Wait there for 6 minutes to allow the maintenance team to verify the delivery. Then continue to the orchard tool shed, deliver the second roll of irrigation hose, and wait until all cargo has been unloaded before returning to the equipment garage by the northern paddock.

Travel to the produce sorting facility and pick up three crates of freshly harvested tomatoes. Deliver one crate to the farm market stand near the main gate, and the remaining two crates to cold storage in Building C. At the farm market stand, wait until the manager checks and accepts the delivery before continuing. After all deliveries are completed, return to the equipment shed to await further loading instructions.

Start at the main greenhouse entrance and pick up a sealed crate containing temperature-sensitive seedlings. Carefully transport the crate to the shade shelter located by the northeast irrigation pond. Wait at the shelter for the horticulture crew to unload the crate. Once the crate is unloaded, proceed to the fertilizer storage shed near the composting area. Collect two bags of slow-release fertilizer from the shed and deliver them to the berry patch on the south slope. After delivery, remain at the berry patch for 10 minutes in case the agriculture team requires help repositioning bags, then return to the main greenhouse entrance.

Proceed to the fertilizer storage bunker and pick up four bags of organic fertilizer. Transport two bags to the irrigation control tower and wait for an operator to unload them. Once unloaded, deliver one bag to the community vegetable garden by the south fence. After leaving the bag, wait five minutes in case additional requests are made. Take the final bag to the orchard’s west gate station and leave it by the signpost. When all deliveries are complete, travel back to the main charging dock.

Begin at the Orchard Garage and collect three empty fruit bins. Deliver all bins to Harvest Row, Section C, and wait for the picking team to load the bins with fresh apples. Once the bins are loaded, transport two of them to the Packing Pavilion beside the South Gate and notify staff upon arrival. Carry the remaining full bin to the Cold Storage Annex at East Lane. Wait for 10 minutes while the bin is unloaded by the inventory team, then return to the Orchard Garage.

Start at the Equipment Hangar near the wind turbine array. Pick up two solar panel crates and a canister of industrial lubricant. Proceed to the Solar Array Maintenance Zone and deliver the two solar panel crates to the installation team. Wait until both crates are fully unloaded and stacked by the technicians. Next, carry the canister of lubricant to the Western Control Shed. Wait for 7 minutes as the maintenance crew uses the lubricant for generator servicing. After the canister is emptied and removed, head to the Logistics Charging Point behind the admin office and wait there for recharge instructions.

Begin at the equipment garage and load three full water canisters onto the robot. Drive to the vineyard plot on the eastern slope and deliver one water canister to the vineyard manager. Wait until the canister has been unloaded. Proceed to the citrus grove worksite in the southwest corner and deliver the remaining two water canisters to the irrigation team. Wait for five minutes in case refilling is needed. After delivery, return to the equipment garage and await your next task.

Start at the Storage Garage and pick up two replacement air filters. Proceed to the Greenhouse Complex and deliver both air filters to the greenhouse technician. Wait for 5 minutes while the technician installs one of the filters and leaves the other on the robot. After the wait, transport the remaining air filter to the Pump House and leave it on the designated supply rack before returning to the Storage Garage and awaiting the next assignment.

Proceed to the lumber yard storage area and load eight bundles of wooden stakes onto your platform. Take five bundles to the Vineyard's east fence and deliver them near the gate repair site. Wait here for 10 minutes while the farm crew organizes the materials. Once time has elapsed, transport the remaining three bundles to the orchard maintenance shed. Once the delivery at the shed is complete, return to the central depot and stand by for the next assignment.

Proceed to the north orchard supply hut and collect a crate of apple-picking gloves, three baskets, and a box of pruning shears. Deliver the box of pruning shears to the pruning crew at row 5, west orchard. Wait for 7 minutes while the crew inspects and takes the shears. Next, take the crate of gloves and all baskets to the temporary shelter at the southern orchard edge. Wait until the harvesting supervisor completes loading any surplus fruit into the baskets. Afterward, carry the full baskets to the cooling shed at the main farm junction, unload them, and then return to the north orchard supply hut.

Begin at the orchard storage barn and collect three bins of freshly harvested pears. Transport these bins to the produce sorting facility adjacent to the central greenhouse. Once at the facility, wait for the sorting crew to unload all three bins and provide verbal confirmation. Next, proceed to the fertilizer shed at the southern perimeter of the farm and pick up two sealed bags of organic fertilizer. Deliver these bags to the east vineyard gate, where the vineyard manager will take receipt. Wait for 10 minutes for the manager to complete a quick inspection of the delivery before returning to the orchard storage barn.

Travel to the Storage Barn next to the northern field and collect three sealed boxes of greenhouse sensors. Head to the Greenhouse Facility located past the pine grove. Deliver all three sensor boxes to the technician waiting by the southwest entrance of the greenhouse. Wait for 12 minutes while the technician unpacks and tests the equipment. Once the technician confirms the receipt and successful test of the sensors, return to the Storage Barn and stand by for further assignments.

Begin at the gravel parking lot behind the main workshop and pick up two sealed containers of diesel fuel. Transport both containers to the tractor refueling station near Field C. Wait for the field supervisor to remove one container. Once unloaded, take the remaining container to the equipment storage barn on the south end of the property. Upon delivery, wait at the barn for 7 minutes in case any empty fuel containers need to be returned to the parking lot. If none are provided, return to the gravel parking lot and wait for the next task.

Begin at the equipment charging station near the south orchard. Pick up three sealed boxes of drone batteries.
