Travel to the vineyard observation tower and deliver one box to the technician at the base; wait there for 10 minutes while the box is inspected. After inspection, proceed with the remaining boxes to the olive grove maintenance shed, and drop off both boxes on the marked supply shelf. Once deliveries are completed, return to the equipment charging station and stand by until further notice.

Start at the greenhouse annex near the east orchard. Pick up four trays of young tomato seedlings. Transport the seedlings to the planting plot at Field Row 7 along the southern boundary. Wait for the planting crew to unload all trays. Once unloaded, proceed to the supply depot adjacent to the irrigation control center and collect two sealed fertilizer bags. Deliver these fertilizer bags to the vineyard staging area at the foot of Hillcrest Lane. After drop-off, stand by at the vineyard staging area for 7 minutes before returning to the greenhouse annex.

Start at the orchard loading ramp and pick up four crates of harvested apples. Transport the crates to the packing shed located beside the north vineyard. Wait at the packing shed until all crates have been unloaded by the staff, but do not wait longer than 12 minutes. Once empty, proceed to the repair bay adjacent to the staff canteen and retrieve a box of replacement sprockets for the conveyor line. Deliver the box to the machine room supervisor in the main processing building. Wait 8 minutes for the supervisor to verify the delivery before returning to the orchard loading ramp to receive further instructions.

Begin at the Equipment Staging Area near the greenhouse entrance. Retrieve three empty fertilizer tanks and load them onto the robot. Travel to the Fertilizer Depot situated on the eastern perimeter road. At the depot, wait for the tanks to be fully refilled by the depot attendant. Once loaded, transport the three filled tanks to Irrigation Station 3, next to the central vegetable plots. Unload all three tanks at the designated drop-off zone. Remain at Irrigation Station 3 for 10 minutes to monitor for any additional delivery requests. After the waiting period, proceed to the Equipment Staging Area to await further tasks.

Begin at the main warehouse and pick up four crates of seed packets from storage bay 3. Transport two crates to the southern planting field and wait for the field crew to unload them. While waiting, monitor for any requests from the crew. Once unloaded, take the remaining two crates to the north orchard's equipment shed and hand them over to the orchard supervisor. After delivery, drive to the wind turbine control hut at the east ridge and wait there for 5 minutes for a system health confirmation before returning to the main warehouse.

Start at the North Storage Shelter and collect three sacks of mineral-enriched soil. Deliver two sacks to Plot 12 in the experimental crop field and wait for the agronomy crew to distribute the soil evenly. After confirmation, proceed with the remaining sack to the Orchard Tool Depot and exchange it for a crate of pruning shears. Take the crate of pruning shears to Apple Row M and wait up to 15 minutes for the orchard specialists to finish removing the tools before returning to the North Storage Shelter.

Start from the paved entrance near the east-side packing facility. Travel to the row of loading pallets just outside the berry sorting tent and pick up four bags of packing materials. Proceed to the refrigerated storage trailer stationed by the northern crop field. Deliver two bags of packing materials to the storage trailer and wait for the staff to finish unloading. Next, move to the farm workshop located behind the windbreak trees and drop off the remaining two bags of packing materials. Wait at the workshop for 5 minutes to ensure receipt confirmation. Complete the task by returning to the paved entrance near the east-side packing facility.

Begin at the solar panel maintenance shed near the eastern boundary. Collect the large toolbox labeled ‘Panel Repair Kit’ and drive to Solar Array Row 4, Section C. Wait for technicians to remove the old inverter panel and load it onto the robot; this may take up to 15 minutes. Once the inverter is loaded, proceed with it to the electronics recycling depot located beside the south fence. Deliver the inverter panel at the depot, then wait for 10 minutes to see if additional e-waste items need collection. Afterwards, proceed to the rainwater collection tanks by the northwest windbreak, and pick up any empty water testing canisters found there. Finally, return all testing canisters to the laboratory building at the central facility hub. Conclude the route at the solar panel maintenance shed.

Begin by collecting six sealed chemical sample containers from the laboratory prep room in the processing facility. Distribute the containers across three fertilizer testing stations by delivering two containers to each: first to Testing Station A near the northeast field border, second to Testing Station B at the central operations tent, and third to Testing Station C beside the southwest irrigation channel, making sure that if any station is unavailable for drop-off upon arrival, proceed to the next and return to complete deliveries in the same order once the area is accessible. Once all chemical sample containers have been delivered, remain at Testing Station C for fifteen minutes to allow for field test initiation, then travel back to the laboratory prep room and wait there until the lead technician signals that test results are ready for pickup.

Start at the maintenance garage next to the equipment depot and collect four fully-charged lithium battery packs from the charging station. Transport two battery packs to the irrigation control hut by the east corn field and wait until the technician swaps out both batteries. After the technician completes the exchange, drive to the remote sensor tower at the northern boundary and deliver one battery pack. Wait at the tower for 7 minutes while the sensor system is rebooted using the new battery pack. Once the reboot is finished and the battery pack has been removed from the robot, continue to the drone launch pad behind the machinery barn to deliver the final battery pack. Remain at the drone launch pad until a ground crew member removes the last battery pack, then proceed back to the maintenance garage to await further tasks.

Begin at the seed storage barn and load fifteen sealed seed packets destined for distribution. Proceed to the north planting grid and deliver five seed packets there; after confirming the drop-off is complete, drive to the east planting grid to deposit another five seed packets. Allocate the remaining five seed packets to the south planting grid, ensuring each grid receives an equal share. Once all distributions are finished, wait for 10 minutes at the south planting grid for supervisors to inspect and verify delivery. Only after the inspection is approved should the robot return to the seed storage barn to complete the assignment.

Begin at the north storage hangar and collect seven bins of wheat grain. Deliver three bins to Silo A, and wait until each bin is fully unloaded before proceeding. Then, take two of the remaining four bins to Silo B; after the bins have been emptied at Silo B, pause at the silo for five minutes to allow for inventory checks. Transport the final two bins to Silo C, ensuring all grain is removed before leaving. After completing all deliveries, return to the north storage hangar and wait there for instructions on the next assignment.

Begin at the Main Warehouse loading dock and retrieve six maintenance toolkits, making sure all kits are securely loaded. Proceed first to the Engine Maintenance Bay and deliver two toolkits, waiting until the maintenance engineer confirms their removal. After the delivery at the Engine Maintenance Bay is complete, continue to the Generator Control Room and transfer another two toolkits, again remaining until the tools have been fully unloaded. For the final two toolkits, travel to the Remote Sensor Calibration Station; deliver one toolkit immediately, but wait 8 minutes before delivering the second toolkit to allow the technician to finish calibrating the first set, then hand over and confirm removal of the last toolkit. Once all deliveries are verified, return to the Main Warehouse loading dock to complete the operation.

Start at the central supply depot and collect twelve irrigation sensor modules. Transport the sensor modules to Field Sector A, and distribute four modules at the northern pump control station. After waiting five minutes for the field technician to verify installation, proceed to Field Sector B, where you will deliver another four sensor modules to the east end relay post. Once these modules are accepted, continue to Field Sector C and drop off the final four sensor modules at the southern monitoring node. Wait at the monitoring node until the technician signals payload removal of the last set of modules, then return immediately to the central supply depot to report completion.

Begin by heading to the Main Seed Storage Shed to collect a batch of eight specialized seed trays. Evenly distribute these eight trays between three greenhouse zones—place three trays in Greenhouse Alpha, three trays in Greenhouse Beta, and the remaining two trays in Greenhouse Gamma, ensuring each location receives its assigned quantity. After each delivery, wait until the agricultural technician at the respective greenhouse confirms that the seed trays have been offloaded, then proceed to the next drop-off location. Once all trays have been delivered, move to the Equipment Inspection Area and wait there for 7 minutes to allow staff to complete a preliminary equipment check before continuing to your next assigned duty.

Begin at the dock warehouse where you will collect a pallet containing thirty-six produce crates. Next, deliver these crates by transporting twelve crates each to Storage Silo Alpha, Storage Silo Bravo, and Storage Silo Charlie, ensuring that if there are any remaining crates after equal distribution, those extras are added to Storage Silo Alpha. After the crates are fully offloaded at the last destination, wait at Silo Alpha for twenty minutes to allow inventory reconciliation by the site supervisor. Once the wait period concludes, proceed directly to the equipment maintenance bay to await further instructions.

Begin at the chemical storage room inside Processing Facility 1 and collect nine canisters of liquid fertilizer. Transport all nine canisters directly to Mixing Bay Alpha and wait until the mixing crew signals that they have removed exactly five canisters for blending. Once the five canisters have been unloaded from the robot, proceed with the remaining four canisters to Storage Shed 4, but allow for an exact seven-minute waiting period outside Storage Shed 4 before approaching the entrance. After seven minutes, deliver three of the remaining canisters to Storage Shed 4 and retain the final canister. Take this last canister to the Machinery Calibration Annex and wait there until the annex operator confirms the canister has been received; only then may you return to Processing Facility 1 to stand by for additional assignments.

Start at the seed storage area adjacent to Dock 2 and collect six sacks of winter rye seed, ensuring all sacks are securely loaded. Next, proceed to Grain Silo A, Grain Silo B, and Grain Silo D in sequence, and deliver two sacks to each silo—after dropping off sacks at each location, pause for 3 minutes to allow the silo operator to confirm receipt before moving to the next silo. Once all six sacks have been distributed and confirmations recorded, travel to the field monitoring station behind the silos and remain there until the field manager removes any remaining empty containers from your cargo bay.

Start at the packing shed adjacent to the south orchard and pick up nine crates of harvested apples. Transport the crates first to Silo A, where you should deliver three crates and remain until silo staff have finished unloading. Next, take the remaining six crates to Silo B and deliver another three crates, repeating the waiting process until unloading is confirmed. Carry the final three crates to Silo C, wait for unloading as before, and then pause at Silo C for 15 minutes to allow quality inspectors to complete their checks. After the waiting period, return to the packing shed to await further instructions.

Start at the loading dock adjacent to Warehouse A and secure nine sealed nutrient containers onto your payload platform. First, travel to Field Alpha’s southern access point, and distribute four nutrient containers to the crop management crew, waiting until all four have been fully unloaded before moving on. Proceed to Field Beta’s east gate, deliver three more of the nutrient containers to the technicians stationed there, pausing until you receive confirmation that all containers have been removed. Take the last two containers to the remote soil laboratory northeast of Field Beta, where you must wait for the laboratory staff to remove the final containers from your payload area. After all deliveries are complete, remain parked at the soil laboratory for five minutes before heading back to the loading dock at Warehouse A.

Start at the central fertilizer storage and collect six sealed bags of premium fertilizer mix. Distribute the bags as follows: deliver two bags to the east apple orchard tool shed, then one bag to the north vineyard supply point, and afterwards two bags to the south field shed, making sure at each stop to wait until a staff member confirms receipt of the delivered bags before departing. Carry the remaining single bag to the greenhouse complex and wait for 7 minutes to allow the growers to organize staging before handing off the final bag. Once all locations have been served and confirmed delivery, return directly to the central fertilizer storage for your next assignment.

Begin at the equipment depot and load four maintenance toolkits. Proceed to Maintenance Bay Alpha, where you must deliver one toolkit and wait for confirmation that the inventory specialist has removed it. Then continue to Maintenance Bay Beta and deliver another toolkit, again remaining until it has been removed. Next, bring the third toolkit to Maintenance Bay Gamma, waiting for unloading as before, and deliver the final toolkit to Maintenance Bay Delta, awaiting removal there as well. After completing these four drop-offs and all have been confirmed, return to the equipment depot and remain on standby for 10 minutes before commencing any further missions.

Start at the storage warehouse and collect twelve fertilizer bags, ensuring all are securely loaded. Travel to Field North and deliver five fertilizer bags, waiting until you receive confirmation that the field supervisor has removed those five bags. After this confirmation, go to Field East and unload four fertilizer bags, remaining on-site until removal is completed. Then, proceed to Field South with the remaining three fertilizer bags, and as before, await confirmation that all bags have been taken by the field crew. Only after every field's fertilizer has been dropped and their respective removals confirmed, proceed to the maintenance shed, and remain stationary for exactly 8 minutes before undertaking any new assignments.

Begin at Storage Shed A and pick up twelve seed trays destined for sowing. Evenly distribute the seed trays across Tomato Plot #1, Lettuce Plot #2, and Herb Plot #3, assigning four seed trays to each plot and delivering them one plot at a time. After completing the delivery to Herb Plot #3, proceed directly to the Irrigation Supply Area to collect one fertilizer pack. Wait for three minutes at the Irrigation Supply Area to allow for the pack to be prepared, then transport and drop off the fertilizer pack at Greenhouse Entrance B. Once the fertilizer delivery is acknowledged at Greenhouse Entrance B, remain there for five minutes before returning to Storage Shed A for standby duty.

Begin by proceeding to the Parts Inventory Depot to collect seven hydraulic filter canisters intended for use in pending equipment maintenance. Next, divide the seven hydraulic filter canisters so that you deliver two canisters each to Maintenance Bay A, Maintenance Bay B, and Maintenance Bay C, and bring the remaining one canister to the Emergency Repair Station. At each maintenance bay—A, B, and C—wait until the technician at that location has removed their two designated canisters from the robot before proceeding to the next bay. After leaving the final canister at the Emergency Repair Station and confirming its removal, return to the Parts Inventory Depot and remain stationary for 20 minutes to synchronize with the next scheduled restocking cycle.

Begin at the central depot and load nine harvested grain sacks onto your platform. Transport the first three grain sacks to grain silo A located at the northern edge of the facility, and wait until all three sacks are offloaded by the silo crew. Next, deliver another three grain sacks to grain silo B in the eastern sector and remain there for 5 minutes to allow for inventory scanning. After the waiting period, carry the final three grain sacks to grain silo C near the administration building, and do not leave until the crew removes all sacks. Once these deliveries are complete, return with your empty platform to the central depot and wait for new loading instructions.

Start at the fertilizer storage shed and load a total of seven bags of compost enhancer. Distribute these bags evenly by delivering two bags to each of the following locations: the north vegetable field, the central flower bed, and the east corn plot; make certain the final remaining bag is delivered to the experimental crops greenhouse. At each drop-off, wait until the field supervisor or greenhouse technician removes the bags from the robot before proceeding. After the last delivery at the experimental crops greenhouse, remain there for 5 minutes in case any bag needs to be retrieved for quality control, and only return to the fertilizer storage shed once the wait period has elapsed and all bags have been accepted.

Begin at the irrigation control shed and pick up three sensor calibration kits. Head to Wheat Field A, Rice Field B, and Soy Plot C in sequence, delivering one calibration kit to each field. After each delivery, pause for 90 seconds to allow the field technician to calibrate the sensors and signal that the kit is ready for removal. After completing all three deliveries and receiving confirmation from each field, make your way to the tools warehouse to retrieve the maintenance checklist for the next task.

Begin by traveling to the Equipment Maintenance Bay to collect four replacement hydraulic actuators and seven calibration sensors. Evenly distribute the hydraulic actuators so that one is delivered each to the Tomato Sorting Facility, Potato Grading Dock, and the Lettuce Packaging Line, and deliver the remaining actuator to the central Robotics Workshop even if the numbers do not divide evenly. For the calibration sensors, allocate two sensors to the Tomato Sorting Facility, three sensors to the Potato Grading Dock, and deliver the final two sensors to the Lettuce Packaging Line; if a destination receives fewer than another, deliver the surplus to locations in order as listed. After each actuator and sensor delivery at any destination, wait until the maintenance supervisor at that location confirms receipt before proceeding to the next delivery site. Once all parts have been distributed and confirmed, wait for 15 minutes at the Robotics Workshop for a final inspection before returning to the Equipment Maintenance Bay.

Begin at the fertilizer warehouse and collect a batch of twelve nutrient canisters. Distribute these canisters as evenly as possible among three locations: place four canisters at Irrigation Station A, four at Pump House B, and deliver the remaining four to Storage Shed C; if any canisters remain after equal distribution, assign the remainder to Storage Shed C. Upon completing all drop-offs, proceed to the central shed and wait for 10 minutes to allow the field technicians to confirm successful delivery and storage. After receiving approval from the technicians, travel to Maintenance Bay 2 to retrieve one replacement filtration unit and transport it back to the fertilizer warehouse for restocking.

Begin at Maintenance Bay 3 by picking up eight replacement battery packs designated for drones. Travel first to Field Outpost Alpha to deliver three battery packs and wait until the field technician confirms all three battery packs are unloaded. Once you receive confirmation, proceed to the Central Launch Pad, deliver another three battery packs, and remain there for 15 minutes while the launch crew installs them. Finally, bring the remaining two battery packs to Hangar West, wait until the payload removal is complete, then return directly to Maintenance Bay 3 to complete the cycle.

Start your shift at the fertilizer loading station adjacent to the Field Operations Center and collect twenty-five sealed nutrient packs. Your first delivery route includes supplying eight nutrient packs to Greenhouse Delta, followed by transporting another eight packs to Hydroponics Bay Beta; any remaining nutrient packs after these allocations must be delivered to Soil Lab Gamma, regardless of quantity. After all nutrient packs have been delivered, proceed to the robot recharge pad near the main irrigation pipeline and wait for five minutes to allow your battery systems to stabilize before resuming any further tasks. Once the waiting period has elapsed and only if all three delivery confirmations are received from Greenhouse Delta, Hydroponics Bay Beta, and Soil Lab Gamma, navigate to the Logistics Control Room to receive your next assignment in person from the duty supervisor.

Start at the main equipment depot and pick up a total of nine sensor calibration modules. Transport three calibration modules to Barn Alpha, then deliver another three modules to Dairy Facility Bravo, and finally bring the last three modules to Feedstock Storage Charlie to ensure each location receives an equal allocation. Once all modules have been dropped off and the last delivery at Feedstock Storage Charlie is completed, return to the main equipment depot and pause for five minutes to allow technicians to prepare a shipment of temperature loggers. After waiting, collect the shipment of five temperature loggers, bring them to Greenhouse East, and remain there until technicians confirm all loggers have been safely removed from the robot.

Begin at the Seed Storage Silo and collect a total of seven bags of organic fertilizer, then proceed to distribute these bags between the East Orchard, Central Vegetable Patch, and the South Herb Garden such that each area receives two bags to start, with the final seventh bag delivered to the Central Vegetable Patch as the extra allocation to ensure none are wasted. After delivering each allotment, wait at each location for the site supervisor to certify that the fertilizer bags have been properly received and positioned before moving to the next field, beginning with the East Orchard, then the Central Vegetable Patch, and finally the South Herb Garden. Once all deliveries are acknowledged and completed, return directly to the Seed Storage Silo and await further loading instructions from the inventory manager.

Collect four empty produce crates from the storage dock in Warehouse B and proceed to Orchard Sector 5. Evenly distribute the crates between Packing Station Alpha, Packing Station Beta, and Packing Station Gamma, delivering one crate to each; the fourth crate should be placed at Packing Station Alpha to handle the remainder. After each delivery, wait at the respective station for a supervisor to confirm crate placement before moving to the next destination. Once all crates have been delivered, remain at Packing Station Gamma for 8 minutes to allow field workers to repurpose any crates or provide additional instructions.

Starting from Dock Station 2, collect six containers of processed grain from the sorting warehouse. Deliver two containers each to Grain Silo Alpha, Grain Silo Beta, and Grain Silo Gamma, always waiting at each silo for confirmation that the containers have been fully unloaded before proceeding to the next destination. After the final delivery at Grain Silo Gamma, navigate to Maintenance Bay 5 and remain there for seven minutes to undergo a system diagnostic check. Only after the diagnostic is complete, return to Dock Station 2 and prepare for the next scheduled transport task.

Begin at the maintenance depot adjacent to the southern machine bay and collect nine replacement hydraulic filters from the storage rack. Divide these filters for delivery: bring three filters to the Harvesting Vehicle Garage and wait until all three filters have been removed by the mechanics before proceeding. Once the Harvesting Vehicle Garage delivery is complete, transport another three hydraulic filters to the Tractor Maintenance Hangar located next to the fuel station; after arriving, pause for two minutes to allow the maintenance crew to unload these filters. After this waiting period, deliver the remaining three filters to the Equipment Calibration Lab on the upper west side of the yard, and wait there until a technician confirms the receipt of all filters before returning to the maintenance depot.

Start at the equipment maintenance bay and pick up four sealed toolkits required for field repairs. Transport two toolkits to the south wheat field machinery station and wait until the field technician has removed them both and confirmed successful unloading. Then, deliver one toolkit to the irrigation pump house at the central canal, waiting for the supervisor to take possession before proceeding. Bring the last remaining toolkit to the vineyard outpost, which sits along the western ridge, but wait outside for 7 minutes before transfer to ensure the outpost gate is unlocked. After all toolkits have been delivered and each recipient confirms receipt, return directly to the equipment maintenance bay.

Begin at Storage Bay A and load six sealed seed pouches onto the robot. Then, proceed to distribute these seed pouches by delivering two pouches each to Silo 1, Silo 2, and Silo 3, visiting each silo in turn and waiting for the respective silo manager to remove the seed pouches before heading to the next destination. If at any point a silo is not ready to accept the delivery, wait for 4 minutes at that silo before attempting to deliver again. After all six seed pouches have been successfully dropped off and confirmed removed, proceed to the Vehicle Maintenance Hangar and remain there until a technician completes a final inspection of the robot’s cargo bay. When the inspection is complete, return the robot to Storage Bay A for end-of-shift docking.

Start at the seed storage warehouse and pick up a total of seven sacks of wheat seed intended for distribution. First, carry and deliver two sacks to the North Slope planting field, waiting until the planting team signals that all sacks have been fully unloaded before proceeding. Next, transport three sacks to the East Meadow field; after confirming unloading completion with the supervisor there, wait for 5 minutes to allow for record-keeping and equipment checks on site. Finally, bring the remaining two sacks to the South Ridge demonstration plot, and only return to the seed storage warehouse after the agricultural technician at South Ridge confirms receipt of these final sacks. Ensure sacks are distributed according to the specific counts for each destination, and if any sacks remain undelivered due to access issues at any location, immediately return them to the warehouse before ending the task.

Begin at the Packing Dock adjacent to the produce warehouse and load up six crates of fresh strawberries. Deliver three of the strawberry crates to Market Stall 1 at the farmers' market on the south lot and remain until the manager at Market Stall 1 confirms unloading. Next, proceed to the Cold Storage Unit in Building B and drop off two more strawberry crates, waiting for five minutes to accommodate the temperature acclimation process. Once that interval is complete, transfer the final crate to the Administrative Office lobby, where you should stay until the office staff remove the cargo and log the receipt of the strawberries before moving on to your next mission.

Begin at the central supply warehouse and pick up seven crates of fertilizer pellets intended for morning field application. Proceed immediately to Greenhouse One and deliver two crates there, waiting five minutes to allow staff to inspect and log the delivery before proceeding. After confirmation, transport three crates to Field Plot B at the eastern edge of the property, remaining on-site until all three crates are fully removed from the robot by the field manager. Take the last two crates to Nursery Bay Seven, where you must wait until the nursery technician is ready and verifies the crate contents. Only after all deliveries have been completed and the last technician has removed the crates from the robot, return directly to the central supply warehouse to report task completion.

Begin at the central depot and load nine crates of greenhouse tomatoes designated for delivery. Travel first to Packing Station Alpha and evenly distribute three tomato crates, remaining at the station until all three crates are confirmed as unloaded by staff. Next, deliver another three tomato crates to Packing Station Beta, again waiting on-site until workers have removed the assigned crates. With the final three crates, continue to Packing Station Gamma and stay until you receive go-ahead from the unloading personnel that the transfer is complete. Upon completing all deliveries and removals, wait at Packing Station Gamma for exactly 6 minutes before proceeding back to the central depot to conclude this delivery sequence.

Start at the Orchard Equipment Bay and retrieve a pallet containing twelve empty produce crates. Proceed to Harvest Site A and distribute four crates to the collection platform; remain until the harvest supervisor has verified the delivery and signaled removal of all four crates. Immediately continue to Harvest Site B and release another four crates to the designated drop-off point, waiting until confirmation is received that these have been unloaded. Move next to Harvest Site C, delivering the final four crates and waiting for the crew at Site C to finish their removal before departing. After all crates have been dropped off and cleared from the robot at each site, return to the Orchard Equipment Bay to complete your delivery circuit, ensuring the cycle is not considered finished until all three sites have acknowledged full receipt of their assigned crates.

Begin at the supply depot and collect a bundle of nine biodegradable planting trays. Travel to Field A and unload three planting trays, waiting for the field supervisor to confirm the trays are properly positioned before proceeding. Next, continue to the seed processing shed and deliver another three planting trays, this time waiting for the technician to finish inspecting the trays, which may take up to 10 minutes. Finally, transport the remaining three planting trays to the soil testing lab, but only enter once the previous batch of trays has been removed from the drop-off table; afterward, wait at the lab until all trays are accounted for before returning to the supply depot for the next assignment.

Begin at the Packing Warehouse where you will collect a crate containing 17 freshly harvested produce boxes. Head to Loading Dock A first and deliver 6 produce boxes, then continue to Loading Dock B to unload another 6 boxes. Since that accounts for 12 boxes, drive the remaining 5 produce boxes to Loading Dock C for final delivery. After each delivery at each dock, pause for 3 minutes to allow dock staff to verify the contents before proceeding to the next dock; if any verification is delayed, wait until it is complete before moving on. Once all deliveries and verifications are finished at all three loading docks, return the empty crate to the Packing Warehouse for inspection.

Begin at the Main Equipment Depot and retrieve a crate containing twelve sensor modules designated for quality assurance testing. Transport the crate to the Calibration Lab, where you must deliver five sensor modules, waiting there for the calibration specialist to prepare and verify the modules for installation, which will take 10 minutes. Once the preparation is complete, proceed to the Assembly Line 2 with four more sensor modules and remain onsite until the assembly supervisor confirms that the modules have been correctly integrated into the machinery. After successful confirmation, deliver the remaining three sensor modules to the Field Testing Dock. Wait for the field engineer to finalize the acceptance of the modules before returning to the Main Equipment Depot to complete your cycle and prepare for the next round of tasks.

Begin at Storage Warehouse Delta and load seven crates of harvested tomatoes. Proceed to Packing Station 1 to unload and wait until workers have removed exactly three crates before transporting the remaining four crates to Distribution Hub Beta. Once at Distribution Hub Beta, wait for two minutes while staff check and accept the crates, then return to Storage Warehouse Delta. If upon your return any empty tomato crates are ready for collection, load them and immediately deliver these empty crates to the field collection point adjacent to Greenhouse South, where you will wait until all empty crates have been offloaded before ending the task.

Begin by collecting four sacks of seed from the packing warehouse. Bring the entire load to the eastern field edge and wait until the field manager confirms the unloading of the first sack. Once the first sack has been removed, transport two sacks to the central field station and remain there for three minutes to allow station workers to prepare for the next transfer. After the waiting period, take the final sack to the northern irrigation hub; only after the sack has been removed by the technician should you return to the packing warehouse for your next assignment.

Begin at the logistics hub near the western storage silos and pick up six 5-kg sacks of fertilizer. Distribute these sacks among Greenhouse A, Crop Field B, and Vineyard C such that Greenhouse A receives two sacks, Crop Field B receives two sacks, and Vineyard C receives the remaining two sacks; after each delivery, pause for 5 minutes at the respective destination to allow on-site staff to remove each sack before proceeding to the next location. Only after all sacks have been delivered and confirmed removed from your payload area at each site, return to the logistics hub, and wait there for 20 minutes in case additional cargo becomes available for transport.

Start by moving to Packing Station East and wait for the station supervisor to confirm that a crate of harvested blueberries is ready to be loaded onto the robot. After the crate is secured, transport it directly to Cooling Room 3 and wait until the cooling technician completes unloading. Next, remain in Cooling Room 3 for 8 minutes to allow temperature stabilization before proceeding to the Maintenance Dock. Upon arrival at the Maintenance Dock, unload and pick up an empty container; however, only proceed to Compost Yard A if the empty container has been confirmed loaded. Once at Compost Yard A, wait for the waste manager to remove the empty container, then return immediately to Packing Station East for further instructions, ensuring all required waiting and confirmation steps are completed in sequence.

Begin at the Central Storage Depot and load twelve bags of hybrid wheat seed onto your payload platform. Proceed to the North Field Entrance and deliver four seed bags to the planting crew, then wait until each bag is confirmed as unloaded before departing. Next, take another four seed bags to the East Terrace Plot, and once all four bags have been delivered and acknowledged by the field supervisor, remain at the East Terrace Plot for 5 minutes to allow the planting machinery to be serviced. Afterward, transport the remaining four seed bags to the South Slope Access Point, where you must wait for the agronomist to inspect and approve the seed bags before completing the delivery. Once all deliveries and required waiting periods are fulfilled, return directly to the Central Storage Depot for further instructions.

Begin your route at Maintenance Bay 3, where you must wait for the technician to confirm that a sealed container of replacement hydraulic oil is ready for transport. As soon as the container is available, travel directly to Tractor 12, which is stationed at Field Access Point C, and deliver the container to the on-site mechanic. Remain at Field Access Point C for five minutes while the mechanic verifies the integrity of the hydraulic oil before you proceed. If the mechanic confirms successful receipt of the hydraulic oil, continue to Water Pump Station 7 at the eastern perimeter and wait until the pump operator removes all empty supply containers from your cargo bay before proceeding to the machine shed for your next task assignment. If the technician at Maintenance Bay 3 fails to provide the container, do not leave Maintenance Bay 3 but instead await further instructions from the supervisor.

Start by picking up four empty chemical mixing tanks at Storage Dock A and transport them one by one to Mixing Plant 2, making sure that after each tank is delivered, you wait until the Mixing Plant 2 technician signals that the tank is loaded with fertilizer slurry. Once all four tanks have been filled, distribute three of the slurry tanks—one to Field Zone North, one to Field Zone East, and one to Field Zone South—delivering them in that order and waiting at each field until the local team has removed the tank from your payload. The remaining fourth tank should be delivered to the Emergency Response Shed; after arrival there, wait for three minutes for inspection before returning to Storage Dock A for further assignments.

Start your route at the equipment maintenance bay and collect six replacement hydraulic filters. Deliver two hydraulic filters to the main irrigation pump house on the south field edge, then continue to the eastern grain silo to drop off another two hydraulic filters. Take the final two hydraulic filters to the remote valley outpost workshop and wait for the workshop technician to remove the previous filters before completing the delivery there. After all filters have been distributed and the removal at the workshop is confirmed, return to the equipment maintenance bay and wait for three minutes before taking on any new tasks.

Begin at the central storage depot and collect a shipment consisting of eleven crates of assorted fertilizer. Evenly distribute these crates among the north field distribution point, the south greenhouse loading dock, and the eastern orchard gate by transporting batches of crates one location at a time, making sure that the north field and south greenhouse each receive four crates, while the eastern orchard gate receives the remaining three crates. After completing the drop-off at each location, wait for local staff to remove all crates at that site before proceeding to the next destination. Once the entire shipment has been delivered and confirmed, wait for 8 minutes in the maintenance bay near the workshop before returning to the depot for further instructions.

Begin at the central materials depot and load eight sealed bags of fertilizer. Travel to Orchard Plot A and deliver three bags, then pause for 4 minutes to allow field technicians to manually remove each bag. After all three bags have been unloaded, proceed to Greenhouse 2 and drop off two more bags, waiting for confirmation by the greenhouse supervisor before leaving. Deliver the remaining three bags to Irrigation Station North; however, if staff at Irrigation Station North are not present to receive the delivery, wait in standby for 8 minutes before returning to the central materials depot.

Start at the Seed Warehouse and acquire a pallet loaded with 17 bags of soybean seeds. Transport the pallet to the Main Loading Dock and remain there for 4 minutes while the crew inspects and tags the shipment for distribution. Once the inspection is confirmed complete, divide the 17 seed bags for delivery: bring 6 bags to the East Field Storage Shed, take 6 more bags to the South Equipment Barn, and deliver the remaining 5 bags to the North Irrigation Depot, ensuring each location receives its specified quota without omission. After all bags are handed over, return to the Seed Warehouse and wait for the next assignment.

Start by moving to the main seed storage shed and collecting eight fertilizer pods. Evenly distribute these pods by delivering three pods to the west cornfield depot, three more to the south soybean staging area, and the remaining two pods to the north wheat plot, ensuring that each drop-off location receives its assigned number of pods. After each completed delivery, wait 15 minutes at the location to allow field personnel to confirm receipt and secure the pods before proceeding to the next site. After all pods have been delivered and confirmed, return directly to the equipment maintenance bay for further task assignments.

Collect nine fertilizer containers from the Supply Shed and deliver three containers each to Crop Plot East, Crop Plot North, and Crop Plot West, ensuring that if there happens to be a remainder, the final container is allocated to Crop Plot North. After you have completed the deliveries to all plots, remain at Crop Plot West for twelve minutes to supervise initial distribution by the field crew, and only proceed back to the Supply Shed after the field crew at Crop Plot West confirms that the containers have been fully emptied.

Starting from the loading dock, collect a batch of seven freshly packed produce crates and ensure all crates are secured. Transport three crates to the southern market stall and wait there for four minutes to allow the market staff to unload them completely; after the unloading is confirmed, continue by taking two crates to the packaging facility’s receiving bay, where you must wait until staff signal that the bay is clear for drop-off. With the remaining two crates, proceed directly to the cold storage unit at the western end and deposit them on the labeled intake shelf. After all crates have been successfully delivered to their respective destinations, return to the loading dock, ensuring the cart is empty before awaiting your next assignment.

Start your mission at the maintenance bay, where you must collect six replacement air filters designated for scheduled equipment upkeep. Deliver two air filters to Pump Station Alpha and wait until the station technician confirms removal before proceeding. Next, transport another two air filters to the ventilation shaft access point in the South Field, but before unloading, remain idle for 3 minutes to allow environmental stabilization protocols to complete. Once the time has elapsed, wait for the environmental crew to remove both air filters from your platform. For the remaining two air filters, bring them to the machinery shed at the Western Perimeter, and only depart after the shed supervisor acknowledges receipt. After all deliveries are finalized, make your way back to the maintenance bay to stand by for the next assignment.

Begin at the supply depot and collect six irrigation hoses labeled for distribution. First, head to the east apple orchard and deliver two hoses to the maintenance post, then wait there for 8 minutes to ensure that the orchard crew receives the equipment. Next, proceed to the southern vineyard storage tent and leave another two hoses in the designated equipment bin; after placing the hoses, pause for 12 minutes to give staff time to log the drop-off. Once both drop-offs are complete and the waiting periods have elapsed, take the remaining two hoses to the central irrigation control hub, and deliver them to Bay 3. Only after verifying that all six hoses have been distributed and the waiting times at the orchard and vineyard have been observed, return to the supply depot and await further instructions.

Start at the Central Grain Storage Facility and collect a batch of fourteen empty sampling containers intended for the morning harvest analysis. First, bring five of the containers to the Cornfield North and wait for the agronomist to load them with soil samples, a process that will take seven minutes per batch. After the samples are loaded, proceed to Wheatfield East with five more containers, again waiting seven minutes as the field technician fills them. With the remaining four sampling containers, travel to Soy Plot B and wait an additional seven minutes for the technician to complete loading. Only after all containers at each location have been filled and secured should you return to the Central Grain Storage Facility, where you will deposit the samples into the analysis intake locker before notifying the facility manager that the morning collection is complete.

Begin at the Seed Storage Facility and collect twelve sealed seed canisters for distribution. Transport four seed canisters to Planter Robot Dock Alpha and wait there until the attendant confirms that the seed canisters have been fully loaded onto the dock's robot unit. Next, deliver another four seed canisters to Planter Robot Dock Bravo and wait for payload removal to be completed. Any remaining seed canisters, which may total four or fewer depending on prior unloading, must be brought to Planter Robot Dock Charlie. At Dock Charlie, remain on-site for seven minutes while maintenance staff inspect your cargo area for residual seed material before you move on. Only after all delivery confirmations from Docks Alpha, Bravo, and Charlie have been received, proceed to the Logistics Bay to report task completion and await further instructions.

Begin at the central loading dock and acquire four sealed crates of vegetable seedlings. Transport two crates to the hydroponic bay and wait there for 3 minutes as the farm technicians prepare the planting apparatus. Once the hydroponic bay technicians have removed their two crates, immediately deliver the third crate to the greenhouse annex, waiting for confirmation of crate acceptance. After receiving confirmation at the greenhouse annex, proceed with the final crate to the western field entrance, and remain there until a field supervisor collects the last crate, at which point you may leave the field and return to the central loading dock for your next assignment.

Start at the Harvest Control Center and collect a set of six soil sampling containers. For the first phase, travel to Field Plot A and deliver two soil sampling containers, waiting until the field technician at Plot A has removed them completely before proceeding. Next, head to Field Plot B with two more soil sampling containers, again waiting for complete removal by the technician at Plot B. Then, transport the final two soil sampling containers to Field Plot C and ensure they are unloaded by the local staff. After the last container has been removed at Field Plot C, proceed to the Equipment Cleaning Bay and remain there for a 12-minute decontamination period before returning directly to the Harvest Control Center, ensuring that the sequence of container drop-offs and waiting periods is followed exactly before beginning the decontamination wait.

Begin at the chemical storage depot and pick up nine sealed pesticide canisters, ensuring each canister is clearly labeled for inventory tracking. Transport three pesticide canisters to the greenhouse complex and wait until the greenhouse supervisor has prepared the sprayer units for refilling; after the canisters are accepted, head to the central orchard pump station to deliver another three canisters. Once the staff at the pump station confirms the canisters are safely received, proceed to the vineyard maintenance shed with the final three canisters, but pause outside the shed for five minutes before entering to allow for ongoing equipment sanitization to finish. Only after this five-minute wait, deliver the canisters to the vineyard staff, then return directly to the chemical storage depot to log the completion of all deliveries.

Begin at the parts warehouse and load nine replacement hydraulic filters, making sure all filters are securely stowed before departing. Next, proceed to Maintenance Bay 1 and deliver three hydraulic filters, waiting until maintenance staff completely remove all three filters from your payload compartment prior to moving on. After completing the first drop-off, travel to Maintenance Bay 2 to deliver another three hydraulic filters, pausing there as well until all filters have been confirmed as unloaded. Any remaining hydraulic filters should be taken to Maintenance Bay 3; if there are fewer than three filters left, deliver all of the remainder to Maintenance Bay 3 and wait for the staff to finish the removal process. Once deliveries to all bays are complete and your payload area is empty, stay docked at Maintenance Bay 3 for 10 minutes to allow for potential spare parts collection requests before returning to the parts warehouse.

Commence at the machine workshop and load a toolkit case intended for calibration tasks. Move to Wind Turbine 1 located along the northern ridge and wait until the technician signals that the toolkit case is ready for removal. Once the toolkit case has been fully offloaded, proceed to Solar Array Hub A in the eastern field; remain at Solar Array Hub A for exactly 10 minutes to allow engineers time to prepare diagnostic tools that require pickup. As soon as the diagnostic tools are ready, collect them and drive to the control lab inside the operations center near the main gate. Wait there until all diagnostic tools have been removed by lab personnel. After completing this sequence, return without delay to the machine workshop and await further instructions from the maintenance coordinator.

Start by retrieving four sealed crates of grain from the central storage warehouse and transport them to the north silo complex. Distribute the crates evenly across Silo A, Silo B, and Silo C—depositing one crate into each, and deliver the remaining crate to Silo D to ensure all silos receive at least one. After every crate drop-off, wait for 2 minutes at each silo while the receiving mechanism secures the payload, proceeding to the next silo only after confirmation. Once the final crate has been unloaded at Silo D, return directly to the central storage warehouse and remain there until dispatched for another collection task.

Commence your route at the main storage warehouse and load nine sacks of fertilizer onto your cart. Travel first to Greenhouse A and deliver three sacks of fertilizer, ensuring they are received by the head grower; before departing, wait for confirmation that all three sacks have been safely stored inside. Next, proceed to Crop Field Delta and offload another three sacks of fertilizer, verifying that the field supervisor acknowledges the delivery; if any sacks remain undelivered, wait an additional 5 minutes for the supervisor’s authorization before leaving. Finally, bring the remaining three sacks of fertilizer to the Orchard Utility Shed, and wait until the facility manager confirms receipt and removes the sacks from your cart. Only after all deliveries have been completed and receipts verified at each destination should you return to the main storage warehouse and park at Loading Bay 2, awaiting your next assignment.

Begin at Supply Warehouse North and load eight battery packs intended for field equipment recharge. Take three battery packs to the Western Soil Monitoring Station and remain onsite until the staff have removed those battery packs from your cargo bay. After the transfer is confirmed, deliver another three battery packs to the Eastern Surveillance Tower and wait for payload removal verification. The last two battery packs must be brought to the Central Maintenance Shed, where you must stay for five minutes so the maintenance supervisor can log and inspect the delivery. Once all battery packs have been distributed and confirmation of acceptance from every facility has been received, proceed directly to the Refueling Depot and wait there for ten minutes before initiating any new assignments.

Start at the equipment storage depot and load nine spare irrigation valves onto the robot. First, head to South Orchard Row 12 and deliver three irrigation valves, ensuring that the orchard manager has removed all three before departing. Next, travel to Field Shed B and distribute another three irrigation valves; wait at Field Shed B until the on-site technician confirms the valves have been collected. Proceed to the Main Reservoir Pump House and deliver the final three irrigation valves, then wait for six minutes to allow the maintenance crew to finish installation prep. After the waiting period at the Pump House, return promptly to the equipment storage depot to complete the round.

Begin at the equipment dispatch point adjacent to the maintenance garage, then proceed to the seed storage silo to pick up five bags of fertilizer pellets. Distribute the fertilizer pellets among three crop fields as follows: deliver two bags to Field Alpha and wait until all fertilizer has been removed, transport two bags to Field Beta and again wait for unloading to complete, and finally take the remaining one bag to Field Gamma. After every drop-off, make sure each bag is completely unloaded before departing for the next field. Once all fertilizer deliveries are complete, drive to the machine wash station near the western orchard and remain there for 7 minutes to allow equipment cleaning before the next assignment.

Start at the Central Packing Facility and retrieve a container holding 31 high-precision circuit modules. Transport the container first to the Electronic Assembly Line and stay for 8 minutes while assembly technicians inspect and unload exactly 12 modules; depart only after removal is complete. Next, deliver 10 modules to the Maintenance Bay on the south side and remain there until the maintenance supervisor removes all modules intended for that location. With the remaining 9 modules, proceed to the Quality Control Laboratory; after arrival, wait for 5 minutes to allow the inspection system to verify and accept the delivery. Following the final transfer, return to the Central Packing Facility and await further deployment instructions.

Start by navigating to the harvest storage dock adjacent to the southern field edge and retrieve a crate of packaged apples labeled 'Batch 14'. Next, proceed to Distribution Point 1 at the west parking bay and wait for staff to prepare the reception area for the delivery; after the area is ready, unload exactly 10 apples from the crate for local distribution. Following a mandatory wait of 7 minutes to finalize documentation at Distribution Point 1, continue to Distribution Point 2 located by the maintenance garage at the northern end of the property where you must deliver 12 apples, pausing again for 5 minutes to allow refrigeration staff to secure the apple shipment. Any apples remaining in the crate after these first two deliveries must be taken to Distribution Point 3 at the eastern market entrance, where you will deliver all remaining apples and wait for all apples to be removed before returning the emptied crate to the harvest storage dock to complete the mission.

Begin at the Seed Storage Facility by collecting a shipment of fifteen fertilizer canisters. Distribute the canisters in batches so that Greenhouse 1 receives five canisters on the first trip, Greenhouse 2 receives another five on the second trip, and Greenhouse 3 receives the remaining five on the final trip, making sure to return to the Seed Storage Facility between each delivery to reaffirm batch pickup. At each greenhouse stop, after placing the designated batch of five canisters, wait for the local operations manager to signal that the fertilizer canisters have been fully removed before proceeding. Once all three greenhouses have received their allocations and confirmed complete removal, travel to the Maintenance Bay and remain stationary for 180 seconds to allow for a scheduled system diagnostic before re-entering service.

Start by proceeding to Seed Storage Barn 2 and waiting until two seed pallets are prepared by the inventory manager. Once both pallets are ready, transport the first pallet to Cornfield Loading Zone and wait while a field technician offloads it. Afterward, continue to Wheatfield Access Point to deliver the second pallet and wait for the removal confirmation. Then, remain at Wheatfield Access Point for 5 minutes to allow for equipment reset before heading to Main Equipment Shed where you are to load a soil moisture sensor kit. Only if the soil moisture sensor kit is successfully loaded, proceed to Orchard Block C, and wait at the site until the sensor installation crew removes the kit. Upon completion of all drop-offs and confirmations, return directly to Seed Storage Barn 2 for the next assignment.

Start at the loading dock of Warehouse B and secure a crate containing sensitive irrigation sensors. Transport the crate without delay to Quality Control Lab A, and wait at the lab entrance until the technicians have confirmed receipt of the irrigation sensors and cleared your cargo bay. Once unloaded, proceed with the empty robot to Storage Silo Three in the northern field complex and wait there for 7 minutes, allowing the inventory team to prepare a shipment consisting of nine sealed fertilizer bags. Next, distribute these nine fertilizer bags evenly among Feedlot One, Feedlot Two, and Feedlot Three; deliver three bags to each feedlot, making a direct trip to each destination in turn and ensuring that you wait at every location until the full batch of three fertilizer bags has been fully offloaded at each spot. After all fertilizer bags have been distributed to the three feedlots, return to Warehouse B and remain at the loading dock until further scheduling instructions are issued.

Start at the south loading dock and retrieve twelve fertilizer containers labeled for field application. Evenly distribute the containers by delivering four containers each to the east greenhouse, the north wheat field storage shed, and the west maintenance barn, in that order. At each location, wait for the staff to remove all four fertilizer containers before proceeding to the next; only continue to the subsequent location once the current drop-off is fully unloaded. After the last delivery at the west maintenance barn has been confirmed and all fertilizer containers have been removed, remain at the barn for 5 minutes to allow the quality control supervisor to inspect the delivery, then return to the south loading dock to complete your task route.

Begin at the machinery workshop and collect a set of twelve replacement hydraulic filters, ensuring all filters are properly secured before departure. Move to Harvester Bay 1 and deliver four hydraulic filters, then wait until the maintenance crew has confirmed receipt and installation is underway. Next, proceed to Harvester Bay 2 and provide another four hydraulic filters, but before leaving, remain for 5 minutes to allow the maintenance crew to verify the compatibility of the delivered filters. Continue to Harvester Bay 3 with the final four filters, making sure to wait until all previous spare filters at Harvester Bay 3 have been removed before placing the new batch. Only after every filter has been delivered to its respective bay and all confirmations or wait periods have been satisfied should you return to the machinery workshop to complete the assignment.

Start by traveling to Storage Bay 2 to collect a pallet containing twenty seed bags. Distribute the seed bags among three planting zones: first, deliver seven seed bags to Field Sector Alpha, and wait until agricultural staff have removed all the bags. Then, bring another seven seed bags to Plot Bravo, waiting again until the unloading is complete. Finally, transport the remaining six seed bags to Greenhouse Annex, where you must remain until greenhouse personnel confirm receipt of every bag. After all deliveries are completed, proceed to Maintenance Dock B, wait exactly fifteen minutes for a scheduled diagnostic check, and only then return to Storage Bay 2 to complete your route.

Start at Tool Storage Bay A and collect five replacement hydraulic filters labeled 'Model X12'. Transport the filters to Maintenance Station Alpha, Maintenance Station Beta, and Maintenance Station Gamma, allocating one filter to each station in that order. After dropping off a filter and confirming its removal at both Maintenance Station Alpha and Maintenance Station Beta, proceed to Maintenance Station Delta with the two remaining filters and distribute them both there, instructing the technician to record their receipt. Wait for 7 minutes upon arrival at Maintenance Station Delta to allow technicians to complete initial filter installations, then return to Tool Storage Bay A for subsequent missions.

Begin at the central maintenance bay and pick up a single diagnostic toolkit along with eight replacement hydraulic filters. Proceed to Field Equipment Station Alpha, and deliver three hydraulic filters, waiting until the station operator removes all three filters before moving on. After this task, continue to Irrigation Hub Bravo to deliver another three hydraulic filters, but only unload them if the station has signaled it is ready for restock; if there is no readiness signal, wait for five minutes and check again before proceeding. Once both Field Equipment Station Alpha and Irrigation Hub Bravo have received their filters, bring the remaining two hydraulic filters to Storage Locker 7 in the northeast quadrant, and do not leave until a technician has transferred the filters from your payload. After all filter deliveries are complete, carry the diagnostic toolkit to Vehicle Hangar C, wait for the hangar supervisor to confirm that the toolkit is ready to be received, and finally return to the central maintenance bay to await your final inspection before ending your route.

Start at Field Maintenance Shed and collect the fuel canister labeled 'Fuel Canister Alpha.' Transport Fuel Canister Alpha to Tractor Station 1 and wait until the maintenance crew completes refueling and removes Fuel Canister Alpha from the robot. Once the canister is removed, proceed to Fertilizer Depot to retrieve three small fertilizer sacks, then make individual trips: deliver one fertilizer sack to Greenhouse A, another to Greenhouse B, and the third to Greenhouse C, pausing for two minutes at each greenhouse to allow for application setup by staff before leaving for the next destination. After all three sacks have been delivered and the wait times fulfilled, report back to Field Maintenance Shed to log completion of the supply run.

Start at the north equipment depot and collect seven containers of fertilizer. Distribute the fertilizer containers by delivering three to Orchard Plot Alpha, two to Greenhouse Beta, and two to Vineyard Gamma, making sure that Orchard Plot Alpha receives any remaining containers if the total amount is not evenly divisible. After each delivery, wait at the respective plot for 2 minutes to give agronomy staff time to unload and confirm receipt of the containers. Once all fertilizer containers have been delivered and receipt confirmed at every location, return to the north equipment depot and await further dispatch instructions.

Begin at the Crop Storage Shed and collect twelve fresh produce crates, ensuring that all crates are present before departing. Deliver five crates to the Farmers' Market Drop-off Zone, waiting until each crate is individually removed by the vendor staff; then transport four crates to the Refrigerated Processing Facility, pausing for 10 minutes after arrival to allow for temperature acclimation before the staff starts unloading, ensuring all crates are removed before proceeding. Finally, take the remaining three crates to the Quality Inspection Lab—wait for the arrival of the laboratory technician before unloading, and only depart once the last crate has been collected and the technician verbally confirms receipt. After all deliveries have been completed and verified at each location, return promptly to the Crop Storage Shed to conclude your mission.

Start at the fertilizer supply depot and retrieve a total of nine nutrient solution canisters labeled for different crop zones. Transport and deliver four canisters to the hydroponic tomato field, waiting at the field until the field supervisor confirms the canisters have been fully transferred. After the supervisor's confirmation, proceed to the high-density lettuce plot and deposit another three canisters, again waiting for the staff acknowledgment of receipt. Finally, take the remaining two canisters to the rooftop herb garden, and remain at this final location for 10 minutes to allow the irrigation system technician to integrate the canisters into the automated system before returning to the fertilizer supply depot for your next task assignment.

Begin by collecting a seed dispersal crate containing 17 units from the Storage Warehouse; promptly transport the crate to Field Alpha and distribute exactly 5 units there, ensuring each unit is fully unloaded before continuing. After Field Alpha's delivery, proceed to Field Beta where you should deliver another 6 units from the same crate, waiting after each drop-off until Field Beta's supervisor confirms the seed units have been properly removed. Carry the remaining 6 units to Field Gamma; once the delivery is completed, remain stationary for 4 minutes at Field Gamma to allow automated planting equipment to process the received seeds. Only after these tasks are finalized should you return the empty crate to the Storage Warehouse and await the next assignment.

Begin your task by navigating to the fertilizer bay located west of Greenhouse 2 to collect a batch of seven labeled fertilizer bags. Once loaded, proceed directly to Irrigation Pump Station 1, and unload two fertilizer bags for the maintenance crew, ensuring to wait until you receive confirmation that both bags have been removed from your platform. After this, continue to the open storage shelter at Field Gamma, where you are to deposit three additional fertilizer bags. Remain at Field Gamma until the inventory handler signals that all three bags have been collected. The final two fertilizer bags must then be delivered to the compost yard near the northern boundary; once there, stay until the compost sorting conveyor has fully offloaded your payload. Upon completion of all deliveries, return to the fertilizer bay and stand by for five minutes to allow for system diagnostics before commencing any further operations.

Prepare for the morning cycle by starting at Grain Silo A and collecting a supply hopper filled with 47 kilograms of processed wheat grain. You must then distribute the wheat across three poultry feeding stations: Feeding Station West, Feeding Station Central, and Feeding Station East. Deliver exactly 15 kilograms of grain to Feeding Station West, followed by a mandatory 6-minute pause to allow feeding to begin and the staff to inspect the dispenser. Afterward, deliver another 15 kilograms of processed wheat to Feeding Station Central, waiting for 4 minutes at that site for the station's auger to complete intake verification. The remaining 17 kilograms should be transported to Feeding Station East; wait until staff confirm removal of the entire delivery before returning to Grain Silo A with the now-empty supply hopper, ensuring it is placed back on the loading rack to prepare for subsequent use.

Start at the regional tool depot and retrieve a batch of eleven specialized irrigation valves, ensuring all valves are securely loaded. Transport four irrigation valves to the south maintenance bay first, and once the south maintenance crew has removed their allotted valves, deliver the next four valves to the northern pump station, where you must wait for five minutes after arrival before the technicians can take the delivery. With the remaining three irrigation valves, proceed to the east perimeter control shed, but only enter the shed if the northern pump station technicians have finished removing their valves; after the east shed team has collected their share, return to the regional tool depot to complete your delivery loop.

Begin at the fertilizer depot adjacent to the greenhouse complex and collect six sealed fertilizer drums. Transport the first two drums to Field Plot Alpha and leave them at the designated drop-off zone; then move the next two drums to Field Plot Beta, repeating the same procedure. Allocate the final two drums to Field Plot Gamma. After each drum delivery, remain on site for 3 minutes to confirm that field staff have unloaded and positioned the drums correctly at the respective plot, proceeding to the next delivery only after the confirmation is received. Once all drums are distributed and properly unloaded at all three plots, proceed to the watershed runoff monitoring shed by the eastern creek and wait there for 10 minutes to allow environmental sensors to calibrate before returning to the fertilizer depot to conclude your route.

Begin by traveling to the material warehouse on the east side of the campus to collect a shipment of twelve metal component boxes. Distribute these boxes among Assembly Line 1, Assembly Line 2, and Assembly Line 3 by delivering five boxes to Assembly Line 1, four to Assembly Line 2, and the remaining three to Assembly Line 3, ensuring that every assembly line receives its allotted number of boxes sequentially. After dropping off boxes at each assembly line, wait at the location for 3 minutes to allow staff to unload and check the component boxes before proceeding to the next assembly line. Once all deliveries are complete and unloading has been verified at all three sites, proceed to the quality control bay located near the central loading dock and remain there for further operational instructions.

Begin at the orchard supply warehouse and load a total of ten pollination sensor modules designated for deployment. Travel first to the west grove and install four pollination sensor modules there, making sure each module is ready before proceeding. After the west grove receives its modules, head to the central operations hub and distribute three pollination sensor modules, waiting for two minutes at the hub after unloading to allow systems calibration. Only after this wait should you proceed to the southern boundary field and deliver the remaining three pollination sensor modules; ensure that you do not begin the southern field drop-off until the central hub's calibration time has elapsed. Once all deliveries are finalized, return directly to the orchard supply warehouse and await further instructions.

Begin by traveling to the Finished Goods Storage and collect twelve crates of packaged produce, ensuring all crates are loaded before departure. Once the loading is confirmed, proceed first to Shipping Dock A and deliver five crates there, waiting until all five have been successfully removed by the dock staff. After the crates have been fully received at Dock A, navigate to Shipping Dock B with four additional crates, and remain at that location until the staff at Dock B complete the removal. Proceed to Shipping Dock C with the remaining three crates regardless of their type, staying at the dock until the staff have taken possession of the entire payload. Once all deliveries are complete, wait at Shipping Dock C for a duration of 6 minutes in case there are urgent dispatch orders, and only after this waiting period return to the Finished Goods Storage to report availability for the next assignment.

Start by proceeding from the north farm gate to the central packing shed to pick up a set of eight empty harvest crates. Next, evenly distribute the crates across three harvest sites: deliver three crates to Berry Patch Delta and wait for the crew to completely unload all three, then bring three more crates to Orchard Row Five and wait until unloading is confirmed, and finally transport the remaining two crates to Field Station Maple, ensuring all crates are removed before moving on. After each site’s unloading is verified, pause for exactly 5 minutes at Field Station Maple before returning to the equipment launch pad. This sequence ensures balanced distribution and accommodates the time required for on-site coordination at the last location.

Begin by traveling to the seed storage warehouse and collect seven labeled fertilizer bags. Proceed by delivering three fertilizer bags to the north crop field distribution point, waiting until the on-site supervisor confirms that all three bags have been fully removed before continuing. Next, transport two fertilizer bags to the east orchard gate and wait for 6 minutes after arrival to allow the orchard manager enough time to prepare the unloading area before transferring the bags. Lastly, deliver the remaining two fertilizer bags to the greenhouse loading dock on the southern edge, and wait for the logistics team to remove both bags, ensuring all fertilizer bags have been delivered and acknowledged at their respective destinations before returning to the seed storage warehouse.

From the Grain Processing Facility, collect a batch of fifteen seed sample containers destined for regional analysis. Head first to the Quality Control Lab and deliver five containers, remaining on site until all five containers are carefully examined and the technician signals readiness for the next drop. After receiving confirmation, travel to Storage Silo 12 where an agronomist awaits; provide another five containers and wait while they verify and remove the samples. Only once both the lab and silo transfers are fully complete, proceed to the Crop Research Pavilion and supply the final five containers, lingering for an additional 10 minutes in case further documentation needs arise. Upon completion of the wait at the pavilion, promptly return the empty transport module to the Grain Processing Facility and stand by for follow-up instructions.

Begin at Charging Station West and travel to Orchard Supply Depot to collect a pallet of tree sapling pots after receiving confirmation that the pallet is ready. Proceed to Planting Zone A and unload twelve sapling pots, then continue to Planting Zone B to deliver another twelve, and finally allocate the remaining twelve sapling pots to Planting Zone C, explicitly ensuring that each zone receives its portion before continuing to the next. Wait for five minutes after the last delivery at Planting Zone C to allow field workers to inspect and accept the sapling pots, then return the empty pallet to Orchard Supply Depot. Only after the empty pallet has been officially removed by depot staff, travel to Charging Station West and wait for further instructions.

Commence operations at the West Field Equipment Dock by collecting six battery packs needed for the day's drone harvesters. Evenly distribute the battery packs by transporting two at a time, first to the East Field Charging Station, then to the Central Orchard Drone Hangar, and finally to the North Ridge Control Post, ensuring that every destination receives two battery packs in total and that any extra pack is transferred to the North Ridge Control Post if not divisible. After each delivery, pause at the delivery site until the field supervisor confirms the safe removal of the battery packs before returning to the Equipment Dock for the next batch. Once all battery packs are delivered and confirmation is received at the final destination, proceed directly to the Cold Storage Warehouse and wait 240 seconds to synchronize schedules with the incoming shift before accepting new assignments.

Begin at Charging Station A and proceed to the fertilizer depot to pick up a shipment consisting of twelve fertilizer canisters. Divide the canisters among four different field plots, delivering three canisters to Field 1 East first—you must wait at Field 1 East until all three fertilizer canisters are unloaded by field staff. Next, carry another three canisters to Field 2 North and remain there until the canisters are fully removed. The third stop is Field 3 West for another set of three canisters; again, wait until unloading is finished. Deliver the final three canisters to Orchard Block C, staying onsite until orchard staff confirm all canisters have been accounted for. As soon as all deliveries are complete, go directly to Maintenance Bay 5. Wait for ten minutes to allow for a mandatory system check before returning to Charging Station A to finish the task sequence.

Begin your task at the North Greenhouse Loading Area, where you will collect a shipment of eight sealed seed trays designated for delivery. Distribute these seed trays across three separate cultivation zones as evenly as possible: deliver three trays to Cultivation Zone Alpha, transfer another three trays to Cultivation Zone Beta, and bring the remaining two trays to Cultivation Zone Gamma; wait at each location until a horticulturist signals that they have finished unloading the seed trays before moving on to the next. Once all trays have been distributed and confirmed as received, proceed to the Main Sensor Calibration Shed and wait there for a continuous period of 10 minutes to allow technicians to inspect your mechanical systems. After the inspection window concludes, return directly to the North Greenhouse Loading Area for standby instructions.

Start at the central grain silo and collect nine seed dispersal units designated for spring planting campaigns. Allocate the nine seed dispersal units by delivering three units each to Field Alpha, Field Beta, and Field Gamma; ensure that if there is any difficulty unloading at a particular field, do not proceed to the next destination until all three units for the current field have been successfully transferred and removed by the field supervisor. After completing the drop-offs at all three fields, return to the central grain silo but wait exactly 10 minutes before initiating the next collection cycle, even if you arrive early, to coordinate with scheduled refueling procedures.

Start at the Central Equipment Depot and retrieve twelve replacement air filters, then allocate these filters among four livestock barn storage rooms as follows: deliver three filters each to Barn Storage A, Barn Storage B, and Barn Storage C, and allocate the remaining three filters to Barn Storage D. At each barn storage room, wait until maintenance staff remove the delivered air filters before proceeding to the next location. After all four barns have received their filters and the staff have cleared them from your cargo bay, pause for seven minutes at the last visited barn storage room to allow ventilation systems to stabilize before navigating directly to the West Perimeter Maintenance Garage for system diagnostics.
