Start at Maintenance Bay A and collect a package of 15 replacement hydraulic filters. Next, distribute these filters by delivering five to Tractor Garage North, four to Greenhouse Workshop, and four to Irrigation Control Room; return to Maintenance Bay A with the remaining two filters. For each location, remain on site until a technician has removed the assigned filters from the robot. After completing all deliveries, wait for five minutes at Maintenance Bay A before initiating any further assigned operations, allowing engineers to inspect the empty cargo compartment.

Start at the central equipment depot and load nine replacement irrigation hoses. Distribute these hoses by delivering four to Pump Station West, three to the South Field technician station, and the remaining two to the North Orchard repair shed, ensuring each location receives its allocated quantity and no hoses remain undelivered. At every destination, wait while the local technician removes all designated hoses from the cargo bay before proceeding to the next site. Once the final drop-off at the North Orchard repair shed is confirmed complete, continue to the chemical storage zone, where you must remain stationary for exactly 10 minutes to accommodate a mandatory decontamination cycle prior to returning to the central equipment depot.

Begin at Warehouse Bay 5 and collect six cartons of spare tractor parts. Deliver two cartons each to the Maintenance Workshop, the Field Repair Station, and the Outlying Equipment Shed, making sure each location receives only its allotment. After dropping off the cartons at any location, wait until the onsite supervisor confirms receipt before proceeding to the next. If, at any drop-off, the recipient is not present, wait for two minutes before attempting handover again; resume deliveries in the original order only after successful transfers. Once all cartons have been delivered and confirmed, return to Warehouse Bay 5 and remain there for at least five minutes before awaiting further dispatch instructions.

Begin at the central cold storage unit and retrieve six insulated seafood crates listed for outbound shipping. First, bring two crates to Dock A, where you must wait until a quality inspector at Dock A verifies the crate labels match the manifest before you leave. After this confirmation, carry another two crates directly to Dock B, but pause there for a mandatory 5-minute thawing period before leaving the crates at the designated drop-off point; only after this waiting period may you continue. The final two insulated seafood crates should be transported to Dock C, and upon arrival, wait by the Dock C weighbridge until a technician removes both crates from your payload. Once all crates have been successfully delivered and the last technician has completed removal, proceed back to the central cold storage unit and await further delivery instructions.

Start inside Warehouse Section B, where you should collect fifteen boxed precision components prepared for shipment. Divide the components as evenly as possible: deliver five boxes to Assembly Line 1 and wait on site until the automated hoist system has retrieved all five, confirmed by an indicator. After this, carry another five boxes to Storage Area Q, and wait for six minutes to allow the quality control team to inspect and log the delivery. With the remaining five boxes, navigate to Quality Lab 4, but only proceed with drop-off if confirmation has been received from Assembly Line 1 that their delivery is complete; otherwise, remain at Storage Area Q until that confirmation comes through. After successfully depositing the last batch at Quality Lab 4 and verifying that all components are unloaded, return directly to Warehouse Section B to report the cycle's completion.

Travel to the Seed Depot and pick up fifteen bags of certified wheat seed, verifying that all bags are secured before departing. Once loaded, bring five bags to Planter Row Alpha and wait until all five bags of wheat seed have been emptied from your container by the crew. After this is finished, continue with another five-bag load directly to Planter Row Bravo, again remaining onsite until the field operators have completely removed all five bags. Take the last five bags of wheat seed to Planter Row Charlie, waiting at that location until every bag has been offloaded as confirmed by ground staff. After all seed deliveries are complete, proceed to the Equipment Maintenance Shed and pause operations for 10 minutes to await a scheduled service check before returning to the Seed Depot to prepare for your next assignment.

Begin your assignment at the equipment depot adjacent to Loading Dock B, where you will retrieve six sealed crates of replacement drip lines from the storage rack. Transport the entire load first to Greenhouse Alpha and deliver two crates to the tool station near the east entrance, remaining stationed there until you observe both crates being fully removed by the greenhouse technician. Next, proceed to Field Outpost Delta and transfer another two crates onto the platform beside the irrigation manifold; ensure you wait until both crates at this location are confirmed as offloaded. After completing these drop-offs, drive to the southern Soil Testing Shed and unload the final two crates, waiting until the shed attendant verifies successful collection of your payload. Once all crates have been distributed and respective removal signals received at each site, return to the equipment depot and wait exactly 7 minutes for system cooling procedures before you accept subsequent dispatch tasks.

Start at the Packing Plant Loading Dock and pick up nine pallets of boxed produce, ensuring all are loaded before proceeding. Distribute these pallets among three destinations: deliver three pallets to the Southeast Chilled Storage Room, three pallets to the North Distribution Hub, and allocate the remaining three pallets to the West Side Grocery Dispatch. At each destination, wait until staff signal that the delivered pallets are ready to be offloaded before proceeding to the next drop. After the final delivery at the West Side Grocery Dispatch, wait for five minutes in the dispatch area for a quality assurance inspector to complete a brief cargo check before returning to the Packing Plant Maintenance Bay for a routine equipment inspection.

Begin at the workshop loading bay and collect five sealed containers of precision seeds from the storage rack. Proceed to Field Alpha and deliver two seed containers, waiting for the field supervisor to signal completion of unloading before continuing. Next, transport another two seed containers to Field Beta, but after arrival, you must wait for seven minutes to allow the irrigation system to finish pre-soaking the soil before placing the containers at the distribution point. Finally, deliver the last remaining seed container to Field Gamma; upon arrival there, do not release the container until the remote field technician confirms readiness via the Field Gamma terminal. Once all seed containers are delivered and confirmations are received at each location, return to the workshop loading bay and remain there until the next assignment is issued.

Commence operations at the Central Seed Warehouse by collecting six bins of genetically-tagged corn seeds and verify that the robot's payload bay is securely latched before departure. Proceed first to Distribution Point Alpha and offload two seed bins; after the local agronomist removes both bins and acknowledges receipt, wait for five minutes to allow for an on-site calibration process. Next, travel to Distribution Point Bravo and deliver another two bins, remaining stationary until both bins are fully unloaded. For the remaining two seed bins, continue to Distribution Point Charlie, where you will wait until the field crew confirms payload removal. After distributing all bins, return to the Central Seed Warehouse without delay to report mission completion.

Start at the seed warehouse adjacent to Field 3 and load a batch of fourteen irrigation monitoring sensors onto your robot. Navigate to the east quadrant of Field 3 and distribute five sensors along the eastern perimeter, waiting 120 seconds at each drop-off point to allow field technicians to verify proper installation. Once all five sensors have been left and verified in the east quadrant, proceed to the southern edge of Field 3 and unload another five sensors, pausing for three minutes at the southern boundary while the sensors are calibrated in place. After the southern drops and waiting period, continue to the equipment station on the north side of Field 3 to deliver the remaining four sensors; if and only if the equipment station supervisor finishes the check-in process for all four sensors, then advance to the central farm office for route completion confirmation.

Start your route at Maintenance Bay Three by picking up a repair kit and two spare hydraulic filters, then proceed to Dock A and wait until a maintenance supervisor signals that the dock's machinery is powered down before initiating the repair kit delivery. Once the kit has been removed at Dock A, immediately continue to Silo Four, where you must deliver one hydraulic filter and then wait for two minutes at Silo Four to allow the receiving technician to finish testing the filter. After this waiting period, take the remaining hydraulic filter to Field Workshop Delta, where delivery is only complete once the senior mechanic confirms the filter's installation. Make your way back to Maintenance Bay Three only after all payloads have been confirmed as removed from each destination.

Begin at the Main Equipment Garage and move directly to the Solar Panel Field to collect a box of diagnostic tools required for maintenance. After securing the box, proceed to Maintenance Bay 1 and deliver the tools at the intake counter, waiting for 10 minutes while the technicians prepare the next set of replacement batteries. Once the replacement batteries are ready, pick them up and transport them to three different destinations: deliver two batteries to the Southern Tractor Shed, three batteries to the Eastern Harvester Station, and assign the remaining battery to the Central Irrigation Control Room. At each drop-off point, wait until local staff confirm the battery has been properly stored before continuing to the next. After completing the final delivery at the Central Irrigation Control Room, return to the Main Equipment Garage and remain there until new maintenance requests become available.

Begin at Storage Dock C and retrieve a crate containing 11 soil moisture sensors. Transport these sensors to Field Plot 1 and deliver four sensors to the monitoring station, then proceed to Field Plot 2 to hand over another four sensors at the data relay post. After that, travel to Field Plot 3 and deliver the remaining three sensors to the analysis tent. At each plot, wait until a designated field technician has confirmed removal of that plot’s allocated sensors from the robot. Once all deliveries are complete, stay at the analysis tent in Field Plot 3 for 10 minutes to assist in sensor calibration procedures before returning directly to Storage Dock C to log completion of the task.

Begin at the central storage warehouse and collect a crate containing nine soil sensor modules. Proceed to Greenhouse One to deliver three soil sensor modules, waiting there for four minutes to give the greenhouse staff enough time to review and sign off on the partial delivery. Once the waiting period is over, move to Orchard Block East and drop off another three sensor modules, ensuring that a facility technician confirms the removal of all three modules before leaving. Continue to Research Plot Seven, where you must deliver the final three soil sensor modules; remain at Research Plot Seven until all modules have been removed from the crate. Only after confirming that all modules have been delivered in full to their respective locations may you return to the central storage warehouse to conclude your route.

Begin by navigating to the packing dock and load twelve fertilizer canisters onto your platform. Next, evenly distribute the canisters among Field Alpha, Greenhouse Two, and Orchard West by transporting four fertilizer canisters to each location in sequential order, starting with Field Alpha. For every delivery, after depositing the set of four canisters at a location, remain at that spot for five minutes so that the field management crew can organize the supplies before you proceed to the next site. Once the last batch of four canisters has been delivered to Orchard West and the five-minute wait is over, return directly to the equipment maintenance bay to complete your task round.

Start at Maintenance Garage 2 and make your way to the Spare Parts Warehouse to collect three replacement hydraulic pumps after verifying the parts are ready for pickup. Once the pumps are secured, deliver one hydraulic pump to Greenhouse Alpha and wait for facility staff to remove it before proceeding. Following removal confirmation, transport the second hydraulic pump to Tractor Shed North, and do not leave until a mechanic has picked up the pump. After this return to the Spare Parts Warehouse with the remaining hydraulic pump and wait for three minutes outside to allow warehouse staff to prepare for return processing; once the waiting period is over, take the final hydraulic pump to Field Repair Station Delta. Only after all pumps have been delivered and their respective pickups completed, return to Maintenance Garage 2 and await further deployment instructions.

Start at Loading Dock 2 and navigate to Storage Bunker Alpha to collect twenty seed trays designated for planting. Distribute these trays evenly across Greenhouse 1, Greenhouse 2, and Greenhouse 3—delivering six seed trays to each greenhouse, and if there are any remaining trays after this initial distribution, bring the last two seed trays to Greenhouse 2 to accommodate high-priority crops. Between each greenhouse delivery, wait for three minutes to allow horticulture staff to confirm each seed tray has been properly received before proceeding to the next destination. After delivering the final trays and receiving confirmation from Greenhouse 2, travel to Refueling Station C, wait for five minutes to complete a necessary battery recharge, and only then return to Loading Dock 2 to complete the assignment.

Begin at Cold Storage Facility A and collect nine insulated food containers designated for delivery. Transport three containers each to the South Gate Drop-off Point, the Administration Loading Dock, and the Greenhouse Entry Zone, deliberately ensuring that every location receives exactly three containers before proceeding to the next. After each delivery is made, remain at the destination for five minutes to account for temperature stabilization requirements and wait for confirmation from the local staff that the cold chain has not been interrupted. Only after receiving verbal confirmation or written notice at each site should you continue to the next drop-off; if confirmation is not received within the five-minute window, repeat the waiting period once more. Upon completing all deliveries and confirmations, return to Cold Storage Facility A and position yourself at the designated recharge stall to await further instructions.

Start by collecting a crate containing nine high-efficiency irrigation sensors from the Equipment Warehouse. Transport three sensors to Greenhouse Alpha and wait at Greenhouse Alpha until all three sensors have been unloaded by the greenhouse manager. Next, continue to Field Beta Distribution Point with another three sensors; after confirming the completion of this delivery with the field supervisor, remain at Field Beta Distribution Point for 7 minutes to allow irrigation technicians to calibrate the newly installed sensors in your presence. Once the wait period concludes, bring the final three sensors to the Orchard Control Shed, and do not depart until you receive confirmation that all three sensors have been successfully integrated into the orchard’s monitoring system. When all sensors are delivered and all waiting periods are satisfied, return the empty crate directly to the Equipment Warehouse and await further deployment instructions.

Begin in Maintenance Bay 2 and collect a shipment of 17 replacement drive belts. Travel first to Assembly Line West to deliver 6 drive belts directly to the line supervisor, then proceed to Conveyor Repair Bay where you must hand over another 5 drive belts to the repair lead. Continue to Quality Control Lab and deliver the remaining 6 drive belts to the testing engineer. At each of the three destinations, wait until the designated recipient confirms the removal of their allocated drive belts from the robot before proceeding to the next location. Once the final delivery at Quality Control Lab is confirmed, remain on standby in the lab for a period of 8 minutes to allow for initial installation assessments before returning to Maintenance Bay 2 to report the completion of all deliveries.

Start at the Loading Dock A by picking up a shipment of twenty-one fertilizer pouches, ensuring all pouches are secured before departure. Travel to Greenhouse West, and deposit six fertilizer pouches there, remaining on site for two minutes each time a pouch is handed over so that greenhouse staff can log each delivery; proceed next to Storage Shed 2 and allocate an additional eight pouches, also pausing for 90 seconds at each handoff to enable inspection by the storage supervisor. After deliveries to both Greenhouse West and Storage Shed 2 are completed, continue to Orchard Block 5 with the remaining seven pouches, where you must wait until all pouches are manually unloaded by the orchard manager. Only after confirmation of complete unloading at Orchard Block 5 are you to return to Loading Dock A and await further deployment details. Distribute the pouches evenly as described, and if a location cannot accept its allocated number of pouches, transfer any surplus directly to the next destination in the sequence before proceeding.

Begin at the supply warehouse adjacent to the main processing plant. Retrieve twelve sealed cartons of irrigation sensors and confirm their readiness with the warehouse manager. Next, distribute these twelve cartons evenly by delivering four cartons to the Northern Equipment Hub, four to the Central Field Station, and four to the Southern Maintenance Outpost; if there is any difficulty unloading at any of the destinations, wait for the station technician to confirm that all cartons have been removed before moving to the next location. After all deliveries are complete, proceed immediately to the Field Supervisor's Control Trailer and wait for a continuous period of 8 minutes to allow staff to review delivery records and provide feedback on sensor conditions. Only after this wait has elapsed, head to the mobile charging bay near Dock 3 for final system diagnostics.

Start at the Main Equipment Depot and pick up three battery packs and five protective tool kits. Transport two battery packs to Maintenance Bay A, wait until the technician removes both battery packs from the robot, and then remain at Maintenance Bay A for ten minutes while the maintenance team performs diagnostics. After the waiting period, deliver one battery pack to Maintenance Bay B, waiting until it is fully unloaded by the staff. Next, evenly distribute the five protective tool kits by bringing two to Field Outpost 1, two to Field Outpost 2, and the remaining one to Field Outpost 3, ensuring at each location to wait until the outpost supervisor removes the corresponding tool kits from the robot before proceeding to the next destination. After all battery packs and tool kits have been delivered, return directly to the Main Equipment Depot and await further instructions.

Start at the fertilizer storage depot near the east entry of the compound and acquire a total of seven 25-kg bags of premium fertilizer, verifying with the depot supervisor that the payload is ready for transport. The distribution should be as follows: deliver three bags to the North Field Equipment Shed, where you must wait until all three bags have been fully unloaded by the field team. After confirming removal at the North Field Equipment Shed, proceed to the Central Irrigation Control Room with two fertilizer bags, and after arrival, wait for 4 minutes to allow the technicians to inspect and remove both bags. Finally, with the remaining two bags, head to the Greenhouse Assembly Annex at the southern perimeter, and remain on site until the greenhouse supervisor removes the fertilizer. Only after these steps are completed, return to the fertilizer storage depot to complete your shift.

Begin at the southern operations depot and collect a total of fourteen empty water containers. Travel first to Pump Station X and drop off five containers, pausing at the station until all containers have been refilled before continuing. Afterward, proceed to Field Delta and deliver four refilled water containers, ensuring the field sensors indicate each container has been received before leaving. The remaining five containers should be split between Greenhouse 1 and Greenhouse 2, with three containers going to Greenhouse 1 and the final two delivered to Greenhouse 2; for each greenhouse, wait outside until all containers are fully unloaded and restocked by greenhouse staff. Once each delivery has been completed and verified at its destination, return to the southern operations depot and remain there for ten minutes to accommodate scheduled system diagnostics before your next set of instructions.

Start at Maintenance Bay 3 and pick up six robotic planter modules destined for equipment upgrades. First, travel to Field Delta Upgrade Station and deliver two modules, waiting at the station until a technician completes the installation of both units. Once installation is verified, move to Silo 8 Loading Dock to offload another two modules; after drop-off, pause at the loading dock for 4 minutes to allow quality assurance checks before proceeding. Finally, transport the remaining two planter modules to Processing Facility C, ensuring that these last modules are not released until the facility supervisor notifies you that all safety protocols are in place. After all modules have been delivered and all designated waiting periods are complete, return directly to Maintenance Bay 3 for inspection and standby.

Begin at the robotics charging bay and collect the machine calibration toolkit assigned for the day’s preventive maintenance. Travel directly to Assembly Line 3 in Factory Hall A and deliver the calibration toolkit to the maintenance supervisor, staying there until the supervisor has removed the toolkit and confirmed successful receipt. Once this handoff is confirmed, proceed to the Paint Shop loading dock to pick up a pallet containing nine cans of high-durability industrial paint. To distribute the paint appropriately, deliver three cans each to the Automated Conveyor Station, the Forklift Fleet Storage, and the Machine Parts Storage Room, ensuring that at each stop, the staff have received and unloaded exactly three cans before proceeding to the next location. After all deliveries are complete, return the empty pallet to the Paint Shop loading dock, remain dockside for seven minutes, and then navigate back to the robotics charging bay to await the next operational cycle.

Begin at Loading Dock A and collect a batch of 26 soil nutrient sample kits from the storage cabinet. Transport 8 sample kits to Field Plot Delta, and wait until the agronomist confirms receipt and removal of exactly 8 kits. Proceed to the Greenhouse Annex next, where you must deliver another 9 kits; remain at the Greenhouse Annex until the monitoring technician has finished unloading all 9 kits for their testing. After this delivery, take the remaining 9 nutrient sample kits to Soil Analysis Lab 3. Before leaving the lab, wait for a period of 5 minutes to allow the laboratory assistant to log the receipt of the sample kits and initiate the intake process. Once the wait is complete, return directly to Loading Dock A to conclude today's batch distribution tasks.

Start at the southern grain elevator and pick up a load of nine sealed grain sample containers. Deliver three grain sample containers each to the primary quality testing lab, the secondary processing facility, and the grain research center—in that order. After leaving the containers at each location, wait beside the designated receiving station for two minutes to verify that laboratory staff have acknowledged receipt before departing for the next site. Once all containers have been delivered and confirmations obtained from every location, drive to the vehicle charging station near the maintenance yard, remain there for five minutes to allow for a partial recharge, and finally return to the southern grain elevator to complete your task.

Start at the Main Parts Warehouse and collect a package of nine replacement hydraulic actuators needed for routine equipment servicing. First, transport three actuators to Maintenance Bay 1, then remain on-site until the technician completes the actuator installation, which will require six minutes per unit before they acknowledge readiness for removal. Afterwards, carry another three actuators to Maintenance Bay 2, but wait twelve minutes for mechanical preparations to finish before offloading, ensuring all actuators are installed before leaving. For the final three actuators, proceed to Maintenance Bay 3, where you must wait until the previous day’s old actuators have been cleared—this clearance is expected to take up to eight minutes—before handing over the new units. Once all actuators have been delivered and technician confirmations at each bay have been received, return directly to the Main Parts Warehouse and log the actuator transfer completion in the maintenance system before ending your route.

Start at the Seed Storage Facility and collect a total of seventeen nutrient packs, verifying that all seventeen packs are loaded securely before departing. Travel first to Greenhouse A to deliver six nutrient packs, waiting until greenhouse staff confirm all six nutrient packs have been unloaded before proceeding. Next, move to Greenhouse B with another six nutrient packs; after delivery, remain on-site for 7 minutes to allow staff to start their automated nutrient dispersal system. Finally, bring the remaining five nutrient packs to Greenhouse C, but pause at the entrance until all previously stored nutrient packs at Greenhouse C have been cleared out and relocated by staff. Only once deliveries to all greenhouses have been completed, including meeting every waiting or clearance requirement, should you return to the Seed Storage Facility and await further dispatch instructions there.

Start at the Central Supply Depot and retrieve nine sealed pesticide canisters, ensuring all canisters are secured before moving on. First, travel to Orchard Zone One and unload three pesticide canisters, waiting for the zone supervisor to fully remove each canister before continuing. After completing delivery at Orchard Zone One, proceed to Orchard Zone Two and deliver another three pesticide canisters, but pause for eight minutes upon arrival to allow the air circulation system to activate before any unloading begins; only after this wait should the canisters be released and the removal process by staff allowed. Once all canisters are accepted at Orchard Zone Two, transport the final three pesticide canisters to Orchard Zone Three, remain until all canisters have been taken by the local team, and then return to the Central Supply Depot, verifying that each orchard zone receives the correct number of canisters and all prerequisite waiting periods and staff removals have been completed at each stop before returning.

Begin at the Packing Shed and retrieve a full rack containing twelve trays of ripe tomatoes along with a spare wheel for the forklift. Next, divide the twelve trays of tomatoes as evenly as possible among the Greenhouse Sorting Area, the Market Loading Dock, and the Cafeteria Kitchen; deliver four trays to each destination, but if any remainder trays exist, deliver the extra tray first to the Market Loading Dock, then to the Cafeteria Kitchen, ensuring that no location receives more than one extra tray. After dropping all tomatoes, proceed without delay to the Maintenance Bay and deliver the spare forklift wheel to the technician; only once the wheel is confirmed received, wait at the Maintenance Bay for five minutes to accommodate possible urgent requests for additional spare parts from the staff. Upon completion of this pause, return directly to the Packing Shed for further instructions, ensuring that every location receives the correct number of tomato trays and that the spare wheel is delivered before any waiting occurs in the Maintenance Bay.

Start at Warehouse Sector 5 and pick up twelve pesticide canisters, then travel to Crop Field Alpha and deliver five canisters, pausing for three minutes to allow farmhands to transfer the canisters to onsite storage. Once the transfer at Crop Field Alpha is complete, head to Vineyard Block C and deliver four more canisters; wait at Vineyard Block C until you receive a signal from the supervisor that all four canisters have been removed before proceeding further. Carry the remaining three pesticide canisters to Equipment Maintenance Bay, but if the maintenance crew is unavailable upon arrival, wait for ten minutes in standby mode before returning to Warehouse Sector 5 to complete the cycle.

Initiate the task by proceeding to the Central Storage Depot to collect a total of nine sealed fertilizer barrels. These barrels must be distributed among Irrigation Point Alpha, Irrigation Point Beta, and Irrigation Point Gamma such that each location receives three barrels—deliver the barrels sequentially, starting with Irrigation Point Alpha. After each delivery of three fertilizer barrels, remain at the respective location for two minutes to enable system calibration and acknowledgment from the local control terminal before departing for the next Irrigation Point. Once the final three barrels have been delivered to Irrigation Point Gamma and the final two-minute wait has been completed, travel to the Equipment Cleaning Station at the main service hub and remain there until a technician confirms that all fertilizer residue has been removed from your delivery apparatus, at which point the task concludes.

Initiate your route at Storage Hangar Zulu and collect eight sealed pouches of plant micronutrient solution. Navigate to Orchard Sector 1 and dispense three pouches to the automated fertilization terminal, waiting at the terminal until all three pouches are removed by the dispensing system. Afterwards, continue to Irrigation Hub Bravo and deposit another three pouches on the supply rack, remaining present until confirmation is received that these pouches have been taken by the hub operator. With the remaining two pouches onboard, drive to Greenhouse Laboratory Theta and deliver both directly to the lab's chemical intake station, ensuring both are fully received by laboratory staff before departing. After all deliveries are completed and each site has acknowledged receipt, wait precisely 10 minutes at Greenhouse Laboratory Theta to allow for system calibration, after which you will return to Storage Hangar Zulu to finalize your cycle.

Start at the Main Seed Vault and pick up four marked seed crates required for distribution. Proceed first to Greenhouse A and deliver one seed crate, then wait until the greenhouse technician signals that the crate has been successfully unloaded. Afterward, continue to Irrigation Control Center where you must deliver two seed crates; remain on site until both crates have been fully removed and the irrigation supervisor provides confirmation. Before proceeding to the final delivery, wait at the Irrigation Control Center for 90 seconds to allow for inventory update synchronization. After the wait, travel to the South Field Trial Plot and deliver the remaining seed crate. Ensure that the trial plot manager has acknowledged receipt of the seed crate before returning to the Main Seed Vault to complete the route.

Begin at Seed Storage Bay and collect the crate labeled 'Hybrid Wheat Seeds.' Transport Hybrid Wheat Seeds to Sowing Platform Alpha and remain onsite until the platform operator confirms removal of the crate. Following successful drop-off, wait for three minutes to allow calibration of sowing machinery before retrieving four empty collection baskets from Platform Alpha. Next, distribute the baskets: deliver two baskets to Harvest Dock East, one to Sorting Zone Delta, and one to Crop Research Station; ensure that you pause at Harvest Dock East for one minute during each drop-off to facilitate staff handover before departing to subsequent locations. After all baskets are delivered and corresponding pauses completed, return to Seed Storage Bay to log the full task sequence and standby for further instructions.

Start your route at the Maintenance Bay and collect a set of fifteen engine filters, verifying that all filters are secure before departure. Visit Tractor Shed 1 first, deliver five filters, and remain on site until a mechanic removes each filter from your payload, ensuring this occurs before moving on. Once the filters have been successfully transferred at Tractor Shed 1, proceed to Tractor Shed 2, where you will hand off another five engine filters; wait for confirmation from the maintenance crew that they have received and logged every filter before continuing. Take the final five filters to Tractor Shed 3, and only after the on-site engineer confirms all filters are received and removed should you initiate a mandatory downtime period of ten minutes for recalibration. Following this waiting period, return to the Maintenance Bay to complete the mission, making certain you do not skip any location or waiting steps along the route—even if a Tractor Shed is temporarily unattended, remain at that location until the required personnel arrive for the transfer.

Begin at the Seed Vault and pick up a pallet containing twenty-seven seed trays for distribution to various planting zones. Transport an initial batch of nine seed trays to Planting Zone Alpha, and stay until field staff confirm all nine trays have been removed from the robot for setup. Next, head to Planting Zone Beta with another nine seed trays, but wait outside the gate for five minutes to allow irrigation equipment to clear the unloading area before you proceed to offload the trays, ensuring staff have retrieved all of them before continuing. For the remaining nine seed trays, deliver them to Planting Zone Gamma, and remain on-site until you receive confirmation that the planting beds in Zone Gamma are fully prepared, a process that should not exceed seven minutes. After all twenty-seven seed trays have been distributed evenly across the three planting zones and staff confirmations at each zone have been received, return to the Seed Vault to await further instructions.

Begin at the Tool Storage Facility and collect eight orange safety cones, confirming that all cones are securely fastened before departure. Next, travel to Loading Dock 7 and deliver three orange safety cones, waiting on site until the dock supervisor has removed all three cones from the carrier. Once the cones are fully unloaded, continue to Warehouse Entrance B where you will distribute another three orange safety cones; remain at Warehouse Entrance B until the facility attendant has taken all three cones and confirmed clearance. Transport the remaining two orange safety cones to the North Perimeter Gate, making sure not to leave the area until both cones have been retrieved by security staff. Once all eight cones have been successfully delivered and acknowledgments received at each location, proceed directly to the Charging Station Hub, pause your route there for 5 minutes to allow for battery diagnostics, and only afterward return to the Tool Storage Facility to finalize the task.

Begin at the Parts Storage Warehouse and secure eight hydraulic pump assemblies for delivery. Transport three hydraulic pump assemblies to the Vehicle Maintenance Bay, and wait until the mechanics there have fully removed all three hydraulic pump assemblies from the loading compartment. After unload confirmation, drive to the Eastern Loading Dock and deliver another three hydraulic pump assemblies, pausing at the site for four minutes to allow the incoming crew to verify and safely store the delivered equipment. Once the waiting period at the Eastern Loading Dock concludes, proceed with the final two hydraulic pump assemblies to the Agricultural Equipment Shed. Do not attempt drop-off at the Agricultural Equipment Shed until the shed supervisor has marked that their storage rack has enough space available for the hydraulic pump assemblies; only after this clearance is granted should you complete the delivery and return directly to the Parts Storage Warehouse for your next assignment.

Start your route at Storage Facility B and pick up nine sealed chemical drums. Deliver three drums to Processing Plant South first, waiting at the unloading area for six minutes to allow chemical safety checks before departing. Take the next three drums to Manufacturing Bay Seven, and after dropping them off, wait for a notification from plant staff confirming successful integration of the drums into the production line. Transport the final three drums to Laboratory Annex One, but before releasing them, you must wait for the lab manager to prepare the secure containment area—do not leave the site until this step is explicitly confirmed. After all drums are delivered and all waiting periods or confirmations at each destination are completed, immediately return to Storage Facility B and remain on standby for five minutes to await any emergency retrieval instructions that may be issued.

Start at Maintenance Bay One and collect a total of thirteen equipment toolkits intended for deployment across the field zones. Proceed to Field Zone Delta first and deliver five toolkits, waiting for the maintenance supervisor to signal that the entire shipment has been unloaded and logged. Afterward, travel to Field Zone Echo and offload four toolkits; remain at the unloading point for three minutes while safety inspectors complete a mandatory on-site check before you receive a go-ahead to leave. Next, transport the final four toolkits to Field Zone Foxtrot, and submit these toolkits only after the zone manager confirms Foxtrot is ready to receive new tools, which may require waiting until earlier deliveries to Delta and Echo are officially registered. If, during the route, you encounter locked entrances or blocked access at any zone, immediately return any undelivered toolkits to Maintenance Bay One before concluding your mission, ensuring each field zone receives its allocated quantity barring access restrictions.

Start at the Chemical Storage Area and collect nine sealed boxes of crop protection reagents. Distribute these boxes in the following manner: first, deliver three boxes to the West Soybean Plot Shed, waiting at the shed until the field technician has finished loading the reagent sprayers before leaving. After completion at the West Soybean Plot Shed, proceed to the Central Equipment Hub and transfer another three boxes, but do not depart until two minutes have passed, allowing the hub operators to perform safety checks on the chemical manifest. Next, carry two boxes to the South Cornfield Workshop, making sure you wait until a supervisor confirms receipt and proper storage of the boxes. For the last remaining box, bring it to the North Grain Silo Annex; before drop-off, ensure a staff member at the annex has completed the prior inventory check, after which you may leave the box. Once all deliveries are successfully completed and confirmed at each site, return immediately to the Chemical Storage Area to await further instructions.

Begin at Grain Storage Silo 1 and collect a shipment of fifteen labeled seed bags and a case of calibration weights used for machinery settings. Your goal is to distribute the fifteen seed bags equally among the East Corn Plot, South Wheat Plot, and the North Research Field: deliver five seed bags to each plot, but if there are any leftover bags, allocate the first extra bag to the North Research Field and the next to the East Corn Plot, ensuring no plot receives more than one extra. After finishing all seed deliveries, proceed immediately to the Central Equipment Depot and transfer the case of calibration weights to the instrumentation technician, waiting until the technician confirms receipt before proceeding. Once the transfer is acknowledged, remain at the Central Equipment Depot for 6 minutes to provide logistical support in case of urgent requests for spare equipment, and only after this waiting period has elapsed, return to Grain Storage Silo 1 to await subsequent assignments.

Start at the grain storage facility and load a shipment of twenty fertilizer drums onto your payload platform. Proceed first to Field Alpha to offload eight fertilizer drums, ensuring each drum is accounted for before you leave. Once Field Alpha has received its allocation, move on to Field Beta and transfer another seven fertilizer drums; after placing these drums, wait at Field Beta for five full minutes to allow field staff to prepare the application systems. Only after this waiting period, head to Field Gamma with the remaining five fertilizer drums, and distribute them there. Ensure all drums at each field have been confirmed as delivered before proceeding to the next location. After the last delivery at Field Gamma, return promptly to the grain storage facility and await further deployment instructions.

Begin your operation by moving to the Seed Supply Warehouse to acquire a single crate containing 24 standard greenhouse starter trays. Next, proceed to Greenhouse 1 and deliver 7 starter trays, awaiting confirmation from the greenhouse supervisor that all trays have been unloaded before continuing. After this, transfer 8 starter trays to Greenhouse 2; upon arrival, wait for precisely five minutes to allow on-site staff to stage the trays for planting, only then proceed onward. The remaining 9 starter trays must be taken to Greenhouse 3, but do not deposit them until the automated irrigation system confirms readiness for seeding, which may require a wait on location. Once the full delivery is complete and final confirmation is received at Greenhouse 3, return directly to the Seed Supply Warehouse, placing the empty crate onto the designated return shelf for inventory tracking, ensuring the cycle is ready for the next sequence of greenhouse tray deliveries.

Begin at the North Orchard Storage Shed and load twelve boxes of freshly harvested apples. Your first stop is Market Depot C, where you must deliver five boxes and wait for the produce inspector to confirm inventory before proceeding. Next, transport four boxes to the Juice Processing Center, but you must remain at the facility for four minutes to allow quality assessment before the boxes can be unloaded. Deliver the remaining three boxes to the School Cafeteria Receiving Dock, and ensure the cafeteria manager is present to authorize the receipt before departing. Once all apple boxes have been distributed and every required confirmation or waiting interval is complete, return directly to the North Orchard Storage Shed and wait there for six minutes in case of any last-minute shipping updates or additional dispatch requests from farm management.

Begin your route at the Seed Vault Warehouse and retrieve twelve sealed containers of premium wheat seeds. Evenly distribute the containers among the North Test Plot, the Central Planter Field, and the East Ridge Demonstration Plots, allocating four containers to each site. For the Central Planter Field, after you arrive, wait for the field manager to confirm the arrival by scanning each container before proceeding; only after the scan is complete should you move on. At the East Ridge Demonstration Plots, leave the containers but also remain on-site for five minutes to allow the research team to review the seed integrity. Continue by collecting three empty soil sample tubes from the East Ridge site and transport all three to the Soil Analysis Laboratory at the Main Facility, but do not begin this segment until the seed delivery period at the East Ridge is fully concluded. After the laboratory staff confirms removal of all soil tubes, navigate back to the Seed Vault Warehouse to indicate task completion.

Begin by collecting twenty pesticide canisters from Supply Zone Delta, ensuring all canisters are properly sealed and accounted for. Transport the entire batch to Field Sector East, and once on site, distribute the pesticide canisters among Spraying Drone Pad A, Spraying Drone Pad B, and Spraying Drone Pad C by allocating six canisters to each pad and delivering the two remaining canisters to Spraying Drone Pad C to account for the irregularity in distribution. At each pad, wait until ground crews confirm they have prepared the drones with the received canisters before proceeding to the next delivery location. After all canisters have been distributed and confirmed at every pad, stay at Spraying Drone Pad C for a period of five minutes to allow for system diagnostics to be performed on the robotic delivery system before returning to Supply Zone Delta to complete your assignment.

Starting at Maintenance Bay Gamma, pick up eight sensor calibration kits and head to Drone Hangar 1, but do not deliver the calibration kits until all faulty drone reports are received from Hangar Control. Once the reports are confirmed, deliver three calibration kits to Drone Hangar 1, wait exactly two minutes for technicians to install them, and then proceed to Drone Hangar 2 with three more calibration kits, pausing for another two minutes to allow further installations. Afterward, transport the remaining two calibration kits to Drone Hangar 3. Only after the last set of calibration kits are delivered and Hangar 3 technicians confirm receipt, go to Refuse Disposal Zone Zeta, where you must remain for five minutes to complete decontamination procedures. Finally, return to Maintenance Bay Gamma, but ensure the return trip only commences after decontamination is fully finished and clearance is granted by Zone Zeta staff.

Begin at Storage Facility Delta and pick up six sealed fertilizer containers and four pesticide sprayers, then proceed directly to Greenhouse 12. Wait for the greenhouse manager to confirm that all four pesticide sprayers are fully prepared and loaded onto the system before continuing. Next, evenly distribute the six fertilizer containers between Crop Field Alpha, Orchard Bravo, and Vegetable Plot Charlie, such that Crop Field Alpha and Orchard Bravo each receive two fertilizer containers, while Vegetable Plot Charlie receives the remaining two. At each destination, wait until the local supervisor removes the correct number of fertilizer containers from the robot before moving on to the next field. After all fertilizer and sprayers have been delivered, proceed to Equipment Wash Station Omega and remain there for seven minutes to complete the cleaning cycle, ensuring no return to Storage Facility Delta until the wash cycle is finished and the station attendant provides explicit release clearance.

Start at the Central Storage Depot and collect a total of sixteen fertilizer pallets. Allocate these pallets among the South Crop Field Loading Dock, the Northwest Vine Nursery, and the East Orchard Entrance, distributing five pallets at both the South Crop Field and Northeast Vine Nursery, and the remaining six pallets at the East Orchard Entrance to account for the division remainder. Once you have delivered pallets at the South Crop Field Loading Dock, wait on-site for two minutes to allow the dock foreman to sign off on the delivery; do not leave until this time elapses. After the final drop-off at the East Orchard Entrance, immediately proceed to the Equipment Sanitization Bay and remain there until all delivery containers from your previous payloads are collected and sanitized, which will be confirmed by the sanitation crew. Only once sanitization is complete should you return to the Central Storage Depot to await your next assignment.

Begin your mission at Supply Dock Echo by picking up five crates of precision irrigation nozzles after confirming they are ready for transport. Proceed immediately to Crop Field Gamma and unload two crates at the maintenance outpost, then stay until both crates are collected by the field technician. Once the technician has retrieved the nozzles, take the next two crates to Vineyard West Equipment Shed, pausing here for exactly five minutes before unloading to give the shed team time to prepare the storage rack. After the five-minute wait, hand over both crates and verify their removal by the equipment crew. Finally, transport the remaining single crate to Greenhouse Omega, but do not deliver it until all prior crate deliveries have been acknowledged; upon confirmation, wait for the greenhouse engineer to remove the last crate, then return directly to Supply Dock Echo for stand-down instructions.

Begin at the Field Maintenance Garage and pick up four water filtration modules. Transport one module to each of the following: the Northwest Irrigation Control Hub, the Central Pumping Station, and the South Canal Monitoring Post, ensuring that each location receives exactly one module. The fourth filtration module should be delivered to the East Reservoir Outflow after all previous modules have been dropped off. Upon arrival at each location, wait until the maintenance crew signals that the module is ready for installation before proceeding to the next destination. Once the last filtration module has been delivered to the East Reservoir Outflow and the readiness confirmed, wait at the outflow site for five minutes to monitor for emergency technician requests before returning directly to the Field Maintenance Garage.

Begin by proceeding to the Fertilizer Depot and retrieve three sealed fertilizer barrels marked 'Nutrient Plus Formula.' Next, transport all three barrels to Field Zone A and wait at the unloading area until the field technician confirms removal of the first barrel. Immediately after the first barrel is accepted at Field Zone A, deliver the second barrel to Field Zone B, but pause for four minutes at Field Zone B to allow integration into the soil enrichment system before moving on. The third barrel must then be taken to Field Zone C; however, only drop off this last barrel after Field Zone B has completed its four-minute integration pause. Once all barrels are distributed to their respective fields and the time-gating at Field Zone B is fulfilled, return to the Fertilizer Depot to notify staff that the fertilizer delivery circuit has been completed, and remain there for further allocation tasks.

Begin at Loading Dock 5 and collect a shipment consisting of seven irrigation drone batteries and five hydraulic pump filters, ensuring both sets of payloads are securely stowed. Proceed first to Maintenance Bay Aurora, where you must wait until the technician confirms all five hydraulic pump filters have been removed from the robot. Once the removal is complete, deliver the seven irrigation drone batteries evenly across three drop points: place two batteries at Drone Launch Pad X-ray, three batteries at Drone Hub Echo, and the remaining two batteries at Drone Supply Depot Sierra, in that sequence. At each location, pause for exactly ninety seconds following delivery to allow for inspection and sign-off by authorized staff before advancing to the next site. After distributing the batteries and completing all waiting periods, report immediately to Secure Storage Vault Theta and remain there until the vault supervisor certifies that the payload bay is empty and clean, which may take several minutes; only upon receiving this clearance should you return to Loading Dock 5 to complete your assignment.

Start at Assembly Line Dock A, where you must load eight manufacturing toolkits labeled for redistribution. Your objective is to deliver these toolkits to three locations: Quality Control Lab, Finished Products Warehouse, and the Central Maintenance Bay. Allocate three toolkits to the Quality Control Lab, three to the Finished Products Warehouse, and the remaining two to the Central Maintenance Bay, making sure that no location receives more than its assigned amount. For each delivery, wait until the receiving supervisor at each location has removed all toolkits before moving to the next destination. Once all toolkits have been handed over, proceed to the Battery Charging Station and wait for 5 minutes to allow diagnostic systems to run safety checks on your power supply before returning to Assembly Line Dock A to complete the route.

Start your route at Supply Depot Gamma by collecting a total of nine sealed nutrient bins, verifying that all bins are accounted for before proceeding. Make your way to Hydroponics Greenhouse West and deliver three nutrient bins; after the delivery, wait for five minutes to ensure greenhouse staff have emptied the bins and confirmed the contents, as this is necessary before any further action. Once you receive confirmation from the staff at Hydroponics Greenhouse West, continue to Seedling Nursery Delta with another three nutrient bins, and wait at Nursery Delta until you receive an all-clear signal indicating all bins have been transferred into storage. With the remaining three nutrient bins, proceed to Fertilizer Processing Plant Omega and wait on site for two minutes, even if personnel are present immediately, to allow for safety checks before leaving. Only after all nine bins have been delivered and each respective waiting period is fulfilled should you return to Supply Depot Gamma to finalize your delivery cycle.

Begin at Storage Yard Delta by retrieving eight sealed containers of fertilizer pellets, ensuring all containers are ready for safe transport. Deliver three containers to the Distribution Hub South, but hold there and wait until the local staff removes all three containers before departing. After confirmation of removal, transport another three fertilizer containers to Crop Plot Seven and remain at the delivery point for a full four minutes to allow field managers to complete their contamination checks prior to offloading; proceed only when the team has collected all three containers. With the final two fertilizer containers, navigate to the Remote Irrigation Control Shed and deliver both, waiting until the site supervisor approves their handover. Only after all deliveries are completed and verified at every location, travel back to Storage Yard Delta to await further deployment instructions.

Begin your mission at Storage Depot Alpha and load eleven sealed nutrient crates earmarked for three separate greenhouse facilities: Greenhouse North, Greenhouse Central, and Greenhouse South. First, transport five nutrient crates to Greenhouse North, offload them, and wait until the staff at Greenhouse North confirm that their temperature sensors have stabilized after receiving the delivery, which may require a brief delay. Once cleared, proceed to Greenhouse Central, deliver four crates, and remain on-site for two minutes to allow environmental systems to adjust to the inventory change. The final two crates must be taken to Greenhouse South, but deliver these only if all previous deliveries to Greenhouse North and Greenhouse Central have been successfully completed and acknowledged by their respective facility managers; otherwise, return any undelivered crates directly to Storage Depot Alpha. After all greenhouse facilities have received their allocated portions and proper confirmations are obtained, end the mission at Storage Depot Alpha.

Begin at Charging Station 4 and ensure your battery is fully topped up, then collect twelve calibration sensor kits from Maintenance Bay A. Your task is to distribute these sensor kits across three designated test plots: Test Plot Red, Test Plot Blue, and Test Plot Yellow. First, take five calibration sensor kits to Test Plot Red and wait at Test Plot Red until their technical supervisor verifies the correct installation of each kit—a process that might take several minutes and must be completed before you proceed. Once approval is received, move to Test Plot Blue and deliver four calibration sensor kits; after you have placed the kits, remain on-site for exactly four minutes to ensure that their server confirms full remote connectivity. Following this interval, proceed to Test Plot Yellow with the remaining three sensor kits and offload them only if both previous deliveries to Test Plot Red and Test Plot Blue have been fully acknowledged by their on-site leads. If at any point a delivery confirmation is declined or cannot be obtained, return all remaining undelivered sensor kits directly to Maintenance Bay A instead of proceeding. After successful distribution and acknowledgment at all test plots, go to Charging Station 4 and await the next dispatch.

Begin at Machinery Depot and wait until the operator signals that the three maintenance supply crates are fully prepared for pickup. Once the crates are ready, deliver the first crate to Irrigation Pump Station 1 and wait while the maintenance crew unloads it; after the crate has been removed, proceed immediately to Solar Panel Field Dock to drop off the second crate and remain there until the field technician completes the removal. Next, transfer the final crate to Greenhouse Entry Gate, and after it has been offloaded, wait an additional 10 minutes at Greenhouse Entry Gate to accommodate equipment sanitation protocols. Only after this waiting period should you navigate to Spare Parts Shed to collect a diagnostics scanner; if the diagnostics scanner is present and successfully loaded, continue to Livestock Monitoring Tower, where you must remain until the scanner has been received and installation confirmed by the livestock technician. Conclude the route by returning to Machinery Depot for debrief and storage.

Begin your operation at Equipment Garage Central, where you must retrieve a shipment of nine heavy-duty tiller blades. Transport all nine tiller blades to Machining Station Alpha and remain at the designated offloading point until the blades have been inspected and accepted by the machining supervisor. Once this initial delivery is confirmed complete, proceed to Parts Storage Depot 2 to pick up a batch of twelve precision bearings. Your next objective is to distribute the twelve precision bearings evenly across three different assembly lines: Assembly Line Greenhouse, Assembly Line Orchard, and Assembly Line Vineyard. For each assembly line, deliver four precision bearings; after each delivery, wait at the respective assembly line until all bearings have been successfully transferred to the line's inventory racks, and ensure that this process is completed at each location before moving to the next. After all assembly lines have received their designated bearings, return to Equipment Garage Central and wait for a period of five minutes before taking further action, allowing maintenance staff to inspect your cargo bay for residual parts or safety concerns.

Gather twelve maintenance toolkits from Workshop Bay Alpha, making sure each toolkit is fully stocked and logged before departure. Once collected, transport all toolkits to Equipment Shed Bravo and distribute them by placing four toolkits each at Robot Service Station 1, Robot Service Station 2, and Robot Service Station 3; if any station is undergoing repair and unavailable upon arrival, hold its toolkit allocation in Equipment Shed Bravo until the station becomes accessible, and only deliver to that station once repairs are confirmed completed. At every station, wait until the local technician signals that the delivered toolkits are unpacked and ready for use, then move on to the next station or return to Equipment Shed Bravo if awaiting access. Once all twelve toolkits have been placed and acknowledged at their respective destinations, remain at Equipment Shed Bravo for a three-minute interval to facilitate an inventory reconciliation process before returning to Workshop Bay Alpha to close out the maintenance delivery route.

Collect fifteen harvest sensor units from Storage Facility Gamma, verifying that the calibration check for each unit has passed prior to departure. Deliver the sensor units to Orchard Block East, Vineyard Strip North, and Grain Plot West by allocating five sensor units to each field location; if there are any leftover sensor units due to an unexpected calibration failure, take any remaining sensors to Storage Facility Delta for further inspection. For each delivery at the field locations, wait in place until the on-site installation crew confirms the removal and readiness of the deployed sensor units before proceeding to the next location. Once all sensor units are either distributed or returned for inspection, pause at Grain Plot West for five minutes to monitor any immediate deployment issues before navigating back to Storage Facility Gamma to await your next allocation task.

Start your route at Seed Warehouse 5, where you will collect a total of eleven labeled fertilizer canisters intended for redistribution across several crop beds. Distribute the fertilizer canisters as evenly as possible by delivering four canisters to Vegetable Plot Alpha, four canisters to Fruit Orchard Beta, and the remaining three canisters to Herb Section Gamma, specifically ensuring that each location receives its assigned number before moving to the next. After completing the delivery at each crop area, wait for two minutes to allow the respective field managers to remove the fertilizer canisters and confirm successful receipt. If removal is not acknowledged within the two-minute interval at any site, repeat the waiting period up to two times before proceeding. Once all canisters have been delivered and acknowledged, make your way to the Central Maintenance Bay and remain stationed there for ten minutes in case any urgent redistribution requests arise due to unexpected demand from the field managers.

Begin at Docking Station 5 and verify that a shipment consisting of twenty sensor calibration modules is prepared for transport. Divide these modules among the following locations: deliver seven modules to the Quality Assurance Lab, eight modules to the Field Testing Zone, and the remaining five modules to the Remote Monitoring Hut. Transport the first seven modules to the Quality Assurance Lab, then wait until a technician confirms the modules have been removed before proceeding. After the Quality Assurance delivery is complete, transfer the next eight modules to the Field Testing Zone; following arrival, remain for three minutes to give field engineers time to unload and log the modules. Once this unloading period has elapsed, proceed to the Remote Monitoring Hut with the final five modules and wait until the on-site specialist acknowledges full receipt and removal. Only after all deliveries are completed and confirmed at every location, return directly to Docking Station 5 and wait for two minutes to allow the logistics supervisor to sign off your delivery manifest.

Begin your operation at the Parts Storage Facility where you will retrieve a batch of fifteen high-capacity spare batteries labeled for field equipment maintenance. Navigate first to Tractor Depot A to deliver six spare batteries, waiting until the maintenance supervisor has removed all six batteries before advancing. After confirmation of battery pickup at Tractor Depot A, proceed to Irrigation Pump Station 3 and offload five of the remaining batteries, staying on site until the pump technician has collected all five spare batteries. With the last four batteries, continue to Drone Charging Area 2; after arrival, wait for exactly three minutes to give the drone technicians adequate time for battery removal, but if any batteries are left after this period, extend the waiting time by an additional three minutes only once. If all batteries have still not been collected, log the discrepancy before departing. Once every location has received and acknowledged its assigned batch of batteries, transport any empty containers back to the Parts Storage Facility, and then proceed directly to the Clean Room for a mandatory five-minute decontamination hold before concluding your assignment.

Commence your mission at the Central Agro Supply Warehouse, ensuring that a collection of twelve sealed soil nutrient cartridges is ready for distribution. Allocate four cartridges to Greenhouse Alpha, another four cartridges to Crop Field Beta, and the remaining four cartridges to Vineyard Delta. First, deliver four cartridges to Greenhouse Alpha, then remain there until the greenhouse manager has acknowledged and removed the delivered cartridges. Only after confirmation at Greenhouse Alpha should you proceed to Crop Field Beta, where you must wait for two minutes upon arrival to allow the field crew to finish preparations before they can accept and remove the next four cartridges. When the transfer at Crop Field Beta is complete, bring the last four cartridges to Vineyard Delta, and remain on site until the vineyard technician explicitly signals that all cartridges have been received and removed. After successful delivery and confirmation at all three locations, immediately return to the Central Agro Supply Warehouse and hold position for three minutes to await inspection and sign-off by the distribution supervisor before concluding your route.

Start your route at the North Equipment Garage and verify that six pallets of biodegradable planting trays are fully prepared for outbound transfer. Divide these six pallets so that two pallets are delivered to Seeding Line A, another two to Fertilizer Shed South, and the final two to Orchard Entry Gate. Begin by moving the first two pallets to Seeding Line A, where you must wait until the trays are completely removed by the processing team. After confirmation of removal at Seeding Line A, proceed directly to Fertilizer Shed South with the next two pallets, remaining onsite until the fertilizer technician has finished unloading. Once you receive an unload signal at Fertilizer Shed South, wait an extra five minutes to allow the technician to perform a quality inspection on the delivered trays. Next, transport the last two pallets to Orchard Entry Gate; upon arrival, pause your operation for three minutes before unloading to ensure that the orchard staff are assembled and ready. Only after the waiting period should you allow the removal of trays, and once offloading is complete, return immediately to North Equipment Garage to provide a status update to dispatch staff and to recharge for the next operational cycle.

Start at the Grain Storage Facility and pick up a set of nine pest monitoring sensors packaged for deployment. Proceed to the North Wheat Field first and install three pest monitoring sensors, waiting until the field technician at North Wheat Field finishes calibrating each before moving on. Next, drive over to South Corn Plot and deliver another three pest monitoring sensors, and again, wait for the on-site agronomist to complete a check of the sensors' placement before proceeding. Finally, travel to Vineyard East and deploy the remaining three pest monitoring sensors, ensuring that after all sensors have been placed you remain at Vineyard East for ten minutes to provide support in case any calibration issues arise, only heading back to the Grain Storage Facility once this support interval expires.

Begin at the Central Machine Depot and collect a diagnostic toolkit, two replacement power cells, and four sensor calibration pods. Head first to Wind Turbine Station Alpha and deliver one power cell and one calibration pod; wait on-site until the maintenance supervisor has removed both items, then after a five-minute interval to allow system rebooting, travel to Solar Array Field Bravo. At Solar Array Field Bravo, distribute two calibration pods and the second power cell, ensuring that each item is received individually by the designated technician. Once all deliveries at this site are confirmed, proceed to Geothermal Substation Charlie with the remaining diagnostic toolkit and final calibration pod, but only unload these items once verification from substation personnel is provided. After these steps are complete, remain at Geothermal Substation Charlie for ten minutes to monitor system stability, and finally return to the Central Machine Depot for end-of-mission checks.

Begin at the Maintenance Hub by confirming that two replacement hydraulic actuators are ready for pickup. Once confirmation is received, transport the first actuator to Harvester Bay 3 and wait five minutes while the harbor crew inspects and installs the actuator. When installation is complete, proceed to Silo Access Point 2 with the second actuator, but deliver it only if the Silo Engineer is present; if the Silo Engineer is not found, wait for up to fifteen minutes for their arrival before returning the actuator to the Maintenance Hub for safekeeping. Regardless of delivery outcome at Silo Access Point 2, after either successful handover or the waiting period, navigate to the Charging Station Alpha and remain docked there for twenty minutes of system diagnostics before accepting new assignments.

Start at Storage Depot A and retrieve nine sealed fertilizer bags from the designated pallet. Distribute the fertilizer bags so that three are delivered to Field Station North, two to Field Station East, and the remaining four to Field Station South, explicitly ensuring that if all four bags cannot be accepted at Field Station South, redirect any excess to the Adjacent Overflow Shed before progressing. For each delivery, remain at the respective field station until the field supervisor confirms that the current batch has been safely unloaded. After every batch delivery is completed, pause for ninety seconds at each drop-off location to allow safety checks before proceeding to the next station. Only after delivery of all nine fertilizer bags and completion of the required waiting periods at each site, return to Storage Depot A for post-task inspection.

Start at the Central Warehouse and load six bags of slow-release fertilizer. Evenly distribute these by first taking two bags to Orchard Access Point A, then proceed to Vineyard Loading Dock to deliver another two bags, and finally take the remaining two to the Southern Vegetable Plot shed; if any single location is temporarily unattended and cannot accept its allocation, wait at that site for three minutes before retrying the delivery. After all six bags have been delivered to their designated locations and receipt is confirmed with each local supervisor, return to the Central Warehouse and remain on standby for the next task assignment.

Begin at the Grain Elevator Control Room and collect a batch of 11 sample jars from the central sorting table, then transport the whole set to the Loading Dock B. At the dock, evenly allocate the sample jars among the three quality assessment labs: deliver 4 jars to Lab A in the east processing wing, 4 jars to Lab B in the main operations annex, and the remaining 3 jars to Lab C located adjacent to storage silo 7, ensuring that each lab receives their full share before proceeding to the next. Once the last samples have been dropped off in Lab C, wait at the lab's entryway for 7 minutes in case of urgent requests or return samples. When the waiting period is over, head directly to the supervisor's office inside the administration building to report task completion before taking on new duties.

Begin your route at Workshop Delta and pick up six sealed coolant canisters once the loading crew signals that all canisters are secured. Head to Generator Station A and unload two coolant canisters, but remain at the loading area until both canisters are collected by the generator technician. After confirmation of the pickup, proceed to Pump House Beta with the next two canisters, and upon arrival, wait for three minutes before unloading as the maintenance team sets up their receiving platform; ensure both canisters are handed over and removed by the staff. The final two coolant canisters are to be transported to Substation Zeta, where you must first wait until the substation supervisor is present to authorize the transfer before unloading. Once all six coolant canisters have been delivered and removed from the robot, return to Workshop Delta for mission debriefing.

Travel to Warehouse 2 and collect a case containing 23 soil sample vials, verifying readiness before proceeding. Then, allocate the vials by first transporting and delivering eight vials to the Field Testing Tent, confirming that the field technician has removed the vials before leaving. Next, head to Laboratory Annex and deliver another eight vials; again, do not depart until the lab technician has retrieved the delivery. Transfer the remaining seven vials to the Storage Vault, and wait for the vault operator to finish unloading all vials. Once every destination has received its assigned vials, remain at the Storage Vault for three minutes to allow security staff to conduct a routine contents check before you proceed to Charging Station C for recharge preparations.

Begin at Main Parts Depot and retrieve six engine filter cartridges for routine tractor maintenance. Proceed first to Tractor Barn Alpha and deliver two cartridges to Mechanic Bay 1, waiting until both cartridges have been acknowledged and removed by the maintenance crew. Afterwards, move to Tractor Barn Beta and deposit another two cartridges at Mechanic Bay 2, remaining in position until all filters are collected by the technicians there. Once these steps are completed, drive to Tractor Barn Gamma with the final two cartridges and transfer them to Mechanic Bay 3, again waiting until the maintenance personnel at Gamma confirm full receipt. After all cartridges have been distributed and verified as removed from the robot, remain at Tractor Barn Gamma for a period of five minutes to allow for post-delivery processing, and only after this interval return to Main Parts Depot to complete your operational round.

Begin at the warehouse loading dock and retrieve six boxes of replacement irrigation valves, verifying that each box is labeled for Zone A, Zone B, or Zone C as specified by the shipment manifests. Distribute the boxes by delivering two to the control shed in Field Zone A, then proceed to Field Zone B's utility tent where another two boxes must be left; wait at the utility tent until maintenance personnel confirm the receipt and removal of these two boxes before continuing. Take the remaining two boxes to the repair workshop in Field Zone C, but upon arrival, wait for 8 minutes outside the workshop to avoid disturbing an ongoing machinery calibration session. Once the mandated waiting period has lapsed, move the boxes into the workshop and stay until workshop staff removes both boxes and signals task completion, after which you may return to the warehouse loading dock and stand by for subsequent assignments.

Begin at the grain storage facility and pick up nine sealed grain sample boxes. Transport three grain sample boxes to Laboratory A, and wait there for lab staff to collect all three before proceeding. Next, deliver another three grain sample boxes to Laboratory B, once again waiting until lab personnel have fully unloaded them. Take the remaining three grain sample boxes to Laboratory C and stay until all the samples have been removed. After completing deliveries to all three laboratories and confirming that every grain sample box has been received, travel to the equipment wash station and wait for five minutes to allow for mandatory cleaning procedures before returning to the grain storage facility.

Start at the Loading Dock and collect a total of nineteen harvested apple crates. Deliver these crates to three destinations by allocating six crates to Cold Storage Room A, seven crates to Packing Station 2, and six crates to the Quality Inspection Area; since all destinations are in different parts of the facility, ensure each location receives the correct amount and no crates are left behind. For each stop, wait at the delivery zone until all crates designated for that location have been fully unloaded before departing. After the final delivery at the Quality Inspection Area, proceed directly to the Sanitation Bay, and remain there for 10 minutes to complete mandatory decontamination procedures before returning to the Loading Dock for your next assignment.

Begin at the central loading bay and pick up seven sealed sample containers of harvested grain. Proceed to Grain Silo A and transfer two sealed sample containers, waiting until the storage supervisor removes both containers before continuing. Next, go to Quality Control Lab 1 and deliver three more sealed sample containers, ensuring that the laboratory technician confirms receipt and storage of all three. Once the Quality Control Lab transfer is complete, proceed to Shipping Dock C with the final two sealed sample containers; after arrival, wait for five minutes to allow the export team to inspect and remove the containers. Only after inspections are complete at Shipping Dock C, return to the central loading bay and set the robot to standby for further assignments.

Start at the maintenance bay adjacent to Storage Hangar 2 and collect five diagnostic toolkits. Head first to Greenhouse Alpha and deliver two toolkits to the horticulture crew, waiting at Greenhouse Alpha until both toolkits have been removed from your payload section. Afterwards, continue to Hydroponic Control Shed and supply one diagnostic toolkit for equipment calibration, but remain at the shed for precisely three minutes after the toolkit is unloaded to allow for system initialization. Once the three-minute wait at Hydroponic Control Shed concludes, move to Field Operations Hut and hand over one toolkit, but only proceed if the previous three-minute waiting period has elapsed. Deliver the final diagnostic toolkit to the Central Weather Station, ensuring that all toolkits have reached their destinations before returning to Storage Hangar 2, where you must remain stationary for five minutes prior to receiving subsequent dispatch commands.

Begin at Charging Station 3 and collect twelve sealed fertilizer sacks from Supply Depot South. Deliver three sacks each to Field Zone East, Field Zone West, and Field Zone North, confirming at each site that the fertilizer sacks have been removed before proceeding. With the remaining three sacks, proceed to Field Zone Central, and after delivering these final sacks, wait at Field Zone Central for exactly 5 minutes to allow for soil moisture assessment before returning directly to Charging Station 3 for recharge.

Start at the Packaging Zone, collect a total of 17 crates of harvested tomatoes, and prepare to distribute them to three different cold storage rooms—Cold Storage A, Cold Storage B, and Cold Storage C.
