Allocate 6 crates to Cold Storage A, 6 crates to Cold Storage B, and deliver the remaining 5 crates to Cold Storage C, ensuring each trip delivers crates exclusively to a single storage room per run. After unloading at any cold storage room, wait three minutes for the refrigeration staff to verify and acknowledge receipt of that shipment before proceeding with the next batch; repeat these collection and delivery cycles until all 17 crates are fully distributed as specified. Once all deliveries and verifications are completed, navigate to the Maintenance Corner in the Utility Wing and await further loading instructions near Spare Part Locker 4.

Begin at the Seed Warehouse and collect a shipment consisting of fourteen sealed grain bags. Transport these grain bags to the Grain Distribution Dock and wait for the dock supervisor to prepare the payload for distribution. Once the shipment is ready, divide the grain bags evenly among three silos: Silo East, Silo Central, and Silo West. Deliver four grain bags to each silo one by one, making a separate stop at each silo and waiting until a technician removes the bags each time. After distributing four bags to each silo, transport the remaining two grain bags to Silo Central for storage. Following the final delivery, return to the Grain Distribution Dock, remain stationary for five minutes to allow supervisors to verify records, and then proceed to the Seed Warehouse for standby instructions.

Start at Storage Bay 2 where three replacement hydraulic pumps and two containers of coolant fluid are staged for dispatch. Pick up the hydraulic pumps and transport them to Workshop Alpha, leaving one pump at this location for the senior technician; once the delivery is acknowledged, proceed to Workshop Bravo and deliver the second pump, waiting until the maintenance chief confirms installation is ready before you depart. Take the final hydraulic pump to Workshop Charlie, but only deposit it after the crew at Workshop Bravo has removed their unit. Then, return to Storage Bay 2 and collect both containers of coolant fluid; first, drive to the Greenhouse Cooling Station and unload one coolant container, remaining for four minutes to allow the staff to connect the container safely, and finally, head to Machinery Bay 1 to drop off the last coolant container to the shift supervisor before concluding your route.

Begin at the Central Maintenance Bay and load four hydraulic fluid canisters onto your cargo deck, verifying that each canister is securely fastened. Proceed first to Harvester Station Alpha and deliver one canister, pausing for 5 minutes to give the technicians ample time to remove the empty container before making the drop-off. Afterwards, travel to Tractor Depot West to distribute the second canister; wait until the depot supervisor signals that the depot fluid reservoir has been fully refilled and the canister can be detached. For the third and fourth canisters, drive consecutively to Irrigation Control Shed North and then to Planter Assembly South, delivering one canister at each site and confirming each recipient’s readiness before release. Once all fluid canisters have been delivered and verified, relocate to the Washdown Pad to await further instructions, remaining in place for 10 minutes to allow cleaning crews to complete decontamination procedures on your chassis.

Begin your route at Loading Dock B and retrieve six pallets of irrigation hose reels. Deliver two pallets to Greenhouse Zone 1 and wait three minutes while the facility manager inspects and unloads the hose reels; if unloading is not confirmed in that time, continue waiting in similar three-minute intervals until the process is complete. After completing unloading at Greenhouse Zone 1, proceed to Greenhouse Zone 2 and repeat the same delivery and waiting procedure with another two pallets and inspection period. Finally, take the remaining two pallets to Outdoor Pump Station C, but only deliver them if confirmation has been received that both previous greenhouses accepted their delivery—if not, remain at Outdoor Pump Station C and await remote instruction for up to fifteen minutes before returning to Loading Dock B for further orders.

Start by traveling to the Seed Inventory Shed and collect a total of thirteen seed bags required for planting. Then, distribute the seed bags across Field Alpha, Field Beta, and Field Gamma by delivering four bags each to Field Alpha and Field Beta, and the remaining five bags to Field Gamma to accommodate the differing plot sizes. At each field, wait for the local planting supervisor to confirm that their respective seed bag supply is ready to be unloaded before proceeding to the next field. After all seed bags have been delivered and confirmations received, move to the Irrigation Pumping Station and remain there for 15 minutes to allow field crew to flush and refill the main water lines. Once this waiting period has elapsed, continue to the Equipment Sanitization Dock, collect any empty containers that were used for seed transportation, and transfer these empty containers back to the Seed Inventory Shed. Make sure not to leave the area until the shed supervisor has verified all empty containers are returned and accounted for.

Begin at the pesticide storage vault near the farm headquarters to collect seven sealed pesticide canisters. Transport three pesticide canisters to the western vineyard distribution shed, and wait at the shed until a vineyard supervisor removes all three canisters. After the removal is confirmed, proceed to the apple orchard supply kiosk at the south entrance and deliver two pesticide canisters, remaining at the kiosk for five minutes while the orchard crew calibrates their equipment with the new canisters. Once the five-minute wait is over, travel to the solar-powered equipment bay at the northeastern field and offload the remaining two pesticide canisters. Wait beside the equipment bay until all canisters are retrieved by staff, then return to the pesticide storage vault to complete the delivery cycle.

Start at the fertilizer silo located near the eastern edge of the farm and collect a batch of 13 sealed fertilizer sacks. Divide these sacks as evenly as possible among Field Alpha, Field Bravo, and Field Charlie: deliver 4 sacks to Field Alpha first, then proceed to Field Bravo with 4 more sacks, and finish by delivering the remaining 5 sacks to Field Charlie. At each field, wait until the on-site staff confirm that the sacks are ready for offloading before proceeding to the next destination. After completing deliveries at all three fields, wait at Field Charlie for exactly ten minutes to allow for inventory correlation by the field manager. When the waiting period concludes, return directly to the fertilizer silo to report task completion.

Begin at the Maintenance Depot and pick up the set of four diagnostic toolkits prepared for seasonal tractor checks. Head first to Tractor Bay 1 and deliver one diagnostic toolkit, waiting until the on-site mechanic confirms via signal that the toolkit has been safely received. Next, proceed to Tractor Bay 2 to distribute the second toolkit, again waiting for acknowledgment from the receiving mechanic before advancing. After the first two bays, travel to Tractor Bay 3 but pause for precisely 180 seconds at the service waiting area before delivering the third toolkit, as the maintenance crew there requires time to complete prior tasks. Once the timer expires and after the toolkit is handed over with confirmation, continue to Tractor Bay 4 to deliver the final toolkit. With all toolkits distributed, navigate to the Fuel Storage Facility and remain there for 7 minutes so that staff can attach any used toolkits needing calibration for return. Only after the waiting period is over and all toolkits are secured, drive back to the Maintenance Depot to conclude your mission.

Begin your route at the East Maintenance Garage and collect a shipment of nine spare harvester blades from the tool rack. Your first stop is the North Wheat Field Service Point, where you will deliver three blades; pause there for five minutes to allow maintenance crew to install the blades. Following the waiting period, proceed to the Central Grain Silo Loading Dock and distribute another three blades, then remain until the site supervisor removes the blades from your payload. Finally, bring the last three blades to the South Machinery Bay, waiting until the technician confirms all blades are received and the bay inventory has been updated. Only after all deliveries and acknowledgements are complete should you return to the East Maintenance Garage to signal task completion.

Begin at the Distribution Warehouse and collect a shipment consisting of ten fertilizer sacks and three irrigation control units. Make your first delivery by bringing four fertilizer sacks and one irrigation control unit to Greenhouse 3, waiting for three minutes after arrival to allow the staff to verify and accept the equipment. Once the handoff at Greenhouse 3 is complete, proceed to Orchard Station with three more fertilizer sacks and one irrigation control unit, where you must also wait three minutes for staff inspection and confirmation. Deliver the remaining three fertilizer sacks and the final irrigation control unit to the Experimental Hydroponics Lab, this time waiting five minutes while the receiving technician inspects the delivery. Only after all deliveries have been fully accepted at their respective locations may you return to the Distribution Warehouse to register the completion of this multi-stage distribution cycle.

Begin at the Orchard Storage Facility and load up a crate containing 23 fresh produce inspection devices. Next, transport the crate to the Sorting Shed by the northeast corner of the apple grove and wait there for 3 minutes while the quality assurance team verifies the manifest. After the confirmation is received, distribute the inspection devices among three destinations: deliver 8 devices to the Packing Line A Station, 8 more to the Maintenance Workshop adjacent to the loading dock, and bring the remaining 7 devices to the Central Control Booth. Ensure that after each delivery, you wait for the crew at each respective location to fully remove the designated batch before departing for the next stop. Once all inspection devices are successfully delivered and acknowledged at their destinations, proceed to the Orchard Storage Facility and await further deployment orders.

Begin your mission at the Seed Storage Facility, where you must load twenty-seven fertilizer packs onto your cargo platform, confirming the full quantity before departure. First, head to Field Alpha and distribute nine fertilizer packs at the designated drop-off zone; only proceed once you have received an all-clear from the field supervisor that the drop-off is complete. Then continue to Field Bravo, where you must deliver another nine fertilizer packs—wait until the packs have been removed by the attendants before moving on. Bring the remaining nine fertilizer packs to Field Charlie and deposit them near the irrigation controls, ensuring each pack is accounted for by the zone manager. After all fertilizer packs have been successfully distributed across the three fields, proceed to the Loading Dock, and remain there for five minutes to allow cooperative robots to clear the path before returning to the Seed Storage Facility to end your mission.

Start at the Central Maintenance Depot and collect twelve fresh hydraulic filters, ensuring the batch is complete. Distribute the filters to three tractor bays as follows: deliver five filters to Tractor Bay 1, four filters to Tractor Bay 2, and allocate the remaining three filters to Tractor Bay 3. For each bay, wait until all assigned filters are unloaded and the bay supervisor confirms receipt before proceeding to the next destination. After all hydraulic filters have been delivered and confirmed, travel to the Refueling Station and pause there for an exact duration of seven minutes to allow system diagnostics to complete. Once the time has elapsed, conclude the operation by returning to the Central Maintenance Depot.

Commence operations at the supply dock and collect a batch of nine irrigation pump filters. Evenly distribute these filters among the North Orchard control room, the Central Vineyard maintenance station, and the South Field utility shed, delivering three filters to each site. After each delivery, remain at the respective site for 5 minutes to wait for the on-site technician to confirm the installation of the filters before proceeding to the next destination. Once all nine filters have been delivered and their installation confirmed at all three locations, return directly to the supply dock and stand by for the next assignment.

Begin by traveling to Dock 1 at the shipping yard to pick up three containers labeled 'fertilizer batch 2024'. Once the containers are ready for transfer, proceed to the machinery maintenance bay adjacent to the fuel depot and deliver only one of the containers there, waiting until the maintenance personnel have removed this fertilizer container. Afterward, move to Storage Shed 3 near the east orchard to deliver the second fertilizer container and similarly wait until the shed operator confirms removal of the payload. Transport the third and final fertilizer container to the greenhouse annex on the west side of the property and deliver it there. Once the drop-off at the greenhouse annex is complete, wait for 10 minutes to allow for inventory processing before returning to Dock 1 to prepare for the next delivery assignment.

Begin at the Central Harvest Shed and collect nine produce crates marked for distribution. Transport and deliver three crates to Sorting Facility A, then pause at Sorting Facility A for four minutes while workers verify the receipt of these crates; if the verification is not completed within four minutes, repeat the same four-minute waiting interval until the confirmation is received. Once the delivery is officially confirmed at Sorting Facility A, proceed to Packaging Zone B and deliver another three crates, waiting two minutes after unloading for the station supervisor's acknowledgment before moving on. For the remaining three crates, proceed directly to Cold Storage Unit 5 and place all three crates inside the marked cooling bay. Only after all nine crates have been successfully transferred and all required confirmations are received at both Sorting Facility A and Packaging Zone B, return to the Central Harvest Shed to await your next instructions; if any delivery acknowledgment is not received after three consecutive waiting intervals at a particular facility, halt operations at your current location, and await further instructions from the command center.

Start at the fertilizer storage facility and load yourself with a shipment of forty-seven fertilizer sacks. Transport the fertilizer sacks by first delivering fifteen sacks to Wheat Field A, then fifteen sacks to Corn Plot 3, and finally fifteen sacks to Soybean Paddock 2, allocating the remaining two sacks to Wheat Field A to ensure the total shipment is fully distributed. Following the drop-off of the last fertilizer sack at Soybean Paddock 2, wait at Soybean Paddock 2 for ten minutes to allow field specialists to inspect the delivery. After this wait, proceed to the central service depot, but only do so if confirmation is received from the Soybean Paddock 2 supervisor that the delivery inspection is complete. Upon arrival at the central service depot, remain there until a new task is assigned.

Start at the Main Tool Depot and retrieve four inspection drones along with the precision spray nozzle attachment. Head first to Maintenance Bay A, where you must wait for the senior technician to confirm the readiness of the nozzle attachment before departing. Then, deliver one inspection drone to each of the following locations, in this order: the West Grain Storage Hangar, the Central Irrigation Control Room, and the South Field Service Post, leaving one drone at each site and awaiting confirmation from staff at every stop that the drone has been successfully activated before moving to the next destination. Carry the remaining inspection drone to the East Fertilizer Mixing Station and wait for ten minutes to allow the operations crew to install and test the device. After this period, return directly to the Main Tool Depot and stand by until summoned for additional route assignments.

Begin by traveling to the Equipment Storage Bay and collect a single diagnostic toolkit. Bring the diagnostic toolkit to Maintenance Station 1 and wait there until a technician signals that the toolkit is ready for transfer. Once confirmation is received, deliver the diagnostic toolkit to Maintenance Station 2, but pause there for exactly four minutes to allow for equipment testing before proceeding further. After the waiting period, if the toolkit has not yet been collected by staff at Maintenance Station 2, remain onsite until the toolkit is removed. Once the toolkit has been offloaded at Maintenance Station 2, make your way to the Refueling Platform and remain there until further instructions are given.

Begin the task by proceeding to the Fertilizer Storage Shed and loading nine bags of mineral fertilizer. Once all nine fertilizer bags are secured, travel to Field Alpha and distribute three bags, remaining at the location until the field manager confirms all bags have been removed from your platform. Following the successful delivery at Field Alpha, continue to Field Bravo with another three fertilizer bags, and wait at Field Bravo until every bag is unloaded by the field crew. With the final three bags, make your way to Field Charlie, deliver the bags to the on-site agronomist, and stay at Field Charlie for five minutes to allow for documentation and inspection. Once the inspection is completed and the waiting period has elapsed, return directly to the Fertilizer Storage Shed to receive new dispatch instructions from the operations coordinator.

Begin at the Machine Maintenance Bay, where you are to collect a batch of ten replacement hydraulic filters intended for three tractor units. Navigate promptly to Tractor Bay Alpha and deliver three filters there, remaining at the bay until the lead technician signals that the filters have been removed and verified. Once this confirmation is received, proceed to Tractor Bay Bravo to distribute another three filters, but before the handover, wait for sixty seconds to allow ongoing maintenance work to be paused. After the minute has elapsed and once the filters are unloaded at Bravo, move to Tractor Bay Charlie and supply the remaining four filters; ensure any surplus filter is noted, as Bay Charlie requires an extra due to an earlier parts recall. Wait at Tractor Bay Charlie until the maintenance supervisor certifies the complete removal of all delivered filters, then immediately return to the Machine Maintenance Bay to log the task’s end.

Begin by proceeding to the Seed Depot to collect twelve trays of hybrid maize seeds. Divide these trays among the following destinations: transport five trays to the East Greenhouse loading dock, four trays to the Central Nursery receiving bay, and the remaining three trays to the West Plot entrance. After each delivery, wait for a staff member to remove the trays, ensuring that each location receives only its designated quantity before moving on. Once all twelve trays have been delivered and acknowledged, travel to the Main Workshop, and remain there for three minutes to allow for routine maintenance inspections before accepting your next assignment.

Start your task at the Central Warehouse Dock and retrieve fourteen fresh produce crates labeled for dispatch. Evenly allocate the crates by delivering five crates each to Packing Station A and Packing Station B, and bring the remaining four crates to Cold Storage Room 3. For each station, wait until the local supervisor at Packing Station A and then at Packing Station B confirms the removal of their respective crate deliveries before proceeding to the next delivery; at Cold Storage Room 3, after depositing the last four crates, stay for four minutes to allow for cold chain stabilization before heading to the Sanitation Bay for cleaning. Once the cleaning process at the Sanitation Bay is complete, return directly to the Central Warehouse Dock and stand by for your next set of instructions.

Start at the Maintenance Depot and collect twelve lubricant canisters scheduled for preventive servicing. Divide the canisters evenly by delivering four canisters each to Conveyor Belt Area A, Press Line B, and Packaging Station C; if there is any leftover canister after distribution, bring the extra canister to Quality Control Lab for sampling. After each delivery at Area A, Line B, and Station C, wait two minutes for the maintenance supervisor to verify the drop-off before proceeding to the next area. Only after all initial deliveries and supervisor verifications are complete should you proceed to collect any empty lubricant containers from each of those three locations. For each set of collected empty containers, return and deposit them in the Recycling Center, making a separate trip per location, and waiting one minute upon arrival at the Recycling Center for inventory confirmation before returning for the next batch. Once all empties are deposited and confirmed, report back to the Maintenance Depot to signal the end of the maintenance support cycle.

Begin by traveling to Inventory Warehouse North and collect nine sealed drums of soybean oil, then transport three drums each to Loading Dock A, Packaging Room 2, and Baker's Preparation Area, ensuring that all three destinations receive an equal share; if there are any leftover drums after even distribution, deliver the remaining drums to Packaging Room 2 to balance the count. At each location, wait until the designated staff member confirms removal of the delivered drums before proceeding to the next drop-off. Once all drums have been successfully offloaded, move to the Equipment Sanitation Bay and remain there for four minutes to complete the mandatory robot decontamination process before returning to Inventory Warehouse North for your next dispatch assignment.

Start your route at the grain storage silo, where you will collect eighteen sample vials for soil analysis. Divide these vials for delivery as follows: deliver seven vials to the north experimental plot, five vials to the southwest corn field, and the remaining six vials to the southeast greenhouse, taking care to keep each batch separate. After delivering the vials to the north experimental plot, wait for 4 minutes to allow the agronomy team to acknowledge receipt, then proceed to the southwest corn field and wait for an additional 6 minutes after your drop-off to ensure their records are updated. Only after both waiting periods have concluded and all sample vials have been delivered to the three locations should you return to the grain storage silo and report task completion at the administration terminal.

Begin at the Assembly Component Storage Area adjacent to Manufacturing Bay 4, where you will load a batch of ten sensor modules onto the robot, waiting for the quality control manager to confirm that the modules are ready for transfer. Distribute the sensor modules by delivering four modules to the Precision Welding Lab, three modules to the CNC Machining Center, and the remaining three modules to the Final Assembly Quality-Bay, in that specific order. Upon arrival at each destination, wait at the location until all allocated sensor modules have been removed by the respective zone supervisor before continuing to the next drop-off point. After the last delivery at the Final Assembly Quality-Bay, proceed immediately to the Maintenance Inspection Dock near the facility entrance and remain there for 10 minutes to allow for a comprehensive preventative check, only returning to the Assembly Component Storage Area after completing the inspection wait period.

Start at the Grain Storage Barn, where you are to pick up fifteen bags of feed, ensuring all bags are tagged for distribution. Divide the fifteen bags as evenly as possible by delivering five bags to Livestock Pen A, five bags to Livestock Pen B, and the remaining five bags to Livestock Pen C, but before leaving each pen after your delivery, remain at each site for two minutes while the automated feed dispensing system confirms the receiving process is complete. Only proceed to the next pen after receiving confirmation at the prior pen; if confirmation fails, repeat the delivery check and waiting process until acknowledgment is obtained. After all fifteen bags have been distributed and all confirmations are secured, proceed to the Equipment Maintenance Bay and wait for seven minutes for a technician to assess your cargo area for leftover debris before returning to the Grain Storage Barn to complete your cycle.

Begin your route at the Central Parts Depot by collecting twelve precision sprocket assemblies packed in one container. Deliver four sprocket assemblies to Maintenance Bay One, then wait at Maintenance Bay One until the maintenance chief verifies unloading of all four assemblies. Following the chief’s confirmation, proceed with another four sprocket assemblies to Maintenance Bay Two, where you must pause for exactly five minutes to enable on-site staff to inspect and catalogue the delivered items; only after this time elapses continue to Maintenance Bay Three with the final four sprocket assemblies. At Maintenance Bay Three, remain until the maintenance engineer logs the receipt of all four assemblies. Once all sprocket deliveries and waiting intervals are complete, return the empty container to the Central Parts Depot and await instructions for your next assignment.

Start at the fertilizer warehouse and load exactly eleven bags of nitrogen fertilizer. Proceed to distribute these bags to the following three grain field depots: Field Depot Alpha, Field Depot Bravo, and Field Depot Charlie, ensuring that each receives three bags, and deliver the remaining two bags solely to Field Depot Charlie. For every delivery, after offloading the assigned bags at each depot, wait until local field staff confirm the bags are properly received before traveling to the next one. Once all depots have accepted their fertilizer, return to the fertilizer warehouse, but wait outside for seven minutes to allow warehouse staff to verify your empty cargo compartment before reentering.

Begin at Storage Shed A and retrieve a pallet containing 25 sealed fertilizer bags; proceed directly to Field Plot 1 and distribute exactly 8 bags onto the offloading platform by the northeast entrance. Wait at Field Plot 1 for 7 minutes to allow field crew to organize the drop-off, then continue with the remaining 17 bags to Field Plot 2 and deliver 9 bags at the designated supply zone. After the 9 bags have been removed at Field Plot 2, transport the remaining 8 fertilizer bags to Greenhouse West; upon arrival, wait until greenhouse staff confirms all bags are offloaded, then return to Storage Shed A without delay.

Begin at Control Shed North, where you will collect twelve pesticide canisters prepared for today's field application. Proceed to Field Plot Alpha and deposit five canisters, waiting until the field manager removes all five before heading to Field Plot Beta with four additional canisters. Once at Field Plot Beta, deliver the four canisters and remain in place for three minutes to observe the field's response sensors, then continue to Field Plot Gamma with the last three canisters. At Field Plot Gamma, transfer the remaining canisters and wait until confirmation of removal from the gamma-plot technician. After all deliveries are complete, travel to Refueling Station Bravo to recharge the robot before returning to Control Shed North and await further deployment orders.

Begin at the main fertilizer bunker and collect a total of seven nitrogen canisters. Drive to Field Plot One and distribute two nitrogen canisters, waiting for the field operator to signal that unloading is complete before proceeding. Next, deliver three nitrogen canisters to Greenhouse B, pausing for 5 minutes at the greenhouse entrance to allow staff to prepare the storage racks for unloading. Use the final two nitrogen canisters to resupply the automated irrigation kiosk at Orchard Lane, but unlock the kiosk only after confirming that the Greenhouse B delivery was fully removed. After all deliveries, return to the fertilizer bunker for equipment inspection.

Begin at the Loading Dock and collect twelve packages of irrigation sensor modules. Deliver four modules each to Field Alpha, Field Beta, and Field Gamma, making sure to visit each field in sequence and to wait for a field technician to confirm installation readiness before depositing the modules at each site. In cases where maintenance staff at any field are not present, pause for 4 minutes before reattempting confirmation. After distributing and confirming all four modules at Field Gamma, return to the Loading Dock and await the next set of deployment instructions.

Begin at Storage Dock One and confirm that nine sealed crates of harvested wheat are ready for transport. Allocate these nine crates so that four crates go to Silo Alpha, three to Silo Bravo, and the remaining two to Silo Charlie, explicitly managing the unequal distribution. First, shuttle four crates to Silo Alpha and wait onsite until all four crates are fully unloaded by the silo operator. Only after the unloading at Silo Alpha should you proceed to deliver the next three crates to Silo Bravo; again, remain at Silo Bravo until unloading is reported complete. After the Silo Bravo transfer, pause your activities for seven minutes at Silo Bravo to accommodate the routine grain sample testing period before moving on. Once the waiting period at Silo Bravo has concluded, carry the final two crates to Silo Charlie and wait until these are accepted by staff at the intake bay. Upon successful delivery to all three silo destinations, return to Storage Dock One and remain there until the next shipment of wheat crates is signaled as ready for transfer.

Start your route at the Central Packing Dock and pick up three pallets of harvested apples labeled Pallet_A, Pallet_B, and Pallet_C. Transport Pallet_A to the Refrigerated Storage Room and deliver it there; upon successful unloading and once staff have acknowledged receipt of Pallet_A, proceed to the Sorting Facility with Pallet_B. At the Sorting Facility, wait a full 15 minutes for quality inspection procedures to finish and for workers to clear Pallet_B from your cargo bay. Afterward, take Pallet_C to the Juice Processing Hall, but do not offload until the processing supervisor signals that the juicing line has been reset, which may require an on-site wait. Once all pallets have been successfully distributed and corresponding confirmations received at each location, navigate to the Robot Charging Bay for routine battery replenishment before accepting new assignments.

Begin your route at the main fertilizer storage bunker beside Field Alpha and collect a shipment of twenty 25-kilogram fertilizer sacks. Next, transport the entire shipment to the input bay of Mixing Station A, but only unload ten sacks there; wait for the bay supervisor to verify that all ten sacks have been removed. After the confirmation, immediately drive to Mixing Station B, where you must deliver six additional sacks and again wait until the operator confirms all six sacks are unloaded. Take the remaining four sacks to the western end of Field Beta, but wait for 7 minutes after arrival before allowing field staff to remove the sacks, as soil condition testing is required before the deployment of fertilizer. Once all sacks have been successfully distributed and unloading is complete at each location, proceed to the maintenance garage near the irrigation reservoir and remain there until new dispatch orders are received.

Start by positioning yourself at Packaging Dock 2 inside Factory Complex West and load fourteen sealed electronics modules from the dispatch cart. Transport six modules to Assembly Line A, pausing at the delivery bay until all six modules have been verified and removed by the assembly supervisor. Once the transfer at Assembly Line A is finalized, proceed to the Quality Control Room adjacent to Warehouse 3 to deliver another five modules, making sure to wait until the QC inspector has confirmed their removal before moving on. For the remaining three modules, head to the Robotics Maintenance Bay in the north wing of the complex and deliver them to the maintenance engineer; after waiting for the maintenance crew to finish unloading, remain idle at the bay for exactly ten minutes before navigating back to Packaging Dock 2 for your next assignment.

Begin at the Central Warehouse and pick up a shipment of seven irrigation sensor modules. Distribute these modules as evenly as possible among the North Field Relay Station, East Field Node, and Greenhouse Control Room by first delivering two sensor modules to the North Field Relay Station and waiting until the technician verifies the installation, then transporting another two modules to the East Field Node, where the system operator must acknowledge receipt before proceeding. Deliver the remaining three modules to the Greenhouse Control Room, but after arrival, wait for five minutes before unloading as the area must be cleared by facility staff. Once all sensor modules are delivered to their respective destinations and unloading is confirmed at each, navigate back to the Central Warehouse to complete the operation.

Start at the Seed Storage Barn and load twelve bags of wheat seed onto the robot, making sure to wait for the barn manager to signal that the loading is complete. Distribute the bags immediately and in order as follows: deliver five bags to Field Plot A, four bags to Field Plot B, and the remaining three bags to Field Plot C, waiting at each plot after arrival until all seed bags designated for that location are unloaded by the respective field supervisors. After all seeds have been distributed, proceed to the Field Equipment Shed and wait for 8 minutes to allow equipment calibration specialists time to clean the spreading tools, then return to the Seed Storage Barn once the equipment shed waiting period has ended.

Start at the main machine shop and collect a maintenance toolkit containing twelve spare hydraulic filters. Transport the toolkit to Repair Bay A and deliver four spare hydraulic filters, then proceed immediately to Maintenance Station B and deliver another four hydraulic filters from the toolkit. Next, go on to the Field Operations Trailer and deliver the remaining four hydraulic filters. Once all hydraulic filters have been distributed to their respective destinations, wait at the Field Operations Trailer for ten minutes to allow the maintenance supervisors to inspect and log the completed deliveries. After the waiting period, return promptly to the main machine shop to report that the distribution task is finished.

Begin at the Seedling Sorting Room and pick up twelve trays of labeled lettuce seedlings. Transport four trays of lettuce seedlings first to the Hydroponics Greenhouse and wait there until the greenhouse manager confirms receipt of the delivery. After delivery at the Hydroponics Greenhouse, bring another four trays of lettuce seedlings to the Rooftop Research Beds, pause at the drop-off location for seven minutes to allow researchers to inspect the trays, then proceed with the remaining four trays of lettuce seedlings to the Vertical Farming Tower. If, upon arrival at the Vertical Farming Tower, the farm technician has already cleared space on the receiving rack, deliver the final four trays of lettuce seedlings immediately; otherwise, wait at the Vertical Farming Tower until space becomes available before completing the delivery, and only then return to the Seedling Sorting Room to end your task.

Start by retrieving a pallet of fertilizer bags labeled Batch 22 from the Central Supply Depot and transport it to Silo A on the western side of the property; wait at Silo A until staff finish removing 6 bags from the pallet. After this, drive the remaining pallet to Silo B near the southeastern boundary and deliver another 5 bags, making sure to remain in position while each bag is fully offloaded before proceeding. With the last 4 bags still on the pallet, continue to Silo C adjacent to the irrigation control hut. Distribute all 4 remaining bags at Silo C, then wait for two minutes to allow the automated loader to secure the empty pallet. Once the loader signals completion, return the empty pallet to the Central Supply Depot and stand by for further instructions.

Begin at the main equipment depot and collect twelve diagnostic sensor modules. Deliver an equal number of diagnostic sensor modules to each of the following maintenance bays: Maintenance Bay A, Maintenance Bay B, and Maintenance Bay C. Since twelve cannot be divided evenly among three bays, allocate four diagnostic sensor modules to each bay. However, if any maintenance bay cannot receive its allocation due to space constraints, wait for up to ten minutes at that bay until there is sufficient room and the technician signals that receiving is possible. After all diagnostic sensor modules have been distributed and received by the respective maintenance teams, proceed to the central operations office to report task completion and await future assignments.

Begin at the equipment storage depot adjacent to the northern greenhouse and pick up a crate containing twelve irrigation valve assemblies. Proceed first to Field Delta and deliver three valve assemblies near the main pipeline junction; once Field Delta staff confirm the payload is ready for removal, continue to the southern tool station at Field Echo and drop off four more valve assemblies. At Field Echo, wait for seven minutes while the assembly technician verifies compatibility with the existing system, then transport the remaining five valve assemblies to the maintenance bay beside the machinery garage at Field Foxtrot. Upon arrival at Field Foxtrot, wait for the maintenance supervisor to be ready for unloading before the valve assemblies are removed, and after this final handoff, proceed to the depot office at the main farm entrance to await instructions for return logistics.

Start by proceeding to Mechanic Bay 2 to collect eight maintenance toolkits scheduled for distribution. Make your first stop at Machine Shed Alpha, delivering two toolkits and waiting at Machine Shed Alpha until a technician confirms all toolkits have been removed from your cargo. Next, transport three toolkits to Tractor Garage West; after all three toolkits have been fully unloaded at Tractor Garage West, wait there for two minutes to allow for an equipment audit to complete before departing. With the remaining three toolkits, continue to Sprayer Dock C and deliver as many as the dock manager will accept; in the event that Sprayer Dock C cannot receive all three toolkits, move any leftover toolkits directly to Storage Cabinet Zeta. After each drop-off location, remain stationary for sixty seconds to enable routine safety checks before continuing to the next task. Once all eight toolkits have been distributed and all time-gated stops have been observed, return promptly to Mechanic Bay 2 to await your subsequent assignment.

Commence your route at the Seed Storage Depot and collect a container filled with hybrid corn seeds. Proceed immediately to Field Plot A and wait for two minutes while the field crew verifies that the seeder machinery is properly aligned to receive the seeds. Once confirmation is received, deliver a third of the seed container’s contents to Field Plot A, ensuring any excess due to non-divisible quantity remains reserved. Next, deliver the next third of the seeds to Field Plot B, again pausing for two minutes after arrival to allow staff to prepare their spreaders. Transfer the remaining seeds, including any excess from earlier division, to Field Plot C and wait until the last portion has been fully transferred. After completing all three deliveries, return directly to the Seed Storage Depot and wait for instructions regarding fertilizer distribution.

Start your task at Storage Warehouse 2 and load six sealed crates of harvested tomatoes onto your cargo bay. Deliver three crates to Packing Station A, ensuring an even split, and wait there for two minutes while the quality inspectors unload and scan each crate. After all crates have been removed, take the remaining three crates to Cold Storage Room B, but if the walk-in refrigeration unit at Cold Storage B is occupied when you arrive, wait outside for five minutes before attempting delivery again. Only once all crates have been successfully transferred to Cold Storage Room B should you proceed to Cleaning Dock 4 for scheduled decontamination.

Start at Materials Loading Dock 1 and pick up a total of eleven sealed battery units scheduled for distribution. Deliver four battery units to Assembly Line X, then wait until a technician at Assembly Line X signals that all delivered battery units have been installed; only after receiving this signal, continue to Assembly Line Y with three more battery units and remain there for five minutes, even if the unloading is completed earlier, to allow for inventory checks. After the five-minute interval, head to Quality Assurance Center and provide the remaining four battery units, but be sure to wait for explicit confirmation of battery intake before leaving; if this confirmation is delayed, wait for an additional three minutes before checking again, repeating this waiting cycle up to two times. After all battery units are delivered and required confirmations are successfully received at each destination, return directly to Materials Loading Dock 1 to complete your shift.

Begin at the main crate staging dock and load fourteen bags of nitrogen fertilizer, checking that each bag is properly secured before leaving. Proceed first to Field A, where you must deliver five fertilizer bags directly to the supply shed, stopping and waiting until the shed manager signals all bags have been fully removed from your cargo. After the removal is complete, travel to Field B and distribute another five fertilizer bags to the fertilizer bin, again waiting on site until the bins are confirmed fully stocked and your payload is reduced accordingly. Any remaining fertilizer bags—either three or four depending on the original bag count—should then be transported to Field C; if there are four bags left, place two bags inside the east storage unit and two bags in the west storage unit, but if there are only three, allocate two to the east unit and one to the west. Once all deliveries are complete, remain at Field C for an additional 8 minutes to provide support for any urgent redistribution requests before making your return journey to the main crate staging dock.

Start at Grain Mill Loading Dock and collect nine sacks of processed barley flour. Distribute the sacks in the following manner: deliver three sacks to Bakery Storage Room, two sacks to Research Kitchen Pantry, and four sacks to Community Market Stall, ensuring that the Research Kitchen receives its sacks only after all sacks have been successfully delivered to Bakery Storage Room. If any location is temporarily inaccessible for drop-off, skip to the next destination, and return later to complete the outstanding deliveries in the original order. After all sacks have been distributed, wait for five minutes at the Community Market Stall to allow inventory staff to inspect the delivered flour before returning to Grain Mill Loading Dock to await notification of the next batch's availability.

Begin at the Central Materials Hub and collect twenty-four sealed fertilizer packets designated for the day's scheduled field applications. Evenly distribute these packets by making delivery stops at Field Alpha, Field Delta, and Field Gamma, leaving eight fertilizer packets at each field; if there are any remaining packets after these deliveries due to partial batch requests, bring all leftover fertilizer packets to the Equipment Storage Barn as a backup stockpile. After the final delivery at Equipment Storage Barn is complete, proceed directly to the southern loading dock adjacent to the Administration Building, but do not approach the dock platform until receiving confirmation from the dock supervisor that the payload space is cleared and ready for offloading operations. Only once this confirmation has been received, remain at the southern loading dock for a duration of ten minutes to allow field personnel to inspect and potentially reassign your carrying module before your next set of tasks are assigned.

Start at the Central Maintenance Bay and load twelve replacement hydraulic filters onto the robot. Next, navigate to Tractor Depot One and deliver four hydraulic filters, remaining at the depot until the service manager confirms that each filter has been fully offloaded and inspected. Afterward, proceed to Tractor Depot Two to unload another four hydraulic filters, but pause for eight minutes outside the depot entrance to allow workers to secure the equipment area before entering and transferring the filters; do not depart until the depot staff acknowledge receipt of all four filters. Move on to Tractor Depot Three with the remaining four hydraulic filters and, upon arrival, wait for the maintenance supervisor to signal readiness before commencing the drop-off process. Only after all twelve filters have been successfully distributed among the three depots—with staff confirmations and required waiting periods completed at each location—should you return to the Central Maintenance Bay to conclude your route.

Begin at the Parts Storage Depot and load seven hydraulic pump modules onto the transport carrier. Proceed first to the North Orchard Maintenance Shed and deliver two hydraulic pump modules, waiting for the orchard chief mechanic to verify proper receipt before continuing. Next, head to the East Vineyard Equipment Bay to drop off another two modules, and remain until notified that their installation has begun. Then, transport two additional hydraulic pump modules to the South Field Repair Station and await confirmation from the field supervisor that both modules have been unloaded. Finally, take the last remaining hydraulic pump module to the West Irrigation Control Tower and wait there for five minutes to allow the engineering team to complete their inspection before returning to the Parts Storage Depot to report completion of all deliveries.

Proceed to Storage Bay Alpha to collect a total of nine pest-control canisters; then, begin distribution by delivering three canisters each to Orchard Section 1, Orchard Section 2, and Orchard Section 3, ensuring that each section receives an equal share. After each drop-off, remain at the respective orchard section until you receive confirmation from the on-site supervisor that all canisters have been unloaded before moving to the next section. Upon completion of all three deliveries, return to Storage Bay Alpha and wait for seven minutes before initiating any additional tasks, to allow time for inventory reconciliation and potential replenishment of your payload.

Initiate the process at the main equipment bay beside the west greenhouse and proceed to the pallet loading zone near the fertilizer storage shed to pick up a batch of nine sealed fertilizer containers. Deliver four containers to Crop Field Alpha beside the irrigation channel and wait until each container has been manually offloaded by the field operators. Once complete, transport three fertilizer containers to Crop Field Bravo adjacent to the southern fence and wait for all three containers to be removed by staff. Then, take the remaining two containers to Crop Field Charlie by the eastern shelterbelt, waiting until unloading of both is confirmed. After completing all container deliveries, remain at Crop Field Charlie for a 7-minute standby period before returning to the main equipment bay to conclude the mission.

Start at Storage Warehouse 3 and collect nine sealed fertilizer bags designated for distribution. Transport four bags first to Silo Loading Dock A, and remain at Silo Loading Dock A until all four fertilizer bags are removed by the dock agent. Once this transfer is confirmed, proceed to Field Access Gate West with three more fertilizer bags, and wait for the on-site crew to unload all three bags. After this handoff is complete, deliver the final two fertilizer bags to the Equipment Staging Pad near Greenhouse 7, making certain to wait until a greenhouse technician verifies removal of both bags. Between each delivery, pause for 90 seconds near the exit of each location before departing to the next stop to ensure system stabilization. After the last delivery at Greenhouse 7’s staging pad, return directly to Storage Warehouse 3 for the next distribution cycle.

Begin your route at the Northern Seed Warehouse, where you must load the cart with fifteen irrigation control units. Proceed first to Pumping Station East and offload five irrigation control units at the maintenance crate, waiting until the maintenance technician at Pumping Station East signals that all units are removed. After confirmation, continue to Pumping Station Central and deliver another five irrigation control units, again pausing until the maintenance technician at Pumping Station Central has finished unloading the requested units. Next, proceed to Pumping Station West and deliver the final five irrigation control units, remaining until you receive the removal confirmation from the maintenance crew at Pumping Station West. Once all fifteen units have been distributed and their removal fully confirmed at the three pumping stations, you are to return directly to the Northern Seed Warehouse but only after remaining at Pumping Station West for an additional three minutes to allow for system updates by the site manager before departing the location.

Begin at the Seed Storage Facility and collect a shipment of eighteen fertilizer packs labeled for field application. Distribute the fertilizer evenly by delivering six packs each to Wheat Field Alpha, Corn Plot Beta, and Soybean Terrace Gamma; if there are any leftover packs after this allocation, transport the remainder to the Experimental Test Bed for agronomy trials. After delivering fertilizer to each field, pause for five minutes to allow the respective farm manager at Alpha, Beta, or Gamma to inspect the application, and do not proceed to the next destination until inspection is complete. Once all primary deliveries and inspections are finished, return to each field in sequence to pick up any empty fertilizer containers left behind, and shuttle these to the Sanitation Dock, waiting two minutes for decontamination procedures to finish at the dock after each trip. When all empties have been processed, return to the Seed Storage Facility and await further dispatch instructions for a period of seven minutes before concluding the task.

Begin at the Central Seed Vault and take possession of four irrigation control modules. Allocate the modules by delivering one each to Crop Plot Alpha, Crop Plot Beta, and Crop Plot Gamma, making sure to handle any remaining module by transporting the extra one to Crop Plot Delta to ensure all plots receive at least one. After the final module has been delivered at Crop Plot Delta, remain at that location for 7 minutes as a precaution in case module calibration is required. Once the waiting period is complete and no additional tasks are requested by the field technician, proceed directly to Maintenance Bay 2 and confirm your arrival before initiating shutdown procedures.

Begin at the central loading dock and collect a total of twenty-four fertilizer canisters designated for three distinct fields; once all canisters are secured, transport nine canisters to the west sunflower field, distribute eight canisters to the east wheat plot, and deliver the remaining seven canisters to the south orchard, making sure no canisters are mixed between fields. After completing each delivery, wait for three minutes at the drop-off location to receive confirmation from the field supervisor that the fertilizer canisters have been properly positioned. Only after all twenty-four fertilizer canisters have been distributed and after all three confirmation waits have transpired, proceed to the equipment maintenance bay to undergo a routine status check before powering down for the day.

Start your mission at the Central Storage Depot, picking up six sealed fertilizer bags that are to be allocated to multiple sites. First, transport two fertilizer bags to the Northern Orchard Distribution Point and wait until the site supervisor confirms reception and removal of the bags from your cargo. After this transfer, continue to the Western Vegetable Field Shed, where you are to deliver another two fertilizer bags and remain onsite until the field crew has emptied your payload compartment of these bags. Next, take the final two fertilizer bags to the Southern Crop Research Plot; upon arrival, wait for five minutes while researchers complete their intake procedures and log the fertilizer receipt. Once all fertilizer transfers have been confirmed at each destination, return directly to the Central Storage Depot and stay in the robot staging area until further deployment instructions are provided.

Start at the Seed Storage Facility and load a total of thirteen seed distribution containers onto the robot, confirming that all containers are securely in place before departure. Travel first to Field Plot A and deliver four seed distribution containers, waiting at Field Plot A until each container has been fully removed by the field technician. Once all four containers are unloaded at Field Plot A, proceed to Field Plot B and allocate another four containers, remaining on site until removal is complete. After leaving Field Plot B, head directly to Field Plot C with the remaining five containers: unload four containers right away, then wait for seven minutes before handing over the final container, as per the agronomist's staggered planting request. Confirm that the last container has been removed at Field Plot C, then return to the Seed Storage Facility to complete the delivery cycle and prepare for possible additional dispatches.

Begin your route at the loading dock of the grain processing plant and acquire nine sealed bags of treated wheat seed destined for field planting. Your first delivery comprises three bags, which must be transported to Silo A at the west paddock and distributed to the receiving area; be sure to wait until the onsite agronomist removes all three bags before leaving. Next, deliver another three seed bags to Silo B next to the north barley field, and remain parked for 5 minutes upon arrival to allow the inventory audit to be completed before the bags can be unloaded. Finally, take the last three seed bags to the Field Research Station adjacent to the east plot, but do not leave until the field manager has manually confirmed the delivery and removed the payload from your platform. Once all seed bags have been distributed and acknowledged at their respective sites, return directly to the grain processing plant's loading dock and await further orders.

Begin at Loading Dock Alpha in the central depot and load nine sacks of fortified grain from the storage pallet onto your transport module. Distribute the sacks among Field Station North, Livestock Barn Delta, and the Processing Mill as follows: deliver three grain sacks to Field Station North first, remain on-site for five minutes to allow workers to offload the goods, and wait until all three sacks are confirmed unloaded. Next, proceed to Livestock Barn Delta and unload another four grain sacks, staying until farm staff have removed the bags and signaled completion. Any remaining sacks, which will be two, should then be taken to the Processing Mill, but only transfer the grain sacks to the intake bay once the mill operator has finished clearing the previous batch (wait at the mill entrance for up to seven minutes if necessary before making the drop). After all sacks are delivered and confirmed at each site, return to Loading Dock Alpha to await further dispatch instructions.

Begin at the Main Maintenance Garage and wait until the engine diagnostic package is ready. Once the diagnostic package is prepared, transport it directly to Tractor Bay 4 and remain until the tractor technician collects and removes the package. After receiving confirmation of the removal, proceed immediately to Storage Yard A and collect six replacement hydraulic hoses. Distribute these hoses by delivering two hoses each to Greenhouse Loading Dock, Field Equipment Shed, and Processing Facility Receiving Area, ensuring that any remainder hoses are left at Processing Facility Receiving Area if the total number is not evenly divisible. After completing all drop-offs, wait at the Processing Facility Receiving Area for 10 minutes to allow staff to conduct an inventory check before returning to the Main Maintenance Garage to report task completion.

Commence your route at the Equipment Loading Dock, where you must acquire a total of seven irrigation hose reels, then travel directly to the Eastern Vineyard. Distribute three irrigation hose reels to the vineyard crew and wait until they confirm all three reels have been removed from your robot. With four reels remaining, proceed to the Southern Greenhouse Complex and deliver another three irrigation hose reels to the greenhouse staff, again waiting until all items are fully unloaded. After these deliveries, take the final irrigation hose reel to the West Farm Utility Shed; upon arrival, remain for four minutes to allow the maintenance team to conduct their inspection and transport procedures. Once all hose reels have been successfully delivered and accounted for at each location, return your vehicle to the Equipment Loading Dock and wait there for further instructions.

Start at the Equipment Loading Dock and collect a total of eight fertilizer containers labeled for immediate distribution. Transport three containers first to Silo One at the western storage ring, deliver them, and wait at Silo One until all three containers have been fully offloaded by the receiving supervisor. Next, bring another three fertilizer containers to Silo Two, which is situated next to the eastern service road, and remain there until the drop-off is complete and the containers are acknowledged as received. Once both silos have been restocked, take the remaining two fertilizer containers to the Emergency Supply Shed located between Greenhouse Block A and Greenhouse Block B. After confirming successful transfer at the Emergency Supply Shed, wait for 5 minutes to allow for any unforeseen loading issues; then, proceed immediately to the Vehicle Charging Station at the central junction and stand by for further deployment instructions.

Start at the West Storage Depot and load eight sacks of premium fertilizer onto your platform. Deliver three sacks to the North Orchard Shed and wait until each sack is removed by the orchard manager. Once the North Shed delivery is complete, proceed to the Central Greenhouse Annex with another three sacks, but before you allow the greenhouse staff to remove the sacks, wait outside the annex for four minutes to allow for safety checks. With the two remaining fertilizer sacks, continue to the South Vegetable Plots Distribution Area, and wait there until both sacks are unloaded by the supervisor. After confirming that all eight sacks have been completely distributed among the three locations, return promptly to the West Storage Depot to report task completion.

Commence your shift at the tool storage depot and retrieve a set of six precision irrigation nozzles labeled for the north sector upgrades. Proceed to the east greenhouse loading dock and transfer two irrigation nozzles to the horticulture supervisor, waiting until both nozzles are confirmed as unloaded before continuing. Next, carry the remaining four nozzles to the pump calibration laboratory, where you will deliver three nozzles to the technician and wait for five minutes to allow for an initial calibration check. Leave the last nozzle on the laboratory intake bench, then return directly to the tool storage depot and remain there until all delivery confirmations are received from both the horticulture supervisor and the laboratory technician.

Start by navigating to Water Pump Station Delta and load four high-capacity filtration cartridges into the robot's compartment, making sure to check that each cartridge is securely stowed before departing. Deliver one cartridge to Irrigation Node East, and wait until the technician at Irrigation Node East completes removal before heading to the next location. Next, transport two cartridges to Irrigation Node South; if at any point the maintenance personnel at Irrigation Node South are delayed, wait for six minutes before reattempting delivery and offload both cartridges only when they are ready to receive them. For the last remaining cartridge, continue to Irrigation Node West, but do not initiate removal until you have received confirmation from the supervisory control room that the operating schedule permits it—if confirmation is not received within five minutes of arrival, return the cartridge to Water Pump Station Delta. Once all intended deliveries are either completed or returned due to scheduling conflicts, proceed to Service Dock Beta for a post-route diagnostic check and remain there until the service technician authorizes departure, after which the robot should return to its original starting position at Water Pump Station Delta.

Begin at the packing facility next to Warehouse 8 and retrieve a sealed pallet containing fourteen packages of organic seeds. Transport the pallet to the east loading dock at Silo Complex Alpha and unload exactly five packages there, waiting until the receiving clerk signals that all packages have been properly checked in. After this confirmation, continue to the greenhouse equipment yard and offload another five packages, ensuring that the greenhouse supervisor confirms payload removal before proceeding. Move on to Distribution Point Charlie with the remaining four seed packages, and deliver them to the designated drop zone for horticulture staff. After the staff remove the packages, remain at Distribution Point Charlie for ten minutes to allow for a mandatory record-keeping interval before returning to the packing facility to await further deployment orders.

Begin at the Grain Processing Facility by retrieving nine seed packets from Storage Room A, ensuring each packet is accounted for before departure. Proceed first to Silo Alpha and distribute three seed packets, waiting onsite until the silo manager confirms the packets have been successfully removed. Once receipt is confirmed, travel to Greenhouse Beta and deliver another three seed packets, remaining at the greenhouse until removal by the greenhouse technician is explicitly acknowledged. Next, head to Field Station Gamma with the final three seed packets, awaiting the field supervisor’s confirmation of packet removal. After all deliveries are completed and removal of each batch is verified at every location, return to Storage Room A and remain stationary for 6 minutes, allowing inventory personnel sufficient time to log your completed drops before taking on a new job.

Start by navigating to Warehouse C and retrieve a crate containing 37 sealed fertilizer pouches. Distribute these pouches across three field storage stations: deliver 13 pouches to North Field Bay and wait until all 13 are unloaded by the receiving attendant, then proceed to South Field Bay to drop off another 12 pouches and remain there until they are removed. The remaining 12 pouches must be transported to West Field Depot; after unloading, wait for a full 7 minutes to give the depot staff sufficient time to verify the delivery and sign off on the received quantity. Only after finishing the waiting period and confirming all pouches have been delivered should you continue to Maintenance Shed B to await further supply transfer instructions.

Start at Dock Bay 3 and collect two water filtration units from the delivery pallet. Bring both water filtration units to the Equipment Calibration Room adjacent to the processing plant and wait until both are confirmed to be calibrated by the technician; this may require standing by for up to 5 minutes. After both units are ready, deliver the first water filtration unit to the South Field Pump House, and once the unit has been removed at the Pump House, proceed to transport the second water filtration unit to the North Irrigation Control Shed. Only after both units have been successfully delivered to their respective destinations, return to Dock Bay 3 and wait for 2 minutes in case additional water filtration units require transportation.

Begin by collecting nine sealed crates of seed packets from Storage Room Delta. Transit immediately to Field Plot 1 and deliver three crates there, waiting at Field Plot 1 until each crate has been fully offloaded by the field technician. Afterward, proceed to Field Plot 2 and deposit another three crates of seed packets, but remain on site for five minutes to allow the planting crew to confirm the delivery and scan the crate barcodes—do not leave before the time elapses, even if the unloading is complete. The last three crates should be brought to Greenhouse Entry Dock; if Greenhouse Entry Dock is not ready to receive all three crates, leave as many as can be accepted and transport any remaining crates back to Storage Room Delta for secure holding. Once the seed packet deliveries and all necessary waiting intervals are finalized, return to Storage Room Delta and await further instructions from the supervisor.

Start at Field Storage Shed and collect 14 trays of freshly harvested tomatoes, ensuring all trays are properly secured before departing. Transport the tomatoes first to Packing Station East and deliver 5 trays to the supervisor; wait until the supervisor finishes unloading the 5 trays before continuing. Next, travel to Quality Sorting Zone where 5 additional trays must be handed over; remain in place until the sorting lead completes the removal process. Afterwards, bring the final 4 trays to Cold Room 3 for storage—if the cold room is still being sanitized upon arrival, wait for 6 minutes before the storage clerk removes the trays. Once all tomatoes have been delivered, remain in Cold Room 3 for a further 5 minutes to verify proper logging of the transferred produce, then return directly to Field Storage Shed and prepare for the next assignment.

Begin at Loading Dock C and move to the Refrigerated Storage Area to pick up nine crates of perishable produce once the crates are labeled for transport. Distribute these crates evenly by delivering three crates each to Market Distribution Point 1, Market Distribution Point 2, and Market Distribution Point 3; if a location cannot accept a full set due to capacity limits at the time of arrival, wait at that location for two minutes before attempting delivery again, repeating this waiting cycle until the full allocation is accepted. After all nine crates are successfully delivered to their respective destinations, proceed directly to Loading Dock C and wait there for five minutes so that post-delivery sanitation protocols can be completed before your next assignment.

Start by going to the Parts Warehouse adjacent to the main assembly plant and pick up four sensor calibration kits. Proceed to Machine Station One in the north wing and deliver one calibration kit, remaining on site until the maintenance supervisor confirms the kit has been received and ready to install. Following this, head to Machine Station Two located in the central production hall and drop off another calibration kit, waiting there for three minutes to allow the technician to review the delivery documentation. Next, transport a kit to Machine Station Three at the southern end of the facility, and pause until the kit is physically removed from your platform by the on-duty engineer. The final kit should be delivered to Machine Station Four near the east exit, but only proceed to this location after all prior deliveries have been verified as complete; once the last delivery is made, return immediately to the Parts Warehouse for system check-in and assignment update.

Start at the Seed Supply House and collect eight seed crates designated for distribution to three distinct fields: distribute three seed crates to Wheat Plot Epsilon, four seed crates to Corn Field Zeta, and deliver the remaining single seed crate to Barley Test Strip Theta. Following each delivery, wait until all crates are confirmed removed by the respective field supervisor before proceeding to the next location. Only after all crates have been fully delivered and unloaded at every destination, travel to Maintenance Bay Gamma and wait there for 10 minutes to undergo routine diagnostics before you may accept new delivery tasks.

Begin at Maintenance Bay Alpha and pick up nine replacement hydraulic hoses, confirming that all hoses are undamaged and properly secured before departure. Proceed first to Greenhouse Block One and deliver three hoses to the on-site repair technician, waiting for a signal that each hose has been successfully integrated into the irrigation system before moving on. Next, continue to Equipment Shed Two and deposit four hoses, remaining there until a technician confirms that the old hoses have been fully removed and the replacements are staged for installation. With the final two hoses, make your way to Tractor Depot Omega, where you must wait exactly three minutes after arrival to allow the depot staff to clear the service area, and then deliver the hoses onto the designated bench. Only after every drop-off is complete and all confirmations have been received, return to Maintenance Bay Alpha and stay there for five minutes to ensure the service log is reviewed by onsite personnel before the task cycle concludes.

Start by navigating to Storage Depot A and collect seven crates of irrigation valves. First, proceed to Nursery Shed 1 and deliver two of the crates, making sure to wait until the nursery manager verifies that both crates have been offloaded before you continue. Next, head to Field Pump Station B with three more crates and remain at the location for five minutes while the crew completes their inventory check and removes the crates from your cart. Lastly, transport the remaining two crates of irrigation valves to Greenhouse Sector D; however, if the greenhouse supervisor is not present when you arrive, hold your position for six minutes before attempting to complete the transfer. Do not return to Storage Depot A until every crate has been successfully received and acknowledged at its respective destination.

Start by collecting eight sealed seed crates from the supply warehouse. Proceed to Field Section Alpha first, where you must distribute three seed crates and wait for the local technician to finish inspection before unloading. After this, continue to Field Section Bravo, allocating another three seed crates, and remain on site for a 4-minute waiting period to allow the automated sowing machines to initialize. The remaining two seed crates must be delivered to the experimental test plot at Field Section Gamma, but only commence this final drop-off if the technician at Field Section Alpha has confirmed that all crates were successfully received. Upon completion of all distributions, return to the supply warehouse for system diagnostics.

Start by proceeding to Bulk Chemical Storage Facility A to pick up a cargo of fifteen sealed fertilizer drums. Distribute these fertilizer drums among four field depot sites: deliver four drums each to Field Depot North and Field Depot South, three drums to Field Depot East, and the remaining four drums to Field Depot West, making certain each depot receives the specified number. After each drop-off at a depot, wait until the depot supervisor confirms the removal of all fertilizer drums at that location before heading to the next destination. Once all fertilizer drums have been delivered and offloaded confirmations are received from every depot, travel to the Central Decontamination Bay and remain there for ten minutes to complete a mandatory decontamination protocol before returning to service or receiving additional assignments.

Start at the maintenance depot and collect nine replacement air filters needed for seasonal servicing. Transport three replacement air filters to Workshop A and wait until all three have been collected by the maintenance technician before proceeding. Next, bring another three replacement air filters to Workshop B, ensuring you remain at the drop-off point until all three filters are removed by Workshop B's staff. After completing the second delivery, carry the final three replacement air filters to Workshop C, wait until the technicians have retrieved these last filters, and then remain at Workshop C for two minutes to allow for any immediate supply requests before returning to the maintenance depot to report task completion.

Begin your route at Supply Depot Delta and collect twelve sealed fertilizer canisters for distribution. Your first destination is Field Plot A, where you must offload five canisters; wait up to five minutes for the field team to confirm successful storage before departing. Next, proceed to Field Plot B and deliver another five canisters, again waiting five minutes to ensure the goods are properly received. The remaining two canisters are to be taken to Greenhouse Station 3; only hand them over after you verify that both Field Plot A and Field Plot B teams have confirmed receipt of their deliveries. Once the Greenhouse Station 3 supervisor acknowledges arrival of the last pair of canisters, stay at Greenhouse Station 3 for a minimum of three minutes to synchronize operation logs with the station's control panel. After all steps are completed, promptly return to Supply Depot Delta for future tasks.

Begin at the packaging warehouse and pick up twelve sealed cartons of organic tomatoes. Transport four sealed cartons to Loading Bay 2, making sure to wait until the packaging supervisor confirms removal of all four cartons before you proceed. Following this, take another four sealed cartons to Refrigerated Storage Room 1, and wait there for eight minutes to allow the cooling system to stabilize and the storage manager to remove the cartons. Once both prior drop-offs are complete, carry the remaining four sealed cartons to Distribution Dock 5, and wait at Distribution Dock 5 until the shipping staff has fully unloaded the final four cartons. After all deliveries and checks are completed, return directly to the packaging warehouse to synchronize with the central logistics system.

Start at the Harvest Control Center and confirm that a shipment of seventeen harvested apple bins is ready in Dock Bay 2. Distribute these apple bins by delivering six to Processing Facility A, five to Packaging Station B, and the remaining six to Cold Storage Unit C, making sure to account for all seventeen bins. First, take six apple bins to Processing Facility A, wait until the facility manager confirms and removes all bins, and do not proceed until you receive this confirmation. Then, deliver five apple bins to Packaging Station B, waiting on-site for three minutes to allow the station crew to complete their setup before they are able to remove the bins; only after this waiting period should you facilitate the transfer and confirm all five bins have been received. Finally, transport the last six apple bins to Cold Storage Unit C, remaining there until the cold storage technician removes every bin and provides verbal acknowledgment of receipt. Once all apple bins have been properly distributed and receipt confirmed at each location, return to Dock Bay 2 at the Harvest Control Center and remain idle for five minutes to complete system logging and downtime before you shut down your route.

Begin at Storage Dock A and acquire a batch of 17 sensor modules, confirming each module is properly packaged for safe handling before leaving the dock. Travel first to Greenhouse Unit 1 and deliver six sensor modules; remain at Greenhouse Unit 1 until the installation supervisor verifies each module has arrived and is unboxed. Then, proceed to Greenhouse Unit 2 and distribute another six sensor modules, but wait at Greenhouse Unit 2 for four minutes to allow for preliminary on-site testing of these modules. Afterward, transport the final five sensor modules to Greenhouse Unit 3, but do not proceed with delivery until all outdated sensors at Greenhouse Unit 3 have been fully removed and accounted for by the greenhouse manager. Once every batch has been delivered and all waiting periods or conditions are satisfied at the respective greenhouses, return directly to Storage Dock A and await clearance from the logistics coordinator before concluding the assignment.

Start your route at Grain Storage Silo 1, where you must collect a total of fourteen sealed grain sample containers. Evenly distribute these containers among four quality control collection points: deliver three containers to Lab Station Alpha, three to Lab Station Beta, four to Testing Dock Gamma, and the remaining four containers to Warehouse Delta; if uneven distribution is necessary, allocate the extra container(s) to Warehouse Delta. After completing all four drop-offs, proceed to the Loading Bay and wait for five minutes to allow the logistics coordinator to process the collection receipts. Once the waiting period has concluded, head directly to Equipment Depot 7 to pick up a set of calibration weights, then deliver these weights to the Maintenance Control Room, but only do so after receiving confirmation from the coordinator at the Loading Bay that the receipt process is finished.

Start at Loading Dock 3 and retrieve four cases of processed seed packets, ensuring all four cases are accounted for before departing. Make the first delivery to Silo West, depositing one case and waiting there until the storage assistant confirms successful transfer. Next, continue to the Farmstead Workshop with two cases; on arrival, distribute one case to the lead technician and the second to the maintenance room, waiting until both have been removed from your payload before proceeding. Finally, take the remaining single case to Crop Plot Gamma, deliver it to the field manager, and wait alongside the delivery area for seven minutes while initial seeding preparations take place. Only after the full seven minutes have passed and all cases have been delivered, return directly to Loading Dock 3 to complete your route.

First, make your way to the Central Tool Shed to retrieve nine replacement hose reels. Distribute these hose reels as follows: bring four hose reels to Greenhouse 2’s west entrance, three hose reels to the South Orchard maintenance alcove, and deliver the last two hose reels to the North Storage Platform.
