For each drop-off, wait at the location until the site technician has removed the hose reels and confirmed receipt before heading to the next destination. Once all nine hose reels are delivered and acknowledged, proceed to the Irrigation Control Center and wait there for fifteen minutes to allow the facilities manager to complete a system reset. Only after the allotted time at the Irrigation Control Center should you depart for your subsequent assignment, ensuring that all previous handoffs and waiting periods have been properly observed.

Start at the storage hangar and collect a crate containing twenty-three irrigation drone batteries. Travel first to Field Station West and deliver eight batteries, but do not continue until the maintenance technician at Field Station West has signaled that all batteries have been safely unloaded. Next, bring seven batteries to Field Station Central, waiting for the station engineer to confirm payload removal before proceeding. Then, take the remaining eight batteries to the solar array outpost, where you must wait until the solar array supervisor confirms receipt of all batteries. Once deliveries to all three locations are confirmed, remain at the solar array outpost for fifteen minutes to accommodate system testing, and then return to the storage hangar for the next assignment.

Start at Maintenance Bay A and retrieve the three spare battery units prepared for network relay towers. Transport one battery unit first to Relay Tower South, and after handing it over, remain nearby for four minutes to allow technicians to install and validate the battery. Next, proceed to Relay Tower East and wait until the previous battery has been safely removed by the service crew before delivering the second battery unit; only transfer the battery once you receive confirmation from the crew chief. Deliver the third battery to Relay Tower West, but if the weather station adjacent to Relay Tower West is still undergoing repairs upon your arrival, wait for up to ten minutes before attempting to drop off the battery. After all three batteries have been successfully delivered and acknowledged at their respective towers, return directly to Maintenance Bay A to report task completion.

Begin by moving to the Chemical Storage Facility and waiting for the safety officer to finish prepping thirty pesticide canisters for transport. Once loaded, divide the canisters by delivering twelve to Spraying Station East, another twelve to Spraying Station West, and the final six to Spraying Station Central, explicitly verifying that the correct count is left at each spot. After each delivery, pause for 5 minutes at the station gate to allow for security clearance checks by station staff before traveling to the next destination. As soon as all canisters are delivered and the waiting periods are complete, proceed immediately to the Vehicle Charging Dock and remain there until notified that the next transport cycle is ready.

Start by proceeding to the Seed Storage Room and collect nine seed dispensers, ensuring all dispensers have been properly loaded and tagged for distribution. Next, deliver three seed dispensers each to Greenhouse 1, the West Test Plot, and the Experimental Vertical Farm; carry out the deliveries one location at a time, and after completing each handoff, wait until the designated agronomist at the current site provides verbal confirmation of receipt before continuing to the next destination. If any site reports that their receiving bay is full, pause for five minutes at the location before attempting to complete the transfer again; resume the delivery sequence in the original order once each transfer is acknowledged. After all seed dispensers are successfully distributed, head to the Equipment Cleaning Station, wait for seven minutes to complete post-operation sanitization, and then remain there until further instructions are issued.

Start at the Greenhouse Loading Dock and collect a shipment of nineteen fertilizer sacks. Proceed to Field Plot A and deliver six fertilizer sacks, then wait until the field supervisor indicates that all sacks have been offloaded before continuing. Next, travel to Field Plot B and unload another six fertilizer sacks, remaining by the drop-off point until workers have removed each sack. For Field Plot C, deliver the remaining seven fertilizer sacks—explicitly ensuring that this plot receives the extra sack to handle the shipment remainder. After all sacks have been distributed, proceed to the Equipment Cleaning Station and pause for seven minutes to allow for a decontamination process. Only after the decontamination period has elapsed, return to the Greenhouse Loading Dock to end the delivery sequence.

Begin at the main seed vault adjacent to Facility A and collect a total of seven sealed soybean sample canisters. Transport two canisters each to Laboratory 1 North, Laboratory 2 Central, and Laboratory 3 East, ensuring that no laboratory receives more than two canisters—deliver the remaining single canister to Laboratory 4 South to handle the leftover. After each drop-off, wait for the laboratory personnel at each location to confirm the removal of their assigned canisters before proceeding to the next destination. Once all deliveries are complete, proceed to the equipment sterilization zone near Loading Dock B, and remain there for 12 minutes to allow for mandatory decontamination procedures before returning to the main seed vault for further instructions.

Begin at Maintenance Bay Alpha and collect nine battery replacement modules, ensuring that all modules are loaded onto your platform before leaving. Travel to Charging Station One and deliver three battery replacement modules, making sure each module is handed over and confirmed by the technician prior to departure. Next, proceed to Equipment Shed Bravo to deliver another three battery replacement modules, but do not start unloading until you have waited for 4 minutes to allow the old batteries at Equipment Shed Bravo to be safely removed; only then, deliver the modules one by one and confirm each removal. The final three battery replacement modules are to be taken to Field Operations Hub; however, if any of the previous delivery locations are delayed in acknowledging receipt, pause outside the Field Operations Hub for an additional 2 minutes before attempting to offload. Upon completion of all deliveries and adherence to the specified wait times and acknowledgments, promptly return to Maintenance Bay Alpha for system diagnostics and resupply preparation.

Start at the main equipment depot to collect eight battery packs intended for distribution across remote sensor posts. Travel first to Sensor Post Alpha and deliver three battery packs, ensuring that each delivery is confirmed as received before proceeding. Once Sensor Post Alpha has been resupplied, move to Sensor Post Beta and unload another three battery packs, waiting one minute after the handoff to allow for diagnostic checks. Following the completion of tasks at Sensor Post Beta, continue to Sensor Post Gamma with the remaining two battery packs and complete the final delivery, being certain not to begin this step until the battery transfer at Sensor Post Beta and its diagnostic wait period are fully complete. After all eight battery packs have been delivered to the three sensor posts, return to the main equipment depot and await further deployment orders.

Begin your operation at the Grain Storage Silo, where you must collect a single inspection kit. Proceed to Field Sector Alpha to perform a full inspection, waiting until the inspection kit is fully utilized and the sector supervisor confirms completion. Only after the confirmation in Field Sector Alpha, drive to Field Sector Beta, repeating the inspection process and awaiting supervisor clearance there as well. After both fields have been examined and confirmed, head directly to the Machine Shed to drop off the used inspection kit for sanitization, and remain at the shed for 5 minutes to ensure equipment decontamination procedures are completed before returning to the Grain Storage Silo to finalize your mission.

Start at the Harvest Loading Dock and collect a total of seven sacks of biofortified wheat harvested this morning. Next, evenly distribute the sacks between Silo North, Silo East, and Silo South: deliver two sacks each to Silo North and Silo East, and bring the remaining three sacks to Silo South to ensure all sacks are allocated. Once the delivery at each respective silo is complete, wait beside each intake chute until the respective operator has removed all delivered wheat sacks before departing that location. After all wheat sacks are delivered and confirmed as unloaded at every silo, proceed to the Equipment Cleaning Bay adjacent to Silo South and remain there for ten minutes to complete decontamination procedures before returning to the Harvest Loading Dock for further harvesting cycles.

Commence your mission at the main pallet storage hub, where you will collect a total of seven irrigation valve modules earmarked for deployment. Transport three modules to the West Crop Circulation Field, but before leaving this location, remain until you have received a completion signal that the field technician has correctly installed all three modules. Once confirmed, continue to the North Irrigation Control House with two more valve modules, waiting an additional five minutes at the North Irrigation Control House to support system testing and to verify activation under load conditions. After this interval and only if both the West Crop Circulation Field and North Irrigation Control House have each acknowledged module receipt and system integrity, deliver the final two valve modules to the Southeast Equipment Shed. If installation at either of the first two locations fails or goes unacknowledged, immediately halt further deliveries and return any remaining valve modules to the main pallet storage hub for secure holding. Upon successful delivery and confirmation of all seven valve modules, make your way back to the main pallet storage hub to log completion and stand by for new deployment orders.

Begin your shift at the Central Seed Storage, collecting fourteen fertilizer sacks to be distributed among the three designated sites: Rice Field Plot A, Corn Plot B, and Soybean Plot C. First, allocate five sacks to Rice Field Plot A and wait at the field until you receive confirmation that all five sacks have been unloaded. Afterward, deliver another five sacks to Corn Plot B, again waiting at the plot for the unloading confirmation. With four sacks left, proceed to Soybean Plot C, ensuring the remaining fertilizer sacks are offloaded before moving on. Once all deliveries are completed, proceed to the Field Equipment Maintenace Shed, where you must remain for six minutes to allow routine inspection of your loading bay. Only after all inspection checks are finished may you conclude your run by returning your robot to the Central Seed Storage and await the next set of distribution commands.

Start at the Central Equipment Garage to pick up a calibrated soil testing probe and three moisture sensor kits. First, proceed to Field Alpha where you must wait until the field operator indicates that conditions are ready for soil probing; only once the signal is received should you hand over the soil testing probe. Next, carry the three moisture sensor kits to Field Beta, Field Gamma, and Field Delta in any order, delivering one kit to each location. At each field, pause for two minutes after the kit handoff to allow the installation crew to complete initial setup; do not depart from a field before this time has elapsed. Once all deliveries and prescribed wait periods have been completed, return directly to the Central Equipment Garage and remain there until the next deployment instructions are issued.

Start from the supply depot adjacent to Storage Silo 2 and retrieve a large canister of specialized seed coating chemical, which must be distributed among the North, East, and West Seed Treatment Stations. First, drive to the North Seed Treatment Station and deliver exactly one-third of the canister’s contents, remaining there until a staff technician confirms via indicator that the transfer is complete. Afterward, proceed to the East Seed Treatment Station, but wait for 90 seconds upon arrival to allow the station’s receptacle to finish auto-cleaning, then transfer the next third of the chemical—do not proceed until unloading is verified by the station’s sensor. Finally, carry the remaining portion, including any precise leftover from the prior divisions, to the West Seed Treatment Station, ensuring the final amount matches the recorded remainder; wait at the West station for confirmation that all the chemical has been received. Once distributions are done, return to the supply depot and remain on standby for a minimum of 8 minutes before accepting any new dispatches.

Start the task by moving to Fertilizer Depot Alpha to receive a batch of nine nutrient additive bags for upcoming soil enrichment. Split the nutrient additive bags so that you deliver four bags to Crop Field North, three bags to Crop Field East, and two bags to Crop Field South, making sure each field receives its exact quota in this order. Upon reaching each field, wait until the farm supervisor at that location signals the bags are fully unloaded before proceeding to the next delivery. Following the final drop-off at Crop Field South, remain at the edge of that field for ten minutes to allow for supervisor verification, and once the waiting period has elapsed, return to Fertilizer Depot Alpha to complete your current assigned transport cycle.

Begin at the Central Storage Depot and collect five insulated coolant canisters tagged for use across the western Greenhouse Complex, the Northgate Bio-Lab, and the Solar Machinery Bay. Transport two canisters directly to the Greenhouse Complex first and remain there until the greenhouse technician confirms both canisters have been completely offloaded. Afterward, proceed to the Northgate Bio-Lab to deliver another two canisters; again, wait for confirmation of successful receipt by the lab staff. Carry the final remaining canister to the Solar Machinery Bay. After the last canister is unloaded and acknowledged by the maintenance chief, wait exactly 8 minutes at the Solar Machinery Bay before proceeding to your home base at the Central Storage Depot, completing your round only once all canisters have been delivered and all waiting periods have elapsed.

Starting from the equipment storage bay next to Workshop 2, pick up twelve replacement hydraulic pumps and confirm that all pumps are secured. Transport four pumps each to Maintenance Shed North, Maintenance Shed East, and Maintenance Shed South, delivering them one location at a time; any remainder must stay on board until all sheds have received their sets. At each shed, wait for maintenance staff to remove the designated pumps before proceeding to the next shed. Once the final four pumps have been dropped off—including handling the remainder if the division isn’t perfect—return to the storage bay, but pause for 5 minutes in the loading zone before entering, allowing site traffic to clear. After the waiting period, dock at the equipment storage bay and remain stationed there until further instructions are issued.

Begin at Maintenance Bay A and travel to the Parts Warehouse to collect eight sealed containers of replacement hydraulic fluid. Wait at the Parts Warehouse until all containers are inspected and verified as spill-free before departing. Deliver three containers to Tractor Repair Station 1, three containers to Tractor Repair Station 2, and the remaining two containers to Tractor Repair Station 3, making sure that each delivery is completed before proceeding to the next location in sequence. After each delivery, wait at the respective Tractor Repair Station for sixty seconds to allow technicians to offload and check the containers, and only proceed once the waiting period is complete. Following the final delivery at Tractor Repair Station 3, return to Maintenance Bay A and await instructions for your next maintenance support task.

Start at Fruit Loading Dock Alpha and wait until the batch of twelve packed apple crates is ready for pickup. Once all twelve apple crates are loaded onto your transport, proceed to Orchard Storage Barn and unload four apple crates, waiting until the barn staff confirm all four have been removed. Next, deliver another four apple crates to Farmers' Market Staging Lot, and after all four apple crates are offloaded, wait there for seven minutes to accommodate inspection and sorting. Following the waiting period, take the remaining four apple crates to Cold Storage Chamber 2; do not leave until the chamber crew has removed every crate. Once all deliveries are finalized, return your empty transporter to Fruit Loading Dock Alpha and wait for the supervisor to provide further instructions.

Collect a shipment of nine precision nutrient dispensers from the Central Equipment Warehouse, intended for deployment across several cultivation sectors. First, proceed to Hydroponic Bay Alpha and deliver three nutrient dispensers, remaining onsite until all three dispensers have been unloaded by the bay technician. Upon confirmation of the Hydroponic Bay Alpha drop-off, travel to Field Plot 7B and transfer another three dispensers to the awaiting agronomy crew; after they have removed their allocation, wait an additional two minutes to ensure proper installation is underway. Only after both previous deliveries are complete, continue to Vertical Farm Tower 2, where you are to provide the final three nutrient dispensers. Stay at Vertical Farm Tower 2 for a full five minutes to accommodate their staggered unloading schedule, and do not depart until this time elapses. Once all dispensers are distributed and removed, return the empty shipment pallet to the Central Equipment Warehouse and await further dispatch instructions at that location.

Begin your operation at Storage Hub Alpha by collecting a batch of seven nutrient canisters, then head to Greenhouse Section C and deliver three of the canisters, ensuring a technician is present to confirm their removal. After the technician has taken the canisters, wait for five minutes at Greenhouse Section C to allow the staff to initiate a system flush. Next, proceed to Crop Field Station Nine to distribute two canisters, but do not unload them until the station manager provides authorization that the soil sensors have stabilized; upon confirmation, wait until the payload is removed. Take the remaining two canisters to Fertilizer Shed Omega, and refrain from beginning a return journey to Storage Hub Alpha until the final canister has been unloaded and an all-clear signal is received from the site supervisor at Fertilizer Shed Omega.

Begin at the Central Depot and load twelve maintenance toolkits onto the robot. Navigate first to Machine Bay 1 and deliver three toolkits, making sure to wait until the technician at Machine Bay 1 confirms all toolkits have been offloaded. Next, proceed to Machine Bay 2 and distribute another four toolkits, remaining at Machine Bay 2 until all four toolkits have been removed. After departing Machine Bay 2, travel to Machine Bay 3 with the remaining five toolkits; deliver three toolkits immediately and wait for eight minutes before handing over the last two toolkits, as per the staggered maintenance schedule. Once the final two toolkits are acknowledged as received at Machine Bay 3, return to the Central Depot and wait for two minutes before initiating any subsequent assignments.

Start at the refrigerated storage facility and load twelve boxes of perishable produce onto the robot. Travel first to Packing Dock A and deliver five boxes of produce; once all five boxes are removed from the robot at Packing Dock A, wait for two minutes to allow quality inspection by staff. Next, continue to Packing Dock B, where four boxes of produce should be offloaded; if Packing Dock B is full and cannot immediately accept all four boxes, wait for up to five minutes until space becomes available and the dock supervisor authorizes unloading. Finally, proceed to Packing Dock C with the remaining three boxes, ensure the three boxes are received and fully unloaded, and then return to the refrigerated storage facility for sanitization procedures before accepting the next task batch.

At the Central Granary Loading Zone, pick up twelve sealed grain bags and ensure they are securely fastened before departing. Sequentially deliver four grain bags to Silo A, four to Silo B, and allocate the remaining four to Silo C, confirming at each location that the storage supervisor signals readiness before you unload any bags. After the final delivery at Silo C, proceed to the Equipment Sanitation Bay located near the eastern access gate, wait for seven minutes while sanitation staff perform a decontamination procedure on the robot, and once the cleaning is complete, return directly to the Central Granary Loading Zone for final logging.

Start at the seed storage facility and prepare to collect seven seed dispensers labeled for the replanting operation. Transport three of these seed dispensers directly to Sowing Area West, and once the Sowing Area West technician confirms all three dispensers have been removed from your cargo, proceed to Sowing Area Central to deliver another two seed dispensers, ensuring you wait for the completion signal after unloading at this location as well. Move next to Sowing Area East with the remaining two seed dispensers, but after unloading, wait at Sowing Area East for exactly fifteen minutes, allowing the field crew to complete calibration tasks before you return to the seed storage facility to restock for the next sowing batch.

Initiate at Loading Dock 2 and collect a batch of nine sealed fertilizer sacks allocated for delivery to three separate greenhouses: Greenhouse Alpha, Greenhouse Beta, and Greenhouse Gamma. Distribute the sacks as evenly as possible, with each greenhouse receiving three sacks; if any greenhouse cannot accept delivery due to a full storage bin, proceed to the next location and attempt delivery there, returning to the original greenhouse only after all others have been serviced. After each drop-off, pause exactly five minutes at the receiving greenhouse to allow staff to inspect and acknowledge the fertilizer sacks. Once all sacks have been successfully delivered and confirmations have been received from the three greenhouses, travel to the Refueling Station behind the equipment hangar and await instructions for the next assignment.

Begin at the tools depot next to the north equipment shed and collect a set of eight precision harvest sensors. Distribute three sensors to the orchard command station beside the apple grove, waiting five minutes after arrival to allow local staff to finish preparations before continuing. Next, deliver another three sensors to the southern greenhouse staging area, and do not proceed until the on-site technician completes removal of the outdated sensors. Take the final two sensors to the weather monitoring station near the windbreak, where you must wait for confirmation that the previous sensors have been swapped out before leaving. Once all harvest sensors are delivered and all removal confirmations have been received, return directly to the tools depot and stand by for ten minutes prior to releasing the robot for its next scheduled assignment.

Begin at the Equipment Maintenance Garage and collect two replacement hydraulic actuators and a diagnostic toolkit. Travel directly to the Orchard South Machinery Shed and wait for the maintenance crew to signal that they are ready to receive the hydraulic actuators. Once you have confirmation of readiness, transfer both hydraulic actuators to the crew and wait until the crew acknowledges removal of both items. After this exchange is complete, navigate to the Vineyard Storage Hut and drop off the diagnostic toolkit. Remain at the Vineyard Storage Hut for 8 minutes to allow for equipment logging and inspection, then proceed to the Main Dispatch Point adjacent to the central road for your next set of instructions.

Start your route at the north-side Storage Silo, where you must collect nine fertilizer bags clearly labeled for distribution. Navigate to Crop Field Zone 1 and unload three fertilizer bags at the storage canopy, waiting until all three Zone 1 fertilizer bags are fully removed by the assigned field worker. Once this removal is confirmed, proceed immediately to Crop Field Zone 2 and deliver another three fertilizer bags, again waiting until all bags for Zone 2 are confirmed to be offloaded. After both of these deliveries are complete, transport the remaining three fertilizer bags to Crop Field Zone 3 but remain there for an additional 10 minutes after the fertilizer bags are removed by staff, in case any empty packaging needs to be transferred back on your return leg. Only after the 10-minute wait concludes at Zone 3 and all packaging actions are finalized should you proceed back to the north-side Storage Silo to complete your task sequence.

Start at Storage Shed 3 and gather twelve sealed crates of seed potatoes. Navigate directly to Harvest Prep Dock and wait at the designated receiving area until dock personnel confirm the removal of exactly six crates for immediate processing. After these first six crates have been offloaded, continue with the remaining six crates to Sorting Room B, but upon arrival, you must pause for four minutes at the security checkpoint outside Sorting Room B before entering. Once four minutes have elapsed, deliver four of the remaining crates inside Sorting Room B and ensure they are accepted by the sorting technician. With the last two crates still onboard, proceed to Equipment Maintenance Bay, and remain at the bay until maintenance staff signal that both crates have been removed for storage. Only after the final crates are offloaded at Equipment Maintenance Bay may you return to Storage Shed 3 and await further deployment instructions.

Begin at Fertilizer Depot West and pick up a shipment of fifteen balanced-fertilizer sacks. Transport five sacks to Soybean Field Alpha, unload them, and wait for the field supervisor at Soybean Field Alpha to confirm removal of all sacks before proceeding. After delivery confirmation, take another five sacks to Cornfield Bravo, wait for the crop technician at Cornfield Bravo to remove these fertilizer sacks, and only then continue to the final destination. Deliver the last five sacks to Barley Plot Delta, remaining at Barley Plot Delta until all sacks are removed by staff. After all fifteen sacks have been distributed and fully unloaded at their respective fields, proceed to the Charging Station North; once at Charging Station North, wait there for five minutes before returning to Fertilizer Depot West for system check-in.

Start at the Seed Inventory Depot and collect a shipment of 20 sealed seed bags. Travel to Wheat Field North and deliver 7 seed bags, then wait until the field supervisor signals that the unloading process is complete and all bags are accounted for. Afterward, drive to Corn Field East to deliver another 7 seed bags, repeating the wait for confirmation from the local crew. Proceed to Soy Field South with the remaining 6 seed bags; if the Soy Field South staff report that less than 6 seed bags are needed, return any surplus seed bags directly to the Seed Inventory Depot before taking any further action. Once all seed bags are properly delivered or returned, remain at Soy Field South for 3 minutes to ensure there are no immediate issues with the distributed supplies, then proceed back to the Seed Inventory Depot to conclude this operation.

Starting at the main greenhouse dispatch zone, collect a batch of twelve nutrient supplement packs designated for this morning's shipment. Distribute these supplements evenly by delivering five packs to Plant Bay 1, four to Plant Bay 2, and the remaining three to Plant Bay 3, making sure to clarify the pack count at each bay’s inventory intake terminal. After delivering the packs to Plant Bay 1, wait for the on-duty technician’s digital confirmation before proceeding to Plant Bay 2. When arriving at Plant Bay 2, remain there for 3 minutes to allow the bay’s automated integration system to finish preparing the intake conveyor, then complete the delivery. Head last to Plant Bay 3 and wait at the bay until a remote supervisor logs the receipt of all three packs into the tracking system. Only once all deliveries have been completed and logged, return to the main greenhouse dispatch zone and await the next set of instructions.

Start at the equipment maintenance bay and pick up a set of eight replacement drive belts. First, bring three drive belts to Assembly Line A and wait until the line supervisor has taken each belt from the robot. Next, take another three drive belts to Packaging Zone B to deliver them to the quality control station, waiting there until a quality inspector confirms removal of these belts. Deliver the remaining two drive belts to the Robotics Calibration Room and wait 7 minutes while the calibration team inspects the new parts. After this timed wait, proceed to the central inventory counter and remain there until receiving acknowledgement that all completed drop-offs have been logged in the maintenance ledger.

Begin at the North Storage Silo and pick up a shipment of seven fertilizer bags as well as the standard distribution log sheet. Proceed first to Crop Field East and deliver three fertilizer bags; remain until all three bags have been removed and recorded on the log sheet by the receiving crew. After a two-minute interval to allow for transfer confirmation, continue to Vegetable Plot South with the remaining fertilizer bags. Unload two fertilizer bags there, ensuring that the crew completes their sign-off before departing. Carry the final two fertilizer bags to the Orchard Lane Distribution Point, unload both bags, and wait for four minutes as the orchard manager inspects and verifies receipt of the shipment. Once sign-off is complete, return the signed distribution log sheet to the North Storage Silo, handing it to the inventory supervisor before awaiting further dispatch instructions.

Begin at the Field Equipment Shed and pick up four replacement seed planter modules. Transport one module first to Planter Alpha, stationed in North Field, and wait until the maintenance crew signals that the module has been installed before departing. Next, take one module to Planter Beta, located next to the irrigation channel in East Field, and remain there for three minutes after arrival to allow technicians to prepare for installation. After the wait, proceed to Planter Gamma, parked along the South Field access road, and deliver the third module; stay at this location until you receive confirmation from the supervisor via radio that the replacement is complete. The remaining module should be taken to the Workshop Loading Ramp for storage; however, if any of the previous planters report a failure to install, return to that specific planter immediately with the spare module instead of going to the Workshop. Once all modules have been delivered or accounted for, finish by moving to the Central Charging Station and wait there until further instructions are provided.

Start at the Seed Distribution Center and collect a batch of 17 seed packets. Proceed to Field Plot Alpha, Field Plot Beta, and Field Plot Gamma, distributing the seed packets as evenly as possible by delivering 5 seed packets to each plot. After completing the main distributions, deliver the remaining 2 seed packets to Field Plot Alpha to account for the surplus. Following each delivery, pause at the respective field plot until the planting crew signals that the seed packets have been received. Once all deliveries are complete, continue to the Tool Maintenance Shed and wait there for three minutes to allow for equipment inspection before returning to the Seed Distribution Center.

Begin at the central tool depot and retrieve a package of thirteen crop sensor units. Your first stop is Soy Field Section 7, where you must deliver five sensor units, waiting there until the field technician confirms all units have been properly received. Next, proceed to Pump House B and hand over four sensor units, ensuring you remain on site until you receive confirmation from the pump technician that the delivery is complete. After the handoff, continue to Irrigation Control Room Alpha with the final four sensor units, and do not proceed until they have been removed and signed for by the control supervisor. Once all deliveries are complete, wait at Irrigation Control Room Alpha for eight minutes to allow recalibration of the system with the new sensors before returning to the central tool depot to report task completion.

Begin at the robotics maintenance bay and pick up nine sealed lubricant canisters. Transport three canisters each to Machine Shop 1, Conveyor Assembly Line, and Drone Hangar in that order, ensuring that one canister is delivered per trip and that after each delivery the respective station supervisor inspects and approves the canister before you proceed to the next trip. Between each delivery, wait 6 minutes to allow inspection and clearance by the supervisors, and do not start the subsequent leg until this waiting period has elapsed and clearance is granted. After all nine canisters have been distributed and verified, return to the robotics maintenance bay and remain there for further dispatch orders.

Start at Loading Dock C and collect a shipment of seven chemical test kits required for quality control. First, transport three test kits to Quality Laboratory 1 and wait there until laboratory staff signal that all three kits have been safely unloaded. Once the test kits have been removed at Quality Laboratory 1, proceed to Quality Laboratory 2 with another three kits; remain on site for four minutes to allow laboratory staff adequate time to process the delivery before departing. After this wait, take the final test kit to the Research Annex, but do not leave the site until the research team confirms receipt of the last kit. Only after all deliveries are completed and acknowledged, return to Loading Dock C and wait for further instruction from the operations manager.

Start at the Central Maintenance Hangar and collect a shipment of 10 replacement hydraulic pistons, then proceed to the Fleet Truck Depot by Warehouse 3. At the depot, deliver exactly 3 pistons to the service technician and wait for 15 minutes while the pistons are being installed. Once the installation at the Fleet Truck Depot is complete, transport the remaining 7 pistons to Loading Bay 5 at Production Facility B, drop off 4 of the pistons there and wait until the facility supervisor has removed the pistons from your cargo. After this handover, take the last 3 pistons to Automated Assembly Line Alpha; only enter the line if a signal light indicates that previous assembly material has been cleared. Once inside, wait for confirmation from the Assembly Control Terminal that all 3 pistons are ready for pickup by the assembly robots before returning directly to the Central Maintenance Hangar for further instructions.

Begin at the machinery storage garage, and proceed to the Seed Inventory Warehouse to pick up twelve sealed sacks of soybean seeds. Transport the entire load to Field Alpha, stopping at the northern entry point. There, distribute four sacks at the north entry and remain until the planting team has finished unloading all four sacks. Next, continue with the remaining eight sacks to Field Alpha’s eastern access gate, deliver another four sacks, and again wait until these are fully unloaded by the planting crew. With the final four sacks, head toward the temporary outpost near the southern tractor lane; offload these sacks, then wait on-site for three minutes to allow field supervisors to complete their inventory scan of the delivered seeds. Once the scanning is confirmed, return to the machinery storage garage and await your next directive.

Begin by collecting ten sealed seed crates from the Packing Shed and ensure each crate is properly secured for transit. Travel first to Field Plot 1 and deliver three sealed seed crates; after the field crew has removed these crates, continue to Field Plot 2 to drop off another three seed crates, staying until confirmation of retrieval. Next, proceed to Field Plot 3, unload the remaining four sealed seed crates, and remain on site until the harvest manager acknowledges receipt. Once all deliveries across the three field plots are confirmed, drive directly to the Machine Maintenance Workshop and wait there for 12 minutes to allow for any urgent equipment inspection requests. Do not proceed to any other location until the full waiting period at the Machine Maintenance Workshop is complete.

Begin at Docking Station A where a palette containing fifteen sealed fertilizer bags is ready for transfer. Retrieve the palette and proceed to Field Plot East, where you should leave five fertilizer bags and wait until the field manager signals that the bags are safely unloaded. Next, transport five more fertilizer bags to Field Plot Central, ensuring to remain at the location for three minutes to allow the automated spreaders to calibrate with the new stock. Afterward, deliver the remaining five bags to Field Plot West. If any residual bags are left after equal distribution, deposit them at the Storage Shed near Field Plot West. Only after all fertilizer bags have been dropped at their assigned locations and any residuals secured, return to Docking Station A to stand by for further instructions.

Start at the fertilizer storage facility next to Silo 3 and collect nine sealed nutrient canisters. Evenly allocate these canisters by delivering three each to the North Crop Plot loading zone, the East Orchard junction, and the South Vineyard utility shed, ensuring that every location receives its share in separate trips. Once you have delivered canisters to each site, wait at the South Vineyard utility shed for five minutes while vineyard supervisors complete their inspection. After the inspection period has elapsed, return to the fertilizer storage facility and remain there until notified for the next task.

Begin at the central maintenance hub and collect six replacement battery packs assigned for equipment in three separate greenhouses: Greenhouse One, Greenhouse Two, and Greenhouse Three. Distribute the battery packs by delivering two to each greenhouse; if an odd number of battery packs remains after an initial allocation, ensure that Greenhouse One receives the extra unit. After arriving at each greenhouse, wait for a technician to confirm that the battery packs are ready for offloading before proceeding to the next destination. Between every consecutive delivery, remain stationary for 4 minutes at an intermediate staging area to allow the facility operators to prepare for incoming equipment at the next greenhouse. Once all battery packs have been distributed and the technician at each greenhouse has signaled readiness, return to the central maintenance hub to complete your assignment.

Begin at Material Warehouse Alpha to pick up a crate containing seven precision bearing units needed for scheduled maintenance. Proceed to Field Assembly Point 3 and deliver three bearing units to Technician Marta, waiting there until she confirms all three units are unloaded. Next, travel to Maintenance Hangar B and offload two more bearing units, pausing for five minutes to give the crew time to inventory their shipment before departing. Finally, transport the remaining two bearing units to Equipment Shed East, await the removal of both units by the assigned engineer, and only then return to Material Warehouse Alpha to report mission completion, ensuring no location is skipped and that all waiting intervals are fully observed.

Start at the Harvest Collection Shed and wait until twelve crates of freshly picked apples are fully loaded onto the robot. Once ready, proceed to Cold Storage Facility West to deliver five apple crates; stay at the facility until all five crates have been removed by the refrigeration clerk. After confirmation, drive to the Farmers' Market Pavilion and distribute four additional apple crates, waiting two minutes at the pavilion for the stall managers to verify and collect their delivery. Take the remaining three apple crates to the Fruit Processing Plant, but only unload and hand over the crates after you receive approval from the plant supervisor, which may involve waiting on-site. Once all twelve apple crates have been distributed and accounted for at their respective destinations, return directly to the Harvest Collection Shed and await further dispatch instructions from the logistics coordinator.

Start by traveling to the Pallet Receiving Dock to collect a batch of seventeen sensor units secured for installation at distributed monitoring stations. Evenly allocate five sensors to Greenhouse Alpha first, where you must wait until all five sensors are unloaded and signed off by the greenhouse technician. Next, deliver another six sensors to Irrigation Hub Delta, but after arrival, remain on site for four minutes to allow for verification of sensor compatibility before unloading proceeds. With the final six sensor units, proceed to Field Perimeter Post 7; after arrival, wait until perimeter staff finish removing all units from the robot. Once all deliveries are confirmed at each destination, navigate to Workshop Annex C and remain there for six minutes, giving the engineering team time to perform software diagnostics before you return to the Pallet Receiving Dock to complete the assignment.

Proceed to the Central Packing Dock to retrieve a shipment of twelve labeled produce crates, verifying that all crates are securely stowed. Begin distribution by delivering five produce crates to the Fresh Market Loading Zone and, upon arrival, wait for confirmation from the on-site loader that each crate has been removed from your platform before continuing. After the Fresh Market transfer is complete, navigate to Warehouse 3 and unload four produce crates, waiting at the warehouse until the storage bay controller notifies you that all crates have been accepted. The remaining three produce crates are to be brought to the Cold Storage Annex; after drop-off, stand by for two minutes to allow the refrigeration doors to cycle and the crates to stabilize in temperature. Once all crates have been delivered and the required waiting period has elapsed, return to the Central Packing Dock and remain in standby mode for ten minutes to permit shift supervisors to conduct equipment checks before further deployment.

Start at the Grain Storage Elevator and retrieve six bags of wheat seed, confirming each bag is suitable for planting. Move directly to the North Field Plot One, where you should deliver two bags and wait until the foreman acknowledges receipt before proceeding. Continue to South Field Plot Two with another two bags; in case the foreman signals a delay, remain at the location for up to 7 minutes or until unloading is authorized, whichever occurs first. Take the remaining two bags to West Field Plot Three, but if there is a remainder bag, deliver one bag as usual, then loop back to Grain Storage Elevator to report the inventory mismatch before finalizing the second drop at West Field Plot Three. Conclude the operation by parking at the Field Tool Shed and remain there for 12 minutes to synchronize with the incoming shift's deployment schedule.

Commence the task at Storage Container B where six sealed bags of engineered seed must be retrieved for distribution. Deliver exactly two bags to the Irrigation Pump House, and wait there until each bag is independently marked as received by the agronomist. After confirmation for both bags, transport the next two bags to the Soil Testing Laboratory, and remain at the laboratory for four minutes to allow lab personnel to catalog each bag into inventory. Once this interval is complete, take the final two bags to Greenhouse 3. Wait at the entrance of Greenhouse 3 until the greenhouse manager removes both seed bags from the transport bay. After all bags are successfully delivered and confirmed at their respective destinations, proceed to the Maintenance Garage and wait six minutes while scheduled diagnostics are performed on the robot’s drive system before the task may be marked complete.

Start your route at the Seed Vault loading dock, where you will collect a shipment comprising thirteen seed trays labeled for experimental planting. Your next task is to distribute these seed trays among the three research plots: deliver four trays to Research Plot 1, five trays to Research Plot 2, and the remaining four trays to Research Plot 3, ensuring that each plot receives the allocated number with no trays left unassigned. After dropping off the designated seed trays at each plot, wait for 3 minutes at each location to allow the field technicians time to log and verify the delivery before proceeding to the next plot; confirmation at each step is required before moving onward. Once the final seed tray has been delivered and logged at Research Plot 3, return any empty transport containers back to the Seed Vault's return bay to complete the cycle, and only then may you proceed to park at the maintenance annex for mission completion.

Begin by retrieving nine sealed seed bags from the storage area in Seed Shed 3, then navigate directly to Field Plot D-2. At Field Plot D-2, distribute three seed bags and wait until the farm supervisor signals that the bags have been received. Proceed to Greenhouse Complex West with another three seed bags, deliver them, and wait again for confirmation of receipt. For the remaining three seed bags, continue to Crop Research Tent 7; after delivering these, remain at Crop Research Tent 7 for twelve minutes to allow researchers to organize their supplies and prepare instructions for the next planting sequence. Once the waiting period at Crop Research Tent 7 is complete, return all empty seed bag containers to Seed Shed 3 and await further deployment instructions.

Start at Storage Shed C and gather ten irrigation sensor modules. Deliver four sensor modules to the Northwest Crop Field first, and wait until the field manager confirms that all four modules have been removed. After this confirmation, transport another three sensor modules to the Eastern Orchard and wait at that location for 10 minutes to allow technicians to prepare the orchard’s monitoring systems before proceeding. Following the waiting period, continue to Vineyard Station and deliver the final three sensor modules; remain onsite until a technician acknowledges the complete offload. Once all modules have been successfully distributed across the three locations, return promptly to Storage Shed C to complete your assigned delivery run.

Start at Vehicle Garage Bay 2 and collect eight spare tire assemblies for tractor maintenance. Travel first to Workshop A and drop off three tire assemblies, remaining there until the lead mechanic removes all three from the robot and verifies their serial numbers. Once this task is complete, navigate to Maintenance Shed C and offload another three tire assemblies, staying on-site while the maintenance supervisor conducts a preliminary inspection and signals completion. Deliver the final two tire assemblies to Field Repair Site Delta, but before leaving the site, you must wait for ten minutes to allow for final field installation and documentation by the repair crew. As soon as the ten-minute wait at Field Repair Site Delta has concluded, immediately return to Vehicle Garage Bay 2 for further instructions.

Begin at the Harvest Processing Hub and retrieve a batch of twenty-one freshly packed fruit crates. Evenly distribute these crates between the North Cold Storage Facility, the Southwest Packing Shed, and the East Market Loading Zone by delivering seven crates to each location. At the North Cold Storage Facility, once the crates have been deposited, wait for the storage operator to confirm the refrigeration system is ready before leaving. Proceed with crate deliveries to the remaining two locations in any order, but after the Southwest Packing Shed delivery, remain onsite for three minutes to allow for the official handover process. As soon as the last set of crates is delivered to the East Market Loading Zone, return immediately to the Harvest Processing Hub and wait until all empty containers from your deliveries are returned to you by the processing staff. Only after regaining the emptied containers should you move to the Maintenance Inspection Bay for final checks.

Begin operations at Central Warehouse Bay 2 by loading nine engine coolant containers designated for the vehicle maintenance project. Transport the first three coolant containers to Maintenance Garage North; upon arrival, remain for four minutes while the technicians offload and confirm receipt of the containers. Following this, proceed to Repair Dock South with another three coolant containers, ensuring that you wait for a five-minute verification period after drop-off to allow the dock supervisor to complete intake checks. Before delivering the final three coolant containers, confirm that both Maintenance Garage North and Repair Dock South have finished their respective intake processes. Then, bring the last set of coolant containers to Servicing Hangar West and wait until the hangar crew notifies you that all containers have been removed. Conclude your run by returning immediately to Central Warehouse Bay 2 to prepare for subsequent assignments.

Begin by proceeding to Storage Bay 4 to collect nine barrels of granulated feed, ensuring the barrels are securely ready for transport before moving on. Distribute these nine barrels evenly, allocating three barrels each to the Dairy Barn, Poultry Enclosure, and Swine Stable, making certain that if any surplus barrels remain after this division, deliver the extra barrel to the location nearest to Storage Bay 4, which is the Dairy Barn. Wait at each destination until the facility supervisor confirms that all barrels for that location have been removed from the robot before heading to the next site; pause for four minutes at the Poultry Enclosure before making your final delivery to allow staff to clear the receiving area. Once the last delivery at the Swine Stable is finished, return directly to Storage Bay 4 to confirm the task's completion.

Begin your delivery run at the South Orchard Dock by loading nine boxes of freshly picked apples. Transport three boxes to Packaging Station 1 and wait until onsite staff confirms all three boxes have been unloaded. After this confirmation, deliver another three boxes to Packaging Station 2, waiting again for completion of unloading before proceeding. With the remaining three boxes, continue to the Quality Inspection Lab and stay until quality inspectors remove all boxes and provide a final unloading acknowledgment. Once all apple boxes are distributed and confirmed, move directly to the Vehicle Maintenance Bay where you must remain idle for a 7-minute diagnostic process. Do not return to the South Orchard Dock for further instructions until the diagnostic procedure at the Vehicle Maintenance Bay has fully concluded.

Start your route at the Main Fertilizer Depot near the eastern boundary and collect twelve nutrient supplement bags. Proceed to Greenhouse Alpha first and deliver four nutrient supplement bags. Once all four bags have been removed at Greenhouse Alpha, continue on to Greenhouse Beta, where you are to distribute another four nutrient supplement bags. After verifying that the removal at Greenhouse Beta is complete, travel to Greenhouse Gamma to offload the remaining four nutrient supplement bags, ensuring distribution is equal and all remainders are handled at this final location. Wait for three minutes at Greenhouse Gamma to allow the greenhouse staff to perform a supplemental inventory check before you head back to the Main Fertilizer Depot for the next deployment cycle.

Begin at Maintenance Bay Delta and collect six fully-charged battery units for equipment servicing. Proceed directly to the Windmill Array Control Shed and deliver two battery units, ensuring you wait until maintenance staff have finished swapping out both batteries. Once the removal of depleted batteries is complete, continue to Irrigation Pump House B with two more battery units and remain on site until technicians confirm installation of both batteries has been finished. With the final two battery units, travel to the Automated Fertilizer Hopper at Silo 3; after these batteries have been unloaded and their status logged by the monitoring system, wait an additional 4 minutes to allow for diagnostics to run on the power system before returning to Maintenance Bay Delta and preparing for the next set of servicing tasks.

Start at the Vehicle Maintenance Bay and collect a set of twelve diagnostic toolkits. Distribute these toolkits by delivering four each to Repair Station 1, Repair Station 2, and Repair Station 3; should any toolkits remain after evenly dividing them, transport the leftover toolkits to Spare Parts Storage adjacent to Repair Station 3. After completing the last drop-off, return immediately to the Vehicle Maintenance Bay but pause for seven minutes to allow engineers time to inspect the diagnostic logs you have retrieved. Once the waiting period concludes, collect two newly calibrated battery packs from the engineers and deliver both to Charging Hub Delta, where you must wait until all battery packs have been confirmed as safely unloaded by the hub supervisor before concluding your route.

Begin your task at the Grain Reception Area, collecting a total of eight sensor calibration modules from the supply counter. Distribute the modules so that three modules are delivered first to Silo A, two modules go to Silo B, and the remaining three modules are assigned to Silo C; if any silo is currently undergoing maintenance, skip delivery there and proceed in order to the next available silo. After each silo receives its allocation, wait at the corresponding silo for exactly 5 minutes to allow on-site technicians to confirm proper installation and provide clearance before moving on to the next destination. Once all silos have received their modules and every wait period is complete, return any unused modules directly to the Maintenance Lab, and remain there until further deployment instructions are issued.

Start at the main maintenance depot and collect eight hydraulic filter units from the service storage rack. Proceed first to Maintenance Bay A and deliver three hydraulic filter units, waiting until the maintenance supervisor acknowledges the drop-off. Next, take three more hydraulic filter units to the Equipment Repair Station and remain there for a duration of six minutes to assist technicians while they swap out old filters. With the final two hydraulic filter units, head over to Tractor Parking Section 4, and once both filters have been received by the on-site mechanic, return immediately to the main maintenance depot to report completion and await the next set of instructions.

Start at the Central Storage Depot and retrieve eight replacement hydraulic rams from Shelf A. Deliver three hydraulic rams each to Maintenance Bay 1 and Maintenance Bay 2, making sure to confirm that the bay technician at each location has taken all three delivered units before departing. Then, bring the remaining two hydraulic rams to Maintenance Bay 3, and wait by the tool bench until Maintenance Bay 3’s technician has removed both units. Once all replacement rams have been distributed and verified as received at each maintenance bay, proceed to the South Vehicle Wash Station and remain there for a period of five minutes while post-delivery diagnostics are performed before returning to the Central Storage Depot to await further tasks.

Start at the machine staging area and collect twelve repair kits from the main supply depot. Next, you must allocate all twelve repair kits between three malfunctioning tractors: Tractor Alpha in Field 4 receives five kits, Tractor Bravo at the north barn receives four kits, and Tractor Charlie at the equipment yard receives the remaining three kits, ensuring that each tractor’s repair kit allocation does not overlap. After delivering the repair kits to each location, wait at least two minutes for each mechanic to inspect and confirm receipt of the repair kits before proceeding to the next tractor. Only after successful confirmation at all three sites should you return to the main supply depot and remain there for five minutes to allow inventory logging before completing your route.

Start at Fertilizer Storage Central and collect a load of sixteen sealed fertilizer drums, ensuring no drum is leaking before departure. Distribute these drums among three recipient locations: deliver five drums to Orchard Field North, then remain at the field until the orchard manager confirms receipt and initiates the automated spreaders; proceed next to Grain Plot Delta with six drums, where you must wait five minutes following offload so that the field operator can stage safety barriers around the drums, and finally, carry the remaining five drums to Greenhouse Omega, explicitly checking once at the greenhouse that all prior delivery confirmations (from Orchard Field North and Grain Plot Delta) have been documented before transferring the final drums. After completing the last delivery and receiving the greenhouse supervisor’s go-ahead, return immediately to Fertilizer Storage Central, and wait there for ten minutes to allow for a full restocking audit by inventory staff before ending the route.

Travel to the Central Tool Depot and wait for the maintenance coordinator to confirm that twelve equipment toolkits are ready for pickup. Once the toolkits are prepared, distribute them among four different workshops: deliver three toolkits to Workshop Alpha, four toolkits to Workshop Bravo, two toolkits to Workshop Charlie, and the remaining three toolkits to Workshop Delta, ensuring that each location receives its allocated quantity and any remainder is correctly assigned to meet the total. After each delivery, wait until the receiving supervisor at the respective workshop has fully removed all delivered toolkits before proceeding to the next workshop. Once all toolkits have been successfully delivered and acknowledged, return to the Central Tool Depot and remain there for 10 minutes before awaiting further instruction.

Start at the supply dock and collect a total of nineteen fertilizer canisters. Evenly distribute these canisters among Orchard Plot East, Vineyard Block 3, and Pasture Section 5, ensuring that Orchard Plot East receives six canisters, Vineyard Block 3 receives six canisters, and Pasture Section 5 receives the remaining seven to account for the uneven division. After each delivery, wait at the respective drop-off location until a field technician verifies that the fertilizer canisters have been removed before proceeding to the next destination. Once the final batch is delivered to Pasture Section 5 and confirmation is received, travel to the charging station in the equipment shed and wait there for 10 minutes for the battery recharge cycle to complete before returning to the supply dock for further instructions.

Begin at Maintenance Bay 2 and wait for the machine parts labeled Hydraulic Assemblies to be loaded onto the robot. Once the loading is confirmed, travel directly to Assembly Line Station A, where you must wait while technicians unload a portion of the Hydraulic Assemblies. Do not leave until the technicians have signaled the removal is complete. Following this, proceed immediately to Station B, unloading another portion of the Hydraulic Assemblies and waiting again for the removal confirmation. After deliveries to Stations A and B, take the remaining Hydraulic Assemblies to Station C, ensuring all are offloaded before departing. Upon completing the final drop at Station C, return to Maintenance Bay 2 but wait outside the bay entrance for exactly five minutes before entering, to allow supervisors to finalize inspection procedures prior to your next assignment.

Begin your route at the maintenance bay and retrieve a set of four replacement hydraulic pumps. Head first to Packaging Station Delta and install two hydraulic pumps, waiting five minutes on-site to verify operational status with the station supervisor before proceeding. Once this confirmation is received, continue to Machine Shop Omega where you must deliver one hydraulic pump and pause for eight minutes to allow the crew to remove the old unit and prepare the workspace. The last hydraulic pump is to be delivered to the Automated Loader at Dock 7 only if both the Packaging Station Delta and Machine Shop Omega have acknowledged receipt of their respective pumps. After all pumps are distributed, return any empty packaging materials from each drop-off site to the maintenance bay for recycling, ensuring no items are overlooked at any of the intermediate locations before concluding the assignment.

Begin your route at the Feed Supply Depot by collecting a total of ten sealed feed bags designated for livestock. You must allocate these bags across three destinations: deliver four feed bags to Barn A’s front loading dock, three feed bags to the Hay Storage Annex, and the remaining three feed bags to the West Pasture Distribution Shed; take care to confirm that the count at each location matches the required quantity, with no bags left unassigned. At each stop, wait until the barn supervisor or shed operator removes all the feed bags for that destination and signals completion before you proceed to the next. After the West Pasture Distribution Shed drop-off is finished, wait at that location for a period of twelve minutes before returning to the Feed Supply Depot, in case additional urgent transport requests for empty feed sacks arise during that interval.

Start at Storage Silo 3 and wait until eight containers of processed wheat are ready for collection. Once the containers are loaded, transport three containers to Mill Receiving Dock A, waiting there for workers to remove all three containers before departing. Next, deliver another three containers to Mill Receiving Dock B, similarly waiting until they are all offloaded. The remaining two containers should then be taken to the Quality Inspection Lab, and you must not leave until both have been removed and a supervisor gives confirmation. After completing all deliveries, proceed to Charging Station West and remain there for twenty minutes before beginning your next operation, ensuring that the rest period is uninterrupted.

Begin your mission at the Maintenance Bay, where you are to retrieve a set of six diagnostic toolkits and one replacement hydraulic actuator. Deliver two diagnostic toolkits to each of the following tractor locations in sequence: Field Tractor Dock A, Field Tractor Dock B, and Field Tractor Dock C; however, if any toolkits remain after these deliveries, distribute the first remaining toolkit to Field Tractor Dock C and the next to Field Tractor Dock B, ensuring no single dock receives more than one additional toolkit. After all diagnostic toolkits are offloaded, transport the replacement hydraulic actuator directly to Combine Harvester Station 4. You must wait at Combine Harvester Station 4 until the maintenance technician confirms removal of the hydraulic actuator before moving on. Once confirmation is received, stay at Combine Harvester Station 4 for four more minutes to assist with equipment realignment procedures, then proceed back to the Maintenance Bay to conclude your assignment and await further instructions.

Start at the Main Distribution Hub and collect 25 sealed fertilizer containers, inspecting each for intact packaging before proceeding. Head first to Field Plot North and drop off 9 fertilizer containers; after depositing, wait 5 minutes at Field Plot North to allow the agronomy team time to arrange for initial placement. Once this interval has passed and the agronomy team confirms receipt, continue to Field Plot South and deliver another 8 fertilizer containers, remaining there until all containers are removed by field crew staff. With the remaining 8 fertilizer containers, proceed to Field Plot East only after confirming via direct message from Field Plot South that transfer there is complete; upon arrival at Field Plot East, stay until the containers have been claimed, and then return to the Main Distribution Hub for decontamination procedures and await further dispatch instructions.

Beginning at the Main Warehouse, collect twelve containers of pesticide concentrate and ensure the pickup is confirmed by the site manager. Transport these containers first to North Field Pump Station, where you must deliver four containers and wait until all containers have been removed by the pump technician before proceeding. Afterward, proceed to East Field Pump Shed, deliver another four containers, and remain on-site until unloading is acknowledged. Carry the last four containers to South Maintenance Bay, unloading and waiting again until the maintenance crew confirms all containers have been received. Once all deliveries are complete, remain at South Maintenance Bay for exactly ten minutes so equipment can be sanitized, and after this interval, return directly to the Main Warehouse to complete your route.

Starting at Warehouse Dock 3, load twelve sealed nutrient containers designated for different hydroponic sites. Transport four containers to Hydroponics Bay A; wait at Hydroponics Bay A until staff confirm full unloading of all four containers. After completion, drive to Hydroponics Bay B, but before beginning the offload, remain idle for three minutes to allow sensor calibration procedures to complete; then, deliver another four containers as previously scheduled and confirm with on-site staff. For the final batch, proceed to Hydroponics Bay C, and if the unloading process at either Bay A or Bay B is reported incomplete by remote monitor, reroute to the nearest service lay-by for five minutes before retrying Hydroponics Bay C delivery. Once the remaining four containers are successfully delivered at Hydroponics Bay C and all bays confirm proper receipt, return to Warehouse Dock 3 for container sanitization and reloading instructions.

Travel first to the Harvest Bay Dock and wait there until the six crates of freshly picked apples have been loaded onto the robot, then set off to deliver two crates each to the Processing Plant Loading Zone, the Farmer’s Market Entrance, and the Cold Storage Facility, distributing the crates evenly across the sites. Remain at every location until all crates assigned to that site have been removed from the robot by staff before departing to the next destination; at the Cold Storage Facility, after unloading, wait an additional seven minutes for a cold chain verification process before departing. Once the final delivery is complete, proceed to the Maintenance Garage and remain there for six minutes for a post-delivery vehicle inspection before finishing the assignment at the Harvest Bay Dock.

Start at the central maintenance bay and acquire four replacement water pumps designated for irrigation. Proceed to Pump House One and deliver one replacement water pump, waiting until the on-site crew indicates the pump is fully offloaded. Next, travel to Pump House Two, drop off two replacement water pumps, and do not depart until both pumps have been confirmed as removed by the supervisor. Take the final replacement water pump to Pump House Three, wait for the removal to be completed, and then pause at Pump House Three for eight minutes to allow diagnostics on the installed equipment. After the waiting period, return immediately to the central maintenance bay to conclude this assignment.

Start at the Equipment Maintenance Bay and pick up a set of eight replacement hydraulic pumps, verifying that each pump is correctly identified and tagged before departure. First, proceed to Assembly Line 1 and deliver three pumps, waiting by the designated drop-off area until a technician removes all three from your payload and signs off on receipt. Once the transfer at Assembly Line 1 is complete, travel to the Central Inventory Depot; here, deposit another three pumps and remain at the depot for exactly 6 minutes to facilitate an incoming inventory audit before allowing the pumps to be offloaded—do not depart until all pumps have been unloaded and a depot supervisor gives verbal approval. With the two remaining pumps, continue to Maintenance Outpost B; however, if Maintenance Outpost B is still locked upon your arrival, wait until access is granted and a maintenance engineer is present before initiating unloading. After both hydraulic pumps are handed over and signed for at Outpost B, retrace your route back to the Equipment Maintenance Bay to finish your assignment and prepare for system diagnostics.

Begin at the main charging dock and proceed to Greenhouse 2 to collect a set of fifteen seedling trays prepared for transport. Your objective is to distribute these seedling trays across four planting zones: assign four trays each to Planting Zone East and Planting Zone West, deliver another four trays to Planting Zone South, and transport the remaining three trays to Planting Zone North, taking care to deliver each batch directly to its specified zone in this order. After delivering each zone’s allocated seedling trays, remain at the respective planting zone for three minutes to allow for on-site verification and tray unloading by the field staff before moving to the next delivery. Upon completion of your final delivery and the last three-minute waiting period at Planting Zone North, proceed immediately to the wash bay and wait there until the sanitation staff remove any soil residue from your tray racks, signifying the end of this operation.

Begin your route at Supply Depot A, where you must collect a total of eight replacement coolant filters designated for the tractor fleet. Transport three coolant filters to Workshop Bay 1 and remain at the bay entrance until the engineering team confirms the removal of all three filters from your cargo. After the filters have been taken at Workshop Bay 1, proceed to Machine Shed West and deliver another three coolant filters; upon arrival, wait there for ten minutes to give technicians time to inspect and pick up the filters before you move on. Once the wait is complete, bring the remaining two coolant filters to Service Station North, and stay there until service personnel indicate that both filters have been successfully retrieved. Only after completing all three deliveries in this sequence, with required waits and confirmations at each stop, return directly to Supply Depot A for your next assignment.

Start by navigating to the Seed Storage Warehouse on the north side of the facility and acquire a pallet containing 11 bags of premium wheat seeds. You must then distribute these seed bags among the East, Central, and West Field Sowing Stations so that each station receives an equal number of bags, with any leftover bags (if the 11 bags are not evenly divisible) being given to the East Field Sowing Station first, followed by the Central Field Sowing Station if there is more than one extra. After delivering all seed bags, move to the Irrigation Pump Control Room located adjacent to the Central Field Sowing Station and wait for the irrigation supervisor to signal that all seed deliveries have been verified and logged. Once verification is complete, remain in the Control Room for an additional five minutes to assist with a system calibration before finally returning to the Seed Storage Warehouse to complete your mission.

Begin at the Main Equipment Depot and collect a set of calibration tools along with nine sealed water sampling containers. Head first to Irrigation Tank Field Alpha and distribute three sampling containers to the field technicians, pausing at the site until the technicians have loaded at least two used containers onto the robot for retrieval. Once loaded, proceed immediately to Quality Analysis Lab North and drop off the retrieved containers and the calibration tools for analysis. After you have received confirmation of delivery at the lab, return to the Main Equipment Depot to pick up any remaining unused sampling containers, if requested, and then deliver three containers each to Greenhouse Block C and Reservoir Inspection Point Delta, ensuring that you wait five minutes at each location to allow staff adequate time for offloading and documentation, before finally returning to the Main Equipment Depot for your next assignment.

Begin your shift at the fertilizer storage facility on the northwest corner of the property, where you must collect a bulk pallet containing ten sealed nutrient bags. Head first to Greenhouse A along the central access road and deliver four of the nutrient bags, waiting there until each bag is manually unloaded and inventory is confirmed by the greenhouse supervisor. After all four bags have been removed, proceed directly to Field Plot 5, situated southeast of the main barn, to distribute three more nutrient bags, but wait precisely 7 minutes between each delivery to allow for soil analysis and application—only initiate the next delivery after receiving clearance from the field team. With the final three bags, continue to the seed preparation dock adjacent to the west irrigation channel and wait for the dock crew to signal that the preparation area is clear before commencing unloading. When all nutrient bags have been distributed, return to the fertilizer storage facility, but before entering, pause for 5 minutes outside the entrance as a decontamination protocol, then report for assignment completion.

Begin your task at the parts storage bay by collecting a batch of fifteen replacement drive belts needed for machinery maintenance across multiple production areas. First, take five drive belts to Assembly Line A, and remain at Assembly Line A until the maintenance technician completes their inspection and signals that the belts have been installed. After receiving the confirmation, continue with another five drive belts to Packaging Machine Zone, but pause outside the Packaging Machine Zone for exactly six minutes to allow the area to be cleared for safe delivery. Once the waiting period has elapsed, proceed inside Packaging Machine Zone and hand over the belts, staying until the machinery operator has verified receipt. Finally, deliver the remaining five drive belts to Maintenance Workshop 2, and after all drive belts have been distributed and confirmed, immediately return to the parts storage bay to await further instructions.

Start at Supply Depot West and collect twelve labeled seed crates, verifying with the depot manager that they are ready for dispatch. Distribute the seed crates across Field Plot Alpha, Greenhouse East, and Storage Shed 3 by allocating four crates to each location; however, if any of the locations cannot accept the full four crates—such as if only partial unloading is allowed at Greenhouse East—then deliver the maximum possible crates at that stop and bring any remainder to Storage Shed 3 last. After delivering to each site, wait for 2 minutes to allow agricultural staff to sign off on the received seed crates before proceeding. Once all seed crates have either been delivered or deposited at Storage Shed 3, return to Supply Depot West and await instructions for the next assignment.

Start at Storage Silo 4 by picking up a batch of twenty-four seedling trays intended for distribution across three greenhouses. Divide the seedling trays as evenly as possible, delivering eight trays to Greenhouse Alpha, then eight trays to Greenhouse Beta, and finally transporting the remaining eight trays to Greenhouse Gamma, making sure that any leftover trays due to counting errors are returned to Storage Silo 4 for reconciliation at the end. After each drop-off, wait at the respective greenhouse for three minutes to allow staff to unload the seedling trays before proceeding to the next location. Once all trays have been delivered and any excess accounted for, move to Maintenance Garage East and wait there for ten minutes to receive a status update from the greenhouse supervisors before returning to Storage Silo 4 to complete the round.

Begin your assignment at the main storage depot and pick up a pallet containing sixteen bags of mineral fertilizer. Proceed to Field Alpha and deliver five bags, then wait there for exactly 10 minutes to allow the soil amendment process to begin; only after this wait can you depart. Afterwards, drive to Field Beta and offload another six bags of fertilizer, but remain until the field supervisor has removed all six bags from your platform. Finally, transport the remaining five bags to Greenhouse Gamma and deliver them to the supply area, explicitly confirming that no bags remain on board. Once all deliveries have been completed and verified at Greenhouse Gamma, return directly to the main storage depot to log your completed route before shutting down for maintenance.

Begin your operation at the Central Equipment Depot, where you will retrieve a batch of seven irrigation pump filters designated for replacement. Proceed to Field Station Alpha and deliver two irrigation pump filters, waiting until the station lead confirms filter readiness before departing. Next, continue to Field Station Beta to supply another two irrigation pump filters, once again waiting for the beta team to complete installation and signal filter removal. Deliver the final three irrigation pump filters to Field Station Gamma, and remain onsite for fifteen minutes after filter delivery to observe system performance and respond to any immediate issues. Only after the fifteen-minute observation period at Field Station Gamma should you return all empty filter packaging to the Central Equipment Depot before awaiting your next assignment.

Initiate your route at the Storage Depot and collect twelve fresh produce crates earmarked for distribution. First, transport five crates to Dock A at the Processing Plant and wait until all crates have been safely unloaded before proceeding. Once unloading at Dock A is confirmed, deliver another four produce crates to Market Stall 7 at the Farmers’ Pavilion, waiting for two minutes upon arrival to allow for inventory verification by stall staff. Allocate the remaining three crates for the Cold Storage Facility—bring them there only after the previous deliveries to Dock A and Market Stall 7 are fully complete. Following all deliveries, report immediately to Maintenance Bay 2 but do not begin any recharge cycle until a supervisor has inspected the robot’s cargo bay for residual materials; commence recharging at Maintenance Bay 2 only upon receiving verbal confirmation from the supervisor that the inspection is complete.

Begin your task at the Main Parts Warehouse, where you will collect a batch of thirteen diagnostic toolkits required for maintenance operations.
