Following this verification period, return to Material Storage Yard 1 and wait at the loading dock until a technician removes all empty transport racks from your cargo bay before initiating your next task.

Start by proceeding to Receiving Dock C to load a pallet of fifteen sealed chemical reagent drums designated for laboratory use. These drums must be distributed among three locations: deliver six drums to the Pharmaceutical Synthesis Laboratory, five drums to the Microbiology Research Unit, and the remaining four drums to the Hazardous Waste Processing Zone, ensuring the correct allocation without surplus at any site. For every location, wait until laboratory staff or waste technicians have completely removed all drums from the robot before heading to the next assigned destination. Once all deliveries are complete, navigate to Equipment Maintenance Bay 2 and wait exactly 7 minutes while a technician runs a full sensor calibration check on the robot; only after receiving a completion signal from the technician may you proceed back to Receiving Dock C to finalize the delivery manifest and stand by for further instructions.

Begin at Maintenance Depot Alpha by collecting eight solar panel cleaning units and a crate of diagnostic sensors, then proceed directly to Solar Field Row 3 to deliver four cleaning units. After arrival, wait three minutes while the field assistant verifies the delivery, then continue to Solar Field Row 5 with the remaining four cleaning units and offload them as well, again waiting three minutes for confirmation. Once all cleaning units have been distributed and the respective waiting periods have elapsed, transport the crate of diagnostic sensors to Equipment Calibration Bay Sigma, but only hand over the crate if the calibration technician is present; if not, remain at the bay and wait up to seven minutes for technician arrival before attempting the handoff. Once the crate has been removed, return to Maintenance Depot Alpha and remain in standby mode for five minutes, prepared for subsequent assignments.

Start by moving to Grain Silo A to collect six soil moisture sensors, verifying that each sensor is correctly tagged for deployment. Evenly distribute these six sensors by first delivering two sensors to Field Plot North, ensuring that an agronomist is present for payload removal before proceeding. Next, bring another two sensors to Field Plot East and wait for three minutes after the sensors are received to allow personnel to calibrate them. Finally, deliver the last two sensors to Field Plot South, remaining at the location until you receive confirmation that both sensors have been safely removed. Once all soil moisture sensors have been delivered and appropriately installed, return to Grain Silo A to log the completed deployment task before beginning the next sequence.

Begin at Charging Station Delta and travel to Harvest Dock 3 to wait until the crate of freshly picked apples is fully loaded onto your platform. When the apples are secured, proceed directly to Storage Silo North to drop off ten apples, remaining in place until all ten apples have been removed by the silo operator. After the northern silo delivery is complete, continue by transporting twelve apples to Processing Center Beta, ensuring these are accepted by the processing supervisor before continuing. Next, deliver any remaining apples—this will be the last three of the original batch—to Temporary Holding Bay Gamma, waiting for the cargo-ready indication light before returning to Charging Station Delta.

Start the task at the Central Grain Depot and retrieve a total of eleven grain sensors scheduled for deployment across Silo West, Feed Mill Two, and the Livestock Barn. First, deliver four grain sensors to Silo West, and wait until the silo operator confirms that all four grain sensors have been properly removed. Next, head to Feed Mill Two with another four grain sensors in tow, but pause for six minutes at the Feed Mill after arrival, ensuring the maintenance team has adequate time to install and calibrate the delivered grain sensors before you proceed further. After this waiting period, transport the remaining three grain sensors to the Livestock Barn, explicitly awaiting removal of each sensor by the barn foreman before departing. Once all sensors are distributed and your cargo compartment is empty, drive directly to the Equipment Maintenance Bay, where you must wait an additional five minutes for a post-delivery inspection before returning to the Central Grain Depot to complete the route.

Begin at Supply Depot Eleven and collect eight compact feed bins designated for livestock enclosures throughout the northern farm sector. First, transport three feed bins to Cattle Pen Alpha and wait there until the on-site manager removes each bin from the robot. Once all three bins at Cattle Pen Alpha are unloaded, proceed to Sheep Fold Beta and deliver two feed bins, remaining at Sheep Fold Beta until the feeding technician signals that both bins have been emptied. Next, drive to Goat Shelter Delta to drop off two more feed bins, requiring a five-minute pause following arrival to allow for inspection by the quality assurance inspector. Finally, take the last remaining feed bin to Poultry Hutch Gamma, where you must stay until the caretaker acknowledges receipt of the feed bin. Once all deliveries are complete and every involved staff member has confirmed their tasks, return to Supply Depot Eleven to await the next dispatch.

Begin your operation at the Central Warehouse, where you will collect 17 sealed seed crates assigned for distribution. First, proceed to Greenhouse One and unload six seed crates, waiting at Greenhouse One until you receive a signal indicating all crates are ready for removal before departing. Next, head to Greenhouse Two with the remaining seed crates, delivering another six seed crates and waiting for four minutes to allow the greenhouse technicians to inspect and verify the payload. After the four-minute waiting period, take the final five seed crates to Greenhouse Three, and do not leave Greenhouse Three until the lead operator confirms that all five crates have been removed and properly logged in the supply inventory. Only after each of these deliveries is complete should you return to the Central Warehouse to await further instructions.

Commence at the Fertilizer Depot, where you are to collect a batch of twenty-one fertilizer sacks scheduled for morning distribution. Next, navigate to Orchard North, Orchard Central, and Orchard South, delivering seven sacks to each orchard; after unloading each batch of fertilizer sacks at a given orchard, wait until the on-site agronomist confirms the sacks have been positioned in their designated storage areas before proceeding. Once all fertilizer sacks have been successfully distributed and confirmations received, continue on to the Water Reservoir Control Station and remain there for exactly 10 minutes to allow irrigation valves to be calibrated in response to the fertilizer deployment. Upon completion of this waiting period, transport any empty fertilizer pallets you find at the Water Reservoir Control Station back to the Fertilizer Depot, and make sure not to depart the depot until the logistics coordinator confirms that all empty pallets have been registered and returned to their proper location.

Start by traveling to the Loading Dock outside Material Warehouse 1 to pick up a shipment of eleven steel machinery parts required for seasonal equipment upgrades. Distribute these parts evenly by first delivering four steel machinery parts to Maintenance Bay C, then wait at Maintenance Bay C until a technician confirms the four steel machinery parts have been completely unloaded. Afterward, take three steel machinery parts to Tractor Repair Garage, but pause at the Garage entrance for three minutes before unloading to allow workshop doors to open and internal space to be cleared by staff. Once the three steel machinery parts have been removed at the Garage, proceed to the Implements Shed with the next three steel machinery parts, and wait there until an operator signals that all three steel machinery parts have been fetched. Carry the remaining single steel machinery part to Storage Alcove 5 at the far end of the property—however, do not attempt delivery at Storage Alcove 5 until you have received confirmation from the Implements Shed that the previous part removal is fully completed; if this confirmation is delayed, remain parked outside Storage Alcove 5 until it arrives, then deliver the final steel machinery part. After all deliveries and confirmations are finalized, return directly to the Loading Dock and remain idle for ten minutes, allowing for paperwork processing and subsequent dispatch instructions.

Begin your operation at the Central Tool Depot, where you must collect a maintenance kit containing twelve replacement hydraulic seals and six diagnostic sensors. Your first destination is Harvester Service Bay Alpha, to which you will deliver five hydraulic seals and two diagnostic sensors; after arrival, wait exactly five minutes for the technician to inspect and remove the parts. Once the Service Bay Alpha delivery is complete, proceed to Combine Shelter Bravo with four hydraulic seals and two diagnostic sensors, and wait three minutes after arriving to allow for their retrieval. The remaining three hydraulic seals and two diagnostic sensors are to be brought to Grain Loader Maintenance Shed, but if the staff are not immediately prepared to unload the delivery, you must wait outside the Grain Loader Maintenance Shed for two minutes before trying again. Only after all component handovers are confirmed and the payload has been removed at all three facilities may you return the empty containers to the Central Tool Depot and await further dispatch instructions.

Start at the Fertilizer Storage Facility and gather a total of seventeen nutrient supply pods designated for the morning crop cycle. Head first to Corn Field Alpha and deliver six nutrient supply pods at the field’s northern drop-off point, waiting there until the field manager confirms all six pods are accounted for and removed. Next, transport another six nutrient supply pods to Soybean Plot Bravo, delivering them to the shed stationed at the plot’s southeast edge and similarly wait until a confirmation is received from the crew leader that all pods have been unloaded. Take the remaining five nutrient supply pods to Vineyard Delta at the hillside entrance, but before departing, wait for exactly eight minutes at Vineyard Delta to accommodate mandatory environmental checks by the agronomist team. Return directly to the Fertilizer Storage Facility only after all pods have been offloaded and both the explicit confirmations and time-based hold at Vineyard Delta are complete, preparing for subsequent deployment instructions.

Begin your sequence at the Seed Storage Depot by collecting a pallet that contains twenty-one seed trays. Your task is to distribute these trays by transporting eight seed trays to Field Plot Alpha, six seed trays to Field Plot Beta, and the remaining seven seed trays to Field Plot Gamma, prioritizing Field Plot Alpha first. Upon arrival at Field Plot Alpha, wait for the local field manager to signal that the soil bed is ready before you unload all eight trays. After completing the delivery there, proceed to Field Plot Beta and deposit the six seed trays; following this delivery, pause for 5 minutes to allow the field sensors to calibrate before moving on. Continue to Field Plot Gamma to deliver the last seven seed trays and confirm that the field technician has signed off the receipt of these trays through the digital handover system. Only after all trays have been distributed and logged at each location, make your way to the Equipment Washdown Bay and remain there for decontamination procedures before receiving further assignments.

Begin at the Central Maintenance Garage and collect four calibrated toolkits from the Equipment Staging Area, verifying that all toolkits are ready for safe transport. Take the first toolkit to Turbine Monitoring Station A and remain there until the station operator confirms removal and readiness for use. Next, deliver two toolkits to Solar Array Field B, but after arriving you must wait for ten minutes to allow active drone inspections to finish before you release both toolkits at the designated drop-off zone, ensuring field personnel are present to receive them. Afterward, transport the final toolkit to the Wind Sensor Tower C; upon arrival, wait until the remote maintenance crew signals completion of preparatory work via the Tower C interface, then deliver the toolkit. Once all four toolkits are delivered with explicit removal confirmations at each destination, return directly to the Central Maintenance Garage and await further assignment.

Begin at the Central Harvest Dock and collect twenty-two produce crates, ensuring all crates are securely loaded before departure. Distribute the crates across Field Post North, Field Post South, and Field Post East by allocating nine crates to Field Post North, eight crates to Field Post South, and the remaining five crates to Field Post East, making certain to handle any partial loads by visiting each field post sequentially. At each location, wait until the field supervisor has fully removed and inspected all crates delivered to that site before moving on to the next post. Once all deliveries are complete, proceed back to the Central Harvest Dock but pause for ten minutes upon arrival to allow dock staff to replenish and calibrate your transport platform prior to your next assignment, only departing the dock once recalibration is officially confirmed.

Begin your task at Packing Station East, where you must collect a batch of twelve fresh produce crates. Transport the crates to three destinations: deliver five crates to Cold Storage Unit A, another four crates to Cold Storage Unit B, and take the remaining three crates to the Distribution Dock. Make sure to wait at each destination for the receiving dock manager to signal that their unloading bay is available; if any destination's unloading bay is not accessible upon arrival, remain on-site for a full 120 seconds before rechecking availability. Only proceed to the next delivery location after the current crate drop-off and acknowledgment by the dock manager are complete. Once all crates are delivered to their respective cold storage units and the dock, navigate to Sanitization Bay Alpha and remain there for 4 minutes to complete compulsory cleaning procedures before returning to Packing Station East to await further assignments.

Start your route at Greenhouse Control Center and secure ten hydroponic nutrient tanks marked for today’s batch rotation. Proceed first to Vertical Grow Room 3 to deliver three nutrient tanks, but only allow the technician on duty to remove the tanks after waiting there for four minutes to let the mixing system purge any residues. Once those three tanks are confirmed removed at Vertical Grow Room 3, take another three nutrient tanks to Rooftop Cultivation Deck, and remain at the deck for six minutes while the solar panel arrays recalibrate before offloading the tanks to the deck supervisor. After both previous deliveries are verified as complete, transport the last four nutrient tanks to Propagation Bay South and do not commence offloading until Propagation Bay South staff provide clearance that their intake hoppers are empty. Once you have unloaded all nutrient tanks at each location and received confirmation from every on-site manager, make your way back to Greenhouse Control Center to finalize the delivery log and reset the carrying module for the next shift.

Start your task at the Central Workshop by collecting a sealed container of calibration weights designated for three different quality assurance labs. Proceed to Lab Alpha first, where you must deliver four calibration weights and remain until all four are removed by Lab Alpha's technician. After the successful hand-off at Lab Alpha, navigate to Lab Beta and supply three calibration weights, staying in place until the Lab Beta supervisor acknowledges full receipt. Next, continue to Lab Gamma and provide the final two calibration weights, waiting for confirmation from the lab staff that delivery has been completed. Once all calibration weights have been distributed among the three labs, return to the Central Workshop, but pause for a mandatory seven-minute interval outside the workshop entrance to allow the facility safety officer to complete post-delivery decontamination before you re-enter the building for your next deployment.

Begin your route at the Main Warehouse Entry and retrieve twelve seed boxes scheduled for distribution to Field Sector A, Field Sector B, and Field Sector C. Deliver four seed boxes to Field Sector A first, but after arrival, wait for confirmation from the sector supervisor that all boxes have been unloaded before departing. Proceed to Field Sector B to drop off another four seed boxes, again remaining on-site until the technician signals completion of the transfer. Next, transport the remaining four seed boxes to Field Sector C; after verifying that all seed boxes have been removed by the local agronomy assistant, travel directly to the Refueling Pad for a mandatory five-minute standby period to recharge systems. Once recharged, return to the Main Warehouse Entry to complete the operational cycle, ensuring no seed boxes remain on the payload at any stage of the process.

Begin your route at the Seed Storage Facility, where you must wait for the loading technician to confirm that four pallets of barley seed are secured on the robot. Once loaded, distribute the four pallets as follows: deliver one pallet each to Field Plot A, Field Plot B, and Field Plot C, ensuring that a single pallet is delivered per plot in sequential order. Pause at each plot and wait until a field worker has fully removed the delivered pallet before proceeding to the next destination. Due to an unequal allocation, after these deliveries, transport the remaining pallet to Field Plot D, where you must wait an additional 8 minutes after unloading to comply with the soil stabilization protocols recently enacted there. Only after this waiting period is complete should you proceed to the Fertilizer Shed to collect a drum of liquid nitrogen fertilizer, but do so only if all previous barley seed pallets have been removed from the robot. After the drum is onboard, bring it directly to Field Plot B for immediate handoff to the application team, waiting at the site until the fertilizer drum is fully removed. Finally, return to the Seed Storage Facility to report completion and prepare for subsequent tasks.

Begin at the Materials Storage Shed and load two maintenance toolkits and ten spare hydraulic filters. Make your way first to Machine Repair Bay A, delivering one maintenance toolkit and five hydraulic filters; remain at Repair Bay A until each item has been removed by the repair supervisor, confirming complete transfer before departing. Following this, travel to Machine Repair Bay B and offload the second maintenance toolkit together with three hydraulic filters, but wait for four minutes upon arrival before allowing removal of any items, in order to permit the bay's ventilation cycle to complete. Only after this enforced pause should you allow the staff to remove the toolkit and filters, ensuring accountability for every item. With two hydraulic filters remaining, continue to the Mobile Equipment Dock and, for each filter, wait for the equipment operator to signal readiness before releasing the filter; do not leave until both filters have been claimed. Once the entire payload has been distributed precisely as required and all necessary waiting periods and dependencies have been observed at each destination, return directly to the Materials Storage Shed to conclude your task.

Begin at the Central Storage Facility and retrieve a set of nine irrigation filters and four spare water pumps. Transport three irrigation filters to Pumping Station East, waiting until the maintenance engineer confirms the filters have been removed from the robot before proceeding. After the filters have been offloaded at Pumping Station East, remain on site for seven minutes while system calibration is performed. Next, bring three more irrigation filters to Pumping Station West and wait until the supervisory technician has removed the payload. Then, deliver the final three irrigation filters to Pumping Station South, pausing there until a staff member has finished unloading them. Following the completion of all irrigation filter deliveries, distribute the four spare water pumps by taking two to Greenhouse 7 and one to Cropping Block D, ensuring at each location to wait for the respective systems manager to remove each water pump before moving on. Take the fourth water pump to Maintenance Hub 3, but only proceed to this hub after all previous pump deliveries are complete; once there, remain for five minutes while the maintenance team runs diagnostics before you return directly to the Central Storage Facility to complete this task cycle.

Start your route at the Fertilizer Depot and pick up a container holding 23 nutrient packs assigned for delivery to three separate greenhouse units. First, transport 8 nutrient packs to Greenhouse A, and stay until all 8 packs have been offloaded and the greenhouse technician confirms receipt. Afterward, proceed to Greenhouse B with the next batch of 7 nutrient packs, but wait outside until you receive a signal that the UV sanitation cycle inside Greenhouse B is complete, which may take up to 4 minutes before entry is permitted; then, deliver the packs and remain until they have all been acknowledged as removed. For the remaining 8 nutrient packs, drive to Greenhouse C and deliver them, but do so in two rounds by unloading 4 packs, waiting until the horticulturist acknowledges removal, then depositing the last 4 packs and staying until the final confirmation is received from Greenhouse C staff. Once all nutrient packs are allocated appropriately and confirmations have been received from each greenhouse, return to the Fertilizer Depot and await further tasks.

Begin your route at the Main Fertilizer Storage Facility and acquire nine sealed fertilizer drums. Distribute these drums among the following destinations: deliver four drums to the North Field Supply Dock, three drums to the Greenhouse Annex, and bring the remaining two drums to the Aquaponics Lab Storage Room. After dropping off the allocated drums at each location, wait until an authorized staff member signals that the drums have been safely removed from your cargo bay before proceeding to the next stop. Once all fertilizer drums have been distributed and verified as unloaded, pause for nine minutes at the Aquaponics Lab Storage Room to enable a safety inspection of any residual fertilizer in your hold before making your final leg directly to the Vehicle Maintenance Bay for a routine chassis inspection.

Begin at Storage Facility 3 and collect a shipment of twelve fertilizer canisters designated for field distribution. Travel to Field Alpha and deliver five canisters to the distribution terminal, waiting at Field Alpha until all five fertilizer canisters are fully removed by the field team. After completing this step, proceed to Field Beta and offload four additional canisters, remaining at Field Beta until every canister has been confirmed as unloaded by the site supervisor, then wait an extra five minutes to allow for soil integration procedures. With the remaining three fertilizer canisters, continue to Field Gamma, providing the final set of canisters and waiting for their removal; only after all canisters have been accepted at Field Gamma should you return directly to Storage Facility 3, ensuring each field receives the correct number of fertilizer canisters and that timing and unloading verifications are strictly observed throughout your route.

Begin at the Loading Dock and retrieve a pallet containing a set of ten replacement hydraulic hoses for scheduled maintenance. Travel first to Maintenance Bay 1 and supply three hydraulic hoses, remaining at Maintenance Bay 1 until the technician has removed all three hoses from the pallet and verified compatibility. After completion, proceed to Maintenance Bay 2 and deliver four more hoses, but pause five minutes after arrival to allow for necessary equipment switchover within the bay before you release the hoses for removal. With the remaining hoses, advance to Maintenance Bay 3 and provide the last three hydraulic hoses; wait until the Maintenance Bay 3 supervisor confirms that all hoses have been removed. Once every bay has received their allotted hydraulic hoses, promptly return the now-empty pallet to the Loading Dock, and await further assignment instructions from operations control.

Commence your task at the main processing plant loading dock, where you must retrieve a single crate of calibration sensors, a bundle of high-tensile cables, and two sealed containers of thermal lubricant. Head first to the west-side robotic maintenance bay to deliver the crate of calibration sensors, remaining at the bay until the maintenance supervisor removes it and provides verbal clearance. Immediately following this, transport the high-tensile cables to the north equipment storage facility and wait outside for three minutes before entering, to allow the automated door system to reset after heavy machinery has passed. Upon completion of the wait, enter the facility and deliver the high-tensile cables. Next, distribute the two containers of thermal lubricant evenly between the two transformer substations located at Substation A and Substation B; deliver one container to each substation, in either order, but ensure you wait for the on-site technician to finish safety checks and signal readiness before you unload at each location. Once all deliveries and confirmations are finalized at their respective destinations, return to the main processing plant loading dock and await your next dispatch instructions while remaining on standby near the security kiosk.

Begin at Loading Station 3 and prepare to transport nine fertilizer canisters for the morning distribution. Evenly allocate the canisters by delivering three canisters to Greenhouse 1, three to Greenhouse 2, and three to Greenhouse 3; if any greenhouse’s storage area is full upon arrival, wait there for five minutes to allow for manual rearrangement before attempting delivery again. Once all nine canisters have been fully distributed and confirmed received by the respective greenhouse managers, proceed directly to Tool Maintenance Bay 1, but pause at Field Access Gate B for four minutes to allow for equipment inspection and clearance by the safety supervisor. After successfully passing inspection at Field Access Gate B, continue to Tool Maintenance Bay 1 to conclude the task, remaining onsite until notified by the equipment maintenance lead that the robot is cleared for further assignments.

Begin at Loading Dock Alpha to collect eight fertilizer drums stacked for outbound delivery, confirming with the dock manager when all are ready. Transport the drums to Greenhouse East, Greenhouse Central, and Greenhouse West, ensuring each greenhouse receives two drums, delivered in order of proximity. After each delivery, wait until the corresponding greenhouse supervisor inspects and removes the drums before departing to the next location. Once all six drums are distributed, carry the final two fertilizer drums to the Tool Shed at Field Block D, pause for 6 minutes to allow the field team to inspect the shipment, and then retrace your route back to Loading Dock Alpha for check-out with the dock manager.

Start by proceeding to the Grain Mill Loading Dock and wait until the operator has completely filled fifteen seed bags for transport. Once the seed bags are ready, distribute them so that seven are delivered to Silo Alpha, four to Silo Bravo, and the remaining four to Silo Charlie, making sure that each silo receives its precise allocation in one uninterrupted visit. After depositing the seed bags at each silo location, wait for three minutes at the corresponding silo entrance to facilitate inventory scanning by the storage supervisor. Immediately after the final delivery and all associated waiting periods are finished, proceed directly to the Vehicle Wash Station and remain there until the cleaning sequence for the transport robot is fully completed, ensuring the robot is sanitized before its next assignment.

Start by retrieving fifteen bagged seed packets from the Main Supply Depot, ensuring that none are missing or damaged. Next, distribute the seed packets across the Crop Test Plot, Community Garden, and Northern Field Workstation in a way that the Crop Test Plot receives six bags, while both the Community Garden and the Northern Field Workstation receive an equal number and any leftover bag should be delivered to the Northern Field Workstation—this results in four bags for each of the latter locations, with the extra one going specifically to the Northern Field Workstation. For each location, after traveling, wait for the designated site manager to confirm they are ready to take the seed packet delivery before allowing removal of the packets. Once all deliveries and handoffs are complete at every site, proceed to the Central Sanitation Bay, wait for ten minutes to allow for routine decontamination and exterior cleaning, and then proceed to the Logistics Coordinator’s Office at the farm perimeter to report completion of the distribution route.

Start at Maintenance Bay A and collect a total of twelve boxed replacement parts intended for ongoing repairs. First, transport five boxed replacement parts to Machine Shop 1 and wait there for three minutes while the technicians unpack and verify their contents. Once the shop staff confirm successful unloading, shuttle four boxed replacement parts to the Assembly Line 3 Service Area, staying on site until the assembly supervisor indicates that all boxed replacement parts have been removed and accounted for. With the remaining three boxed replacement parts, proceed to the Equipment Storage Shed and deposit them onto the marked shelving unit, then pause for ten minutes to allow the inventory manager to finish logging the deliveries. When all boxed replacement parts have been distributed and each stop’s staff has completed their respective tasks, return to Maintenance Bay A to conclude your mission.

Begin at the equipment loading bay adjacent to the central warehouse, and collect seven crates of fertilizer mix designated for field deployment. Transport two crates of fertilizer mix to Field Plot One, and wait at Field Plot One until the field manager confirms the fertilizer dispenser is ready to receive them. After completing delivery there, take the next three crates to Field Plot Two, pausing for three minutes at Field Plot Two to allow manual inspection by the soil technician before initiating transfer. Once Field Plot Two's delivery is acknowledged, carry the remaining two crates to Field Plot Three located beside the southern hedgerow, ensuring Field Plot Three's unloading team confirms receipt of both crates. After all seven crates have been successfully distributed and verified at their respective destinations, and only once this is complete, return directly to the equipment loading bay to finalize the delivery run.

Start by moving to the Seed Supply Depot and wait until twelve hybrid seed crates are marked as ready for transport. After the seed crates are available, shuttle four seed crates to Rice Plot North, another four seed crates to Barley Patch East, and four seed crates to Clover Field South. At each destination, after delivering the crates, wait for the respective field manager to remove all delivered seed crates before proceeding to the next location. Once the last seed crate has been delivered to Clover Field South and confirmed as removed, remain at Clover Field South for six minutes while agronomists perform their seed inventory check, and then, after the waiting period, proceed directly to the Recharge Station in the southwest corner of the facility and await further deployment instructions.

Start at the supply depot and load seven irrigation control modules onto the robot. Deliver two of the irrigation control modules to Field Plot Alpha, and wait until the site supervisor has removed both modules before proceeding. Next, carry three irrigation control modules to Field Plot Beta, but before the transfer can occur, remain onsite for five minutes while the maintenance staff stabilize the control lines. Once the modules for Field Plot Beta have been removed, transport the final two irrigation control modules to the Equipment Calibration Shed. Wait at the shed until a technician confirms proper installation and removes the remaining modules from the robot. Only after all modules are delivered and acknowledged at their destinations may you return to the supply depot, concluding the assignment.

Begin at the Main Equipment Shed and load eight toolkits onto the autonomous robot. Deliver three toolkits to Maintenance Bay One; after technicians at Maintenance Bay One remove all three toolkits, wait for four minutes to allow for equipment calibration scans. Once the wait is complete, proceed to Maintenance Bay Two with another three toolkits, and only commence offloading after receiving confirmation that the previous calibration at Maintenance Bay One was fully successful; if confirmation is delayed, remain at Maintenance Bay Two for up to six minutes awaiting the clearance message. After all toolkits are delivered to Maintenance Bay Two, transport the last two toolkits to the Spare Parts Depot, but if either of the prior deliveries was not fully acknowledged by the bay supervisors, reroute to the Operations Control Center for manual intervention instead of continuing directly to the depot. When all toolkits have been successfully transferred and the transfer process is confirmed by the respective bay or depot supervisors, return to the Main Equipment Shed to complete the route.

Start your route at the Seed Storage Facility and load thirteen precision seeder units which are scheduled for field deployment. Distribute these seeder units by delivering four units to Field Plot 7, four units to Field Plot 8, and four units to Field Plot 9, in that order; if one seeder unit remains after these deliveries, bring it directly to the Equipment Testing Shed for calibration trials. After delivering each batch of four to a field plot, wait five minutes at that location to allow the on-site agronomist to validate and record the shipment before proceeding to the next field. Once all seeder units are delivered and validated, return to each plot—beginning with Plot 7—to collect any faulty seeder units flagged during validation and deliver each one individually to the Maintenance Workshop, waiting three minutes upon arrival for the technician to sign off on acceptance before retrieving faulty units from the next field. Complete the deployment sequence by returning to the Seed Storage Facility and logging the final delivery manifest.

Commence your route at the Central Loading Dock, collecting a total of fifteen 10-liter water canisters for irrigation purposes. Divide these canisters across Field Alpha, Nursery Beta, and Orchard Gamma, giving six canisters to Field Alpha, five to Nursery Beta, and the remaining four to Orchard Gamma; after each delivery, wait at the destination until the field crew has confirmed removal of all the delivered canisters before departing. Between completing the first and second deliveries, pause at least seven minutes to allow greenhouse controls to be recalibrated per irrigation site requirements; only proceed once this interval has fully elapsed. After all canisters are delivered and their removal has been verified at the three locations, return to the Central Loading Dock and remain idle there for ten minutes before finalizing the mission, to synchronize with the next scheduled transport wave.

Initiate your route at Central Seed Storage and retrieve fifteen seed bags designated for spring planting. Your distribution sequence will be as follows: transport an initial batch of six seed bags to Field Plot West, and upon reaching Field Plot West, wait until farm personnel confirm all seed bags are offloaded before departing. Next, move the remaining seed bags to Greenhouse 2 and deliver another five seed bags; after you have completed this transfer, continue to the Equipment Calibration Zone with the last four seed bags in your payload. At the Equipment Calibration Zone, you must wait precisely 6 minutes to allow resident technicians to test seeders and collect the rest of the bags. Once all seed bags are unloaded and acknowledged by staff, proceed directly to the Vehicle Wash Area, and do not enter until your cargo bed is verified empty. Then, remain at the Vehicle Wash Area for 3 minutes for a required rinsing cycle, before finally returning to Central Seed Storage for your next assignment.

Begin at the Equipment Depot, where you will load three distinct maintenance toolboxes and one replacement battery unit. Transport the replacement battery unit directly to the North Field Irrigation Pump Station and remain there until the pump technician signals that the battery installation is complete. As soon as the battery transfer is confirmed, proceed to distribute the three toolboxes among the inspection crews at the following sites: deliver one toolbox to the South Crop Storage Silo, a second toolbox to the West Boundary Sensor Array, and the final toolbox to the Central Processing Shed, delivering to each location in the listed sequence. After dropping off a toolbox at each stop, verify that the respective crew member has signed for the delivery before continuing to the next site. Once all three toolboxes are delivered and all signatures are collected, head to the Vehicle Wash Bay for post-operation cleaning and wait there for 8 minutes before returning to the Equipment Depot.

Begin at the main equipment depot and collect a shipment of nine replacement hydraulic hoses needed for ongoing repairs across several machinery stations. Drive first to Tractor Maintenance Bay 1 and deliver four hoses, waiting until a technician removes all hoses from the robot. Afterwards, proceed to Harvester Maintenance Bay 2 and drop off another three hoses, remaining idle until receipt is confirmed by a maintenance supervisor. With the final two hydraulic hoses, continue to Sprayer Maintenance Shed 3, deliver both, and then wait for fifteen minutes to allow installation checks. During this waiting period, if the supervisor signals completion before the full time elapses, immediately proceed to Field Control Office and await further instructions; otherwise, after the timer ends, return directly to the main equipment depot for your next assignment.

At the loading dock next to Warehouse 2, pick up nine fertilizer canisters earmarked for transfer across Greenhouse Alpha, Orchard Depot, and the South Plot Shed. Begin by delivering three fertilizer canisters to Greenhouse Alpha, then remain on-site until the greenhouse manager confirms all canisters have been safely removed. Proceed to Orchard Depot and drop off three additional fertilizer canisters, but pause operations there for a three-minute interval before unloading, to allow their storage crew to prepare. Once the crew gives the all-clear and the canisters are removed, continue to South Plot Shed with the final three fertilizer canisters, staying until the agricultural technician acknowledges completion of the delivery. After all canisters have been distributed and verified as unloaded at each destination, return immediately to the loading dock at Warehouse 2 for decontamination procedures, ensuring no fertilizer residue remains on the transport module during return transit.

Begin the task at the Grain Storage Facility and load nine sacks of premium wheat destined for distribution. Make your first stop at Mill House East and deliver three sacks, then proceed to Bakery Supply Dock to unload another three sacks, and finally transport the remaining three sacks to Animal Feed Station Omega. After each delivery, remain at each respective drop-off point for five minutes to ensure the receipt process is completed and station staff confirm the transfer of the sacks. Only after all nine sacks have been successfully removed at their designated locations should you return to the Grain Storage Facility. Upon return, wait for notification that new payloads are ready before undertaking another distribution task.

Start your task at the Seed Storage Facility and pick up a batch of thirteen tomato seed trays designated for distribution to three different greenhouses: Greenhouse North, Greenhouse East, and Greenhouse South. Transport five tomato seed trays to Greenhouse North first, and wait at their entrance until the greenhouse manager confirms that all five trays have been offloaded. After this confirmation, proceed to Greenhouse East and deliver four trays, but before entering, wait outside for three minutes to allow their climate control cycle to complete. Once permitted, move the seed trays into Greenhouse East and remain until all four trays are removed by the local staff. With the remaining four trays onboard, continue to Greenhouse South, where you must offload the final trays and await their collection by South's supervisor, who will signal removal. After all seed trays have been successfully delivered and verified at each location, return promptly to the Seed Storage Facility and prepare for your next assigned distribution.

Begin at the main machine shop and pick up three replacement drive belts, ensuring each belt is clearly labeled for dispatch. Deliver the first drive belt to Tractor Maintenance Bay 1, but only leave after the maintenance technician confirms the old belt has been removed—this confirmation may require you to wait up to seven minutes. Then, bring the second drive belt to Combine Harvester Service Station, where you must wait for the supervisor to signal that the maintenance bay is cleared for deliveries before proceeding; this wait period can extend up to five minutes. Afterwards, transport the third and final drive belt to the Mobile Irrigation Unit Garage and remain there for a minimum of eight minutes to provide the service crew with sufficient installation time. Once all three drive belts have been delivered, and after waiting at the garage, proceed directly to the Equipment Toolshed and stand by for further transport duties.

Start by navigating from the Fleet Maintenance Hangar to the Tool Supply Depot and collect nine precision wrench sets designated for calibration. First, proceed directly to Assembly Line One, unload three wrench sets, and wait there until the team completes retrieval of all three sets; once pickup is confirmed, continue with the remaining six sets to the Quality Control Station. At this location, offload four wrench sets, explicitly waiting until the station manager authorizes removal of the entire batch. With two wrench sets left, travel to Repair Bay Delta, deliver the final two sets, and then pause at Repair Bay Delta for four minutes to allow technicians to perform an immediate inventory check. Following confirmation from the technicians, return to the Fleet Maintenance Hangar and await further instructions for your next operational run.

Begin your route at the Tool Storage Shed to pick up a pallet of ten irrigation sensors intended for field deployment. Proceed first to Crop Monitoring Point North and distribute three sensors, pausing until the technician at that station signals that all sensors are securely installed. Following the confirmation at North, continue to Crop Monitoring Point East to drop off another three sensors and remain there for 120 seconds to allow for equipment calibration by the field team. Your next stop is Crop Monitoring Point South, where you must deliver the remaining four sensors; stay onsite until the lead agronomist personally verifies successful handover of all items. Once sensor deliveries at North, East, and South are fully completed and the required wait at East has elapsed, return to the Tool Storage Shed to report mission completion and prepare for any further assignments.

Commence the operation at the Greenhouse Packing Station and pick up a total of nine cartons of hydroponic tomatoes prepared for morning shipment. Distribute these cartons in a batch transfer: deliver three cartons each to Refrigeration Unit A, Refrigeration Unit B, and the Canteen Storage Room, making sure that each destination receives a balanced quantity. Upon arrival at each location, remain at the handover area until all cartons delivered to that specific location have been verified and removed by the responsible staff member. Once you have completed these three sequential deliveries, wait at the Loading Bay adjacent to the Canteen Storage Room for five minutes to facilitate final recordkeeping by the shipping coordinator before proceeding. After the waiting period, return to the Greenhouse Packing Station and await new instructions for the next delivery cycle, ensuring the route is not repeated until the completion of all verification and timing requirements.

Start at Maintenance Bay 3 within the equipment hub and collect a toolbox labeled 'Hydraulic Repair Kit' along with three replacement hydraulic hoses. Travel directly to Greenhouse Alpha and wait for the greenhouse staff to prepare and secure the entrance for equipment servicing, which may take up to 8 minutes. After the staff confirms readiness, deliver the hydraulic repair kit and one of the hydraulic hoses to Greenhouse Alpha’s control booth. Next, proceed to Storage Barn 4 east of the main livestock enclosure and deposit the second hydraulic hose at the main entrance vestibule. Do not leave Storage Barn 4 until you receive an acknowledgement from the on-duty technician that the delivered hose has been inspected for quality. Once the first two hoses are delivered and verified, carry the remaining hydraulic hose to Drip Irrigation Station 7 on the south perimeter of Field Delta, where you must wait for the irrigation supervisor to remove and store the hose before departing. After all three delivery actions and confirmation steps at each site are finalized, return to Maintenance Bay 3 and remain on standby for 10 minutes before seeking your next task assignment.

You will begin at Central Maintenance Depot to load a set of nine diagnostic toolkit crates onto your cargo bay and then proceed to the Precision Harvester Line in Assembly Bay 2. There, you are to deliver four diagnostic toolkit crates directly to the mechanic crew and await until all four crates have been fully removed from the robot. Once this transfer is completed, travel to Lithium Battery Charging Station 5 with the remaining five diagnostic toolkit crates in your payload. At Charging Station 5, distribute three toolkit crates evenly to the battery techs and wait at the site for two minutes to allow for verification of serial numbers and acceptance logs. After the two-minute verification period is over, bring the last two toolkit crates to Temperature Sensor Calibration Lab on the western edge of the facility; remain stationed there until the calibration team retrieves both remaining crates and gives a clearance for departure. Upon successful delivery and confirmation of all nine diagnostic toolkit crates at their respective destinations, make your way back to Central Maintenance Depot, where you will remain parked until the next dispatch cycle begins.

Start at the grain silo near the eastern maintenance bay and load twelve motorized grain augers carefully to ensure none are damaged. Transport exactly four augers each to the North Paddock Loading Zone, South Feed Station, and West Harvest Dock, delivering one batch at a time and making certain that at each location you wait for staff to finish unloading all four augers before departing. If at any location you encounter a delay and unloading takes longer than expected, pause for two additional minutes before proceeding to your next destination to allow for coordination between teams. After completing all deliveries, return to the grain silo and wait for ten minutes to receive confirmation from the operations manager that the equipment has been properly distributed and no retrievals are required; only after this waiting period is over should you return to the eastern maintenance bay and park for maintenance inspection.

Begin at Cold Storage Facility D, where you must pick up a shipment of fifteen perishable pharmaceutical packages, ensuring all packages are secured before departing. Distribute these packages to three specific research locations: deliver five packages to Laboratory Wing A, four packages to Research Suite B, and the remaining six packages to Analytical Lab C, allocating the extra package(s) to Analytical Lab C if division cannot be equal. At each laboratory, wait precisely three minutes after arriving to allow lab staff to sanitize the drop-off point before awaiting confirmation that each package has been unloaded from the robot; do not proceed to the next laboratory until this removal is confirmed. After all deliveries and waiting periods have been completed at each destination, navigate to the Sanitation Bay, remain there for six minutes for a mandatory decontamination cycle, and only then proceed to Dispatch Control to receive the next routing assignment from the supervisor.

Begin the shift by navigating to the Cold Storage Warehouse and taking delivery of a total of twenty-five crates of fresh produce, confirming with the warehouse manager that all crates are properly secured on the robot platform. Proceed first to Market Loading Dock 1 and offload eight crates of fresh produce, remaining at the dock until each crate has been individually inspected and removed by the dock personnel. As soon as Market Loading Dock 1 has received its allocation, continue to Grocery Outlet 2 and deliver another eight crates of fresh produce; do not depart until the store manager signals that all crates have been accepted and placed in the receiving area. After leaving Grocery Outlet 2, travel to Community Pantry Express where you will deliver the final nine crates—however, since the pantry volunteers can only handle five crates at a time, unload five crates first, then wait eight minutes before you can hand over the last four crates to accommodate their limited sorting capacity. Once every crate of fresh produce has been successfully removed at all destinations, promptly return to the Cold Storage Warehouse to await further dispatch instructions.

Begin your route at the Fertilizer Storage Facility where you are required to load a total of seven sealed fertilizer crates, making certain that all crates are properly secured before departure. Your first stop is Field Plot 3, where you will deliver two fertilizer crates and await the field technician’s readiness signal prior to unloading each crate. Next, proceed to Greenhouse A to deliver another two fertilizer crates, again only unloading them after the greenhouse supervisor has indicated that the receiving station is ready. With three remaining fertilizer crates, make your final delivery at Orchard Sector B, ensuring all three crates are acknowledged and removed by the orchard manager before proceeding. After completing all scheduled deliveries, wait at Orchard Sector B for four minutes to allow for equipment inspection before you return to the Fertilizer Storage Facility to log completion of the distribution round.

Begin by traveling to the Raw Materials Warehouse and retrieve a shipment of twenty-four harvested corn sacks. These corn sacks must then be distributed among the Northern Silo, the Western Feed Barn, and the Eastern Processing Plant, allocating eight sacks to each site; if there are any surplus sacks—meaning if the total is not exactly divisible—deliver the first surplus sack to the Northern Silo and the next to the Western Feed Barn, ensuring that the difference in sack quantities between sites does not exceed one. After each location has received its allotted corn sacks and the site manager at the Eastern Processing Plant confirms their inventory, proceed immediately to the Central Weigh Station but pause outside for five minutes to allow grain dust in the processing area to settle for safety reasons. Only after this waiting period should you enter the Central Weigh Station, where you must remain until invited to return to the Raw Materials Warehouse for additional assignments, ensuring that every transfer, time delay, and dependency between pick-up and delivery sites has been strictly respected throughout this operation.

Start at Packaging Station East and verify that a bulk shipment of twenty-four sealed boxes of apple cider bottles is prepared for distribution. Divide these boxes as evenly as possible among Loading Dock 3, Retail Pickup Zone, and Cold Storage Unit D, assigning eight boxes to each location. Deliver the first batch of eight boxes to Loading Dock 3 and wait at Loading Dock 3 until the receiving crew confirms removal of all eight boxes. Next, proceed directly to Retail Pickup Zone with the second set of eight boxes, but remain at Retail Pickup Zone for six minutes following delivery to allow for the completion of required retail inventory scanning. After the six-minute interval has elapsed and scanning is complete, transport the final group of eight boxes to Cold Storage Unit D, and wait at Cold Storage Unit D until the cold chain supervisor acknowledges successful transfer of all boxes into refrigeration. Once all deliveries are finished and confirmed at their respective destinations, return immediately to Packaging Station East for further assignment and hold position until a new shipment of cider boxes is ready for dispatch.

Begin your route at the Cold Storage Depot and load fifteen temperature-sensitive seed trays intended for three different locations. First, deliver five seed trays to Planting Field East, ensuring that the on-site field technician is present and waits for all five trays to be confirmed as ready before leaving the site. Next, proceed to Nursery Block 2 and offload another five seed trays, but pause for three minutes upon arrival to allow for acclimatization of the trays; only after this wait should you complete the hand-off to the nursery supervisor. Once both Planting Field East and Nursery Block 2 have received their allocations, transport the remaining five seed trays to the Experimental Crop Tunnel, and do not depart until the laboratory staff has acknowledged readiness for acceptance. Following the completion of all deliveries and confirmation that each recipient has successfully received their seed trays, return to the Cold Storage Depot and wait for twelve minutes to let your cooling system stabilize after extended exposure to outside temperatures before beginning any new tasks.

Begin at the Assembly Material Depot and collect a total of seven spare actuator units, verifying that all units are properly secured to your cargo tray. Transport three actuator units to Maintenance Bay Alpha and remain in position until service staff have offloaded all three actuator units from your tray. From there, proceed to Maintenance Bay Bravo to deliver another two actuator units, staying at the unloading dock until both actuator units have been removed. The final two actuator units should then be taken to Maintenance Bay Charlie; after waiting for confirmation that both actuator units have been received, wait an additional 4 minutes at Maintenance Bay Charlie to allow mechanics time for inventory checks. Once this holding period has passed, return to the Assembly Material Depot for your next assignment.

Begin at Storage Shed Gamma, where you will load nine crates of irrigation tubing needed by three separate fields. Deliver three crates each to Orchard East, Vineyard South, and Row Crop West, but after arriving at each location, wait for the local field supervisor to confirm that all irrigation tubing crates for that specific field have been unloaded before proceeding to the next destination. After completing deliveries to all three fields, return promptly to Storage Shed Gamma, but before entering the storage area, wait outside the entrance for six minutes to allow warehouse staff to complete an inventory audit of both your outbound delivery receipts and your empty cargo space. Reenter Storage Shed Gamma only once the staff gives clearance after their audit is finished.

Begin your route at the Maintenance Hub and pick up a set of twelve toolkits assigned for periodic equipment servicing at Warehouse A, Workshop B, and Field Post Charlie. Deliver five toolkits to Warehouse A first, and wait at their loading dock until a technician verifies removal of all five toolkits. Afterwards, travel to Workshop B and offload four toolkits, but pause outside for two minutes before entering to ensure their machinery is fully powered down. Once the toolkits are accepted by Workshop B staff, proceed to Field Post Charlie with the final three toolkits. Remain at Field Post Charlie until their supervisor confirms all remaining toolkits have been received. Upon completion of toolkit distribution to all three destinations, promptly return to the Maintenance Hub to await further deployment instructions.

Begin at the Grain Transfer Dock and wait until a customs officer confirms that a bulk pallet of corn meal is fully loaded on the robot. Once the pallet is on board, transport it to Silo Bay Alpha, Silo Bay Beta, and Silo Bay Gamma in that order, distributing the corn meal so Silo Bay Alpha receives five sacks, Silo Bay Beta gets five sacks, and the remainder—specifically two sacks—are delivered to Silo Bay Gamma, ensuring no sacks are left undelivered. At each silo bay, remain until a site manager confirms the sacks have been fully unloaded before continuing to the next destination. After completing all three deliveries, travel directly to the Cleaning Station and wait for four minutes to allow for decontamination procedures before returning to the Grain Transfer Dock for final inspection.

Begin at the Central Warehouse and pick up a batch of fifteen irrigation pipe kits designated for immediate distribution. Head first to Pump Station Delta and deliver five irrigation pipe kits; remain at Pump Station Delta until the supervisor there confirms removal of all five pipe kits. Once this initial drop-off is complete, proceed to Field Zeta Storage and unload another five irrigation pipe kits, but wait at Field Zeta Storage for ten minutes to allow the field crew to arrange existing supplies and prepare for transfer, then confirm that the five kits have been removed before leaving. With the final five pipe kits, make your way to the Equipment Dock at Silo Nine; ensure that you wait for dock personnel to finish previous unloading tasks, then authorize removal of the last five kits and stay until a dock operator verifies completion. Only after all fifteen pipe kits have been distributed and confirmations of removal are received at all three locations may you return to the Central Warehouse and await further dispatch instructions.

Begin at the Riverfront Loading Dock and wait until dock personnel have finished securing a pallet of 12 fertilizer bags onto the robot. Head to Field Alpha and deliver three fertilizer bags, waiting two minutes upon arrival to allow the field manager to clear a safe drop area, then confirm each bag has been removed before moving on. Next, proceed to Field Beta to deliver another four fertilizer bags, again pausing for two minutes and confirming each bag’s removal by the receiver. Continue to Field Gamma and distribute the last five fertilizer bags, assigning the extra bag here due to uneven division, and follow the same wait and confirmation process. Once all deliveries are complete, travel to the Equipment Wash Station and remain there for five minutes to undergo a cleaning protocol before reporting to the Ag Operations Control Room for your next set of instructions.

Begin your task at Field Supply Depot A by collecting 25 fertilizer canisters intended for distribution across several silos. Make your initial trip to Silo 1 and deliver exactly nine fertilizer canisters, then wait at Silo 1 until the silo manager visually confirms and authorizes the removal of those nine canisters. After this confirmation, proceed to Silo 2 with the next nine canisters, but before unloading at Silo 2, you must pause for three minutes at the adjacent safety inspection point to allow for routine decontamination; only after the three minutes have elapsed may you transfer the nine canisters to Silo 2 and wait until Silo 2 staff verify successful delivery. With the final seven fertilizer canisters, continue to Silo 3, deliver all remaining canisters, and remain on site until Silo 3 personnel provide an explicit signal indicating successful transfer to storage. Once you receive the confirmation from Silo 3, make your way back to Field Supply Depot A and wait in the service bay for further tasks.

Commence the mission at Maintenance Depot A by moving to Tool Storage Room 1, where you must wait until a maintenance toolkit is prepared for your platform; once the toolkit is loaded and ready, proceed immediately to Machine Line Red. At Machine Line Red, remain stationary until all technicians have finished removing and checking each item from the toolkit, which may take several minutes. When the technicians confirm the kit is empty, depart and travel to Spare Parts Warehouse West to collect a shipment of twelve high-wear replacement gears designated for distribution. Deliver these gears by allocating them as evenly as possible between three machinery repair stations: Repair Station Vista, Repair Station Summit, and Repair Station Ridge—with each station receiving four gears; if the shipment cannot be accepted in full at any station due to space limitations, deliver what can fit, then continue with the remainder to the other stations, looping back later to complete the deliveries as space becomes available. After every delivery action, pause for three minutes at the repair station to confirm receipt before moving to the next. Once all twelve gears have been accepted across the three repair stations, conclude the task by returning to Maintenance Depot A and waiting for further scheduling.

Proceed to Central Storage to acquire a shipment of eight spare hydraulic actuators, then transport the complete set directly to Assembly Line 4, pausing at the designated receiving area until the assembly supervisor verifies and removes exactly five actuators for immediate use. Once these five actuators are unloaded and accepted, continue with the remaining three actuators to Maintenance Workshop B; however, do not initiate the handover at Maintenance Workshop B unless the diagnostic report for faulty machine arm #7 has been officially logged—if the report is pending, remain outside Maintenance Workshop B for twelve minutes, then check again for the report’s status. After confirmation and complete transfer of the three actuators to Maintenance Workshop B, detour to Northern Parts Shelter and wait until the parts manager signals readiness to accept and remove an empty actuator crate before returning to Central Storage, ensuring that each phase is completed in sequence and no actuators are left aboard at any location.

Start at Fertilizer Depot 1 and collect nine nutrient canisters, ensuring all canisters are securely loaded onto the robot. Transport three canisters to Irrigation Hub Alpha; after arriving, wait exactly eight minutes to allow the hub’s intake system to finish its purge cycle before proceeding. Once the eight minutes have passed, wait for the irrigation staff to confirm removal of all three canisters, then head to Greenhouse Delta with another three canisters and deliver them to the greenhouse foreperson, waiting on site until the foreperson retrieves all canisters. After the transfer at Greenhouse Delta is complete, take the final three canisters to Crop Field Gamma; if Crop Field Gamma’s storage bay is occupied upon arrival, wait until it becomes available, then deliver the remaining canisters and wait to ensure complete unloading. After all nine canisters have been successfully delivered and removed from the robot at their respective locations, return immediately to Fertilizer Depot 1 for debriefing.

Begin your operation at the Central Loading Dock by picking up a batch of fourteen harvested produce containers. Travel first to Packing Station A and deliver exactly five produce containers, waiting until all five have been removed and logged by the station attendant before proceeding further. Next, continue to Packing Station B and allocate another five produce containers, but wait for a period of 3 minutes at this location to allow quality control personnel to perform an inspection of the payload before unloading. Once both packing stations have received their assigned containers and all necessary confirmations are complete, take the remaining four produce containers to Cold Storage Facility C, but initiate unloading only if both Packing Station A and Packing Station B have confirmed successful receipt of their respective deliveries. After transferring the final four containers at Cold Storage Facility C, promptly return to the Central Loading Dock to complete your route and await further instructions.

Begin operations at Maintenance Bay 3 and retrieve the designated set of replacement hydraulic hoses: Hose_Alpha, Hose_Beta, Hose_Gamma, Hose_Delta, and Hose_Epsilon. Deliver Hose_Alpha and Hose_Beta to Tractor Unit 09 in Field 7 South, but pause for exactly 7 minutes at Field 7 South after arrival to accommodate the technician’s ongoing safety briefing; once the briefing ends and the technician has collected both Hose_Alpha and Hose_Beta, immediately proceed to the Irrigation Pump Station. At the Irrigation Pump Station, hand over Hose_Gamma and Hose_Delta sequentially, making sure to wait until the maintenance supervisor has confirmed the installation of each hose—this may require intermittent waiting periods between hose handoffs. Finally, take Hose_Epsilon to the Equipment Storage Shed, but before entering the shed, wait an additional 5 minutes to allow other equipment to clear the access path. After all hoses have been accepted and signed off by the respective site personnel at each location, return directly to Maintenance Bay 3 and remain parked until the maintenance manager initiates the next assignment.

Start by proceeding to Seed Storage Facility Alpha to collect a batch of fifteen sealed seed canisters, ensuring all canisters are prepared and ready for safe transport before leaving. Distribute these canisters across three destinations as follows: deliver six canisters to Sowing Site West, five canisters to Sowing Site East, and four canisters to Sowing Site South; if there are any issues at a delivery point preventing offload, immediately bypass that destination and increase the allocation to the next scheduled site instead. After completing all seed canister deliveries, you must wait for a confirmation signal at the last drop-off location indicating that the field crew has successfully received and inventoried all items—remain onsite for three additional minutes after this signal to assist with setup verification. Only after this waiting period should you proceed to Fertilizer Mixing Station Beta to collect two fertilizer sample bags; if the bags are not yet prepared when you arrive, remain at Fertilizer Mixing Station Beta until notified that they are ready for transport. Finally, transfer both sample bags to Soil Laboratory Delta, but only depart after laboratory staff acknowledge acceptable condition of the samples, then return to Seed Storage Facility Alpha to complete your assignment.

Begin the mission by proceeding to Grain Elevator 5 and collect eight sealed seed crates once the elevator operations manager indicates they are ready for loading. Next, transport and unload three seed crates at the Western Planting Zone, then pause on-site for three minutes to allow the planting crew to verify receipt and sign off on inventory sheets. After this delay, continue to the Central Irrigation Control Shed to deliver two of the remaining seed crates, again waiting until a facility technician confirms that the seed crates have been removed from your payload. Upon completion of the second drop-off, proceed immediately to the North Greenhouse Loading Area with the final three seed crates. As soon as all three seed crates are offloaded, wait at the loading area until the site supervisor notifies you that all empty transport containers from your deliveries have been cleared from your storage compartment. Only after this notification has been received are you authorized to return directly to Grain Elevator 5 to conclude your route.

Start at the fertilizer storage bay and retrieve eight cartons of organic feed labeled 'Nutrient Blend A'. Your first destination is Field Section Alpha, where you will drop off three cartons and remain on site for two minutes to ensure the field manager confirms receipt. Then, transport the next three cartons to Field Section Beta, where you are required to wait until all three cartons have been removed by the planting crew before continuing. Finally, deliver the remaining two cartons to the machinery shed located beside the tractor garage; only proceed to close out your assignment and return to the fertilizer storage bay once a maintenance technician has collected both cartons and signaled completion of inventory processing. Each drop-off must be successfully completed in full at its designated location before starting the next delivery leg.

Begin at Maintenance Bay 2 and collect three spare drive belts from the parts locker, then proceed to Silo 5 on the western grain row where you must wait for the onsite technician to confirm the removal of one drive belt. After the first delivery is complete, continue to the Mill Workshop and deliver the remaining two drive belts, staying until both belts are unloaded by the workshop crew. Once all belts have been handed off, travel to the Refueling Station beside the field entrance, but before proceeding further, wait for five minutes to allow a scheduled fuel delivery to finish. Once the waiting period ends, make your way back to Maintenance Bay 2 to complete the circuit, ensuring each stop is visited in the correct sequence and that all waiting steps are observed before returning.

Begin your assignment at Receiving Dock Alpha, where you must wait until the four sealed pallets of wheat seed are fully loaded onto the robot; following confirmation of readiness, proceed first to Silo 5 and deliver one pallet there, staying at Silo 5 until its assigned pallet has been removed by the storage technician. After departing, continue on to Silo 11 and unload two pallets, remaining onsite until both are removed by authorized staff; once this drop-off is complete, wait for five minutes at Silo 11 to accommodate required inventory reconciliation activities. Next, transport the final pallet to the Seed Testing Laboratory Loading Bay, delivering it to lab personnel and waiting until the pallet is removed and acceptance is confirmed. Once all pallets have been distributed and the laboratory has taken possession, return immediately to Receiving Dock Alpha and wait there for eight minutes to allow for a debriefing session and a system log upload before ending your route.

Initiate operations at Maintenance Bay Alpha by retrieving eight fresh battery modules labeled for AgriDrone units. Transport these battery modules first to Charging Station South, where you must unload three modules and wait precisely five minutes for the charging cycle to start under technician supervision. After the wait period, continue to Field Sensor Node 14 and deliver two battery modules, remaining at the node until the on-site engineer completes the installation and signals readiness. Carry the remaining three battery modules to the Utility Equipment Storage Bunker, and stay at the bunker until all battery modules are confirmed removed from your payload by the storage clerk. Once all modules have been successfully distributed and verifications are complete at each location, return directly to Maintenance Bay Alpha to await your next set of delivery instructions.

Begin your mission at the Logistics Depot and pick up a pallet loaded with fifty-four sealed nutrient packs labeled for three remote crop plots. Travel first to Crop Plot Alpha and deliver eighteen sealed nutrient packs, then wait at Crop Plot Alpha for two minutes so that the farm staff can verify the delivery and sign off the receipt. Once the confirmation is obtained, continue to Crop Plot Beta and offload another set of eighteen sealed nutrient packs, remaining at Crop Plot Beta until sensors indicate that the bin is unloaded and empty. When the delivery at Crop Plot Beta is complete, proceed to Crop Plot Gamma with the remaining eighteen sealed nutrient packs and unload them for use in the greenhouse there. After all deliveries are verified and completed at all three plots, return to the Logistics Depot and remain stationed at the loading dock for four minutes to allow time for staff to inspect your cargo hold and complete dispatch documentation before you leave the area.

Start your assignment at Maintenance Bay B, where you are to collect a crate containing fifteen irrigation valve controls. After confirming the crate is ready, depart for the Southern Cropland Staging Area and wait until a local technician has removed five valve controls for immediate deployment. Once the initial batch is offloaded, travel to Northern Pump Station and deliver another five valve controls, remaining on-site until the technician completes the removal process. For the remaining five valve controls, continue to Field Operations Hub and wait there until the last set has been fully transferred. Following the completion of all deliveries, pause at Field Operations Hub for seven minutes to allow system diagnostics and to enable the hub manager to check the empty crate, before returning to Maintenance Bay B to conclude your mission.

Start at the Fertilizer Depot and load sixteen nutrient distribution canisters marked 'Spring Blend.' Proceed first to Field Plot North and deliver five canisters, ensuring that each canister is secured before continuing. Next, travel to the Greenhouse Annex and deliver another five canisters, pausing for three minutes after each transfer to allow greenhouse staff to integrate the nutrients into their irrigation system. After the Greenhouse Annex, take the remaining six canisters to the East Orchard; if the orchard manager signals that storage is full upon arrival, wait five minutes for space to be cleared before performing the delivery. When all canisters have been distributed, conclude your task by returning to the Fertilizer Depot and waiting in the loading area for the next assignment.

Begin at Maintenance Bay 4, where you are to retrieve a set of ten precision calibration sensors specifically designated for equipment in three separate production zones. Once you have confirmed that all ten calibration sensors are secured, transport four sensors directly to Robotics Assembly Line A, and remain at that location until the line supervisor has verified and removed all four sensors from your load. After this confirmation at Assembly Line A, proceed to Production Testing Chamber B with the next three calibration sensors; wait on site for three minutes to allow engineers adequate time to conduct a preliminary inspection of the sensors before departure. Once the timed wait has concluded in Chamber B, take the remaining three calibration sensors to Quality Assurance Station C, and do not leave until the quality team completes sensor removal and acknowledges full receipt. Only after all sensors have been successfully distributed and acknowledged at each destination, return immediately to Maintenance Bay 4 and remain there for five minutes to await any urgent recalibration requests before ending your route.

Begin by collecting nine containers of harvested tomatoes from the Processing Shed at the southwest corner of the farm complex. Transport and distribute these tomatoes to the Cold Storage Room, the Packing Station, and the Local Market Loading Dock, allocating three containers to each location for equitable delivery. Upon arrival at each destination, wait until the unloading crew confirms that the containers have been removed before departing to the next site. After the final delivery to the Local Market Loading Dock, remain at the dock for a period of five minutes to assist with possible overflow handling, and only then return to the Processing Shed to await further transport instructions.

Start your mission at the Central Supply Depot, where you are to collect a container filled with 19 sealed water filter cartridges needed for seasonal irrigation system maintenance. Travel first to Pump Station Delta and transfer 7 cartridges, making sure to wait at the unloading bay until a technician confirms all 7 cartridges have been removed and stored. Next, proceed to the Greenhouse Complex and deliver 6 more cartridges, but before you hand over the cartridges, wait for 5 minutes at the greenhouse entrance to allow on-site staff to prepare their workspace. Once the greenhouse crew is ready and all 6 cartridges are received, head to Irrigation Control Cabin E with the last 6 cartridges. At the cabin, wait until the operations manager verifies the complete removal of the final batch of cartridges. After all sites have received their designated cartridges and confirmation of receipt is obtained for each location, return the empty container to the Central Supply Depot and await further instructions.

Start at Maintenance Bay 4 and load five replacement filter cartridges designated for the Harvesters Fleet. Transport two filters to Field Harvester Alpha, parked at North Field Station, and wait nearby until the maintenance team has finished removing both cartridges from the robot. After confirming removal, drive to South Field Station with two more filter cartridges for Field Harvester Bravo; pause for 6 minutes before permitting drop-off to allow for ongoing calibration checks. Once both preceding deliveries have been completed and all four cartridges are confirmed as removed, bring the final filter to Workshop Storage Annex. If either North or South Field Station reports an incomplete cartridge removal, remain at Workshop Storage Annex and await confirmation from both field sites before releasing the last filter for storage. After all five filter cartridges have been delivered and verified, return to Maintenance Bay 4 for task debriefing.

Start by picking up a pallet containing twelve hydroponic nutrient tanks at Receiving Bay Two of the supply warehouse.
