Travel first to Field Plot Alpha and distribute four fertilizer bags, then wait until the field technician verifies all four bags are unloaded and arranged properly. After confirmation, proceed to Greenhouse Delta to deliver three additional fertilizer bags, and remain there for three minutes to allow greenhouse staff to inspect and record the delivery. Once the waiting period has elapsed and the three fertilizer bags have been confirmed as received, move on to Orchard Gate Bravo with the final two fertilizer bags. At Orchard Gate Bravo, transfer the last two fertilizer bags and wait for orchard crew acknowledgment of transfer. Only after successful handover at Orchard Gate Bravo, return to the Fertilizer Depot and signal task readiness for the next dispatch.

Commence at Harvest Collection Point Delta and collect a total of twenty-one fruit crates, ensuring that each crate is marked with its correct destination tag. First, deliver nine crates to Refrigeration Facility A, but once you arrive at Refrigeration Facility A, wait for the cold storage foreman to authorize unloading before any crates are removed. After confirmation and removal of the nine crates at Refrigeration Facility A, immediately proceed to Market Loading Dock East with eight additional crates, but do not begin unloading at Market Loading Dock East until three minutes have elapsed to accommodate the arrival of a shipment coordinator. Once the eight crates have been delivered and acknowledged at Market Loading Dock East, transport the final four crates to Process Bay 3 in the Canning Plant; however, the delivery at Process Bay 3 is contingent upon receiving confirmation that a sanitation protocol has been completed at Process Bay 3, which may only occur after you have finished the deliveries at the preceding two locations. When the four crates are removed at Process Bay 3, stay on site for an additional four minutes to await an inspection report before returning to Harvest Collection Point Delta to complete your shift.

Begin your mission at the Tool Inventory Room near the main facility entrance by collecting seven calibration wrenches earmarked for maintenance. Proceed first to the East Maintenance Bay and hand over two calibration wrenches to the engineer stationed at the tool drop-off counter, waiting until the engineer confirms the receipt of both wrenches. Next, navigate to the West Equipment Shed and deliver three calibration wrenches to the designated technician, remaining in place until all wrenches have been collected by the technician. For the remaining two calibration wrenches, travel to the North Field Mobile Workshop; if the workshop's service port is engaged upon arrival, pause and wait for five minutes before delivering the final two wrenches to the on-site supervisor. After all wrench deliveries have been confirmed at each respective location, move to the Charging Dock located in the northwest corner of the facility and wait for one minute before concluding your assignment.

Start your assignment at Maintenance Bay Alpha, where you will collect six replacement hydraulic actuators designated for critical equipment refresh. Transport two hydraulic actuators to Harvester Service Station 1, remain there while the chief mechanic offloads both actuators, and then wait an additional five minutes to allow for equipment recalibration before moving on. Next, proceed to Irrigation Pump House Delta and drop off another two hydraulic actuators; wait until the pump technician removes these two actuators from your payload before continuing. Deliver the final two hydraulic actuators to Sorting Facility Dock 3, but only depart once the operations supervisor has not only removed both actuators but also scanned each actuator’s barcode and provides verbal confirmation of receipt. After all hydraulic actuators have been delivered, removed, and the scheduled waits completed at each site, return directly to Maintenance Bay Alpha to upload system logs and check for urgent resupply tasks before concluding your mission.

Start at Maintenance Bay 5 in the equipment yard and collect twelve fresh hydraulic filter units from the supply rack. Transport four hydraulic filter units to Tractor 14 parked at Station Alpha, and wait by Tractor 14 until maintenance technicians have removed the old filters and are ready for installation. Once the transfer is confirmed, proceed with the next four hydraulic filter units to Combine Harvester 8 at Station Bravo, following the same waiting procedure until the payload is ready for pick-up. Deliver the last four hydraulic filter units to Sprayer Rig 21 at Station Charlie, but after technicians complete the swap, remain at Station Charlie for an additional ten minutes to monitor for any immediate part issues. When the ten-minute observation window concludes, return to Maintenance Bay 5 and stand by at the main entrance until the maintenance supervisor provides your next set of dispatch instructions.

Begin at Field Depot 1 and retrieve fifteen sealed soil sample canisters. Transport five canisters to Analysis Lab A, then wait for two minutes to allow the analyst to verify their integrity before depositing the shipment. Following confirmation, proceed to Analysis Lab B and deliver another five canisters; only unload these if you have received the verification from Lab A, otherwise remain at Lab B for up to five minutes for clearance, returning to Depot 1 if authorization is denied. After Lab B receives their allocation, transport the last five canisters to Analysis Lab C, but if Labs A or B have not verified their deliveries, you must wait outside Lab C in one-minute increments, up to six minutes, for instruction to proceed. Once all canisters have been successfully delivered or the time limits expire, return directly to Field Depot 1 and await further orders.

Start your assignment at Warehouse 7, where you will pick up a total of fourteen fertilizer packets designated for this morning’s delivery cycle. Proceed first to Greenhouse Alpha and drop off five fertilizer packets; after all five packets have been successfully removed and confirmed by the greenhouse supervisor, you are to continue to Crop Test Plot Beta with the next four packets. Upon arrival at Crop Test Plot Beta, distribute the four fertilizer packets and wait onsite until you receive confirmation that technicians have completed the transfer. Once this step is done, travel to the Hydroponics Lab and deliver the final five fertilizer packets. However, before departing from the Hydroponics Lab, remain at the location for seven minutes to allow researchers to inspect and log the new stock, as indicated by their protocol. After all fertilizer packets have been allocated and all required waiting periods are fulfilled at each destination, return directly to Warehouse 7 to conclude your delivery operation.

Start at Bulk Storage Depot West, where you are to collect nine sealed fertilizer drums destined for three distinct crop fields. Make your way first to Cornfield Zone A, unload three fertilizer drums, and remain onsite until Field Operator Lin confirms removal of each drum. After receiving clearance, proceed to Soybean Patch D with another three fertilizer drums; upon arrival, wait exactly four minutes before allowing the drums to be accessed, ensuring the planting crew has vacated the loading area. Once those drums are taken by the designated handler, continue to Wheat Plot 7 with the final three fertilizer drums, and do not release the drums until you receive verification from the site supervisor that prior deliveries at both Cornfield Zone A and Soybean Patch D are completed. After successfully distributing all nine drums, return promptly to Bulk Storage Depot West and wait for five minutes to cool down your lifting actuators before logging the end of your task sequence.

Start at the Machine Maintenance Bay and collect three diagnostic toolkits, confirming with the maintenance chief that they are each properly calibrated before leaving. Proceed first to Tractor Unit One parked at the East Field Entrance and deliver one diagnostic toolkit, waiting onsite until the repair technician confirms full removal. Next, go to Combiner Harvester Two located at the South Storage Shed to drop off the second diagnostic toolkit, again waiting until a technician removes the toolkit from the robot before moving on. The third diagnostic toolkit must be delivered to Seeder Cart Three positioned at the West Equipment Lot; after it is removed, remain at Seeder Cart Three for an additional 10 minutes to allow the engineering supervisor to run preliminary diagnostics. Only after this timed inspection concludes, return to the Machine Maintenance Bay and stand by for a new assignment, but do not report task completion until you have verified with each equipment team that their respective toolkits have been received and signed for.

Start at Maintenance Bay Alpha and collect eight battery packs from the charging rack. Deliver three battery packs to Machine Bay 1, waiting for the maintenance chief to remove and inspect each pack before proceeding to the next. After completing the delivery at Machine Bay 1, transport another three battery packs to Machine Bay 2, but wait precisely 7 minutes upon arrival at Machine Bay 2 before offloading the battery packs so the cooling systems can be prepped for installation. Once all three battery packs are handed off at Machine Bay 2, take the final two battery packs to the Emergency Power Shed; if either the shed is locked or the operations manager is unavailable, wait on site until both battery packs have been properly received and logged. After distributing all eight battery packs at their destinations, return to Maintenance Bay Alpha to complete your assignment.

Start at the Assembly Materials Warehouse and collect a total of fifteen motor component crates earmarked for redistribution. First, deliver five motor component crates to Assembly Line A, and stay at Assembly Line A until the line supervisor confirms removal of all five motor component crates from your platform. After this delivery is validated, proceed to Electrical Testing Bay with six motor component crates and unload them there, but do not depart until you receive acknowledgement from the bay attendant that all six motor component crates have been taken and documented for inspection. Finally, transport the remaining four motor component crates to the Component Storage Loft; once you have arrived, wait precisely three minutes—regardless of whether the crates have already been removed—to allow the storage team to prepare for the intake. After the three minutes have elapsed, verify with the storage team that all four motor component crates are unloaded before returning promptly to the Assembly Materials Warehouse and await further dispatch instructions.

Start at the Crop Processing Warehouse by picking up nine sacks of seed potatoes for field planting. Distribute these sacks between Field Alpha, Field Bravo, and Field Charlie as follows: Field Alpha is to receive four sacks, Field Bravo should receive three sacks, and Field Charlie will get the remaining two sacks, making certain that each field receives the exact designated quantity. After each delivery, remain at the respective field until you receive confirmation from the planting crew that the seed potatoes have been fully offloaded and are ready for planting, only then proceed to the next destination in the sequence Alpha, Bravo, then Charlie. Once the last sack is delivered to Field Charlie and offloading has been confirmed, head to the Equipment Washdown Station and pause operations for precisely five minutes to allow sanitation personnel to clean any residual dirt from the delivery robot before proceeding on any further assignments.

At the Tool Storage Bay, gather a collection of fourteen soil moisture sensors intended for deployment. Proceed first to Field Section Alpha and install five soil moisture sensors, remaining there until the site technician completes the calibration for all sensors. After the technician signals completion, travel to Field Section Beta and deploy another five soil moisture sensors, but wait at the edge of the crop rows for exactly eight minutes to enable environmental stabilization before installation. Allocate the final four soil moisture sensors to Field Section Gamma; wait outside the field gate until the field manager confirms that the sensor calibration process at Gamma is finished. Once all fourteen sensors have been properly installed and cleared at each section, return to the Tool Storage Bay and stand by for further instructions from the site supervisor.

Begin your mission at Maintenance Bay 3 and pick up two spare harvester blades along with a diagnostic toolkit. Head directly to Field Station Delta and deliver both harvester blades to the engineering crew stationed there, staying at Field Station Delta until both blades have been removed and signed off. Once the exchange is complete, proceed without delay to Silo 7 to hand over the diagnostic toolkit to the maintenance supervisor, and wait at Silo 7 for five minutes to allow the supervisor to inspect and confirm the arrival of the toolkit. After the confirmation period ends, return immediately to Maintenance Bay 3 and prepare the robot for the next scheduled servicing task.

Start at Central Grain Storage and retrieve a load of forty-three harvested corn sample bags. First, transport the entire load to Drying Facility Alpha and deposit sixteen corn sample bags into the intake bay, then wait by the intake station for three minutes while the grain moisture levels are evaluated and approved by the facility monitor. After approval, proceed with the remaining twenty-seven corn sample bags to Quality Sorting Room Delta, where you must deliver fourteen bags to the main sorting conveyor and wait until the sorting technician confirms that all fourteen bags have entered processing. Next, immediately bring the last thirteen corn sample bags to Laboratory B-7, depositing them into the specimen drop-off bin and remaining at the laboratory until staff finish scanning each bag's barcode and issue a receipt confirmation. Only once confirmation receipts from all three locations—Drying Facility Alpha, Quality Sorting Room Delta, and Laboratory B-7—have been received, may you return directly to Central Grain Storage and await the next assignment; if any receipt is delayed, stay at the most recent delivery location for five additional minutes before attempting to return again.

Begin at Storage Barn A and wait for the robotics technician to ready eight crop monitoring drones for deployment; after confirming the technician has secured all drones, transport the first three drones to Survey Grid Alpha and wait until the lead agronomist finishes unloading them. As soon as Survey Grid Alpha is completed, proceed to Survey Grid Beta to deliver another three drones, but pause for 7 minutes between deliveries to allow each grid manager to calibrate the equipment before drone removal. Deliver the remaining two drones to Survey Grid Gamma, and if any grid is still occupied with another operation upon arrival, wait for 5 additional minutes until the area is accessible before proceeding with unloading. Once all drones have been handed off and confirmation is received from each grid, return directly to Storage Barn A and remain there for 10 minutes to log deployment data and await further instructions.

Begin at Loading Dock 12 and collect fifteen sealed nutrient barrels designated for distribution. After confirming the cargo is secured, proceed to Field Zone Delta and deliver six nutrient barrels; remain at Field Zone Delta until the site supervisor verifies and removes all delivered barrels. Next, head directly to Greenhouse Complex B to offload five nutrient barrels, but do not initiate the unloading transfer until the greenhouse staff notify you that their receiving pallets are ready. Stand by at Greenhouse Complex B until every barrel is acknowledged as received and logged by staff, then continue to Livestock Feeding Station Alpha with the final four nutrient barrels. Deliver these four barrels to Station Alpha, and after the last barrel is removed, pause at the station for two minutes to allow sanitation staff to inspect the transport vehicle. Once inspection concludes and all delivery stations confirm receipt of their assigned barrels, return to Loading Dock 12 for debriefing, but only depart Station Alpha for your return after receiving explicit clearance from sanitation staff post-inspection.

Begin your mission at the Produce Packing Dock, where you will load fifteen crates of freshly harvested strawberries onto the robot. Your task is to allocate these fifteen crates among the Refrigerated Storage Facility, the South Market Loading Bay, and the Local Food Bank Depot. First, transport six strawberry crates to the Refrigerated Storage Facility and remain on-site until all six crates have been unloaded and inspected by cold storage staff, who will confirm completion before you continue. After that, proceed to the South Market Loading Bay, delivering five additional strawberry crates, and wait for two minutes at the loading bay for the market staff to finish initial inventory scanning before you move on. Carry the remaining four strawberry crates to the Local Food Bank Depot, ensuring that all four crates are acknowledged and removed upon arrival. Once all crates have been delivered and receipt at every destination is confirmed, return to the Produce Packing Dock and remain stationed there until the next assignment is available.

Start by proceeding to the Main Repair Depot to collect a shipment of fourteen replacement hydraulic filters, ensuring that all filters are securely loaded onto the robot. Next, travel to Field Machinery Station Alpha and deliver four hydraulic filters; wait until the maintenance engineer has completed unloading all four filters before you move on. After this, head to Tractor Bay Bravo where you will distribute another four hydraulic filters, but only begin the handover if you have previously received confirmation that Field Machinery Station Alpha has successfully retrieved its allocation. Upon completion, make your way to Combine Harvester Outpost and deliver the remaining six filters—because the on-site technician needs extra preparation time, wait for six minutes at Combine Harvester Outpost before allowing any filter removal to commence. Once the full set of fourteen filters has been removed and signed off at all three locations, complete your route by returning directly to the Main Repair Depot to report task completion.

Start your mission at the Central Tool Maintenance Bay and prepare to collect nine replacement hydraulic filters once they are ready for dispatch. After confirming that all nine filters are prepared, make your first trip to the Tractor Service Area and deliver four hydraulic filters, remaining there until the service manager verifies receipt of all four filters. Next, transport three of the remaining filters to the Orchard Equipment Garage and wait at the garage until a technician removes the filters from your payload. Finally, take the last two filters to the Irrigation Control Shed, pausing at the shed for five minutes after drop-off to allow staff to inspect and install the new filters. When all deliveries have been completed and the final waiting period has elapsed, return promptly to the Central Tool Maintenance Bay to conclude your assigned tasks.

Start at Field Operations Building 2 to collect a shipment of fourteen pest monitoring sensor units destined for installation across three monitoring outposts: Hilltop Station, Creekside Post, and Granary Lookout. Begin by transporting the entire shipment to Hilltop Station, where you must unload five sensor units and remain onsite until a technician confirms the transfer is complete. Following the confirmation, proceed to Creekside Post with the remaining nine sensor units; upon arrival, distribute exactly five sensors there, and impose a five-minute waiting interval to allow for sensor unpackaging and inventory confirmation. After this interval, move on to Granary Lookout carrying the last four sensors, but only initiate unloading once both previous outposts have sent confirmation of sensor intake; if either site has not yet confirmed, hold position at Granary Lookout until both acknowledgments are received, then deliver all four remaining sensor units as the final stage of the mission and report back to Field Operations Building 2 for further deployment instructions.

Start at the Central Maintenance Depot and wait there until the diagnostics engineer notifies you that the replacement gearbox unit is ready for transport. Once ready, take the replacement gearbox to Machine Station Delta, but do not deliver it immediately; instead, wait beside Machine Station Delta for 8 minutes to allow technicians to prepare the old unit for removal. After the 8-minute wait, present the replacement gearbox for removal and wait until it has been fully accepted by personnel. Only after confirmation of successful removal at Machine Station Delta, continue to Assembly Line Epsilon for a secondary delivery: collect two lubrication canisters, one from Storage Locker B and one from Storage Locker C, then deliver both canisters directly to Assembly Line Epsilon, pausing after each handover until a technician verifies their receipt. Once both lubrication canisters have been handed over and all receipts have been confirmed, return to the Central Maintenance Depot and await further instruction from the diagnostics engineer, ensuring all prior workflow dependencies are met before concluding your operation.

Start your operation at Grain Storage Facility A, where you will collect six sealed sacks of autumn wheat earmarked for local distribution. First, navigate to Flour Mill Loading Dock and deliver two wheat sacks, waiting on-site until both have been received and processed by dock personnel. After the dock confirms the payload removal, make your way to Bakery Delivery Bay, where you are to drop off another two sacks, not leaving the bay until the bakery staff signals that both sacks have been fully unloaded. For the final two wheat sacks, head to the Animal Feed Mixing Compound, but before initiating the handover, wait precisely three minutes to allow ongoing equipment cleaning. Once the waiting period has elapsed, deliver the last pair of sacks and confirm their removal by the feed technician. Only after all sacks are distributed and each removal has been verified should you return to Grain Storage Facility A to finalize your distribution route, ensuring no location is skipped and all time windows are strictly observed.

Begin at the Seed Storage Facility and pick up a container holding seven precision planting sensor modules. Bring three sensor modules to Corn Field Section Alpha, and wait on-site for five minutes while the field engineers perform initial calibration checks with the modules. After the five-minute interval, proceed to Soybean Plot Delta with another three sensor modules. Only deliver the modules to Soybean Plot Delta if all modules were confirmed as successfully handed over at Corn Field Section Alpha; wait until the staff there acknowledge complete receipt of the initial batch before departing. Finally, transport the last remaining sensor module to the Equipment Calibration Workshop. Once the calibration technician removes this sensor module from your container, immediately return the empty container to the Seed Storage Facility and await further deployment tasks.

Start at the Storage Dock and collect a total of ten seed crates, then transport them for distribution among Field Plot Alpha, Field Plot Beta, and Field Plot Delta, allocating three seed crates to each plot in the first round and delivering the remaining crate to Field Plot Delta as it requires additional seeding. After each delivery at a field plot, wait for the on-site supervisor at that plot to confirm receipt of the seed crates before continuing to the next location. When all deliveries are complete, proceed to the Farm Equipment Bay and wait there for 7 minutes to synchronize with the scheduled equipment refueling window before returning to the Storage Dock to confirm the distribution is finished.

Start at Maintenance Garage 2 and retrieve a set of nine diagnostic sensor modules assigned for installation in three distinct Greenhouse Units. Begin by transporting three sensor modules to Greenhouse Unit Alpha; after arriving, remain on site until greenhouse personnel confirm successful removal of all three modules for installation. Once Greenhouse Unit Alpha has verified complete retrieval, proceed to Greenhouse Unit Bravo and deliver another three sensor modules, waiting there for five minutes to accommodate environmental stabilization procedures before unloading. For the final three modules, advance to Greenhouse Unit Charlie; however, if either of the previous unit deliveries has not been marked as completed in the system logs, reroute to the Main Operations Office and pause for four minutes to resolve the delivery record discrepancies prior to attempting delivery to Greenhouse Unit Charlie. After all nine sensor modules have been properly distributed and confirmation is received from each greenhouses’ staff, return promptly to Maintenance Garage 2 for resupply and further task assignments.

Start your task at Maintenance Depot 2 by waiting until twelve battery packs are ready for deployment. Once loaded, navigate first to Irrigation Control Point Delta and deliver four battery packs, ensuring you wait until the site operator completes the removal and verifies each pack’s serial number. After confirming all four battery packs at Delta have been offloaded, proceed to Robotics Field Hub 7 with the next batch of four packs; however, upon arrival at Hub 7, pause for three minutes before unloading to allow the robotics team to finalize shutdown procedures, then remain at Hub 7 until all four battery packs are accepted and removed by the crew. Next, transport the final four battery packs to Solar Array Bay 1, but do not initiate the transfer until you have received clearance from the solar team leader—once clearance is provided, monitor the transfer and only leave after every pack has been collected from your cargo. Once all twelve battery packs have been properly distributed and removed at their respective destinations, return to Maintenance Depot 2, and upon arrival, wait an additional five minutes before accepting further instructions, even if new tasks become available during the wait period.

Start at the warehouse bulk storage and retrieve a set of ten irrigation valve controllers for scheduled field maintenance. Distribute the controllers evenly by delivering three each to Field Plot A, Field Plot B, and Field Plot C, making sure that each plot manager receives and removes their respective three controllers before proceeding to the next location. The remaining single controller should be delivered to the Field Supervisor’s Station to account for the allocation remainder. Between each delivery, insert a waiting period of four minutes at the location’s drop-off point to allow for documentation and equipment verification by the staff. After all controllers have been distributed, travel to the vehicle refueling station adjacent to Field Plot B and wait there for seven minutes to complete the energy recharge cycle before returning to the warehouse bulk storage area to stand by for additional maintenance tasks.

Begin at Storage Building Alpha with a pallet containing eighteen sacks of fertilizer, which must ultimately be supplied to the North Field Zone, East Field Zone, South Field Zone, and West Field Zone. First, proceed to the North Field Zone and drop off five sacks, then wait for the field sensor to confirm removal of the last sack before moving on. Next, head to the East Field Zone, where you must offload another five sacks; after delivery, remain idle at this location for 2 minutes to accommodate automated spreading initiation. Following the wait, deliver four additional sacks to the South Field Zone, ensuring that South's on-site receiver signals readiness before proceeding. Convey any remaining sacks—including the precise difference from dividing the initial batch—directly to the West Field Zone. Once the total of four sacks is received at the West location, wait for staff confirmation of full receipt, then return to Storage Building Alpha and do not depart again until a minimum of 6 minutes has passed, ensuring enough time for inventory reconciliation.

Begin your task at Harvest Dock 3, where you will pick up a crate containing thirteen sealed boxes of freshly picked tomatoes that need to be distributed among three cold storage units: Cold Storage East, Cold Storage West, and Cold Storage South. First, deliver four tomato boxes to Cold Storage East and wait at the loading bay for Cold Storage East’s attendant to signal that all four boxes have been safely stored before continuing. Next, proceed to Cold Storage West with another four tomato boxes; after unloading, remain at the unloading zone for 5 minutes to allow for temperature recalibration inside Cold Storage West. Upon completing this waiting period, drive to Cold Storage South, where you must drop off the final five tomato boxes—explicitly handling the extra box resulting from the division. Remain at Cold Storage South until their inventory manager confirms removal of all delivered boxes. Once confirmation is received from all three storages, promptly return to Harvest Dock 3 to await further instructions, staying idle for no less than 7 minutes to facilitate cleaning protocols.

Start by traveling to the Fertilizer Depot and secure a shipment containing 17 nutrient solution canisters, confirming with the site foreman that all canisters are present and sealed before departure. Next, distribute the canisters to three field storage locations: deposit 6 canisters at Field Shed Alpha, ensuring you remain at Field Shed Alpha until the shed attendant signals the area is prepared for unloading. Following this, take 6 more canisters to Field Shed Bravo, where you must wait for the field supervisor to clear a five-minute safety inspection interval before beginning the transfer. Deliver the last 5 canisters to Field Shed Charlie, but do not initiate the offload until a chemical safety check is completed and the all-clear is given by the remote monitoring system. Once deliveries to all three field sheds have been completed and each on-site verification is acknowledged, return to the Fertilizer Depot to report that the cycle is complete and await any further dispatch instructions, making note of any delivery remainders in your log before concluding operations.

Begin your shift at Garage Bay 4 by retrieving a shipment of twelve diagnostic sensor modules and verifying their integrity before departure. First, proceed to Maintenance Hangar A and deliver five sensor modules, waiting for three minutes after your arrival to allow the on-site engineers to complete equipment calibration before transferring any modules. Once all five modules have been successfully received at Maintenance Hangar A, continue to Equipment Staging Area 2 with another four sensor modules; if, upon arrival, Equipment Staging Area 2 is occupied or unavailable, detour immediately to Storage Enclosure X, deliver two modules there, then return to Staging Area 2 to complete the drop-off of the remaining sensor modules. The final three sensor modules must be evenly distributed among Greenhouse Control Shed, Operations Hub, and Water Pump Station 7 by delivering one module to each location in that order, making sure that each drop-off occurs only after confirmation that the previous location has accepted its module. As soon as all modules are delivered and acceptance is confirmed at every site, navigate back to Garage Bay 4 and remain parked for eight minutes to allow for system diagnostics and recharge before awaiting further instructions.

Begin your route at the Harvested Crop Depot and collect a shipment of thirty-six pre-packaged vegetable crates intended for distribution. Evenly allocate these crates among Storage Shed A, Storage Shed B, and the Distribution Center, ensuring that each site receives twelve crates; however, if any crates remain after equal distribution, transport all extra crates to the Overflow Refrigeration Facility to prevent spoilage. After completing the final drop-off at the Overflow Refrigeration Facility, proceed directly to Maintenance Bay 4. Wait at Maintenance Bay 4 until you receive a signal confirming that the cleaning crew has finished their mandatory sanitation process for arriving vehicles, and only then wait an additional seven minutes on-site so that technicians can perform a routine diagnostic check on your navigation system before you resume further deliveries for the day.

Proceed to the Seed Vault and retrieve a shipment of twenty-two nutrient seed packets marked for crop test plots. Distribute these seed packets such that Test Plot North receives eight seed packets, Test Plot East receives seven, and Test Plot South receives the remaining seven packets; explicitly verify with the corresponding agronomist at each plot that the full allocated number has been received before departing to the next plot. After making each delivery, wait for two minutes at the plot’s tool shed to allow laboratory personnel to collect grain samples for baseline data. Once all test plots have received and confirmed their allotments, return to the Seed Vault and remain at the intake docking bay until the logistics coordinator issues further routing instructions for the next planting cycle.

Start the task at Supply Bay 4 and proceed to Parts Depot Delta to pick up seven replacement hydraulic actuators designated for machinery maintenance. Transport the actuators to Maintenance Hub 1, where you will unload three of them and wait five minutes while the maintenance crew verifies the serial numbers before continuing. Next, carry two actuators to Workshop Gamma, delivering them and waiting for two minutes to allow for inspection by quality control staff. Take the remaining two actuators to Equipment Shed Theta, but if shed access is delayed due to ongoing repairs, wait until the crew signals that the unloading area is clear before proceeding. After all actuators have been delivered to their respective locations and every recipient has acknowledged removal, return to Supply Bay 4 and remain stationary for three minutes to complete inventory reconciliation before concluding the operation.

Initiate the operation at the north loading dock, where you will collect eight sealed containers of harvested blueberries, ensuring all containers are confirmed as ready for transport before departure. Once loaded, distribute three containers to the Fruit Processing Center, remaining there for four minutes to allow for unloading and quality inspections. After the required waiting period, proceed with two containers to the Cold Storage Facility and wait until cold storage personnel complete removal of both containers. The final three containers must be delivered to Packaging Bay Five; upon arrival, wait until the packaging supervisor signals that the bay is ready and all three containers are removed from the robot. Only after all blueberry containers have been delivered to their assigned destinations, removed, and all waiting steps fulfilled, return directly to the north loading dock to signal task completion and stand by for further instructions.

Start at the Southeast Maintenance Bay where you will be assigned eight replacement air filters designated for distribution across the Engine Assembly Line, the Testing Lab, the Packing Facility, and the Parts Storage Vault. Move first to the Engine Assembly Line and deliver three air filters; remain at the line until the lead engineer confirms that all three filters have been properly installed. Next, proceed to the Testing Lab and drop off two filters, waiting until lab personnel verify their receipt and installation. Continue to the Packing Facility to deliver another two filters and wait until the on-site supervisor approves the completed drop-off. Transport the one remaining filter to the Parts Storage Vault, and after confirmation by inventory staff that the filter has been stored, wait for seven minutes at the Parts Storage Vault for any urgent reallocation requests from the facility staff. Once the waiting period concludes and you confirm there are no extra filters, return directly to the Southeast Maintenance Bay to end your distribution shift.

Begin at the Grains Storage Silo and retrieve a shipment crate containing 22 processed grain sacks designated for three distribution points. Transport the entire crate to Distribution Point A and allocate 7 grain sacks to the local staff, pausing until all 7 sacks have been fully removed by the receiving team. Next, proceed to Distribution Point B with the remaining 15 grain sacks, where you will distribute 8 more sacks and wait for the on-site supervisor to finish unloading and log each sack into the inventory. After the confirmation at Distribution Point B, continue to Rural Outpost C carrying the last 7 grain sacks; upon arrival, remain at the outpost for a duration of 6 minutes while the rural operations crew completes both sack removal and intake documentation. Once every sack is accounted for at Rural Outpost C, navigate back to the Grains Storage Silo and stand by until instructions for new assignments are broadcast.

Begin the operation at the Bulk Fertilizer Warehouse, where you must load nine sealed fertilizer bags onto the robot. Your task is to distribute these nine fertilizer bags among the West Orchard Silo, the Central Equipment Shed, and the East Greenhouse in such a way that each location receives an equal number, and the Central Equipment Shed receives any extra if the division is uneven. First, deliver three fertilizer bags to the West Orchard Silo and wait until the orchard supervisor confirms that all three bags have been unloaded. Following the confirmation, proceed to the Central Equipment Shed with three additional fertilizer bags and remain until the maintenance technician has finished removing all three bags from the robot. Next, head to the East Greenhouse and deliver the remaining three fertilizer bags, retaining your position until the greenhouse operator acknowledges the complete removal. As soon as all nine bags have been successfully delivered and accounted for at their respective locations, return to the Bulk Fertilizer Warehouse and stay there for five minutes before concluding the mission.

Start by retrieving four diagnostic sensor modules from the Electronics Inventory Room, making sure each module is accounted for before proceeding. Your first destination is Greenhouse Alpha, where you will deliver one sensor module and remain until the greenhouse tech signals that installation is complete—a process that typically takes five minutes, during which you must wait on site. After this confirmation, take two modules to Field Control Shed Zeta, but only transfer the first sensor module immediately; after the first transfer, pause at Shed Zeta for six minutes to allow for system calibration before handing over the second sensor module to the shed supervisor. Once both modules have been successfully delivered at Shed Zeta, transport the remaining sensor module to the Central Data Hub, but only do so if the earlier deliveries at Greenhouse Alpha and Shed Zeta are both verified as completed; should any delivery fail, retain the last sensor module and return it directly to the Electronics Inventory Room for safekeeping. At each delivery point, wait for the site operator to confirm module readiness or completion before moving to the next location. Once all scheduled deliveries and acknowledgements are finalized, return to your Charging Dock and remain idle for ten minutes to complete your internal diagnostics before accepting a subsequent task.

Begin your route at the Assembly Parts Depot to gather a shipment of thirty-seven hydraulic seal kits earmarked for three production lines. Once you have received and confirmed all thirty-seven seal kits, deliver fifteen kits to Production Line Blue, eight kits to Production Line Green, and allocate the remaining fourteen kits to Production Line Orange, ensuring no seal kits are misallocated during transit. After dropping off the kits at each production line, remain onsite for four minutes so that a line operator can examine and validate the delivery before proceeding to the next destination. If any validation is not completed within four minutes, wait an additional two minutes at that production line before moving on. After all deliveries and validations are successfully completed, travel to the Mobile Robot Charging Station and stay there for five minutes to recharge before starting your next sequence of tasks.

Begin at Receiving Dock 2 and wait for the set of nine nutrient injector canisters to be fully loaded onto your cargo compartment. Once you have verified all canisters are secured, proceed to Fertilizer Storage Shed and deposit three canisters, making sure that each is removed and logged by the attendant before leaving the location. Next, travel to Irrigation Pump House Delta to deliver another three canisters; after these are received, pause at Pump House Delta for eight minutes to allow the pump technicians to perform a preliminary system flush. When the time has elapsed and confirmation of successful delivery is received from Fertilizer Storage Shed and Pump House Delta, continue to Crop Enhancement Lab Annex with the final three canisters. If the Crop Enhancement Lab Annex staff are not present upon your arrival, remain at the entry area and wait until the lab team is ready to offload the canisters. Only after all nine nutrient injector canisters have been documented as received at their respective sites should you return directly to Receiving Dock 2 for unloading procedures.

Begin your mission at the Seed Storage Facility by waiting until a batch of 13 advanced seed canisters designated for experimental planting is prepared and released by the inventory manager. Once the canisters are ready, transport 4 seed canisters to Greenhouse A, remaining at Greenhouse A until the horticulture technician confirms that all 4 canisters have been unloaded from your cargo platform. Immediately after, make your way to Greenhouse B to deliver 5 more seed canisters; after offloading, pause at Greenhouse B for a two-minute inspection period while the automation specialist calibrates the seed dispensers with the new canisters. Following this wait, proceed to Greenhouse C to deposit the final 4 seed canisters, then stay at Greenhouse C until every canister has been collected by the research staff. Only after all seed canisters have been successfully delivered and confirmed at their respective greenhouses, travel to the Logistics Coordination Office. Upon arrival at the office, wait for eight minutes so the administrative team can enter the transfer records and authorize your next assignment, then return to your initial position at the Seed Storage Facility to await future tasks.

Start at Storage Bay 1 and retrieve twelve chemical sprayer units, confirming with the supply officer that all units are loaded and secured. Transport these sprayer units to Field Control Station Alpha and wait until the field supervisor verifies the payload is authorized for deployment. Once verification is complete, distribute the twelve sprayer units across Field Plot Red, Field Plot Blue, and Field Plot Green. Deliver five sprayer units to Field Plot Red, four units to Field Plot Blue, and the remaining three units to Field Plot Green, visiting each plot in sequence and waiting at each stop until an agronomist has fully removed the designated number of sprayer units. After the last delivery at Field Plot Green, proceed to Refueling Station Omega and remain there for seven minutes to complete a mandatory equipment reset before returning directly to Storage Bay 1 for end-of-operation procedures.

Begin your route at the Seed Inventory Room, where you must wait until the batch labeled Hybrid Seed Lot 42B is loaded onto the robot. Depart to Sowing Field A and deliver four of the twelve seed packets, remaining onsite until the field manager has removed all four packets. Then travel to Sowing Field B with five seed packets and again wait until they are collected by the field crew. For the remaining three seed packets, proceed to Sowing Field C; if at any prior destination fewer packets were accepted, ensure that Sowing Field C receives the remaining balance. At each field, after all seed packets are removed, you must pause for 90 seconds to allow for inventory reconciliation before heading to the next location. Once all twelve seed packets have been distributed and the final pause at Sowing Field C is complete, return to the Seed Inventory Room and wait outside for two minutes to allow your wheels to be inspected for contaminant seeds before reentering the storage area.

Begin by moving to the North Storage Dock to pick up a set of twenty specialized irrigation valves intended for distribution to different field locations. First, travel to Irrigation Control Station Alpha and deliver eight irrigation valves there, remaining on site until the station engineer confirms each valve has been checked for compatibility. Next, proceed to Pump Station Bravo with seven irrigation valves, and after arrival, wait for three minutes before starting unloading, allowing the crew to clear the installation area. Once this three-minute interval has elapsed, hand off the valves and do not leave until they have been removed by the pump station staff. With the remaining five irrigation valves, make your way to Field Operations Shed Delta; deposit four of them and pause for ninety seconds while the field technician verifies that the inventory matches the manifest. Finally, deliver the last irrigation valve to Maintenance Workshop Echo and do not depart until the valve has been retrieved directly from the payload compartment by the senior mechanic. Once all irrigation valves have been delivered to their proper destinations and every required waiting period has concluded, return to the North Storage Dock and await further deployment instructions for two minutes before considering the mission complete.

Start by traveling to Seed Storage Facility West to receive a total of thirteen labeled seed packets from the storage attendant. Once the seed packets are secured, divide them as evenly as possible between three different planting sites: deliver four seed packets to Orchard Block 1, five to Grain Field 7, and four to Vegetable Plot Delta; if an uneven allocation occurs, ensure Grain Field 7 is assigned the extra packet. Upon arrival at each destination, only transfer seed packets after the respective planting supervisor at Orchard Block 1, Grain Field 7, or Vegetable Plot Delta signals that their automated planters are ready to accept new seeds. Between each delivery, require a mandatory wait period of two minutes after departing each plot before navigating to the next destination to avoid disrupting ongoing field work. Once all seed packets are distributed and each site supervisor has acknowledged receipt, return to Seed Storage Facility West and remain on standby for a period of five minutes before accepting any subsequent tasks, ensuring all field communications are fully logged.

Start at the seed storage facility and retrieve a total of twenty-four irrigation pipe segments. Deliver eight pipe segments each to Field Zone Alpha and Field Zone Beta, but if there are any leftover segments after dividing between the two, transport all remaining segments to Field Zone Gamma, where field engineers will handle excess distribution onsite. After completing the deliveries to all three fields, move to the equipment maintenance shed and wait for exactly seven minutes to allow the mechanics to prepare the drip nozzle set. Only when the seven-minute waiting period concludes and you receive confirmation that the drip nozzle set is ready should you collect the nozzle set from the maintenance shed and return with it to the seed storage facility for secure storage.

Start at the Seed Inventory Building and load eight sealed seed crates onto the robot, ensuring all crates are clearly labeled. Navigate first to the Storage Shed at Field Alpha, where you will unload three seed crates and wait until the shed supervisor confirms all crates are placed inside. Next, deliver another three seed crates to the Greenhouse Loading Dock and pause there for 6 minutes to allow the greenhouse staff time to inspect the crate contents. Finally, transport the remaining two seed crates to the Orchard Equipment Station, where you must wait for all seed crates to be removed by the station manager before departing. Once the last seed crate has been removed, proceed directly to the Fueling Area and wait there for 10 minutes to allow for a potential refueling operation before returning to the Seed Inventory Building to complete the mission.

Start by collecting eight diagnostic toolkits from the Equipment Inventory Room, verifying that each toolkit is fully calibrated. Proceed to Maintenance Bay Alpha and deliver three toolkits, remaining on site until the lead technician at Maintenance Bay Alpha has acknowledged receipt and removed all three toolkits. After this delivery is complete, continue to Manufacturing Line B to deliver another three toolkits, but before permitting removal, wait exactly four minutes to accommodate the shift supervisor’s safety inspection; if the inspection is delayed, you may extend the wait by two additional minutes, but do not exceed this period. Once all toolkits there have been handed over, transport the final two toolkits to Quality Control Station 7, where you must wait until the station supervisor is present and confirms readiness before toolkit removal proceeds. After all toolkits have been delivered and all acknowledgments secured from each location, return any empty containers back to the Equipment Inventory Room. Conclude your operation by heading to the Vehicle Maintenance Shed and remain stationary there for five minutes to complete a mandatory diagnostic systems check before powering down.

Start at the Loading Dock and wait until the set of twelve diagnostic toolkits is confirmed as ready for collection by the maintenance supervisor. Once the toolkits are loaded onto your payload compartment, deliver them in specified quantities to three different destinations: bring five toolkits to Maintenance Bay 1, four toolkits to Maintenance Bay 2, and allocate the remaining three toolkits to Maintenance Bay 3, explicitly ensuring that any leftover toolkits not divisible by three are assigned to Maintenance Bay 3. After you have dropped off the toolkits at each maintenance bay, remain onsite for exactly three minutes at each stop to allow the onsite technicians to perform an inventory check and acknowledge the receipt of the toolkits before moving to the next destination. Following the completion of all deliveries and verifications, return immediately to the Loading Dock and wait an additional four minutes before your deployment instructions are considered fulfilled.

Begin at the Logistics Docking Bay where you must retrieve six sealed seed crates intended for controlled distribution across multiple agricultural zones. Transport the seed crates first to Storage Silo 4 and distribute two seed crates to the silo supervisor, ensuring all two seed crates are fully removed before proceeding. Next, once the Storage Silo 4 drop-off is complete, bring two of the remaining seed crates to Irrigation Control Center 1, but wait for three full minutes outside the entrance after arriving to allow the irrigation team to complete their contamination protocols before delivering the seed crates. Only after both previous deliveries are completed, proceed with the final two seed crates to Remote Field Node-C and remain there until all crates are offloaded by the field technician, even if this process takes several minutes. Upon placing all seed crates, immediately return to the Logistics Docking Bay and do not leave your post until a supervisor confirms completion of post-delivery checks, which may require up to four additional minutes of waiting.

Start by collecting a total of fifteen sealed water sampling containers from the Supply Depot adjacent to the south entrance. Distribute these containers evenly among Field Station Alpha, Field Station Bravo, and Field Station Charlie such that each location receives five containers. At each Field Station, remain on site until the on-duty technician verifies and removes all delivered containers before proceeding to the next drop-off point; if a technician is delayed at any location, wait an additional four minutes for container removal before moving on. Once all stations have received their containers and each removal has been acknowledged or timed out, navigate to the central Data Collection Hub, and remain docked there for six minutes to allow data transfer personnel time to download route logs from your system before resuming any further assignments.

Start at the Equipment Maintenance Bay and wait until the replacement hydraulic pump labeled Pump-Alpha is mounted onto the robot. Proceed directly to Field Irrigation Station 7, where you must wait for staff to remove Pump-Alpha and provide verbal confirmation of receipt. Only after this confirmation, travel to Storage Shed D, wait exactly 120 seconds while technician Adewale readies Valve-Gamma, and then receive Valve-Gamma onto the robot. After Valve-Gamma is secured, make your way to Greenhouse Complex 2 and deliver Valve-Gamma, remaining on-site until the greenhouse supervisor has removed the part and given sign-off. Upon successful delivery to both Irrigation Station 7 and Greenhouse Complex 2, return to the Equipment Maintenance Bay even if there were any delays, and wait for further instructions before powering down.

Begin at Seed Repository Room A and load a shipment of 19 high-yield corn seed packets designated for field deployment. Distribute these seed packets across Growth Plot Alpha, Irrigation Test Zone C, and Experimental Terrace E so that Growth Plot Alpha receives 7 seed packets, Irrigation Test Zone C receives 6 seed packets, and Experimental Terrace E receives the remaining 6. Wait for the plot manager at each delivery location to confirm removal of all seed packets before departing to the next destination. Following distribution, proceed to Equipment Recharge Station 4 and wait seven minutes to allow for recharging cycles; only after the recharge period is complete, continue to Pesticide Containment Shed to await further assignment. If at any delivery point the removal of seed packets is delayed for more than five minutes, remain at that location until confirmation is given, even if it extends the schedule for subsequent deliveries.

Start by navigating to Storage Warehouse 2 and collecting a total of 29 irrigation valves. Deliver these valves in three batches: 12 valves to the South Orchard Pump Station, 9 valves to the East Vine Tomato Beds Intake, and the remaining 8 valves to the North Field Outflow Control. After delivering each batch, pause for 7 minutes at the location to allow on-site technicians to verify the valve installation sites are cleared and ready; do not depart until the wait period has elapsed. Once all deliveries and waiting periods are completed, proceed to the Central Workshop and stand by for maintenance checks before new assignments are given.

Initiate your mission at Storage Dock Delta by preparing to move a shipment containing fifteen fertilizer canisters, which need to be divided among Field Plot A, Field Plot B, and Field Plot C. Evenly allocate five canisters to each field; however, if due to future batch changes there are any canisters left after the initial distribution, deliver any remaining canisters to Field Plot B as a contingency. For each delivery, after reaching a given field plot, pause and wait until the field supervisor confirms that the fertilizer canisters are ready to be offloaded. Once each field plot’s allocation is confirmed and offloading commences, wait for exactly three minutes at a designated shade shelter before proceeding to the next plot, to allow workers to clear the area and prepare safely. After all fertilizer canisters have been successfully delivered and accounted for at each plot, make a final stop at Logistic Center East to confirm delivery records before returning to Storage Dock Delta to conclude your route.

Start your mission at the Fertilizer Warehouse and collect a batch of ten standard nutrient canisters, making sure all ten nutrient canisters are secured before proceeding. Transport your first load to Crop Field West and deliver four nutrient canisters directly to the field manager; remain there until all four nutrient canisters have been validated and accepted by the manager. Next, continue to Crop Field East to supply three nutrient canisters, but do not unload them until crop workers at Crop Field East indicate readiness—wait at the delivery point as long as necessary for the signal before transferring all three nutrient canisters. Once delivery at Crop Field East is completed, proceed to Crop Field South and prepare to deliver the remaining three nutrient canisters; however, you must wait at Crop Field South for exactly five minutes before initiating the drop-off to ensure proper personnel are present, then complete the handover of all three nutrient canisters. After all ten nutrient canisters have been distributed and acknowledged at their respective fields, report to the Farm Supervisor’s Office, pause for an additional two minutes for post-distribution confirmation, and, following this wait, return to the Fertilizer Warehouse to complete your operational sequence.

Start at the equipment locker adjacent to Machine Shop 2 and collect five replacement sensor modules. Proceed first to Autonomous Tractor Bay A, deliver one sensor module, and wait until the maintenance technician confirms removal before continuing. Next, head to Drone Pad B to deliver two sensor modules, but before offloading, wait for five minutes to allow the drone teams to complete their pre-inspection safety protocols. After the timed wait and completion of the transfer at Drone Pad B, continue to Silo Monitoring Tower where you will deliver another two sensor modules; if the technician at Autonomous Tractor Bay A reported any issues with module fitting, skip the Silo Monitoring Tower delivery and instead return to Machine Shop 2 with any undelivered sensor modules for diagnostics. For every location where a delivery was made, wait for explicit confirmation that the old sensor modules have been removed before departing. Once all modules are either distributed or returned for diagnostics as per the specified conditions, finish your route by returning to the equipment locker and remain there for twelve minutes in standby for any further urgent maintenance requests.

Begin your route at the Central Orchard Depot, retrieving fifteen soil nutrient probe kits destined for deployment at three distinct orchard zones: Apple Section North, Peach Section East, and Cherry Section West. First, proceed to Apple Section North to deliver seven probe kits and remain there, waiting until the orchard engineer has removed and confirmed all seven are accounted for before you continue. Once the probes have all been picked up at Apple Section North, drive to Peach Section East to deliver the next four probe kits, again waiting for the removal confirmation from the section supervisor. The final four probe kits are to be brought to Cherry Section West, and after the supervisor has retrieved all four, remain on site for six minutes to ensure instrument initialization procedures are fully completed. Following this time-controlled step, continue to the Southwest Equipment Diagnostics Bay for a post-delivery function test as the closing action of your mission.

Start at the Central Tool Locker and pick up a set of 15 precision calibration kits labeled for the quarterly equipment maintenance. First, transport five calibration kits to Maintenance Bay A, and remain at that location until the head technician signals that all five kits have been successfully retrieved. Next, proceed to Workshop B to deliver another five calibration kits; if Workshop B staff indicate that fewer than five kits are needed, immediately return the extra calibration kits to the Central Tool Locker before continuing. Then, carry the remaining calibration kits to Quality Control Lab C, and wait for a period of seven minutes after arrival to allow the lab engineers time to check and accept the kits before any are handled. Only after both Maintenance Bay A and Workshop B have either received or definitively declined their allotted calibration kits should you leave Quality Control Lab C. Once the Quality Control Lab confirms acceptance or specifies the need for fewer kits—returning any surplus to the Central Tool Locker if necessary—proceed back to the Central Tool Locker and stay for two minutes as a standby precaution before concluding the maintenance supply route.

Start by proceeding to the Grain Storage Facility to collect fifteen sealed grain sample containers, ensuring each container is properly labeled by the quality control officer. After verifying all fifteen grain sample containers are secured, deliver five containers to the Laboratory Testing Center; remain there until laboratory staff have removed every container and acknowledged receipt. Next, take another five grain sample containers to the Research Greenhouse, but only begin unloading after waiting five minutes at the Research Greenhouse entrance to allow the environmental decontamination system to complete its cycle. Once the Research Greenhouse staff have collected their allocated containers, transport the remaining five grain sample containers to the Regional Regulatory Office; do not initiate unloading until the regulatory supervisor has signaled that the documentation checks are finished. Following the successful transfer at the Regional Regulatory Office, return directly to the Grain Storage Facility and standby for further instructions from operations management.

Start the shift at Loading Dock 4 by verifying that a total of seven harvested grape crates are ready for transportation. Once the grape crates are confirmed, your assignment is to shuttle them to three distinct locations: deliver two grape crates to Fermentation Room A, another two grape crates to Testing Lab 1, and the remaining three grape crates to the Cold Storage Facility. Begin by transporting two grape crates to Fermentation Room A and remain there until the winery staff has fully removed both crates from your cargo bed. After both crates have been unloaded, proceed to Testing Lab 1 with the next two grape crates, waiting on-site while the lab technician receives and removes each crate. Upon successful transfer at the lab, continue to the Cold Storage Facility carrying the final three grape crates, making sure to wait for the storage supervisor to acknowledge the unloading of all three crates. If, at any point during a drop-off, staff are delayed, wait up to ten minutes before proceeding to the next destination. Once all seven grape crates have been distributed, return to Loading Dock 4 and perform a five-minute idle period as a systems cooldown before ending the assignment.

Proceed to the Part Storage Warehouse and load three replacement hydraulic actuators and two diagnostic toolkits. Once all payloads are secured, head directly to Maintenance Bay 1 and await confirmation from the bay mechanic that the faulty actuator at Maintenance Bay 1 has been fully removed before delivering one hydraulic actuator and one toolkit. Next, transfer one hydraulic actuator and the remaining toolkit to Maintenance Bay 2; upon arrival at Maintenance Bay 2, wait for seven minutes to allow for system de-energization before the mechanic signals readiness for the actuator swap. Finally, bring the last hydraulic actuator to Maintenance Bay 3, but before offloading, verify with the maintenance supervisor that both prior bays have reported completion; only then should you hand over the actuator at Maintenance Bay 3, after which you must return any unused packaging to the Part Storage Warehouse to complete your route.

Begin at Shipping Dock Delta and collect a batch of ten sealed coolant canisters intended for machinery upkeep; transport three coolant canisters to Assembly Line 7 and wait until an engineer has finished retrieving them. After the canisters have been removed from Assembly Line 7, proceed immediately to Quality Control Zone A to deliver another three coolant canisters, remaining on site for five minutes so that safety inspectors have sufficient time to log the delivery and verify canister integrity. Next, carry the final four coolant canisters to Maintenance Hub North, but only await removal of these remaining canisters if a notification is received that the Maintenance Supervisor is present; should the supervisor not be present within four minutes of your arrival, return all undelivered canisters to Shipping Dock Delta. Once all coolant canisters have either been dropped off or returned, continue to Central Communications Station and stand by for three minutes to synchronize delivery logs before completing the assignment.

Begin at Maintenance Bay 1 and collect a total of fifteen spare hydraulic hoses designated for three different repair sites: Repair Site Alpha, Field Equipment Shed Bravo, and Tractor Garage Zulu. Deliver five hydraulic hoses to Repair Site Alpha first, and wait at the site until the on-site technician has finished removing all five hoses from the robot before proceeding. After this, continue to Field Equipment Shed Bravo and deposit another five hoses there; remain at the shed for a minimum of six minutes to allow the maintenance crew to inspect and confirm the hose delivery. Once the pause at Field Equipment Shed Bravo is complete, transport the final batch of five hydraulic hoses to Tractor Garage Zulu. Do not leave Tractor Garage Zulu until the supervisor notifies that the hoses have been fully transferred. Only after all fifteen hoses are delivered and confirmation has been received at all sites, return empty to Maintenance Bay 1 to await further dispatch instructions.

Begin at the Central Storage Hall and collect a total of 29 bags of fertilizer, ensuring each bag is loaded securely for transport. Proceed to distribute these bags among Orchard Plot East, Orchard Plot West, and Orchard Plot South, allocating 10 bags each to Orchard Plot East and Orchard Plot West, and delivering the remaining 9 bags to Orchard Plot South so that all fertilizer bags are utilized. At each orchard plot, after unloading the assigned fertilizer bags, wait 6 minutes at that location to allow the agricultural staff to perform quality inspections on the delivery before moving on to the next plot. Once every bag of fertilizer has been successfully offloaded and all inspection periods have elapsed at Orchard Plot East, Orchard Plot West, and Orchard Plot South, return to Central Storage Hall and await the supervisor’s confirmation for the next task cycle.

Initiate the operation by traveling to the Main Storage Hangar and wait until six maintenance tool kits are confirmed ready for dispatch. Once the tool kits are prepared, take three of the tool kits and proceed to Machine Bay Alpha, where you must wait for the technician to remove all three tool kits from your payload before continuing. Next, collect the remaining three tool kits from Main Storage Hangar and deliver two of these tool kits to Machine Bay Beta, awaiting confirmation that both have been removed by the assigned engineer. Finally, take the last remaining tool kit from Main Storage Hangar directly to Maintenance Workshop One, and after ensuring the last tool kit has been removed by the supervisor, wait at Maintenance Workshop One for five minutes to provide standby assistance for immediate follow-up tasks before returning to Main Storage Hangar for new instructions.

Start at the Maintenance Depot and wait for the technician to load a shipment of nine sealed engine filter cartridges onto the robot. Once the loading is complete, travel first to Machine Bay Delta to deliver three engine filter cartridges, staying at the bay until all three cartridges have been removed and logged by the maintenance crew. Afterward, proceed directly to Machine Bay Echo and distribute another three engine filter cartridges, remaining at the site for five minutes to allow the maintenance staff time to inspect and install the cartridges. Then, continue to Machine Bay Foxtrot with the remaining three engine filter cartridges and wait until the crew there has verified and removed the final batch. Only after all cartridges have been fully distributed and acknowledged at each machine bay should you conclude by returning to the Maintenance Depot for the next maintenance cycle briefing.

Begin at Storage Warehouse B and load twelve sealed crates labeled 'Component-X' intended for different production zones. Navigate first to Assembly Line 2 and leave five of the Component-X crates with the station supervisor; only after receiving confirmation that Assembly Line 2 has fully received all five crates, proceed to Quality Control Bay. At Quality Control Bay, offload another four Component-X crates, but pause for six minutes to allow the inspection protocols to run on those crates before moving forward. Once inspection at Quality Control Bay is cleared, deliver the final three Component-X crates to Final Packaging Dock, but if the dock is currently occupied, remain on standby at the dock until the area is free and then hand over all remaining crates. After each batch of Component-X crates is verified as received at its respective destination, and all specified wait times and conditions have been met, return directly to Storage Warehouse B and await further assignment.

Begin your task at Loading Dock 2 and collect eleven feed bags designated for livestock distribution. Transport three feed bags to Dairy Barn Alpha first, ensuring that you wait until the barn supervisor confirms all three bags have been unloaded before moving on. Next, deliver four feed bags to Equine Stable B and remain at Equine Stable B for 120 seconds after the last bag has been removed to allow staff to arrange storage. Once the wait at Equine Stable B is complete, bring another three feed bags to Poultry Coop 7 and only proceed once a designated poultry technician has signaled that these feed bags have been received. The eleventh feed bag must be delivered to Maintenance Bay C: you should not begin this final delivery until you have received acknowledgements from Dairy Barn Alpha, Equine Stable B, and Poultry Coop 7 confirming all their feed allocations have been fulfilled. After the final handoff at Maintenance Bay C, return to Loading Dock 2 and wait there for 60 seconds to complete post-distribution logging before ending your route.

Start your mission by proceeding to Raw Materials Depot Alpha and retrieving nine sealed seed containers intended for field deployment. Transport four seed containers to Irrigation Zone C and remain there until all four containers have been unloaded by field technicians. Once this is confirmed, bring three seed containers to Tractor Station 5; however, pause for two minutes before allowing removal so that calibration teams can prepare to receive the containers. After the two-minute wait, stay on site until tractor staff have completed the unloading process. The last two seed containers should be delivered to Greenhouse 2, where you must wait for five minutes to allow the greenhouse manager to log and inspect the received items. Only after every seed container has been successfully distributed, with confirmation of receipt from each location, proceed to Recharging Bay South and remain there for seven minutes so that system diagnostics can be performed before commissioning new tasks.

Start at the Supply Dock and wait for the warehouse supervisor to load seven units of liquid fertilizer containers onto the robot. Once all containers are secured, proceed to Field Plot North and deliver two fertilizer containers, remaining onsite until the field manager confirms their removal. Head next to Crop Storage Shed 3 and drop off another two fertilizer containers, waiting for three minutes to allow the storage assistant to properly log the delivery. Carry the final three fertilizer containers to Orchard Block East; if the orchard supervisor is present, wait until all containers have been offloaded and documented before departing. Only after all fertilizer containers have been distributed and acknowledged at their respective destinations should you return to the Supply Dock to prepare for the next assignment.

Start at the Central Workshop and proceed to Loading Dock A to collect a shipment of twenty-four precision toolkits designated for scheduled equipment servicing. Begin delivery by making your way to Greenhouse 1 and offload seven toolkits, ensuring you wait on site until all units are confirmed received by the maintenance engineer. Following that, transport eight toolkits to the Irrigation Control Shed, but wait for six minutes upon arrival before unloading, allowing technicians to complete preparations for tool storage; only release the toolkits after this period has finished and an all-clear notification is provided. Next, bring five toolkits to Drone Charging Station West, waiting for a signal from the station supervisor before permitting removal. Carry the remaining four toolkits to Field Gate South, hand them over to the service technician immediately, and then wait for four minutes to accommodate safety checks in the area. After all toolkit deliveries, wait times, and dependencies have been met, return to the Central Workshop and await the next set of instructions.

Start by retrieving nine sealed pesticide canisters from Supply Depot A. Proceed first to Crop Field North and deliver three canisters, waiting until the field supervisor at Crop Field North removes all three. After this transfer, drive to Crop Field East with the remaining six sealed pesticide canisters, but before offloading, wait for ten minutes to allow field workers at Crop Field East to finish preparation. Once the wait is complete, deliver three more canisters to Crop Field East, ensuring prompt removal by the designated staff. With the final three canisters, move to Crop Field South; however, only begin the unloading process once you receive confirmation from the Crop Field South safety officer that the application machinery is ready. After all three remaining sealed pesticide canisters have been collected at Crop Field South, return immediately to Supply Depot A, deposit any empty canister trays, and await further instructions from the logistics coordinator.

Begin at Storage Dock A and wait until the warehouse crew has loaded nine pesticide canisters onto your payload, ensuring you do not depart until explicit confirmation is received from the shift supervisor. Proceed to Field Plot East and deliver four of the pesticide canisters, remaining on site until the field manager verifies proper placement and unlocks the canisters for manual retrieval, which may take several minutes. Once approval is obtained at Field Plot East, continue to the South Boundary Sprayer Shed and offload three additional pesticide canisters, but wait exactly four minutes at the South Boundary Sprayer Shed to provide standby support in case any loading malfunctions occur. After this time period, and contingent upon receiving confirmation from both Field Plot East and South Boundary Sprayer Shed that all delivered canisters have been successfully processed, transport the final two pesticide canisters to the Maintenance Outpost. If at any point delivery confirmation fails at either of the first two locations, immediately bring any remaining pesticide canisters back to Storage Dock A and notify the operations chief upon arrival. Upon successful completion and confirmation of all pesticide canister deliveries, return to Storage Dock A to await further dispatch instructions.

Begin at the fertilizer storage facility near Loading Dock 3 and collect a batch of fourteen seedling trays. Evenly distribute these trays among Greenhouse Alpha, Greenhouse Beta, and Greenhouse Gamma by delivering four trays to each, and carry the remaining two trays to the outdoor Plant Propagation Yard. For every greenhouse delivery, wait until the horticulture supervisor officially confirms the trays are in position before heading to the next site. After all deliveries are complete and confirmations received, proceed to the maintenance supply cabin adjacent to the main reservoir and remain on standby for eight minutes to accommodate any emergency requests from the greenhouse staff before returning to the fertilizer storage facility and concluding the route.

Begin your shift at the automated warehouse entrance and pick up a batch of fifteen diagnostic sensor modules intended for preventative maintenance across multiple outbuildings. Transport five sensor modules to the Cold Storage Unit first, and upon arrival, wait for the on-site operator’s signal that the transfer bay is secure before allowing the sensor modules to be removed. Immediately after successful handoff, proceed to the Fertilizer Mixing Shed and deliver another five sensor modules; once these have been deposited, remain next to the unloading dock for three minutes to verify the system calibration completes without faults. For the last five sensor modules, drive to the Field Equipment Hangar, but before initiating the offload, pause outside for four minutes to allow hangar staff to clear equipment access; only once you receive clearance should you complete the transfer. After all modules are delivered and acknowledged at their respective destinations, return to the automated warehouse entrance and stand by for further maintenance supply runs.

Begin by collecting eight sealed water sampling kits from Testing Supply Depot, then proceed to the East Irrigation Canal Platform to deliver three water sampling kits, remaining on-site until the environmental technician verifies that each kit is properly configured for field tests. Following confirmation, head south to the Bio-Monitoring Trailer and drop off two water sampling kits; after the transfer, you must wait for five minutes to permit on-board systems calibration before leaving the trailer. Next, continue to the Remote Weather Station near Field Boundary 4, distributing two more water sampling kits, and wait until an operator at the Weather Station has completed kit log-in procedures. For the final water sampling kit, travel to the Agricultural Research Greenhouse and stand by until the greenhouse manager indicates all previous monitoring equipment has been stowed safely, then hand over the last water sampling kit. After every kit has been delivered and each destination's requirements are met, return at once to Testing Supply Depot and await the next assignment.
