Begin at the Central Fertilizer Depot and load a total of fifteen nutrient canisters to be distributed among the Crop Field North, Seedling Nursery, and Orchard Irrigation Station. Start by transporting five nutrient canisters to Crop Field North; once you have arrived, wait until the field manager confirms the full removal of all five canisters from your compartment. After the confirmation, proceed with five more canisters to the Seedling Nursery located adjacent to the propagation tunnels, but upon arrival, stay idle for 120 seconds to provide staff time to log the incoming inventory before unloading your delivery. Finally, convey the last five canisters to Orchard Irrigation Station at the far west perimeter, but do not begin the handover until you verify that the previous deliveries at Crop Field North and Seedling Nursery have been logged—delay at Orchard Irrigation Station if any confirmation is missing. Conclude your route by returning directly to the Central Fertilizer Depot, and after docking, remain stationary for 90 seconds to allow synchronization and unloading preparations before new assignments may be issued.

Begin at Warehouse Loading Dock B and collect eight boxes of calibration sensors. Your task is to evenly distribute the sensors to Testing Facility East, Testing Facility West, and Control Room Zeta: deliver three boxes to Testing Facility East, three boxes to Testing Facility West, and two boxes to Control Room Zeta, explicitly ensuring the remainder is allocated to Control Room Zeta. For each delivery, wait until the on-site technician signals that each box has been successfully removed before proceeding to the next destination. After completing all drop-offs, proceed to Charging Station Omega and remain there for ten minutes to allow auxiliary systems to synchronize data logs before heading back to Warehouse Loading Dock B for further assignments.

Begin at the North Logistics Hub where you will pick up twelve sealed nutrient bags intended for three separate crop fields: Orchard Plot A, Hydroponic Greenhouse 5, and Open Field Delta. Split the payload by transporting four nutrient bags to each location in the following sequence: deliver to Orchard Plot A first, halting there for ten minutes to allow agricultural staff to calibrate dosing equipment before they remove any bags. Once all four bags are taken by the Orchard Plot A staff, proceed to Hydroponic Greenhouse 5 with four more nutrient bags and remain in place until a technician confirms via handheld scanner that each bag's batch code matches the greenhouse treatment schedule; only continue after all scans are successful. Finally, take the last four nutrient bags to Open Field Delta; if, after distributing four bags to each field, any defective or leftover nutrient bags remain due to incomplete transfers, ensure they are also left with the Open Field Delta supervisor for proper handling. Wait at Open Field Delta for five minutes to accommodate final quality checks, then return immediately to the North Logistics Hub and stand by there until the regional coordinator completes the return manifest review and gives you clearance for your next task.

Begin by navigating to Maintenance Depot A to collect a batch of nine calibrated seed planters. Distribute the seed planters evenly across Soy Field 1, Wheat Field 2, and Barley Plot 5 by delivering three planters to each location; for any remainder (if the depot provides fewer units), ensure Soy Field 1 receives any extra. After dropping off the seed planters at Barley Plot 5, remain at that location for exactly 4 minutes to allow the planting supervisor to perform a verification check. Proceed next to the Central Irrigation Station and retrieve a moisture analysis kit only after you receive confirmation from the Wheat Field 2 foreman (from your previous stop) that the planters have been successfully unloaded. Deliver the moisture analysis kit directly to Greenhouse Unit 7 and wait until the greenhouse technician collects the kit from the cargo platform before returning to Maintenance Depot A to complete the assignment.

Start at Maintenance Shed X to collect nine empty fertilizer canisters needed for service. Deliver three canisters each to Sprayer Unit Bay 1, Crop Plot West, and Chemical Mixing Station C, but if any location cannot accept its full share due to volume limits, redistribute those extra canisters evenly to the remaining sites, giving priority to Crop Plot West for any excess. After each delivery, wait at the location until the supervising technician confirms all fertilizer canisters have been removed, then wait an additional five minutes at Crop Plot West for equipment cooldown after offloading. Once all canisters are accounted for, make your way to Refueling Pad Z, and remain on-site for two minutes before returning to Maintenance Shed X for inspection and task closure.

Begin your run at Central Parts Storage by collecting nine hydraulic pump units destined for Manufacturing Line A, Manufacturing Line C, and the Quality Assurance Lab. Deliver three hydraulic pump units to Manufacturing Line A first, but only offload the units after confirming the station leader at Manufacturing Line A has acknowledged readiness. Once the three units are verified as received, continue to Manufacturing Line C and attempt to deliver another three pump units; however, if the Manufacturing Line C supervisor has not yet cleared space for new components, wait for four minutes before making the delivery. After the supervisor at Manufacturing Line C confirms receipt of all three pump units, proceed to the Quality Assurance Lab with the final three hydraulic pump units, and pause until each unit has been inspected and signed off by lab personnel prior to complete offloading. Following the final transfer, remain at the Quality Assurance Lab for ten minutes before returning to Central Parts Storage for your next task cycle, ensuring that all requisition logs are updated prior to departure.

Start at the Grain Storage Facility and pick up a batch of twenty-four soil sampling kits, ensuring all kits are securely loaded before departure. First, head to Field Plot A and unload nine sampling kits, waiting for the agronomist to confirm pickup before proceeding. Next, drive to Field Plot B to deliver another eight sampling kits, remaining stationary until the field supervisor finishes collecting all kits from your payload. Then, take the final seven kits to Field Plot C, where you must wait for ten minutes to allow the research team to prepare for unloading; only after the specified waiting period may you permit removal of the sampling kits by the research staff. Once all sampling kits have been distributed and acknowledged at each field location, return to the Grain Storage Facility for debriefing and maintenance checks.

Start at the Harvest Packing Shed and collect twelve sealed berry crates scheduled for dispatch to three distribution points: Downtown Market Pickup, Riverside Cold Storage, and the Eastern Farmstand. Allocate the berry crates so that Downtown Market Pickup receives five crates, Riverside Cold Storage receives four crates, and deliver the remaining three crates to the Eastern Farmstand, handling each transfer in sequence without skipping a destination. For each location, upon arrival, unload the assigned number of berry crates, then wait exactly three minutes to allow quality assurance personnel to inspect and clear the delivery before continuing to the next checkpoint. After all berry crates have been delivered and checked at their respective destinations, proceed directly to the Equipment Wash Bay and remain there until the sanitation team has removed all delivery totes from the payload compartment, signaling the end of your delivery cycle.

Begin your operation at Docking Station Echo and collect nine sealed nutrient additive containers designated for field deployment. Transport three additive containers to Cornfield Plot Alpha and remain at the plot until the irrigation team completes the removal of the payload from your storage compartment. Next, proceed with three more additive containers to Soybean Test Field Beta; after you arrive at Test Field Beta, wait there for five minutes to allow the research team to calibrate their dispensing equipment prior to your offloading the containers, and then wait for confirmation that all three containers have been successfully removed. Finally, deliver the last three additive containers to Greenhouse Theta, but if there are any containers left unremoved at the prior two destinations for any reason, adjust and deliver all remaining containers to Greenhouse Theta instead, waiting on-site until the greenhouse automation system signals that payload removal is complete. Once deliveries and removals at each location are confirmed, return directly to Docking Station Echo and stand by for ten minutes to allow software to update your deployment status before undertaking new assignments.

Start at the Main Parts Depot and collect twenty-three replacement hydraulic actuator units. Transport eight actuators to Maintenance Bay One and await confirmation from the senior technician that the actuator mounting racks are prepped for safe transfer before unloading. After the offload at Maintenance Bay One, bring another eight actuators to Maintenance Bay Two, but this time, upon arrival, wait for exactly six minutes to accommodate a mandatory ventilation cycle before beginning the actuator delivery. The remaining seven actuators must be delivered to Field Workshop South, and if additional actuators (due to surplus or discovery of defective actuators en route) exist beyond these allocations, transfer any such surplus directly to the Component Inspection Station for evaluation. For each of these location deliveries—including the Component Inspection Station—wait until local staff have removed all actuator units before proceeding to your next destination. Once all actuators and any surplus have been distributed and removed, return to the Main Parts Depot and remain stationary for ten minutes as inventory reconciliation is completed by depot staff before accepting any further assignments.

Start at the central packaging facility and load seven crates of fresh strawberries. First, proceed to Loading Dock A and deliver two crates to the delivery clerk, then immediately make your way to the Market Square Kiosk to drop off three crates in the refrigerated holding area. Afterward, travel to Distribution Bay 3 with the remaining two crates, but only unload these if you confirm that the bay supervisor at Distribution Bay 3 has finished cleaning the storage shelves; if shelf cleaning is still underway, wait at Distribution Bay 3 for up to eight minutes before making the delivery. After all strawberry crates have been properly distributed, wait at Distribution Bay 3 for an additional five minutes to ensure that post-delivery inspections are complete before returning directly to the central packaging facility and park at the robot charging station.

Start at the chemical supply depot and retrieve twelve containers of liquid fertilizer labeled for Field North, Field East, and Field West. Evenly allocate four fertilizer containers to each field: first, travel to Field North and wait at the designated drop site until the field supervisor confirms that all four containers are ready for dispensing. Once confirmation is received, continue to Field East and repeat the process—ensure that the supervisor's signal is received before unloading another four containers. After completing deliveries to Field North and Field East, proceed to Field West with the final four containers, but upon arrival, wait three minutes before unloading to allow the field crew to finish preparing the storage area. Following the complete delivery of fertilizer containers to all three fields, return directly to the chemical supply depot for inspection and remain there until further notice from the operations manager.

Begin by proceeding to Storage Warehouse 4 to collect a batch of nine fertilizer sacks, ensuring all sacks are secured before leaving. Afterward, travel directly to Crop Field Zone North, where you will deposit three fertilizer sacks at the north entry supply point, and wait four minutes for the field manager to confirm receipt. Once confirmation is received, continue to Crop Field Zone South, delivering another three fertilizer sacks to the main irrigation hub. Before moving on, wait for the payload removal signal from the hub supervisor. With the remaining three fertilizer sacks, head to Greenhouse 2, where the sacks should be delivered to the west access station; wait until the greenhouse technician verifies and removes all sacks from the robot. Only after all sacks are fully transferred and acknowledged at each drop-off point should you return to Storage Warehouse 4 for end-of-task logging and readiness check for future assignments.

Begin your operation at the Parts Storage Facility and collect twelve maintenance batteries designated for urgent delivery. Distribute these batteries evenly among Workshop A, Vehicle Garage, Workshop C, and the Equipment Testing Bay, delivering three batteries to each location in sequence. At each stop, after you confirm that the assigned three batteries have been unloaded by the local technician, wait for four minutes to allow inspection and acknowledgment from the workshop manager before proceeding to the next destination. Once all twelve batteries have been successfully delivered and all four confirmations recorded, proceed without delay to the Maintenance Control Office, and remain there until the maintenance supervisor removes any empty battery crates from your storage compartment.

Start your shift at the Fertilizer Depot where you will collect a batch of fourteen sealed fertilizer bags intended for Greenhouse 1, Orchard Packing Shed, and East Field Supply Hut. Evenly distribute the bags by delivering five to Greenhouse 1 first, making sure to wait for the greenhouse manager to confirm the storage bins are empty before offloading any bags. Upon completion and confirmation at Greenhouse 1, travel to the Orchard Packing Shed and deposit four fertilizer bags—if the main entrance is blocked by a forklift in use, wait for seven minutes or until the pathway is clear, whichever comes first, before proceeding to offload. After the Orchard Packing Shed delivery, take the remaining five fertilizer bags to the East Field Supply Hut, pausing until the field technician has finished clearing space for the new stock. Once all fertilizer bags are delivered and verified at each location, return to the Fertilizer Depot but remain outside at the designated decontamination station for a five-minute processing period before re-entering the facility.

Begin at Maintenance Depot Alpha and retrieve nine replacement hydraulic hoses, ensuring each hose is tagged for its destination. Proceed first to Tractor Repair Station West with four of the hydraulic hoses; once at the station, wait for the mechanic supervisor to confirm removal of all four hoses before departing. Next, move to Combine Harvester Bay and deliver three hydraulic hoses—after dropping them off, remain at Combine Harvester Bay for ten minutes to allow installation checks and documentation processes to occur. Finally, bring the remaining two hydraulic hoses to Irrigation Pump House South and wait until the pump technician has removed both hoses. Ensure delivery has been confirmed at each location after the appropriate waiting periods or receipt confirmations, then return directly to Maintenance Depot Alpha to complete the mission.

Begin at Maintenance Bay 1 and pick up a set of ten replacement drive belts designated for scheduled equipment servicing. Transport four drive belts to Field Pump Station Zeta and remain there until all four belts are unloaded by the maintenance engineer. Once unloading is confirmed, proceed to Irrigation Control Shed 3 with three of the remaining drive belts and wait while the shed supervisor verifies their removal. After their acceptance, travel directly to Greenhouse Machinery Room, where you must wait five minutes before initiating transfer of the final three drive belts to accommodate the completion of a chemical rinse cycle in the room. Once the five-minute interval is over and the rinse is confirmed finished, deliver all three drive belts and remain on-site until the greenhouse operator finishes removing them. After all deliveries and verifications are complete, immediately return to Maintenance Bay 1 for end-of-task inspection and await further instructions.

Head to the Main Equipment Storage and retrieve a crate containing 47 fertilizer packets. Distribute the packets evenly across the Greenhouse A Entrance, West Crop Row Shed, and Northern Field Gate—delivering 16 packets to Greenhouse A Entrance, 16 packets to West Crop Row Shed, and the remaining 15 packets to Northern Field Gate, in that order. After each delivery, remain at the destination for 5 minutes to allow staff to inspect the delivered packets and confirm receipt before proceeding to the next location. Once all fertilizer packets have been delivered and confirmation waits completed, move directly to the Maintenance Charging Bay and wait there for technicians to finish a mandatory 10-minute diagnostic before resuming further transport tasks.

Begin the workflow at the Seed Storage Facility by collecting a load of fourteen nutrient supplement pellets. Distribute these pellets by transporting six to the North Field Mixing Station, where you must wait until field technicians finish removing all six pellets before you continue. Next, deliver another six pellets to the Greenhouse Feed Room and wait there for exactly four minutes while the greenhouse staff confirms the acceptance and clearance of those pellets. Take the final two nutrient supplement pellets to the Orchard Tool Shed; remain onsite until the orchard crew has physically removed both pellets from your delivery platform. Once all fourteen nutrient supplement pellets have been distributed and their removal is verified at North Field Mixing Station, Greenhouse Feed Room, and Orchard Tool Shed, proceed directly to the Maintenance Bay, pausing for eight minutes to allow for routine diagnostics and system reset prior to ending the task sequence.

Begin your round at Cold Storage Facility Delta by waiting until the staff has fully loaded six insulated crates of perishable produce onto the robot. When the loading process is confirmed complete, head directly to Market Stall Omega and deliver two crates to the rear unloading zone, remaining there until all crates have been removed by the stall operator. After this, navigate to Retail Dock 3 and deposit another two crates, pausing for four minutes at the dock for a required temperature check before the crates can be accepted. Next, transport the final two crates to Processing Plant West, where you must wait at the intake entrance until plant personnel have removed all crates from the delivery platform. Once all crates have been delivered and the prescribed waiting periods at each destination are completed, return to Cold Storage Facility Delta without delay to stand by for any subsequent assignments or further instructions.

Commence your route at the Main Maintenance Shed, where you will retrieve a set of eleven replacement hydraulic filters intended for the ongoing field harvester tune-ups. Begin by transporting four filters to Field Service Station Alpha located near Orchard Row 2; wait at Field Service Station Alpha until all four filters have been collected by the technician team leader. After successful handoff at Station Alpha, carry three hydraulic filters to Field Service Station Bravo adjacent to South Pasture Gate, but do not depart until Bravo’s supervisor personally confirms receipt of the filters. With four filters remaining, deliver two of them to Field Service Station Charlie on the ridge beside the North Windbreak, and remain on site for exactly 10 minutes to accommodate tool sterilization procedures required before unloading the filters. Next, with the last two filters, proceed directly to the Emergency Storage Depot in the central operations yard and wait until both filters have been removed by the depot steward. Once all filters are distributed and acknowledgments have been received at each location, return immediately to the Main Maintenance Shed and reset your carrying platform, standing by there for further maintenance assignments.

Begin your mission at Grain Silo 4 by collecting a total of fifteen seed sacks designated for distribution across three separate fields: Field North, Field East, and Field South. Allocate six seed sacks to Field North, five seed sacks to Field East, and deliver the remaining four seed sacks to Field South to ensure all fields receive an appropriate portion, accounting for the difference in field size. Start by traveling to Field North and offload six seed sacks there, waiting until the local farm technician has reported the removal of all sacks before moving on. After Field North is complete, proceed directly to Field East and unload five seed sacks, pausing for three minutes at Field East to allow for irrigation system synchronization before heading to your final destination. Bring the last four seed sacks to Field South; if upon arrival you discover that Field South’s seed troughs are full, wait at Field South for up to ten minutes for space to become available, only depositing seed sacks as soon as permitted. After the successful delivery or when the waiting period expires, ensure any undelivered seed sacks are returned promptly to Grain Silo 4 and confirm the end of the shift by waiting five minutes at Grain Silo 4’s maintenance bay for final system diagnostics before shutting down.

Start at Central Depot to retrieve a crate labeled 'Precision Tools Kit,' ensuring the kit is secured before proceeding. Next, deliver the Precision Tools Kit to Machinery Maintenance Bay, and wait for the maintenance supervisor to finish offloading the kit and then confirm removal. After the kit is fully transferred, move to Component Storage Room to collect a batch of eight hydraulic pumps. Evenly distribute these pumps to three assembly lines: Assembly Line Alpha should receive three pumps, Assembly Line Beta two pumps, and Assembly Line Gamma the remaining three pumps—the allocation must address the differing needs of each line. At each line, wait for the assembly lead to signal after removing their respective pumps before heading to the next destination. Once all hydraulic pumps have been successfully delivered and removal signals received from each assembly line, return to Central Depot and remain there for five minutes to allow for inventory reconciliation before ending the task.

Start your mission at Main Chemical Storage, where you will collect twelve nutrient solution canisters earmarked for today’s hydroponics operations. Proceed to Mixing Station A and unload five nutrient solution canisters, waiting at Mixing Station A until facility engineers have fully emptied and returned the canisters to your cargo bed. Once retrieval is confirmed, continue to Lab Annex 3, distributing four fresh canisters of nutrient solution and pausing there for seven minutes to allow laboratory staff to calibrate their dispensing apparatus using these canisters. After this interval and upon securing the empty canisters, bring the final three nutrient solution canisters to Seedling Incubation Room and wait until Seedling Supervisor acknowledges all canisters have been removed from your load. Only after all twelve canisters have been successfully distributed and acknowledged, proceed to Maintenance Zone 2 for a mandatory ten-minute system diagnostic before you may leave for Main Chemical Storage to complete your mission.

Begin your route at Storage Dock 4, where you are assigned to transport a total of eleven fuel canisters for generator replenishment. First, drive to Harvest Shed Alpha and deliver four fuel canisters, remaining at the location until the shift supervisor has removed all four canisters; do not depart until removal is confirmed. Next, continue to the East Orchard Equipment Lot with the next portion of the fuel load and transfer another four canisters; once at the Equipment Lot, wait for two minutes after the attendant has started the offloading process, then ensure all canisters are removed before proceeding. For the remaining three fuel canisters, head to Maintenance Bay C, where you must wait for the maintenance engineer to take delivery and confirm in person that the final three canisters are off your payload. Only after the maintenance engineer’s confirmation at Maintenance Bay C are you to return to Storage Dock 4, where you must remain at your original start location for three minutes to enable a post-delivery inspection before ending your route.

Begin at the Equipment Maintenance Bay and collect six sealed battery modules destined for redistribution. Proceed to the Solar Charging Station, where you must deposit two battery modules and await confirmation from the station manager that both are safely unloaded before continuing. Next, head to the South Storage Locker to deliver another two battery modules; after arriving, wait a full 8 minutes to allow the technical staff to test and log each module into inventory. The final two battery modules are to be transported to the Remote Drone Launchpad, but only make this last trip after receiving confirmation that both prior deliveries have been completed. Once at the Drone Launchpad, wait for the drone technician to remove the modules, then return to the Equipment Maintenance Bay for a post-route inspection and battery status report.

Start at the Bulk Fertilizer Shed and load seven fertilizer sacks intended for distribution across Orchard North, Orchard East, and Orchard South. Deliver two sacks to Orchard North and remain until each sack is removed by field staff. Proceed to Orchard East with another two sacks, and wait for confirmation that both sacks have been fully offloaded before moving on. Transport the remaining three sacks to Orchard South, and only proceed further once you have received indication that all sacks have been unloaded. After completing deliveries to each orchard, travel to Maintenance Bay 1, wait for 8 minutes to allow technicians to inspect and recalibrate your dispensing equipment, and then return to the Bulk Fertilizer Shed for your next assignment. If at any point unloading is delayed at any orchard, immediately notify site personnel and do not resume transit until all sacks for that location are confirmed removed.

Start at Storage Warehouse Omega, where you must collect nine water purification cartridges. Transport three cartridges to Irrigation Control Station East, ensuring that after each cartridge drop-off you remain at Irrigation Control Station East for two minutes to verify that maintenance staff have securely installed each cartridge. Once all three cartridges are delivered and confirmed at Irrigation Control Station East, proceed to Livestock Hydration Facility South with the next three cartridges, and wait for one minute following each drop-off to ensure the hydration system performs a proper system check. The final three cartridges should be delivered one-by-one to Greenhouse Cluster 7, remaining at Greenhouse Cluster 7 after each cartridge delivery until the cluster supervisor removes the cartridge from your cargo. After successful delivery and removal of all nine cartridges at their respective sites, move to Central Recharging Dock and wait there for five minutes to allow for battery diagnostics before returning to Storage Warehouse Omega to finish the assignment.

Begin at the Cold Storage Facility and collect ten 20-kg bags of seed potatoes. Transport and distribute these bags among the West Field, North Silo, and Central Experiment Plot, allocating three bags each to the West Field and North Silo, with the remaining four bags designated for the Central Experiment Plot to ensure no bags are left over. After delivering the bags to the West Field, wait until the planting supervisor confirms that unloading is complete before heading to the North Silo. At the North Silo, remain on site for seven minutes to allow the silo operator to complete documentation and quality checks; only proceed to the Central Experiment Plot once this interval has elapsed. Upon arrival at the Central Experiment Plot, do not commence unloading until the research coordinator has signaled readiness for the incoming delivery, then wait an additional two minutes after offloading to allow for sample inspection. Once all bags are delivered, verified, and the waiting times are observed for each location, return directly to the Cold Storage Facility and prepare for the next seed distribution cycle.

Begin by traveling to Warehouse Dock C to collect eighteen sealed crates containing replacement tractor parts, ensuring that the depot supervisor verifies the readiness of all crates for dispatch. Once all crates are confirmed ready, start the delivery circuit by bringing six crates to Maintenance Bay Delta and remain there until the mechanics remove all six and sign off on the receipt. Afterward, transport another six crates to Equipment Staging Area Bravo; upon arrival at Bravo, you must wait ten minutes before unloading to allow the team to clear space and organize their storage racks. After the ten-minute interval, oversee the transfer of all six crates and confirm acceptance by the staging supervisor. For the final six crates, proceed to Field Workshop Echo, but postpone unloading until you receive explicit clearance from the remote operations desk that the workshop is prepared—this clearance may arrive at any time, so stay onsite until notified. Once every crate has been delivered and their removals acknowledged at each location, return to Warehouse Dock C, and await final debrief instructions from the logistics manager before powering down.

Begin your shift at Storage Warehouse 3, where you must wait until nine bags of high-nutrient fertilizer are prepped and loaded for distribution. Once ready, set out to Greenhouse Annex Alpha and deliver three bags, ensuring that you wait at the annex until each bag has been thoroughly inspected and logged by the greenhouse technician; do not depart until all three bags have been accounted for. Next, proceed to Orchard Field B and deliver another three bags of the fertilizer, but upon arrival, you are required to wait for six minutes before unloading, as orchard staff need time to clear the staging area—only begin the handover process after this delay, waiting until all three bags have been fully removed by field staff. For the remaining three bags, travel to Vineyard Section 4, and before initiating the delivery, verify that confirmation has been received from the vineyard supervisor signaling readiness for transfer; remain at Vineyard Section 4 until the supervisor or a designated crew member removes all final bags from your cargo. Once you have verified that all nine bags of fertilizer have been distributed and cleared from your load at their respective destinations, immediately return to Storage Warehouse 3 to complete your route.

Begin the operation at the Central Harvest Depot and collect nine sacks of harvested corn, ensuring each sack is clearly labeled for tracking. Transport and allocate three sacks of corn to each of the following storage silos in this sequence: Silo A, Silo B, and Silo C; if for some reason not all nine sacks can be distributed equally, deliver any leftover sacks to Silo C after the first two silos have received their full portion. After unloading the corn sacks at each silo, wait until the respective silo attendant verifies and signals that the goods have been properly stored, remaining on-site and waiting an additional five minutes for every delayed verification until the confirmation is received or a total of twenty minutes have elapsed. Once all confirmations from the silo attendants are complete, return to the Central Harvest Depot and remain stationed there for four minutes to allow for post-mission inspection before proceeding to Maintenance Station 1 for routine diagnostics. If cargo verification at any silo is not completed within twenty minutes, skip deliveries to all remaining silos and head directly to Maintenance Station 1, but document which silos received their deliveries.

Start your route at the Materials Storage Dock, where you must collect a set of fifteen maintenance toolkits earmarked for three assembly lines: Conveyor Belt Alpha, Robotic Arm Bay, and Quality Control Station Zeta. Deliver the toolkits in batches of five, beginning with Conveyor Belt Alpha, where you must wait for a supervisor sign-off before you can release the toolkits; if this sign-off is not completed within eight minutes, proceed to the next step regardless, leaving the toolkits in a holding area. Continue to Robotic Arm Bay with the next five toolkits, but pause there for exactly six minutes, allowing maintenance staff to remove any hazardous materials from the drop-off zone before you unload the toolkits. After successful drop-off or once the waiting period lapses, proceed to Quality Control Station Zeta with the last five toolkits, and wait at the bay until each toolkit has been individually checked and cleared by the station technician; only after this confirmation is received can you return to the Materials Storage Dock. At the end of your journey, remain at the dock for four minutes to allow the shift manager to verify your cargo manifest and log your completed delivery.

Begin at Fertilizer Depot Alpha and collect a load of sixteen nutrient pods designated for crop treatment. Divide the delivery as evenly as possible among three separate fields: transport and drop off five nutrient pods at Wheat Field North, six nutrient pods at Corn Field East, and the remaining five nutrient pods at Soybean Field South, ensuring that each field receives notification of the precise count. After delivering the nutrient pods to Wheat Field North, wait until the field supervisor transmits a digital confirmation of complete offloading before proceeding to Corn Field East; following the delivery at Corn Field East, remain onsite for a mandatory pause of eight minutes to permit the field crew to arrange storage, then complete the drop off at Soybean Field South, again requiring a supervisor’s confirmation. Only after all fields have accepted the correct quantities and acknowledged receipt should you return to Fertilizer Depot Alpha, confirming that the delivery manifest is marked complete.

Start at Equipment Maintenance Bay 2 and wait until the replacement hydraulic actuator is ready for transport. Once prepared, deliver the actuator to Harvester Unit Alpha located in Field Sector 6, then wait until the field technician confirms complete removal of the old actuator from Harvester Unit Alpha. Next, leave Field Sector 6 and travel to Workshop Storage Area C to collect two sealed lubricant canisters. Deliver one canister to Pump Station Delta and the other to Irrigation Substation Beta; at each site, wait for five minutes after arrival to allow staff to inspect the delivered canister before proceeding. After completing both lubricant deliveries, return to Equipment Maintenance Bay 2 and remain there until further task updates are provided.

Start at the Central Storage Depot and load nine fertilizer canisters, confirming each canister’s serial number as you do so. Initialize your deliveries by bringing four canisters to Wheat Field North, waiting at this location until farmhands have completely removed all four fertilizer canisters. After this drop-off, proceed to Orchard Supply Shed to deliver three more canisters, and once at the shed, wait exactly 7 minutes to allow the orchard staff to safely calibrate their equipment before you permit unloading of the canisters. The remaining two fertilizer canisters should be delivered to Vineyard Pumping Station, but only initiate this delivery after both the Wheat Field North and Orchard Supply Shed transfers are complete. At Vineyard Pumping Station, wait until a vineyard operator signals that the unloading is finalized. Once all canisters have been distributed and confirmed at every site, return directly to Central Storage Depot to report mission readiness for further assignment.

Start by picking up a load of thirty-six seed bags from the Central Supply Dock in the early morning, then proceed to Irrigation Plot Delta to deliver twelve seed bags; after delivering, wait until you receive confirmation from the plot supervisor that all bags have been unloaded before continuing. Next, bring the subsequent twelve seed bags to Greenhouse Station B, but before you offload the bags, wait for four minutes at the station to ensure its internal robot arms complete calibrations—only upon receiving a ready signal from Greenhouse Station B should you deliver the seed bags. Transport the final twelve seed bags to Orchard Lot Seven, and if you find that any of the locations have refused partial delivery due to storage issues, return any leftover seed bags directly to the Central Supply Dock. For each delivery—including potential returns—wait for local staff to physically remove all seed bags from your payload platform before moving to your next destination. Once all deliveries and possible returns have concluded, head back to the Central Supply Dock and stay there until further dispatch orders arrive.

Begin at Seed Storage Facility Alpha and collect a total of nine temperature-sensitive seed crates, making sure that each crate is properly labeled for destination tracking. First, transport four seed crates to Greenhouse Block 3, and remain there until all four crates are safely offloaded and verified by the greenhouse supervisor; following this, wait an additional four minutes on site to allow the seeds to acclimate to the ambient environment before leaving. Next, deliver three seed crates to Nursery Shed Delta, waiting until the horticulture manager confirms the removal of all three crates. For the remaining two crates, proceed to Research Plot HQ and remain until both crates have been received and signed off by the research lead. Once all seed crates have been distributed and acknowledged at their respective locations, return to Seed Storage Facility Alpha and await further assignment instructions from logistics control.

Begin the operation at Fertilizer Loading Bay 1 and secure nine fertilizer sacks, which must be distributed to three different crop fields: North Cornfield, East Wheat Plot, and South Soy Enclosure. Allocate the sacks as evenly as possible by delivering three to each field; in any event where North Cornfield’s drop-off is unexpectedly delayed, remain at that location and only proceed once all three sacks have been acknowledged as fully unloaded. After leaving the Cornfield, transport three sacks to East Wheat Plot, pausing for six minutes once you arrive to allow irrigation equipment to clear the drop zone before unloading. For the final three sacks, proceed to South Soy Enclosure, but if any fertilizer sack takes over three minutes to be removed, skip that sack and return for it after completing your main circuit of deliveries. Upon finishing all deliveries or returning for missed items, navigate to Central Service Kiosk and wait for twelve minutes for the agricultural engineer to conduct a routine calibration, only departing for Fertilizer Loading Bay 1 after the calibration process is verified as complete.

Begin your route at the Central Harvest Warehouse, where you must wait for the batch of produce crates to be tagged and ready for distribution. Once the 11 produce crates are loaded, travel to Sorting Station East and deliver 3 crates, pausing at Sorting Station East until all crates are removed by the sorting crew. Proceed next to Packaging Shed South with 4 produce crates, but upon arrival, wait for 5 minutes to allow the packaging team to sanitize the receiving platform before beginning the offloading process, and then remain at Packaging Shed South until all 4 crates have been collected. The final 4 crates must be delivered to Cold Storage Dock West; after arriving at Cold Storage Dock West, wait until a dock worker signals that the chiller is operational before unloading the last 4 crates. Once all deliveries are confirmed and every crate has been accepted at its destination, return directly to the Central Harvest Warehouse and wait there for three minutes to allow a supervisor to check the cargo bay for any missed items before closing out your task.

Start your mission at Maintenance Hub 1, where you must confirm readiness of three replacement hydraulic filters and six battery modules for delivery to Assembly Line Red, Painting Booth Green, and Welding Station Blue. Collect all nine maintenance items and distribute them as follows: deliver two hydraulic filters and two battery modules to Assembly Line Red, three battery modules and one hydraulic filter to Painting Booth Green, and the remaining one hydraulic filter and one battery module to Welding Station Blue, ensuring each station receives its required components. After delivering to Assembly Line Red, remain on site until you receive confirmation from the assembly supervisor that the items have been fully installed and removed from your payload. Next, proceed to Painting Booth Green; upon arrival, wait precisely four minutes to allow the ventilation system to complete its cycle before presenting your maintenance items for transfer, and verify that the booth operator has accepted all components. For your last stop at Welding Station Blue, pause outside the bay until a technician notifies you that all previous equipment has been cleared, waiting up to six minutes if necessary, and, once granted permission, complete the handoff and confirm receipt. Upon finishing all deliveries and confirming all items have been properly handed over, return to Maintenance Hub 1 and wait in the diagnostics zone for seven minutes to complete a system self-check before you conclude your route.

Begin your operation at the Seed Storage Warehouse by retrieving a total of seven seed crates, then proceed to distribute these seed crates among Field Plot A, Field Plot B, and Field Plot C, ensuring that Field Plot A and Field Plot B each receive two crates and Field Plot C receives the remaining three crates to account for allocation remainders. After delivering each batch of seed crates to its respective plot, pause at the location and wait until the field supervisor at that plot confirms the crates have been unloaded before proceeding to the next plot. Once all seed crates have been distributed and receipt confirmed at each plot, travel immediately to the Equipment Cleaning Bay; upon arrival, wait for five minutes to allow cleaning staff to prepare decontamination of your cargo bay before beginning your return trip to the Seed Storage Warehouse, ensuring the cycle is complete and debris risk is managed between critical steps and locations.

Begin by retrieving twelve sealed crates of seed packets from Storage Warehouse A and ensure that the labels are verified for the correct planting season. Distribute the crates evenly among Field Plot North, Field Plot East, and Field Plot South, delivering four crates to each location; in the event of any excess crates due to a discrepancy in the count or labeling, ensure that the extra crates are first delivered to the Field Plot North as a priority destination. After each delivery at a field plot, wait until the designated plot manager has removed the delivered crates before proceeding to the next plot. Once all seed packet crates have been delivered and confirmed removed from the cargo hold, make your way to Central Tool Depot and remain there for eight minutes to allow for exterior cleaning of the robot. Upon completion of the cleaning process, return to Storage Warehouse A and stand by for further sampling or loading tasks as instructed by the operations team.

Begin at Loading Bay West in Factory Complex 2 to acquire a shipment of twelve electronic control modules, verifying that the modules have been properly secured before departure. After the modules are loaded, transport the full shipment directly to Testing Laboratory C; upon arrival, wait outside the laboratory until a technician has finished unloading all electronic control modules from your payload bay. Once the payload bay is cleared, proceed to Maintenance Shed Delta, where you must pause for exactly six minutes while the maintenance crew inspects your navigation sensors to ensure they’re functioning correctly following exposure to the electromagnetic fields near the laboratory. As soon as inspection is complete, return to Loading Bay West, retrieve eight empty packaging crates, and distribute them in batches of three, three, and two to Storage Area 5, Storage Area 6, and Storage Area 7 respectively, making independent drops at each location in sequence, and waiting at each storage area until the staff confirms successful removal before moving to the next. When all empty crates have been delivered, report back to the Factory Control Office for your next assignment.

Start at Loading Dock B and pick up a sealed crate containing twelve irrigation valve kits, each distinctly marked for its destination. Head to Field Section Alpha first and deliver five valve kits from the crate, staying until the irrigation technician confirms they have been removed from the delivery container. Once this acknowledgment is received, proceed to Field Section Delta and offload four additional valve kits; after unloading, remain for three minutes to allow the installation team to verify model compatibility before moving on. For the final leg, travel to Field Section Gamma to deliver the last three valve kits and wait there until the maintenance lead removes a receipt tag from the empty crate. Only after the receipt tag has been collected at Field Section Gamma should you return the empty crate to Loading Dock B, where you must wait for two minutes to allow the logistics coordinator time to log the completed delivery before powering down.

Begin at Grain Mill Loading Bay and collect a total of seven seed sample crates, verifying that all crates are properly secured before departure. Next, proceed to Test Field Alpha and deliver three of the seed sample crates to the research plot drop zone, then pause for five minutes to allow the research supervisor to inspect and sign off on the delivered crates; do not leave Test Field Alpha until this confirmation is obtained. Afterward, transport the remaining four seed sample crates directly to the Greenhouse Processing Station, but split these crates between the North Bench (receiving two crates) and the East Bench (receiving the other two), ensuring that each delivery is acknowledged by the greenhouse technician prior to finalizing the drop-offs. Once all seed sample crates have been delivered and verified at their respective locations, move to the Central Workshop Charging Station and remain there for ten minutes to recharge, resuming scheduled maintenance rounds only after this period has elapsed.

Start at the Central Equipment Depot and pick up twelve replacement battery modules labeled for urgent drone fleet servicing. Evenly distribute these battery modules by delivering four modules each to Charging Station East, Charging Station West, and the Field Drone Hangar; at each destination, wait until all modules handed over are confirmed as logged and cleared from your payload by the technical specialist. Upon completing the deliveries to all three destinations, proceed to the Outdoor Diagnostics Pad and remain there for eight minutes while system checks are performed on your navigation sensors by the diagnostics team. After the eight-minute waiting period and verification from the team, return to the Central Equipment Depot and await further deployment instructions, ensuring that no subsequent route is initiated until every previous module drop-off and diagnostics process has been fully concluded.

Begin by proceeding to Loading Dock C and wait until eight sealed produce crates labeled Early Harvest are ready to load, as verified by the dock manager. Once the crates are loaded, transport five crates to Cold Storage Unit 2; after arrival, stay until all five Early Harvest crates are removed and checked in by the storage technician. Following the successful handoff at Cold Storage Unit 2, wait for three minutes to permit completion of inventory syncing procedures before relocating. Collect the remaining three Early Harvest crates and deliver them to Retail Dispatch Bay 1, but only unload two crates at this location, and wait until both crates are removed by the shipment staff. Take the last Early Harvest crate to Quality Control Center, remaining there until the quality inspector removes the final crate and approves it for sampling. Return to Loading Dock C only after all Early Harvest crates have been delivered and individually signed off at each location, signaling the completion of your distribution round.

Begin by traveling to the Chemical Storage Depot to collect twelve pesticide canisters, ensuring you wait for the safety officer to confirm all canisters are properly sealed and safe for handling. Next, go to the North Field Spraying Station and deliver five of the pesticide canisters, and remain at the station until the field supervisor completes the unloading and signs off on the inventory. Proceed with the remaining seven canisters to the Western Orchard Block, unload four canisters there, and wait for orchard staff to remove them fully before leaving. Take the last three canisters to the Maintenance Bay, where you must wait until the technical team signals that all three canisters have been successfully offloaded and properly stored. After every delivery is finished and all confirmations are received, wait at the Maintenance Bay for 2 minutes to provide availability in case any immediate retrieval or adjustment is requested by the maintenance supervisor, then return to the Chemical Storage Depot and stand by for further deployment instructions.

Initiate your route at Loading Dock A, where you are to collect a batch of fifteen boxed fertilizer units once the dock foreman confirms that the entire batch is ready for loading. Your delivery sequence should begin at Orchard Plot 7, where you will transfer five fertilizer units and wait for a confirmation signal from the orchard supervisor indicating successful receipt. After completion at Orchard Plot 7, travel to Greenhouse North; if the greenhouse staff can take fewer than five fertilizer units due to storage constraints, deliver the maximum possible there and direct any undelivered units in your batch to Crop Field Delta. At each stop, wait an additional three minutes post-unloading to allow time for staff inventory checks and barcode scans to be completed before moving to your next destination. Upon finishing all deliveries and ensuring the entire consignment has been distributed, proceed back to Loading Dock A and stand by for further instructions.

Begin your task by moving to the Fertilizer Storage Shed to collect a batch of twenty-three fertilizer bags reserved for upcoming crop enhancement at three different farm plots. Once all twenty-three bags are loaded, head first to Field Delta's western entrance and drop off nine fertilizer bags for the irrigation team, only proceeding after verifying that every bag has been completely removed from your platform. Next, navigate to Field Echo's main service gate to deliver another seven fertilizer bags to the distribution crew, waiting until you receive their signal confirming the removal of the seven bags before departing. Allocate the final seven bags to the Greenhouse Supply Depot, but if the unloading process at the depot is not initiated within five minutes of arrival, wait an additional three minutes before contacting depot staff to prompt the unloading process. After the complete offload at each site and all verification steps are fulfilled, remain for six minutes at the Greenhouse Supply Depot to allow for a post-delivery inspection of your payload area, and then promptly travel back to the Fertilizer Storage Shed to complete your cycle.

Start at the Seed Storage Facility and wait for the batch of 17 fertilizer bags to be loaded onto your platform. Immediately proceed to Crop Field Alpha and deliver 5 fertilizer bags, waiting at Crop Field Alpha until the on-site crew has completely removed all 5 bags. After this delivery, continue to Crop Field Bravo with 6 fertilizer bags; upon arrival, pause for 4 minutes to allow irrigation equipment to be safely shut down before offloading the 6 bags, at which point you must also wait until all bags are removed by the field team. The remaining 6 fertilizer bags should be transported to Crop Field Charlie; upon reaching Crop Field Charlie, deliver all 6 bags evenly and do not leave until the last bag has been taken by the ground staff. Once every delivery has been successfully completed and all fertilizer bags have been offloaded at their respective fields, return promptly to the Seed Storage Facility and remain there for 2 minutes so a quality assurance inspector can verify that the cargo area is empty before you conclude your assignment.

Initiate the task by traveling to the Loading Dock and waiting until six sealed crates of fertilizer become ready for transfer. Once the crates are available, distribute them in a specific sequence: deliver two crates to Greenhouse 1, two crates to Tomato Plot B, and the remaining two crates to Orchard Shed 3, ensuring that no site receives more than two crates. After each delivery, wait for two minutes at the respective location to allow on-site sensors to confirm the receipt of the crates before continuing to the next destination. Following the final delivery at Orchard Shed 3, proceed directly to the Vehicle Charging Station, but remain there for exactly ten minutes to allow your battery systems to recharge sufficiently before initiating any subsequent operations, making sure not to break the sequence of crate deliveries and associated waiting periods at each stop.

Start your task at Dock 7 within the Processing Plant, and collect a batch of 22 sealed chemical drums labeled 'Batch CL-09'; make certain that these drums are securely loaded before proceeding to allocate them across Warehouse Alpha, Warehouse Bravo, and Packaging Area 2. Begin by delivering 7 chemical drums to Warehouse Alpha and wait for 5 minutes after arrival to ensure that the hazardous materials safety inspection is completed. Once Warehouse Alpha has received their allocation, transport the next 7 drums to Warehouse Bravo, and allow a waiting period of 3 minutes to accommodate inventory staff in conducting a reconciliation check. Proceed to Packaging Area 2 with the remaining 7 drums, but before unloading, wait for 6 minutes to allow the ventilation system to reach safe ambient levels, as confirmed by the area supervisor. In the event that there is one extra drum following distribution, deliver this drum directly to the Hazardous Waste Containment Bay and wait there for 4 minutes to supervise initial containment procedures before leaving the vicinity. After the last drum has been handled and all mandatory waiting intervals have elapsed, immediately travel to Vehicle Charging Station 3 and remain there until your onboard power level reaches full capacity, after which you may await your next assignment.

Start your task at the Fertilizer Depot, where you are to pick up a total of nine fertilizer sacks, carefully labeled for three different locations. Make your first delivery run by transporting three fertilizer sacks to Orchard Lot 5, waiting up to three minutes after arrival for the orchard manager's signal confirming that storage space has been cleared. Once accepted, return to the Fertilizer Depot to collect the next batch and deliver three fertilizer sacks to Vineyard Block 2, where you must wait for a minimum of four minutes to ensure the field crew is ready to receive the sacks and has donned proper safety gear. For the final batch, carry the remaining three fertilizer sacks to Crop Research Plot D, but only release the delivery after the research supervisor confirms all prior deliveries have been completed for the day at that location; continue waiting at Plot D if this confirmation is delayed. After the last sacks have been delivered and all wait periods have elapsed, proceed without delay to the Vehicle Charging Station for a scheduled battery recharge and await further deployment instructions.

Start at the Cargo Loading Dock with a shipment of fourteen seedling trays, each intended for greenhouse propagation. First, deliver five seedling trays to Greenhouse A, waiting at the unloading zone until all five trays are acknowledged and manually removed by the horticulture technician. Next, travel to Greenhouse B with another batch of five seedling trays, but only proceed with unloading once the greenhouse manager confirms that space in the receiving racks has been prepared; if confirmation is not received within three minutes, wait an additional two minutes before checking again. After both Greenhouse A and Greenhouse B have been restocked, take the remaining four seedling trays to the Propagation Laboratory, where you must wait exactly six minutes outside the laboratory entrance to allow the airflow system to complete a sterilization cycle before any trays are transferred. Once the laboratory environmental controls are cleared and the trays are successfully delivered to Propagation Laboratory staff, return directly to the Cargo Loading Dock and remain in position for the final sign-off by the logistics supervisor before concluding the operation.

Start at Maintenance Bay East and wait until ten new battery packs are loaded onto the robot. After all battery packs are secured, proceed to Solar Field Zone 1 and deliver three battery packs to Technician Group Alpha, waiting until all three battery packs have been removed and installation is confirmed. Once the transfer is complete, continue to Wind Turbine Array 4 and deliver another four battery packs, remaining at the site for three minutes to allow the engineering crew to inspect the shipment before removal. Take the remaining three battery packs to Pumping Station North; if Pumping Station North is running an active system flush, remain on standby and wait up to five minutes or until notified that the bay is accessible, then deliver and wait for the removal of all remaining battery packs. Upon successful drop-off at each site, return directly to Maintenance Bay East and wait for further servicing instructions from the lead technician.

Begin your route at the Seed Inventory Dock and collect a batch of 13 treated seed bags designated for distribution. Make your first stop at Greenhouse Alpha to deliver five seed bags, then proceed to Greenhouse Beta and provide four seed bags, ensuring staff at each greenhouse remove their allocation before you move to the next destination. The final four seed bags should be delivered to the Outdoor Test Plot, but only after waiting for six minutes at the entrance for the test plot supervisor to complete site preparation and confirm readiness for the drop-off. Once all deliveries are complete, travel to the Equipment Wash Station, wait there for three minutes during the mandated decontamination cycle, and finally return to the Seed Inventory Dock to finalize the transfer log with on-site personnel.

Initiate your route at Maintenance Bay 1 and pick up eight replacement solenoid valve kits, clearly labeled for greenhouse operations. Head first to Greenhouse Section A and deliver three valve kits, then wait for the technician to complete their installation check, which requires 7 minutes. After this confirmation, proceed to Greenhouse Section B and drop off another three valve kits; in this area, you must wait up to 10 minutes for the automated loader to finish removing the previous faulty components. Next, take the final two valve kits to Greenhouse Section C; before transferring them, wait until the site manager signals that the section’s irrigation system has been fully de-pressurized, which may take a while depending on workflow but is critical for safety—do not unload the valve kits until this is confirmed. Once all valve kits have been distributed and acknowledged at their destinations, return directly to Maintenance Bay 1 and stand by for further deployment instructions.

Begin at the main supply garage and collect four sealed toolkits intended for equipment maintenance throughout the facility. First, deliver one toolkit to Maintenance Bay Alpha and wait until the head technician confirms its receipt before proceeding. After this confirmation, continue to Maintenance Bay Beta and deploy two toolkits there, waiting for up to eight minutes if the bay crew has not immediately removed both toolkits from your cargo. Once both toolkits have been offloaded and acknowledged by the crew at Maintenance Bay Beta, take the final remaining toolkit to the Remote Power Station on the western perimeter. At the power station, wait for exactly five minutes to allow the engineer to prepare for the pickup, then ensure the engineer retrieves the toolkit. After every toolkit has been delivered and all removals are confirmed, return to the main supply garage and await the next set of maintenance dispatch instructions.

Start at the Fertilizer Storage Depot and load a total of seventeen compost nutrient sacks onto your transport frame. Distribute the sacks as follows: deliver six sacks to the South Orchard Plot, five sacks to the Central Greenhouse, and the remaining six sacks to the North Vineyard Hill, making sure no location receives more or less than its allocated amount. At the Central Greenhouse, after you have arrived and unloaded the five sacks, wait for three minutes to allow the greenhouse operator to perform a quality check on the nutrient sacks before departing. For the North Vineyard Hill delivery, if the weather station near the drop-off point is reporting high humidity, pause operations for four minutes prior to unloading to prevent moisture exposure. Only after all assigned sacks have been correctly distributed to each intended destination and all required wait periods have elapsed should you return to the Fertilizer Storage Depot to complete your operational cycle.

Begin at Storage Locker Delta to collect six sealed replacement filters and a coolant diagnostic kit, then proceed to Engine Room B where the coolant diagnostic kit must be released; wait until confirmation is received from the maintenance crew that the diagnostic process has begun before continuing. Next, take the six sealed replacement filters to distribute evenly among Hydrogen Generator A, Diesel Backup Shed, and Solar Inverter Room, delivering two filters at each station in the specified order. At every delivery site, pause for three minutes to allow staff to remove and inspect the filters before proceeding to the next site. Once the last set of filters has been removed and inspected at the Solar Inverter Room, navigate to Quarantine Materials Bay, remaining there for five minutes before returning to Storage Locker Delta to await further assignments.

Start by proceeding to Loading Dock Alpha to prepare for the collection of a shipment containing sixteen boxed seedling trays earmarked for delivery to three separate destinations: Hydroponics Lab, Storage Shed Delta, and Plant Nursery Pavilion. Distribute the shipment by delivering seven seedling trays to Hydroponics Lab, five trays to Storage Shed Delta, and the remaining four trays to Plant Nursery Pavilion, ensuring no destination is missed, with the higher allocation going to the Hydroponics Lab as prioritized by the distribution order. For each stop, after you have arrived and prior to unloading, wait until the site supervisor at that location has signaled that their indoor climate controls are operational to ensure seedling safety; only then offload the designated number of trays. After departing each site, insert a 90-second pause before continuing to the next destination to allow the facility staff to complete initial inspections, and wait for confirmation that all trays have been successfully removed from your payload before proceeding. Once all seedling trays have been delivered and the corresponding confirmations received from each location, return to Loading Dock Alpha and remain parked at the loading bay for two minutes to allow for record reconciliation before ending the task.

Begin at the Central Farm Storage and await readiness of eight water-testing sample kits from the supply counter. Once all eight sample kits are ready, systematically distribute the kits across the various water bodies: deliver three kits to the North Irrigation Reservoir, three kits to the Southeast Lake, and the remaining two kits to the West Channel Outpost, making sure that every location receives its assigned quantity. At each water site, after placing the sample kits, wait five minutes to allow the site supervisor to confirm receipt before departing for the next destination. Following the completion of all deliveries, immediately return to the Central Farm Storage and wait there for fifteen minutes to provide any necessary handover briefing to the quality control engineer, ensuring all location-based drop-offs and site waiting periods are strictly followed in order.

Begin at the main warehouse and retrieve a pallet containing seventeen fertilizer bags. Transport the full pallet to Distribution Dock 1, then distribute the fertilizer bags among Greenhouse Alpha, Greenhouse Beta, and Greenhouse Gamma by delivering six bags to Greenhouse Alpha, six to Greenhouse Beta, and the remaining five to Greenhouse Gamma, ensuring that the odd bag is explicitly assigned to Greenhouse Gamma to handle the remainder. At each greenhouse, wait until the respective greenhouse supervisor has signaled that all delivered fertilizer bags have been offloaded before proceeding to the next destination. Once each fertilizer drop-off is confirmed complete and the pallet at the last greenhouse is empty, return directly to the main warehouse and await instructions from the inventory manager.

Begin by navigating to the Fertilizer Storage Depot adjacent to Field 6 and collect eleven nutrient dispersal canisters reserved for use across four crop zones. Distribute these canisters as follows: deliver three canisters to Irrigation Node West, two to Irrigation Node Central, and three to Irrigation Node East, making sure to deposit the remaining three canisters at Irrigation Node South, clearly handling any leftover units if the total cannot be split evenly. For each delivery location, wait until local field staff confirm that the canisters are ready for deployment before departing to the next node. After all nutrient canisters have been successfully allocated and receipt confirmed at every Irrigation Node, proceed to the Central Drone Launch Pad; pause for six minutes to await synchronization procedures with aerial monitoring teams before returning to the Fertilizer Storage Depot for inventory reconciliation.

Begin your assignment at Grain Silo East by collecting twelve sealed fertilizer totes prepared for seasonal distribution. Navigate first to Crop Field Section A and transfer five totes, then remain on-site for four minutes to allow the agronomist to verify tote integrity. Once the wait concludes, proceed to Crop Field Section B to unload another four fertilizer totes, remaining there until the field supervisor confirms removal. Carry the final three totes to Greenhouse Intake Dock; if the dock is currently processing a delivery and is unavailable, wait at the dock until the receiving signal is given. When all fertilizer totes have been successfully handed over and confirmations logged at each destination, return to Grain Silo East, and remain there until further instructions are dispatched by logistics control.

Begin at Storage Depot Alpha and verify the availability of eight sealed fertilizer canisters. Once all canisters are ready, collect them and proceed to Field South. Deposit three fertilizer canisters at Field South and remain on site until the field supervisor has confirmed removal of each canister. After completion, head to Orchard East with three additional canisters and wait there for two minutes to allow the irrigation team to prepare the distribution equipment before handing over the fertilizer, making certain that each transfer is acknowledged. Deliver the remaining two canisters to Greenhouse Gamma, but only perform the canister handoff if confirmation has been received that the previous drop-offs at both Field South and Orchard East were successfully completed. Stay at Greenhouse Gamma until the greenhouse manager reports that all canisters have been safely stored. Finally, return to Storage Depot Alpha and remain for three minutes to allow for inventory reconciliation before proceeding with further tasks.

Load eight labeled coolant canisters from the Parts Storage Room and proceed directly to Engine Test Station Alpha, where you must unload three coolant canisters and wait until engineering staff finish connecting all three to the test rigs. Once staff confirm all canisters are in use, continue to the Central Maintenance Hub with the remaining five coolant canisters, depositing four of them and remaining at the hub for three minutes so maintenance personnel can initiate their system checks. After receiving clearance from the hub supervisor, deliver the last coolant canister to Generator Bay Two, waiting there until the generator operator signals the canister has been installed. Upon successful completion of all deliveries and verifications, return to the Parts Storage Room to stand by for your next assignment.

Start your mission at Warehouse Gate 2, where you will load fifteen water purification cartridges onto the transport sled. Deliver five cartridges to Irrigation Pumping Station West, five to Irrigation Pumping Station East, and allocate the remaining five in single units to each of the following stations—Field Hydration Node 1, Node 2, Node 3, Node 4, and Node 5—ensuring each location receives exactly one cartridge. Once you have completed the drop-offs at both Pumping Stations, pause for six minutes at Pumping Station East to allow operators to synchronize system settings and confirm cartridge installation. Only after receiving this confirmation should you proceed with deliveries to the Field Hydration Nodes. After distributing cartridges to all destinations and acknowledging the last delivery at Node 5 with the site manager, return to Warehouse Gate 2, but remain outside the entry bay for an additional four minutes if you encountered any issues with cartridge access or delayed confirmations along your route, to allow for further maintenance checks before concluding your shift.

Begin by going to the Main Fertilizer Depot to load twelve fertilizer canisters, then proceed to deliver the fertilizer canisters in batches among the three designated zones: deliver five canisters to Orchard West, four canisters to Vineyard North, and three canisters to Greenhouse Central. For each location, wait until the grounds crew at that site confirms that all fertilizer canisters have been removed before departing to the next zone. Once the final delivery is accepted in Greenhouse Central, remain on site for 10 minutes to allow for system calibration and air quality checks; only after completing this wait period should you return to the Main Fertilizer Depot. If any destination is inaccessible and canisters remain undelivered, return directly to the Main Fertilizer Depot with the undelivered canisters before ending your shift.

Start at the Central Supply Depot and collect a shipment of nine nutrient sensor modules earmarked for distribution across three experimental plots. Travel first to Plot North and deliver three sensor modules, remaining at this location for four minutes while agronomy staff install and activate each module. Proceed next to Plot East with another three modules for delivery, again pausing for four minutes to support installation activities as directed by the field team. Bring the remaining three modules to Plot South; after completing the final transfer, wait for two more minutes to allow the research team to calibrate the deployed sensors. Once the waiting period in Plot South concludes, immediately return to the Central Supply Depot and await confirmation from the project coordinator that all modules have passed activation tests before powering down for maintenance.

Start at Maintenance Bay Delta and wait until two palletized seed dispensers are declared ready for transport by the equipment technician. Upon confirmation of readiness, move both seed dispensers to the Harvesting Equipment Garage. Once at the garage, unload one seed dispenser and remain on site until the garage supervisor signs off that the dispenser is properly installed. Transport the remaining seed dispenser to Field Plot 7A, then pause for three minutes before entering the field station to give the local crew time to finish previous equipment setup. After the three-minute waiting period, deliver the seed dispenser to Field Plot 7A and wait until the planting machinery operator confirms the delivery is complete. Only after both seed dispensers have been received and acknowledged at their separate destinations should you proceed to return to Maintenance Bay Delta, where you will remain for seven minutes to allow the maintenance chief to review your transport log before you are cleared for your next assignment.

Start at the Maintenance Garage and collect nine containers of lubricant fluid, ensuring each container is securely prepared for transit. Next, proceed to Pumping Station West and deliver three containers directly to the supply bench, where you must wait to confirm all three containers have been removed by the maintenance team before moving forward. After this confirmation, travel to Field Machine Shed Bravo to drop off another three containers at the machinery servicing area; remain on-site until these are acknowledged as fully unloaded by the equipment supervisor. The final three remaining containers should then be transported to Wind Turbine Base Station, where you will wait for the turbine engineer to validate complete removal before leaving. Once all containers have been distributed and removal confirmations received at each of the three destinations, return to the Maintenance Garage and remain idle for a total of five minutes so garage staff can perform intake checks on your internal storage compartments before new tasks are assigned.

Begin your assignment at the Central Storage Bay by retrieving a pallet containing twenty-one greenhouse monitoring sensors bound for three separate research sites. Your first destination should be Field Lab West, where you will deliver eight sensors and stay until the field engineer physically removes each sensor from the pallet and provides verbal confirmation. Following this, proceed directly to Nursery Station South to drop off seven of the remaining sensors, but before moving on to the final site, wait at Nursery Station South for five minutes to allow the technical staff to perform initial diagnostics on the inventory. After the waiting period ends and all seven sensors have been received, transport the final six sensors to Crop Trials Facility East; at this location, wait until all sensors have been fully removed from the pallet and the facility manager authorizes your departure. Only after all sensors are distributed, acknowledgments are obtained, and time requirements are met at each stop, return to the Central Storage Bay to complete your delivery cycle.

Starting at Loading Bay 3, acquire twelve seedling trays destined for this morning’s greenhouse allocation. Your first stop is Greenhouse A, where you are to deliver five seedling trays to the horticulture supervisor; stay onsite until each tray has been removed for inspection. Once Greenhouse A’s delivery is complete, navigate to Greenhouse B and provide four seedling trays to the nursery technician—after arrival, remain idle for four minutes to allow climate stabilization in the receiving area before payload transfer, then confirm removal of all trays. The last three seedling trays are allocated to Greenhouse C; proceed there, deliver the trays, and remain at Greenhouse C for six minutes to accommodate any urgent planting instructions from the agronomy staff. After all seedling trays are distributed, and each waiting period and confirmation step has been fulfilled, return directly to Loading Bay 3 to await your next horticultural task.

Start by making your way to Grain Processing Dock 3 to collect a bundle containing seventeen precision-weigh crop samples needed for laboratory testing. After securing the bundle, travel directly to Agricultural Lab Entrance and deliver the first six crop samples, then pause at the lab’s intake desk and remain there for four minutes to enable technicians to log and process the incoming samples. Following this wait, proceed to Storage Room Alpha with the remaining eleven samples, where you will split them by depositing five samples into Locker A and six samples into Locker B, ensuring each drop is completed before proceeding to the next. Once all samples are stored in their respective lockers, return to Grain Processing Dock 3 to confirm with the dock supervisor that the empty bundle has been returned properly, then remain at the dock for six minutes to accommodate potential transport container checks before concluding your shift.

Start your task at Seed Warehouse 2 and wait for the inventory controller to confirm that a total of 19 seed supply crates are prepared and secured for transfer. Once all crates are loaded, proceed directly to Crop Test Plot Alpha, where you are to offload 6 seed supply crates, remaining at Crop Test Plot Alpha until a field technician has recorded and removed each crate individually. Immediately after, go to Precision Planter Station, unload 7 seed supply crates, and wait an additional four minutes to allow staff to verify the planter compatibility of each crate before leaving the site. Transport the remaining 6 seed supply crates to Nursery Expansion Area; upon your arrival, deliver 4 seed supply crates straightaway and then wait until the nursery manager verifies storage space is available before offloading the final 2 crates. If at any destination a staff member refuses a crate due to discrepancy or storage limitation, reroute any undelivered crates to Seed Warehouse 2, unload them there, and inform the inventory controller. Once all seed supply crates are distributed or returned and each site’s staff completes their respective intake process, return to Seed Warehouse 2 and await further deployment orders.

Start your task at Storage Shed Alpha, where you will collect a set of eight spare hydraulic pumps scheduled for distribution to three separate repair stations: Workshop Delta, Equipment Ramp Bravo, and Field Outpost Echo.
