Prior to unloading at the East Crop Test Plot, ensure that the test plot agronomist has verified storage readiness; only after confirmation should you release the final set of canisters. After all deliveries are complete and all recipients have acknowledged removal of their respective nitrogen canisters, return to the Fertilizer Storage Depot and remain parked outside for four minutes to finalize delivery logs and synchronize with the central inventory database.

Commence your shift at Loading Dock Alpha and collect a stack of sixteen small machine part boxes designated for three different workshop bays. Once the boxes are loaded, proceed to Assembly Workshop One and offload five machine part boxes, ensuring you wait at Assembly Workshop One until their inventory technician scans and removes each box individually from the cart. After confirming all five boxes are received at Assembly Workshop One, advance to Calibration Lab Delta to deliver another six machine part boxes; upon arrival at Calibration Lab Delta, hold position until the calibration supervisor completes an inspection of the delivered boxes and authorizes you to depart. Move on to Maintenance Bay Seven with the last five machine part boxes, but before starting the unload at Maintenance Bay Seven, remain idle for four minutes to safely allow fork-lift operations in the receiving area to finish. Once the four-minute waiting period elapses, unload the remaining machine part boxes at Maintenance Bay Seven, ensuring all five are present and acknowledged by the maintenance foreman. Return any signed delivery paperwork to Loading Dock Alpha after all boxes are distributed and confirmations are received from each location before ending your delivery route.

Begin your operation at Seed Warehouse A by securing a batch of thirteen sealed corn seed crates for field distribution. Set your course for Field 4 South, but pause outside Field 4 South for three minutes to allow the crew leader time to position field unloading equipment; unload five corn seed crates at Field 4 South once the crew leader signals readiness and confirms safe access to the loading zone. As soon as all five crates have been handed over, travel to Field 7 East with the next four corn seed crates, but do not attempt to offload until receiving confirmation from the irrigation system operator that the soil is sufficiently dry for seed placement. Once the operator has indicated safe conditions and taken all four seed crates, proceed to the last delivery stop at Test Field 1Z, where you will distribute the remaining four corn seed crates to the agronomy research team. If any crates were unable to be delivered at a prior stop due to access restrictions or failed readiness checks, reroute to Storage Silo E and deposit those undelivered seed crates for later collection before returning directly to Seed Warehouse A. Upon final return, remain stationary at Seed Warehouse A for six minutes to enable remote backup of the completed delivery manifest before powering down.

Commence your route at Agricultural Supply Center Delta, where you must obtain a consignment of twelve irrigation valve kits once the package has been verified by the dispatch supervisor. Your itinerary is to distribute these valve kits among three locations as follows: first, travel to Greenhouse Block A and deliver four valve kits, ensuring you wait until the Greenhouse Block A manager has individually removed all units from your payload before proceeding. Next, proceed to Orchard Storage Barn and pause for five minutes upon arrival to allow for the assembly crew to prepare the barn site before offloading the next four valve kits; verify that each kit is removed by the crew before you leave. Then, the last four valve kits are to be delivered to Vine Terrace Tool Shed, but only begin the transfer after receiving confirmation from the Tool Shed operator that access is clear and a technician is present on site. Following successful handover at all three destinations, promptly return to Agricultural Supply Center Delta and remain at Docking Bay 3 for a three-minute post-mission maintenance check before you stand by for further instructions.

Begin your route at the Fertilizer Depot and wait until the pallet containing sixty fertilizer bags is ready for collection as confirmed by warehouse staff. Once loaded, undertake a distribution route to deliver these bags to four different orchard storage sheds: allot seventeen bags to Orchard Shed A first, fifteen bags to Orchard Shed B, thirteen bags to Orchard Shed C, and then bring the remaining fifteen bags, explicitly assigning any leftover bags due to indivisible quantities to Orchard Shed D. At each shed, wait until the respective farm supervisor has removed all delivered fertilizer bags before proceeding to the next destination. After all fertilizer bags are successfully distributed and offloaded, navigate to Field Monitoring Station 7, where you must remain for nine uninterrupted minutes to enable post-delivery system diagnostics before finally returning directly to the Fertilizer Depot to complete your delivery cycle.

Begin your route in the Tool Inventory Bay, where you must collect a total of eleven diagnostic sensor kits, each clearly labeled for their specific final location. First, take five sensor kits to Maintenance Station Alpha; upon arrival, wait for the senior technician to prepare the intake area, and only hand over the kits when readiness is confirmed. Once the five sensor kits have been removed at Maintenance Station Alpha, proceed to Calibration Lab 1 with three more sensor kits, pausing outside the lab for two full minutes to allow sensitive calibration equipment to reach the required stabilization temperature before entering and delivering the sensor kits. After these deliveries are confirmed, your final task is to transfer the remaining three sensor kits to Storage Locker Omega, but only if an alert is received that Storage Locker Omega has been cleared of expired stock—this clearance is permissible solely after the prior two deliveries are completed. Following the removal of the sensor kits at Storage Locker Omega, wait there for an additional minute to synchronize your task logs with the central management system before returning to the Tool Inventory Bay to conclude operations for the day.

Begin at Loading Dock Bravo and collect twelve crates of harvested tomatoes that await transfer. Evenly distribute these crates among Packing Station A, Storage Cooler 2, and Quality Control Lab, allocating four crates to each destination so that all twelve crates are accounted for. After delivering crates to Packing Station A, do not leave until the packing supervisor signals that the unloading process is complete. Proceed next to Storage Cooler 2, and remain there for a mandatory five-minute interval to give the refrigeration technician time to inspect the crate temperatures and approve storage. Only after this pause may you advance to the Quality Control Lab. Upon arrival at the Quality Control Lab, wait until the lab manager confirms sample extraction is finished before you unload the final set of crates. Once all crates have been handed off, all wait times fulfilled, and each destination’s protocol completed, return without delay to Loading Dock Bravo and stand by for further tomato harvest transfers.

Begin at Supply Depot Delta and collect a total of fifteen crop nutrient canisters, ensuring all canisters are secured for transit. Evenly distribute these canisters by first transporting five canisters to Field Distribution Node A; after each delivery, remain at Field Distribution Node A for three minutes to verify automated injection machinery successfully loads each canister, and proceed only after confirmation is complete. Once all five canisters have been delivered and verified at Node A, continue by taking another five canisters to Field Distribution Node B, but do not begin unloading until the field operator at Node B signals readiness; after unloading each of these five canisters, wait for four minutes to monitor initial nutrient dispersal performance as per protocol. Deliver the final five canisters, one by one, to the Vertical Farm Loading Bay, remaining at the Vertical Farm Loading Bay after each drop-off until the inventory manager removes each canister from your cargo. Upon completing all fifteen deliveries and confirming the removal or successful handoff of each nutrient canister at their respective destinations, proceed directly to the Equipment Maintenance Shed and wait for ten minutes, allowing maintenance staff to conduct post-delivery inspection of your transport platform before concluding your tasks by returning to Supply Depot Delta.

Start your operation at the Loading Dock, where you must pick up a set of twelve diagnostic toolkits intended for distribution to Maintenance Bay A, Maintenance Bay B, and Maintenance Bay C. Deliver five diagnostic toolkits to Maintenance Bay A first, and remain at that bay until the technician confirms removal of all five toolkits. After receiving confirmation at Maintenance Bay A, proceed to Maintenance Bay B and supply it with another four diagnostic toolkits; pause at this location for three minutes to permit the maintenance crew to run initial equipment checks using the delivered toolkits. Once the waiting period is complete, continue to Maintenance Bay C to deliver the remaining three diagnostic toolkits, staying until the bay supervisor acknowledges full receipt and removal. Only after all toolkits have been delivered and acknowledgements from each bay have been received should you head back to the Loading Dock, where you will wait an additional five minutes to support any urgent retrievals before ending your shift.

Begin at Seed Storage Facility A and collect a batch of twenty-three labeled seed packets intended for three field zones. Transport the batch first to Field Zone West, where you will unload eight seed packets and remain on site until the irrigation technician confirms the packets are safely incorporated into the sowing apparatus; this confirmation is required before moving on. Next, proceed to Nursery Building Two to deliver another eight seed packets, but only distribute them after waiting for two minutes to allow nursery staff to prepare their seedling trays. Complete the route by delivering the final seven seed packets to Field Zone South—if the greenhouse supervisor at Field Zone South indicates the receiving tables are occupied, wait five minutes to enable the transfer of prior inventory before proceeding with the packet delivery. After all seed packets have been properly distributed and receipt is acknowledged at each zone, return to Seed Storage Facility A and wait in the departure lane until further instructions are issued.

Begin at the Bulk Seed Storage Facility, where you are tasked with collecting fifteen bags of certified wheat seeds after confirming they are ready for transport. Evenly distribute the seed bags by making three consecutive deliveries: first, transport five bags to Field Plot Alpha and wait there until you receive a signal that local staff have secured the delivery. Proceed next to Field Plot Bravo with another five bags and remain for three minutes after arrival to ensure accurate handoff during an ongoing field calibration process. Finally, deliver the remaining five seed bags to Field Plot Charlie, but stay onsite until the field supervisor confirms removal of all bags from your payload. Once all fifteen wheat seed bags have been properly delivered and acknowledged at their respective plots, promptly return to the Bulk Seed Storage Facility to complete the seed distribution mission.

Begin your round at Seed Storage Vault and collect a batch of sixteen fertilizer bags slated for distribution. First, transport six of the fertilizer bags to Orchard Plot East; upon arrival, wait outside the entry gate for three minutes to allow field staff to prepare receiving the fertilizer, then deliver the six bags and wait for each bag to be removed individually before proceeding. Next, take five fertilizer bags from Seed Storage Vault to Greenhouse Beta, ensuring you do not enter the greenhouse until the ventilation system indicates safe air quality; after system confirmation, deliver all five bags and remain until the greenhouse supervisor confirms full removal. The final five bags are to be delivered to Crop Field North; if Crop Field North’s loading platform is at capacity when you arrive, wait for four minutes before reattempting entry—if still unavailable after this interval, divert the fertilizer bags to Overflow Shed C. Once all fertilizer has been distributed or stored in Overflow Shed C, return to Seed Storage Vault and pause operations for one minute while your cargo platform is inspected for residue or contamination before concluding your assignment.

Begin at Central Pallet Depot, where you are scheduled to collect a load of fourteen wooden pallets for redistribution. First, transport five of the wooden pallets to Packaging Hall B, ensuring that upon arrival you wait for a packaging technician to signal readiness before offloading begins; wait at Packaging Hall B until all five pallets have been fully removed by staff. Next, deliver another five wooden pallets to Assembly Platform 2, but after arriving at Assembly Platform 2, remain stationary for four minutes to allow assembly workers to clear space prior to offloading— do not begin pallet removal until this waiting period has elapsed. For the final four wooden pallets, proceed to Maintenance Storage Shed; after reaching Maintenance Storage Shed, distribute all four pallets and wait for the storage attendant to finish his inventory check and remove the pallets from your cargo platform. Once all deliveries are completed and confirmed, return immediately to Central Pallet Depot and await a final clearance from the shift overseer before powering down, which may only occur after confirmation that every destination confirmed full removal of their allocated wooden pallets.

Start from the Equipment Service Garage and prepare to shuttle a total of ten diagnostic sensor modules to three different destinations: Field Maintenance Shed, North Orchard Workshop, and Storage Silo 2. First, take four sensor modules to the Field Maintenance Shed and wait at the location until a technician indicates that all four modules have been removed from the robot. After successful offloading, wait for exactly three minutes to allow staff at the Field Maintenance Shed to perform preliminary calibrations before proceeding. Next, transport another three sensor modules to the North Orchard Workshop, ensuring you remain on site until personnel confirm that all three sensor modules have been removed. Only after both prior deliveries have been fully completed, deliver the last three sensor modules to Storage Silo 2, again waiting until silo operations staff have finished unloading all modules. Once all ten diagnostic sensor modules have been delivered and the mandatory waiting period at the Field Maintenance Shed has elapsed, return directly to the Equipment Service Garage to complete your route.

Begin at Chemical Storage Bay Delta to collect nine containers of fertilizer marked for Field Plot 4, Greenhouse 2, and Vine Nursery 7. Deliver three containers each to Field Plot 4 and Greenhouse 2, dropping off the assigned containers at Field Plot 4 first, then waiting two minutes to allow the farm supervisor to inspect and authorize the offloading. After field supervisor authorization is complete, continue directly to Greenhouse 2, unload three more containers, and remain there for four minutes, giving the greenhouse staff enough time to move the fertilizer into secure storage. Take the final three containers to Vine Nursery 7; however, only offload the containers if the vine technician has finished preparing the storage racks—otherwise, wait at the nursery for up to five minutes for rack preparation before proceeding with the handoff. Once all containers have been delivered and confirmed at their destinations, return to Chemical Storage Bay Delta and wait in standby mode for three minutes to allow for refill or decontamination processes before receiving any new assignments.

Starting at the fertilizer mixing shed, collect a container holding sixteen liters of liquid fertilizer and transport it to Field Plot East. Evenly distribute five liters of fertilizer at Field Plot East and wait for the agronomist to verify application completion before leaving. Next, travel to Field Plot North to apply another five liters, but pause for three minutes upon arrival to allow remote sensors to calibrate nutrient absorption rates. After the waiting period, finish distribution at Field Plot North and then proceed to Field Plot South, where the remaining six liters must be delivered. If at Field Plot South the crop maintenance crew has not yet cleared the sprayer docking area, remain on standby until the area is accessible and the container can be fully emptied. Lastly, once all distribution tasks at each plot have been executed and confirmed, return the empty container to the fertilizer mixing shed’s cleaning bay and wait there for further sanitation instructions.

Begin your operations at the Central Harvest Dock by collecting a shipment of twenty-seven nutrient supplement crates to be distributed among the Cereal Grain Silo, the Orchard Fertilizer Shed, and the Livestock Feed Depot. Load all crates and wait until dock personnel confirm the shipment is securely fastened. Deliver nine crates to the Cereal Grain Silo, but after arrival, remain parked for two minutes to allow the silo’s automated lift to stabilize before offloading; do not allow crate removal until this stabilization period has lapsed. Following successful crate transfer, transport nine additional crates to the Orchard Fertilizer Shed, and wait for confirmation from shed staff that prior deliveries have been fully received before permitting removal of this batch. The final nine supplement crates are earmarked for the Livestock Feed Depot, but before offloading, pause for four minutes at the depot entrance to enable the livestock area to be secured; once the area is clear and depot workers provide confirmation, proceed with the crate transfer. After all twenty-seven supplement crates have been delivered and acknowledged at their respective sites, return to the Central Harvest Dock, and remain stationed there for at least five minutes to complete end-of-route diagnostics.

Begin your task at the Central Seed Vault, where you must collect a total of sixteen high-value soybean seed bags destined for four separate planting locations. Initially, transport five seed bags to South Terrace Plot A and remain until the field technician confirms all five seed bags have been unloaded. After successful offloading at South Terrace Plot A, proceed to deliver four seed bags to West Slope Plot B, and wait for a full five minutes on site to allow for inventory checks before leaving. Next, carry three seed bags to East Meadow Plot C, but do not depart the location until after the agronomist has finished inspecting and physically removed all three seed bags from the robot. With the remaining four seed bags, proceed to North Ridge Plot D, waiting there until the seeds have been picked up by the planting crew. Only once all four plot deliveries and their required waiting or confirmation steps are complete, return to the Central Seed Vault and prepare the platform for the next batch transfer mission, ensuring the platform remains idle for at least two minutes upon arrival.

Begin your shift at Workshop Bay C, where you are to retrieve twelve maintenance kits clearly labeled for sector distribution. Proceed directly to Engine Shed 1 and deliver four maintenance kits, waiting there until all kits have been removed by the site engineer before moving to the next step. Next, transport another four maintenance kits to Pump Station East; if the site engineer at Engine Shed 1 identifies any missing or damaged items, remain at Pump Station East for three minutes prior to the technician's removal of the kits to allow for inventory reconciliation. With the remaining four maintenance kits, continue to the Control Tower, where you must wait for explicit confirmation from the supervisor that the location is available before allowing removal of the maintenance kits. After all kits have been successfully delivered and removed at their assigned locations, and all conditional waiting periods are complete, return promptly to Workshop Bay C to mark the task sequence as finalized and await further dispatch orders.

Start at the Loading Bay at Manufacturing Plant B, where a total of twenty-four engine filter modules are prepared for same-day distribution. Collect the full set of filter modules from the Loading Bay, then travel first to Maintenance Garage North and deliver eight filter modules, pausing at the site until each module is verified as received and logged by the shift supervisor. After confirmation at Maintenance Garage North, proceed with the subsequent eight filter modules to Fleet Operations Center 3, but wait five minutes upon arrival to allow the operations crew to organize the intake before starting the offload. After the full delivery is processed and acceptance is confirmed by Fleet Operations Center 3, transport the final eight filter modules to Emergency Equipment Depot East. Ensure that, before unloading the last batch at Emergency Equipment Depot East, you have received confirmation from both prior drop-off locations that their deliveries are complete—if any confirmation is delayed, remain in place at the depot until all acknowledgments are received. Following successful transfer of all filter modules across the three destinations, navigate to the Central Calibration Stand and wait for seven minutes while system diagnostics are performed before concluding your route.

Start at Central Parts Inventory and collect nine replacement hydraulic valve blocks, confirming the correct count before departure. Transport three valve blocks first to Repair Shed Alpha and remain at the site for two minutes to allow the maintenance crew to remove the faulty units before you transfer the new valve blocks. After the technician at Repair Shed Alpha confirms receipt, proceed to Machine Bay Delta, where you will deliver another three valve blocks; wait for four minutes at Machine Bay Delta while the installation crew completes their preliminary diagnostics. Only once the handoff and diagnostic confirmation at Machine Bay Delta have occurred should you advance to Field Support Post Gamma and provide the final three valve blocks to the field engineers. If confirmation of deliveries at both Repair Shed Alpha and Machine Bay Delta has not been received upon arrival at Field Support Post Gamma, wait there in one-minute intervals, up to a maximum of five minutes, for any missing clearance before returning all undelivered valve blocks to Central Parts Inventory. After every delivery has been confirmed or any undelivered items are brought back, return to Central Parts Inventory and remain there until the logistics coordinator assigns the next task.

Initiate operations at Storage Facility A, where you are to receive a batch of eleven sealed seed crates—wait until all eleven crates have been verified as loaded onto your transport compartment. Once loaded, travel first to Tractor Maintenance Bay and deliver four seed crates; after the maintenance crew at Tractor Maintenance Bay confirms removal of all four crates, proceed to Greenhouse 7 to drop off another four seed crates, ensuring you remain onsite until each crate is individually logged and removed by the greenhouse technicians. After completing the deliveries to Greenhouse 7, pause at Greenhouse 7 for six minutes to accommodate post-delivery inspection protocols before departing. With the final three seed crates still on board, head to Field Staging Area 3 and deliver the remaining crates; if Field Staging Area 3’s supervisor is unavailable upon arrival, you must remain at the area until the supervisor arrives and authorizes removal. Only after all eleven seed crates have been accepted and logged at their respective destinations should you return directly to Storage Facility A for debrief and unloading, disregarding return until you have proper confirmation from all recipient sites.

Commence operations by traveling to Packing Facility Dock 3 to pick up twenty-one crates of fresh produce labeled for delivery. Each crate must be distributed among three destinations: deliver seven crates to Retail Storefront West, eight crates to Community Food Bank North, and the remaining six crates to School Cafeteria South, ensuring the totals match exactly with no crates left over. Upon arrival at each location, wait until the receiving supervisor signals that the loading bay is ready before proceeding to unload; at the Retail Storefront West, wait four minutes after unloading for final inventory verification before departing. At Community Food Bank North, only advance to School Cafeteria South once all eight crates are confirmed received and you have waited an additional two minutes as requested for quality checks. Upon arriving at School Cafeteria South, if the cafeteria staff are delayed, wait five minutes outside before attempting delivery again. Once all twenty-one crates have been delivered and acknowledged at every destination with their respective timing requirements, return promptly to Packing Facility Dock 3 and wait for the logistics coordinator to confirm you are cleared for your next assignment.

Start at the Seed Distribution Depot and load a shipment of nine precision-sealed seed canisters designated for the upcoming planting cycle. First, proceed to Greenhouse Section A and distribute three seed canisters, then wait five minutes while the horticulture supervisor initiates the automated seeding system and confirms acceptance of all canisters. Next, travel to Greenhouse Section B to deliver another three seed canisters, but do not initiate the handover until confirmation arrives that Greenhouse Section A’s canisters have been fully unpacked; once this is received, wait for the staff manager to remove Section B’s canisters before continuing. For the final three seed canisters, make your way to Open Field Plot #7; upon arrival, pause for two minutes to allow field sensors to prepare, and then release the remaining canisters for field teams. Once all seed canisters have been distributed and their retrieval confirmed at each destination, return to the Seed Distribution Depot for a thorough system diagnostic and refill procedures.

Start at Warehouse Central and collect a total of twenty-seven fertilizer drums labeled for seasonal distribution. First, proceed to Field Station Delta and allocate nine drums; after offloading, remain at Field Station Delta for three minutes to allow soil technicians to connect and test the fertilizer mixers. Once the mixing confirmation is received, move to Field Station Echo with the next batch and deliver nine more fertilizer drums, again pausing for four minutes at their equipment yard to provide time for system integration checks. The remaining nine drums are to be transported to Field Station Foxtrot, but only begin the transfer after verifying that Field Station Echo's delivery is fully confirmed and any empty containers have been removed from the unloading zone. At Field Station Foxtrot, wait precisely five minutes after depositing the drums so water management teams can recalibrate their distribution channels. When all stations have received their drum allotments, return any unused shipping pallets to Warehouse Central before proceeding to the Service Garage to complete your task log for the day.

Start your route at Storage Depot West, collecting a stack of ten seed crates destined for timely distribution among South Field Plot 7, Irrigation Control Hub, North Orchard Lot 2, and the Greenhouse Loading Dock. Make your first delivery by taking three seed crates to South Field Plot 7 and wait there until the field supervisor indicates all crates are unloaded and properly logged. Once departed from South Field Plot 7, proceed to Irrigation Control Hub to deposit two seed crates; after arrival, remain for four minutes to allow hub staff to check crate contents for moisture levels before acknowledging receipt. Next, transport another three seed crates to North Orchard Lot 2, but do not proceed until you receive official confirmation from Irrigation Control Hub that the crates have passed inspection and been recorded in the inventory system—even if delay occurs, hold position at the hub. After notification, head to North Orchard Lot 2, unload the crates, and stay until the orchard manager signals that both receiving and placement are complete. To handle the two remaining seed crates, deliver them to Greenhouse Loading Dock. Upon unloading at the loading dock, wait at least five minutes to allow greenhouse staff time to prep storage space and confirm safe transfer of the seed crates. After all steps are finalized with completion signals from every recipient, return immediately to Storage Depot West and stand by for further assignment.

Begin by collecting a total of sixteen fertilizer bags from Warehouse 2, destined for three key field storage sites. First, transport and deliver seven fertilizer bags to Field Storage Alpha, remaining onsite until all bags have been individually confirmed as offloaded by the storage supervisor. Once this delivery is fully completed, proceed to Field Storage Bravo with five fertilizer bags; upon arrival at Field Storage Bravo, wait for exactly eight minutes to allow the field crew to prepare proper ventilation protocols before any unloading begins, then deliver the five bags and stay until they have all been removed. After Bravo’s handoff, bring the final four fertilizer bags to Field Storage Charlie. After unloading each of these bags at Field Storage Charlie, remain at the site for three minutes to accommodate last-minute inventory checks by the agronomy coordinator. Only after all fertilizer bags have been distributed, all waiting periods observed, and all confirmation steps completed at each field storage area, return directly to Warehouse 2 and await further transportation instructions from the logistics manager.

Begin your route in Packing Area 3 and wait until four boxes of fragile electronics have been prepared by the loading coordinator. Once the boxes are ready, deliver one box each to Assembly Line Alpha, Assembly Line Beta, and Assembly Line Gamma, while the fourth and final box should be taken to Quality Control Lab. For each assembly line delivery, do not depart until a technician at the respective location has physically removed the box from the robot. Following the drop-off at Quality Control Lab, remain on site for five minutes to allow inspectors sufficient time to perform an initial unpacking check before proceeding. After all four boxes have been correctly delivered and their removal acknowledged at all locations, return directly to Packing Area 3, but only conclude your route after reporting to the loading coordinator for a final inventory confirmation.

Begin at Bulk Fertilizer Storage and collect five sealed fertilizer drums labeled 'Type A7.' Travel first to Loading Dock One and offload two fertilizer drums, waiting for the dock attendant at Loading Dock One to signal readiness before leaving each drum; if the dock is temporarily occupied, remain outside for up to three minutes, retrying entry each half-minute, until admitted or until three minutes elapse. After completing the delivery at Loading Dock One, proceed to Irrigation Pump Station Two, where you will deposit another two fertilizer drums, but only after an engineer at Irrigation Pump Station Two verifies acceptance following a visual check; if the engineer is delayed, wait for ninety seconds before attempting to alert station staff again. Finally, transport the last fertilizer drum to Glasshouse Delta, depositing it directly at the marked supply bay, and then stay at Glasshouse Delta for four minutes to assist with any urgent supply requests. Once this holding time ends, return to Bulk Fertilizer Storage, but if any of the previous locations notify that a drum delivery failed, make an immediate return trip to the affected location with a replacement drum if available, otherwise report back and stand by at Bulk Fertilizer Storage for further instructions.

Begin at Loading Bay 3 and await the attachment of the fertilizer container labeled Batch-92. Once Batch-92 is securely mounted, proceed to Field Section East-A and deliver four units of fertilizer; wait until the automated spreader arm removes these units and signals completion. Afterward, continue to Orchard Lot 5 and unload another four units, but pause for five minutes at Orchard Lot 5 to allow soil moisture readings before release. Retain the final two units and travel directly to Meadow Plot Zeta, only unloading the remaining fertilizer units there once remote monitoring control verifies that Plot Zeta’s irrigation cycle is inactive. Following the confirmed drop-off at Meadow Plot Zeta, return to Loading Bay 3 regardless of current workload, waiting at least two minutes before commencing any new assignment.

Begin your operation at the Central Packing Hall where you must collect eighteen sealed produce crates for distribution across three cold storage units: Cold Storage Alpha, Cold Storage Beta, and Cold Storage Gamma. First, make your way to Cold Storage Alpha to deliver seven sealed produce crates; after unloading each crate, remain at Cold Storage Alpha until a quality control sensor signals crate integrity is uncompromised, repeating this process for all seven crates. Once every crate has passed inspection at Cold Storage Alpha, proceed directly to Cold Storage Beta with another six sealed produce crates, but upon arrival, do not initiate unloading until the cold storage controller transmits a readiness alert—once this signal is received, unload the crates, then wait a total of five minutes to allow temperature stabilization within Cold Storage Beta before departing. Finally, transport the remaining five sealed produce crates to Cold Storage Gamma, but deliver these only if digital logs confirm that the full deliveries at both Alpha and Beta are completed and verified; upon unloading each crate, wait for the facility supervisor to confirm removal before handling the next crate. Once all eighteen crates have been delivered, verified, or removed at their respective destinations, return without cargo to Central Packing Hall and remain stationary for six minutes to run post-route cleaning and diagnostic routines before concluding your mission.

Initiate operations at Parts Warehouse A to retrieve seven sealed engine coolant canisters required for the next maintenance cycle. Transport three canisters to Maintenance Bay North as your first stop, then wait until the maintenance lead has verified that all three canisters have been inspected and logged on the bay inventory system before proceeding. After confirmation, deliver two more canisters to Vehicle Garage 3, where you must wait for six minutes to allow garage personnel to unload the coolant and transport them into secure storage; use this time to ensure no canisters remain on your payload. The remaining two canisters should be delivered to Field Service Trailer 5, but only complete the offload if at least one technician is present at the trailer—if not, wait at the location for up to four minutes until a technician arrives to receive the delivery. Once all deliveries are verified, return directly to Parts Warehouse A and remain stationary for five minutes to undergo a mandatory system diagnostic check before any new outbound tasks are initiated.

Begin at Loader Bay A and collect a batch of seven engine diagnostic kits, ensuring all are accounted for before departure. Transport three diagnostic kits to Maintenance Hangar 5 and remain at the hangar until maintenance staff confirm the removal of each kit from your payload. Once the kits have been offloaded, proceed to Parts Storage Shed C with another three diagnostic kits, but pause on arrival for six minutes to allow the storage supervisors to prepare the intake area before you transfer the kits; if intake remains unprepared after six minutes, check in every one and a half minutes until clearance is received. Finally, deliver the seventh engine diagnostic kit to Mobile Fleet Service Point and wait there until a technician confirms readiness to receive the kit. After all seven kits have been delivered and acknowledged at their respective destinations, continue on to Power Unit Charging Area D and remain docked for twelve minutes to complete a routine recharge cycle before heading back to Loader Bay A for your next assignment.

Start at the Central Packing Facility and wait until Package Set Bravo is flagged as ready for dispatch. Once Package Set Bravo is available, carry it to Loading Dock One and remain until all hazardous materials within Package Set Bravo are safely removed by certified personnel. After hazardous material removal is acknowledged, deliver the remaining contents of Package Set Bravo to Storage Depot Gamma, where you must wait for twelve minutes to allow for proper inventory logging. As soon as this logging period ends, retrieve the empty containers from Storage Depot Gamma and visit Quality Control Station Six; only proceed if you confirmed that every container is marked as inspected. If any container is not approved at Quality Control Station Six, instead transport only the failed containers to Reprocessing Area Two and remain for five minutes to enable contamination checks. Finally, after all successful containers have been processed—or after failed ones have been left at Reprocessing Area Two—navigate back to the Central Packing Facility to complete the cycle.

Begin at Storage Silo Delta and wait until twelve sealed grain bags have been loaded onto your cargo platform by the supply technician. After all twelve grain bags are confirmed as secure, sequentially deliver four grain bags each to Feed Mill Station 1, Feed Mill Station 2, and Distribution Shed B, ensuring that any remaining bags beyond exact multiples of four are brought to Distribution Shed B as well. At each Feed Mill Station, wait for the station supervisor to indicate readiness for grain bag removal before you unload the corresponding four bags, and do not leave the station until all the bags have been offloaded by the staff. For Distribution Shed B, pause for two minutes after arrival to allow the dust suppression system to complete its cycle before you deliver the assigned grain bags. Do not depart from Distribution Shed B until the inventory clerk has acknowledged removal of all grain bags allocated for that destination. After all twelve grain bags have been dropped at their designated locations and their removal confirmed, proceed directly to Robot Charging Pad Echo and remain there until your onboard charging cycle reaches 100 percent, as verified by the monitoring system.

Begin your mission by arriving at Grain Silo #1 to collect a harvest batch consisting of twenty sacks of barley, ensuring that all sacks are ready before departure. Once the entire batch has been loaded and confirmed, transport seven sacks of barley to Brewing Facility Alpha; upon reaching Brewing Facility Alpha, remain on site until all seven sacks are offloaded and a quality control sign-off is received from the supervisor. Next, travel to Feed Processing Unit B with another seven sacks of barley, but wait for five minutes after arrival to allow the processing crew to prepare the intake conveyor system before permitting unloading and confirming the full removal of all sacks assigned to Feed Processing Unit B. After both partial deliveries, proceed with the remaining six sacks of barley to Livestock Enclosure East, and if the animal feed storage area is temporarily inaccessible, wait until storage access is granted, then stay until the staff fully removes and counts the barley sacks. Only once all sacks have been distributed and acknowledgements at each site are complete should you navigate to Fleet Charging Station Zeta, where you must remain docked for nine minutes to complete a full recharge cycle before finishing your task.

Start your mission at the Maintenance Garage, where you will wait until the machine technician has fully prepared three distinct toolkits labeled Tractor Repair Set, Irrigation Fix Kit, and Combiner Adjustment Bundle for transport. Once all toolkits are confirmed ready, proceed first to Tractor Bay 1 and deliver the Tractor Repair Set, remaining on site until the lead mechanic has removed the toolkit. Next, move on to the Irrigation Control Shed to drop off the Irrigation Fix Kit, but upon arrival, wait for 6 minutes to allow for a critical safety inspection to be completed before the technician retrieves the kit. After completing these two deliveries, travel to the Combiner Hangar and deliver the Combiner Adjustment Bundle, ensuring you only hand over the toolkit if the hangar supervisor has finished earlier maintenance—otherwise, wait an extra 8 minutes until the supervisor signals availability. Once all toolkits have been successfully delivered and acknowledged at their respective locations, return immediately to the Maintenance Garage and remain there for 12 minutes to finalize hand-off documentation and receive any follow-up assignments.

Start at the Robotics Loading Bay and retrieve twelve crates of replacement machine parts, confirming each crate is properly scanned for inventory. Proceed first to Fabrication Unit 3 and deliver four crates; after staff at Fabrication Unit 3 confirm receipt via digital signature, continue to Maintenance Workshop Delta with another four crates and wait at least six minutes to allow their technician team to prepare the workbenches before transfer. After the Maintenance Workshop Delta delivery and confirmation, bring the remaining four crates to Assembly Hall Omega, ensuring delivery only after you have received a clearance signal from Assembly Hall Omega’s supervisor. If at any point a location refuses delivery or takes longer than fifteen minutes to issue confirmation, record the failure and reroute any undelivered crates to Central Storage Vault instead, unloading them there only after receiving access permission. Once all crates are either properly delivered or securely stored, return to the Robotics Loading Bay and wait for three minutes for a post-mission systems review before task completion.

Begin your route at the Seed Storage Warehouse, where you must load twenty-one sealed grain seed crates for multi-location planting preparation. Deliver eight seed crates to Silo Crest Loading Bay in your first trip, then remain at Silo Crest Loading Bay for six minutes to allow on-site personnel to inspect the crate seals and confirm inventory counts before proceeding. After receiving inspection clearance, continue by transporting another eight seed crates to Field Delta Staging Area, staying on site until a field technician completes and records the removal of all eight seed crates from your payload. With the remaining five seed crates, head to the Experimental Plot Access Gate, where you are to transfer the final seed crates and wait an additional five minutes while the research superintendent validates the crate numbers and checks the log entry. Once all seed crates have been fully delivered, inspected, and acknowledged at their respective locations, proceed to the Dockside Cleanup Station and do not leave until sanitation staff have finished unloading all empty delivery trays, signaling the completion of your seed distribution circuit.

Begin your route at the Chemical Storage Warehouse and load exactly fourteen herbicide containers reserved for distribution across three separate paddocks: East Paddock, South Pasture, and West Gully. Deliver the first batch of five containers to East Paddock and, after arrival, wait precisely six minutes to allow the paddock supervisor to validate area safety before releasing the containers. Following confirmation, proceed back to the Chemical Storage Warehouse to retrieve the next batch and take five more herbicide containers to South Pasture; only unload these containers if East Paddock's delivery has been officially logged as received, and remain at South Pasture until the maintenance crew removes the new containers from your cargo. Lastly, for the final delivery to West Gully, transport the remaining four herbicide containers directly, but if prior allotments have left a remainder, allocate any excess to West Gully as well and note the total delivered. Upon arrival, wait for a minimum of three minutes to ensure field equipment calibration, then release all remaining containers. Once the entire allocation has been completed and all confirmation or wait times have passed, journey to the Equipment Servicing Bay for a comprehensive sensor recalibration before standing by for the next assignment.

Begin your circuit by traveling to Fertilizer Storage Shed B to collect a batch of fifteen nutrient bags designated for application across three separate greenhouses. Distribute the fifteen nutrient bags in batches: deliver five bags to Greenhouse Alpha, six bags to Greenhouse Sigma, and four bags to Greenhouse Omega, ensuring that no bags remain in your payload after all three stops. Upon arriving at Greenhouse Alpha, pause for three minutes outside to allow ventilation systems to cycle before unloading the nutrient bags, then resume to Greenhouse Sigma, where the greenhouse manager must confirm completion of the previous delivery before you proceed with unloading the next six bags. Only once the manager at Greenhouse Sigma verifies receipt should you continue to Greenhouse Omega, delivering the last four bags and waiting until all bags have been removed by staff. Following confirmation of empty payload at Greenhouse Omega, return directly to Fertilizer Storage Shed B and remain there until the operations supervisor has checked your cargo compartment for cleanliness and readiness for the subsequent deployment.
